papers.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. While general robotic manipulation has been extensively studied, personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM) lacks a controlled benchmark for separating task completion from preference satisfaction. We introduce LIBERO-PeRM, a benchmark for preference learning in embodied agents. LIBERO-PeRM studies five questions: 1) how policies follow preferences in zero-shot settings; 2) how they learn single preferences from demonstrations; 3) how efficiently they acquire preferences as demonstrations increase; 4) how learned preferences generalize across layouts and tasks; and 5) how policies compose preferences and behave under conflicts. We propose a controlled formulation and taxonomy of observable preferences in simulation, covering motion, skill, and user-profile choices. This formulation is restricted to language-expressible preferences that can be instantiated in LIBERO without changing the task goal, evaluated automatically, and reused across tasks. Building on LIBERO, our procedural pipeline generates paired demonstrations with and without preferences. We create five task suites (312 tasks) with high-quality demonstrations, rich metadata, and preference-satisfaction metrics. Experiments show that current VLA policies struggle with zero-shot personalization, while SFT makes preferences learnable. Mixed training achieves better no-preference retention than sequential adaptation and improves performance with contextual prompts compared with preference-only training, but can weaken motion-preference learning; preference generalization, decomposition, and conflict handling remain difficult. The code, datasets, and demos can be found on the project website: https://libero-perm.github.io/.
papers.comment: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026); Project Website: https://libero-perm.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LIBERO-PeRM 是面向个性化机器人操作 (PeRM) 的受控基准：在 LIBERO 上用程序化流程生成带/不带偏好的成对示范，构建 5 个任务套件共 312 个任务，并配套偏好满足度指标。实验显示当前 VLA 策略难以零样本个性化，SFT 可让偏好变得可学；混合训练比顺序适应更好地保留无偏好能力、上下文提示优于仅偏好训练但会削弱运动偏好学习，偏好泛化、分解与冲突处理仍然困难。
Motivation: 通用机器人操作研究很多，但个性化机器人操作缺少能把任务完成与偏好满足分离开的受控基准，无法系统比较策略在零样本、示范学习、泛化与冲突下的表现。
Method: 提出可观测偏好的受控形式化与分类（覆盖运动、技能、用户画像三类选择），限定为可语言表达、在 LIBERO 中不改变任务目标即可实例化、可自动评测且可跨任务复用的偏好；基于 LIBERO 的程序化流程生成带偏好与不带偏好的成对示范，构建 5 个任务套件（312 个任务）及偏好满足度指标，围绕零样本遵循、单偏好示范学习、随示范增加的学习效率、跨布局与任务泛化、偏好组合与冲突五个问题做实验。
Result: 实验显示当前 VLA 策略在零样本个性化上表现吃力，而 SFT 使偏好变得可学；混合训练在无偏好保留上优于顺序适应，上下文提示 (contextual prompts) 相比仅偏好训练提升性能但会削弱运动偏好学习；偏好泛化、分解与冲突处理仍然困难。
Conclusion: 偏好满足需要与任务完成分开度量，混合训练加上下文提示是当前更可取的训练方式，但运动偏好学习与冲突处理仍是未解决问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Gen4P: Video Generators are 4D Perceivers
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Gen4P, a unified framework for recovering 4D geometry and motion from monocular video. We show that a pretrained video generator can be repurposed into a feed-forward 4D perceiver without iterative denoising. Building on on-demand querying, Gen4P processes clean video latents in a single encoder pass and predicts the requested 4D attributes through a lightweight cross-attention decoder. The on-demand query formulation enables flexible spatial sampling, and our proposed continuous-time queries further provide temporal flexibility. To strengthen geometric knowledge, we propose a straightforward plug-in solution by incorporating a pretrained video-depth LoRA as a frozen geometry prior, improving overall performance without adding extra trainable parameters. Gen4P achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on tasks of 3D point tracking, video depth and camera pose estimation. Qualitative results on in-the-wild videos illustrate its capability of tracking complex motion while maintaining the delicate structure. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of video generative pretraining for unified 4D perception. See https://gen4p.github.io for more visual results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Gen4P 把预训练视频生成器改造成单次前馈的 4D 感知器：不再迭代去噪，而是在干净视频 latent 上一次编码，用轻量 cross-attention 解码器按需查询所要的 4D 属性。加入冻结的 video-depth LoRA 作为几何先验后不增可训练参数，在 3D 点跟踪、视频深度与相机位姿估计上达到 SOTA 或有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 单目视频的 4D 几何与运动恢复通常依赖迭代式生成或分立的专用模型，难以在一个统一框架内按需输出点跟踪、深度、位姿等多种属性。
Method: 将预训练视频生成器复用为无需迭代去噪的前馈 4D perceiver：单次 encoder 处理干净视频 latent，轻量 cross-attention 解码器响应 on-demand query 输出所请求的 4D 属性；on-demand query 支持灵活空间采样，continuous-time queries 提供时间灵活性；另以冻结的预训练 video-depth LoRA 作为可插拔几何先验，不引入额外可训练参数。
Result: 在 3D 点跟踪、视频深度估计与相机位姿估计任务上取得 state-of-the-art 或有竞争力的表现；在野外 (in-the-wild) 视频的定性结果中能跟踪复杂运动并保持精细结构。
Conclusion: 视频生成式预训练本身蕴含足够的几何知识，配合按需查询与冻结深度先验即可支撑统一的 4D 感知，无需迭代去噪。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Which Tokens to Merge? Diffusion Dynamics for Efficient Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Token merging has emerged as an effective training-free strategy for accelerating diffusion models by reducing redundant token computation while minimizing generation degradation. A key challenge is determining which tokens can be safely merged and which should be preserved for subsequent computation. Existing method addresses this by preserving prompt-aligned foreground regions, thereby protecting semantically relevant structures. However, this text-relevance criterion overlooks background objects, local details that are not explicitly mentioned in the prompt, leading to degraded structural coherence. In this work, we propose Dynamics-aware Token Merging (DaTMe), a training-free framework that grounds token merging in the underlying diffusion dynamics. Our key insight is that token importance should reflect whether a token remains unresolved during denoising and whether it carries structural information. To this end, DaTMe constructs a dynamics- aware importance map from the Tweedie denoised estimate. The map combines a temporal signal, measuring inter-step changes in the predicted clean image, with a structural signal, capturing local high-frequency content such as boundaries and fine details. Using this map, DaTMe adaptively assigns tokens into merging roles under a given compression ratio: important tokens are preserved as anchors, while tokens that are both temporally stabilized and structurally homogeneous are selected as safe merge candidates. Experiments on PixArt-a and FLUX demonstrate that DaTMe maintains visual fidelity across the entire image, highlighting diffusion dynamics as an effective token-level merging decision in efficient generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/SeungJuCha/DaTMe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DaTMe 用扩散去噪动力学决定哪些 token 可合并：从 Tweedie 去噪估计构造重要性图，结合时间信号（相邻步预测干净图的变化）与结构信号（边界、细节等高频内容），在给定压缩比下保留重要 token 为 anchor，只合并时间已稳定且结构同质的 token。在 PixArt-a 与 FLUX 上保持全图视觉保真，说明文本相关性不足以单独决定合并对象。
Motivation: 现有训练无关 token merging 只按 prompt 对齐保留前景，忽略背景物体与未被提示词点名的局部细节，导致结构连贯性下降。
Method: DaTMe 是训练无关框架：由 Tweedie 去噪估计生成 dynamics-aware 重要性图，时间信号度量相邻去噪步之间预测干净图的变化，结构信号捕捉边界与细节等局部高频；再在给定压缩比下自适应分配角色，重要 token 作 anchor 保留，时间稳定且结构同质的 token 作安全合并候选。
Result: 在 PixArt-a 与 FLUX 上的实验显示 DaTMe 在整幅图像范围内保持视觉保真，把扩散动力学作为 token 级合并判据用于高效生成。
Conclusion: token 重要性应由去噪过程中是否仍未解决及是否携带结构信息共同决定，而非仅靠与 prompt 的文本相关性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SoftCache: Adaptive Step Size Caching for Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow models generate a sample over iterative steps, each a full pass through a large network, and that pass dominates generation cost. Training-free caching accelerates them by reusing activations from recent evaluations instead of recomputing them. Dynamic caching methods decide when to refresh by accumulating a cheap probe of the network input into a staleness signal and spending a fresh evaluation once it crosses a threshold. They perform hard caching: the signal is a binary switch between refresh and reuse, and every step, fresh or cached, advances by the prescribed step size. We observe that the signal carries much more than this switch. How far it sits below the threshold, its headroom, predicts the error induced by reuse. We propose SoftCache, which performs soft caching: instead of a binary switch, the headroom sets how far each cached step goes. Where the headroom is large, the sampler jumps past several scheduled nodes, and as a refresh nears, its steps shrink back toward the original step. These adaptive jumps may land between the scheduled nodes, taking the sampler off its fixed grid. SoftCache requires no training and adds no per-backbone settings: on FLUX for images and on HunyuanVideo and Wan2.1 for video, at speedups from $3.5\times$ to $6.9\times$, it is ahead of every baseline on all four fidelity metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SoftCache 把动态缓存的二值刷新开关改成连续步长：用陈旧度信号距阈值的余量 (headroom) 直接决定每个缓存步走多远，余量大时跳过多个预定节点、临近刷新时步长缩回原步。免训练且无需按 backbone 调参，在 FLUX 图像与 HunyuanVideo、Wan2.1 视频上以 3.5× 到 6.9× 加速，在全部四项保真度指标上领先所有基线。
Motivation: 扩散与流模型每次迭代都要跑一遍大网络，生成成本被这一步主导；现有动态缓存把陈旧度信号只当二值开关用，丢掉了信号里关于复用误差大小的信息。
Method: 沿用动态缓存的廉价输入探针累积陈旧度信号，但不再二值切换：以信号距阈值的余量预测复用引入的误差，并用它设定每个缓存步的步长，允许落在预定节点之间、使采样器脱离固定网格；免训练，不引入按 backbone 的设置。
Result: 在 FLUX（图像）与 HunyuanVideo、Wan2.1（视频）上达到 3.5× 至 6.9× 加速，并在全部四项保真度指标上领先每个基线。
Conclusion: 陈旧度信号的余量本身携带可利用的误差信息，把它从二值开关改成连续步长即可在免训练缓存下同时拿到更高加速与更高保真度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Discovering state-of-the-art quantum circuits with large language models
papers.abstract_en: Significant efforts are currently being directed toward the implementation of large-scale quantum information processors, but realizing useful quantum advantage also requires the development of efficient quantum algorithms. While for many practical problems the dominant resource costs are associated with a small set of computational primitives, optimizing them in the quantum setting presents unique challenges, including a reversibility constraint absent from ordinary classical computation. Here we introduce an evolutionary framework in which large language models (LLMs) propose circuit designs and an independent evaluator verifies and scores them. We apply this framework to tasks spanning numerical computation, chemistry, optimization, quantum simulation, and number theory. In seven of the eight tasks, the discovered circuits significantly reduce both Toffoli and qubit counts relative to the state of the art. In the eighth, the search discovers a new reversible architecture for prime-field modular inversion. By handling reversibility differently, the architecture makes divsteps -- a classical algorithm previously impractical for reversible integer arithmetic -- viable and substantially improves the Toffoli-qubit trade-off for modular inversion. These results open the door for evaluator-guided LLM co-design of new algorithmic structures for quantum computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LLM 提议电路设计、独立评估器验证打分的进化式框架，用于发现满足可逆性约束的量子计算原语电路。在数值计算、化学、优化、量子模拟、数论八项任务中，七项的 Toffoli 数与量子比特数相对 SOTA 显著下降；第八项发现素域模逆的新可逆架构，使原本难以用于可逆整数运算的 divsteps 变得可行，并大幅改善 Toffoli-量子比特折衷。
Motivation: 许多实际问题的主要资源开销集中在少数计算原语上，而量子设定下的优化受可逆性约束，这一约束在经典计算中不存在，使原语电路设计困难。
Method: 进化式框架：LLM 批量提议电路设计，一个独立的 evaluator 对每个候选做验证与打分，迭代筛选；应用于数值计算、化学、优化、量子模拟、数论等任务的原语电路发现。
Result: 八项任务中七项的 Toffoli 计数与 qubit 计数相对 SOTA 显著下降；第八项发现素域模逆的新可逆架构，通过不同的可逆化处理使 divsteps（一种此前在可逆整数算术中不实用的经典算法）可行，并大幅改善模逆的 Toffoli-qubit 折衷。
Conclusion: 评估器引导的 LLM 协同设计可以产出超越已知构造的量子算法结构，尤其是可逆原语电路；divsteps 类经典算法经恰当可逆化后可进入量子电路设计空间。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 评估器引导的 LLM 协同设计可以产出超越已知构造的量子算法结构，尤其是可逆原语电路；divsteps 类经典算法经恰当可逆化后可进入量子电路设计空间。

papers.title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
papers.abstract_en: Predicting how the world responds to an action requires more than what can be seen: robots must account for environmental factors that are neither directly observable nor explicitly specified, from physical properties such as friction and mass to human-defined environmental rules. We introduce T2-Z for test-time optimization of environment latents, which augments a robotic world model with a learnable environment latent to condition world predictions. This compact latent captures underlying environmental variation without supervision of what environmental factors exist or what values they take. During training, T2-Z alternates between two stages: a world-model optimization stage that fixes the latents and learns general action-conditioned dynamics across environments; and an environment-latent optimization stage that freezes the world model and optimizes the conditioning latents, allowing latent structure to emerge purely through world prediction. At test time, the world model remains frozen and a newly initialized environment latent is optimized from one or more test-time interactions, adapting the model to previously unseen environmental configurations. Across 7 simulated settings and 4 real-world robotic tasks, T2-Z reduces object prediction error metric from 15.20 to 7.00 and raises action success from 33.73% to 72.96%. Its emergent latents capture structured representations of individual and compounded factors across diverse visual scenes. Ablations further show that T2-Z can efficiently infer environment latents from as little as a single test-time interaction trajectory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T2-Z 给机器人世界模型加一个可学习的环境隐变量 (environment latent)，训练时交替优化世界模型与隐变量，测试时冻结模型、仅用一次或几次交互重新优化该隐变量以适配未见过的环境配置。在 7 个仿真设置与 4 个真实机器人任务上，物体预测误差从 15.20 降到 7.00，动作成功率从 33.73% 升到 72.96%。
Motivation: 机器人预测动作后果时必须处理摩擦、质量乃至人为规则等既不可直接观测也未被显式指定的环境因素，而现有世界模型缺少对这类隐含变量的适配机制。
Method: 在动作条件世界模型上引入无监督的环境隐变量；训练分两阶段交替——固定隐变量学跨环境动力学，再冻结世界模型只优化隐变量；测试时模型冻结，用新初始化的隐变量从一条或少数测试时交互轨迹做梯度优化。
Result: 在 7 个仿真设置与 4 个真实机器人任务上，物体预测误差指标由 15.20 降至 7.00，动作成功率由 33.73% 升至 72.96%；消融显示最少一条测试时交互轨迹即可有效推断环境隐变量，且隐变量涌现出对单因素与复合因素的结构化表示。
Conclusion: 把环境变化压缩成可在测试时单独优化的隐变量，能让冻结的世界模型适配未见过的环境配置，并同时改善预测精度与执行成功率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce P$^{3}$-WAM, a unified world action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation that learns 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and goal-directed planning through three complementary modes: Perceive, which reconstructs articulated hand motion and camera trajectories from video; Predict, which generates visual futures under prescribed actions; and Plan, which jointly generates action trajectories and their anticipated visual consequences conditioned on an initial image, a language instruction, and an optional visual goal. Our model integrates a compact, structured 3D action representation into a pretrained video diffusion transformer through a mixture-of-transformers architecture with shared base weights, modality-specific adaptation, and bidirectional visual-action attention. Randomized modality visibility lets video and 3D actions serve as either conditioning context or prediction targets across the three modes. Experiments show that unified training improves all three capabilities over single-mode training, including gains in planning quality under a vision-language model evaluation. Through unified training, our model outperforms specialized baselines on 3D hand reconstruction and action-conditioned video prediction across four datasets, while producing goal-directed manipulation videos with stronger instruction adherence and action progression than video-generation baselines. Project Page: https://p3-wam.pages.dev/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: P³-WAM 把第一视角灵巧手操作的感知、预测、规划三种能力统一进一个世界动作模型：以 mixture-of-transformers 架构把结构化 3D 动作表示接入预训练视频 diffusion transformer，共享基础权重并用双向视觉-动作注意力。统一训练在四个数据集上同时优于单模式训练与专用基线，规划质量在视觉-语言模型评测中也提升。
Motivation: 第一视角灵巧操作中，3D 手部重建、动作条件视频预测、目标导向规划通常分开建模，彼此的表征无法互益，规划也缺少对动作视觉后果的预期。
Method: 三种模式共享一个模型：Perceive 从视频重建关节手运动与相机轨迹，Predict 在给定动作下生成视觉未来，Plan 由初始图像、语言指令与可选视觉目标联合生成动作轨迹及其预期视觉后果。核心是把紧凑的结构化 3D 动作表示通过 mixture-of-transformers（共享基础权重 + 模态特定适配 + 双向视觉-动作注意力）接入预训练视频 diffusion transformer，并用随机模态可见性让视频与 3D 动作互为条件或预测目标。
Result: 实验显示统一训练在三项能力上全部优于单模式训练，规划质量在视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 评测中有增益；在四个数据集上，3D 手部重建与动作条件视频预测均超过专用基线；生成的目标导向操作视频在指令遵循与动作推进上强于视频生成基线。
Conclusion: 感知、预测、规划三种模式共享训练能让每一项能力都变强，结构化 3D 动作表示可以直接嵌入预训练视频 diffusion transformer 支撑统一建模。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Generative simulation can automate robot environment construction, but physically valid environments are not necessarily useful for training. The challenge is to identify environments that address a policy's failures and supervision that helps it overcome them. We introduce CoDA, a framework in which a simulation data engine and an action policy co-evolve through a shared heterogeneous memory of environment construction, policy failures, and learning progress. The memory compiles validated diagnoses from a vision-language critic into generation programs that recreate difficulties and training programs that help the policy overcome them. We further propose Text2potential to convert these diagnoses into staged potentials for action-chunk value learning, providing dense supervision for policy updates while preserving the task's optimal policy under standard shaping assumptions. Measured learning progress guides further generation and program refinement. Across four manipulation task families, CoDA improves out-of-distribution success from 5.3% after supervised fine-tuning to 27.6%, exceeding the strongest closed-loop baseline by 9.5 percentage points with the same generation budget. On LIBERO-Pro, 15 rounds of generation and training raise success from 25% to 84% under position perturbations and from 1% to 76% under instruction perturbations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoDA 让机器人仿真数据引擎与动作策略通过共享异构记忆共同演化：视觉-语言 critic 给出的诊断被编译成复现难度的环境生成程序和帮助策略克服困难的训练程序，并用 Text2potential 把诊断转成分阶段势函数做稠密监督。在四类操作任务上，OOD 成功率从监督微调后的 5.3% 提到 27.6%，同生成预算下比最强闭环基线高 9.5 个百分点；LIBERO-Pro 上 15 轮生成训练把位置扰动成功率从 25% 提到 84%、指令扰动从 1% 提到 76%。
Motivation: 生成式仿真能自动搭建机器人环境，但物理上有效的环境未必对训练有用：缺少针对策略失败点选环境、选监督的机制，闭环数据生成容易空转。
Method: CoDA 用共享异构记忆（环境构建、策略失败、学习进展）连接数据引擎与策略；视觉-语言 critic 产出经验证的诊断，记忆将其编译为复现难度的生成程序与缓解难度的训练程序。Text2potential 把诊断转成分阶段势函数 (staged potentials) 用于 action-chunk 价值学习，在标准势函数塑形假设下保持最优策略不变；学习进展指标反过来指导下一轮生成与程序精化。
Result: 四类操作任务上 OOD 成功率由监督微调的 5.3% 升至 27.6%，在相同生成预算下超出最强闭环基线 9.5 个百分点。LIBERO-Pro 上 15 轮生成与训练后，位置扰动成功率 25%→84%，指令扰动成功率 1%→76%。
Conclusion: 把 critic 诊断、环境生成与稠密势函数监督放进同一个共同演化回路，能在固定生成预算下显著提升策略对分布外扰动的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Grounding Generative Verification in 3D Content
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and 3D generation have expanded 3D understanding and synthesis. However, beyond visual fidelity, task-specific correctness grounded in 3D evidence remains a major challenge. We argue that building reliable 3D systems requires not only stronger generation and reasoning, but also verification feedback that identifies unmet requirements and explains their violations, allowing systems to reflect on and refine their outputs. Such feedback must integrate multi-view observations and distinguish genuine inconsistencies from projection-dependent appearances. We make three contributions. First, we introduce 3DVerifierBench, a benchmark spanning 10 tasks that evaluates decisions, rejection explanations, and responses to controlled changes in specifications and candidates. A human study reveals a 21.6 percentage-point gap between humans and the strongest tested model, GPT-6 Astra, while explanation-aware analysis exposes weaknesses in rejection reliability. Second, we analyze verification across fine-grained factual categories, exposing errors in values and target binding. We develop a scalable pipeline combining multi-view fact extraction, controlled 3D editing, and native annotations to produce 14,126 training examples with contradiction explanations and linked counterfactuals. Third, we examine how verification could support 3D generation through candidate selection and recursive refinement. In human-labeled sixteen-candidate pools, oracle selection improves complete factual success from 26.7% to 90.0%. In a separate eight-input study, human-guided recursive refinement satisfies all seven requirements for every input, compared with three under parallel Oracle@8. Together, our benchmark, analysis, and data pipeline establish a foundation for models to reflect on 3D content through reliable verification feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 3D 内容生成的验证反馈框架：3DVerifierBench 覆盖 10 类任务，评测决策、拒绝解释与规格变更响应；人与最强模型 GPT-6 Astra 之间存在 21.6 个百分点差距。用多视角事实抽取、受控 3D 编辑与原生标注造出 14,126 条带矛盾解释的训练样本；在 16 候选池上 oracle 选择把完整事实成功率从 26.7% 提到 90.0%，递归精修对每个输入都满足全部七项要求。
Motivation: MLLM 与 3D 生成已能产出视觉上可信的内容，但任务级正确性缺少基于 3D 证据的验证反馈：模型无法指出哪些要求未满足、为何违反，也难以区分真实不一致与投影造成的表面差异。
Method: 三项贡献：3DVerifierBench 基准含 10 个任务，评测决策、拒绝解释以及对规格与候选的受控变更响应；细粒度事实类别分析定位数值与目标绑定错误；可扩展数据管线结合多视角事实抽取、受控 3D 编辑与原生标注，产出 14,126 条带矛盾解释和关联反事实的训练样本；再以候选选择与递归精修检验验证对生成的支撑。
Result: 人类与最强受测模型 GPT-6 Astra 在 3DVerifierBench 上相差 21.6 个百分点，解释感知分析显示拒绝可靠性偏弱；训练数据 14,126 条；在人工标注的 16 候选池中 oracle 选择把完整事实成功率从 26.7% 提升到 90.0%；在 8 输入研究中，人工引导的递归精修对每个输入都满足全部七项要求，而并行 Oracle@8 只满足三个。
Conclusion: 可靠验证反馈（指出未满足要求并解释违反原因）能让模型反思并改进 3D 输出：候选选择与递归精修是把验证接入生成的两条有效路径，基准、分析与数据管线共同构成该方向的基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting of Multivariate Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Time series foundation models are becoming increasingly popular for general-purpose forecasting. However, most leading models predict marginal quantiles, leaving the dependence structure of future trajectories unspecified. This distinction matters for trajectory-dependent quantities such as cumulative demand, peak load, and event timing, yet point and marginal scores do not reveal it. To model this dependence, we introduce PathFM, a trajectory-based forecasting model that uses flow matching to generate complete future paths. We further distill the model to one or two steps and share history attention cache across draws. Together, these enable PathFM to generate multiple paths for a single series in roughly the time needed for one query to a quantile model. The distilled sampler also makes it practical to optimize a calibration loss directly. PathFM achieves competitive marginal accuracy on the established forecasting benchmarks fev-bench and TIME. To complement these evaluations, we introduce Forecast Path Score Bench (fps-bench), which augments fev-bench tasks with energy and variogram scores and downstream metrics. PathFM achieves a higher aggregate path score on fps-bench than all evaluated external baselines. Experiments on chaotic systems further show that our flow model sustains long-run variability, while strong baselines rapidly collapse. PathFM makes generative time series forecasting both competitive and practical, enabling diverse downstream applications.

Motivation: 主流时序基础模型只预测边际分位数，未来轨迹的依赖结构未被指定，而累计需求、峰值负荷、事件时刻这类轨迹相关量依赖该结构，点分数与边际分数无法揭示它。

papers.title: DK-VLM: Geometry as Position for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models still struggle to understand 3D spatial relations across views and update spatial judgments as the observer moves. A common approach fuses 3D reconstruction features into visual tokens, but aligning these features with pretrained semantic representations remains challenging under limited spatial supervision. We propose DK-VLM with Dual-Kernel Attention, which computes attention from both a visual token's input position and its geometric position in the scene. A semantic kernel retains the pretrained model's native attention and positional encoding, while a separate geometric kernel uses estimated 3D points and camera poses to directly modulate attention through point displacements and relative view transformations. Then, a learned gate fuses their outputs. Geometry thus enters attention as position rather than as fused reconstruction features. We further introduce Reference-Frame Composition (RC) supervision to train the model to update its reference frame across successive judgments. It provides stepwise turn and heading targets derived from verified single-step annotations. Among the compared methods, DK-VLM-8B achieves the highest average score across six spatial benchmarks and the highest overall scores on VSI-Bench (74.33) and ReVSI-32 (58.28). RC supervision further improves multi-step spatial reasoning, while the full model preserves general video understanding. Project page: https://sumuru789.github.io/DK-VLM-website/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DK-VLM 用 Dual-Kernel Attention 把几何位置直接注入注意力：语义核保留预训练的位置编码，几何核用估计的 3D 点与相机位姿通过点位移和相对视角变换调制注意力，再用可学习门控融合，几何以位置而非融合特征进入模型。配合 Reference-Frame Composition (RC) 监督训练跨视角更新参考系，DK-VLM-8B 在六个空间基准上平均分最高，VSI-Bench 74.33、ReVSI-32 58.28 均为所比方法中最高。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型难以跨视角理解 3D 空间关系并随观察者移动更新判断；把 3D 重建特征融进视觉 token 又难与预训练语义表征对齐，且空间监督有限。
Method: Dual-Kernel Attention：语义核沿用预训练注意力与位置编码，几何核用估计 3D 点和相机位姿，通过点位移与相对视角变换直接调制注意力，可学习门控融合两路输出；再加 Reference-Frame Composition (RC) 监督，用经核验的单步标注派生逐步转向与朝向目标，训练跨连续判断更新参考系。
Result: 在六个空间基准上 DK-VLM-8B 取得最高平均分；VSI-Bench 总分 74.33、ReVSI-32 总分 58.28，均为所比较方法中最高。RC 监督进一步提升多步空间推理，完整模型保持通用视频理解能力。
Conclusion: 几何应作为位置进入注意力，而非作为融合的重建特征；配合参考系组合监督可在提升多步空间推理的同时不损失通用视频理解。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models have become an important approach for scaling model parameters. Modern MoE architectures increasingly combine two design choices: fine-grained expert segmentation and shared experts. The former increases expressiveness by enabling more expert combinations at a fixed activation ratio, and the latter introduces experts that are active for every token. We identify an exploration dilemma between these designs: shared experts can make routing less exploratory by reducing the variability of token representations. This conflicts with the greater need for exploration induced by fine-grained expert segmentation due to the combinatorially enlarged routing space. Consequently, the additional expressiveness offered by fine-grained segmentation may not be fully realized in practice. MirrorMoE is proposed to reconcile this exploration dilemma by shrinking the exploration space through token-adaptive suppression of unnecessary experts. MirrorMoE consistently improves performance across model scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 现代 MoE 同时采用细粒度专家切分与共享专家，二者在路由探索上互相冲突：共享专家压低 token 表征的变异性、让路由更少探索，而细粒度切分又把路由空间组合式放大、更需要探索，导致细粒度带来的额外表达力在实践中兑现不了。提出的 MirrorMoE 用 token 自适应地抑制不必要专家来收缩探索空间，从而调和这一探索困境，并在各模型规模上一致提升性能。
Motivation: 细粒度专家切分与共享专家是现代 MoE 的两个主流设计，但前者扩大路由空间、后者降低表征变异性，探索需求与探索能力相互矛盾，使细粒度切分的表达力增益无法充分兑现。
Method: MirrorMoE 通过 token-adaptive suppression（按 token 自适应抑制不必要专家）收缩探索空间，调和共享专家与细粒度切分之间的探索困境；在多个模型规模上进行训练比较。
Result: MirrorMoE 在各模型规模上一致提升性能（consistent improvement across model scales），摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 共享专家与细粒度切分的探索冲突是细粒度表达力未被兑现的根因，按 token 自适应收缩探索空间即可在不同规模上稳定获益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SUPRA-TEX: 3D Generation with Super-Aligned Texture
papers.abstract_en: Single image 3D generation aims to dress a given 3D mesh with relightable materials while faithfully preserving the visual details of a reference image. Existing methods either introduce artifacts when fusing inconsistent multi-view predictions or struggle to preserve fine details through implicit image-feature conditioning. To resolve these challenges, we introduce SUPRA-Tex, built on the principle of decoupling visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion. This division of labor allows the 3D generator, trained on limited 3D data, to focus its capacity on preserving visible evidence and completing unobserved surfaces. Specifically, we first train an MLLM-based image editing model to predict lighting-separated PBR maps in the reference view. We then project these maps onto the visible surface and encode them with the pretrained material VAE encoder into native observation latents that share the generation target's latent space. An interleaved flow transformer holds these latents as fixed, read-only anchors while alternating unobserved-region and full-surface updates to generate complete material latents. This design achieves super-alignment with the reference, delivering What You See Is What You Get fidelity on visible regions and coherent completion on unobserved surfaces. Trained solely on public datasets, SUPRA-Tex achieves SOTA performance in both geometry-conditioned texturing and end-to-end asset generation, matching or even exceeding leading commercial systems on in-the-wild images. Project page: https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SUPRA-Tex 把单图 3D 生成拆成可见材质估计、表面对齐与观测引导补全三步：用 MLLM 编辑模型预测光照分离的 PBR 图，投影到可见面并编码为与生成目标共享潜空间的观测潜变量，再由 interleaved flow transformer 将其作为只读锚点交替更新未观测区与全表面。仅用公开数据训练即在几何条件纹理化与端到端资产生成上达到 SOTA，野外图像上匹配甚至超越领先商业系统。
Motivation: 单图 3D 生成要在给定 mesh 上生成可重光照材质并忠实保留参考图细节，但现有方法融合多视角不一致预测会引入伪影，或经隐式图像特征条件化难以保住精细细节。
Method: 先训练基于 MLLM 的图像编辑模型在参考视图预测光照分离的 PBR maps，投影到可见表面后用预训练 material VAE encoder 编码为与生成目标共享潜空间的 native observation latents；interleaved flow transformer 把这些 latents 作为固定只读锚点，交替执行未观测区域更新与全表面更新以生成完整材质 latents。
Result: 在几何条件纹理化 (geometry-conditioned texturing) 与端到端资产生成 (end-to-end asset generation) 两项任务上均取得 SOTA；在野外 (in-the-wild) 图像上匹配甚至超越领先商业系统；可见区域实现所见即所得 (WYSIWYG) 保真，未观测表面补全连贯。
Conclusion: 把可见证据保留与未观测表面补全解耦分工，即使 3D 训练数据有限，也能同时拿到参考图对齐保真与完整材质生成，且仅靠公开数据即可比肩商业系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
papers.abstract_en: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer's own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). An online platform lets humans practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting, where unstated constraints must be discovered, the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. Yet information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it reaches a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10. These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Website: https://fde-gym.com/paper ; Code: https://github.com/deeplethe/fde-gym ; Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/DeepLethe/FDE-Gym
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FDE-Gym 是一个面向前线部署工程师 (forward-deployed engineer) 交付能力的智能体基准：95 个端到端交付任务、20 个客户场景、18 个行业，由行业专家改写自真实交付项目，在带脚本化干系人与可修改客户系统的模拟环境中按客户自身成功指标打分（0 为系统未变，1 为参考解，并对消息、试运行与等待时间扣分）。评测 7 家提供商的 13 个模型配置后，最差短板在发现未言明约束：现实设定下最佳配置平均分仅 0.56、95 个任务中只有 14 个达到 0.8 且无事故；即便在 23 个已从干系人处拿到全部关键事实的任务上，也只有 10 个达到 0.8 以上的业务提升。
Motivation: 现有智能体基准都用 issue 报告、规格或任务票据把需求写清楚，而真实客户交付要求澄清模糊需求、在生产级系统上作业并主动挖出未言明约束，这条差距缺少可复现的评测载体。
Method: 构建 95 个端到端交付任务（20 个客户场景、18 个行业，由行业专家从真实交付项目改编），置于带脚本化干系人与可修改客户系统的模拟环境中；评分以客户自身成功指标的提升量归一化到 0–1，并对干系人交互（消息、试运行、等待时间）施加惩罚；另提供同评分标准的在线练习平台。
Result: 评测 7 家提供商的 13 个模型配置：现实设定（需自行发现未言明约束）下最佳配置平均 FDE-Gym 分 0.56，95 个任务中仅 14 个达到 ≥0.8 且无事故；在最佳配置已从干系人处获取全部关键事实的 23 个任务上，也只有 10 个达到归一化业务提升 ≥0.8。
Conclusion: 发现未言明约束是首要瓶颈，但信息发现不足以解释全部差距——即使事实齐全，模型仍难以把任务解成对客户有效的交付，说明解好规格明确任务与交付真实客户之间存在实质鸿沟。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: FDE-Gym 是一个面向前线部署工程师 (forward-deployed engineer) 交付能力的智能体基准：95 个端到端交付任务、20 个客户场景、18 个行业，由行业专家改写自真实交付项目，在带脚本化干系人与可修改客户系统的模拟环境中按客户自身成功指标打分（0 为系统未变，1 为参考解，并对消息、试运行与等待时间扣分）。评测 7 家提供商的 13 个模型配置后，最差短板在发现未言明约束：现实设定下最佳配置平均分仅 0.56、95 个任务中只有 14 个达到 0.8 且无事故；即便在 23 个已从干系人处拿到全部关键事实的任务上，也只有 10 个达到 0.8 以上的业务提升。

papers.title: Speculative Forcing for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Few-step autoregressive video generators enable streaming generation, yet they run every token through the final denoising step, regardless of how much refinement it needs. We find this uniform computation is often unnecessary: many tokens already closely match their eventual full-step outputs in the initial steps, while others require refinement until the end. We introduce Speculative Forcing, a framework that treats intermediate clean estimates as drafts and predicts when individual tokens can be safely accepted early. Once accepted, a token is frozen as its final output and undergoes no further denoising, while its cached keys and values remain available as context for the remaining tokens. We explore two alternative verifier designs: a training-free one based on similarity to clean content and stability across steps, and a learned one that reads the frozen generator's intermediate features to estimate each token's remaining gap to its full-step output. Across short-video, long-video, and world generation, Speculative Forcing preserves the quality of full-step sampling while substantially reducing computation. On LongLive, it matches the four-step generator with ~1.7 denoising steps per token, running over 1.5x faster at 41.7 and 37.8 fps. On Lingbot-World 2.0, where camera motion continually changes the visible content, it maintains quality with ~2.5 denoising steps per token and runs 1.35x faster at 24.5 fps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Speculative Forcing 把自回归视频生成器的中间干净估计当作草稿，用验证器判定单个 token 何时可提前接受并冻结，冻结后的 KV 缓存继续作为上下文。在 LongLive 上以每 token 约 1.7 步去噪匹配四步生成器质量，速度超 1.5 倍（41.7 与 37.8 fps）；在 Lingbot-World 2.0 上约 2.5 步即维持质量，快 1.35 倍（24.5 fps）。
Motivation: 少步自回归视频生成器对每个 token 都跑满全部去噪步，但许多 token 在初始步已接近最终输出，均匀计算是浪费。
Method: 将中间干净估计作为草稿，逐 token 预测可安全提前接受的时机，接受后冻结为最终输出且不再去噪，其缓存 key/value 仍作为剩余 token 的上下文。验证器有两种设计：基于与干净内容相似度及跨步稳定性的 training-free 版本，以及读取冻结生成器中间特征、估计 token 距全步输出残差的 learned 版本。
Result: 在短视频、长视频与 world generation 三类设定下保持全步采样质量同时大幅减少计算。LongLive 上以每 token 约 1.7 个去噪步匹配四步生成器，速度提升 1.5 倍以上，达 41.7 与 37.8 fps；Lingbot-World 2.0（相机运动持续改变可见内容）上约 2.5 步维持质量，快 1.35 倍，24.5 fps。
Conclusion: 逐 token 的差异化去噪步数足以替代统一满步计算：多数 token 可提前接受，冻结后仍能通过 KV 缓存为后续 token 提供上下文。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding from assisting scientific research and engineering to autonomously developing and improving AI systems, advancing AI for AI (AI4AI) as a pathway toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Workflow-driven machine learning engineering (MLE) systems provide a practical path toward this pursuit through complex orchestration that manages long-horizon experimentation, while recent MLE systems adopt model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize experiments and adapt optimization strategies based on execution feedback. However, feedback from each experiment reflects several preceding decisions, and a long MLE run contains many such costly experiments. Training must therefore select useful supervision from long interaction trajectories and learn from intermediate outcomes. We propose a post-training method for autonomous long-horizon MLE optimization and apply it to train MLExpert, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model. We design the Kaggle-MLE Factory to construct executable tasks and an interaction harness for model-directed experimentation. Hierarchical agentic SFT transfers general tool-use and coding capabilities to MLE through outcome-guided supervision. Windowed Interaction RL (WIRL) treats the multi-turn decisions between successive experiment results as an execution window and assigns it a shared outcome-based reward. Asynchronous collection and policy correction support policy updates before the trajectory ends. On MLE-Bench Lite, MLExpert improves the average medal rate of the base model from 37.9% to 72.7%, achieving performance comparable to larger frontier models such as Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3. Further experiments show that MLExpert improves performance on NatureBench Lite, agent scaffold optimization, and algorithm optimization, suggesting that the learned optimization capability generalizes to other tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MLExpert 是一个 35B MoE 的自主机器学习工程 (MLE) 智能体模型，用分层 agentic SFT 加 Windowed Interaction RL (WIRL) 做长程实验优化后训练：把相邻两次实验结果之间的多轮决策视为执行窗口并共享结果奖励，配合异步采集与策略校正在轨迹结束前更新策略。在 MLE-Bench Lite 上把基座模型平均奖牌率从 37.9% 提到 72.7%，达到与 Kimi-K3、GLM-5.3 等更大前沿模型相当的水平。
Motivation: 长程 MLE 运行包含大量昂贵实验，单次实验反馈同时反映此前多个决策，训练时必须从长交互轨迹中挑出有用监督并利用中间结果，现有 workflow 驱动系统难以做到。
Method: 提出 Kaggle-MLE Factory 构造可执行任务与 model-directed 实验的交互 harness；先用 Hierarchical agentic SFT 把通用工具使用与编码能力经结果引导监督迁移到 MLE，再用 WIRL 把相邻实验结果之间的多轮决策作为执行窗口赋予共享的结果奖励，并以异步采集和策略校正支持轨迹未结束时的策略更新，训练出 35B MoE 模型 MLExpert。
Result: 在 MLE-Bench Lite 上，MLExpert 将基座模型的平均奖牌率 (average medal rate) 从 37.9% 提升到 72.7%，性能与更大的前沿模型 Kimi-K3 和 GLM-5.3 相当；进一步实验显示其在 NatureBench Lite、agent scaffold 优化和算法优化上也带来提升。
Conclusion: 结果引导的 SFT 加窗口化结果奖励 RL 能把通用能力转成长程自主 MLE 优化能力，并可迁移到 NatureBench Lite、脚本脚手架与算法优化等其他任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Recent 3D world models increasingly use features from geometry foundation models (GFMs) as predictive world states, benefiting from their rich geometric priors. However, the view dependence of these features entangles scene dynamics with camera-induced variation, making the resulting state evolution harder to predict. We propose GeoState, a view-decoupled geometry representation for predictive 3D world modeling that separates scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation. Specifically, a scene tokenizer aggregates multi-view GFM features into a view-decoupled scene state, which a geometry decoder queries using camera rays. An autoregressive world model then predicts future scene states, while camera motion is modeled separately. The predicted states can therefore be decoded under either predicted or externally specified cameras, while retaining a single context-derived scale throughout the rollout without per-frame scale alignment. Experiments show that GeoState outperforms prior 3D world models on Waymo, supports geometrically consistent cross-view querying, and generalizes zero-shot to KITTI and nuScenes. Project page: https://hongchang-liu.github.io/GeoState-project-page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoState 提出视图解耦的几何状态表示：scene tokenizer 把多视图几何基础模型 (GFM) 特征聚合成与相机无关的场景状态，geometry decoder 用相机射线查询解码，自回归世界模型只预测场景状态演化、相机运动单独建模。在 Waymo 上超过既有 3D 世界模型，支持几何一致的跨视图查询，并零样本泛化到 KITTI 与 nuScenes。
Motivation: GFM 特征具有视图依赖性，把场景动态与相机引起的观测变化纠缠在一起，使状态演化更难预测。
Method: scene tokenizer 聚合多视图 GFM 特征得到视图解耦的场景状态；geometry decoder 以相机射线为查询解码；自回归世界模型预测未来场景状态，相机运动独立建模，rollout 全程保持单一上下文尺度、无需逐帧尺度对齐。
Result: 在 Waymo 上优于先前 3D 世界模型，支持几何一致的跨视图查询，并零样本泛化到 KITTI 与 nuScenes；预测状态可在预测相机或外部指定相机下解码。
Conclusion: 把场景状态演化与相机依赖观测解耦后，3D 世界模型的 rollout 可在单一尺度下跨视图、跨数据集保持几何一致。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
papers.abstract_en: We introduce 3DCodeVerse, a research ecosystem that enables coding agents to create editable and verifiable 3D content at scale. 3DCodeVerse comprises large-scale, high-quality datasets of executable 3D code, a coding harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding. First, we construct 3DCodeVerse-2M, a large-scale curated dataset of standalone 3D executable code. We build this corpus by collecting open-source data, converting specialized representations, and generating new programs with coding agents. Each program is packaged with the source files and associated assets required for execution in its declared environment, along with available descriptions and verification records. Second, we develop the 3DCodeVerse Harness, a multi-agent directed acyclic graph framework for generating and refining 3D content. It uses execution checks, spatial measurements, and visual feedback to automatically evaluate and revise generated programs without human feedback during generation. Third, we conduct systematic empirical studies of 3D coding, establishing baselines with fine-tuned open models and deriving practical guidance through component-level analyses of our harness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning on our dataset significantly improves the 3D coding capabilities of open-source models. Notably, our 3DCodeVerse harness achieves a 90% win rate against Claude Design (3D Object) in pairwise human evaluations, when both are utilized by Claude Opus 5.5.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3DCodeVerse 是让 coding agent 大规模生成可编辑、可验证 3D 内容的生态：200 万级可执行 3D 代码数据集 3DCodeVerse-2M、多智能体 DAG 框架 3DCodeVerse Harness（用执行检查、空间测量与视觉反馈自动迭代，无需人工反馈），以及组件级消融得到的实践指南。在开源模型上微调该数据集显著提升 3D 编码能力；Harness 在双方均使用 Claude Opus 5.5 的成对人评中对 Claude Design (3D Object) 取得 90% 胜率。
Motivation: 3D 内容创作目前难以同时做到规模化、可编辑与可验证：生成结果多为不可修改的黑盒资产，缺少执行环境与自动验证闭环，coding agent 也没有针对 3D 编码的训练语料和评测手段。
Method: 构建 3DCodeVerse-2M：收集开源数据、转换专用表示、再由 coding agent 生成新程序，每个程序附带执行所需源文件与资产、描述和验证记录。提出 3DCodeVerse Harness：多智能体有向无环图 (DAG) 框架，靠执行检查、空间测量和视觉反馈自动评估并修订生成程序。另做 3D 编码的系统性实证研究，用微调开源模型建立基线，并对 harness 做组件级分析。
Result: 在 3DCodeVerse-2M 上微调显著提升开源模型的 3D 编码能力；Harness 在双方均使用 Claude Opus 5.5 的成对人评 (pairwise human evaluation) 中对 Claude Design (3D Object) 胜率 90%。
Conclusion: 把 3D 内容表示为可执行代码并配自动验证闭环，是让 coding agent 产出可编辑、可验证 3D 内容的可行路径；数据集微调与多智能体执行反馈两条线都有效，且组件级分析给出了 harness 的实践配置指南。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dexterity from Supervised Play
papers.abstract_en: How can robots autonomously collect the contact-rich experience needed to learn dexterous manipulation? We present DSP: Dexterity from supervised play, a framework in which a robot learns a play policy from minutes of human play through behavior cloning, then deploys it autonomously to collect hours of interaction data to train a world model. During inference, the same play policy then guides model-predictive control (MPC) by proposing candidate action sequences for evaluation under the learned world model. To accelerate inference, we also introduce a method for distilling a closed-loop, goal-conditioned policy through self-play within the learned world model. We evaluate this framework on underactuated pushing and any-to-any in-hand pose reorientation with a multifingered hand, in simulation and real world. In real world experiment, our method outperforms hindsight behavior cloning by 69.6% in success rate and achieves comparable success to reinforcement learning with 490 times less interaction data. These results demonstrate that supervised play can autonomously collect interaction data, guide model-based planning, and enable policy learning without any task-specific demonstrations or sim-to-real transfer.

papers.title: Lean Graph Search for Formal Theorem Proving
papers.abstract_en: Retrieving relevant lemmas is crucial for formal theorem proving, enabling provers to build machine-checkable proofs from established mathematical results. Recent retrieval systems match library declarations to a target theorem or its intermediate proof steps, but make limited use of multi-hop dependencies among declarations. These dependencies can reveal supporting lemmas that are not necessarily lexically similar to the target theorem but recur in proofs of related problems. To this end, we propose LeanGraphSearch, a graph-based retrieval method for Lean 4 that constructs a graph from Mathlib's forward dependencies and traverses it to uncover supporting lemmas through multi-hop dependency chains. Specifically, LeanGraphSearch links each declaration to the premises it depends on, uses a graph-based ranking algorithm to propagate relevance from semantically matched declarations to their dependencies, and reranks the expanded candidates against the original query. Across two mathematical retrieval benchmarks, LeanGraphSearch improves recall by up to 12% over the strongest baseline, LeanSearch v2, on MathlibQR and increases coverage of complete annotated proof routes on MathlibMPR, covering up to 3.7% of extra groups. More importantly, we evaluate whether these retrieval gains translate into improved end-to-end theorem proving by integrating LeanGraphSearch into an iterative proving loop guided by Lean feedback. Across three theorem proving benchmarks, LeanGraphSearch improves pass rate at {8, 16, 32} reflection turns by as much as 40% compared to vanilla prover and at most 10% compared to LeanSearch v2, showing higher accuracy-cost efficiency. These findings highlight the value of dependency graph search for theorem proving and motivate further research on structure-aware search for proof discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LeanGraphSearch 为 Lean 4 提出基于依赖图的引理检索：从 Mathlib 的前向依赖建图，把语义匹配到的声明的相关性沿依赖链传播到其前提，再对扩展候选按原查询重排。在两个检索基准上，MathlibQR recall 比最强基线 LeanSearch v2 最多提升 12%，MathlibMPR 完整标注证明路径覆盖率最多多覆盖 3.7% 的 group；接入带 Lean 反馈的迭代证明循环后，三个定理证明基准上在 {8,16,32} 轮反思时 pass rate 相对 vanilla prover 最多提升 40%、相对 LeanSearch v2 最多 10%。
Motivation: 现有检索系统只把库声明与目标定理或中间证明步骤做词面匹配，几乎不用声明之间的多跳依赖，因而漏掉词面不相似却在相关问题证明中反复出现的支撑引理。
Method: LeanGraphSearch 从 Mathlib 的前向依赖构建图，将每条声明链接到其依赖的 premise；用基于图的排序算法把语义匹配声明的相关性沿依赖传播到下游依赖，再把扩展出的候选相对原始查询重排。检索结果接入由 Lean 反馈引导的迭代证明循环做端到端验证。
Result: 在 MathlibQR 上 recall 比最强基线 LeanSearch v2 最多提升 12%；在 MathlibMPR 上完整标注证明路线的 group 覆盖率最多额外覆盖 3.7%。在三个定理证明基准的迭代循环中，{8, 16, 32} 轮反思时 pass rate 相比 vanilla prover 最多提升 40%，相比 LeanSearch v2 最多提升 10%，体现更高的精度-成本效率。
Conclusion: 依赖图上的多跳搜索能把检索增益转化为端到端定理证明的 pass rate 提升，说明结构感知的证明搜索值得进一步研究。

papers.title: Robust Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Treatment Regimes under Model and Measurement Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: We develop a robust reinforcement learning (RL) framework for learning adaptive treatment policies that generalize across patients and remain reliable under errors in the measured biomarker and shifts in the disease dynamics. By modeling the patient as a hidden context, we address generalization and robustness in a unified manner through robust contextual Markov decision processes. Applying our framework to adaptive therapy for metastatic prostate cancer in a simulator calibrated to clinical data, we obtain generalizable and robust policies that substantially outperform the existing adaptive therapy method. In particular, we attain robustness with almost no loss of performance when the biomarker is accurate and the disease evolves as anticipated, and find that the resulting policy Pareto-dominates the existing method across a diverse array of scenarios. Our findings suggest that robust RL holds great promise as a principled methodology for learning reliable adaptive treatment policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于鲁棒上下文马尔可夫决策过程 (robust contextual MDP) 的强化学习框架，把患者当作隐变量 context，同时应对生物标志物测量误差与疾病动力学偏移。在按临床数据校准的转移性前列腺癌自适应治疗模拟器中，所学策略在生物标志物准确、疾病演化符合预期时几乎无性能损失，并在多种场景下 Pareto 优于现有自适应疗法。
Motivation: 自适应治疗策略需要跨患者泛化，而实际中生物标志物测量有误差、疾病动力学会漂移，普通 RL 策略在这两类不确定性下不可靠。
Method: 把患者建模为隐 context，用鲁棒上下文 MDP 统一处理泛化与鲁棒性，学习自适应治疗策略；在按临床数据校准的转移性前列腺癌模拟器上训练与检验。
Result: 在临床校准的转移性前列腺癌模拟器中，策略在生物标志物准确且疾病按预期演化时以几乎零性能损失获得鲁棒性，并在多种场景下 Pareto 支配 (Pareto-dominates) 现有自适应疗法，性能大幅领先。
Conclusion: 鲁棒 RL 是学习可靠自适应治疗策略的原则性方法，可在不牺牲标称性能的前提下覆盖测量误差与动力学偏移。

papers.title: Evaluation Awareness Beyond English: Do LLMs Act Differently When Tested in Indic Languages?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can often tell when they are being tested. This ability, known as evaluation awareness, can lead models to act more cautiously during safety evaluations than in real use. Existing work has studied evaluation awareness almost entirely in English, although models serve users in many languages. Indic languages are spoken by over a billion people, yet evaluation awareness remains almost entirely unstudied in them. We test four instruction-tuned models from three families in five Indic languages alongside English. A set of cues varies whether the model is told that it is monitored and whether the monitoring is a safety test. Models refuse harmful requests more often when they are told that they are being tested. This increase appears in all four models and all six languages. In Indic languages, refusal of harmful requests rises by 14.4 percentage points on average. The test cue also brings Indic refusal of harmful requests level with English, but raises refusal of benign Indic requests from 6.9% to 11.3%. We release all 47,880 judged responses to support further work. These results suggest that safety evaluations in Indic languages may not reflect how models treat their everyday users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在五种印度语言与英语下测试四个指令微调模型的 evaluation awareness：被告知正在被监控且是安全测试时，有害请求拒绝率上升，且这一上升在四个模型、六种语言中一致出现。印度语言有害请求拒绝率平均上升 14.4 个百分点并追平英语，但良性请求拒绝率也从 6.9% 升到 11.3%，说明印度语言安全评测可能不反映模型对待日常用户的真实行为。
Motivation: evaluation awareness 几乎只在英语中被研究，而模型服务着多语言用户；印度语言使用者超过十亿，其安全评测是否反映真实使用行为完全未知。
Method: 对三个模型家族的四个指令微调模型，在五种印度语言加英语上施加一组提示线索 (cues)，变化是否告知模型正被监控、以及监控是否为安全测试；对有害与良性请求分别判定拒绝行为，共发布 47,880 条判定响应。
Result: 被告知正在被测试时有害请求拒绝率上升，四个模型、六种语言全部出现；印度语言有害拒绝率平均上升 14.4 个百分点，与英语持平；良性印度语言请求拒绝率从 6.9% 升至 11.3%；共发布 47,880 条判定响应。
Conclusion: 测试线索会系统性抬高印度语言下的拒绝率并抹平与英语的差距，因此印度语言安全评测可能不反映模型对待日常用户的方式。

papers.title: KnowGPO: Knowledge-Grouped Policy Optimization for Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Deep search agents solve knowledge-intensive tasks through long-horizon, multi-turn interactions, where assigning credit to individual search decisions is fundamentally difficult. Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides only a single terminal reward shared across an entire trajectory. Recent process-supervision methods aim to assign credit at finer granularity, but they typically anchor credit to either surface-level trajectory states or model-internal signals, both of which become unreliable in deep search where observations are heterogeneous and retrieved contexts are long and noisy. We propose KnowGPO, a reinforcement learning framework that aligns trajectories by the task-relevant knowledge they have acquired rather than by their surface observations. For each query, KnowGPO decomposes the information required to derive the answer into atomic knowledge conditions, and represents the state of a trajectory at each step by the subset of conditions it has satisfied. Trajectories sharing the same knowledge state are grouped for within-group comparison, and the incremental knowledge gain between consecutive steps serves as an environment-grounded process reward. Experiments on Xbench, BrowseComp-ZH, and GAIA show KnowGPO consistently outperforms outcome-only (GRPO) and process-supervision baselines (GiGPO, IGPO) by 3.8 to 4.2 points, with our 8B model rivaling or exceeding most 32B open-source systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KnowGPO 把深度搜索智能体的轨迹按“已获得的任务相关知识”而非表面观测对齐：将回答所需信息拆成 atomic knowledge conditions，用已满足条件的子集表示每步状态，同知识状态的轨迹分组做组内比较，相邻步的知识增量作为环境落地的过程奖励。在 Xbench、BrowseComp-ZH、GAIA 上比 outcome-only 的 GRPO 与过程监督基线 GiGPO、IGPO 高 3.8 到 4.2 分，8B 模型持平或超过多数 32B 开源系统。
Motivation: 深度搜索的长程多轮交互里，outcome-based RL 只给整条轨迹一个终局奖励，个体搜索决策难以归因；现有过程监督又锚定表面轨迹状态或模型内部信号，在观测异构、检索上下文长而嘈杂时不可靠。
Method: 对每个 query 把推导答案所需信息分解为 atomic knowledge conditions，用轨迹在每步满足的条件子集表示状态；相同知识状态的轨迹分组做组内比较 (within-group comparison)，相邻步之间的增量知识增益作为环境落地的过程奖励，整体在 RL 框架下训练搜索智能体。
Result: 在 Xbench、BrowseComp-ZH、GAIA 三个基准上，KnowGPO 相对 outcome-only 的 GRPO 与过程监督基线 GiGPO、IGPO 一致高出 3.8 到 4.2 分；其 8B 模型持平或超过多数 32B 开源系统。
Conclusion: 深度搜索的信用分配应按任务相关知识状态而非表面观测对齐，知识增量可以充当可靠的过程奖励，让 8B 模型达到 32B 级搜索能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Designing Transformers for Continuous Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) offer an alternative approach to parallel language generation; however, most existing studies directly use transformer architectures from either causal large language models (LLMs) or Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for image generation, which were not optimized for CDLMs. In this paper, we conduct a systematic study on Transformer architectures for CDLMs and introduce Language Diffusion Transformer (LangDiT), combining feature and query-key normalization, wider noise conditioning, likelihood-shortcut gradient routing and calibration, and confidence-gated training self-conditioning. LangDiT significantly reduces generation perplexity in matched LangFlow comparisons, establishing a new state of the art in continuous language generation across different model formulations. Using LangFlow as a representative CDLM, LangDiT as a plug-and-play backbone leads to a new state-of-the-art model with a generation perplexity (GenPPL) of 21.72 using 1024 NFEs and 44.72 GenPPL using 128 NFEs on the unconditional generation of 1024-token sequences on the OpenWebText dataset. When adapted to Plaid-style CDLM formulations, LangDiT results in a new leading GenPPL of 11.33 using 1024 denoising NFEs, and 27.51 GenPPL using 128 denoising NFEs. These gains are achieved while retaining each model's underlying representation, training objective, and inference sampler, isolating transformer architecture as a fundamental source of improvement. Our study identifies architectural design as an important source of improvement in continuous diffusion language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对连续扩散语言模型 (CDLM) 直接套用因果 LLM 或图像 DiT 架构的问题，提出 LangDiT：组合特征与 query-key 归一化、更宽的噪声条件注入、likelihood-shortcut 梯度路由与校准、以及置信度门控的训练自条件。在 LangFlow 上作为即插即用骨干把 1024-token 无条件生成的 GenPPL 降到 21.72（1024 NFEs）与 44.72（128 NFEs），在 Plaid 式配方下达到 11.33（1024 NFEs）与 27.51（128 NFEs），且保持各模型的表示、训练目标与采样器不变，把提升隔离为架构本身的贡献。
Motivation: 现有 CDLM 研究直接沿用因果 LLM 或图像生成 DiT 的 Transformer 架构，这些结构并非为连续语言扩散设计，架构层面的改进空间未被系统研究。
Method: LangDiT 在 DiT 骨架上加入四项设计：特征与 query-key 归一化、更宽的噪声条件 (noise conditioning)、likelihood-shortcut 梯度路由与校准、置信度门控的训练自条件 (training self-conditioning)；作为即插即用骨干接入 LangFlow 与 Plaid 式 CDLM 配方，保持各自的表示、训练目标与推理采样器不变。
Result: LangFlow + LangDiT 在 OpenWebText 1024-token 无条件生成上 GenPPL 21.72（1024 NFEs）、44.72（128 NFEs）；适配 Plaid 式配方后 GenPPL 11.33（1024 denoising NFEs）、27.51（128 denoising NFEs），在不同模型配方上均建立新的连续语言生成 SOTA。
Conclusion: Transformer 架构设计本身是连续扩散语言模型性能的重要改进来源，而非仅靠表示、目标函数或采样器；LangDiT 可作为通用骨干跨配方复用。

papers.title: ACEdit: Stable Multi-Turn Image Editing via Asymmetric Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Image editing models produce impressive results for individual edits, but their quality often deteriorates over multiple editing turns. Each editing turn introduces small distribution shifts that accumulate over successive edits, creating a gap between the input distributions encountered during the editor's original training and multi-turn inference. We introduce a training scheme that makes multi-turn image editing stable under this accumulating distribution shift. A key is to force the editor to operate on its own outputs from previous editing turns during training, bringing the principle of Self-Forcing to image editing. The main challenge is that self-generated editing trajectories deviate from ground-truth trajectories, making direct supervision unreliable. We address this challenge through a distillation objective that leverages a teacher image editor to provide a reliable training signal when the model operates on its own previous outputs. We introduce an asymmetric conditioning scheme: while the student performs edits sequentially on its own outputs, the teacher remains anchored to the original clean image and receives a compound editing instruction. Experiments show substantially reduced degradation over long multi-turn sequences while maintaining editing quality and instruction adherence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ACEdit 用 Self-Forcing 式训练让图像编辑模型在多轮编辑中直接吃自己上一轮的输出，以对抗逐轮累积的分布偏移；监督信号由教师编辑器提供，教师始终锚定原始干净图像并接收复合编辑指令，而学生顺序编辑自己的输出（非对称条件化）。实验显示长多轮序列上的质量退化显著减轻，同时保持编辑质量与指令遵循。
Motivation: 单轮编辑效果好，但每轮引入的小分布偏移会逐轮累积，使多轮推理时的输入分布偏离编辑器原始训练分布，导致质量随轮次下降。
Method: 训练时强制编辑器在自身先前输出上操作（把 Self-Forcing 引入图像编辑）；因自生成轨迹偏离真值轨迹、直接监督不可靠，改用蒸馏目标：教师编辑器锚定原始干净图像并接收复合编辑指令，为学生在自身输出上的操作提供可靠训练信号，构成非对称条件化 (asymmetric conditioning) 方案。
Result: 实验显示在长多轮编辑序列上退化显著减轻，同时保持编辑质量与指令遵循。
Conclusion: 让编辑器在训练中就暴露于自己的输出、并用锚定原图的教师做非对称蒸馏，是稳定多轮图像编辑的关键。

papers.title: Twice Upon a Time: Complementary Representations for Time-Series Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) enable language-based understanding and reasoning over temporal data, yet a fundamental question remains: what information should their time-series representations preserve, and what variation should they factor out? Existing TSLMs typically expose the language model to a single representation, imposing a fixed inductive bias across downstream tasks. We instead introduce complementary representations as a design principle for time-series reasoning. Our model combines two visual views: line plots preserve absolute measurements and the observed coordinate frame, while normalized delay embeddings factor out positive amplitude rescaling and offsets while exposing temporal structure. Dedicated visual encoders integrate both views into a shared language model through visual tokens and multi-level feature fusion. Evaluation-time interventions verify that the two views exhibit distinct invariance profiles, while single-view ablations show that their combination is particularly beneficial beyond basic perception, with the large gains in prediction and reasoning. Built on Qwen3-VL-8B, our dual-view model improves overall TSRBench accuracy from 44.5% with line plots alone to 53.2%, substantially exceeding the strongest evaluated dedicated TSLM baseline at 36.7%. It further achieves 89.9% accuracy on TSExam and 86.8% numerical accuracy on multivariate ChatTS alignment. Together, these results demonstrate that complementary representations provide an effective design principle for general-purpose TSLMs, enabling models to exploit temporal structure without sacrificing access to the original measurement frame.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出互补表征 (complementary representations) 设计原则：时间序列语言模型同时吃线图与归一化延迟嵌入两种视觉视图，前者保留绝对量测与坐标系，后者消掉正幅值缩放与偏移、暴露时间结构，经专用视觉编码器以 visual tokens 和多级特征融合接入共享语言模型。基于 Qwen3-VL-8B 的双视图模型把 TSRBench 总体准确率从仅用线图的 44.5% 提到 53.2%，并超过最强专用 TSLM 基线的 36.7%。
Motivation: 现有 TSLM 只把语言模型暴露在单一时间序列表征上，等于对所有下游任务固定一种归纳偏置，无法同时兼顾原始量测坐标与抽象时间结构。
Method: 双视图输入：线图 (line plots) 保留绝对量测与观测坐标系，归一化延迟嵌入 (normalized delay embeddings) 消去正幅值缩放与偏移；专用视觉编码器把两路经 visual tokens 与多级特征融合 (multi-level feature fusion) 送入共享语言模型，底座为 Qwen3-VL-8B。用评估期干预 (evaluation-time interventions) 检验两视图的不变性差异，并做单视图消融。
Result: TSRBench 总体准确率 44.5%（仅线图）→ 53.2%（双视图），最强被评估专用 TSLM 基线为 36.7%；TSExam 准确率 89.9%；多变量 ChatTS 对齐数值准确率 86.8%。单视图消融显示两视图合用在预测与推理任务上增益尤其大，超出基础感知任务。
Conclusion: 互补表征是通用 TSLM 的有效设计原则：让模型利用时间结构的同时不牺牲对原始量测坐标系的访问，且收益主要体现在预测与推理而非基础感知。

papers.title: Dense4D: Pixel-Level 4D Human Correspondence
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing human motion in 4D requires identifying the same surface points through articulation, deformation and changes in visibility. We introduce Dense4D, to our knowledge the first feed-forward model dedicated to dense 4D correspondence across the body, clothing and hair from a set of monocular RGB images, without a body template. Trained specifically for human geometry, Dense4D jointly processes person-centred crops with known image-to-crop transforms to predict Human Point Maps (HPMs) and depth for each image. An HPM assigns each person pixel the 3D position of its observed surface point at a common reference time. These maps support amodal correspondence: points hidden in the reference image can be localised from observations in other frames. Matching HPM coordinates across crops establishes correspondence without predicting camera poses or large scene displacements; per-image depth then lifts the matches into 3D tracks. Experiments on real people demonstrate substantially higher tracking accuracy and closer agreement with scanned surfaces than the evaluated baselines. Points from different frames assemble into coherent human geometry in the reference pose, providing visible evidence of consistent dense correspondence through articulation and clothing deformation. Additional qualitative results, videos, and an interactive viewer are available at https://alpguler.com/dense4d.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dense4D 是首个前馈式稠密 4D 人体对应模型：从一组单目 RGB 图像、不依赖人体模板，联合处理带已知 image-to-crop 变换的人体中心裁剪，预测 Human Point Maps (HPMs) 与逐图深度，把跨帧匹配提升为 3D 轨迹。在真实人体实验中，其跟踪精度与同被评估基线相比显著更高、与扫描表面更吻合，跨帧点可拼成参考姿态下一致的人体几何。
Motivation: 4D 人体重建要在关节运动、非刚性形变与可见性变化下追踪同一表面点，而现有方法依赖人体模板，难以覆盖衣物与头发的稠密对应。
Method: 模型联合处理带已知图像到裁剪变换的人体中心裁剪，为每张图预测 Human Point Maps（把每个人像素映射到参考时刻的 3D 表面位置）与深度；跨裁剪匹配 HPM 坐标建立对应，无需预测相机位姿或大场景位移，再用逐图深度把匹配提升为 3D 轨迹，支持参考图中被遮挡点的 amodal 对应。
Result: 在真实人体实验中，跟踪精度显著高于被评估基线，与扫描表面的吻合度也更接近；不同帧的点在参考姿态下拼成连贯的人体几何，显示关节运动与衣物形变下稠密对应的一致性。
Conclusion: 不依赖人体模板的前馈式 HPM 匹配加深度提升，足以在真实人体上得到比被评估基线更准、更贴合扫描表面的稠密 4D 对应。

papers.title: Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms
papers.abstract_en: The capabilities of an agent swarm depend on both its individual members and how they coordinate. Yet existing multi-agent systems often train agents within fixed orchestration structures, separating the learning of individual capabilities from the organization of collective behavior. We introduce market-based post-training (MPT), a framework for jointly learning action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Agents express their willingness to participate through bids, which determine who acts and how collective outcomes provide local training credit. Learning both action and bidding behavior allows individual capabilities and patterns of participation to adapt together without a central coordinating agent. We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Results show gains over monolithic post-training and confirm that agent participation indeed evolves with learning. With the same post-trained action policies, learned self-orchestration outperforms alternative coordination strategies. Ablations show that both action and bidding benefit from learning, and that learned bids provide more effective action-training signals. Beyond the original training objectives, trained swarms adapt faster to related tasks and achieve better performance with larger populations at inference time. Larger populations also suffer smaller performance losses under agent dropout, demonstrating that learned self-orchestration supports reuse, scaling, and robustness in decentralized agent swarms. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/Embodied-Minds-Lab/MPT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 market-based post-training (MPT)，让去中心化 agent swarm 通过出价 (bid) 决定谁行动、并把集体结果转成局部训练信用，从而把动作策略与自我编排 (self-orchestration) 联合训练。在 embodied crafting、robot navigation 和 deep research 上，MPT 优于 monolithic post-training 与替代协调策略，且更大规模群体在 agent dropout 下性能损失更小。
Motivation: 现有 multi-agent 系统在固定编排结构内训练 agent，把个体能力学习与集体行为组织割裂开，且缺少中心协调者时难以同时调整动作与参与模式。
Method: MPT 联合学习动作策略与出价行为：agent 用 bid 表达参与意愿，出价决定谁执行动作，并决定集体结果如何回传为局部训练信用；训练后动作策略固定时仍可比较不同协调策略，并做消融分离动作学习与出价学习的贡献。
Result: 在 embodied crafting、robot navigation、deep research 三个任务上，MPT 相对 monolithic post-training 有增益，且确认 agent 参与模式随学习演化；相同后训练动作策略下，学习到的自编排优于替代协调策略；消融显示动作与出价都从学习中获益，学习到的 bid 提供更有效的动作训练信号；训练后的 swarm 能更快适配相关任务，推理时更大群体性能更好，且更大群体在 agent dropout 下性能损失更小。
Conclusion: 动作能力与参与出价应联合学习而非在固定编排下分开训练，学习到的自编排可支撑去中心化 swarm 的复用、扩展与鲁棒性。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: MPT 联合学习动作策略与出价行为：agent 用 bid 表达参与意愿，出价决定谁执行动作，并决定集体结果如何回传为局部训练信用；训练后动作策略固定时仍可比较不同协调策略，并做消融分离动作学习与出价学习的贡献。
summary_sections.result: 在 embodied crafting、robot navigation、deep research 三个任务上，MPT 相对 monolithic post-training 有增益，且确认 agent 参与模式随学习演化；相同后训练动作策略下，学习到的自编排优于替代协调策略；消融显示动作与出价都从学习中获益，学习到的 bid 提供更有效的动作训练信号；训练后的 swarm 能更快适配相关任务，推理时更大群体性能更好，且更大群体在 agent dropout 下性能损失更小。
summary_sections.conclusion: 动作能力与参与出价应联合学习而非在固定编排下分开训练，学习到的自编排可支撑去中心化 swarm 的复用、扩展与鲁棒性。

papers.title: AVC-Reward: Event-Centric Audio-Video Consistency Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: As joint audio-video generation models become more capable, they can generate audio-visual scenes exhibiting three forms of complexity: multi-event composition, multi-layer audio mixture, and asymmetric cross-modal relations. However, current evaluations largely reuse metrics from earlier simple and unidirectional tasks. They typically evaluate an audio-video clip as a whole and rely on simple predefined relations, making them unsuitable for these increasingly complex scenes. We propose an event-centric evaluation framework that disentangles audio and visual events at the event level, analyzes each event independently, cross-validates relations across modalities, and aggregates the judgments into a coarse-to-fine, three-level consistency metric. The metric assesses global narrative harmony, event-level temporal synchronization, and fine-grained attribute alignment, providing a general formulation for audio-video consistency evaluation across diverse generation settings and cross-modal relations. We instantiate the metric as AVC-Reward, a trainable audio-video reward model. To evaluate the agreement between automatic judgments and human perception across generation paradigms and relation complexities, we construct AVC-Benchmark, which is primarily built from diverse positive and negative samples generated by various types of audio-video generation models. AVC-Reward achieves state-of-the-art alignment with human judgment among automatic methods, provides interpretable rationales that localize failures, and improves the audio-video consistency of a joint generation model when used as an online reinforcement-learning signal. Project page: https://tsuki0512.github.io/AVC-Reward.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AVC-Reward 是一个以事件为中心的音视频一致性奖励模型：把音视频在事件级解耦、逐事件分析并跨模态交叉验证，再聚合为粗到细的三级一致性度量（全局叙事和谐、事件级时间同步、细粒度属性对齐）。在由多类音视频生成模型的正负样本构成的 AVC-Benchmark 上，它在自动方法中与人类判断的对齐达到 state-of-the-art，给出可定位失败的可解释理由，并作为在线强化学习信号提升了联合生成模型的音视频一致性。
Motivation: 现有音视频生成评测沿用早期单向、简单任务的指标，把整段片段当作整体打分且依赖预定义关系，无法处理多事件组合、多层音频混合与非对称跨模态关系这类复杂场景。
Method: 提出事件级解耦的评测框架：逐事件独立分析、跨模态交叉验证事件间关系，再聚合为三级一致性度量（全局叙事和谐、事件级时间同步、细粒度属性对齐）；并将其具体化为可训练的奖励模型 AVC-Reward，配套构建主要由各类音视频生成模型产生的正负样本组成的 AVC-Benchmark。
Result: AVC-Reward 在自动方法中与人类判断的对齐达到 state-of-the-art（跨生成范式与关系复杂度），输出可解释理由以定位失败点，并作为在线强化学习信号时提升了联合生成模型的音视频一致性。
Conclusion: 音视频一致性应按事件级解耦、跨模态交叉验证再分层聚合来评，且这种度量可以训练成奖励模型直接用于在线 RL 优化生成。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Not Just a Subject: Capturing Adaptive Scene-Specific Variance for Visual Storytelling
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in diffusion models have significantly improved text-to-image generation, enabling their application to visual storytelling, where coherent image sequences are generated from narrative prompts. However, existing methods primarily focus on identity preservation and often fail to adapt to diverse scene variations, resulting in semantic misalignment and structural inflexibility. We propose EOS-Story, a training-free framework that harmonizes identity consistency with scene-specific adaptation across text and vision spaces. In the text space, we decouple the narrative into identity and scene sub-prompts to prevent information dilution, but this leaves the scene without access to appearance cues. To bridge this gap, we introduce Cross-Contextual Bridging, which softly injects a phrase-level appearance residual into the scene's <EOS> embedding. In the vision space, we find that scale mismatch between identity and scene subjects causes a few identity tokens to be repeatedly transferred, producing structural artifacts. We address this with Adaptive Identity Preservation, which anchors identity features at the scene-specific scale (Identity Anchoring) and integrates them via Identity-Aware Self-Attention. To evaluate performance under varied spatial compositions, we extend the Consistory+ benchmark with diverse framing scenarios (Consistory+_+). Extensive experiments show that EOS-Story achieves competitive or superior performance on both benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EOS-Story 是一个 training-free 的视觉叙事 (visual storytelling) 框架，在文本空间用 Cross-Contextual Bridging 把短语级外观残差软注入场景 <EOS> embedding，在视觉空间用 Adaptive Identity Preservation 按场景尺度锚定身份特征并经 Identity-Aware Self-Attention 融合。扩展 Consistory+ 为含多样取景场景的 Consistory+_+ 后，实验显示其在两个 benchmark 上达到 competitive 或 superior 表现。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型视觉叙事方法主要关注身份保持，难以适应多样场景变化，导致语义错位与结构不灵活。
Method: 训练免调 (training-free) 框架：文本空间把叙事解耦为 identity 与 scene 子提示，并用 Cross-Contextual Bridging 将短语级 appearance residual 软注入场景 <EOS> embedding；视觉空间用 Identity Anchoring 把身份特征对齐到场景尺度，再经 Identity-Aware Self-Attention 融合，以解决身份与场景主体尺度失配导致的重复身份 token 与结构伪影。
Result: 在原 Consistory+ 与扩展的 Consistory+_+（多样取景场景）两个 benchmark 上，EOS-Story 取得 competitive 或 superior 表现。
Conclusion: 身份一致性与场景特异适应可以在文本与视觉两个空间分别解耦处理，无需训练即可同时改善视觉叙事的语义对齐与结构灵活性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft
papers.abstract_en: We placed four Gemini 4 Argon agents in a sandboxed Minecraft survival world and gave them one goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. Each agent controlled a player via an open-source library called Mineflayer and coordinated with its teammates through in-game chat and shared memory. No one assigned roles or wrote game logic. The agents planned, wrote, and debugged every program themselves. Researchers could watch the run on a live dashboard and pause or stop it at any time, but they had no cause to intervene. Starting from a randomly generated world on Easy difficulty, the team wrote 2,783 programs and defeated the dragon in 27 hours and 14 minutes, dying 605 times along the way. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end autonomous completion of Minecraft by AI agents, achieved using only the standard Mineflayer library without pre-scouted seeds or other game-specific tools written by humans. Winning required the agents to keep a coherent plan across thousands of dependent steps for more than a day. Complex real-world software engineering and enterprise tasks demand the same long-horizon coding and multi-agent coordination. We describe the setup, how the run unfolded, the team's strategies (dividing the work, sharing what they learned, recovering each other's items), and the limits of the result.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 四个 Gemini 4 Argon agent 在沙盒 Minecraft 生存世界里自主协作通关：无人分配角色、无预写游戏逻辑，全靠 agent 自己规划、编写并调试程序，27 小时 14 分钟内击败 Ender Dragon，共写 2,783 个程序、死亡 605 次。作者称这是首个端到端自主完成 Minecraft 的 AI agent 团队，且只用标准 Mineflayer 库、无预探种子或人工专用工具。
Motivation: 复杂软件工程与企业任务需要跨越数千个依赖步骤、持续一天以上的长时程编码与多 agent 协作，缺少能证明这种能力的真实开放式端到端案例。
Method: 四个 agent 各通过开源 Mineflayer 库控制一名玩家，在随机生成的 Easy 难度世界中以游戏内聊天和共享记忆协调；agent 自行规划、编写和调试全部程序，研究者只在实时仪表盘上观看并可随时暂停或停止。
Result: 在随机生成的 Easy 难度世界中，团队写成 2,783 个程序，27 小时 14 分钟击败 Ender Dragon，期间死亡 605 次；全程仅用标准 Mineflayer 库，无预探种子或人工编写的游戏专用工具。
Conclusion: 作者主张这是首个端到端自主完成 Minecraft 的 AI agent 结果，其长时程规划与协作能力可迁移到复杂软件工程和企业任务。

papers.title: Learning to Steer LLM Agents and Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based agents and multi-agent systems increasingly tackle complex tasks through long-horizon tool use and inter-agent collaboration. However, these systems are prone to deviating from the overall goal as execution unfolds, which wastes execution resources and leads to undesired outcomes, a failure termed goal drift. In this work, we propose a steering agent that supervises execution on the fly and steers the system back on track when drift occurs. The steering agent observes the execution context, deciding when to intervene with a low-cost fast path and how to intervene with a high-cost slow path. To unlock its steering intelligence, the ability to assess goal drift and generate effective interventions, we jointly train the two paths with reinforcement learning, combining a pairwise ranking objective with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). Experiments on information-seeking search tasks show that the steering agent provides effective supervision for both single-agent and multi-agent systems, improving their performance and efficiency. The learned steering intelligence generalizes to out-of-domain tasks, transfers to unseen executors, and supports controllable intervention frequency without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM agent 与多智能体系统在长程工具调用中偏离总体目标的 goal drift，提出一个在线监督的 steering agent：低成本 fast path 判断何时介入，高成本 slow path 决定如何介入，两路用 pairwise ranking 目标与 GRPO 联合强化学习训练。在信息检索类搜索任务上，它同时提升单智能体与多智能体系统的性能和效率，且能泛化到域外任务、未见过的执行器，并支持不重训的可调介入频率。
Motivation: LLM agent 与多智能体系统在长程执行中会逐渐偏离总体目标（goal drift），浪费执行资源并导致不期望的结果，而现有系统缺少执行过程中的在线纠偏机制。
Method: 训练一个 steering agent 在执行中在线监督：观察执行上下文，用低成本 fast path 决定是否介入，用高成本 slow path 生成具体干预；两路以 pairwise ranking 目标结合 GRPO 联合强化学习训练，以获得评估 drift 与生成有效干预的能力。
Result: 在信息检索类搜索任务 (information-seeking search tasks) 上，steering agent 为单智能体与多智能体系统都提供了有效监督，同时改善性能与效率；学到的 steering 能力可泛化到域外任务、迁移到未见过的 executor，并支持不重训的可调介入频率。
Conclusion: 把纠偏做成一个独立训练的在线 steering agent，用快慢双路径分工介入时机与方式，可在不改动执行器的前提下同时改善 LLM agent 系统的性能与效率，并保持跨域、跨执行器的可迁移性。

papers.title: Velox: Spatial Memory Makes World Models Efficient
papers.abstract_en: Video world models turn actions and camera motion into long visual rollouts, making video a natural interface for interactive simulation. Such interaction requires responsive generation, yet coherent rollouts must retain visual memory of what has already been generated. Chunked video diffusion models usually keep this context in growing KV caches, so later chunks become progressively slower. To address this bottleneck, we introduce Velox, a training-free attention router for region-level context selection using frustum slab correspondences from streaming geometry. Velox represents historical blocks as camera frustum slabs with depth intervals and obtains current-block depth through recency-priority multiwarp. For well-covered regions, frustum slab overlap softly modulates each layer's model-derived block importance. Uncovered regions retain the model-derived route without geometric bias. The fixed token-block granularity matches FlashAttention-style tiled execution and reduces the attention term that grows with rollout length. Frustum slab construction runs asynchronously with denoising on the same H200. At chunk 48, Velox accelerates attention by $4.36\times$ and denoising by $2.43\times$. On the full 158-case WBench navigation split, it remains within 0.15 API-free average points of dense LingBot-Fast-Cam. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/velox/ for more details.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Velox 是面向分块视频扩散世界模型的免训练注意力路由器 (training-free attention router)：用流式几何把历史块表示为带深度区间的相机平截体片 (frustum slab)，按重叠度软调制各层的块重要性，未覆盖区域保留模型自身的路由。固定 token-block 粒度与 FlashAttention 分块执行对齐，使随 rollout 长度增长的注意力项被压缩；第 48 个 chunk 上注意力加速 4.36×、去噪加速 2.43×。
Motivation: 分块视频扩散世界模型靠不断增长的 KV cache 保存已生成内容的视觉记忆，导致后续 chunk 越来越慢，交互式模拟需要响应式生成与长程一致性同时成立。
Method: 免训练的区域级上下文选择：历史块编码为带深度区间的相机平截体片，当前块深度由 recency-priority multiwarp 得到；覆盖良好区域用平截体片重叠软调制模型给出的块重要性，未覆盖区域不加几何偏置；平截体片构建与去噪在同一块 H200 上异步执行。
Result: 第 48 个 chunk 上注意力加速 4.36×、去噪加速 2.43×；在完整 158 例 WBench navigation split 上，相对 dense LingBot-Fast-Cam 的 API-free 平均分差距在 0.15 分以内。
Conclusion: 用几何先验做区域级上下文路由，可以在几乎不损失生成质量的前提下压掉随 rollout 长度增长的注意力开销，让长程视频世界模型保持交互响应速度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ARC-SORT: Adaptive, Robust, Compensated Multi-Object Tracking with Interacting Multiple Models
papers.abstract_en: Multi-object tracking in sports broadcasts is hard for two reasons: athletes move fast and change direction abruptly, and the camera pans and zooms at the same time. We present ARC-SORT (Adaptive, Robust, Compensated SORT), a tracking-by-detection tracker that trains nothing and runs in real time. Its design rule: the tracker measures its own uncertainty, and that measurement decides how it acts. An Interacting Multiple Model (IMM) Kalman filter gives every track a predictive covariance, and we turn it into a per-track search region: the less reliable the motion prediction, the larger the region in which a detection may match (uncertainty-adaptive Expansion IoU, EIoU). On identical inputs, this continuous coupling is what matters: the same covariance used as a hard Mahalanobis gate hurts at every threshold we swept, and richer covariance summaries add nothing measurable. When two tracks cross, the assignment cost itself reports whether the decision was close. ARC-SORT keeps such pairs under review and applies at most one corrective identity swap once post-crossing appearance evidence shows the first decision was wrong; this adds +1.0 HOTA (higher order tracking accuracy) on both the SportsMOT and DanceTrack test sets at under a millisecond per frame. For players who leave the frame for seconds, motion extrapolation carries no information, so our offline re-identification drops the usual motion gate and links tracklets by appearance alone. ARC-SORT reaches 81.82 HOTA on the SportsMOT test set with the fewest identity switches of the 69 leaderboard entries as of August 2026 and tied-third multi-object tracking accuracy (MOTA, 97.09), and 62.1 HOTA on DanceTrack test with the same association settings. On Deep-EIoU's public detections and embeddings it reaches 80.31 HOTA, +3.1 over Deep-EIoU. It runs at about 50 frames per second on a laptop RTX 3060 GPU. Code will be released.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 13 tables; supplementary material included as appendix; qualitative video as ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARC-SORT 是一个零训练、实时的 tracking-by-detection 多目标跟踪器：用 IMM Kalman 滤波给出每条轨迹的预测协方差，并把它直接变成不确定性自适应的搜索区域 (Expansion IoU)，预测越不可靠区域越大。在 SportsMOT 测试集达到 81.82 HOTA、MOTA 97.09（截至 2026 年 8 月 69 个榜单条目中 ID switch 最少），DanceTrack 测试集 62.1 HOTA，约 50 FPS（笔记本 RTX 3060）。
Motivation: 体育转播中运动员高速且急转，同时摄像机平移缩放，运动预测不可靠；固定门限或硬 Mahalanobis 门在预测失效时会漏匹配，而离场数秒的球员运动外推完全不含信息。
Method: tracking-by-detection 架构，不训练任何模型：IMM Kalman 滤波为每条轨迹输出预测协方差，经不确定性自适应 Expansion IoU (EIoU) 转成搜索区域；交叉时用分配代价判断决策是否接近，仅在穿越后外观证据表明首次决策错误时最多做一次纠正性 ID swap；离线重识别去掉运动门、仅按外观链接 tracklet。
Result: SportsMOT 测试集 81.82 HOTA、MOTA 97.09（69 个榜单条目中 ID switch 最少，截至 2026 年 8 月）；DanceTrack 测试集 62.1 HOTA；纠正性 swap 机制在两个测试集各加 +1.0 HOTA 且每帧开销低于 1 毫秒；在 Deep-EIoU 公开检测与 embedding 上 80.31 HOTA，比 Deep-EIoU 高 +3.1；约 50 FPS（笔记本 RTX 3060）。同一协方差作为硬 Mahalanobis 门在扫过的每个阈值上都变差，更丰富的协方差摘要无可测增益。
Conclusion: 让跟踪器测量自身不确定性并据此决定搜索区域大小，比硬门限或更复杂的协方差表达更有效；交叉后的外观复核与离场重识别是提升 HOTA、压低 ID switch 的关键。
