papers.title: Knowledge That Is Linear Before Fine-Tuning Generalizes After It
papers.abstract_en: Not all facts a language model can recall support further learning equally well. We distinguish active facts, which support generalization beyond their own recall, from inert facts, which can be recalled but do not support such generalization in a given task. We study this distinction by constructing new relations from existing ones. Take the relation that maps a place to its continent (Paris -> Europe) and assign each of its answers an arbitrary new label (Europe -> crab, Asia -> zebra). The new relation then maps Paris -> crab. We fine-tune the model on the new relation for a subset of subjects, without telling it the original relation or the relabeling rule, and test whether it assigns the corresponding labels to held-out subjects that share an answer in the original relation. Having learned Paris -> crab, does it answer Munich -> crab? Across eleven language models and 70 relations, how linearly readable the original relation is in pretrained representations strongly predicts this generalization. Within each model, the two correlate across relations at Pearson r = 0.87 to 0.92. This association persists when controlling, separately and jointly, for the number of fine-tuning subjects and answers, the model's accuracy on the original relation, and how often the subjects occur in pretraining text. It is also robust to re-randomizing the label assignment and fine-tuning seed, and to replacing the animal labels with labels from thirteen other semantic categories. When we map a fine-tuned model's wrong label back to the original answer it was assigned to, Munich -> zebra becomes Munich -> Asia. Answers recovered this way are more often among the linear probe's top answers for the subject than among the pretrained model's own. Whether a new relation generalizes depends less on whether its facts can be recalled than on how readily their shared structure can be read out linearly.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/NightMachinery/active-inert-facts
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把语言模型能回忆的事实分为 active facts（支持在其自身回忆之外泛化）与 inert facts（能回忆但不支持泛化），通过给已有关系的答案重新贴标签构造新关系来度量。在 11 个语言模型、70 个关系上，原关系在预训练表示中的线性可读性强烈预测微调后的跨主体泛化，模型内跨关系 Pearson r = 0.87–0.92；结论是新关系能否泛化取决于共享结构能否被线性读出，而非事实能否被回忆。
Motivation: 语言模型微调后能否把学到的映射推广到未见过的主体，与其说是记住了事实，不如说取决于表示中结构的可读性；此前缺少把这两者分开的可控构造。
Method: 把已有关系（如 Paris -> Europe）的每个答案替换为任意新标签（Europe -> crab），得到新关系（Paris -> crab）；只在部分主体上微调，不告知原关系与重贴标签规则，再测试共享同一原答案的 held-out 主体（Munich 是否也映射到 crab）。用线性 probe 度量原关系的线性可读性，并控制微调主体数与答案数、原关系准确率、主体在预训练文本中的出现频率，同时更换标签随机化、微调种子与十三类其他语义标签做稳健性检验。
Result: 在 11 个语言模型、70 个关系上，原关系的线性可读性与微调后泛化在每个模型内跨关系的 Pearson r = 0.87 到 0.92；该关联在分别与联合控制微调主体数、答案数、原关系准确率、主体预训练出现频率后仍然成立，并对标签重随机化、微调种子更换以及把动物标签换成另外 13 类语义标签稳健。把微调模型的错误标签映射回原答案（Munich -> zebra 变为 Munich -> Asia）后，这些答案更常出现在该主体线性 probe 的 top 答案中，而非预训练模型自身的 top 答案中。
Conclusion: 新关系能否泛化，主要取决于其共享结构在预训练表示中被线性读出的难易程度，而不是这些事实能否被回忆。

papers.title: AI Consilium: a Benchmark of LLM Clinical Multidisciplinary Second Opinions
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate differential diagnoses for complex cases, but a useful second opinion must also be factually grounded, clinically coherent, actionable, and safe. We developed a multidimensional benchmark using 300 diagnostically resolved NEJM--MedQA cases: 110 for physician reference ratings and Judge calibration and 190 for held-out evaluation. Eight single-model pipelines generated independent role-specific opinions and interactive-consilium reports under free-form and structured clinical-reasoning conditions. A physician-calibrated LLM Judge evaluated 3,040 final reports and the corresponding structured primary-role outputs. Model identity separated report quality more strongly than response format. Structured final reports had higher overall mean scores in seven of eight model pipelines, with their clearest advantage in management (2.740 vs. 2.436). Compared with the structured pre-consilium primary-role opinion, the complete structured synthesis had higher pooled scores across all five shared criteria, with the largest increases in problem prioritization, factual grounding, and reasoning coherence. GPT-5.6-Sol led every evaluated component and reached consensus in the fewest review rounds. These findings show that the benchmark can distinguish model capability, the contribution of multidisciplinary synthesis, criterion-specific effects of response structure, deliberation dynamics, and inference requirements within one common-case evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建 LLM 临床多学科二次意见基准 AI Consilium：用 300 例已确诊的 NEJM-MedQA 病例，让 8 个单模型流水线在自由与结构化两种临床推理条件下生成分角色意见与交互式会诊报告，再由医师校准的 LLM Judge 评审 3,040 份报告。结构化报告在 8 条流水线中的 7 条总分更高，管理维度优势最明显（2.740 vs 2.436）；GPT-5.6-Sol 在所有评估组件领先且最少轮次达成共识。
Motivation: LLM 能为复杂病例生成鉴别诊断，但可用的二次意见还须事实有据、临床连贯、可执行且安全；现有评测缺少在同一病例集上同时区分模型能力、多学科合成贡献、结构化推理效果与审议动态的统一基准。
Method: 用 300 例已确诊的 NEJM-MedQA 病例，其中 110 例用于医师参考评分与 Judge 校准、190 例留出评测；8 个单模型流水线在自由形式与结构化临床推理两种条件下生成分角色独立意见和交互式会诊报告，由医师校准的 LLM Judge 评审 3,040 份最终报告及对应结构化主角色输出。
Result: 模型身份对报告质量的区分度强于回答格式；结构化最终报告在 8 条流水线中的 7 条总均分更高，管理维度差距最大（2.740 vs 2.436）；与结构化会诊前主角色意见相比，完整结构化合成在五项共有准则上 pooled 分数全部更高，增幅最大的是问题优先级排序、事实依据与推理连贯性；GPT-5.6-Sol 领先全部评估组件并以最少评审轮次达成共识。
Conclusion: 在同一病例集上，多学科合成与结构化推理能系统性提升 LLM 二次意见的评分，且基准可同时区分模型能力、准则维度效应、审议动态与推理开销。

papers.title: Private Retrieval Augmented Generation via Random Projection
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by querying external structured knowledge. However, it can also introduce privacy risks by leaking sensitive information from the retrieval datastore. We propose a simple method to preserve datastore privacy in RAG systems via random projection. By applying the same projection to both datastore embeddings and query embeddings, our method provably preserves semantic similarity between queries and retrieved items while substantially mitigating data extraction attacks. Across multiple RAG architectures and datasets, we show that this lightweight approach achieves superior retrieval and generation performance compared to prior methods which leverage formal differential privacy (DP) guarantees, while exhibiting comparable empirical privacy under strong attack models. Our results for the first time suggest that random projection can serve as a competitive and practical baseline for privacy-preserving RAG systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用随机投影 (random projection) 保护 RAG 数据存储隐私：对 datastore 与 query 的 embedding 施加同一投影，可证明保留查询与检索条目间的语义相似度，同时显著缓解数据抽取攻击。在多种 RAG 架构与数据集上，该轻量方法的检索与生成性能优于依赖差分隐私 (DP) 形式化保证的既有方法，且在强攻击模型下经验隐私水平相当。
Motivation: RAG 通过检索外部结构化知识增强 LLM，但检索 datastore 可能泄露敏感信息；已有方法依赖形式化差分隐私保证，往往以效用为代价。
Method: 对 datastore embedding 与 query embedding 施加同一个随机投影，在保留语义相似度的前提下改变可提取的原始表示；与依赖 DP 保证的隐私 RAG 方法对比，覆盖多种 RAG 架构与数据集，并在强攻击模型下检验经验隐私。
Result: 在多个 RAG 架构与数据集上，检索与生成性能优于采用形式化 DP 保证的既有方法，同时在强攻击模型下表现出相当的经验隐私；投影可证明保留查询与检索条目间的语义相似度。
Conclusion: 随机投影可作为隐私保护 RAG 的有竞争力且实用的基线，用经验隐私加语义保持替代纯粹的形式化 DP 保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Backward Compatibility in Zero-Bit Neural Audio Watermarking
papers.abstract_en: Neural watermarking systems are typically trained as tightly coupled embedder-detector pairs and implicitly assume static deployment. In real-world deployments, embedders and detectors are frequently updated and selectively decoupled for security and versioning purposes, which can break detection in previously embedded content and, more critically, increase false-positive rates on embedders that a given detector is intentionally not intended to recognize. In this paper the concept of backward compatibility in zero-bit audio watermarking is formalized. A training framework is proposed that pairs a new detector with a sequence of frozen legacy embedders (its legacy chain), using a performance-weighted sampling strategy so that the detector retains accuracy across all earlier versions. This coupling, while necessary for backward compatibility, is shown to induce an embedder-collapse effect that catastrophically degrades the true negative rate (TNR) against out-of-chain embedders. To counteract this, a Angular Diversity Loss (ADL) is introduced that explicitly forces each new embedder to occupy a distinct region of the output space. The combined approach restores near-perfect TNR with no measurable cost to detection accuracy or perceptual audio quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 零比特神经音频水印的检测器与嵌入器被解耦更新后，旧版本嵌入内容的检测会失效，且对本不该识别的链外嵌入器误报率上升。作者把向后兼容形式化，并用性能加权采样把新检测器与一串冻结的历史嵌入器配对训练；这会诱发嵌入器坍缩、灾难性拉低链外 TNR，加入 Angular Diversity Loss (ADL) 强制每个新嵌入器占据输出空间的不同区域后，TNR 恢复到接近完美，检测精度与感知音质无可测损失。
Motivation: 实际部署中嵌入器与检测器会各自更新并出于安全与版本管理目的选择性解耦，导致旧内容检测失效，并更严重地抬高对链外嵌入器的误报率；此前零比特音频水印缺少对向后兼容的形式化定义。
Method: 提出一个训练框架：把新检测器与一串冻结的历史嵌入器（legacy chain）配对，用性能加权采样 (performance-weighted sampling) 使检测器在所有历史版本上保持精度；针对该耦合诱发的嵌入器坍缩 (embedder collapse)，引入 Angular Diversity Loss (ADL) 约束每个新嵌入器在输出空间中占据互不相同的区域。
Result: 组合方法使链外嵌入器上的真负率 (TNR) 恢复到接近完美 (near-perfect)，同时检测精度与感知音频质量无可测损失 (no measurable cost)。
Conclusion: 向后兼容要求检测器与历史嵌入器耦合，但这种耦合本身会破坏对链外嵌入器的判别力；用角度多样性约束新嵌入器的输出分布，可以在不牺牲检测与音质的前提下修复该判别力。

papers.title: Grounded Human-Attributed Description and Activity Recognition in Videos
papers.abstract_en: Understanding characteristics and activities of individuals in complex multi-person environments is crucial for real-world applications. However, existing datasets often simplify this problem to grounded group activity recognition, single-person activity recognition, or close-set activity recognition, thus limiting the generalizability of models trained on these datasets. In this work, we introduce the task of Grounded Human-Attributed Description and Activity Recognition (GHADAR), which involves describing the characteristics and activity descriptions of \textbf{every} person in a video, provided the location of the person in the video, which is more practical for real-world applications. To facilitate this, we introduce a new dataset derived from AVA-Actions by generating open-set captions for the person description and activity. In addition, we propose a novel method to effectively utilize the information contained in grounding during training by constraining the cross-attention masks during training in VLMs to improve performance for this task. Our experiments show that our method outperforms SOTA VLMs on this task. Finally, we demonstrate the limitations of existing evaluation metrics, which are overly reliant on human-annotations and exact text-text matching. As an added video-based evaluation, we propose a holistic VLM-based evaluation schema that compares concepts {\em directly} between the video and the generated predictions. Thus, in this work, we develop a complete framework for GHADAR, including a dataset, a novel method and an evaluation schema, thereby establishing a strong foundation for future research in this domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出新任务 GHADAR：给定视频中每个人的位置框，为多人场景中的每一个人生成其外貌特征与活动的开放集描述。方法在 VLM 训练时用 grounding 信息约束 cross-attention mask，实验中在该任务上超过现有 SOTA VLM；同时指出依赖人工标注与文本精确匹配的评测指标有缺陷，提出直接在视频与预测之间比对概念的 VLM 评测方案。
Motivation: 现有数据集把复杂多人环境简化为群体活动识别、单人活动识别或闭集活动识别，模型泛化受限，难以支撑需要逐人描述的真实应用。
Method: 构建 GHADAR 任务与数据集：从 AVA-Actions 派生，为人物描述与活动生成开放集 caption；训练时利用 grounding 位置信息约束 VLM 中的 cross-attention mask；评测上提出 holistic VLM-based evaluation schema，直接在视频与生成结果之间比较概念。
Result: 所提方法在 GHADAR 任务上超过 SOTA VLM；并给出对现有评测指标（过度依赖人工标注与文本精确匹配）的局限性论证，配套提出视频层面的 VLM 评测方案。
Conclusion: 逐人开放集描述需要把 grounding 直接注入训练过程，且该任务的评测应从文本对文本匹配转向视频对预测的概念比对；作者给出数据集、方法与评测的完整框架。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Towards Continual Learning: Mitigating Forgetting With Subspace Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) acquire new skills through fine-tuning, but it can destroy capabilities they already have: catastrophic forgetting remains a central obstacle to continual learning in LLMs. Recent works connect forgetting to how far, and along which directions, fine-tuning moves the weights. On-policy methods such as reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation avoid updating the principal singular directions of weight matrices and thus forget less. In contrast, SFT concentrates updates along these directions and is susceptible to catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we introduce Subspace Tuning (SST), which restricts each weight update to the bottom singular subspace, eliminating changes along the principal directions. SST is optimizer-agnostic and composes well with fine-tuning recipes including SFT and self-distillation. SST combines tight subspace protection, dense gradient estimation, and a simple refresh mechanism, enabling stronger learning than prior orthogonal fine-tuning methods. With these mechanisms, protecting as much as 99\% of the weight subspace substantially improves retention while preserving strong target-task performance. This behavior strengthens with model and data size and nearly eliminates forgetting in the large-model regime. SST also keeps the model close to its base distribution, inducing $2$--$4\times$ less KL drift than the baseline recipes. Overall, SST advances the learning--forgetting Pareto frontier, making it a practical default for fine-tuning pre-trained language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Subspace Tuning (SST)，把每个权重更新限制在奇异值底部子空间，完全避开主奇异方向，从而在微调时抑制灾难性遗忘。保护多达 99% 权重子空间可显著改善保持率且目标任务性能不掉，KL 漂移比基线配方低 2–4 倍，且该行为随模型与数据规模增大而增强，在大模型区间几乎消除遗忘。
Motivation: LLM 微调会破坏已有能力，即灾难性遗忘；近期工作把遗忘与权重更新的距离和方向联系起来，SFT 沿主奇异方向集中更新因而更易遗忘，需要一种方向受限的微调方式。
Method: SST 将每个权重更新限制在底部奇异子空间，消除主方向上的改动；它是 optimizer-agnostic，可与 SFT、self-distillation 等配方组合，并结合紧致子空间保护、稠密梯度估计 (dense gradient estimation) 与简单 refresh 机制，强于既有 orthogonal fine-tuning 方法。
Result: 保护多达 99% 的权量子空间可显著提升保持率并维持强目标任务性能；该行为随模型与数据规模增强，在大模型区间几乎消除遗忘；相对基线配方产生 2–4 倍更少的 KL 漂移。
Conclusion: 把更新限制在底部奇异子空间能推进 learning–forgetting Pareto 前沿，SST 可作为微调预训练语言模型的实用默认选项。

papers.title: CAT-alyzing Honesty: Continuous Adversarial Training for Transferable LLM Honesty
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming prevalent in scenarios where honesty is critical. However, despite alignment training, these models still exhibit dishonest behaviour, such as outputting claims that contradict some knowledge or are not supported by what is accessible in context. We introduce Continuous Adversarial Training for Consistent Honesty (CATCH), inspired by a method originally developed to robustly refuse harmful queries. CATCH trains the model towards an honest answer and away from a dishonest one while maintaining the model's capabilities. We evaluate two architectures (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen3-3.6-27B). We show that trained with only hundreds of targets built from self-reporting scenarios, CATCH learns an honest behaviour that robustly generalizes and transfers across distinct benchmarks. It consistently reduces dishonesty under pressure on MASK, increases confessions in the multi-agent game of Among Us, and improves the discovery rates of the model's hidden behaviours in AuditBench. We show that CATCH outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning in improving honesty, and it is on par with state-of-the-art honesty activation steering. However, CATCH surpasses honesty steering in maintaining utility, thanks to a novel choice of utility data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CATCH（Continuous Adversarial Training for Consistent Honesty），把 LLM 朝诚实回答推、朝不诚实回答推，同时用新选的 utility 数据保住模型能力。仅用数百条自报场景构造的目标训练 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 与 Qwen3-3.6-27B，诚实行为可跨基准迁移：在 MASK 上降低受压下的不诚实、在 Among Us 多智能体游戏中增加坦白、在 AuditBench 提升隐藏行为发现率，效果优于 prompting 与 SFT、与 honesty activation steering 相当，且在保持 utility 上超过 steering。
Motivation: 对齐训练后的 LLM 仍会输出与知识矛盾或缺乏上下文支撑的陈述，而诚实关键的场景需要一种能跨基准泛化、又不牺牲模型能力的改进手段。
Method: CATCH 源自用于稳健拒绝有害查询的对抗训练方法：以自报场景构造数百条目标，训练时把模型推向诚实回答、推离不诚实回答，并配合新选的 utility 数据以维持原有能力；在 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 与 Qwen3-3.6-27B 两种架构上实施。
Result: 仅用数百条自报场景目标训练即可跨基准迁移：在 MASK 上持续减少受压下的不诚实，在 Among Us 多智能体游戏中提高坦白率，在 AuditBench 提升模型隐藏行为的发现率。与 prompting 和 supervised fine-tuning 相比更能提升 honesty，与 SOTA 的 honesty activation steering 相当，但在保持 utility 上超过 steering。
Conclusion: 少量自报目标的连续对抗训练足以让诚实行为泛化并迁移，且在效用保持上优于激活 steering；关键在于同时选好 utility 数据。

papers.title: EliteReplay: Preserving Diverse Solutions in RL Post-Training via Quality-Diversity Search
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has become a common post-training technique to improve the accuracy of LLMs on verifiable tasks. However, such training can narrow the set of solutions the model can produce. Several approaches have attempted to address this behavior-sharpening effect, but they often optimize metrics that do not reflect the diversity of correct solutions. Ideally, we want a model that can produce multiple good solutions, not only a single reliable one. We propose EliteReplay, a post-training recipe that pairs GRPO with an "elite" archive built by quality-diversity search. Before training, we use the frozen base model to collect solutions that span distinct approaches; during training, GRPO is combined with a replay loss on this archive. The result is a post-trained model that improves accuracy while preserving more of the base model's solution diversity. On multiple text-to-SQL tasks, EliteReplay achieves a higher pass@128 than all baselines, producing up to 77% more distinct correct strategies than the strongest baselines. It preserves most of the base model's correct strategies, outperforming existing methods in strategy retention. This diversity translates into practical benefits on ambiguous questions, where EliteReplay covers both interpretations nearly twice as often as the strongest baseline on AmbiQT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EliteReplay 把 GRPO 与质量-多样性搜索 (quality-diversity search) 建立的 elite 档案结合：训练前用冻结基座模型收集覆盖不同解法的解，训练中在该档案上加 replay loss。在多个 text-to-SQL 任务上其 pass@128 高于全部基线，最多比最强基线多产出 77% 的不同正确策略，并在 AmbiQT 歧义问题上以接近两倍的频率同时覆盖两种解读。
Motivation: RL 后训练会收窄 LLM 可产出的解空间（behavior sharpening），已有方法优化的指标并不反映正确解的多样性，而目标应是模型能给出多个好解而非单一可靠解。
Method: EliteReplay 后训练配方：训练前用冻结基座模型收集覆盖不同方法路径的解，经质量-多样性搜索建成 elite 档案；训练时将 GRPO 与针对该档案的 replay loss 联合优化。
Result: 在多个 text-to-SQL 任务上 pass@128 高于所有基线，最多比最强基线多产出 77% 的不同正确策略；保留了基座模型大部分正确策略，在策略保留 (strategy retention) 上超过已有方法；在 AmbiQT 上覆盖歧义问题两种解读的频率约为最强基线的两倍。

papers.title: Improving Environment-Agnostic Coding Agents: The Role of Scaffolding
papers.abstract_en: Stronger language models may increasingly construct useful procedures for themselves, reducing the advantage of developer-supplied scaffolding. We investigate why this advantage persists and whether an environment-agnostic agent can be improved without environment-specific engineering. We evaluate a Codex-based agent in two nearly identical prompt variants on ARC-AGI-3, AGI Maze, and Terminal-Bench. Each variant is deployed with unchanged code, prompts, and general-purpose tools across environments, receiving environment-specific information as input. Changing only an instruction to encourage reporting difficulties and returning control for automatic continuation improves mean scores on both ARC-AGI-3 and AGI Maze, while Terminal-Bench shows small, mixed changes. Yet the general agent remains below an ARC-AGI-3-specific reference, including with GPT-5.6-sol. The reference prescribes organization and control rather than supplying new game rules or solutions. To investigate this gap, we transfer reset decisions to a scripted controller that follows a convention already given to the agent. This small change recovers part of the specialized agent's advantage. A complementary AGI Maze experiment shows that additional tutorial experience can reduce performance. Together, these findings highlight the distinction between having information and tools available and using them effectively. Supplied procedures still matter for the models tested here. The performance gains also come with higher token-based cost. The experiments do not separate better use of information and procedures from additional or differently allocated inference. We provide the EnvTraverse framework and an evaluated baseline agent for testing whether further environment-independent changes improve performance in some environments without degrading it in others.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Codex 智能体上只改一条指令——鼓励报告困难并交还控制权以便自动续跑——即可在 ARC-AGI-3 与 AGI Maze 上提升平均分，把 reset 决策交给遵循既有约定的脚本控制器又能收回部分与专用智能体的差距。结论是：对所测模型，外部提供的组织与控制流程仍然有效，但收益伴随更高的 token 成本。
Motivation: 更强的语言模型似乎能自行构造有用流程，削弱开发者提供 scaffolding 的优势；论文要解释这一优势为何仍在，以及能否在不做环境特定工程的前提下改进环境无关智能体。
Method: 基于 Codex 的智能体在两个近乎相同的 prompt 变体下评测，代码、prompt 与通用工具在各环境保持不变，环境特定信息仅作为输入；测试平台为 ARC-AGI-3、AGI Maze 与 Terminal-Bench，并与 ARC-AGI-3 专用参考（含 GPT-5.6-sol）对比，另将 reset 决策移交脚本控制器。
Result: 仅改动那条指令即在 ARC-AGI-3 和 AGI Maze 上提升平均分，Terminal-Bench 变化小且正负不一；通用智能体仍低于 ARC-AGI-3 专用参考（含 GPT-5.6-sol），移交 reset 决策收回部分差距；AGI Maze 上额外教程经验反而可能降低性能；性能提升伴随更高的 token 成本。
Conclusion: 对所测模型，提供的流程仍然重要——拥有信息与工具不等于有效使用它们；但实验无法区分更好的信息利用与更多或重新分配的推理开销。作者提供 EnvTraverse 框架与一个已评测的基线智能体，用于检验进一步的环境无关改动是否能在某些环境提升而不损害其他环境。

papers.title: Learning Rational Strategies for Temporal Objectives in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: We study rational synthesis for stochastic multi-agent systems with unknown dynamics, where each agent is equipped with its own probabilistic temporal objective specified using Probabilistic Linear Temporal Logic on Finite Traces ($\mathsf{PLTL}_f}$). We impose solution concepts (e.g., Nash equilibrium, subgame-perfect equilibrium) as constraints on the joint strategy profile, using payoffs derived from each agent's probability of satisfying its temporal objective. In particular, we formulate per-agent rational synthesis as finding a strategy profile -- if one exists -- such that (i) the designated agent's probabilistic temporal constraint is satisfied, and (ii) the profile represents a stable solution under a chosen solution concept. We give conditional convergence guarantees for tabular Nash-Q learning, certify satisfaction with simultaneous finite-sample confidence bounds, and assess strategic stability with approximate best-response checking. Our approach operates in a stochastic \emph{Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning} (MARL) environment, where model-free learning algorithms attempt to attain extremal satisfaction probabilities for temporal objectives automatically compiled into reward automata. Our approach is empirically validated using 8 general-sum concurrent stochastic games.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在动力学未知的随机多智能体系统中做理性综合 (rational synthesis)：用表格式 Nash-Q 学习逼近各智能体 PLTL_f 时序目标的极值满足概率，再用同步有限样本置信界认证满足性、用近似最优响应检验策略组合是否构成 Nash 或子博弈完美均衡。在 8 个一般和并发随机博弈上做了实证验证。
Motivation: 随机多智能体系统的理性综合通常假设动力学已知，而实际中转移未知；需要在无模型学习下同时保证时序目标的满足概率与解概念意义上的策略稳定性。
Method: 把各智能体的 PLTL_f 有限迹时序目标自动编译为奖励自动机，在多智能体强化学习环境中用表格式 Nash-Q 学习逼近极值满足概率；给出条件收敛保证，用同步有限样本置信界认证满足性，用近似最优响应检查 (approximate best-response checking) 评估策略稳定性。
Result: 在 8 个一般和并发随机博弈 (general-sum concurrent stochastic games) 上进行了实证验证；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 无模型 MARL 加有限样本置信界与近似最优响应检查，可以在未知动力学下求解带概率时序约束的理性综合问题，并给出条件收敛保证。

papers.title: Causal Fingerprints Reveal Hidden Mechanisms in Partially-Observed Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: In partially-observed dynamical systems, distinct hidden mechanisms can produce similar observable summary statistics while explaining individual events differently. We introduce causal fingerprints: realization-dependent patterns that track how information about a hidden state is revealed through subsequent evolution. Within a prescribed dynamical model, we compare the filtering posterior, based on observations up to a given time, with the smoothing posterior, obtained after adding an expanding window of future observations. We quantify this retrospective information gain using Kullback-Leibler divergence and track its evolution as the future window of observational data expands. The fingerprint reveals both the strength and temporal reach of hidden influence, which can vary across events and their stages. Because the observed trajectory is held fixed while hidden-state inference depends on the candidate model, fingerprints reveal how competing dynamical mechanisms explain the same observations even when selected statistics agree. In linear Gaussian systems, we derive a characteristic fingerprint timescale for the temporal reach of hidden influence. Calibrated surrogates matching the observable mean, variance, and decorrelation time can still produce distinct fingerprints when feedback memory, hidden-noise memory, or hidden forcing timescales are misrepresented. Nonlinear examples reveal mechanism-dependent signatures for extreme bursts, oscillatory variability, and regime switching, including multiplicative instability versus additive forcing, deterministic nonlinear feedback versus state-dependent multiplicative noise, and intrinsic bistability versus hidden double-well forcing. Causal fingerprints therefore provide a time- and event-resolved diagnostic for asking not only whether a model reproduces observed statistics, but how its hidden dynamics explain individual events.
papers.comment: 42 pages, 15 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to Chaos
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在部分观测动力系统中提出 causal fingerprints：固定观测轨迹，用滤波后验与加入未来观测窗后的平滑后验之间的 KL 散度度量回溯信息增益，随未来窗扩展追踪其演化，从而分辨观测统计量相同但隐藏机制不同的候选模型。线性高斯系统中导出隐藏影响时间可达的特征指纹 timescale；匹配均值、方差与去相关时间的代理模型若错置反馈记忆、隐藏噪声记忆或隐藏强迫 timescale，仍会产生不同指纹。
Motivation: 不同隐藏机制可以给出几乎相同的观测汇总统计，却对单个事件给出不同解释；仅凭统计量无法在候选动力学模型之间做判别。
Method: 在同一给定动力学模型内比较滤波后验（截至当前时刻的观测）与平滑后验（加入不断扩展的未来观测窗），用 Kullback-Leibler 散度量化回溯信息增益并追踪其随未来窗的演化；在线性高斯系统推导特征指纹 timescale，并在非线性例子中比较成对机制（乘性不稳定 vs 加性强迫、确定性非线性反馈 vs 状态依赖乘性噪声、内生双稳 vs 隐藏双阱强迫）。
Result: 匹配观测均值、方差与去相关时间的校准代理在反馈记忆、隐藏噪声记忆或隐藏强迫 timescale 被错置时仍产生不同指纹；非线性例子对极端爆发、振荡变率与状态切换给出机制依赖的指纹签名；线性高斯情形给出隐藏影响时间可达的解析特征 timescale。
Conclusion: 模型评价不应只问是否复现观测统计，还要问其隐藏动力学如何解释单个事件；causal fingerprints 提供时间与事件分辨的诊断量。

papers.title: Asking Smarter Questions: Targeted Active Preference Learning for Underspecified Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Reward learning typically assumes the human's input covers everything that matters for the task. In practice, humans can only attend to so much at once, so their teaching naturally captures some features---or aspects of the task---better than others. Prior work has shown how the robot can identify which features were poorly supervised directly from its teaching data. But the current solution is to ask the human to try again, putting the burden on someone who already struggled to convey those features. We propose shifting this burden to the robot. Our key insight is that the same information that tells the robot what it doesn't know can help it ask better questions. Preference queries offer a low-effort channel for resolving this uncertainty, but only if the robot knows where to direct them and the human knows what to attend to when answering. We act on this insight in two ways: we build an informed prior that targets preference queries at the features that need resolving, and we accompany each query with an explanation that focuses the human's attention on exactly those features. In simulation, the informed prior beats the standard active preference learning baseline by up to $30.8\%$ in the low-query regime, where reducing human effort matters most. In a user study, the informed prior and explanations each significantly improve reward recovery and amplify each other.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026), Austin, TX. 18 pages, 8 figures, 1 table
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 机器人从人的示范中识别出哪些特征被欠监督，用一个 informed prior 把偏好查询 (preference query) 定向到这些特征，并在每条查询附上解释引导人只关注对应特征。仿真中 informed prior 在低查询量区间比标准 active preference learning 基线最高提升 30.8%；用户研究里 informed prior 与解释都显著改善 reward recovery，且二者效果相互放大。
Motivation: 人的示范天然只覆盖任务的一部分特征，机器人虽能从数据里发现哪些特征监督不足，但现有做法是让人重示范，把负担压在本来就难以表达这些特征的人身上。
Method: 两路设计：一是构建 informed prior，把偏好查询定向到需要澄清的特征上；二是给每条查询配解释，把人的注意力聚焦到恰好那些特征。评测分仿真与用户研究两部分，对照标准 active preference learning 基线。
Result: 仿真中 informed prior 在低查询量区间比标准 active preference learning 基线最高好 30.8%；用户研究中 informed prior 与解释各自都显著提升 reward recovery，且两者效果相互增强。
Conclusion: 让机器人承担澄清责任可行：用「知道自己不知道什么」的信息既决定问哪里，也决定怎么问，从而在人查询预算紧张时更高效地恢复欠指定奖励 (underspecified reward)。

papers.title: Routing Policy Optimization for Online Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning can align visual generators with reward signals beyond their pretraining objectives, but existing score-function methods typically introduce stochasticity by perturbing the reverse denoising trajectory, leading to costly rollout-based optimization. We instead ask whether stochastic exploration can be introduced inside the generator while preserving its original sampler. Routing Policy Optimization (RPO) answers this question by turning attention routing into a stochastic exploration action. At a few selected denoising levels, each query block keeps its own block and samples further key blocks in proportion to the generator's native attention mass, or keeps dense attention. The sampled route perturbs the velocity of that transition, and a Gaussian likelihood around the dense velocity scores the perturbation with a score-function objective. RPO further uses a controlled two-rollout estimator: two rollouts share the same prompt, initial latent, routed denoising levels, and dense anchor layers, differing only in their sampled attention routes. Their reward difference provides an advantage signal for the routed transitions. Because the likelihood differentiates the dense velocity itself, the learned updates remain effective after routing is removed. At inference, RPO restores dense attention and retains the original deterministic sampler. Experiments on text-to-image and text-to-video generation show that RPO improves generation quality while achieving nearly 4x higher training efficiency than Flow-GRPO-style methods. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/rpo for visual results.

papers.title: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks, where running a frontier model at every step is expensive and a small open-weight model alone often fails. Weak-to-strong escalation offers a middle ground where a weak agent acts by default and hands control to a strong one only when needed. The core challenge is deciding when to escalate, which requires an uncertainty signal cheap enough to check at every step. However, even after handoff, the strong agent can still get lost, but a black-box API that the strong agent is usually served exposes no internals to monitor. To this end, we propose LEASH, a training-free framework that unleashes the strong agent only when the weak agent's latent uncertainty signals it is needed, and keeps it on a leash afterward. LEASH has three layers: (1) initial task uncertainty for early routing, (2) step-level uncertainty for runtime escalation, and, after handoff, (3) a shadow observer for continued oversight of the strong black-box agent. Here, we use latent uncertainty as a fuel for all three layers. Specifically, we compare the weak model's hidden states with those from its past successful and failed trajectories, and a state that looks more like the failures signals higher uncertainty. During weak-agent execution, our uncertainty estimator reuses activations already produced during action generation, so it needs no extra forward pass or dedicated monitor training. Experiments on OSWorld across four contemporary model backbones show that LEASH consistently improves over standalone weak agents and outperforms random escalation by 6.55--11.94 points at matched escalation rates. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, LEASH achieves 73.66% task success at $0.4117 per task, matching always-on Claude Opus 5 (72.90%) while reducing inference cost by 19.2%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LEASH 是一个免训练的 computer-use agent 弱到强升级框架：默认由弱模型执行，仅当其隐状态不确定性接近历史失败轨迹时才把控制权交给强模型，交接后再用 shadow observer 持续监督黑盒强模型。在 OSWorld 上四个模型骨干上均稳定优于单独使用弱模型，并在相同升级率下比随机升级高 6.55–11.94 个百分点；用 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 达到 73.66% 任务成功率、每任务 $0.4117，追平常开的 Claude Opus 5（72.90%）同时把推理成本降低 19.2%。
Motivation: 长程 computer-use 任务中每步都调用前沿模型成本过高，而单独用小的开源模型又经常失败；弱到强升级需要一个每步都可检查的廉价不确定性信号，且交接后强模型常由黑盒 API 提供、内部不可监控。
Method: 免训练框架 LEASH 分三层：初始任务不确定性用于早期路由、步级不确定性用于运行时升级、交接后由 shadow observer 持续监督强黑盒模型。不确定性来自把弱模型隐状态与其历史成功/失败轨迹的隐状态比较，越像失败轨迹不确定性越高；估计器复用动作生成时已产生的激活，无需额外前向传播或专门的监控器训练。
Result: 在 OSWorld 上、四个当代模型骨干上，LEASH 一致优于单独的弱智能体，并在匹配升级率下比随机升级高 6.55–11.94 个百分点。以 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 为骨干时任务成功率 73.66%、每任务成本 $0.4117，与常开 Claude Opus 5 的 72.90% 相当，推理成本降低 19.2%。
Conclusion: 隐状态不确定性可以同时充当路由、运行时升级和交接后监督的统一信号，让弱模型默认执行、只在必要时释放强模型，从而在 OSWorld 上以约五分之一的额外成本之外的节省追平前沿模型的成功率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MJev-Spatial: System One Spatial Intelligence via Native Attention Matching
papers.abstract_en: Spatial intelligence lets an agent perceive and act in the physical world, and many of its judgments must be made at interaction rates: which spatial relation holds, how far an object is, or where to place it. Vision-language models (VLMs) produce these answers by free-form text generation, paying for autoregressive decoding and answer parsing even though the output space is compact: one of a few options, a scalar, or a 2D point. In light of this, we introduce MJev-Spatial, a System 1 multimodal decision model that tackles all three types of spatial understanding tasks within a unified classification framework. Specifically, MJev-Spatial treats each candidate as a class and scores it using the backbone's pretrained query and key projections, without adding parameters. The candidates are the given options for choice tasks, or value bins and image regions refined through coarse-to-fine classification for numerical and point prediction, respectively. At inference, each classification decision takes a single forward pass and generates no answer tokens. To train on heterogeneous spatial data efficiently, we supervise all coarse-to-fine stages jointly with teacher forcing in one forward pass, and combine this with length-aware global batching and cross-GPU load balancing, raising training throughput by 30.8% over the original batching strategy. Built on Qwen3.5-4B and trained on 12.3M question-answer pairs converted from existing spatial datasets, MJev-Spatial achieves the highest overall score (65.64%) among eight tested models, ranks first on seven of twelve benchmarks, and outperforms its unmodified autoregressive base model on all twelve, while running 2.5 times faster than the fastest autoregressive baseline and 5.6 times faster than the base model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MJev-Spatial 把空间理解的三类任务（选项选择、数值、2D 点）统一成分类问题：候选即类别，用骨干预训练的 query/key 投影打分，不加参数，单次前向、不生成答案 token。基于 Qwen3.5-4B、用 12.3M 空间 QA 对训练后，在八个受测模型中总分最高（65.64%），十二个基准中七个排名第一，且比最快的自回归基线快 2.5 倍、比原基座快 5.6 倍。
Motivation: VLM 用自由文本生成回答空间关系、距离、放置位置这类输出空间极紧凑的问题，却要付出自回归解码与答案解析的开销，难以满足交互速率下的判断需求。
Method: 将每个候选视为一个类别，用骨干预训练的 query/key 投影打分且不引入新参数；数值预测用 value bins、点预测用图像区域的 coarse-to-fine 分类。训练时用 teacher forcing 在单次前向中联合监督所有 coarse-to-fine 阶段，配合 length-aware global batching 与跨 GPU 负载均衡。
Result: 训练吞吐比原始 batching 策略提升 30.8%；在 Qwen3.5-4B 上用 12.3M 空间 QA 对训练后，八个受测模型中总分最高为 65.64%，十二个基准中七个排名第一，且在全部十二个基准上超过未改动的自回归基座模型；推理比最快的自回归基线快 2.5 倍，比基座快 5.6 倍。
Conclusion: 把空间判断改写为无 token 生成的统一分类决策，可以在保持或提升精度的同时大幅降低延迟，适合作为交互速率下的 System 1 空间决策模块。

papers.title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve diverse future queries. We build on a key asymmetry in modern agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code): while LLM agents are adept at navigating existing filesystems to solve an immediate task, they are rarely trained to construct reusable workspaces for future use. To instantiate this capability, we introduce Librarian Agents, a framework in which a builder agent transforms raw documents into a hierarchical filesystem of synthetic files and reference links, which forms a workspace tailored for a downstream answering agent. We formulate workspace construction as a Markov decision process and optimize the builder policy via reinforcement learning to directly maximize downstream answering accuracy. Empirically, Librarian Agents outperforms the strongest retrieval and precomputation baselines by 33 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus, amortizes upfront construction costs across repeated queries, and generalizes zero-shot to unseen domains on BRIGHT with a 31-point average accuracy improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Librarian Agents：builder agent 在推理前把原始文档整理成分层文件系统（合成文件与引用链接），把工作区构建建模为 MDP 并用强化学习直接优化下游答题准确率。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上比最强检索与预计算基线高 33 个百分点，构建成本可被重复查询摊销，并在 BRIGHT 上零样本泛化到未见领域、平均准确率提升 31 个百分点。
Motivation: 长文档推理中标准检索是反应式的，推理时才处理跨文档复杂推理形成瓶颈；知识图谱等预计算结构又依赖僵硬启发式，难以服务多样化的未来查询。
Method: builder agent 把原始文档转成分层文件系统（synthetic files 与 reference links），构成面向下游 answering agent 的工作区；工作区构建表述为 Markov decision process，用强化学习优化 builder 策略，目标直接是下游答题准确率。
Result: BrowseComp-Plus 上比最强检索与预计算基线高 33 个百分点；构建成本在重复查询间摊销；BRIGHT 上零样本泛化到未见领域，平均准确率提升 31 个百分点。
Conclusion: 让 agent 在推理前主动、面向未来查询地整理语料，比反应式检索与僵硬预计算更能服务复杂跨文档问答，且前期构建开销可被后续查询摊销。

papers.title: Unsupervised Clustering of Public Transport Vehicles Using Deep Morphological Features and Color Histograms
papers.abstract_en: Surveillance cameras along urban roads produce large volumes of unlabeled video that could support the monitoring of public transport, but grouping the observed vehicles into meaningful categories without manual annotation remains challenging, since buses from different routes often share the same body structure and differ mainly in their color schemes. This study presents an unsupervised clustering methodology for public transport vehicles that combines morphological features extracted with a frozen DINOv2 Vision Transformer and handcrafted HSV color histograms through weighted early fusion, followed by UMAP projection and K-Means clustering. The method was evaluated on 7,972 bus images extracted from about 1,460 hours of video of an arterial road in Mexico City, with the goal of isolating the buses of the city's public bus network (RTP) without supervision. With a fusion of 65\% morphological and 35\% color features, the pipeline produced 14 clusters that separate distinct routes and vehicle types, and it increased the precision of the target cluster with respect to morphological features alone. These results show that color complements self-supervised features for route-level clustering, provided that it does not dominate the representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用冻结 DINOv2 提取形态特征并与手工 HSV 颜色直方图按 65%/35% 加权早期融合，再经 UMAP 与 K-Means 做无监督聚类，可在墨西哥城干道监控视频中把不同线路的公交车分开。融合后得到 14 个簇，目标簇（RTP 公交网车辆）的精确率高于仅用形态特征，前提是颜色权重不过度主导表示。
Motivation: 道路监控产生大量无标注视频，但不同线路的公交车车身结构相同、主要靠涂装区分，缺少人工标注时难以按线路分组。
Method: 冻结的 DINOv2 Vision Transformer 提取形态特征，与手工 HSV 颜色直方图做加权早期融合（65% 形态 + 35% 颜色），随后 UMAP 降维并用 K-Means 聚类，目标是无监督分离墨西哥城公交网 (RTP) 的车辆。
Result: 在从约 1,460 小时墨西哥城干道视频中提取的 7,972 张公交车图像上，65/35 融合产生 14 个簇，可区分不同线路与车型；相比仅用形态特征，目标簇的精确率提高。
Conclusion: 颜色特征能补充自监督形态特征做线路级聚类，但前提是颜色在表示中不占主导。

summary_sections.method: 冻结的 DINOv2 Vision Transformer 提取形态特征，与手工 HSV 颜色直方图做加权早期融合（65% 形态 + 35% 颜色），随后 UMAP 降维并用 K-Means 聚类，目标是无监督分离墨西哥城公交网 (RTP) 的车辆。
summary_sections.result: 在从约 1,460 小时墨西哥城干道视频中提取的 7,972 张公交车图像上，65/35 融合产生 14 个簇，可区分不同线路与车型；相比仅用形态特征，目标簇的精确率提高。
summary_sections.conclusion: 颜色特征能补充自监督形态特征做线路级聚类，但前提是颜色在表示中不占主导。

papers.title: X-RIC: An Agentic RAN-Intelligent Controller Benchmark for Enhancing Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: The O-RAN ALLIANCE introduces architectural flexibility through disaggregation and AI-driven control. While the RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) enables centralized optimization, current AI approaches lack reasoning capabilities and explainability. We propose eXplainable RIC (X-RIC), a novel framework integrating agentic AI into O-RAN architectures. X-RIC combines reactive Reinforcement Learning (RL) with strategic agentic reasoning through: (i) automated Behavioral Cloning (BC) using domain heuristics for sample-efficient training, (ii) a Telecom Language Model (TLM), a transformer-based reasoning module providing contextual abstraction and interpretability, and (iii) closed-loop co-adaptation within the Near-RT RIC control loop enabling continuous policy refinement. To ensure deployment readiness, we introduce BARX (Benchmarking Agentic Reasoning for RAN), a domain-specific evaluation framework assessing agentic control across latency, compliance, and determinism metrics. We validate X-RIC on SLA-aware network slicing in simulation and O-RAN-compliant testbed deployments. X-RIC achieves 89% operational cost reduction while maintaining SLA compliance, converging 75% faster with 50% fewer training steps and 46% lower variance.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 10 figures. Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Mobile Ad-Hoc and Smart Systems (MASS), October 21-23, 2026, Hong Kong SAR, China

papers.title: Beyond Pairwise Repulsion: Collective Diversity via Determinant Maximization in Diffusion Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Strong guidance in text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models concentrates sampling toward high-density modes of the conditional distribution, collapsing independently sampled noise vectors onto nearly identical visual prototypes. This limits utility for tasks that demand distributional breadth, most critically synthetic data augmentation. Diversity, however, is a collective property of the whole batch: a set can preserve every pairwise distance yet still collapse onto a low-dimensional subspace. Existing sum-of-pairwise noise-optimization and repulsion objectives respond only weakly to this higher-order failure. We propose DetNO (Determinant Noise Optimization), which formulates diverse generation as RKHS volume maximization on the initial noise, maximizing the log-determinant of an RBF Gram matrix over one-step Tweedie predictions. This set-level functional equals the squared batch volume; its repulsion is strongest when the batch is most collapsed and self-attenuates as diversity is achieved. An anchor-based fidelity term keeps the optimized noises near plausible regions, and Lagrangian relaxation gives a two-term objective with a single hyperparameter $λ$ governing the diversity-quality trade-off, without training or sampler modification. Across three backbones (SD1.5, SDXL, SD3), DetNO achieves leading intra-batch diversity in VendiScore and Mean Self-Similarity, and a downstream few-shot classification experiment confirms that broader mode coverage brings statistically significant accuracy gains for synthetic data augmentation in the low-shot regime. Fixing the pipeline and varying only the batch objective, both RBF-based aggregators outperform InfoNCE, and the log-determinant attains the best downstream accuracy on both benchmarks. Its diversity advantage over InfoNCE widens as the batch grows. Code is available at https://github.com/mobled37/DetNO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DetNO 把 T2I 扩散的批内多样性写成初始噪声上 RBF Gram 矩阵的 log-determinant 最大化（RKHS 体积最大化），在一步 Tweedie 预测上优化，配 anchor 保真项与拉格朗日松弛得到单超参 λ 的两项目标，无需训练或改采样器。在 SD1.5、SDXL、SD3 三个骨干上取得领先的 VendiScore 与 Mean Self-Similarity 批内多样性，低样本合成数据增广的下游分类精度显著提升，且批越大相对 InfoNCE 的多样性优势越大。
Motivation: 强引导使 T2I 采样塌向条件分布的高密度模态，独立噪声收敛到几乎相同的视觉原型；现有成对噪声优化与排斥目标只对这种高阶（整批塌到低维子空间）失效反应微弱。
Method: DetNO (Determinant Noise Optimization)：在初始噪声上最大化一步 Tweedie 预测的 RBF Gram 矩阵 log-determinant，即批体积平方；排斥在批最塌缩时最强、随多样性达成自衰减。加 anchor 保真项把噪声限制在合理区域，拉格朗日松弛成两项目标，单一超参 λ 控制多样性-质量权衡，不训练、不改采样器。
Result: 在 SD1.5、SDXL、SD3 三个骨干上取得领先的批内多样性（VendiScore、Mean Self-Similarity）；下游 few-shot 分类实验确认更宽模态覆盖在低样本 (low-shot) 合成数据增广上带来统计显著的精度提升。固定管线只换批目标时，两个 RBF 聚合器均优于 InfoNCE，log-determinant 在两个 benchmark 上下游精度最佳，且批增大时相对 InfoNCE 的多样性优势扩大。
Conclusion: 批级行列式目标比成对排斥更能应对高阶模态塌缩，且多样性优势随批规模增长；λ 单参数即可权衡多样性与质量，无需重训或改采样器。

papers.title: SCOPE: Semantic Bounded Credit Optimization for Prompt Engineering in Text-to-image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables language models to improve text-to-image (T2I) generation by rewriting prompts for a frozen image generator. Existing methods typically apply a single signal derived from the image to individual subword tokens, although objects, counts, attributes, and relations form coherent semantic spans. We propose SCOPE, an objective based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that aligns update weighting with this structure. The rewriter jointly generates an enhanced prompt and its semantic partition. SCOPE pools shifts in policy log probabilities within each span to derive a shared coefficient for its token losses while retaining a single advantage for each completion. It requires neither separate span rewards nor additional image renders. Across Qwen-Image, SD3, and FLUX.1-dev, SCOPE achieves average relative gains over vanilla GRPO of 9.48% on GeneVal and 7.62% on T2I-CompBench. Ablation studies show that both semantic boundaries and pooling within spans contribute to these gains, supporting semantic structure as a practical inductive bias for prompt engineering with RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCOPE 把 T2I 提示重写中的语义跨度 (semantic span) 结构直接写进 GRPO 目标：重写器同时产出增强提示与其语义划分，跨度内共享一个策略 log 概率偏移系数，跨度内 token 损失共用该系数而每次生成仍保留单一 advantage。在 Qwen-Image、SD3、FLUX.1-dev 上，相对 vanilla GRPO 平均提升 GeneVal 9.48%、T2I-CompBench 7.62%，消融显示语义边界与跨度内池化都对增益有贡献。
Motivation: 现有 RL 提示重写方法把单一图像信号逐 subword token 下发，而物体、计数、属性、关系本是连贯的语义跨度，逐 token 加权与语义结构错配。
Method: 基于 GRPO 的 SCOPE 目标：重写器联合生成增强提示与语义划分，在每个跨度内池化策略 log 概率偏移得到共享系数，用于该跨度的 token 损失，同时每次 completion 保留单一 advantage；不需要单独的跨度奖励，也不需要额外图像渲染。
Result: 在 Qwen-Image、SD3、FLUX.1-dev 上，相对 vanilla GRPO 的平均相对增益为 GeneVal 9.48%、T2I-CompBench 7.62%；消融显示语义边界与跨度内池化两项都贡献了这些增益。
Conclusion: 把语义结构作为提示工程 RL 的归纳偏置是可行且实用的，跨度级加权比逐 token 加权更贴合对象、计数、属性、关系的组织方式。

papers.title: Baselines and Score Centering in Policy Gradient Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has become a widely used approach to post-training large language models. In a typical implementation, learning is off-policy: The policy generating the responses differs from the policy being trained because of training-inference mismatch or policy staleness in asynchronous training. This discrepancy is commonly addressed by importance sampling, whose ratio is usually regularized in practice through truncation, masking, or clipping. Under regularized importance sampling, the importance-weighted policy gradient is no longer invariant to constant shifts in the reward. This invariance is recovered by using the covariance between the reward and the importance-weighted score as the estimand, which coincides with the policy gradient when the ratio is not regularized. This note develops this covariance perspective for both sequence-level and token-level importance sampling. The covariance perspective reveals the roles of the group-mean baseline and score centering in policy gradient estimation. Both perform centering in covariance estimation, but they differ in the mean being subtracted: The group-mean baseline uses a sample mean, whereas score centering uses a population mean. The two lead to distinct unbiased covariance estimators with different variances. Whether both forms of centering should be used simultaneously depends on whether importance sampling is applied at the sequence level or at the token level. With sequence-level importance sampling, score centering adds no benefit once the group-mean baseline is used; with token-level importance sampling, using the group-mean baseline without score centering generally introduces bias when the importance ratio is regularized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 RLHF 后训练的 off-policy 策略梯度中，重要性比经截断/掩码/裁剪正则化后，梯度估计不再对奖励常数平移不变；改用奖励与重要性加权 score 的协方差作为估计目标可恢复该不变性。序列级重要性采样下，group-mean baseline 已含样本均值中心化，再加 score centering 无增益；token 级下只用 group-mean baseline 而不做 score centering 通常引入偏差。
Motivation: 异步训练的策略陈旧与训练-推理不匹配使学习成为 off-policy，需重要性采样校正；但实践中比值被正则化后，标准重要性加权策略梯度丢失奖励平移不变性，且两种中心化手段的取舍在序列级与 token 级下并不相同。
Method: 以奖励与重要性加权 score 的协方差作为估计目标（在比值未正则化时与策略梯度一致），分别在序列级与 token 级重要性采样下推导；区分 group-mean baseline（减样本均值）与 score centering（减总体均值）两种中心化，得到各自的无偏协方差估计量并比较方差。
Result: 得到两个不同的无偏协方差估计量，方差不同；序列级重要性采样下 score centering 在已有 group-mean baseline 时无额外收益，token 级下仅用 group-mean baseline 而不做 score centering 在比值被正则化时通常引入偏差。
Conclusion: 是否同时使用两种中心化取决于重要性采样的粒度：序列级二选一即可，token 级必须做 score centering 才能避免正则化重要性比带来的偏差。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Topology-Inspired Fine-Tuning for Wind-Field Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Scientific super-resolution (SR) models are typically optimized with pointwise reconstruction losses, yet scientific interpretation often hinges on extrema, connected regions, and multiscale scalar structure. We characterize this tension with pretrained CNN and GAN wind-field SR models. Pointwise metrics, bottleneck persistence-diagram (PD) distance, and merge-tree (MT) distance favor the CNN, whereas order-2 Wasserstein PD distances favor the sharper GAN, so even different distances on the same topological descriptor reward different properties. Motivated by this disagreement, we fine-tune the pretrained CNN with differentiable topology-inspired auxiliary losses on scalar speed, gradient magnitude, soft high-speed level sets, and local maxima, and with fixed-pair supervision, which constrains predicted values and persistence at ground-truth persistence-pair endpoints located offline with the Topology ToolKit. A loss study of 16 fine-tuning configurations, each compared with a matched standard fine-tuning control that uses only the original reconstruction loss, on a fixed 168-field benchmark (with topology evaluated on a fixed 160 by 160 subregion of each field), shows that, among the scalar-field losses, gradient supervision provides the strongest PD improvement but does not improve mean MT distance, whereas fixed-pair supervision gives the largest and most consistent joint improvement in PD and MT distances. The final objective combines these two signals. Relative to the pretrained CNN, it lowers mean bottleneck, $W_{2,\infty}$, and $W_{2,2}$ distances by 31%, 25%, and 27% (and by 32-35% relative to the control, which on its own worsens all three), lowers all three on 150 of 168 fields, and gains 1.30 dB PSNR, about half the gain of standard fine-tuning. Mean MT distance also improves, but on only 91 of those 150 fields, indicating that PD and MT capture complementary structure.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 风场超分辨率 (super-resolution) 的逐点重建损失与拓扑结构解释相冲突：预训练 CNN 在逐点指标、bottleneck 持久图 (PD) 距离与 merge-tree (MT) 距离上占优，而二阶 Wasserstein PD 距离更偏爱更锐利的 GAN。用可微拓扑辅助损失微调 CNN 后，相对预训练 CNN 的 bottleneck、W2,∞、W2,2 距离分别下降 31%、25%、27%（相对对照下降 32–35%），PSNR 提升 1.30 dB，约为标准微调增益的一半。
Motivation: 科学超分模型用逐点损失训练，但科学解释依赖极值、连通区域与多尺度标量结构；同一拓扑描述子上的不同距离甚至奖励不同性质，逐点指标无法反映这一冲突。
Method: 在预训练 CNN 与 GAN 风场 SR 模型上刻画逐点指标、bottleneck PD 距离、MT 距离与二阶 Wasserstein PD 距离的分歧；再用可微拓扑辅助损失微调 CNN，损失作用于标量风速、梯度幅值、软高风速水平集与局部极大值，并加入 fixed-pair 监督——用 Topology ToolKit 离线定位真值持久对端点，约束预测值与 persistence。共 16 种微调配置，每种配一个只用原始重建损失的匹配对照，在固定 168 场基准上评测（拓扑在每场 160×160 子区域上计算）。
Result: 16 组配置的损失研究中，梯度监督对 PD 改善最强但不改善平均 MT 距离，fixed-pair 监督对 PD 与 MT 联合改善最大且最一致；最终目标结合两者。相对预训练 CNN，bottleneck、W2,∞、W2,2 平均距离分别下降 31%、25%、27%（相对对照下降 32–35%，而对照本身使三者全部恶化），在 168 场中的 150 场上三项均下降，PSNR 提升 1.30 dB，约为标准微调增益的一半；平均 MT 距离也改善，但仅在这 150 场中的 91 场上成立。
Conclusion: 拓扑辅助微调能在几乎不牺牲重建质量的前提下系统压低持久图距离，但 PD 与 MT 捕捉互补结构，单一拓扑距离不足以代表整体拓扑保真度。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: FPG-Seg: Annotation-free Retinal Vessel Topology Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the art approaches to retinal vessel segmentation typically require extensive annotations, a highly time-consuming process, reliant on clinical expertise. We present FPG-Seg, an annotation-free pipeline for retinal vessel segmentation combining classical vesselness filtering, Bayesian deep learning and topology-aware graph reconstruction to segment retinal vessel topology without manual labels. Tested across four widely used benchmark datasets for retinal vessel segmentation, FPG-Seg attains a clDice of $0.74{-}0.78$, representing $86{-}98\%$ of the performance of an equivalent fully-supervised baseline, despite using no manual annotations for training or hyperparameter tuning. As part of this work, we also provide, to our knowledge, the first performance benchmark of an annotation-free vessel segmentation method on FIVES.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FPG-Seg 是无标注的视网膜血管拓扑分割流水线，把经典 vesselness 滤波、Bayesian deep learning 与拓扑感知图重建 (topology-aware graph reconstruction) 组合起来，在不使用任何人工标注做训练或调参的前提下输出血管拓扑。在四个常用视网膜血管分割基准上 clDice 达到 0.74–0.78，相当于全监督基线性能的 86–98%。
Motivation: 视网膜血管分割的 SOTA 依赖大量人工标注，标注过程耗时且需要临床专家，是该任务的主要瓶颈。
Method: 流水线三段式：先用经典 vesselness 滤波提取血管候选，再用 Bayesian deep learning 给出概率化预测，最后以拓扑感知图重建生成血管拓扑；训练与超参数调优全程不使用人工标注。
Result: 在四个常用视网膜血管分割基准数据集上 clDice 为 0.74–0.78，达到同等全监督基线性能的 86–98%；同时给出据作者所知首个无标注血管分割方法在 FIVES 上的性能基准。
Conclusion: 无标注方法可以逼近全监督视网膜血管分割的拓扑质量，标注不再是该任务的必要前提；FIVES 上的首个无标注基准为后续比较提供了参照。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Denoising Textures is a Different Ballgame Altogether!
papers.abstract_en: The human brain effortlessly deciphers colors and textures from visual stimuli and reconstructs the world around us, yet preserving such details remains challenging in image denoising. While significant progress has been made in generic image denoising, the problem of texture denoising has remained relatively under-explored. Fine details, such as intricate patterns and repetitive structures, often suffer from over-smoothing even in deep learning based approaches for denoising. In this paper, we analyze the behavior of state-of-the-art (SOTA) denoisers on texture datasets and show that performance improvements are possible only by fine-tuning the denoisers on the texture datasets. Surprisingly, fine-tuning on texture datasets result in the models catastrophically forgetting the original dataset. These findings highlight the need for specialized treatment of textures in denoising. Since denoising quality directly impacts downstream tasks such as generative modelling, we argue that dedicated texture aware denoisers are essential for faithful texture reconstruction and synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出通用图像去噪的 SOTA 模型在纹理数据集上会把重复图案与细结构过度平滑，只有在纹理数据集上微调才能提升性能，但微调会让模型灾难性遗忘原始数据集。据此主张为纹理重建与合成专门设计 texture-aware 去噪器，因为去噪质量直接决定下游生成建模的保真度。
Motivation: 通用图像去噪进展显著，但纹理去噪长期被忽视：细粒度图案与重复结构在深度去噪模型中被过度平滑，而纹理保真度又直接影响下游生成建模。
Method: 先分析 SOTA 去噪器在纹理数据集上的行为，再对这些去噪器做纹理数据集微调，观察性能变化与对原始数据集的遗忘现象，据此论证需要专用的 texture-aware 去噪器。
Result: 在纹理数据集上微调是获得性能提升的必要条件；微调后模型在原始数据集上出现灾难性遗忘。摘要未给出具体数据集名称、指标或数值对比。
Conclusion: 纹理需要与通用去噪不同的专门处理：忠实的纹理重建与合成需要专用 texture-aware 去噪器，而单纯微调会以牺牲原始域性能为代价。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: BitSparse: Compact Activation Storage for ReLU Feed-Forward Networks
papers.abstract_en: Reducing memory use in large language model (LLM) training is an ongoing challenge. Activation checkpointing saves memory by recomputation, while lossy compression changes the stored activations. The reemergence of sparse $\relu$ and $\relu^2$ activations creates a third opportunity: losslessly compressing the activation cache itself. We present BitSparse, a GPU-resident lossless compression format for sparse activations. Compression and reconstruction run in custom Triton kernels fused into an autograd function, shrinking the activation cache while recovering it exactly for the backward pass. Bfloat16 (BF16) and FP8 activations are supported. Optional sign-bit packing further increases compression up to close to the theoretical limit. We analyze its compression ratio and compare it to the theoretical optimum. BitSparse lowers per-token VRAM by 31\% and 30\% Modded-NanoGPT and Nemotron-H respectively, with overheads of no more than 1\% at practical sequence lengths. Additionally, a new preallocated buffer system avoids host synchronization during training when variable size tensors are allocated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BitSparse 提出一种 GPU 常驻的无损激活压缩格式，用自定义 Triton kernel 融合进 autograd，在前向缓存稀疏 ReLU/ReLU² 激活、反向时精确还原，支持 BF16 与 FP8 并可选符号位打包逼近理论压缩极限。在 Modded-NanoGPT 与 Nemotron-H 上每 token VRAM 分别降低 31% 和 30%，实际序列长度下开销不超过 1%。
Motivation: LLM 训练的激活缓存占显存，现有手段要么靠重计算（activation checkpointing）付出算力，要么有损压缩改变激活值；稀疏 ReLU/ReLU² 的回归提供了无损压缩激活缓存本身的第三条路。
Method: BitSparse 是 GPU 常驻的无损稀疏激活压缩格式：压缩与重建由自定义 Triton kernel 实现并融合进 autograd 函数，反向传播时精确恢复激活；支持 BF16 与 FP8，可选 sign-bit packing 进一步提高压缩率，并附带预分配 buffer 系统以避免训练中变长张量分配引发的 host 同步。
Result: 在 Modded-NanoGPT 上每 token VRAM 降低 31%，在 Nemotron-H 上降低 30%；实际序列长度下开销不超过 1%。作者对压缩率做了分析并与理论最优对比。
Conclusion: 对稀疏 ReLU/ReLU² 激活做无损位级压缩，可以在几乎不引入开销的前提下显著削减 LLM 训练的激活显存，且不牺牲反向传播的数值精确性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Explore Once, Evaluate Many: Multiple Policy Evaluation for Stochastic Linear Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study how to evaluate $K$ target policies simultaneously in stochastic contextual bandits with linear reward structure. Given a known $d$-dimensional feature map and reward-free access to policy queries, we propose PRISMA (Policy evaluation through Regularized Information Sharing and Mixture Allocation), an algorithm that estimates every target policy's value to accuracy $\varepsilon$ with probability at least $1-δ$. The algorithm uses $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\!\left( \frac{(L^2S^2+β^2)(1\veeρ^\star)}{\varepsilon^2} \cdot \log(K) \right)$ context draws and reward observations, where $ρ^\star\le d$ is an instance-dependent measure of the difficulty of designing a shared sampling distribution. Here, $L$, $S$, and $β$ bound the feature norm, reward parameter norm, and reward noise, respectively, and the suppressed factors are logarithmic in $K$, $d$, and $1/δ$. Our method combines reward-free planning, a regularized sampling design, and a single ridge regression estimator shared across all target policies. An adaptive doubling procedure selects the regularization scale without knowledge of $ρ^\star$. The guarantees require no numerical lower bound on second-moment eigenvalues and have no explicit dependence on the cardinalities of the context and action spaces. Policy-query costs are accounted for separately, with $K$ queries per shared planning context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PRISMA：在已知 d 维特征映射、可无奖励查询策略的线性随机 contextual bandit 中，用一次共享采样分布同时评估 K 个目标策略。样本复杂度为 Õ((L²S²+β²)(1∨ρ*)/ε² · log K)，其中 ρ* ≤ d 衡量共享采样设计的难度，且对每个策略只需 K 次策略查询。
Motivation: 线性 contextual bandit 中逐个评估 K 个目标策略会重复采样，成本随 K 线性增长；已有方法常需二阶矩特征值下界，且显式依赖上下文与动作空间基数。
Method: PRISMA 结合 reward-free planning、带正则的采样设计 (regularized sampling design)、以及所有目标策略共享的单一 ridge regression 估计器；用自适应 doubling 过程在未知 ρ* 的情况下选择正则化尺度。
Result: 以至少 1−δ 的概率把每个目标策略的价值估计到精度 ε，所需上下文抽样与奖励观测为 Õ((L²S²+β²)(1∨ρ*)/ε² · log K)，其中 L、S、β 分别界特征范数、奖励参数范数与噪声，被省略因子对 K、d、1/δ 仅对数依赖；保证不需二阶矩特征值的数值下界，也不显式依赖上下文与动作空间基数；策略查询成本单独计入，每个共享规划上下文需 K 次查询。
Conclusion: K 个线性 bandit 策略的价值评估可以共享一次采样设计，代价只以 log K 增长，且难度由实例相关的 ρ* 而非空间基数决定。

papers.title: Disagreement-Guided Weak-to-Strong Routing
papers.abstract_en: Small language models are increasingly deployed on edge devices and robotic systems to meet cost and latency constraints, yet their limited capabilities can make reliable deployment challenging. Stronger models can provide assistance when needed, but deciding when to route a weak-model response to a stronger model often relies on signals of response correctness. In open-ended and agentic tasks, however, obtaining such signals can require costly ground-truth supervision that is difficult to obtain at scale. We revisit the foundations of weak-to-strong routing and ask whether routing decisions can instead be guided by signals that do not require ground-truth supervision. We first characterize the optimal weak-to-strong routing policy, while allowing for multiple weak-model responses generated through local inference. Building on this characterization, we derive a principled approximation to the optimal routing based on model-to-model comparison. In particular, we introduce a notion of model disagreement that can be measured directly from model-generated responses, without ground-truth supervision. Importantly, the approximation becomes increasingly accurate as the strong model becomes a better proxy for the ground-truth distribution. Across agentic and single-turn tasks, our approach effectively navigates the trade-off between routing cost and response accuracy without ground-truth supervision. Moreover, even when ground-truth correctness signals are available for training, disagreement-based routing can outperform methods trained directly to predict correctness
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无需 ground-truth 监督的弱到强模型路由：基于模型间分歧 (model disagreement) 从模型生成响应直接度量，逼近最优路由策略，且强模型越接近真实分布该近似越准。在 agentic 与单轮任务上，该方法在路由成本与响应准确率之间取得权衡，甚至能超过直接用正确性标签训练的路由方法。
Motivation: 弱模型部署在边缘设备与机器人系统上受成本与延迟约束，但能力有限；开放与 agentic 任务中获取响应正确性信号需要昂贵的 ground-truth 监督，难以规模化。
Method: 先刻画允许弱模型多次局部推理生成多个响应时的最优弱到强路由策略，再基于模型间比较推导其原理性近似，引入可从模型生成响应直接度量、无需 ground-truth 的模型分歧 (model disagreement) 作为路由信号。
Result: 在 agentic 与单轮任务上，该方法在路由成本与响应准确率之间有效权衡，且无需 ground-truth 监督；即使训练时可获得 ground-truth 正确性信号，基于分歧的路由也能超过直接训练预测正确性的方法。近似精度随强模型成为真实分布的更好代理而提高。
Conclusion: 路由决策可以不依赖 ground-truth 正确性信号，模型分歧是可用的替代信号；强模型越接近真实分布，该近似越有效。

papers.title: Language Is a Security Surface for Agent Guards
papers.abstract_en: Step-level guards decide, before each tool call, whether an agent's next action is safe given the user's request and the trajectory so far. Users write those requests in many languages, while guard prompts and the benchmarks on which purpose-built guards are trained and evaluated are English. We ask whether a guard's verdict depends on the language of the request. We build LinguaGuardBench from the 1,220 labelled steps of TS-Bench AgentDojo-Traj: we translate only the user instruction into German, French, Turkish, Swahili and Amharic, and keep every tool call, observation and label byte-identical, so any change in a verdict is attributable to language alone. Six English rewordings and a whitespace placebo serve as controls, and managed guards are run three times to measure their noise. Across 19 guards, from frontier APIs to 4B open models and four purpose-built agent guards, most open, small and purpose-built guards change verdicts under translation beyond their own noise floor, and the effect grows with the rarity of the language: among the nine guards below 13B parameters, the mean placebo-adjusted flip rate rises from +1.5 pp on French to +4.4 pp on Amharic. Purpose-built guards are the most sensitive. The direction of the damage tends to follow guard size: open guards of 12-30B parameters block more benign steps (up to +5.0 pp false positives), and every significant loss of recall is in a guard below 10B (up to -7.4 pp). Frontier guards shift by at most about one point; the strongest, Gemini 3.8 Flash, returns identical verdicts with and without the request. The damage is concentrated in a few instructions and, in a post-hoc analysis, falls on steps where the agent's reasoning restates the English request, consistent with guards reacting to inconsistency between channels. English paraphrase moves every guard less than translation does. We release the benchmark and all 489k verdicts.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD). 9 pages plus appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建 LinguaGuardBench，仅翻译用户指令为德/法/土/斯瓦希里/阿姆哈拉语而保持工具调用与标签逐字节不变，检验 agent step-level guard 的判定是否随语言漂移。19 个 guard 中多数开源小模型与专用 guard 的翻转率超出自身噪声：13B 以下九个 guard 的均值经安慰剂校正后从法语 +1.5 pp 升到阿姆哈拉语 +4.4 pp，专用 guard 最敏感。
Motivation: agent 的 step-level guard 在每次工具调用前判定动作是否安全，但 guard prompt 与训练评测基准都是英文，而用户请求语言多样；若判定随语言变化，安全护栏在非英语用户面前就不可靠。
Method: 从 TS-Bench AgentDojo-Traj 的 1,220 条带标签步骤构建 LinguaGuardBench，只翻译用户指令为德语、法语、土耳其语、斯瓦希里语、阿姆哈拉语，工具调用、观测与标签保持逐字节一致，使判定变化只能归因于语言；用六种英文改写与空白安慰剂作对照，托管 guard 重复运行三次测噪声，覆盖 19 个 guard（前沿 API、4B 开源模型、四个专用 agent guard），并做事后分析定位受损步骤。
Result: 19 个 guard 中多数开源、小参数与专用 guard 的翻译翻转率超出自身噪声，且语言越罕见效应越大：13B 以下九个 guard 的均值安慰剂校正翻转率从法语 +1.5 pp 升至阿姆哈拉语 +4.4 pp。专用 guard 最敏感；损伤方向随参数量分叉——12–30B 开源 guard 更多拦截良性步骤（误报最高 +5.0 pp），所有显著召回损失都出现在 10B 以下 guard（最高 −7.4 pp）。前沿 guard 最多偏移约 1 个点，最强的 Gemini 3.8 Flash 在有无请求下返回完全相同判定。损伤集中在少数指令，事后分析显示落在 agent 推理复述英文请求的步骤上；英文改写对每个 guard 的影响都小于翻译。发布基准与全部 489k 条判定。
Conclusion: 语言本身是 agent guard 的安全攻击面：判定变化与 guard 对多通道不一致的反应一致，且小参数与专用 guard 最脆弱，前沿大模型基本免疫。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Shortcut Sensitivity in Agent-Safety Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: AI agents take actions through tools. Some actions are sensitive, so guards that supervise them must themselves be evaluated reliably. Yet the data used to evaluate a guard can include cues that make labels predictable without measuring the intended safety construct, and those cues can also influence guard decisions. We introduce a three-level shortcut-auditing framework and audit completed LinuxArena trajectories and two TS-Bench-derived step datasets. We distinguish label predictability, observational guard association, and paired decision sensitivity. In LinuxArena, shorter average shell commands strongly predict trajectory labels. In AgentDojo-Traj, exact-tool lookup falls from F_1=.901 with mixed-domain folds to .495 under domain holdout. In AgentHarm-Traj, released TS-Guard F_1 falls from .902 under row weighting to .719 with equal interaction weighting, while balanced accuracy rises. We then test the strongest safe-row marker association in a seven-configuration screen on a frozen 64-step AgentDojo-Traj cohort using repeated, interleaved Haiku calls. Rewriting the <INFORMATION> marker lowers blocking by 8.33 percentage points, while opaque tool aliases raise it by 11.46 points. All unsafe calls remain blocked; the changes concern false positives against inherited labels. Both effects remain nonzero after subtracting the formatting-placebo effect, with exploratory 95% ranges excluding zero. The same edits also change measured accuracy against inherited labels. This provides direct evidence that benchmark representation can materially change a guard's decisions and measured evaluation performance. The Haiku-sized effects do not reproduce in Luna or deterministic Q8 TS-Guard. We recommend domain group holdouts, evaluation-unit metrics, and placebo-controlled paired interventions.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 workshops TAE (Can We Trust AI Evaluation?) and AIWILD (Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 审计发现 agent 安全 guard 的评测数据含可预测标签的捷径线索，且这些线索会直接改变 guard 的决策：在冻结的 64 步 AgentDojo-Traj 队列上重写 <INFORMATION> 标记使拦截率下降 8.33 个百分点，改用不透明工具别名使其上升 11.46 个百分点，扣除格式安慰剂效应后两效应仍非零。作者建议评测采用 domain group holdout、按评测单元计指标、以及安慰剂对照的配对干预。
Motivation: 评测 guard 的数据里存在与标签相关但不测量目标安全构念的线索，这些线索既让标签可被捷径预测，又反过来影响 guard 的决策，使评测结果不可信。
Method: 提出三层捷径审计框架，区分标签可预测性 (label predictability)、观测性 guard 关联 (observational guard association)、配对决策敏感性 (paired decision sensitivity)；审计 LinuxArena 完整轨迹与两个 TS-Bench 派生步级数据集，并在冻结的 AgentDojo-Traj 队列上做七配置筛查，用重复交错的 Haiku 调用做配对干预与格式安慰剂对照。
Result: LinuxArena 中较短的 shell 命令强烈预测轨迹标签；AgentDojo-Traj 上 exact-tool lookup 的 F_1 从混合域折的 .901 降到 domain holdout 下的 .495；AgentHarm-Traj 上已发布 TS-Guard 的 F_1 从行加权的 .902 降到等交互加权的 .719，而 balanced accuracy 上升。重写 <INFORMATION> 标记使拦截率降 8.33 个百分点，不透明工具别名使其升 11.46 个百分点，全部不安全调用仍被拦截，变化只涉及对继承标签的假阳性；两效应扣除安慰剂后仍非零，探索性 95% 区间不含零。这些 Haiku 尺度的效应在 Luna 与确定性 Q8 TS-Guard 上不复现。
Conclusion: 基准的表示方式能实质改变 guard 的决策与测得的评测性能，因此评测必须用 domain group holdout、评测单元指标和安慰剂对照的配对干预；且该效应对模型规模/确定性实现敏感（Haiku 有、Luna 与 Q8 TS-Guard 无）。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SurvICL: a Foundation Model for in-context Survival Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) now outperform gradient-boosted trees in classification and regression. Yet in survival analysis, which predicts when an event occurs from censored data, often on small clinical cohorts, we find that no existing TFM beats the half-century-old Cox model. We address this issue by introducing SurvICL, a TFM that predicts survival curves in-context. SurvICL is pretrained on purely synthetic datasets generated from a novel flexible proportional-odds prior that outperforms other prior types in our ablation study. Unlike most other survival models, SurvICL is trained with a plain quantile regression loss, which is possible because its synthetic pre-training data generator can provide uncensored event times. Additionally, we introduce the largest survival benchmark to date spanning 103 datasets. On the 63 datasets held out from all design decisions, SurvICL outperforms 20 tree-based, deep, and foundation-model baselines without any tuning: it wins 82.9\% of pairwise comparisons in integrated Brier score, against 71.3\% for the runner-up, the Cox model, and is the first model to rank above Cox on small datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SurvICL 是面向生存分析的表格基础模型，在上下文 (in-context) 中直接输出生存曲线：用新型灵活 proportional-odds 先验生成纯合成数据预训练，配合普通分位数回归损失。在 103 个数据集的生存基准中，63 个完全留出的数据集上无需调优即赢下 82.9% 的两两比较（integrated Brier score），次优的 Cox 模型为 71.3%，且是首个在小数据集上排名超过 Cox 的模型。
Motivation: 表格基础模型已在分类与回归上超过梯度提升树，但在生存分析——从删失数据预测事件发生时间、且临床队列通常很小——现有 TFM 没有一个能打败有半个世纪历史的 Cox 模型。
Method: SurvICL 以 in-context 方式预测生存曲线；预训练数据全部为合成数据，由一个 novel flexible proportional-odds prior 生成器产出，消融研究显示该先验优于其他先验类型；因生成器能给出未删失事件时间，模型可用 plain quantile regression loss 训练。同时构建了迄今最大的生存基准，覆盖 103 个数据集。
Result: 在与所有设计决策隔离的 63 个留出数据集上，SurvICL 无需任何调优即胜过 20 个树模型、深度模型与基础模型基线：integrated Brier score 两两比较胜率 82.9%，次优的 Cox 模型为 71.3%；它是第一个在小数据集上排名高于 Cox 的模型。
Conclusion: 合成数据加分位数回归足以让表格基础模型在生存分析中稳定超过 Cox，包括此前无人突破的小样本临床队列场景。

papers.title: MMSearch-OPD: Easy Made Hard, Hard Made Learnable for Long-Horizon Multimodal Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal deep search is moving from short queries to long-horizon investigations that continually acquire evidence. However, training such agents remains constrained by limited challenging training questions and insufficient process feedback. We introduce MMSearch-OPD, combining controllable data refinement with joint reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). Our Refine pipeline performs targeted expansion of reasoning chains derived from existing simple multimodal questions. Parameterized transformations control search depth and cross-modal evidence requirements while reusing existing image--question pairs. For training, answer rewards and lightweight behavior penalties guide RL, while the reward gap modulates token-level teacher guidance on imperfect student trajectories. An exponentially decaying distillation coefficient reduces teacher dependence as training proceeds. Experiments show gains from data refinement and further improvements from joint training after SFT, indicating stronger long-horizon multimodal deep search capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMSearch-OPD 把简单多模态问答改造成需要长程搜索的难题，并用 RL 与 on-policy 蒸馏 (OPD) 联合训练提升多模态深搜能力。参数化变换控制搜索深度与跨模态证据需求，重用已有图文对；答案奖励加轻量行为惩罚引导 RL，奖励差距调制 token 级教师指导，蒸馏系数指数衰减以逐步摆脱教师依赖。实验显示数据精炼带来增益，SFT 后联合训练进一步提升长程多模态深搜能力。
Motivation: 多模态深搜正从短查询转向持续获取证据的长程调查，但训练受限于高难训练问题稀缺与过程反馈不足。
Method: Refine 流水线对现有简单多模态问题衍生的推理链做定向扩展，用参数化变换控制搜索深度与跨模态证据需求并复用已有图文对；训练时以答案奖励加轻量行为惩罚引导 RL，同时用奖励差距调制对不完美学生轨迹的 token 级教师指导，蒸馏系数指数衰减。
Result: 实验显示数据精炼本身带来增益，SFT 之后的联合训练 (RL + OPD) 进一步提升，表明长程多模态深搜能力更强。
Conclusion: 可控数据精炼与 RL、on-policy 蒸馏联合训练是缓解高难多模态训练问题不足、提升长程深搜能力的有效路径。

papers.title: Query-Efficient Rejection Sampling for Parallel Masked Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) accelerate generation by unmasking multiple tokens in parallel, but sampling these tokens independently ignores their correlations and biases the output. Anari et al. (2026) corrected this bias with rejection sampling, decomposing the log acceptance probability into a sum of token-level terms, but the evaluation requires one score query per unmasked token. We propose the Single-Increment Rejection Sampler (SIRS), which provides an estimate of the log acceptance probability from a single randomly sampled increment at the cost of one query. SIRS then converts a Poisson number of clipped estimates into accept/reject decisions through a Bernoulli factory adapted from Chen et al. (2026). Since each query returns the conditionals of all remaining tokens in the block, we further Rao-Blackwellize each increment by averaging over these tokens at no extra cost, thereby reducing clipping. We show that the KL-divergence between the data distribution and the SIRS output is bounded by a clipping term plus the model's training error. With exact scores, parallel decoding pays the full within-block dependence, whereas SIRS pays only the part beyond the clipping range.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Single-Increment Rejection Sampler (SIRS)，用单次 score 查询估计掩码扩散模型 (MDM) 的对数接受概率，把并行解码的查询开销从每个未掩码 token 一次降到一次。理论上 KL 散度被截断项加模型训练误差界定：精确分数下并行解码承担全部块内依赖，SIRS 只承担超出截断范围的那部分。
Motivation: MDM 并行解掩码时独立采样忽略 token 间相关性导致输出有偏；Anari et al. (2026) 的拒绝采样校正需对每个未掩码 token 各做一次 score 查询，查询开销随块大小线性增长。
Method: SIRS 从随机采样的单个 increment 估计对数接受概率，仅需一次查询；再把若干截断后的估计（Poisson 个）通过改造自 Chen et al. (2026) 的 Bernoulli factory 转成接受/拒绝决策。由于每次查询返回块内所有剩余 token 的条件分布，对 increment 在这些 token 上取平均做 Rao-Blackwell 化，零额外成本降低截断。
Result: 给出 KL 界：数据分布与 SIRS 输出之间的 KL 散度被一个截断项加模型训练误差界定；精确分数下并行解码付出全部块内依赖代价，SIRS 只付出超出截断范围的部分。摘要未给出实验数值。
Conclusion: 在 MDM 并行解码中，用单查询加 Bernoulli factory 的拒绝采样可以校正独立解码偏差，同时把查询开销压到常数，代价仅是截断范围外的依赖。

papers.title: Training-Free On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation consolidates specialist models into one student at the price of rollouts, teacher passes and gradient steps for every teacher. We show that the consolidation does not need training: with forward passes only, the capabilities of separately tuned specialists can be aggregated into one model that is, on average, more accurate than either specialist alone. When specialists share a base model, distillation has an exact layer-wise solution: each linear layer of the fused model must reproduce every specialist's output on the inputs that specialist receives while reading its own answers, a least-squares problem whose solution needs only the second moments of those inputs. One forward pass over a few hundred rollouts provides them. We call this training-free on-policy distillation (\method). What the rollouts contain matters more than the solver: answers truncated in repetition loops are few among a mathematics specialist's rollouts but carry a large share of their tokens, and removing them lifts the fused model on AIME25 from task arithmetic's level to the specialist's at matched precision. On Olmo~3 7B, a few GPU-hours of forward computation per specialist yield a generalist that keeps most of each specialist's gain on each of seven mathematics and code benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 训练无关的 on-policy 蒸馏 (training-free on-policy distillation)：当各专家共享同一 base model 时，融合模型的每个线性层只需在该专家所见输入上复现其输出，读取专家自身答案构成的最小二乘问题只需输入二阶矩，几百条 rollout 的一次前向即可求解。在 Olmo 3 7B 上，每个专家几 GPU 小时前向即得到在七个数学与代码基准上平均比任一专家更准的 generalist；剔除数学专家 rollout 中重复循环截断的答案后，AIME25 从 task arithmetic 水平升到专家水平（精度匹配）。
Motivation: on-policy 蒸馏整合专家需要为每个 teacher 付出 rollout、teacher 前向与梯度步骤，成本随专家数增长；作者要证明这种整合不必训练。
Method: 训练无关 on-policy 蒸馏：共享 base model 下给定逐层精确解，每个线性层解一个最小二乘问题，只需专家所见输入的二阶矩，由几百条 rollout 的一次前向提供；rollout 内容的取舍（如剔除重复循环截断答案）作为关键环节。
Result: 在 Olmo 3 7B 上，每个专家几 GPU 小时前向计算得到的 generalist 在七个数学与代码基准上平均比任一专家更准，并保留各专家在每个基准上的大部分增益；在 AIME25 上，剔除数学专家 rollout 中的重复循环截断答案后，融合模型从 task arithmetic 的水平升到专家水平（matched precision）。
Conclusion: 专家整合可以只靠前向完成，rollout 内容比求解器更关键：剔除重复循环截断答案能决定融合模型是停在 task arithmetic 水平还是追平专家。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OS-Helix: Unifying GUI Interaction and Code Execution in Native Computer-Using Agents
papers.abstract_en: Real desktop automation is neither purely visual nor purely programmatic. Agents must understand user-facing interfaces while efficiently manipulating files, scripts, and system state. However, native GUI/code coordination cannot be obtained by prompt-level tool composition. In our preliminary experiments, naively adding a code tool degrades a GUI agent, revealing that GUI/code routing must be internalized through training on high-quality hybrid data. We present OS-Helix, an end-to-end trained multimodal computer-using agent that unifies GUI actions and code execution in one action space. To construct the required supervision, we introduce application-artifact composition, pairing desktop applications with authentic file artifacts to instantiate executable Ubuntu states, and a decoupled instruction/evaluator generation pipeline that produces environment-grounded tasks whose final states can be verified regardless of the solution modality. We cold-start the policy with SFT on filtered hybrid data and further improve it through online RL in live desktop environments. For RL, we propose Step-balanced GSPO, which aggregates importance weight by action step rather than raw assistant tokens to prevent long code actions from dominating heterogeneous-action optimization. On OSWorld-Verified, OS-Helix-27B and OS-Helix-35B-A3B achieve relative improvements of 35.0% and 33.7% over their matched Qwen3.5 hybrid baselines, while OS-Helix-27B-RL further improves by 42.9% to reach 66.44% success. Ablations provide evidence consistent with contributions from learned GUI/code coordination, scalable verifiable supervision, and action step balanced optimization, while demonstrating cross-platform transfer on WindowsAgentArena. Our project homepage is at https://os-copilot.github.io/OS-Helix/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OS-Helix 把 GUI 动作与代码执行放进同一动作空间，端到端训练出原生计算机操作 agent：用 application-artifact 组合造出可执行且终态可验证的 Ubuntu 环境，SFT 冷启动后在真实桌面环境做在线 RL，并提出按动作步而非原始 token 聚合重要性权重的 Step-balanced GSPO，防止长代码动作主导异构动作优化。在 OSWorld-Verified 上 OS-Helix-27B 与 35B-A3B 相对匹配的 Qwen3.5 混合基线分别提升 35.0% 与 33.7%，27B-RL 再提升 42.9% 达到 66.44% 成功率。
Motivation: 桌面自动化既要看懂用户界面又要操作文件、脚本与系统状态，但 GUI/代码协同无法靠 prompt 层拼工具得到：初步实验显示直接加一个 code tool 反而拉低 GUI agent 表现，必须靠高质量混合数据在训练中内化路由。
Method: OS-Helix 在统一动作空间里端到端训练多模态 computer-using agent。监督构造包括 application-artifact composition（把桌面应用与真实文件工件配对，实例化可执行的 Ubuntu 状态）和解耦的 instruction/evaluator 生成流水线，产出与环境绑定、且无论解法模态都可校验终态的任务；先用过滤后的混合数据 SFT 冷启动，再在真实桌面环境做在线 RL，RL 采用 Step-balanced GSPO，按动作步而非原始 assistant token 聚合重要性权重。
Result: 在 OSWorld-Verified 上，OS-Helix-27B 与 OS-Helix-35B-A3B 相对各自匹配的 Qwen3.5 混合基线分别取得 35.0% 和 33.7% 的相对提升；OS-Helix-27B-RL 在此基础上再提升 42.9%，达到 66.44% 成功率。消融结果与学到的 GUI/代码协同、可扩展的可验证监督、动作步平衡优化三项贡献一致，并在 WindowsAgentArena 上展示跨平台迁移。
Conclusion: GUI/代码路由必须通过高质量混合数据在训练中内化，而非 prompt 级工具组合；按动作步平衡的策略优化能让长代码动作不再主导异构动作的 RL 更新，且学到的协同可跨平台迁移到 Windows。
Relevance: 2
