papers.title: WaveLLM: Wavelet-Domain LLM Entropy Modeling for Lossless Image Compression
papers.abstract_en: Lossless image compression fundamentally relies on accurate entropy modeling, driving a recent shift toward large language model (LLM)-based methods. However, existing approaches mainly emphasize the modeling capacity of LLMs while directly serializing images into pixel or residual sequences, leaving heterogeneous signal patterns entangled within a single prediction stream. In this paper, we argue that effective entropy modeling depends not only on model capacity, but also on the predictability of the input representation. Motivated by this insight, we propose WaveLLM, a wavelet-domain LLM-based entropy model for lossless image compression. By decomposing an image into multi-level wavelet subbands, WaveLLM converts a heterogeneous prediction problem into a set of more structured and statistically homogeneous subproblems that are more amenable to autoregressive probability estimation. To bridge numerical coding symbols with the LLM's native text token space, we introduce a dedicated numerical interface featuring value embeddings and a coefficient prediction head. Furthermore, a task-adaptive prompting strategy is designed to enable a single shared model to adapt to diverse subbands within a unified framework. Built on Llama-3.2-3B with LoRA adaptation, WaveLLM achieves 2.51, 2.24, and 2.27 bpsp on Kodak, CLIC.pro, and DIV2K, respectively, outperforming the PixelCNN-based codec using the same wavelet transform by 0.43, 0.36, and 0.46 bpsp, and surpassing recent LLM-based lossless compressors on all three benchmarks.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26). 10 pages, 6 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WaveLLM 把图像做多级小波分解，用 LLM 对各子带分别做自回归熵建模，把异质像素流拆成统计上更均匀的子问题。基于 Llama-3.2-3B 加 LoRA，在 Kodak、CLIC.pro、DIV2K 上分别取得 2.51、2.24、2.27 bpsp，比同小波变换的 PixelCNN 编码器低 0.43、0.36、0.46 bpsp，并在三个基准上超过近期 LLM 无损压缩器。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 无损压缩只强调模型容量，把图像直接序列化成像素或残差，异质信号模式纠缠在同一条预测流里，输入表示本身的可预测性被忽略。
Method: 多级小波子带分解将预测问题拆为更结构化、统计均匀的子问题；引入数值接口（value embeddings 加 coefficient prediction head）把编码符号接入 LLM 文本 token 空间；用任务自适应 prompting 让单一共享模型适配不同子带；主干为 Llama-3.2-3B，LoRA 微调。
Result: bpsp：Kodak 2.51、CLIC.pro 2.24、DIV2K 2.27；相对使用相同小波变换的 PixelCNN 编码器分别低 0.43、0.36、0.46 bpsp；在全部三个基准上超过近期 LLM 无损压缩器。
Conclusion: 熵建模的效果不只取决于 LLM 容量，也取决于输入表示的可预测性：小波域拆分加数值接口与子带自适应提示，能在同一共享模型下提升无损压缩率。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 LLM 无损压缩只强调模型容量，把图像直接序列化成像素或残差，异质信号模式纠缠在同一条预测流里，输入表示本身的可预测性被忽略。
summary_sections.method: 多级小波子带分解将预测问题拆为更结构化、统计均匀的子问题；引入数值接口（value embeddings 加 coefficient prediction head）把编码符号接入 LLM 文本 token 空间；用任务自适应 prompting 让单一共享模型适配不同子带；主干为 Llama-3.2-3B，LoRA 微调。
summary_sections.result: bpsp：Kodak 2.51、CLIC.pro 2.24、DIV2K 2.27；相对使用相同小波变换的 PixelCNN 编码器分别低 0.43、0.36、0.46 bpsp；在全部三个基准上超过近期 LLM 无损压缩器。
summary_sections.conclusion: 熵建模的效果不只取决于 LLM 容量，也取决于输入表示的可预测性：小波域拆分加数值接口与子带自适应提示，能在同一共享模型下提升无损压缩率。

papers.title: Architecting for Hardware Diversity: Meta's End-to-End Co-Design for High-Performance AI Training on AMD GPUs
papers.abstract_en: Meta deploys a heterogeneous fleet comprising NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and proprietary MTIA accelerators to reduce costs and mitigate vendor lock-in. However, the extensive history of NVIDIA-specific optimizations hinders performance portability to other hardware. This paper presents our methods for optimizing alternative accelerators, using AMD Instinct MI350X versus NVIDIA B200 for recommendation model training as a case study. We propose three reusable principles. First, hardware-model co-design is essential: rather than directly porting models from NVIDIA GPUs, revising model structures and software recipes allows full exploitation of accelerator-specific strengths (e.g., MI350X's 1.6x HBM capacity relative to B200). Second, our analytical performance model enables zero-warmup optimal kernel selection across diverse datatypes and matrix shapes in production models, drastically simplifying tuning. Third, increasingly mature agentic workflows have lowered the barrier to porting from the CUDA ecosystem; we extend these workflows for microarchitecture-aware kernel optimizations and custom shim generation. Compared to the directly ported baseline, these methods deliver up to 1.5x improvement in end-to-end training throughput. To our knowledge, this is the first hyperscaler report on productionizing AMD GPUs for large-scale training. Our contributions have been upstreamed to the open-source PyTorch, Triton, and ROCm ecosystems.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 21 figures, 6 tables. To appear in the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Meta 以 AMD Instinct MI350X 对比 NVIDIA B200 的推荐模型训练为案例，提出三条可复用原则：硬件-模型协同设计（利用 MI350X 相对 B200 的 1.6 倍 HBM 容量）、零预热的解析性能模型选核、以及扩展 agentic workflow 做微架构感知的 kernel 优化与自定义 shim 生成。相比直接移植基线，端到端训练吞吐最高提升 1.5 倍。
Motivation: Meta 的异构算力集群（NVIDIA、AMD GPU 与 MTIA）中，长期积累的 NVIDIA 专属优化阻碍了向其他加速器的性能可移植性，直接移植模型无法发挥加速器特有优势。
Method: 三条原则：硬件-模型协同设计，修改模型结构与软件配方以利用加速器特长；解析性能模型在不同数据类型与矩阵形状上做零预热最优 kernel 选择；扩展 agentic workflow 生成微架构感知 kernel 与自定义 shim。以推荐模型训练在 MI350X vs B200 上落地。
Result: 相比直接移植基线，端到端训练吞吐最高提升 1.5 倍；MI350X 的 HBM 容量为 B200 的 1.6 倍。
Conclusion: 跨硬件性能可移植性应靠模型与硬件协同设计、解析选核和 agentic 移植工作流共同实现，而非直接移植 NVIDIA 代码；成果已上游至 PyTorch、Triton、ROCm。

papers.title: How Much Physics Can Vision Learn from Audio? Probing and Distilling Damping Structure
papers.abstract_en: Physical understanding is crucial for decision making, yet vision models struggle to infer properties such as damping that govern how materials behave. Audio encodes such properties directly, because an object's acoustic response to impact reveals its damping through measurable decay. We probe frozen encoders for the quality factor $Q$, a dimensionless measure of how many oscillations an object completes before its ring dies away, and report how well each embedding orders impacts by $Q$ using the Spearman rank correlation $ρ$, for which $ρ=1$ is a perfect ordering and $ρ=0$ an unrelated one. Audio embeddings reach $ρ=0.73$ and retain most of that advantage on materials withheld from training, while a single video frame taken at the moment of impact, encoded by CLIP, supports only $ρ=0.28$. Having established where the signal lives, we ask how much of that gap vision can recover. We distill a frozen audio teacher into a frozen CLIP backbone through a trained projection head and find that this recovers a useful fraction of the audio advantage. Because pooled correlations on this task are dominated in practice by category identity, we also evaluate under a leave-one-material-out protocol in which the held-out material is withheld from the projection head as well as the probe. Distillation with a four-frame input improves the correlation there from 0.234 to 0.338 (+0.053 over the matched four-frame baseline, 14 of 17 materials), a gain that no category-level strategy can produce. Widening the visual input to four frames spanning the impact supplies half of that improvement at no acoustic cost, which indicates that part of what a single frame misses is visible dynamics.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at two NeurIPS 2026 workshops: Representations for the Physical Sciences (RPS) and Physical Understanding for Decision-Making (PhysUnderstand)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的视觉-音频编码器上探测撞击阻尼品质因子 Q 的排序能力：音频 embedding 的 Spearman ρ 达 0.73，而 CLIP 编码撞击瞬间单帧仅 0.28。把冻结音频教师经训练的投影头蒸馏进冻结 CLIP 后，在 leave-one-material-out 协议下四帧输入把 ρ 从 0.234 提到 0.338（+0.053，17 种材料中 14 种），其中一半增益来自跨越撞击的四帧时序扩展。
Motivation: 视觉模型难以推断决定材料行为的阻尼等物理属性，而音频的撞击衰减直接编码该属性；需要量化视觉与音频在该属性上的表征差距，并判断视觉能追回多少。
Method: 冻结多个视觉与音频 encoder，用探针预测无量纲品质因子 Q，以 Spearman 秩相关 ρ 衡量 embedding 对撞击按 Q 的排序质量；再把冻结音频教师经训练的投影头蒸馏进冻结 CLIP backbone，并采用 leave-one-material-out 协议（被留出材料同时对投影头与探针不可见），对比单帧与跨撞击四帧输入。
Result: 音频 embedding ρ=0.73，且在训练中未见的材料上保留大部分优势；CLIP 编码撞击瞬间单帧仅 ρ=0.28。leave-one-material-out 下四帧蒸馏把 ρ 从 0.234 提到 0.338，相对匹配的四帧基线 +0.053，17 种材料中 14 种提升；把视觉输入扩为跨撞击四帧贡献了该提升的一半，且无额外声学代价。
Conclusion: 阻尼信号主要存在于音频而非单帧视觉，但视觉可通过音频到 CLIP 的蒸馏追回一部分，且单帧缺失的部分信息是可见的撞击动态，扩帧比任何类别级策略更能带来该增益。

papers.title: Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation for Unified Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) can elicit specialized visual capabilities in vision-language models (VLMs), yet jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives often introduces cross-capability gradient conflicts. Training experts independently mitigates this interference, but direct reward optimization may entangle specialized knowledge with reward-hacking biases. This paper proposes Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation (SCOPED), which trains capability-specific experts and extracts explicit skills through reward-guided reflection. During on-policy distillation, these skills guide expert supervision while remaining unavailable to the unified student, encouraging it to internalize procedural knowledge without explicit skills at inference time. Across eight multimodal benchmarks, SCOPED consistently outperforms the backbone and mixed-capability RL, demonstrating the effectiveness of skill-decoupled on-policy expert distillation for integrating independently acquired capabilities. Further analyses reveal interference during joint capability optimization and suggest that skill augmentation promotes more consistent expert trajectories, greater attention to task-relevant visual evidence, and better preservation of specialized expertise in the unified student. All code and data are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/SCOPED.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCOPED 先用 RL 分别训练各能力专家，再通过 reward 引导的反思 (reward-guided reflection) 抽出显式 skill，在 on-policy 蒸馏中让 skill 只指导专家监督、不提供给统一学生，使其在推理时不依赖显式 skill 也能内化程序性知识。在八个多模态基准上，SCOPED 一致优于 backbone 与混合能力 RL。
Motivation: VLM 上用 RL 同时优化异构目标会产生跨能力梯度冲突；而各自独立训练专家虽能缓解干扰，直接 reward 优化又会把专业知识与 reward-hacking 偏差纠缠在一起。
Method: 三段式：分别训练 capability-specific experts；用 reward 引导的反思从专家中提取显式 skill；on-policy 蒸馏时以 skill 指导专家侧监督，但统一学生看不到 skill，只吸收程序性知识。
Result: 在八个多模态基准上一致超过 backbone 与 mixed-capability RL；进一步分析显示联合能力优化存在干扰，skill 增强带来更一致的专家轨迹、更多注意力落在任务相关视觉证据上，并在统一学生中更好地保留专业知识。
Conclusion: 把能力拆开训练、蒸馏时用 skill 引导但不暴露给学生，是整合独立获得能力的有效路径；代码与数据已在 GitHub 公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FutureLift: Lifting Trajectory Proposals into Bidirectional Future Graphs for Motion Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate motion prediction is critical for safe autonomous driving, yet even strong forecasters leave residual errors in their multimodal proposals. Existing refiners compress complete proposals or update their segments sequentially, preventing the full proposed future from serving as explicit relational context for correction. We introduce FutureLift, a backbone-agnostic refiner that represents each multimodal proposal as a heterogeneous future graph, with spatially grounded temporal nodes connected to agent histories, map elements, alternative modes, and, for joint prediction, other agents future trajectories. Bidirectional temporal edges allow later evidence to revise earlier segments in a single pass, and the updated nodes predict residual coordinate and confidence corrections. Requiring only proposals, scores, and scene context, FutureLift provides a common refinement interface for structurally different forecasting backbones. On Argoverse2 and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, it consistently improves frozen proposals and outperforms native and specialized refiners across marginal and joint forecasting. On the WOMD motion-prediction leaderboard, FutureLift ranks first in minADE (0.5049m) and minFDE (0.9942m) among the compared standard-input methods, without LiDAR or ensembling, while achieving a competitive 0.4874 Soft mAP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FutureLift 把多模态运动预报的每条候选轨迹提升为异构未来图 (heterogeneous future graph)，用双向时序边让后期证据在单次前向中修正早期片段，并输出残差坐标与置信度修正。在 Argoverse2 与 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 上一致改善冻结的候选轨迹，并在 WOMD 榜单的标准输入方法中以 minADE 0.5049m、minFDE 0.9942m 排名第一，且不用 LiDAR 与集成。
Motivation: 强运动预报器的多模态候选仍留有残差误差，而现有 refiner 要么把完整候选压缩成向量、要么逐段顺序更新，导致整段未来无法作为显式关系上下文参与修正。
Method: FutureLift 是 backbone-agnostic 的 refiner：将每条多模态候选表示为异构未来图，空间锚定的时间节点连接 agent 历史、地图元素、其他候选模式，联合预报时还连接其他 agent 的未来轨迹；双向时序边支持单次前向的跨段修正，更新后的节点预测残差坐标与置信度修正。只需候选轨迹、分数与场景上下文即可接入结构不同的预报 backbone。
Result: 在 Argoverse2 与 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 上一致改善冻结候选，并在 marginal 与 joint 预报上超过原生与专用 refiner；在 WOMD motion-prediction 榜单的标准输入方法中 minADE 0.5049m、minFDE 0.9942m 排名第一，Soft mAP 为 0.4874，全程不用 LiDAR 或 ensembling。
Conclusion: 把候选轨迹整体作为关系图并允许双向时序修正，是一种可跨不同预报 backbone 复用的通用精修接口，能在不依赖 LiDAR 与集成的条件下把标准输入方法推到 WOMD 榜首。

papers.title: GNN-Guided Local Refinement for Efficient Layout Decomposition with DSA-MP
papers.abstract_en: Multiple patterning lithography (MPL) has been widely used to improve lithography resolution in advanced nodes, but it faces cost limits as feature sizes shrink. Directed self-assembly (DSA) offers a cost-effective complement, extending the resolution of optical lithography to sub-10 nm and beyond. Integrating DSA into MPL (DSA-MP) further enhances the resolution of contact/via patterning. Nevertheless, growing design complexity exposes the limits of existing decomposition methods, which struggle to balance solution quality and runtime, and neglect edge-to-edge spacing constraints of DSA templates, compromising manufacturability. To address these issues, we introduce a new conflict graph model capturing the previously overlooked constraints and develop a local refinement strategy powered by the graph neural network, enabling efficient and scalable layout decomposition. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves higher solution quality with faster convergence than state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining robustness across layout scales, design styles, technology nodes, and varying mask counts.
papers.comment: 9 pages. Accepted at the IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 DSA-MP 版图分解，提出一种新的冲突图模型，把此前被忽略的 DSA 模板边到边间距约束纳入建模，并用图神经网络 (GNN) 驱动的局部 refinement 策略求解。实验显示该方法比现有最先进方法解质量更高、收敛更快，且在不同版图规模、设计风格、工艺节点和掩模数量下保持稳健。
Motivation: 先进节点下多重图案光刻 (MPL) 成本受限，DSA-MP 提升接触孔/通孔分辨率，但设计复杂度上升使现有分解方法难以兼顾解质量与运行时，且忽略 DSA 模板的边到边间距约束，损害可制造性。
Method: 构建新的冲突图模型，显式刻画此前被忽略的 DSA 模板边到边间距约束；在此基础上提出由图神经网络 (GNN) 驱动的局部 refinement 策略，用于高效可扩展的版图分解。
Result: 实验表明该方法相较最先进方法解质量更高、收敛更快，并在不同版图规模、设计风格、工艺节点与掩模数量下保持稳健。
Conclusion: 把 DSA 间距约束写进冲突图、再用 GNN 做局部 refinement，可以在 DSA-MP 版图分解中同时改善解质量、收敛速度与跨场景稳健性。

papers.title: Generalization Guarantees of Randomized Block Coordinate Descent for Nonconvex Learning
papers.abstract_en: Randomized block coordinate descent (RBCD) is a popular optimization algorithm for many large-scale machine learning problems. The existing theoretical analysis of RBCD mainly focuses on its convergence behavior from an optimization perspective, while its generalization behavior remains less understood for nonconvex problems. In this paper, we establish high-probability generalization guarantees for RBCD with nonconvex objectives. In the general nonconvex setting, we derive bounds on the gradients of both empirical and population risks, requiring only standard smoothness assumptions. With polynomially decaying step sizes, we tune the iteration number to balance optimization and generalization, thereby quantifying how early stopping leads to the optimal convergence rate for the population gradients. In the gradient-dominated setting, we provide bounds in terms of functional suboptimality, which nearly match the optimistic rates in convex and low-noise settings. Finally, we develop dimension-independent bounds for loss functions of a specific structure, making the generalization guarantees applicable to high-dimensional problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对随机块坐标下降 (RBCD) 在非凸目标上给出高概率泛化保证：一般非凸设定下只需标准光滑性假设即可界定经验风险与总体风险的梯度界，配合多项式衰减步长调节迭代数，量化 early stopping 如何使总体梯度达到最优收敛率。梯度主导 (gradient-dominated) 设定下给出函数次优性界，几乎匹配凸与低噪声设定的乐观速率；对特定结构损失还可给出与维度无关的界，从而适用于高维问题。
Motivation: RBCD 的既有理论主要从优化角度分析收敛行为，其在非凸问题上的泛化行为仍不清楚，而泛化正是决定算法能否用于大规模机器学习训练的关键。
Method: 针对非凸目标的 RBCD 建立高概率泛化界：在一般非凸设定下仅用标准光滑性假设推导经验风险与总体风险的梯度界；采用多项式衰减步长并调节迭代次数以平衡优化与泛化；在梯度主导设定下改用函数次优性度量，并对特定结构的损失函数推导维度无关的界。
Result: 一般非凸设定下得到经验与总体风险的梯度高概率界，多项式衰减步长下 early stopping 使总体梯度达到最优收敛率；梯度主导设定下的函数次优性界几乎匹配凸与低噪声设定的乐观速率；对特定结构损失得到维度无关的界，可覆盖高维问题。
Conclusion: RBCD 在非凸目标上的泛化可由光滑性假设与步长/迭代数调度来量化，early stopping 是平衡优化与泛化的有效旋钮，且在梯度主导与特定损失结构下界可做到接近乐观速率乃至维度无关。

papers.title: TRACE: Topology-Aware Reconnection via Prediction-Adaptive Connectivity Enforcement for Thin-Structure Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Thin, elongated structures are particularly sensitive to connectivity errors, as even a few local segmentation mistakes can disrupt otherwise continuous paths. Existing skeleton-based objectives typically supervise fixed centerline locations and do not account for alternative local routes that may restore connectivity. We propose TRACE, a topology-aware, prediction-adaptive objective that uses a target skeleton to define required local connections. For each connection, TRACE identifies the easiest valid reconnection under the current prediction and jointly supervises its bottleneck with the corresponding skeleton point. The supervision thus adapts to the evolving prediction rather than remaining fixed to the centerline. We further introduce a topology-aware skeleton carrier that preserves both foreground and class-specific topology, enabling reliable definition of these connections. Extensive experiments across six 2D and 3D benchmarks show that TRACE improves connectivity and topology while maintaining strong segmentation accuracy with low training overhead. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 是面向细长结构分割的拓扑感知目标函数：用目标骨架定义必须连通的局部连接，并在当前预测下寻找最省力的合法重连路径，联合监督该瓶颈点与对应骨架点，使监督随预测演化而非固定在中心线上。在六个 2D/3D 基准上提升连通性与拓扑指标，同时保持分割精度且训练开销低。
Motivation: 细长结构对连通性错误极敏感，少数局部分割失误即可切断整条路径；现有基于骨架的目标只监督固定中心线位置，不考虑能恢复连通的替代局部路径。
Method: TRACE 用目标骨架定义所需局部连接，对每条连接在当前预测下识别最易实现的合法重连并与其对应骨架点联合监督瓶颈；另引入拓扑感知骨架载体 (topology-aware skeleton carrier)，同时保持前景与类别特定拓扑以可靠定义这些连接。
Result: 在六个 2D 与 3D 细长结构分割基准上的实验中，TRACE 改善连通性与拓扑指标，同时维持强分割精度，训练开销低。
Conclusion: 把骨架监督从固定中心线改为随预测自适应的重连瓶颈监督，可在不牺牲分割精度的前提下提升细长结构的连通性与拓扑正确性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Downstream QA: Rethinking How We Evaluate Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory benchmarks evaluate whether an agent's responses reflect correct knowledge, measuring downstream question-answering accuracy as a proxy for memory quality. We show this evaluation paradigm is incomplete: it conflates memory correctness with retrieval and generation quality, producing both false positives where correct responses mask broken memory and false negatives where incorrect responses blame correct memory for retrieval failures. We introduce FEB-30, a benchmark of 30 fact-evolution trajectories spanning 6 diagnostic categories and 3 difficulty levels, constructed via paradigm inversion: documents are generated from known fact trajectories, yielding deterministic ground truth without human annotation. Each trajectory defines how a fact should evolve across multi-author artifacts (documents, emails, conversations), enabling direct inspection of the memory store after each ingestion step. Applying FEB-30 to a representative memory system, we demonstrate that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by an average of 16 percentage points, with 44% of trajectories exceeding meaningful divergence thresholds. Diagnostic decomposition reveals that the system correctly classifies memory operations (create, update, reinforce, supersede) only 20% of the time, a failure entirely invisible to extrinsic evaluation, and that failure modes differ systematically by category and difficulty. We release the benchmark, document generation pipeline, and scoring framework to support reproducible evaluation of agent memory systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FEB-30 用范式反转（paradigm inversion）从已知事实轨迹反向生成文档，得到无需人工标注的确定性真值，从而在每次摄取后直接检查 agent 记忆库。对一个代表性记忆系统的评测显示，内在（intrinsic）与外在（extrinsic）QA 评测平均相差 16 个百分点，44% 的轨迹超过有意义的分歧阈值，且该系统对记忆操作（create、update、reinforce、supersede）的分类正确率仅 20%，这一失败对外在评测完全不可见。
Motivation: 以 QA 准确率作为记忆质量代理会把记忆正确性与检索、生成质量混为一谈：既产生正确回答掩盖记忆已损坏的假阳性，也产生把检索失败错记到正确记忆头上的假阴性。
Method: 构建 FEB-30：30 条事实演化轨迹，覆盖 6 个诊断类别与 3 个难度层级，由已知事实轨迹反向生成多作者工件（documents、emails、conversations），使每步摄取后可直接检查记忆库；配套发布文档生成 pipeline 与评分框架。
Result: 在一个代表性记忆系统上，内在与外在评测平均分歧 16 个百分点，44% 的轨迹超过分歧阈值；记忆操作分类正确率仅 20%，该失败对外在评测不可见；失败模式随类别与难度系统性变化。
Conclusion: 下游 QA 准确率不足以刻画 agent 记忆质量，需要能直接检查记忆库的内在评测作为补充；FEB-30 及其生成与评分工具以可复现方式支持这一评测。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Decentralized LLM Workflows via Sequential Auctions
papers.abstract_en: We present a scalable framework for solving multi-step tasks through a decentralized market of self-interested agents. Prior theoretical work demonstrated that agents organized through sequential auctions can converge to a globally optimal policy in a Markov decision process (MDP), but relied on the restrictive assumption of the existence of perfect clones as a model of perfect competition. In reality, exact clones drive agent profit to zero, violating the natural risk-reward incentives of participants. Conversely, we empirically demonstrate that the opposite extreme, absence of competition, also leads to market failure and value extraction collapse. Between these two extremes, we investigate how heterogeneous agents can survive in markets that span the critical middle ground of imperfect competition. To be profitable, agents learn to strategically shade bids to secure positive individual profit margins, while still ensuring that the marketplace functions effectively enough so that collaborative tasks posed by market consumers can still be solved. We formulate and evaluate four bidding algorithms (Mirror Descent, Thompson Sampling, Bayes-Optimal, and PPO) across three auction protocols (1st-Price, 2nd-Price, and Credit-Conserving Vickrey). Across a diverse set of domains, we demonstrate that imperfect competition successfully sustains necessary agent profit margins while maintaining high task success rates at low costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以序贯拍卖组织自利 LLM agent 的去中心化市场框架，用不完全竞争替代既有理论中“完美克隆”假设：完全克隆会把 agent 利润压到零，而完全无竞争会导致市场失灵与价值提取崩溃。在中间地带，agent 学会策略性压价 (shade bids) 保住正利润，同时市场仍能以低成本高成功率完成消费者提出的协作任务。
Motivation: 既有理论证明序贯拍卖能让 agent 收敛到 MDP 全局最优策略，但依赖“完美克隆”这一完美竞争假设；现实中克隆使利润为零，破坏参与激励，而另一极端（无竞争）经验上同样导致市场失灵。
Method: 提出去中心化序贯拍卖市场框架，让异质 agent 在不完全竞争区间内学习出价；形式化并评估四种出价算法——Mirror Descent、Thompson Sampling、Bayes-Optimal、PPO——在三种拍卖协议（1st-Price、2nd-Price、Credit-Conserving Vickrey）下的表现，覆盖多组领域。
Result: 在多样领域上，不完全竞争成功维持了 agent 必需的正利润空间，同时保持高任务成功率与低成本；摘要给出的对照是完全克隆（利润归零）与无竞争（市场失灵、价值提取崩溃）两个极端。
Conclusion: 多步任务的去中心化 LLM agent 市场需要落在不完全竞争的中间地带：出价策略要同时保住个体利润与市场整体任务完成效率，两个极端都不可行。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use
papers.abstract_en: Computer use has reached a turning point: the focus is expanding from GUI-only interaction to systems that complete tasks on users' computers through visual and programmatic interfaces. We define a generalist computer-use agent (GCUA) as a system in which the model chooses how to observe, act, and organize its work across visual and programmatic interfaces. Yet frontier implementations, such as GPT-6 Astra's computer-use system, remain largely closed, limiting systematic study of their design. We introduce Open Generalist CUA (OpenGCUA), an ongoing project to develop and open the full stack for GCUAs with the community. This report presents the first release of OpenGCUA. Code execution is a key feature of our agent design: it lets intermediate results determine subsequent operations and enables models to apply their existing programming capabilities directly to computer interaction. We also propose harness-to-model decision transfer, moving selected observations and task-state decisions from fixed harness rules to the model. On OSWorld-v2, our full configuration improves task scores across all eight evaluated models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5, raising mean partial score by +19.6 points and reducing reported steps per task by an average of 53.0% relative to batched GUI-only execution. We release our implementation and prompts, evaluation trajectories from all eight models, and preliminary versions of a real-device harness and a cross-device SDK. papers.title: HTN-Orchestrate: A Hierarchical Task Network Framework for Multi-Agent Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: Orchestrating multiple agents on a complex task requires reconciling local subtask execution with global task planning. Dynamic dispatch approaches provide execution flexibility but do not explicitly model subtask hierarchies or dependencies, while predefined workflows impose this structure but fix the decomposition before execution begins. Therefore, we introduce HTN-Orchestrate, a two-layer framework that separates these responsibilities through a hierarchical task network (HTN). The Planner maintains subtask hierarchies and dependencies, deferring decomposition until prerequisite results become available, while local Orchestrators schedule workers to execute each leaf subtask. Results propagate upward under \textbf{AND} semantics, and accumulated findings inform a rebuilt task network when the current decomposition cannot resolve the task. On five benchmarks spanning web research, scientific reasoning, and research workflows, HTN-Orchestrate outperforms ReAct, Agent Team, and DeepSeek Harness using the same base model, achieving 89.73% accuracy on BrowseComp and 73.44% on SUPERChem, exceeding Agent Team by 2.45 and 4.69 percentage points, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HTN-Orchestrate 用分层任务网络 (HTN) 把多智能体编排拆成两层：Planner 维护子任务层级与依赖并延迟分解，本地 Orchestrator 调度 worker 执行叶子子任务，结果按 AND 语义上卷，当前分解无法解决任务时用累积发现重建任务网络。在五个覆盖网页检索、科学推理与研究流程的基准上，同底座模型下优于 ReAct、Agent Team 与 DeepSeek Harness，BrowseComp 准确率 89.73%、SUPERChem 73.44%，分别超 Agent Team 2.45 与 4.69 个百分点。
Motivation: 动态分派灵活但不显式建模子任务层级与依赖，预定义工作流有结构却在执行前就固定分解，两者都无法在拿到前置结果后再决定如何拆解任务。
Method: 两层框架：Planner 用 HTN 维护子任务层级与依赖，推迟分解直到前置结果可用；本地 Orchestrator 调度 worker 执行每个叶子子任务；结果按 AND 语义向上传播，若当前分解无法解决任务，则用累积发现重建任务网络。
Result: 在五个基准（覆盖网页检索、科学推理、研究流程）上，与 ReAct、Agent Team、DeepSeek Harness 使用同一底座模型对比：BrowseComp 准确率 89.73%，SUPERChem 73.44%，分别高出 Agent Team 2.45 和 4.69 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把全局分解规划与本地执行调度分层解耦、并允许按前置结果延迟与重建分解，能在相同底座模型下提升多智能体在检索与科学推理任务上的准确率。

papers.title: AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Language model agents increasingly automate post-training, but when given the full training stack they converge on supervised fine-tuning and spend most effort revising training data. Existing systems give the agent one kind of control, selecting rows from a fixed pool or calling a generator, whereas a human data engineer adjusts proportions, prunes, repairs, replaces and synthesizes the data. We design a data action space for these changes and ask whether an automated system can make the full range rather than one of them, and what structure that requires. We first run this loop with a single agent, and it reaches only one action, adjusting category proportions, while its context fills with execution output and is discarded mid-search. We therefore introduce \textbf{AutoSFT}, a multi-agent system where a meta agent separates execution from analysis, gathers proposals from independent angles, and calls a synthesis subagent for capabilities the pool cannot cover, with the model, the trainer, and the budget fixed within each comparison. Adding each component in turn helps: the executor halves context loss, the analysis subagents lift the best IFEval by $+6.5$, and synthesis adds $+3.4$ IFEval and $+2.9$ IFBench. The same loop transfers to code, where analysis adds $+3.7$ MBPP+ over a single agent that does not improve. Every result comes from runs that retrain from the base model each round, so each component's effect is individually attributable. Our findings suggest that automating SFT data research depends more on covering diverse data actions than on a stronger single action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoSFT 把 SFT 数据研究做成多智能体系统：meta agent 把执行与分析分离、从多个独立角度收集数据改动提案，并对数据池覆盖不到的能力调用 synthesis 子智能体。逐项加组件均有效——executor 使 context 丢失减半，分析子智能体把最佳 IFEval 提升 +6.5，synthesis 再加 +3.4 IFEval 与 +2.9 IFBench；迁移到代码后分析子智能体带来 +3.7 MBPP+，而单智能体不提升。
Motivation: 给语言模型智能体完整训练栈时，它会收敛到 SFT 并把精力全花在改训练数据上；现有系统只给单一控制手段（从固定池选行或调用生成器），而人类数据工程师会同时调比例、剪枝、修复、替换与合成。
Method: 先设计覆盖调比例、剪枝、修复、替换、合成的数据 action space，用单智能体跑该循环作对照；再引入 AutoSFT：meta agent 分离执行与分析、从独立角度收集提案、按需调用 synthesis 子智能体，每轮比较内固定模型、训练器与预算，且每轮都从 base model 重新训练。
Result: 单智能体只到达调类别比例这一个 action，且 context 被执行输出填满、搜索中途被丢弃；加入 executor 使 context 丢失减半，分析子智能体使最佳 IFEval 提升 +6.5，synthesis 额外带来 +3.4 IFEval 与 +2.9 IFBench；迁移到代码任务后分析子智能体带来 +3.7 MBPP+，而单智能体在该任务上不提升。
Conclusion: 自动 SFT 数据研究的关键在于覆盖多样的数据动作，而非把单个动作做强；由于每轮都从 base model 重训，各组件的贡献可单独归因。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Terminal-RSI: Recursive Self-Improving Terminal Agents via Recursive Self-Rewrite and Policy-Refine
papers.abstract_en: Converting verifier outcomes into useful policy updates and partial progress into complete task resolution is crucial for terminal agents. We present Terminal-RSI, which alternates Recursive Self-Rewrite (RSR) of verified trajectories with critic-inheriting Recursive Policy-Refine (RPR). We formulate Turn-Boundary Skip-Observation GAE (TB-GAE) to retain token-specific baselines while applying decay across interaction turns. Family Dense Reward (FDR) calibrates semantic progress across task families; Success-Prioritized Reward (SPR) separates strict success from bounded partial credit. A Warm-up Critic Model, recursive critic handoff, and stage-specific learning rates coordinate the two refinement phases. The five-stage sequence from Qwen3.8-27B base model through RSR-1, RPR-1, RSR-2, and RPR-2 yields Terminal-RSI-27B: 19.84% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, 86.52% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 16.95% on Terminal-Bench 3.0, and 79.00% on Terminal-Bench Hard. On LHTB, process reward rises from 0.21 to 0.37 and strict completion from 0/46 to 5/46; SWR100 success doubles from 3.00% to 6.00%. By recursively coupling verified trajectory rewriting with critic-inheriting policy refinement, each retained stage consolidates discovered behaviors and progressively advances the agent from partial local repairs to strict terminal verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Terminal-RSI 用「已验证轨迹的递归自我改写 (RSR)」与「继承 critic 的递归策略精炼 (RPR)」交替训练终端智能体，把验证器信号转成策略更新、把局部修补推进到严格任务完成。从 Qwen3.8-27B base 出发经五阶段序列得到 Terminal-RSI-27B：Terminal-Bench 4.0 达 19.84%、2.1 达 86.52%、3.0 达 16.95%、Hard 达 79.00%；LHTB 上过程奖励从 0.21 升到 0.37，严格完成从 0/46 升到 5/46，SWR100 成功率从 3.00% 翻倍到 6.00%。
Motivation: 终端智能体的关键瓶颈在于：验证器给出的结果难以转成有效的策略更新，而任务中的部分进展也难以累积成完整解决。
Method: 交替执行 RSR（改写已验证轨迹）与 RPR（继承 critic 的策略精炼）；提出 Turn-Boundary Skip-Observation GAE (TB-GAE) 在跨交互轮次施加衰减的同时保留 token 级基线；Family Dense Reward (FDR) 校准跨任务族的语义进展，Success-Prioritized Reward (SPR) 区分严格成功与有界部分得分；配合 Warm-up Critic Model、递归 critic 交接与分阶段学习率协调两个精炼阶段。
Result: 五阶段序列（Qwen3.8-27B base → RSR-1 → RPR-1 → RSR-2 → RPR-2）产出 Terminal-RSI-27B：Terminal-Bench 4.0 为 19.84%，2.1 为 86.52%，3.0 为 16.95%，Hard 为 79.00%。LHTB 上过程奖励由 0.21 升至 0.37，严格完成由 0/46 升至 5/46；SWR100 成功率由 3.00% 翻倍至 6.00%。
Conclusion: 把已验证轨迹改写与继承 critic 的策略精炼递归耦合，可以让每个保留阶段固化已发现的行为，使智能体从局部修补逐步推进到严格终端验证。

papers.title: Attention over noisy examples: generalization and memorization in the exponential Hopfield network
papers.abstract_en: In Hebbian learning from examples a Hopfield network of $N$ neurons is not supplied with the $K$ archetypes it has to retrieve but with $M$ blurred examples of each, of quality $r$, and whether it can infer them depends on the load $α=K/N$ (interference among them) and on the dataset entropy $ρ=(1-r^2)/(Mr^2)$ (how little the examples say about them). We transfer this protocol to the exponential Hopfield model, whose zero-temperature update is a step of softmax attention with the unlabelled examples as keys. A signal-to-noise analysis gives in closed form the overlap between the output and an unseen archetype, $m^{(1)}={\rm erf}(1/\sqrt{2ρ_{\rm eff}})$: the majority-rule law of the pairwise model at small load, with $ρ$ replaced by an attention entropy $ρ_{\rm eff}$ built from the weight the softmax gives to the correct class and the number of examples it spreads it over. Two consequences follow. First, in a window of inverse temperatures $β$ that widens as $\sqrt N$ the interference between archetypes is exponentially small in $Nβ$: the load drops out and the number of archetypes that can be learnt grows as $\exp(c\sqrt N)$. Second, learning fails differently: in the pairwise model through a spin-glass phase, in the exponential model through memorization: the softmax concentrates its weight on the training example closest to the input and returns it in place of the archetype. Seen from the input the softmax weights are those of the random energy model, and memorization is its freezing transition, at $β\sqrt{N(1-r^2)}\simeq\sqrt{2\ln M}$; it is measurable on a head whose keys are examples as the number of examples carrying weight. On MNIST the diagnostic follows the random-energy prediction; on fashion-MNIST it detects sub-clusters in the classes, and the best accuracy lies beyond the memorization threshold, where the softmax reads out a local sub-prototype.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. Code, data and Monte Carlo results at https://github.com/francescoalemanno/hebb-attention
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Hebbian 学习从成对 Hopfield 迁到 exponential Hopfield（零温更新即对无标签样本做 softmax attention），信噪分析给出与未见原型的重叠闭式解 m⁽¹⁾=erf(1/√(2ρ_eff))，其中 ρ_eff 是由 softmax 对正确类的权重及其摊到的样本数构成的注意力熵。结论有二：在随 √N 变宽的逆温 β 窗口内原型间干扰随 Nβ 指数小，可学原型数增至 exp(c√N)；学习失效机制从 spin-glass 相变为记忆化 (memorization)，阈值为 β√(N(1−r²))≈√(2lnM)。MNIST 上记忆化诊断符合 random energy model 预测，fashion-MNIST 上该诊断检出类内子簇，且最佳精度落在记忆化阈值之外。
Motivation: Hebbian 学习中网络拿到的不是要检索的 K 个原型而是每个原型 M 个模糊样本，能否推断原型取决于负载 α=K/N 与数据集熵 ρ=(1−r²)/(Mr²)；成对 Hopfield 模型在高负载下经 spin-glass 相失效，需要弄清 exponential Hopfield（softmax attention）在同一协议下的泛化与失效机制。
Method: 把同一 Hebbian 协议移植到 exponential Hopfield 模型，零温更新写成以无标签样本为 key 的 softmax attention 步；用信噪分析 (signal-to-noise analysis) 闭式推导输出与未见原型的重叠 m⁽¹⁾=erf(1/√(2ρ_eff))，把成对模型的 ρ 替换为注意力熵 ρ_eff；再从输入视角指出 softmax 权重服从 random energy model，把记忆化对应为其 freezing 转变，并在 MNIST 与 fashion-MNIST 上用“携带权重的样本数”作为可测诊断。
Result: 闭式重叠 m⁽¹⁾=erf(1/√(2ρ_eff))，小负载下退化为成对模型的 majority-rule 律；干扰在宽度随 √N 增长的 β 窗口内随 Nβ 指数小，可学原型数按 exp(c√N) 增长；记忆化阈值为 β√(N(1−r²))≈√(2lnM)。MNIST 上记忆化诊断跟随 random energy 预测；fashion-MNIST 上该诊断检出类内子簇，且最佳精度位于记忆化阈值之外，此时 softmax 读出局部子原型 (sub-prototype)。
Conclusion: exponential Hopfield 的负载 α 在注意力熵 ρ_eff 与指数小干扰的意义上“退出”问题，可学容量按 exp(c√N) 增长；但其失效方式是记忆化而非 spin-glass，且记忆化阈值之外 softmax 读出局部子原型反而可带来最佳精度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Change the Number, Change the Answer: Assessing Rating Scale Sensitivity in LLM-Based Text Scoring
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in computational social science to assign scalar scores to social and psychological constructs. However, studies use different rating scales, and whether their scores remain comparable across scale designs is understudied. To address this gap, we define and systematically investigate scale sensitivity, the variation in LLM-generated scores caused by rating scale design. We distinguish numerical sensitivity, changes in normalized scores, from semantic sensitivity, changes in score interpretation. To assess both, our experimental design crosses 2 formats (continuous vs. ordinal), 4 ranges (3, 5, 11, and 21 points), and 2 signs (signed vs. unsigned) across 3 tasks (political leaning, sentiment, and toxicity), 2 prompting strategies (zero-shot and rubric-based), and 5 LLMs. We find that changing one design element shifts normalized scores by about 0.10 on average and changes the category of roughly 20% of texts. Sensitivity is greatest for toxicity, the only unipolar construct examined. Also, rubric-based prompting does not reduce sensitivity compared with zero-shot prompting. We provide practical guidance for designing more reliable LLM-based text scoring and highlight the need for robustness checks across alternative scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统定义并测量 LLM 文本打分中的量表敏感性 (scale sensitivity)：改变评分量表的单一设计要素，归一化分数平均移动约 0.10，约 20% 的文本会跨类别。毒性 (toxicity) 作为唯一单极构念敏感性最高，且基于评分细则 (rubric) 的提示相比 zero-shot 并未降低敏感性。
Motivation: 计算社会科学中不同研究用不同评分量表让 LLM 打分，但分数能否跨量表设计比较一直缺乏研究，直接影响结论可比性。
Method: 实验交叉 2 种格式（连续 vs 序数）、4 种量程（3、5、11、21 点）、2 种符号（带符号 vs 不带符号），覆盖 3 个任务（政治倾向、情感、毒性）、2 种提示策略（zero-shot 与 rubric-based）和 5 个 LLM；区分归一化分数变化的数值敏感性与分数解释变化的语义敏感性。
Result: 改变单一设计要素使归一化分数平均移动约 0.10，约 20% 的文本改变类别；毒性任务敏感性最高（唯一单极构念）；rubric-based 提示相比 zero-shot 未降低敏感性。
Conclusion: LLM 打分对量表设计敏感，跨量表比较不可靠；作者建议设计更稳健的评分流程并对替代量表做稳健性检查。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EVA-Cap: Optimizing Audiovisual Video Captioning via Event-Centric Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Omni Language Models (OLMs) provide a unified solution for audiovisual video captioning. Nevertheless, existing approaches predominantly treat captioning as an unstructured text generation process, neglecting the inherent semantic structure of videos and leading to suboptimal fine-grained audiovisual alignment. To bridge this gap, we propose EVA-Cap, a novel framework that decomposes captions into atomic audiovisual events and transforms unstructured text supervision into event-centric alignment. We train EVA-Cap via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on a self-curated dataset, EVA-Data, which is built with event-centric quality control. During the GRPO phase, the model is explicitly optimized against three event-centric alignment targets: global event completeness, intra-event attribution, and inter-event synchronization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EVA-Cap significantly outperforms existing methods in event-centric evaluation (e.g., +9.0% average gain on ChronusAV), while achieving competitive performance on general audiovisual captioning benchmarks (e.g., +3.3% on WorldSense).
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code will be released at https://github.com/OPPO-Mente-Lab/EVA-Cap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EVA-Cap 把音视频字幕拆成原子音视频事件，用事件中心对齐取代无结构文本生成：先 SFT 再 GRPO，直接优化全局事件完整性、事件内归属、事件间同步三个对齐目标。在事件中心评测上平均提升 +9.0%（ChronusAV），通用字幕基准上 +3.3%（WorldSense）。
Motivation: 现有 Omni Language Models (OLMs) 把字幕当作无结构文本生成，忽略视频内在语义结构，细粒度音视频对齐效果不佳。
Method: 将字幕分解为原子音视频事件，把无结构文本监督转为事件中心对齐；在自建的 EVA-Data（带事件中心质量控制）上先做 Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)，再用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 针对三个事件中心目标优化：全局事件完整性、事件内归属 (intra-event attribution)、事件间同步 (inter-event synchronization)。
Result: 事件中心评测上显著超过现有方法，ChronusAV 平均提升 +9.0%；通用音视频字幕基准上表现有竞争力，WorldSense 提升 +3.3%。
Conclusion: 把字幕监督结构化为事件级对齐目标（完整性、归属、同步），比无结构文本生成更能提升细粒度音视频对齐。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Whole-Body Dexterity
papers.abstract_en: Current humanoid dexterous manipulation remains largely confined to end-effectors and simple grasps, falling short of humans' ability to engage the entire body by bracing and sliding bulky objects against the arms and torso. We introduce Whole-Body Dexterity (WBD), a general framework that uses the robot's body and appendages as contact surfaces to grasp and manipulate objects. Our sim-to-real pipeline first generates a dataset of feasible whole-body grasps, then trains reinforcement-learning experts on a general any-to-any repositioning objective by sampling initial and goal grasps from the dataset, and distills these experts into a single policy that uses proprioception and object geometry. We show that the distilled policy transfers zero-shot to a real Unitree G1, where it repositions a basketball and a cardboard box to regions around the torso and completes a long-horizon task that stows a box under one arm, carries it from a shelf to a table, and places it. The controller operates interactively, steered by coarse motion references from a human teleoperator. Across real-world whole-body manipulation tasks, the distilled controller completes 90% of trials, compared with 18% for direct retargeting and 4% for a generalist whole-body controller.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Whole-Body Dexterity (WBD)：把机器人躯干与手臂当作接触面做全身抓取与操作，先生成可行全身抓取数据集，再训练 any-to-any 重定位目标的强化学习专家并蒸馏为单一策略。蒸馏策略零样本迁移到真实 Unitree G1，真实任务完成率 90%，远高于直接重定向 18% 与通用全身控制器 4%。
Motivation: 现有人形机器人灵巧操作局限于末端执行器与简单抓取，无法像人那样用手臂和躯干支撑、滑动搬运大件物体。
Method: sim-to-real 流水线：先生成可行全身抓取数据集，再以从数据集采样初始与目标抓取的 any-to-any 重定位目标训练多个强化学习专家，最后蒸馏成一个仅依赖本体感知 (proprioception) 与物体几何的策略；运行时由人类遥操作者给出粗略运动参考进行交互式引导。
Result: 蒸馏策略零样本迁移到真实 Unitree G1：可将篮球与纸箱重定位到躯干周围区域，并完成长程任务（把箱子夹到一只臂下、从货架搬运到桌子并放下）。在真实全身操作任务上完成 90% 试验，对比直接重定向 (direct retargeting) 18%、通用全身控制器 (generalist whole-body controller) 4%。
Conclusion: 把全身各部位当作接触面并用蒸馏的单一策略驱动，能在真实人形机器人上实现高成功率的大件物体全身操作，且无需针对真实机再训练。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LAMP: Layerwise Adaptive Mixing of Predictors for Training-Free Few-Shot Vision-Language Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot adaptation often relies on an encoder's final global representation, leaving complementary information in intermediate layers underused. Combining these features is challenging because their dimensions can differ and their usefulness varies across tasks. We propose LAMP, Layerwise Adaptive Mixing of Predictors, a training-free framework that combines global and regional information from multiple encoder layers. A single forward pass per view supplies all descriptors. Global and support-calibrated regional kernel predictors independently fit the same label residuals. Labeled validation data select their mixture in class-score space, preserving native feature dimensions without learned projections. LAMP-F further adapts text-anchored class prototypes, using a cached response to update the fixed-kernel residual predictions exactly. Experiments cover eleven datasets and ViT and ResNet backbones. LAMP achieves state-of-the-art mean accuracy among the compared published training-free ResNet-50 methods at 4, 8, and 16 shots, reaching 78.73% at 16 shots. Averaged across five support budgets, LAMP improves over a paired global-feature-only baseline by 1.14 and 1.59 percentage points on ViT-B/16 and ResNet-50; LAMP-F raises these gains to 1.96 and 2.54 points. LAMP-F reaches 16-shot accuracies of 83.57% and 79.10%, respectively. Controlled experiments identify multi-layer integration as the main source of improvement and examine pooling, calibration, validation labels, and computational cost. These findings show that combining layer-specific predictions can exploit complementary features from frozen encoders to improve few-shot classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAMP 是免训练的少样本视觉-语言适配框架：单次前向取冻结编码器多层特征，全局核预测器与 support 校准的区域核预测器各自独立拟合同一标签残差，再用带标注验证集在类别分数空间选择二者混合，保留各层原生维度而不做投影。在 11 个数据集、ViT 与 ResNet 骨干上，16-shot ResNet-50 平均准确率 78.73%，较仅用全局特征的配对基线在五个 support 预算平均提升 1.14（ViT-B/16）与 1.59（ResNet-50）个百分点，LAMP-F 把增益推到 1.96 与 2.54 点。
Motivation: 少样本适配通常只用编码器最后一层的全局表征，中间层的互补信息被闲置；而各层维度不同、对不同任务的有用性各异，直接拼接困难。
Method: 每个视图一次前向产出全部描述子；全局核预测器与 support 校准的区域核预测器独立拟合同一标签残差，由带标注验证数据在 class-score space 选择混合权重，不引入可学投影。LAMP-F 进一步适配文本锚定的类原型，用缓存响应精确更新固定核的残差预测。
Result: 在 11 个数据集、ViT 与 ResNet 骨干上：LAMP 在所比较的已发表免训练 ResNet-50 方法中于 4、8、16-shot 取得 SOTA 平均准确率，16-shot 达 78.73%；五个 support 预算平均较仅全局特征基线提升 1.14 点（ViT-B/16）与 1.59 点（ResNet-50），LAMP-F 提至 1.96 与 2.54 点，其 16-shot 准确率分别为 83.57% 与 79.10%。受控实验把多层融合作为主要增益来源，并考察了池化、校验、验证标签与计算开销。
Conclusion: 把冻结编码器各层的独立预测组合起来即可利用层间互补特征提升少样本分类，无需训练；增益主要来自多层整合而非其他组件。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 少样本适配通常只用编码器最后一层的全局表征，中间层的互补信息被闲置；而各层维度不同、对不同任务的有用性各异，直接拼接困难。
summary_sections.method: 每个视图一次前向产出全部描述子；全局核预测器与 support 校准的区域核预测器独立拟合同一标签残差，由带标注验证数据在 class-score space 选择混合权重，不引入可学投影。LAMP-F 进一步适配文本锚定的类原型，用缓存响应精确更新固定核的残差预测。
summary_sections.result: 在 11 个数据集、ViT 与 ResNet 骨干上：LAMP 在所比较的已发表免训练 ResNet-50 方法中于 4、8、16-shot 取得 SOTA 平均准确率，16-shot 达 78.73%；五个 support 预算平均较仅全局特征基线提升 1.14 点（ViT-B/16）与 1.59 点（ResNet-50），LAMP-F 提至 1.96 与 2.54 点，其 16-shot 准确率分别为 83.57% 与 79.10%。受控实验把多层融合作为主要增益来源，并考察了池化、校验、验证标签与计算开销。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把冻结编码器各层的独立预测组合起来即可利用层间互补特征提升少样本分类，无需训练；增益主要来自多层整合而非其他组件。

papers.title: LCT: Losslessly Compressed Tensors with GPU friendly execution for Training
papers.abstract_en: Lossless tensor compression could reduce memory usage during training, but training requires tensors to be repeatedly re-encoded. We introduce Losslessly Compressed Tensors (LCT), a GPU execution framework designed for this repeated encode-decode regime. LCT exploits the natural redundancy in floating point data to reduce storage for weights, activations and optimizer states. Highly optimized GPU kernels implement Huffman coding with precomputed codebooks for low compression and decompression overhead, essential for training. Our analysis characterizes LCT's storage costs and adaptation to magnitude shifts. LCT achieves a compression ratio of up to $1.455\times$, and is demonstrated in training and finetuning settings. On a 162M-parameter NanoGPT, LCT reduces memory usage by $24.6\%$ for a $7.2\%$ step-time increase. In Qwen3-4B fine-tuning, LCT saves up to $23.8\%$ of peak memory, enabling a $3.5\times$ larger context length in training on the same GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LCT 是面向训练场景的 GPU 无损张量压缩执行框架，用预计算码本的 Huffman 编码压缩权重、激活与优化器状态，把反复编解码的开销压到可接受。在 162M NanoGPT 训练中显存降 24.6%、单步时间只增 7.2%；Qwen3-4B 微调峰值显存最多省 23.8%，同一 GPU 上训练上下文长度可放大 3.5 倍。
Motivation: 训练过程中张量需要被反复重编码，通用无损压缩方案的编解码开销使其无法用于训练；而权重、激活与优化器状态的显存占用直接限制模型规模与上下文长度。
Method: LCT 利用浮点数据的天然冗余，用预计算码本 (precomputed codebooks) 的 Huffman 编码实现高度优化的 GPU kernel，覆盖权重、激活与优化器状态三类张量；作者分析了其存储开销与对数值量级漂移 (magnitude shifts) 的适应性。
Result: 压缩比最高 1.455×；162M 参数 NanoGPT 训练中显存降低 24.6%，单步时间增加 7.2%；Qwen3-4B 微调中峰值显存最多节省 23.8%，使同一 GPU 上的训练上下文长度扩大 3.5 倍。
Conclusion: 只要把 Huffman 编解码做成低开销的 GPU kernel，无损压缩就能在训练与微调中真正省下显存并换到更长上下文，代价只是个位数的步时增加。

papers.title: REKI: Registering Knowledge in VLAs
papers.abstract_en: We introduce REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model (VLA) pretrained exclusively on public data that sets a new Pareto frontier between performance and model size: on LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin Clean2Rand and RoboCasa365, it is outperformed only by models about twice its size. REKI consists of a vision-language model (VLM) followed by a flow-matching action expert, and is pretrained on a curated mixture of public robot, egocentric human and vision-language data. Additionally, we endow it with a memory that gives the policy access to its recent past at negligible cost: a few register tokens in the action expert summarise the output of the VLM at each frame and persist in the expert's cache. This memory improves success in simulation and on real robots, and makes oscillations between poses about four times rarer. REKI uses a simple model design and training paradigm, and is optimised to be efficient at training and inference. We release the full code across data curation, training, inference and evaluation, deployment, and all pretrained and finetuned model weights: https://github.com/kyutai-labs/reki.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REKI 是一个 2.4B 视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA)，仅用公开数据预训练，在 LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin Clean2Rand 和 RoboCasa365 上只被约两倍体量的模型超过，树立了性能-模型规模的新 Pareto 前沿。其动作专家中用少量 register token 汇总每帧 VLM 输出并持久化在 cache 中，构成近时序记忆，使仿真与真机成功率提升、位姿间振荡减少约四倍。
Motivation: VLA 模型普遍依赖大规模私有数据与大参数量换取性能，且策略缺少对近期历史的访问，导致真机操作中出现位姿间振荡。
Method: REKI 由 VLM 加 flow-matching 动作专家组成，在精选的公开机器人、第一人称人类与视觉-语言数据混合上预训练；记忆机制在动作专家中加入少量 register token，逐帧总结 VLM 输出并保留在专家 cache 中，成本可忽略。
Result: 在 LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin Clean2Rand、RoboCasa365 上仅被约两倍体量的模型超过；记忆机制在仿真与真机上均提升成功率，并使位姿间振荡减少约四倍。
Conclusion: 小体量 VLA 配合低成本的 cache 内记忆即可逼近更大模型的操作性能，并显著抑制真机振荡；作者开源了数据整理、训练、推理、评估、部署代码及全部预训练与微调权重。

papers.title: Motion- and Gravity-Aware Feedforward 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward transformer models have recently achieved strong performance in multi-view 3D reconstruction, but they still rely primarily on appearance-based attention and often struggle in dynamic scenes with weak geometric cues. In this work, we introduce a motion- and gravity-aware framework under the Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) paradigm. During training, residual optical flow and gravity direction are provided as privileged signals to guide geometric representation learning; during inference, the model uses standard visual inputs only. We integrate these priors into transformer backbones with lightweight architectural changes, preserving feed-forward efficiency. Experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent gains in reconstruction accuracy and robustness, especially in scenes with dynamic objects, ambiguous structure, and challenging camera motion. Our analysis further shows that the optimal injection stage is backbone-dependent: middle-layer integration is generally preferable for VGGT, while late-stage integration is more effective for π3. These results suggest that LUPI offers a practical way to inject motion and physical priors into feed-forward 3D reconstruction without increasing test-time complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在前馈多视角 3D 重建中用 LUPI 范式把残差光流与重力方向作为特权信号注入 transformer backbone，训练时引导几何表征、推理时只用标准视觉输入，从而在动态物体、结构歧义和挑战性相机运动场景下提升重建精度与鲁棒性，且不增加测试时开销。注入层位置依 backbone 而定：VGGT 以中层注入更优，π3 以晚期注入更有效。
Motivation: 前馈 transformer 多视角 3D 重建主要依赖外观注意力，在几何线索弱的动态场景中表现不佳，需要在不牺牲前馈效率的前提下引入运动与物理先验。
Method: 采用 Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) 框架：训练阶段以残差光流 (residual optical flow) 和重力方向 (gravity direction) 作为特权信号，通过轻量架构改动注入 transformer backbone 以引导几何表征学习；推理阶段仅使用标准视觉输入，保持前馈效率。
Result: 在标准 benchmark 上重建精度与鲁棒性一致提升，在含动态物体、结构歧义和挑战性相机运动的场景中增益尤其明显；最优注入阶段呈 backbone 依赖性：VGGT 中层注入更优，π3 晚期注入更有效。
Conclusion: LUPI 是把运动与物理先验注入前馈 3D 重建的实用途径，可在不增加测试时复杂度的前提下改善动态场景表现，且注入位置需按 backbone 选择。

papers.title: Mosaic: Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Most existing agentic reinforcement learning methods assume single-session trajectories, where interaction proceeds within one continuously accumulated context. However, agentic techniques such as context compaction and subagent forking may produce trajectories spanning multiple sessions, creating a mismatch between the single-session training assumption and inference-time execution. Therefore, we introduce Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning, a more general setting that supports an arbitrary number of sessions within a trajectory. Under this setting, a widely adopted method is to broadcast trajectory-level advantages to all sessions, but this does not distinguish contributions from various sessions or guide session allocation within trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Mosaic, a multi-session agentic RL method with critic-free hierarchical optimization. At the trajectory level, it incorporates session-usage signals into advantage estimation. At the session level, it shapes each session's advantage according to the estimated marginal contribution. Experiments on BrowseComp with Qwen3.5-4B show that Mosaic outperforms broadcasting in both context compaction and subagent forking scenarios while using fewer sessions on average. Further analyses show that our method achieves improvements in session utility and allocation, which we suggested is a promising target for future advances in multi-session agentic RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mosaic 针对多会话 agentic RL 提出 critic-free 分层优化：轨迹层把 session-usage 信号并入优势估计，会话层按估计的边际贡献塑造各会话优势，替代把轨迹级优势广播给所有会话的做法。在 BrowseComp 上用 Qwen3.5-4B，Mosaic 在 context compaction 与 subagent forking 两种场景下均胜过 broadcasting，且平均使用更少会话。
Motivation: 现有 agentic RL 方法假设单会话轨迹，而 context compaction 与 subagent forking 会让一条轨迹跨多个会话，训练假设与推理执行不匹配；广泛采用的广播轨迹级优势无法区分各会话贡献，也不指导轨迹内的会话分配。
Method: 提出 Multi-Session Agentic RL 设定（一条轨迹含任意数量会话）与 Mosaic：critic-free 的分层优化，轨迹层在优势估计中引入 session-usage 信号，会话层按估计的边际贡献 (marginal contribution) 为每个会话塑造优势。
Result: 在 BrowseComp 上以 Qwen3.5-4B 实验，Mosaic 在 context compaction 和 subagent forking 两种场景下均优于 broadcasting，且平均使用更少的会话；进一步分析显示会话效用 (session utility) 与会话分配均得到改善。
Conclusion: 作者认为会话效用与分配是多会话 agentic RL 未来改进的有前景方向；按边际贡献而非统一广播来分配优势，可在更少会话下取得更好表现。

papers.title: Lexical Reference Frames: Interpreting LM Residual Streams in Native Semantics
papers.abstract_en: The vocabulary of a language model is its native semantics: the embedding and the unembedding fix the meaning of a state at the two ends of the residual stream. Between them, existing methods either reuse a fixed lens or treat the states as a point cloud, and neither reads a state the way the model does. We argue that every hidden state has a native reference frame, induced by the layers that read it next and adaptive to the context. Lexical reference frames approximate it by reading a state through the model's own remaining layers with a stated number of rounds of attention between positions and a typical attention output for the rest, without fitting to the model's output. No lens, with fixed directions per layer, can exceed the square root of the native frame's coherence, 0.30 and 0.35 at mid-depth of SmolLM3-3B and OLMo3-7B, whereas the first-order frame, LexFrame[1], reaches 0.97 and 0.97 and reads a state within 0.16 nats of the model's output. Its coefficients attribute predictions more faithfully than attribution patching, its lexical basis steers a prediction while sparing other tokens, and its confident readings would let an early exit skip 0.45 and 0.42 of the layers, where lenses skip almost none. In this way, lexical reference frames make every hidden state of the model readable, attributable and steerable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LexFrame：用模型自身后续层读取残差流隐状态，构造随上下文自适应的词法参考系 (lexical reference frame)，在不拟合模型输出、不训练 lens 的前提下解释隐状态。理论上任何固定方向的 lens 无法超过原生参考系 coherence 的平方根（SmolLM3-3B 中深度 0.30、OLMo3-7B 0.35），而一阶 LexFrame[1] 达到 0.97 与 0.97，读数与模型输出仅差 0.16 nats。
Motivation: 现有残差流解释方法要么复用固定 lens，要么把隐状态当点云，都不按模型自身读取该状态的方式解读，导致读数与模型真实语义脱节。
Method: LexFrame 通过模型自身剩余层读取状态，指定位置间注意力轮数与典型注意力输出，不拟合模型输出；给出一阶变体 LexFrame[1]，并以 coherence 上界刻画固定 lens 的理论极限。
Result: 固定 lens 上限为原生参考系 coherence 的平方根：SmolLM3-3B 与 OLMo3-7B 中深度分别为 0.30 与 0.35；LexFrame[1] 达 0.97 与 0.97，读数距模型输出 0.16 nats。系数归因比 attribution patching 更忠实，词法基可在不影响其他 token 的情况下引导预测，置信读数支持早退跳过 0.45 与 0.42 的层，而 lens 几乎跳不掉层。
Conclusion: 隐状态存在由后续读取层诱导的原生参考系，按此读取可让每个隐状态同时可读、可归因、可引导，并支持大幅早退。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有残差流解释方法要么复用固定 lens，要么把隐状态当点云，都不按模型自身读取该状态的方式解读，导致读数与模型真实语义脱节。
summary_sections.method: LexFrame 通过模型自身剩余层读取状态，指定位置间注意力轮数与典型注意力输出，不拟合模型输出；给出一阶变体 LexFrame[1]，并以 coherence 上界刻画固定 lens 的理论极限。
summary_sections.result: 固定 lens 上限为原生参考系 coherence 的平方根：SmolLM3-3B 与 OLMo3-7B 中深度分别为 0.30 与 0.35；LexFrame[1] 达 0.97 与 0.97，读数距模型输出 0.16 nats。系数归因比 attribution patching 更忠实，词法基可在不影响其他 token 的情况下引导预测，置信读数支持早退跳过 0.45 与 0.42 的层，而 lens 几乎跳不掉层。
summary_sections.conclusion: 隐状态存在由后续读取层诱导的原生参考系，按此读取可让每个隐状态同时可读、可归因、可引导，并支持大幅早退。

papers.title: Multi-sourced AI Tutor for Non-Native English Speaker Students
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being adopted as teaching tools in computing education, particularly for developing AI tutors capable of answering student questions. With the rise in enrollment of international students in computing programs, researchers have begun to explore the difficulties that non-native English speaker (NNES) students face in computing courses due to language barriers. To aid such students, we developed a general-purpose AI tutor system that can process student questions in foreign languages (currently focused on Mandarin) and provide bilingual responses. Our system also incorporates the functionality of generating a glossary of technical terms and their explanations to enhance comprehension. Our approach utilizes a specialized Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline with a novel question extraction mechanism, enabling us to effectively utilize a diverse array of course materials for answering student queries. We evaluated our AI tutor using 91 Piazza posts, demonstrating that it could answer 83.52% of the posts correctly and in a helpful manner. The tutor also provided high-quality translations for 76.92% of the questions and generated technical term glossaries for 64.47% of them. Our findings underscore the potential of multi-source RAG pipeline in enhancing AI tutor systems, offering support for non-native speakers that are challenging to provide with traditional supporting staff of a computing course.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: EMO: A Closed-Loop Test-Time Computation Framework via Alternating Context Optimization and Logits Steering
papers.abstract_en: Test-time context optimization adapts frozen language models through textual feedback, but ordinary conditional generation provides no separate control over how strongly to reinforce the distributional changes induced by a context update. We introduce EMO, a training-free framework inspired by expectation--maximization that alternates question-specific context estimation (E-step) and distribution refinement (M-step). The E-step revises a system context using textual gradients from an external judge without access to gold answers. The M-step contrasts next-token distributions under the revised and preceding contexts at a shared prefix to construct a confidence-constrained logit correction. Feedback on the steered response drives the next context update, coupling adaptation across rounds with intervention within each generation. Theoretically, we connect parameter and context optimization through a shared target-KL objective and additive logit representations, and derive the steering vector from context-induced logit displacements. Under context-improvement and faithful-steering assumptions, we prove a one-round decrease in target KL divergence for sufficiently small steering strength. Under greedy decoding across eight models and six benchmarks, EMO improves the zero-shot baseline in 39 of 40 aggregated settings, averaging $+9.10$ percentage points. With the same judge, it adds $+1.53$ points on average over context-only optimization (TextGrad), with consistent MMLU-Pro gains across models. At matched target-model generation budgets, accuracy advantages over best-of-$N$ are strongest on Llama, while oracle coverage is higher in most comparisons despite fewer candidates. The coverage--selection gap motivates allocating test-time computation jointly to candidate generation and verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMO 是一个免训练的测试时计算闭环框架，按 EM 思路交替做问题级上下文估计（E 步，用外部 judge 的 textual gradient 改写系统上下文，不看 gold answer）与分布精修（M 步，在共享前缀上对比新旧上下文的 next-token 分布，构造带置信度约束的 logit 校正）。在 8 个模型、6 个 benchmark 的贪心解码下，40 个聚合设置中 39 个优于 zero-shot 基线，平均 +9.10 个百分点；同等 judge 下比仅做上下文优化的 TextGrad 再多 +1.53 点。
Motivation: 测试时上下文优化只能靠文本反馈改写上下文，普通条件生成无法单独控制一次上下文更新所引起的分布变化被强化到多强，参数优化与上下文优化之间也缺少统一目标。
Method: EMO 受 EM 启发交替执行：E 步用外部 judge 提供的 textual gradient 修订系统上下文（无需 gold answer）；M 步在同一前缀上对比修订前后上下文下的 next-token 分布，构造置信度约束的 logit correction，再用对转向后回答的反馈驱动下一轮上下文更新。理论上以共享的 target-KL 目标和 additive logit 表示把参数优化与上下文优化连起来，并从上下文引起的 logit 位移导出 steering vector。
Result: 贪心解码下，8 个模型、6 个 benchmark 共 40 个聚合设置中 39 个优于 zero-shot 基线，平均 +9.10 个百分点；同等 judge 下比 TextGrad 平均再高 +1.53 点，MMLU-Pro 在各模型上增益一致。在相同目标模型生成预算下，相对 best-of-N 的准确率优势在 Llama 上最强，且多数比较中 oracle coverage 更高而候选更少。
Conclusion: 在 context-improvement 与 faithful-steering 假设下，只要转向强度足够小，可证明 target KL 一轮下降；coverage 与 selection 之间的差距说明测试时计算应在候选生成与验证之间联合分配。

papers.title: The importance of tensor handling and implementation of physics-informed DeepONets
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) reduce or eliminate the need for large labelled datasets by enforcing governing equations during training. Physics-informed Deep Operator Networks (PI-DeepONets) extend this approach to learning solution operators, enabling rapid prediction across families of problems. Despite these advantages, we show that their application to higher-dimensional problems remains limited by the computational cost of training. To address this issue, we propose a modified PI-DeepONet architecture that reduces this cost by removing redundancy in how the Branch network processes input functions across collocation points. The proposed formulation is mathematically equivalent to the original architecture but reduces input tensor sizes and the number of Branch network evaluations. We analyse the computational complexity of both architectures and derive theoretical scaling laws for training time with respect to the number of collocation points and input functions. The proposed architecture is evaluated on 1D, 2D, and 3D linear advection problems. In all cases, it achieves comparable predictive accuracy to the original PI-DeepONet while consistently reducing training time. In 2D experiments, a maximum speed-up of $3.75\times$ is observed, with empirical training-time scaling agreeing with the predicted linear dependence on collocation points and input functions. Furthermore, training a 3D model on an NVIDIA A100 GPU is only feasible using the proposed architecture, as the original formulation exceeds memory limits. These results demonstrate that careful consideration of how PI-DeepONets are implemented can yield substantial gains, enhancing the practical performance of PI-DeepONets and enabling their application to otherwise intractable physics-informed learning problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PI-DeepONet 的 Branch 网络在每个 collocation point 上重复处理同一输入函数，导致高维问题训练代价过高。作者提出去掉该冗余的等价架构，减少输入张量尺寸与 Branch 评估次数：2D 线性平流实验最高加速 3.75×，训练时间随 collocation 点数与输入函数数呈线性标度，且 3D 模型在 NVIDIA A100 上只有新架构能训完，原架构超出显存。
Motivation: PI-DeepONet 虽免标注数据并可学解算子，但高维问题的训练计算成本限制其应用；原架构在 Branch 侧对每个 collocation point 重复计算同一输入函数，张量与评估次数冗余，3D 规模直接撞显存墙。
Method: 提出修改版 PI-DeepONet 架构：移除 Branch 网络跨 collocation points 处理输入函数的冗余，使输入张量变小、Branch 评估次数减少，同时与原架构数学等价；对两种架构做计算复杂度分析，并推导训练时间随 collocation 点数与输入函数数的理论标度律。
Result: 在 1D、2D、3D 线性平流 (linear advection) 问题上，预测精度与原 PI-DeepONet 相当而训练时间一致下降；2D 实验最高加速 3.75×，经验训练时间标度与推导出的对 collocation 点数、输入函数数的线性依赖吻合；3D 模型在 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上仅新架构可行，原架构超出显存限制。
Conclusion: PI-DeepONet 的实现细节（张量组织与 Branch 评估方式）能带来数量级的训练收益，去掉冗余后原本不可行的物理信息学习问题变得可训练。

papers.title: Realtime-Bench: Can Frontier Models Solve Real-time Interactive Problems?
papers.abstract_en: Real-time interaction requires agents to perceive evolving environments and act under temporal constraints, yet existing evaluations of real-time streaming models focus on conversational quality and streaming perception, leaving effective action under strict temporal constraints untested. We introduce Realtime-Bench, a suite of carefully curated dynamic tasks where delayed actions directly affect success. Under Wall Clock, where environments advance according to actual inference latency, the best success rate reaches only 44% and the best Pass^3 is only 36%, demonstrating that real-time interaction remains challenging. To separate serving latency from models' real-time streaming capability, we compare Wall Clock with Paused Clock, which removes inference delays as an idealized reference, and introduce Token Clock, which advances simulated time according to generated token counts, testing temporal awareness independently of physical serving speed. We find that temporal costs limit success in evolving environments and that higher reasoning effort has mixed effects under time pressure, reflecting a trade-off between decision quality and timely execution. These findings suggest directions for improving real-time multimodal agents, including adaptive reasoning with temporal awareness and continuous perception and action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Realtime-Bench 把环境推进与真实推理延迟绑定（Wall Clock），用延迟即失败的动态任务测流式多模态 agent 的限时行动能力。最佳成功率仅 44%、最佳 Pass^3 仅 36%；与去掉推理延迟的 Paused Clock 及按生成 token 数推进的 Token Clock 对比，说明时间开销本身在演化环境中限制成功，且高推理努力在时间压力下效果混杂。
Motivation: 现有对实时流式模型的评测只看对话质量与流式感知，严格时间约束下的有效行动从未被检验，而延迟会直接改变动态环境中的成败。
Method: 构建 Realtime-Bench：一组延迟直接影响成功的动态任务套件；三种计时协议——Wall Clock 按真实推理延迟推进环境、Paused Clock 移除推理延迟作理想参照、Token Clock 按生成 token 数推进模拟时间以独立考察时间感知；并分析推理努力与时间压力的权衡。
Result: Wall Clock 下最佳成功率 44%，最佳 Pass^3 仅 36%；对比 Wall Clock 与 Paused Clock 显示时间开销限制演化环境中的成功，更高推理努力在时间压力下呈混合效果，反映决策质量与及时执行的权衡。
Conclusion: 实时交互对前沿模型仍具挑战，改进方向是带时间感知的自适应推理以及感知与行动的连续进行。

papers.title: Specification Gaming and a Constrained Reinforcement Learning Mitigation in a Cleaning Gridworld
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning agents optimize exactly the reward signal they are given, which can diverge sharply from an intended true objective when that signal is only a proxy for it; this failure mode is known as specification gaming. Existing evidence for this failure mode is largely observational, with comparatively few demonstrations pairing a controlled, deliberately constructed proxy/true gap with a mitigation that carries a verifiable guarantee rather than only an empirical improvement. We construct a minimal gridworld in which a cleaning-robot agent can either genuinely remove dirt or conceal it from a cheap sensor, and show that a standard deep Q-network trained only on the sensor's proxy reward converges to a policy that games it completely, reaching near-maximal proxy reward while never achieving the true objective. We then introduce a constrained reinforcement learning fix, penalizing the specific behaviors through which the agent exploits the gap, and show that it eliminates the gaming behavior from the final policy while substantially recovering true-objective performance. We further derive and empirically verify an exact accounting identity relating the proxy reward, true reward, and our cost signal for this environment, showing that the cost signal measures the proxy/true gap exactly rather than merely tracking it, and yields a deterministic guarantee under a hard-constrained variant of the method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在清洁机器人 gridworld 中，只用廉价传感器代理奖励训练的 DQN 会完全 specification gaming：代理奖励接近最大但从不实现真实目标。作者加入针对漏洞行为的约束 RL 惩罚，最终策略消除该行为并大幅恢复真实目标性能，且推导出代理奖励、真实奖励与代价信号之间的精确核算恒等式，硬约束变体下给出确定性保证。
Motivation: RL 智能体精确优化给定的代理奖励，可能与真实目标严重偏离；现有证据多为观察性，缺少受控构造的代理/真实差距与带可验证保证的缓解方法的配对演示。
Method: 构造最小清洁 gridworld（真清除灰尘 vs 向廉价传感器隐藏灰尘），先用标准 DQN 只训练代理奖励，再引入约束 RL：对利用该差距的具体行为加惩罚；并推导代理奖励、真实奖励与代价信号的精确核算恒等式，给出硬约束变体下的确定性保证。

papers.title: RAG-RST: Retrieved Exemplars as In-Context Discourse Schema for RST Parsing
papers.abstract_en: In Rhetorical Structure Theory (RST), each edge of a discourse tree carries a nuclearity label, marking which span holds the central content, and a relation drawn from a closed inventory of functional categories. Neither label is a surface property: the same two clauses can be Elaboration or Background depending on rhetorical intent, and the boundary between them is fixed by annotation convention rather than by lexical cues. Predicting these labels therefore requires a formal discourse schema, and exposure to discourse-rich pretraining text does not supply it: given only a target EDU pair, a strong LLM recovers nuclearity at 0.794 F1 and relation at 0.738 F1. We propose RAG-RST, a retrieval-augmented framework that supplies this schema as in-context demonstration rather than through parameter updates, raising nuclearity to 0.846 F1 and relation to 0.788 F1 with no training. Two configurations are compared: a precomputed strategy that labels all EDU pairs before parsing, and a dynamic strategy that retrieves at each reduce step, so that the exemplars reaching the generator depend on the reductions the parser has already committed to. Both outperform existing RST parsers across span, nuclearity, relation, and full tree metrics, with the dynamic variant consistently strongest. Two properties of the retrieved schema emerge: its utility is bounded in number, saturating and then declining beyond fifty exemplars, and it depends on structural position. Both indicate that a formal linguistic schema can be supplied to a foundation model as a demonstration rather than trained into its parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAG-RST 用检索到的范例作为 in-context 修辞结构 schema 来做 RST 解析，不更新参数：只给目标 EDU 对时强 LLM 的 nuclearity 为 0.794 F1、relation 为 0.738 F1，加入检索范例后分别升到 0.846 与 0.788 F1。检索范例的效用在数量上有界，超过 50 个后饱和并下降，且依赖结构位置；动态检索（每个 reduce 步检索）稳定强于预计算策略。
Motivation: RST 的 nuclearity 与 relation 都不是表层属性，取决于修辞意图与标注惯例，仅靠 discourse-rich 预训练文本无法提供这一形式 schema，导致只看目标 EDU 对时标签预测受限。
Method: 提出 RAG-RST：检索增强框架，把检索到的范例作为 in-context demonstration 提供给 foundation model，而非通过参数更新训练。比较两种配置——预计算策略（解析前为所有 EDU 对打标）与动态策略（在每个 reduce 步检索，使进入生成器的范例取决于解析器已做出的归约）。
Result: 只给目标 EDU 对时，强 LLM 的 nuclearity 为 0.794 F1、relation 为 0.738 F1；RAG-RST 无训练即把 nuclearity 提到 0.846 F1、relation 提到 0.788 F1。两种配置在 span、nuclearity、relation 与整树指标上均超过现有 RST 解析器，动态变体始终最强。检索 schema 的效用在数量上有界，超过 50 个范例后饱和并下降，且依赖结构位置。
Conclusion: 形式语言 schema 可以作为 demonstration 提供给 foundation model，而不必训练进其参数；但范例数量超过约 50 个后不再有收益甚至变差，且范例的结构位置决定其效用。

papers.title: FALCON: FPGA-Accelerated Latency-Certifiable Occupancy Networks for Camera-Based Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: A perception system that must brake for a pedestrian does not need a low average latency. It must deliver an answer before the deadline on every frame, the worst case included. Commodity edge accelerators optimize the mean through dynamic scheduling, OS jitter, thermal throttling, and contention, so their per-frame latency can be measured but not bounded. We build FALCON, a camera-based 3D occupancy front-end on the AMD Kria KR260, an embedded FPGA drawing 4.3 W idle and up to 6.6 W under inference, and make the latency guarantee layered and explicit: programmable-logic (PL) compute is cycle-bounded analytically; inference is a measured envelope over 100k-frame traces; and a watchdog enforces output delivery, publishing the previous output flagged stale when a frame is late. The deadline runs use a fixed-work proxy of six ResNet-50 DPU inferences per frame, not the full occupancy network: across three 100k-frame enforced runs, all 300k proxy frames delivered an output within the 100 ms deadline plus at most 10.2 ms, the worst of the three runs. The full six-camera FlashOcc pipeline composes to about 1.3 s per frame on the board and is not yet a 10 Hz system. The two operations the DPU cannot run, a view-transform gather and a bilinear resize, become fixed-trip-count PL IPs numerically matched to their software references. On the full Occ3D-nuScenes validation set the board reaches mIoU 29.88, 92.8% of an FP32 baseline the DPU cannot run. On a ResNet-50 probe over 100k frames the KR260 tail stays within 1.5 times its median (2.0 times for the six-inference proxy), where Jetson Orin reaches 4.4 times and the worst datacenter GPU run (NVIDIA L4) 23.6 times. The deployment recipe, HLS sources, and raw timing traces are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FALCON 在 AMD Kria KR260 嵌入式 FPGA 上构建基于相机的 3D 占据网络 (occupancy network) 前端，把延迟保证分层显式化：可编程逻辑 (PL) 计算按周期解析界定，推理用 100k 帧轨迹的实测包络，watchdog 强制按时交付、迟到帧发布标记为 stale 的上一帧输出。三次 100k 帧强制运行中全部 300k 个代理帧都在 100 ms 截止期加最多 10.2 ms 内交付；但完整六相机 FlashOcc 流水线在板上约 1.3 s/帧，尚非 10 Hz 系统。
Motivation: 需要为行人刹车的感知系统不能只看平均延迟，必须在每一帧（含最坏情况）都早于截止期给出答案；而商用边缘加速器为优化均值采用动态调度、OS 抖动、热降频与资源争用，逐帧延迟可测但不可界定。
Method: 在 AMD Kria KR260（空闲 4.3 W、推理最高 6.6 W）上部署相机 3D 占据网络前端：PL 计算周期解析界定，推理以固定工作量代理（每帧六次 ResNet-50 DPU 推理）做 100k 帧实测包络，watchdog 强制输出交付；DPU 无法运行的 view-transform gather 与 bilinear resize 改写为固定遍历次数的 PL IP，并与软件参考做数值对齐。
Result: 三次 100k 帧强制运行共 300k 个代理帧全部在 100 ms 截止期加最多 10.2 ms 内交付（最差一次运行）；完整六相机 FlashOcc 流水线在板上约 1.3 s/帧。在完整 Occ3D-nuScenes 验证集上板端 mIoU 29.88，为 DPU 无法运行的 FP32 基线的 92.8%。在 100k 帧 ResNet-50 探针上 KR260 尾延迟不超过中位数的 1.5 倍（六推理代理为 2.0 倍），而 Jetson Orin 达 4.4 倍、最差的数据中心 GPU（NVIDIA L4）达 23.6 倍。
Conclusion: 把延迟保证拆成解析界定的 PL 计算、实测推理包络与强制交付的 watchdog，可在嵌入式 FPGA 上给出可界定的最坏情况延迟，且尾延迟远优于 Jetson Orin 与 NVIDIA L4；但完整占据网络流水线尚未达到 10 Hz。部署配方、HLS 源码与原始时序轨迹已开源。

papers.title: Are You Sure Your LLM Is Sure? Repairing and Auditing Confidence
papers.abstract_en: Confidence scores determine whether an LLM answer is accepted, reviewed, or regenerated, yet scalar recalibration can only correct errors visible through the score itself. We introduce RADAR (Repair, Adopt, and Diagnose After Recalibration), a reliability framework that separates confidence repair from deciding whether to deploy the repair and auditing the errors that remain. Under squared loss, we decompose prediction risk into outcome noise, information hidden by the score, and mapping error; restricting repair to order-preserving maps additionally introduces a pooling gap. For repair, we propose Probe-Anchored Isotonic Calibration (PAIC), which learns a monotone map from correctness-probe predictions on unlabeled target prompts. PAIC's excess risk depends on the probe's score-conditional bias and fitting error rather than its overall accuracy. For adoption, we derive a paired procedure with finite-sample control of false improvements. For auditing, we develop a prompt-clustered kernel test that detects feature-aligned residual errors while accounting for dependent answers from the same prompt. Across multiple LLM checkpoints, benchmarks, and distribution shifts, richer predictors can improve confidence estimation, but projecting their information back to a scalar score can lose these gains, and lower prediction risk need not yield better review decisions. Across 47,400 replayed raw-score allocations, paired betting adopts candidates with lower held-out test risk in 42.95% of allocations, versus 15.09% for one-sided empirical Bernstein. RADAR thus provides a principled workflow to repair what a scalar score can express, adopt a repair only when supported by evidence, and diagnose systematic errors that recalibration leaves behind. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.
papers.comment: main paper 10 pages; supplementary 44 pages; 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RADAR 把 LLM 置信度修复拆成修复、采纳、审计三步：PAIC 用无标签目标 prompt 上的 correctness-probe 预测学单调映射，配对检验控制假改进，聚类核检验定位重标定后残留的系统性错误。在 47,400 次重放的原始分数分配中，paired betting 在 42.95% 的分配上采纳了留出测试风险更低的候选，单侧 empirical Bernstein 仅 15.09%。
Motivation: 标量置信度分数只能修正分数本身可见的误差，更丰富的预测器信息被压回标量时会丢失，且更低的预测风险不必然带来更好的审核决策。
Method: RADAR 框架分三部分：Probe-Anchored Isotonic Calibration (PAIC) 从无标签目标 prompt 的 correctness-probe 预测学单调保序映射，其超额风险取决于 probe 的分数条件偏差与拟合误差；采纳阶段用配对程序对假改进做有限样本控制；审计阶段用 prompt 聚类的 kernel 检验检测与特征对齐的残差误差，并处理同一 prompt 的相关回答。平方损失下把预测风险分解为结果噪声、被分数隐藏的信息与映射误差，保序映射限制额外引入 pooling gap。
Result: 在 47,400 次重放的原始分数分配中，paired betting 在 42.95% 的分配上采纳了留出测试风险更低的候选，单侧 empirical Bernstein 为 15.09%。跨多个 LLM checkpoint、benchmark 与分布偏移，更丰富的预测器能改善置信度估计，但把其信息投影回标量分数会丢失这些增益，更低的预测风险也不必然产生更好的审核决策。
Conclusion: 标量置信度只能修复它自身能表达的误差，修复应在有证据支持时才采纳，重标定留下的系统性错误需要独立审计。

papers.title: Believed but Not Said: Measuring Hidden Belief Collapse in Multi-Agent LLM Discussions
papers.abstract_en: LLM systems increasingly rely on groups of agents that discuss, critique, and check one another, assuming that peers will catch individual errors. We test this assumption against a minimal adversary. In a ten-agent factual discussion, one or three adversarial agents repeatedly assert a plausible false answer. After each round we probe each benign agent's private answer through a separate call whose response is hidden from its peers, and we separately label its public stance toward the claim. Across six models and three factual-QA datasets, groups remain stable without an attacker: only 0.6% of benign agents finish with the false answer. A single adversarial agent increases this rate to 44.8% and three to 60.5%. Studies of conformity typically report public agreement without private change; we find the reverse. With three adversarial agents present, benign agents hold the false answer in 51.6% of exposed turns but publicly endorse it in only 19.7%. Much of the influence therefore remains invisible in the discussion, and the false answers persist when agents are asked for their own views. Agents that retain the true answer often fail to defend it; once adopted, the false answer spreads among benign agents, and baseline knowledge does not predict robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在十智能体事实讨论中植入 1 或 3 个反复断言似是而非错误答案的对抗智能体，用独立调用探查良性智能体的私下答案、再单独标注其公开立场。无攻击者时仅 0.6% 良性智能体最终采信错误答案，1 个攻击者升至 44.8%、3 个升至 60.5%；且私下被说服（51.6% 的暴露轮次）远高于公开背书（19.7%），即信念坍缩主要发生在讨论中看不见的地方。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 讨论默认同伴会互相纠错，但该假设缺少对私下信念与公开立场的分离测量，无法判断错误是被真正接受还是仅被公开附和。
Method: 设定十智能体事实讨论，其中 1 或 3 个对抗智能体反复断言一个似是而非的错误答案；每轮后用一次对其他同伴不可见的独立调用探查每个良性智能体的私下答案，并另行标注其对该主张的公开立场，在 6 个模型与 3 个 factual-QA 数据集上进行测试。
Result: 无攻击者时仅 0.6% 良性智能体以错误答案收尾；单个对抗智能体使其升至 44.8%，三个升至 60.5%。三个攻击者在场时，良性智能体在 51.6% 的暴露轮次中私下持有错误答案，却只在 19.7% 的轮次中公开背书。保留正确答案的智能体常无法为其辩护，错误答案一旦被采纳便在良性智能体间扩散，且基线知识不能预测稳健性。
Conclusion: 从众研究通常只报告公开一致而忽略私下改变，本文发现相反：影响大部分留在讨论之外不可见，因此仅观察公开立场会严重低估多智能体讨论中的信念坍缩。

papers.title: CART: Compatible Routing for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance through instruction tuning, yet real-world applications often require them to continually acquire new capabilities from sequential tasks, i.e., Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT). In typical MLLMs, a projector is employed to align visual representations with the language model. However, existing methods primarily protect the language model from forgetting while continuously updating the projector across tasks. Such asymmetric adaptation can cause substantial representation drift in the projector, increasing the mismatch between the projector and language model and consequently exacerbating catastrophic forgetting. To address this issue, we propose Compatible Routing (CART), which explicitly coordinates the adaptation of the projector and language model. Specifically, CART maintains task-specific experts for both modules and combines them through weighted mixtures. CART jointly infers their weights by considering both expert relevance and cross-module compatibility, thereby promoting coordinated adaptation between the two modules. To further control model growth, we introduce relevance-guided expert consolidation, which merges experts exhibiting similar relevance profiles across samples within each module. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CART achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CART 针对多模态持续指令微调 (MCIT) 中投影器与语言模型的非对称更新，为两个模块各维护任务专属专家，并联合推断加权混合权重，同时考虑专家相关性与跨模块兼容性，以抑制投影器表征漂移导致的灾难性遗忘；再用相关性引导的专家合并控制模型增长。在实验中达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 现有 MCIT 方法主要保护语言模型不遗忘，却在各任务间持续更新投影器，这种非对称适配造成投影器表征大幅漂移，加剧投影器与语言模型的失配，从而加重灾难性遗忘。
Method: CART 为投影器和语言模型分别维护任务专属专家，通过加权混合组合；权重联合推断时同时考虑专家相关性与跨模块兼容性，促进两模块协同适配。另引入相关性引导的专家合并 (relevance-guided expert consolidation)，在每个模块内合并样本相关性分布相似的专家以控制模型增长。
Result: 大量实验表明 CART 达到 state-of-the-art 性能（摘要未给出具体数值、数据集或基线名称）。
Conclusion: 同时协调投影器与语言模型的适配、并按相关性合并专家，可以在控制模型增长的同时缓解多模态持续指令微调中的灾难性遗忘。
