papers.title: Not All Unlabeled Data Are Equal: Unlabeled Data Selection for Semi-Supervised QSAR Modeling with Large Chemical Repositories
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) is particularly attractive in domains where labels are expensive to obtain, while unlabeled examples are readily available. Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship (QSAR) modeling, which predicts molecular biological activity from chemical structure, is one such domain. Obtaining activity measurements requires costly wet-lab experiments, resulting in small labeled datasets, while chemical repositories such as ChEMBL contain millions of unlabeled molecules. Despite this apparent suitability, the potential of large chemical databases to improve QSAR models via SSL remains largely unexplored. Furthermore, it is unclear how unlabeled data should be selected in realistic SSL settings with genuine unlabeled data. We conduct a systematic study of unlabeled-data selection using 10 QSAR datasets extracted from ChEMBL and a pool of more than 400,000 unlabeled molecules. To this end, we evaluate three established SSL algorithms (self-training, co-training, and label propagation) and formulate four unlabeled-data selection strategies based on random, nearest-neighbor, furthest-neighbor, and mixed sampling. Our results show that unlabeled data from large chemical repositories can improve QSAR models, with at least one SSL configuration outperforming the supervised baseline on each of the 10 datasets. Moreover, the most reliable improvements are generally achieved by selecting a relatively small number of chemically distant molecules. This suggests that the composition of the unlabeled set may be more important than its size, challenging the common premise that SSL necessitates an abundance of unlabeled data.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 29th International Conference on Discovery Science, October 5-9, Mainz, Germany
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 QSAR 半监督学习中，从 ChEMBL 的 40 万+未标注分子里挑出少量化学距离远的分子，比随机或近邻采样更能稳定提升模型。10 个 QSAR 数据集上每套数据都有至少一种 SSL 配置超过监督基线，最可靠的改进来自小规模、化学上相距较远的未标注集，说明未标注集的构成比规模更关键。
Motivation: QSAR 标注依赖昂贵湿实验，标注集小，而 ChEMBL 等化学库有数百万未标注分子；但大库能否通过 SSL 改进 QSAR、以及在真实未标注数据下该如何选样，此前基本未被系统研究。
Method: 在从 ChEMBL 提取的 10 个 QSAR 数据集和超过 400,000 个未标注分子池上做系统研究，评估三种既有 SSL 算法（self-training、co-training、label propagation），并设计四种未标注数据选择策略：随机采样、最近邻采样、最远邻采样和混合采样。
Result: 10 个数据集上每个都有至少一种 SSL 配置优于监督基线；最可靠的改进通常来自选择相对少量、化学上距离较远的未标注分子。

papers.title: DemoStream: Batched Task-and-Motion-Plan Optimization for Automated Learning from Demonstration
papers.abstract_en: Learning from demonstration is an effective strategy for endowing robots with manipulation capabilities but requires training on datasets comprised of massive amounts of demonstrations. Existing demonstration collection approaches either require constant human involvement, for example, via teleoperation or are specialized for a single task. Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) systems are able to autonomously solve and therefore generate demonstrations for general-purpose tasks; however, learning from their demonstrations has proven difficult due to multi-modality in their solutions. In this work, we build on recent work leveraging GPU acceleration for TAMP and propose DemoStream, a TAMP system that optimizes demonstration quality in order to improve behavior cloning success rates. First, we introduce batched TAMP sampling operations along with a new TAMP algorithm that correspondingly performs batched constraint satisfaction in order to explore many solutions in parallel. We conduct simulation experiments ablating different action spaces, cost functions, and batch sizes to analyze the effect of these choices on downstream policy success rates. Finally, we show that we can leverage the safety guarantees of TAMP to directly collect real-world demonstrations at an average rate of 66 demos per hour. See our website for policy rollout videos: demostream.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DemoStream 把任务与运动规划 (TAMP) 做成 GPU 批量并行的演示生成器，通过批量采样、批量约束满足与演示质量优化来压低解的多模态性，从而提高行为克隆 (behavior cloning) 的成功率。仿真中对动作空间、代价函数和批量大小做消融，并借助 TAMP 的安全保证在真实机器人上以平均每小时 66 条演示的速度直接采集。
Motivation: 行为克隆需要海量演示，而人工遥操作采集慢、单任务采集器不通用；TAMP 能自主生成通用任务演示，但其解的多模态性让从中学习变得困难。
Method: 在 GPU 加速 TAMP 的近期工作基础上提出 DemoStream：新增批量 TAMP 采样算子，并配套一个执行批量约束满足 (batched constraint satisfaction) 的新 TAMP 算法以并行探索大量解，再对演示质量做优化以改善下游策略学习；仿真中系统消融动作空间、代价函数与批量大小。
Result: 仿真消融给出各选择对下游策略成功率的影响；真实机器人上利用 TAMP 的安全保证直接采集演示，平均采集速率 66 条演示/小时。
Conclusion: 把 TAMP 解的质量作为优化目标并行批量生成演示，可以缓解多模态解对行为克隆的拖累，同时保留安全保证下的真实数据采集速度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Priming Base Models for Agentic Post-Training: An Open Midtraining Recipe
papers.abstract_en: Frontier models, general-purpose and domain-specific alike, now include a midtraining stage between pretraining and post-training, but little has been published about how this stage is built. We present an open midtraining recipe that primes base models for agentic post-training, and we show its effectiveness on two Nemotron models of different sizes. Pretraining typically runs at short context and sees almost no agent interactions, while SFT data is mostly synthetic, and very long SFT stages can hurt the model's later RL trainability. Our midtraining stage sits between the two. It trains at 256K context for hundreds of billions of tokens on a diverse mixture of natural software-engineering data like packed repositories, pull requests, commit histories, and build logs together with a small share of agentic traces. On Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, 500B midtraining tokens improve SWE-bench Verified from 60.7 to 64.5, SWE-bench Multilingual from 55.8 to 62.8, and SWE-bench Pro from 32.0 to 35.5 after identical full SFT. On the larger Nemotron 3.5 Super, 280B midtraining tokens improve DeepSWE, a harder benchmark of long-horizon tasks, from 11.7 to 15.7 and SWE-bench Verified from 72.9 to 74.3 after identical full SFT. Midtraining also improves robustness across agent harnesses on both models. We report the ablations behind the recipe and an evaluation protocol built on short fixed SFT runs, since base-model proxy metrics did not correlate reliably with post-training results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个开放的 midtraining 配方：在预训练与后训练之间用 256K 上下文、数千亿 token 训练，混合自然软件工程数据（打包仓库、PR、commit 历史、构建日志）与少量 agentic traces，为 agentic 后训练做准备。在 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 上加 500B midtraining token 后，SWE-bench Verified 从 60.7 升到 64.5、Multilingual 55.8→62.8、Pro 32.0→35.5；更大的 Nemotron 3.5 Super 上 280B token 使 DeepSWE 从 11.7 升到 15.7、Verified 72.9→74.3，且均在相同完整 SFT 之后比较。
Motivation: midtraining 已成为前沿模型的常规阶段，但其构建方式几乎没有公开资料；同时预训练只在短上下文、几乎不见 agent 交互，而 SFT 数据多为合成、过长的 SFT 会损害后续 RL 可训练性。
Method: 在预训练与 SFT 之间插入 midtraining：以 256K 上下文训练数千亿 token，数据混合自然软件工程语料（packed repositories、pull requests、commit histories、build logs）与少量 agentic traces；配方附带消融实验，以及一套基于短固定 SFT 运行的评估协议，因为 base-model proxy 指标与后训练结果相关性不可靠。
Result: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 加 500B midtraining token、经相同完整 SFT 后：SWE-bench Verified 60.7→64.5，SWE-bench Multilingual 55.8→62.8，SWE-bench Pro 32.0→35.5。Nemotron 3.5 Super 加 280B token：DeepSWE（长时程任务）11.7→15.7，SWE-bench Verified 72.9→74.3。midtraining 还提升了两个模型跨 agent harness 的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 在 SFT 之前用长上下文、以自然软件工程数据为主并掺少量 agentic traces 的 midtraining，能提升 agentic 后训练的起点与跨 harness 鲁棒性；评估该阶段应依赖短固定 SFT 运行而非 base-model proxy 指标。

papers.title: When Models Misread Ink: Auditing VLMs for Arabic Calligraphy Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Arabic calligraphy is a high-stakes cultural visual domain for Muslim communities, yet VLM evaluations rarely test its fine-grained script traditions. We audit 12 VLMs on a cleaned 1,195-image six-way benchmark using numeric, visual-cue, and Diwani-first prompts. In this closed-set setting, the best numeric-prompt accuracy is 60.9% for closed/API models and 47.2% for open-weight models. The main failure is default-label collapse: every numeric run is dominated by a single label taking 33-63% of predictions, against an 18.8% majority-class baseline. For 8 of 12 models the default is Thuluth; GPT-4o labels 52.9% of all images as Thuluth although it is only 18.1% of the set. Prompting helps unevenly: visual cues move accuracy by more than 10 points for some models but hurt others, and foregrounding Diwani often relocates the default rather than removing it. Arabic calligraphy recognition is therefore a compact, culturally grounded stress test for VLM robustness and for measuring which visual traditions become legible to automated systems.
papers.comment: 9 pages, including references and appendix. Accepted for poster presentation at the Muslims in Machine Learning (MusIML) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/NiazTahi/When-Models-Misread-Ink
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 12 个 VLM 做阿拉伯书法体识别审计：在 1,195 张图、六分类闭集基准上，数值提示下闭源/API 模型最高准确率 60.9%、开源权重模型 47.2%。主要失败模式是默认标签坍缩——每次数值提示运行中单一标签占预测的 33–63%，而多数类基线仅 18.8%；12 个模型中 8 个默认输出 Thuluth，GPT-4o 把 52.9% 的图判为 Thuluth（该类实际只占 18.1%）。视觉线索提示对部分模型提升超 10 个百分点、对另一些反而有害，突出 Diwani 往往只是把默认标签换掉而非消除。
Motivation: 阿拉伯书法是穆斯林社群的高风险文化视觉领域，但现有 VLM 评测几乎不覆盖其细粒度书体传统，模型是否真正识别这些视觉传统无从度量。
Method: 构建清洗后的 1,195 张图六分类基准，审计 12 个 VLM，使用三类提示：数值提示、视觉线索提示、Diwani-first 提示；统计准确率、单一标签占比与多数类基线（18.8%）。
Result: 闭集数值提示下最佳准确率：闭源/API 模型 60.9%，开源权重模型 47.2%。默认标签坍缩：所有数值运行中单一标签占预测 33–63%，对照 18.8% 多数类基线；8/12 模型默认 Thuluth；GPT-4o 将 52.9% 图像标为 Thuluth，而该类仅占数据集 18.1%。视觉线索提示使部分模型准确率变动超 10 个百分点，对另一些模型造成下降；突出 Diwani 常把默认标签转移而非消除。
Conclusion: VLM 在细粒度文化视觉类别上普遍退化为默认标签输出，提示工程只能不均匀地缓解；阿拉伯书法识别可作为紧凑、文化落地的 VLM 鲁棒性压力测试。

papers.title: CARA: Causally Guided Retrieval Agent for Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation over text-rich knowledge graphs requires identifying evidence that contributes to answering a question, rather than merely matching its textual content. Existing agentic retrievers adaptively balance global search and multi-hop exploration but primarily rely on textual similarity to guide retrieval. We propose CARA, a training-free, CAusally guided Retrieval Agent that explicitly evaluates the causal relevance of retrieved evidence through two complementary criteria: consequentiality, measuring whether adding evidence improves answerability, and essentiality, assessing whether removing evidence weakens answerability. CARA integrates these assessments with path consistency to guide graph exploration and employs reciprocal rank fusion to aggregate evidence from multiple agents. We evaluate CARA on three STaRK datasets and augment STaRK with ground-truth answers to enable downstream question answering evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that CARA consistently outperforms existing retrievers. CARA also improves answer quality and faithfulness while examining fewer graph nodes and requiring fewer retrieval operations. These findings demonstrate that causal relevance assessment enables more focused and effective agentic graph retrieval, improving both retrieval performance and downstream question answering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARA 是一个免训练的因果引导检索 agent，在文本知识图谱上用 consequentiality（加入证据是否提升可回答性）与 essentiality（移除证据是否削弱可回答性）两条因果准则评估证据相关性，再结合 path consistency 引导图探索、用 reciprocal rank fusion 融合多 agent 证据。在三个 STaRK 数据集上（并扩展 STaRK 以带 ground-truth 答案做下游问答评测）一致优于现有 retriever，同时答案质量与 faithfulness 提升、检查的图节点更少、检索操作更少。
Motivation: 文本知识图谱上的 agentic retriever 主要靠文本相似度在全局搜索与多跳探索之间做权衡，匹配到文本内容不等于找到了真正支撑答案的证据。
Method: 提出 training-free 的 CAusally guided Retrieval Agent (CARA)：用 consequentiality 与 essentiality 两个互补准则评估已检索证据的因果相关性，与 path consistency 结合指导图探索，多个 agent 的证据用 reciprocal rank fusion 聚合；评测基于三个 STaRK 数据集，并给 STaRK 补上 ground-truth 答案以支持下游问答评测。
Result: 在三个 STaRK 数据集上 CARA 一致优于现有 retrievers，并在答案质量与 faithfulness 上提升，同时检查的图节点更少、所需检索操作更少。
Conclusion: 因果相关性评估（而非文本相似度）能让 agentic 图检索更聚焦，同时改善检索性能与下游问答质量，且代价是更少的节点检查与检索操作。

papers.title: Close Enough is Nowhere Near: Fidelity-Consumability Decoupling in KV Caches
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems communicate in text, which is lossy and wasteful: the sender throws away the reading it already did. A growing literature instead transmits the KV cache, the natural carrier of that reading. We study the most appealing form of the idea: both models stay frozen and the sender's cache is substituted for the reader's with nothing trained. It does not work, and the obstruction belongs to the reader. A frozen transformer reads only caches close to the one it would have written itself, a region we call its tolerable set. We show that geometric similarity to that cache does not predict whether the reader can use it, and the failure is not gradual, so a more faithful substitute is not the remedy it appears to be. We explain this phenomenon with competitive attention. Experimentally, we test eight diverse substitution methods against two measured anchors: an uninformative cache baseline and the reader's own accuracy from having read the passage. All sit at the baseline. That turns a long tail of separate negative results into one outcome with a stated condition for overturning it. A different design does work: if the reader keeps its own cache and attends over the sender's as extra context, adapting only its queries, it beats its own baseline, and also clears the baseline with eight senders pooled where undirected attention over the same union falls below it. We offer this as a characterization on one probe, not a leaderboard claim. Our central contribution is a redirection: pursuing faithful substitute caches is the wrong target; adding a cache to what the reader already has is the promising one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体 LLM 用 KV cache 替代文本传递时，冻结模型直接替换读者 cache 的做法全部失败：八个替换方法都落在无信息 cache 基线上，几何相似度高也不代表读者能用。可行设计是保留读者自己的 cache、把发送方 cache 作为额外上下文做注意力、只适配 query，此时超过读者自己读原文的基线。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 之间用文本通信既丢失信息又浪费发送方已完成的阅读；直接传递 KV cache 看似自然，但冻结模型下替换式传递为何失败缺少统一解释。
Method: 定义读者的 tolerable set（冻结 transformer 只能读接近自己会写出的 cache），用 competitive attention 解释失败机制；实验比较八个 cache 替换方法，锚点为无信息 cache 基线与读者自己读原文的准确率；对照设计为保留自身 cache、对发送方 cache 做额外注意力并只适配 query。
Result: 八个替换方法全部落在无信息 cache 基线上，几何相似度不能预测读者可用性，失败是突变而非渐进；保留自身 cache 加 query 适配的设计超过读者自身基线，并在八个发送方合并时仍高于基线，而对同一 cache union 的无向注意力低于基线。
Conclusion: 忠实替代 cache 是错误目标，把发送方 cache 作为附加上下文叠到读者已有 cache 上才是有前景的方向；作者声明这是单一探针上的刻画而非排行榜结论。

papers.title: GraphBEAT: Graph-based Bucketized Event Aggregation Over Time for Early Risk Stratification of Gastrointestinal Cancers
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) contain complementary diagnostic and laboratory information about patient health. However, irregularity, sparsity, heterogeneity, and incompleteness in documentation complicate EHR modeling. To address the problem, we introduce GraphBEAT (Graph-based Bucketized Event Aggregation over Time), a temporal graph representation learning framework that groups clinical events into time buckets and transforms observed features into patient-specific, temporally directed graphs to enable early risk stratification for gastrointestinal cancers. Each node in an EHR graph encodes feature identity, observed value, and temporal position of clinical events. A context-aware, time-decay message-passing mechanism models transitions between successive buckets, followed by multi-head attention pooling to generate patient-level representations. GraphBEAT was trained and evaluated on multi-site longitudinal diagnosis codes and laboratory tests to predict pancreatic, liver, and intestinal cancer at 12-, 24-, and 36-month diagnostic lead times. In all experimental setups, GraphBEAT consistently outperformed baseline graph neural networks (GraphSAGE, GAT, and GCN) and sequence modeling approaches (Transformer and long short-term memory [LSTM]). GraphBEAT also required over 250x fewer floating-point operations per patient and over 20x fewer parameters than the Transformer and LSTM baselines. These results support GraphBEAT as an accurate and computationally efficient approach for cancer risk stratification from sparse, heterogeneous longitudinal health records.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphBEAT 把纵向 EHR 临床事件按时间桶分组，构建成患者专属的有向时序图，用带时间衰减的上下文感知消息传递加多头注意力池化生成患者表示，用于胰腺癌、肝癌和肠癌的早期风险分层。在多站点诊断码与化验数据上，12/24/36 个月提前期的全部实验设置中均稳定优于 GraphSAGE、GAT、GCN、Transformer 与 LSTM，且每患者浮点运算量少 250 倍以上、参数量少 20 倍以上。
Motivation: 纵向 EHR 文档存在不规则、稀疏、异构与不完整问题，使时序建模困难，而癌症早期风险分层需要在长提前期上用稀疏记录做可靠预测。
Method: GraphBEAT 将临床事件分入时间桶，每个节点编码特征身份、观测值与时间位置，构成患者专属的时序有向图；用上下文感知、时间衰减的消息传递建模相邻桶之间的转移，再经多头注意力池化得到患者级表示，在多站点诊断码与化验数据上训练并评估。
Result: 在预测胰腺癌、肝癌与肠癌的 12、24、36 个月诊断提前期的全部实验设置中，GraphBEAT 均稳定优于基线图神经网络 GraphSAGE、GAT、GCN 以及序列模型 Transformer 和 LSTM；每患者浮点运算量比 Transformer 与 LSTM 基线少 250 倍以上，参数量少 20 倍以上。
Conclusion: 时间桶化的时序图表示加时间衰减消息传递，能在稀疏异构纵向健康记录上以远低于 Transformer/LSTM 的计算与参数成本实现准确的癌症风险分层。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Visual Sanad: Auditing Vision-Language Models for False Acceptance of Qur'anic Citations
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to interpret religious, educational, and culturally sensitive visual content, yet their reliability on citation verification remains underexplored. We introduce Visual Sanad, a controlled benchmark for testing whether VLMs falsely accept incorrect Qur'anic verse attributions when the same quote-reference pair is rendered under different visual framings. The benchmark contains 2,400 rendered images built from 100 English Qur'an verses, four factual states per verse, and six visual conditions ranging from plain text to decorative and authority-framed layouts. All quote-reference pairs were source-checked and human-audited before rendering. Across 24 full model-prompt runs, we observe a sharp capability split. Proprietary API-served VLMs range from near-perfect citation verification to moderate false acceptance, whereas recent open-weight VLMs often show weak discrimination and default to VALID on most images. De-biased prompting can reduce false acceptance, but often by shifting the decision threshold toward INVALID rather than by producing strong citation discrimination. Visual Sanad therefore exposes a culturally grounded multimodal factuality failure: fluent VLMs may treat displayed religious citations as self-authenticating unless they have strong citation-verification ability.
papers.comment: 9 pages, including references and appendix. Accepted for poster presentation at the Muslims in Machine Learning (MusIML) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/NiazTahi/Visual-Sanad
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Visual Sanad 是一个受控基准，用 2,400 张渲染图测试 VLM 是否会把错误的古兰经经文-出处配对判为有效：100 英文经文 × 每篇 4 种事实状态 × 6 种视觉版式（从纯文本到装饰性与权威感排版），全部经来源核对与人工审核。24 组完整模型-提示运行显示能力断层：闭源 API 模型从近乎完美验证到中等误接受，开源权重模型判别力弱且多数默认判 VALID；去偏提示能降低误接受，但主要靠把决策阈值推向 INVALID 而非提升真正的出处判别。
Motivation: VLM 被用于宗教、教育与文化敏感的视觉内容，但其出处核验可靠性研究不足；带装饰或权威感版式的错误经文配对可能被当作自证。
Method: 构建受控基准 Visual Sanad：以 100 篇英文古兰经经文为底，每篇生成 4 种事实状态（配对正确/错误），渲染为 6 种视觉条件（plain text 到 decorative、authority-framed 版式），共 2,400 张图；所有 quote-reference 对先做来源核对与人工审核，再以 24 组完整模型-提示组合运行评测，并测试去偏提示 (de-biased prompting)。
Result: 24 组模型-提示运行呈现明显能力分化：闭源 API VLM 从近乎完美的出处验证到中等误接受率；近期开源权重 VLM 判别力弱，多数图像默认判 VALID。去偏提示可降低误接受，但主要通过把决策阈值移向 INVALID，而非增强出处判别力。
Conclusion: 流畅的 VLM 若缺乏强出处核验能力，会把展示出来的宗教引文当作自证，构成一种文化语境下的多模态事实性失败。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stateful Testing for Deep Learning Compilers
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep learning compilers compile models lazily and cache artifacts across invocations. Retained compiler state can make a later invocation incorrect even when it is correct in isolation. An analysis of 26 publicly reported issues in PyTorch, JAX, and TensorFlow shows that detecting such bugs requires sequences that first establish compiler state and then expose a failure. We present Rondo, a stateful testing method that represents each test case as a model paired with an invocation sequence. Rondo mutates invocation sequences and uses a Markov chain Monte Carlo sampler guided by compilation behavior to favor rarely observed behaviors. Its three-way differential oracle compares execution without compilation, compiled execution with compiler state reset, and compiled execution with state retained. It confirms stateful bugs by replaying the same invocation with state retained and reset while preserving inputs and program state, then shortens sequences while preserving the original bug. We evaluate Rondo on four deep learning frameworks using 24 common model architectures. Rondo detects 117 bugs, including 35 stateful bugs. We submit 39 bug reports, including 18 for stateful bugs; developers confirm 35 reports, including 16 for stateful bugs, and fix 18 bugs, including 11 stateful bugs. Rondo achieves the highest behavior coverage and compiler Python source-line coverage among the compared methods, with 99.26% alarm precision. It shortens 44 of 117 invocation sequences, reducing the lengths of these 44 sequences by 83.34% on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Rondo 把深度学习编译器测试用例表示为「模型 + 调用序列」，用编译行为引导的 MCMC 采样器变异序列以命中罕见状态，并用三方差分 oracle（不编译、编译后重置状态、编译后保留状态）判定状态型 bug。在四个框架、24 个常见模型架构上检出 117 个 bug（含 35 个状态型），报警精度 99.26%，并把 44 条调用序列平均缩短 83.34%。
Motivation: 深度学习编译器惰性编译并跨调用缓存产物，保留的编译状态可能让后续调用出错，而单次独立执行是正确的；对 PyTorch、JAX、TensorFlow 共 26 个公开 issue 的分析表明，这类 bug 必须靠先建立状态、再暴露失败的序列才能触发。
Method: Rondo 将测试用例表示为模型与调用序列的配对，对调用序列做变异，并用受编译行为引导的 MCMC 采样器偏向罕见行为；三方差分 oracle 比较不编译执行、编译且重置状态、编译且保留状态三种路径，随后以保留/重置状态下重放同一调用（保持输入与程序状态不变）确认状态型 bug，并在保留原 bug 的前提下缩短序列。
Result: 在四个深度学习框架、24 个常见模型架构上评估：检出 117 个 bug，其中 35 个为状态型；提交 39 份报告（18 份状态型），开发者确认 35 份（16 份状态型）、修复 18 个 bug（11 个状态型）；在所比较方法中行为覆盖率与编译器 Python 源码行覆盖率均最高，报警精度 99.26%；对 117 条调用序列中的 44 条做了缩短，这些序列长度平均减少 83.34%。
Conclusion: 状态型编译器 bug 需要「先建立状态再暴露失败」的调用序列才能被发现，把状态保留与状态重置的执行差异做成差分 oracle，可以在保持高报警精度的同时检出并最小化这类 bug。

papers.title: Interfaces and Modules: A Scalable Representation for Weight-Space Learning across Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Weight-space learning across architectures requires representations that respect parameter symmetries and scale to large networks. Existing equivariant tensor encoders require architecture-specific symmetry specifications, while neuron graphs make global attention costly. We introduce a typed graph organized around shared coordinate-permutation actions. Its nodes, called interfaces, represent coordinate spaces whose bound tensor axes must be permuted jointly; operation occurrences, called modules, form typed hyperedges. A compiler derives this graph from supported PyTorch models, with exact recovery of the permutation factors defined by its constraints. The Universal Weight Encoder (UWE) combines local equivariant updates to parameter features with global attention over invariant interface summaries. The small number of interfaces makes global attention practical, and a single encoder processes different supported architectures. UWE is competitive with architecture-specific state-of-the-art methods on established benchmarks. On a new zoo of 1,200 transformers spanning 100 architectures, it outperforms the evaluated baselines at ranking networks within unseen architectures, including architectures larger than those used for training, while using substantially less memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出权重空间学习的类型化图表示：把必须联合置换的张量坐标轴封装为 interface 节点，把算子出现位置封装为 module 类型超边，并由编译器从受支持的 PyTorch 模型自动导出该图。UWE 编码器把局部等变参数特征更新与基于 interface 摘要的全局注意力结合，因 interface 数量少而使全局注意力可行，单一编码器即可跨架构处理模型。在含 1,200 个 transformer、覆盖 100 种架构的新权重库上，UWE 在未见架构内对网络排序超过所评测的基线，包括比训练时更大的架构，且内存占用显著更低。
Motivation: 跨架构权重空间学习需要尊重参数对称性的表示：现有等变张量编码器需要逐架构指定对称性，neuron graph 上的全局注意力开销又过大，两者都难以扩展到大网络。
Method: 构建围绕共享 coordinate-permutation 作用的类型化图：interface 节点表示其绑定张量轴必须联合置换的坐标空间，module 作为类型化超边表示算子出现；编译器从受支持的 PyTorch 模型导出该图，并精确恢复其约束定义的置换因子。UWE 编码器结合对参数特征的局部等变更新与对不变 interface 摘要的全局注意力。
Result: 在既有基准上 UWE 与架构专用的最先进方法相当；在新的 1,200 个 transformer、100 种架构的权重库上，于未见架构内网络排序任务中超过所评测基线，涵盖大于训练所用规模的架构，同时内存占用显著更少。

papers.title: Data-Efficient ConvNeXt Pretraining for High-Resolution Sentinel-1 GRD SAR Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Labeled Sentinel-1 Ground Range Detected (S1GRD) datasets remain scarce, limiting supervised deep learning for land-surface remote sensing, while self-supervised pretraining for this domain has been dominated by Vision Transformer (ViT)-based masked image modeling requiring substantial data and compute. We propose SparK-SAR, a sparse convolutional masked pretraining framework built on SparK and ConvNeXt, designed to exploit convolutional inductive biases for S1GRD imagery under constrained compute. SparK-SAR makes three core technical contributions: (i) ConvNeXt-RS, a domain-adapted encoder that halves the stem stride (4x to 2x) to produce 14x14 feature maps at stride 16x, providing 4x more spatial tokens at identical parameter count; (ii) a lightweight ConvNeXt-512 reconstruction decoder with PixelShuffle upsampling that reduces pretraining VRAM by 7.5-8.5% per GPU relative to a UNet-128 baseline while matching its accuracy; and (iii) an empirical characterization of FP16 mixed-precision pretraining instability in the standard SparK UNet-768 decoder on S1GRD data, complemented by a finding that finetuning with layer-wise learning rate decay (LLRD) improves downstream performance of pretrained encoders. On four Copernicus-Bench S1GRD tasks, our finetuned 27.8M-parameter ConvNeXt-RS encoder improves over a non-pretrained baseline by +4.7, +5.0, +5.8, and +1.4 pp on EuroSAT-S1, BigEarthNet-S1, DFC2020-S1, and Flood-S1 respectively, and outperforms the Copernicus-FM ViT (139M parameters, frozen) on three of four tasks at roughly 5x fewer parameters. A pretraining data-scaling study reveals task-dependent data efficiency: classification saturates with as little as 10-25% of the SSL4EO-S12 v1.1 corpus, while dense prediction continues to improve significantly up to 25-50%. The study also includes a CKA representation analysis and a geographic de-collision experiment.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 9 figures. Extends a preliminary paper to be presented at SPIE Asia Pacific Remote Sensing 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SparK-SAR：在 ConvNeXt 上做稀疏卷积掩码自监督预训练，用减半 stem stride 的 ConvNeXt-RS 编码器与轻量 PixelShuffle 解码器，在受限算力下适配 Sentinel-1 GRD。微调后 27.8M 参数的 ConvNeXt-RS 在 Copernicus-Bench 四项任务上较非预训练基线提升 +4.7/+5.0/+5.8/+1.4 pp，并以约 1/5 参数量在其中三项超过 139M 的 Copernicus-FM ViT。
Motivation: Sentinel-1 GRD 有标签数据稀缺，监督学习受限；该领域的自监督预训练又被需要大量数据与算力的 ViT 掩码建模主导，难以在受限算力下开展。
Method: SparK-SAR 基于 SparK 与 ConvNeXt 的稀疏卷积掩码预训练：ConvNeXt-RS 把 stem stride 从 4x 减到 2x，在 stride 16x 处产出 14x14 特征图，同参数量下空间 token 增至 4 倍；解码器为带 PixelShuffle 上采样的轻量 ConvNeXt-512；微调时用 layer-wise learning rate decay (LLRD)。另刻画了标准 SparK UNet-768 解码器在 S1GRD 上 FP16 混合精度预训练的不稳定现象。
Result: 27.8M 参数 ConvNeXt-RS 微调后在 EuroSAT-S1、BigEarthNet-S1、DFC2020-S1、Flood-S1 上较非预训练基线分别 +4.7、+5.0、+5.8、+1.4 pp，并在四项中的三项超过 139M 参数的冻结 Copernicus-FM ViT，参数量约少 5 倍。ConvNeXt-512 解码器相对 UNet-128 基线每 GPU 预训练 VRAM 降低 7.5-8.5% 且精度相当。数据规模研究显示分类任务用 SSL4EO-S12 v1.1 语料的 10-25% 即饱和，稠密预测在 25-50% 区间仍显著提升；另含 CKA 表征分析与地理去碰撞实验。
Conclusion: 卷积归纳偏置配合稀疏掩码预训练能在远低于 ViT 的参数与数据预算下做好 Sentinel-1 GRD 表征学习，且数据效率随任务而异：分类早饱和、稠密预测需更多预训练数据。

papers.title: VesperMUSE: Multi-Modal Fusion Vision Transformer for Image Semantic Segmentation Under Diverse Light Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation is critical for the reliable navigation and scene understanding of autonomous systems, yet its performance degrades severely in low-light environments due to noise, artifacts, colour distortion, and the loss of structural details. To address this challenge, this work introduces VesperMUSE, a unified multi-modal framework designed to achieve robust image semantic segmentation across diverse illumination conditions. The architecture addresses the light deficiency problem on multiple levels: proposing a novel physics-informed synthetic low-light adaptation algorithm, approaching Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE) through a thermal-guided paradigm, and finally aiming to recover the intrinsic scene details for semantic segmentation through a multi-modal fusion approach. Following enhancement, the framework dynamically integrates the primary RGB features with auxiliary thermal representations and surface normal maps highlighting geometric discontinuities and material boundaries. At the core of this integration is a highly scalable, modality-agnostic self-attention mechanism that extracts both global context and fine local features from an arbitrary number of auxiliary inputs. By combining and projecting these hierarchical multi-modal representations into a unified component, the attention module allows the network to selectively attend to relevant cross-modal cues without requiring any architectural modifications when different sensor configurations are used. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that VesperMUSE successfully recovers missing visual cues, providing a flexible, state-of-the-art (SOTA) solution for machine perception in extreme and unstructured real-world environments.
papers.comment: A dissertation submitted to The University of Manchester for the degree of Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VesperMUSE 是面向低光等极端光照条件的多模态语义分割框架：先用物理启发的合成低光自适应算法与热引导的低光图像增强 (LLIE) 恢复 RGB 细节，再用模态无关的自注意力动态融合 RGB、热红外与表面法线图。作者称其在极端与非结构化真实环境中提供灵活的 SOTA 机器感知方案。
Motivation: 低光环境下噪声、伪影、颜色失真与结构细节丢失会使语义分割性能严重下降，直接威胁自主系统的导航与场景理解可靠性。
Method: 三层处理：物理启发的合成低光自适应算法生成训练数据；以热红外引导的 LLIE 增强 RGB；再由可扩展、模态无关的 self-attention 从任意数量辅助输入（热红外、表面法线）中同时提取全局上下文与局部细节，分层表征经拼接与投影统一，更换传感器配置无需改动架构。
Result: 在极端与非结构化真实环境的广泛评测中，VesperMUSE 成功恢复缺失视觉线索，被作者描述为 state-of-the-art 的机器感知方案；摘要未给出具体数据集名称或指标数值。
Conclusion: 把低光增强与跨模态注意力融合放进同一框架，可在不改架构的前提下适配不同传感器配置，实现跨光照条件的鲁棒语义分割。

papers.title: GRID-Planner: Graph-Structured Relational Reward Shaping for Diffusion Planning
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving planning requires selecting trajectories that remain safe, rule-compliant, and comfortable under complex multi-agent interactions, yet robust closed-loop decision making in planning-critical scenes remains challenging. Existing diffusion- and RL-based planners often rely on generic rewards and use relational structure mainly for representation, limiting how planning-critical rollouts shape policy improvement. We present GRID-Planner, a graph--reward integrated diffusion planning framework that aligns generative planning with structured relational signals. Specifically, GRID-Planner combines graph-aware importance weighting, a time-indexed relational reward surrogate, and an advantage-weighted diffusion objective with on-policy self-distillation, forming a rollout-return-advantage-update loop without explicit likelihoods. Experiments on nuPlan and interPlan show that, compared with the diffusion-only baseline, GRID-Planner reduces collision rate, lane deviation, and jerk by 35.8\%, 60.8\%, and 27.4\%, respectively, and improves the planning score by 3.4\%. Project website: https://github.com/yangzhaojason/GRID-Planner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRID-Planner 把图结构关系信号直接嵌入扩散规划的奖励与目标函数：图感知重要性加权、时间索引关系奖励代理 (time-indexed relational reward surrogate)、以及带 on-policy 自蒸馏的优势加权扩散目标，形成无需显式似然的 rollout-return-advantage-update 闭环。在 nuPlan 与 interPlan 上，相比 diffusion-only 基线，碰撞率、车道偏离和 jerk 分别下降 35.8%、60.8%、27.4%，规划分数提升 3.4%。
Motivation: 自动驾驶规划需在多智能体交互下选出安全、合规、舒适的轨迹，但现有扩散或 RL 规划器多用通用奖励，且只把关系结构当表征使用，规划关键场景的闭环决策仍然脆弱。
Method: GRID-Planner 是 graph-reward integrated diffusion planning 框架：图感知重要性加权 + 时间索引关系奖励代理 + 优势加权扩散目标，配合 on-policy 自蒸馏，在不显式计算似然的条件下构成 rollout-return-advantage-update 训练闭环。
Result: 在 nuPlan 与 interPlan 上，相对 diffusion-only 基线，碰撞率降低 35.8%，车道偏离降低 60.8%，jerk 降低 27.4%，规划分数 (planning score) 提升 3.4%。
Conclusion: 把关系结构从表征层推进到奖励与扩散目标本身，可以在不显式似然的条件下改善规划关键场景的闭环安全、合规与舒适性。

papers.title: OntoAct: Hypothesis-Based Neuro-Symbolic Agents through Ontological Abstraction
papers.abstract_en: Learning from experience requires recovering reusable knowledge and determining when it applies to a new situation. We introduce OntoAct, a hypothesis-based neuro-symbolic framework built on ontological abstraction. OntoAct turns individual experiences into axioms over entity types, relations, and conditions, making their underlying patterns reusable across situations. A large language model (LLM) uses this world knowledge to propose hypotheses and actions, while a symbolic verifier assesses their supporting conditions against current observations. Verification identifies missing evidence, and new observations and intervention outcomes update hypothesis assessments and guide subsequent actions. We also introduce Tacit-FLE, a benchmark built on the Factorio Learning Environment (FLE) for diagnosing and repairing hidden faults in existing factories using inherited operational records. Its synthetic maintenance corpus distributes evidence across records, and an executed repair may leave the fault unresolved, requiring agents to reassess their diagnoses through interaction. Across Tacit-FLE, Mars, and ALFWorld, OntoAct achieves leading task performance with efficient interaction and inference.
papers.comment: 49 pages, 13 figures, 33 tables. Preprint, under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OntoAct 把个体经验抽象成关于实体类型、关系与条件的公理，由 LLM 提出假设与动作、符号验证器对照当前观测核查支撑条件，再用新观测与干预结果更新假设评估并指导下一次动作。在 Tacit-FLE、Mars 与 ALFWorld 上取得领先任务表现且交互与推理开销高效。
Motivation: 从经验中学习需要把个别经历提炼成可复用知识，并判断其何时适用于新情境；隐藏故障诊断场景中证据分散在继承的运行记录里，一次执行的修复可能并未真正排除故障。
Method: 基于本体抽象 (ontological abstraction) 的假设式神经符号框架：将个体经验转写为覆盖实体类型、关系与条件的公理；LLM 依据这些世界知识提出假设与动作，符号验证器对照当前观测核查支撑条件，验证暴露缺失证据后由新观测与干预结果更新假设评估并引导后续动作。配套提出 Tacit-FLE 基准，构建在 Factorio Learning Environment (FLE) 之上，其合成维护语料把证据分散到记录中。
Result: 在 Tacit-FLE、Mars 与 ALFWorld 三个基准上取得领先任务表现 (leading task performance)，并保持高效的交互与推理开销；Tacit-FLE 中一次执行的修复可能仍使故障未被解决，需通过交互重新评估诊断。
Conclusion: 把经验固化为可复用的本体公理、再由符号验证器约束 LLM 的假设与动作，能在隐藏故障诊断与跨情境任务上同时拿到领先表现和低交互成本。

summary_sections.result: 在 Tacit-FLE、Mars 与 ALFWorld 三个基准上取得领先任务表现 (leading task performance)，并保持高效的交互与推理开销；Tacit-FLE 中一次执行的修复可能仍使故障未被解决，需通过交互重新评估诊断。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把经验固化为可复用的本体公理、再由符号验证器约束 LLM 的假设与动作，能在隐藏故障诊断与跨情境任务上同时拿到领先表现和低交互成本。

papers.title: Deep Learning of Topological Equivalence Classes
papers.abstract_en: We demonstrate an application of deep learning to the problem of identifying whether two generating vectors correspond to topologically equivalent finite group actions on Riemann surfaces, showing how architectures developed for semantic understanding have use for pure mathematical problems. In doing so we discuss how desired algebraic structure influences model design, and explore which structural properties of topological equivalence classes the model has successfully learnt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把语义理解架构迁移到纯数学问题：判断两组生成向量是否给出黎曼曲面上拓扑等价的有限群作用，并讨论代数结构如何反过来约束模型设计，以及模型实际学到了拓扑等价类的哪些结构性质。
Motivation: 判定两个有限群作用是否拓扑等价是纯数学中的结构性问题，作者想检验为语义理解设计的深度模型能否迁移到这类代数几何任务。
Method: 以生成向量为输入、判断其是否对应拓扑等价的有限群作用，按期望的代数结构指导架构选择，并分析模型学到的拓扑等价类结构属性。
Result: 论文展示了深度学习可用于判定两组生成向量是否给出拓扑等价的有限群作用，并探讨模型成功学到的拓扑等价类结构性质；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 为语义理解开发的架构可迁移到纯数学问题，且模型设计应由目标代数结构驱动。

papers.title: P2TPO: Structure-Aligned Page-to-Token Credit Assignment for Full-Page Document Parsing
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end full-page document parsing must preserve the content and structure of heterogeneous elements, yet otherwise accurate outputs can contain local errors and omissions. A single page-level advantage does not explicitly identify which elements differ in quality across sampled outputs or where their errors occur. We introduce Page-to-Token Policy Optimization (P2TPO), a structure-aligned credit-assignment framework that operates on full-page policy trajectories. Reference-element alignment first associates block-level quality contrasts with generated spans. Unified Anchor Pricing (UAP) incorporates matched and missing element outcomes and provides feedback relative to a fixed quality ceiling when sampled outputs receive identical but imperfect scores for a reference element. Within matched blocks, Span Credit Redistribution (SCR) redistributes existing block credit according to aligned correct and erroneous spans, using boundary proxies for within-block omissions while preserving the total block-derived advantage across its tokens. Under a fixed-weight additive page utility, we show that element-indexed contrasts retain local quality differences that page-level aggregation can cancel out. In the main experimental comparison, P2TPO outperforms all evaluated policy optimization baselines in seed-averaged scores on each of the six document parsing benchmarks. Additional experiments demonstrate gains across model scales and initializations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: P2TPO 把整页文档解析的策略优化从页级优势拆到元素级：先做参考元素对齐，把块级质量对比对到生成 span，再用统一锚点定价 (UAP) 处理匹配与缺失元素、并在采样输出得分相同但不完美时相对固定质量上限给反馈，块内用 span 信用再分配 (SCR) 按对齐的正确与错误 span 重新分配块信用并保持块总优势不变。在六个文档解析基准上，P2TPO 的种子平均分超过全部被评估的策略优化基线。
Motivation: 端到端整页文档解析中，输出整体准确仍可能含局部错误与遗漏；单一的页级优势无法指出哪些元素质量有差异、错误出现在哪里，页级聚合还会把局部质量差异抵消掉。
Method: P2TPO 是面向整页策略轨迹的结构对齐信用分配框架：参考元素对齐把块级质量对比关联到生成 span；UAP 纳入匹配与缺失元素结果，在采样输出对同一参考元素得分相同但不完美时相对固定质量上限提供反馈；块内 SCR 按对齐的正确/错误 span 重新分配块信用，用边界代理处理块内遗漏，并在固定权重的加性页效用下保持块派生优势总和不变。
Result: 在主实验对比中，P2TPO 在六个文档解析基准的每一个上，种子平均分均超过所有被评估的策略优化基线；额外实验显示增益跨模型规模与不同初始化成立。理论上证明元素索引的对比保留了页级聚合会抵消掉的局部质量差异。
Conclusion: 把页级优势按结构元素重新分配到 token，能保留页级聚合抹掉的局部质量信号，从而在整页文档解析上稳定优于页级策略优化；该结论在多规模、多初始化下成立。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learn Only Where You Can't Compute: Structured Corrections to Gaussian Process Posteriors
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed Gaussian processes (GPs) provide a principled framework for scientific inference by expressing uncertainty over empirical measurements, boundary conditions, and governing equations. However, they struggle to scale to larger datasets and nonlinear information. Conversely, diffusion models excel at learning complex distributions over functions from massive datasets, but struggle in scientific contexts where training data are scarce and physical or observational information must be incorporated. We propose a structured posterior-correction framework that combines a tractable Gaussian reference with data-driven corrections via generative learning. After a mean correction and covariance calibration, a diffusion model learns a targeted correction in a low-dimensional subspace selected to capture discrepancies from the reference, while the complement retains its Gaussian law. Across three scientific inference tasks, these corrections recover hidden modes, improve sample structure, and reduce prediction error relative to the Gaussian reference. Comparisons with full-field generative models reveal task-dependent benefits and tradeoffs between predictive accuracy and computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出结构化后验修正框架：以可解析的物理信息高斯过程 (GP) 后验为参考，用扩散模型只在低维子空间上学数据驱动修正，补集保持高斯律。经均值修正与协方差校准后，在三个科学推断任务上恢复隐藏模态、改善样本结构并相对高斯参考降低预测误差。
Motivation: 物理信息 GP 难以扩展到大数据与非线性信息，而扩散模型在训练数据稀缺、需融入物理或观测信息的科学场景中表现不佳，两者各有短板。
Method: 以可解析高斯参考为基础，先做均值修正与协方差校准，再用扩散模型在选取的低维子空间上学针对参考偏差的修正，子空间补集保留高斯分布；并与全字段生成模型对比。
Result: 在三个科学推断任务上，修正相对高斯参考恢复隐藏模态、改善样本结构并降低预测误差；与全字段生成模型的比较显示收益依任务而异，存在预测精度与计算成本之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 把生成式学习限制在参考模型算不准的低维子空间，可在保留物理先验可解析性的同时补上非线性信息，但精度与计算成本的取舍取决于具体任务。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Time to Fake It: Continual Machine Learning Intensifies Unfairness in Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deepfake detectors safeguard against misinformation, rendering their failures as much a societal as a technical concern. As generators constantly evolve, detectors trained on static datasets miss newly arising threats, while progressive training interferes catastrophically. Yet, mitigating forgetfulness in terms of accuracy, the prevalent focus of continual learning (CL), is insufficient to reflect real-world impact. We therefore scrutinize the effects of CL methods with respect to evolving fairness. To this end, we analyze four dimensions of fairness across diverse demographics for detectors trained progressively on a chronological sequence of 11 real-world deepfake generation methods. Tracking fairness metrics over time, we expose non-trivial interplays between performance and fairness that depend on both the choice of CL algorithm and demographic intersections. We find accuracy degradation to typically exacerbate unfairness and, conversely, fairness improvements to remain scarce over time. Dissecting the CL method families (rehearsal, prompts, regularization), we observe that inequitable forgetting is not explained by underrepresentation alone, but likely entangled with representation learning. We thus issue a call to action for CL methods to take social outcomes into account when balancing the stability-plasticity tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在按时间顺序排列的 11 种真实 deepfake 生成方法上渐进训练检测器时，持续学习 (CL) 不仅损失准确率，还系统性加剧人口统计上的不公平。准确率下降通常伴随不公平加剧，而随时间的公平性改善很少出现；不公平遗忘不能仅由数据欠代表性解释，更可能与表示学习纠缠。作者呼吁 CL 方法在权衡 stability-plasticity 时把社会结果纳入目标。
Motivation: 生成器持续演化，静态数据集训练的检测器抓不住新威胁，而渐进训练又会灾难性遗忘；但现有持续学习只盯准确率，忽略了真实世界中对不同人口群体的差异化影响。
Method: 对按时间顺序的 11 种真实 deepfake 生成方法序列做渐进训练，跨多种人口统计维度追踪四个公平性维度的指标随时间的变化，并按 CL 方法族（rehearsal、prompts、regularization）拆解分析。
Result: 在 11 种生成方法的时间序列上追踪公平性指标，发现准确率退化通常加剧不公平，而公平性改善随时间十分稀少；性能与公平性的相互作用非平凡，取决于所选 CL 算法与人口统计交叉群体；不公平遗忘不能仅由欠代表性解释。
Conclusion: 只缓解准确率层面的遗忘不足以反映真实影响，CL 方法在平衡 stability-plasticity 时必须把社会公平结果作为显式目标。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Federated Learning for Joint Communication and Computation in XR Systems
papers.abstract_en: The convergence of communication and computation, empowered by artificial intelligence (AI) enhanced capabilities, emerges as a key enabler for realizing the promising functionalities of the sixth-generation of communication systems (6G). To this end, this paper investigates an AI-native, robust network, where multiple base stations (BSs) simultaneously serve several extended reality (XR) devices. The paper then presents an innovative distributed deep learning-based approach to simultaneously manage the transmit and computing powers, and computation allocation, amidst uncertainties in both channel and computing states information. Under such an interference network scenario, the paper proposes a robust approach for minimizing the worst-case delay across the served XR devices, subject to computation and power constraints. The paper leverages a deep neural network (DNN) that can be trained either centrally or in a federated manner to map estimated channels and computation requirements to optimized resource allocations per BS. During training, uncertainty samples, reflecting both channel and computing estimation errors, are injected after the DNN output to account for such joint uncertainties. Our results validate the enhanced robust delay performance and scalability of joint uncertainty injection as compared to uncertainty-agnostic methods and state-of-the-art benchmarks, with federated learning-based solutions achieving near-centralized performance while enhancing efficiency, privacy, and adaptability.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 16 figures, 3 tables. This paper has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 XR 的 6G 通信-计算融合场景，提出在 DNN 输出后注入信道与计算状态联合不确定性样本的鲁棒资源分配方法，联合优化发射功率、计算功率与算力分配，最小化最坏情况时延。联邦训练版本在保持隐私与可扩展性的同时达到接近集中式训练的鲁棒时延性能。
Motivation: 多基站服务多 XR 设备的干扰网络中，信道与计算状态信息均存在估计误差，传统资源分配方案对这类联合不确定性不鲁棒，且集中式训练在隐私与可扩展性上有局限。
Method: 训练一个 DNN 将估计信道与计算需求映射为各基站的发射功率、计算功率与算力分配；训练时在 DNN 输出后注入反映信道与计算估计误差的不确定性样本，以最小化最坏情况时延为目标，受计算与功率约束；DNN 可集中式或联邦方式训练。
Result: 联合不确定性注入在鲁棒时延性能与可扩展性上优于不确定性无关方法与 state-of-the-art benchmarks；联邦学习方案达到接近集中式训练的性能，同时提升效率、隐私与适应性。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 在输出端注入联合信道-计算不确定性样本可提升 XR 资源分配的鲁棒性，且联邦训练能以接近集中式的性能换取隐私与可扩展性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Why Shallow Neural Networks Learn Sinusoidal Components First: An Orthogonal Polynomial Dynamics Framework
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks often learn low-frequency components before high-frequency ones --- a phenomenon called spectral bias or termed F-principle. Many numerical studies have demonstrated this phenomenon, and theoretical studies have sought to explain it. However, several goals remain insufficiently addressed: (1) explaining spectral bias asymptotically, including its origin and why the preferred components are generally sinusoidal; (2) extending the explanation to general activation functions, such as sigmoid and ReLU; (3) making weak assumptions about the data distribution; (4) avoiding aliasing effects, such as those arising in finite-domain Fourier analysis; and (5) developing a theoretical framework applicable to arbitrary networks. We address these goals theoretically by analyzing the eigenvalue decay and eigenvector shapes of the dynamics matrix H, which arises when we expand the network output as a general Fourier series (GFS) in an orthogonal polynomial basis and express the gradient-descent dynamics of the GFS coefficients as ordinary differential equations. The graded structure of H enables an intuitive explanation of spectral bias, while orthogonal polynomial theory helps us analyze how learning bias depends on the activation function and, potentially, the network architecture.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文从理论上解释浅层神经网络的谱偏置 (spectral bias / F-principle)：把网络输出在正交多项式基上展开为广义 Fourier 级数 (GFS)，将梯度下降动力学写成系数的 ODE，其动力学矩阵 H 的分级结构决定特征值衰减与特征向量形状，从而说明低频、且通常为正弦型的分量先被学到。该框架对 sigmoid、ReLU 等一般激活函数适用，避免有限域 Fourier 分析的混叠效应，并对数据分布假设较弱。
Motivation: 谱偏置虽有大量数值证据，但缺少渐近层面的解释：其起源是什么、为何优先分量一般是正弦、如何推广到 sigmoid/ReLU 等激活函数，以及如何在弱数据分布假设下避免有限域 Fourier 分析的混叠并适用于任意网络结构。
Method: 将网络输出在正交多项式基上展开为广义 Fourier 级数 (GFS)，把 GFS 系数的梯度下降动力学表达为常微分方程，分析动力学矩阵 H 的特征值衰减与特征向量形状；H 的分级结构用于解释谱偏置，正交多项式理论用于刻画学习偏置对激活函数与网络结构的依赖。
Result: 给出一个理论框架而非实验结果：通过 H 的分级结构渐近解释谱偏置的起源与正弦分量的优先性，并将分析推广到 sigmoid、ReLU 等一般激活函数，同时避免有限域 Fourier 分析的混叠效应、对数据分布假设较弱。
Conclusion: 谱偏置可由广义 Fourier 级数系数动力学矩阵 H 的谱结构统一解释，且该解释原则上适用于任意网络架构与一般激活函数。

papers.title: ChronoSheaf: Joint Spatio-Temporal Spectral Filtering on Cellular Sheaves
papers.abstract_en: Sheaf neural networks generalize graph neural networks by assigning each edge a learned linear restriction map that specifies how the local representations of adjacent nodes relate to one another, thereby mitigating oversmoothing. Existing sheaf architectures, however, define the sheaf Laplacian as an instantaneous spatial operator and therefore cannot explicitly model how signals evolve over time on a graph. We first introduce a spectral sheaf Laplacian, defined jointly over space and time, such that a single operator regulates signal propagation across both the spatial graph and the temporal domain. Directly extending this operator's receptive field in space or time would require increasingly complex sheaf structures. Instead, we propose a spectral filter that expands the effective receptive field along both dimensions without enlarging the underlying sheaf. Building on this operator, we introduce ChronoSheaf, a spatio-temporal sheaf network with two key components. First, Transitional Restriction Maps (TRM) decompose each node's restriction map into a spatial term and two temporal frames that independently control its relation to neighboring nodes at the preceding and following timestep, enabling asymmetric temporal influence. Second, the Dual Spectral Filter (DSF) applies a single bounded-degree polynomial filter with an adaptively estimated spectral radius to the joint spatio-temporal sheaf operator. We validate ChronoSheaf on a diverse set of spatio-temporal forecasting benchmarks, where it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. The code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ChronoSheaf-1D7D/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChronoSheaf 把 sheaf Laplacian 从瞬时空间算子扩展为时空联合的 spectral sheaf Laplacian，用 Transitional Restriction Maps (TRM) 把每个节点的限制映射分解为空间项加前/后两个时间帧以实现非对称时间影响，再用 Dual Spectral Filter (DSF) 施加单个有界度多项式滤波器（自适应估计谱半径）在不扩大 sheaf 结构的前提下扩展时空感受野。在一组时空预报基准上超过 state-of-the-art 基线。
Motivation: 现有 sheaf 神经网络把 sheaf Laplacian 定义为瞬时空间算子，无法显式建模图上信号随时间的演化；而直接在空间或时间上扩展该算子的感受野又需要日益复杂的 sheaf 结构。
Method: 先定义时空联合的 spectral sheaf Laplacian，由单一算子同时调控空间图与时间域上的信号传播；TRM 将节点限制映射分解为空间项与两个时间帧，分别控制与前一、后一时间步邻居的关系；DSF 对联合时空 sheaf 算子施加单个有界度多项式滤波器，谱半径自适应估计，从而扩大有效感受野而不放大底层 sheaf。
Result: 在一组多样的时空预报 (spatio-temporal forecasting) 基准上，ChronoSheaf 超过 state-of-the-art 基线；摘要以定性比较为主，未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 时空联合的谱 sheaf 算子配合分解式时间限制映射与单个多项式谱滤波，可以在不增大 sheaf 复杂度的情况下提升图上时空预报效果。

papers.title: SelectPFN: Amortized Bayesian Variable Selection for Sparse Nonlinear Regression with Prior-Data Fitted Networks
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models based on prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) predict on a new data set in a single forward pass, but they cannot report which inputs their predictions depend on. We propose SelectPFN, a PFN that performs Bayesian variable selection and prediction jointly for sparse nonlinear regression. In one forward pass it returns posterior inclusion probabilities for every variable, and its predictions are computed from sampled subsets only, so excluded variables provably cannot affect them; we show this is exactly what the Bayesian model prescribes. The network is pretrained once on synthetic tasks from a meta-prior built around a group spike-and-slab sparse-input neural network. Column-permutation equivariance combined with random interleaving of original and knockoff columns yields knockoff statistics with exact finite-sample false discovery rate control, even when the meta-prior is wrong. We develop theory for amortized selection: a Bayes-regret bound for the amortized median probability model, a characterization showing that the information needed to detect a variable grows like $(2/λ)\log(1/ω)$ in the prior weight $ω$ of structures that can use it, where $λ\le1$ is an efficiency, and a negative result showing that average-case training does not transfer to frequentist guarantees at a fixed truth. On out-of-prior nonlinear designs with p up to 500, SelectPFN improves the area under the precision-recall curve by 0.23-0.28 over the lasso, BART, DART, LassoNet and a group-penalized sparse neural network, at a false discovery proportion of about 0.07 and 0.04 seconds per data set. The advantage persists on real covariate matrices, and, as the theory predicts, detection of interaction-only variables rises monotonically with their prior weight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SelectPFN 把贝叶斯变量选择与预测合并进一个 PFN 前向传播：返回每个变量的后验包含概率 (posterior inclusion probability)，预测只由抽样子集算出，被排除的变量在构造上无法影响预测。列置换等变性配合原始列与 knockoff 列的随机交错产生具精确有限样本 FDR 控制的 knockoff 统计量；在 p 最高 500 的 out-of-prior 非线性设计上，AUPRC 比 lasso、BART、DART、LassoNet 与 group-penalized sparse neural network 高 0.23–0.28，FDP 约 0.07，每个数据集 0.04 秒。
Motivation: 表格基础模型 (PFN) 单次前向即可在新数据集上预测，但无法报告预测依赖哪些输入；稀疏非线性回归里既要有可审计的变量选择，又要保留摊销 (amortized) 推断的速度。
Method: 在围绕 group spike-and-slab sparse-input neural network 构建的 meta-prior 上一次性预训练 PFN，联合做贝叶斯变量选择与预测；用列置换等变性加原始列与 knockoff 列随机交错生成 knockoff 统计量。配套理论给出摊销 median probability model 的 Bayes-regret 界、检测某变量所需信息随其先验权重 ω 呈 (2/λ)log(1/ω) 增长（λ≤1 为效率），以及平均情形训练不能迁移到固定真值下频率派保证的负面结果。
Result: 在 p 最高 500 的 out-of-prior 非线性设计上，AUPRC 相对 lasso、BART、DART、LassoNet 和 group-penalized sparse neural network 提升 0.23–0.28，false discovery proportion 约 0.07，每个数据集耗时 0.04 秒；优势在真实协变量矩阵上保持。交互项变量的检出率随其先验权重单调上升，与理论预测一致。
Conclusion: 单次前向的贝叶斯变量选择可以在 meta-prior 设错时仍保有精确有限样本 FDR 控制，且摊销选择的检出能力由先验权重决定；但平均情形训练不自动给出固定真值下的频率派保证。

papers.title: Following Delegation Traces to Study Human Oversight in Interaction with Multimodal AI
papers.abstract_en: As multimodal AI systems are becoming our everyday thought partners, the shift towards studying how users transfer control to these systems becomes especially urgent. In this paper, we report an overview of findings from an online study with n=56 AI-literate participants and 392 Video Question Answering trials. After inspecting each multimodal AI response, participants rated task-specific trust and selected one of three intended policies for an analogous future task: reject AI assistance, use it with verification, or delegate fully to the AI. Within participants, post-interaction trust strongly predicted the user's delegation choices (OR=14.97, 95% CI [7.14,31.37]). Trust and delegation nevertheless remained distinct. Verification was the dominant policy and often co-occurred with high trust. Delegation also increased with task order after adjustment for momentary and participant-level trust (OR=1.22, 95% CI [1.02,1.45]), indicating an experience-related component that self-reported trust ratings alone could not capture. These findings motivate a shift from intended delegation to a non-intrusive observation of how delegation is enacted in collaborative human-AI tasks. We therefore conclude by proposing enacted delegation traces as a methodological framework for future studies of multimodal and agentic AI use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线研究 n=56 名 AI 素养参与者、392 次 Video Question Answering 试次：交互后信任强烈预测用户的委派选择（OR=14.97，95% CI [7.14,31.37]），但信任与委派并不等同，验证（verification）是主导策略且常与高信任并存。任务顺序在控制瞬时与个体信任后仍提升委派（OR=1.22，95% CI [1.02,1.45]），说明存在自评信任捕捉不到的经验成分；作者据此提出以 enacted delegation traces（实际委派痕迹）作为未来多模态与 agentic AI 研究的方法学框架。
Motivation: 多模态 AI 成为日常思考伙伴后，用户如何把控制权转移给系统成为紧迫问题，但现有研究多依赖自评的委派意图，无法捕捉实际协作中被实施的委派行为。
Method: 在线研究，n=56 名 AI 素养参与者完成 392 次 Video Question Answering 试次；每次查看多模态 AI 回答后评任务特定信任，并为类似未来任务三选一策略：拒绝 AI、带验证使用、完全委派。用组内（within-participants）统计建模信任对委派选择的预测，并在控制瞬时与个体信任后检验任务顺序效应。
Result: 交互后信任强烈预测委派选择，OR=14.97，95% CI [7.14,31.37]；任务顺序在调整信任后仍与委派正相关，OR=1.22，95% CI [1.02,1.45]；验证为主导策略且常与高信任共现；样本 n=56，392 次 VQA 试次。
Conclusion: 信任与委派是可分离的构念，自评信任不足以刻画委派行为，未来研究应从“意图委派”转向非侵入式观察实际实施的委派痕迹（enacted delegation traces）。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Agentic-Priors: Using Large Language Models to Address the Cold Start Problem in Preference Elicitation
papers.abstract_en: An agent that learns a user's preferences from their choices faces a cold start problem: before any choices are observed, it must rely solely on a prior. Informative priors are usually fitted to historical choice data, which new tasks and deployments lack. To address this, we present Agentic-Priors, which lets agentic systems use the implicit knowledge of large language models (LLMs) instead. Specifically, an LLM states a new user's trade-offs in interpretable terms, such as willingness to pay or value of time, which we map to a prior over multinomial logit coefficients. This prior is then refined by a Bayesian learner as choices are observed. Across seven choice datasets, Agentic-Priors improves cold start accuracy over an uninformed prior by 5-40 percentage points. It also outperforms AutoElicit, a state-of-the-art LLM prior-elicitation method, on three datasets and loses on one. It is up to 18 points more accurate than in-context learning, and never significantly worse. Against hierarchical Bayes models fitted to surveys of increasing size, our approach is worth roughly 6-40 surveyed users, in terms of log-loss, so its value is concentrated in a deployment's first users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Agentic-Priors 让 LLM 用可解释量（支付意愿、时间价值）表述新用户的权衡，再映射为多项 logit 系数的先验，由 Bayesian learner 随观测选择不断细化，从而绕开偏好 elicitation 的冷启动。在七个选择数据集上，冷启动准确率比无信息先验高 5–40 个百分点，比 in-context learning 最多高 18 个百分点且从不显著更差，对分层 Bayes 模型约值 6–40 个受访用户。
Motivation: 偏好学习的智能体在观察到任何选择前只能依赖先验，而信息性先验要靠历史选择数据拟合，新任务和新部署没有这类数据，冷启动阶段无先可用。
Method: 由 LLM 以支付意愿、时间价值等可解释术语陈述新用户的权衡，将其映射为多项 logit (multinomial logit) 系数上的先验；观测到选择后由 Bayesian learner 迭代细化该先验。
Result: 在七个选择数据集上，冷启动准确率比无信息先验提高 5–40 个百分点；在三个数据集上胜过 SOTA 的 LLM 先验 elicitation 方法 AutoElicit、在一个数据集上落败；比 in-context learning 最多高 18 个百分点且从不显著更差；按 log-loss 折算，价值约相当于 6–40 个受访用户的分层 Bayes 模型（随调查规模增大而变化）。
Conclusion: LLM 隐含知识可充当冷启动先验，其价值集中在部署的最初几个用户，随用户选择积累而被 Bayesian learner 吸收。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flow-CLIP: Image-Conditioned Residual Scoring for CompositionalImage-Text Matching
papers.abstract_en: Vision--language pre-training has enabled substantial progress in image--text retrieval and zero-shot recognition by learning transferable cross-modal representations. However, sentence-level alignment remains insufficient for compositional matching, where captions can describe the same objects and attributes while differing in how these elements are bound. To address this limitation, we propose Flow-CLIP, which refines global image-text alignment through image-conditioned changes in token--patch evidence. Global Compatibility Calibration (GCC) learns a sentence-level similarity metric, while Image-Conditioned Evidence Refinement (ICER) incorporates visual patch context into token queries and uses the resulting change in local matching evidence to adjust the global score. We further introduce Cross-Image Margin Ranking (CIMR), which compares the same positive--negative caption pair across matched and mismatched images, encouraging a larger ranking margin when the image supports the correct description. Experiments on compositional matching and attribute--object binding benchmarks show that Flow-CLIP improves binding accuracy over pretrained CLIP and learned global alignment through local evidence refinement, while cross-image ranking supervision mitigates reliance on language priors. Code will be released at link.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Flow-CLIP 用图像条件下的 token–patch 证据变化来修正 CLIP 的句子级相似度：GCC 学句级度量，ICER 把视觉 patch 上下文注入 token query 并用局部匹配证据的变化调整全局分数，CIMR 跨图像比较同一正负 caption 对以扩大排序间隔。在组合匹配与属性–物体绑定基准上，绑定准确率相对预训练 CLIP 与学习式全局对齐提升，跨图像排序监督降低对语言先验的依赖。
Motivation: 句子级对齐无法区分元素相同但绑定方式不同的 caption，导致组合式图文匹配失效。
Method: 三个组件：Global Compatibility Calibration (GCC) 学习句级相似度度量；Image-Conditioned Evidence Refinement (ICER) 将视觉 patch 上下文并入 token query，用局部匹配证据的变化调整全局分数；Cross-Image Margin Ranking (CIMR) 在匹配与不匹配图像上比较同一正负 caption 对，鼓励图像支持正确描述时更大的排序间隔。
Result: 在组合匹配与属性–物体绑定基准上，绑定准确率相对预训练 CLIP 和学习式全局对齐提升；跨图像排序监督减轻对语言先验的依赖。
Conclusion: 用图像条件的局部证据变化修正全局分数，配合跨图像排序监督，可以改善 CLIP 系模型的组合式绑定并削弱语言先验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Lagrangian Structure of Cost-Penalized Active Feature Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) sequentially selects features to maximize predictive accuracy under an acquisition budget. A natural heuristic greedily maximizes Expected Information Gain minus a cost penalty, EIG(j|x_S)-lam*c_j (EIG-Cost), but its theoretical guarantees are unclear. We provide an a-posteriori certificate decomposing the gap to the optimal hard-budget policy into a budget-slack term and a greedy-suboptimality term Del_lam. The certificate is computable when the penalized optimum is tractable; on small heterogeneous-cost instances, we verify it exactly, finding Del_lam near zero across 4,000 solved cases. On the large clinical task, Del_lam is not computable, so the decomposition is diagnostic rather than a numerical guarantee. Our analysis identifies EIG-Cost as one-step greedy optimization of the Lagrangian relaxation of expected-cost AFA, with lam as its dual multiplier. For equal costs, we prove Del_lam <= exp(-gam*I(Y;X_[d])), where gam is the submodularity ratio, yielding a structural guarantee in the near-submodular regime. Supporting results establish an adaptive chain-rule identity showing that cumulative stepwise EIG optimizes transcript information, and prove that A -> I(Y;X_A) need not be submodular, even for jointly Gaussian variables. This rules out a direct Nemhauser-Wolsey-Fisher bound; naive Bayes restores submodularity. We also bound the randomization gap between hard-budget and expected-cost optima, analyze sensitivity to dual-multiplier error under local smoothness, and derive a conditional CVAE generator-shift bound given a bound on forward predictive KL. We treat this KL as a diagnostic quantity, not as a transform of training loss. Experiments cover synthetic Gaussian settings, AFA benchmarks, and clinical differential diagnosis on MIMIC-IV. On MIMIC-IV, EIG-Cost achieves macro-F1 0.180 +/- 0.012 at a $30 budget, using 6.6% of full-panel cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 EIG-Cost 贪心策略识别为期望成本 AFA 的拉格朗日松弛的一阶贪心优化，lam 即其对偶乘子，并给出分解为预算松弛项与贪心次优项 Del_lam 的后验证书。等成本情形下证明 Del_lam ≤ exp(-gam·I(Y;X_[d]))（gam 为 submodularity ratio），同时证明 A→I(Y;X_A) 即使对联合高斯变量也不必次模，故 Nemhauser-Wolsey-Fisher 直接界不适用，朴素贝叶斯可恢复次模性。在 MIMIC-IV 临床鉴别诊断上，EIG-Cost 在 30 美元预算（全面板成本的 6.6%）下 macro-F1 为 0.180±0.012。
Motivation: AFA 常用 EIG 减成本惩罚的贪心启发式，但其理论保证不清：既缺少到最优硬预算策略的可计算差距证书，也不知道信息增益对特征集合的次模性是否成立。
Method: 将 EIG-Cost 解释为期望成本 AFA 拉格朗日松弛的单步贪心，lam 为对偶乘子；把与最优策略的差距分解为预算松弛项与贪次优项 Del_lam，在可解的惩罚最优处精确验证。另给出自适应链式法则恒等式（累积逐步 EIG 优化 transcript information）、对偶乘子误差的局部光滑敏感性分析，以及给定前向预测 KL 上界的条件 CVAE generator-shift 界。
Result: 在 4,000 个已求解的小规模异成本实例上 Del_lam 近乎为零；大型临床任务上 Del_lam 不可计算，分解仅作诊断。等成本下证得 Del_lam ≤ exp(-gam·I(Y;X_[d]))。实验覆盖合成高斯设定、AFA 基准与 MIMIC-IV 临床鉴别诊断：MIMIC-IV 上 EIG-Cost 在 30 美元预算、占全面板成本 6.6% 时 macro-F1 为 0.180±0.012。
Conclusion: EIG-Cost 的保证应通过拉格朗日对偶与 submodularity ratio 来刻画，而非假设次模性；A→I(Y;X_A) 的非次模性（联合高斯即反例）排除了直接套用 Nemhauser-Wolsey-Fisher 界，朴素贝叶斯是恢复次模的条件。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: BridgeAfford: Bridging Query-Target Gap for Generalizable 3D Affordance Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Language-guided 3D affordance grounding aims to localize functional regions on 3D objects according to interaction intents. However, existing methods exhibit poor generalization to unseen objects. One challenge is the query-target gap: a semantic discrepancy between query features encoding interaction intents and target-region features, leading to inaccurate grounding. End-to-end training favors query representations tailored to seen objects, limiting their compatibility with shifted target-region features on unseen objects. To address this issue, we propose BridgeAfford, a framework that reduces the query-target semantic gap from two complementary perspectives. First, Interaction Region Alignment (IRA) promotes cross-object alignment among geometrically similar interaction regions during training. This enables structures on unseen objects that resemble previously observed ones to produce representations similar to those learned during training, facilitating target-region recognition. Second, Visual Evidence Aggregation (VEA) leverages a 2D affordance model to refine the attention distribution and guide the query toward the correct region, yielding more target-aware queries. Extensive experiments on the LASO and PIAD datasets demonstrate that BridgeAfford outperforms existing methods, particularly on unseen objects, highlighting its robust generalization ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BridgeAfford 针对语言引导 3D affordance 定位在未见物体上的泛化差问题，从查询-目标语义鸿沟两端入手：IRA 在训练中对几何相似的交互区域做跨物体对齐，使未见物体上相似结构产生接近训练期的表示；VEA 借助 2D affordance 模型细化注意力分布、把查询导向正确区域。在 LASO 与 PIAD 数据集上超过现有方法，且在未见物体上优势尤其明显。
Motivation: 端到端训练让查询表示过拟合已见物体，与未见物体上偏移的目标区域特征不兼容，导致交互意图查询与目标区域特征之间存在语义鸿沟，定位不准、对未见物体泛化差。
Method: BridgeAfford 含两个互补模块：Interaction Region Alignment (IRA) 在训练期对几何相似的交互区域做跨物体表示对齐；Visual Evidence Aggregation (VEA) 用 2D affordance 模型细化注意力分布，生成更具目标感知的查询。
Result: 在 LASO 与 PIAD 数据集上，BridgeAfford 超过现有方法，在未见物体 (unseen objects) 上提升尤其突出，展示出较强的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 缩小查询与目标区域的语义鸿沟——跨物体区域对齐加视觉证据聚合——是提升 3D affordance 定位对未见物体泛化的有效路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CodeHealth Predicts the Token Cost of Agentic Code Review: A Pre-Registered Study of 465 Agent-Authored Pull Requests
papers.abstract_en: Context: Organizations increasingly delegate code review to multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines billed per token. Low code quality raises human maintenance effort, but its effect on agent review cost has not been measured. Objective: We test whether baseline CodeHealth predicts the token cost of agentic review and fix beyond pull request (PR) footprint. Method: In a pre-registered observational study, we sampled 465 agent-authored PRs from 246 repositories in AIDev, jointly stratified by CodeHealth and footprint under repository caps. A frozen five-agent review-and-fix pipeline processed every PR with three different LLMs. Per LLM, we fitted a mixed model of log tokens on CodeHealth and log PR footprint, with a repository random intercept. Results: For all three LLMs the CodeHealth coefficient was negative, with 95% CI excluding zero; each CodeHealth point was associated with 3.5% to 6.1% lower token cost. CodeHealth was unrelated to PR footprint, so PR size does not explain the association. Two of three registered smells predicted fix cost; batch fixing left median CodeHealth unchanged. Exploratory analyses located the association in the review stage, where agents iterated more on unhealthy code without writing more comments. Adjusting for the size of the scored files absorbed the association, which we interpret as mediation by file size. Conclusions: A quality metric calibrated against human maintainability also predicts the inference cost of multi-agent review and fix. The effect is modest per point and not carried by PR size, so the refactoring case extends to agent-reviewed code when it changes structure and file size, not only the score. Data Availability: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22127920
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CodeHealth 基线分数能预测多智能体代码评审与修复的 token 成本，且这一关联独立于 PR 体量：在 465 个 AIDev 智能体编写 PR、冻结的五智能体流水线与三种 LLM 上，CodeHealth 每高 1 分对应 token 成本低 3.5%–6.1%（95% CI 不含零）。关联集中在 review 阶段——智能体在不健康代码上迭代更多但评论数不变——按被评分文件大小调整后被吸收，作者解释为文件大小的中介作用。
Motivation: 按 token 计费的多智能体 LLM 代码评审流水线中，低代码质量已知抬高人工维护成本，但它对智能体评审与修复的推理成本的影响此前没有被测量。
Method: 预注册观察性研究：从 AIDev 的 246 个仓库按 CodeHealth 与 PR 体量联合分层抽样 465 个智能体编写 PR（设仓库上限）；冻结的五智能体 review-and-fix 流水线用三种不同 LLM 各处理一遍；对每个 LLM 拟合 log token 对 CodeHealth 与 log PR footprint 的混合模型，仓库设随机截距。
Result: 三种 LLM 的 CodeHealth 系数均为负且 95% CI 不含零，CodeHealth 每 1 分对应 token 成本降低 3.5%–6.1%；CodeHealth 与 PR footprint 不相关，故 PR 大小不能解释该关联；注册的三种 smell 中有两种预测 fix 成本；批量修复后 CodeHealth 中位数不变；探索性分析把关联定位在 review 阶段（迭代更多、评论数不变），按被评分文件大小调整后关联被吸收。
Conclusion: 对人类可维护性校准的质量指标同样预测多智能体评审与修复的推理成本，但每分效应不大且不由 PR 大小携带——重构的理由应落在改变结构与文件大小上，而不只是分数本身。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: CodeHealth 基线分数能预测多智能体代码评审与修复的 token 成本，且这一关联独立于 PR 体量：在 465 个 AIDev 智能体编写 PR、冻结的五智能体流水线与三种 LLM 上，CodeHealth 每高 1 分对应 token 成本低 3.5%–6.1%（95% CI 不含零）。关联集中在 review 阶段——智能体在不健康代码上迭代更多但评论数不变——按被评分文件大小调整后被吸收，作者解释为文件大小的中介作用。

summary_sections.method: 预注册观察性研究：从 AIDev 的 246 个仓库按 CodeHealth 与 PR 体量联合分层抽样 465 个智能体编写 PR（设仓库上限）；冻结的五智能体 review-and-fix 流水线用三种不同 LLM 各处理一遍；对每个 LLM 拟合 log token 对 CodeHealth 与 log PR footprint 的混合模型，仓库设随机截距。
summary_sections.result: 三种 LLM 的 CodeHealth 系数均为负且 95% CI 不含零，CodeHealth 每 1 分对应 token 成本降低 3.5%–6.1%；CodeHealth 与 PR footprint 不相关，故 PR 大小不能解释该关联；注册的三种 smell 中有两种预测 fix 成本；批量修复后 CodeHealth 中位数不变；探索性分析把关联定位在 review 阶段（迭代更多、评论数不变），按被评分文件大小调整后关联被吸收。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对人类可维护性校准的质量指标同样预测多智能体评审与修复的推理成本，但每分效应不大且不由 PR 大小携带——重构的理由应落在改变结构与文件大小上，而不只是分数本身。

papers.title: Learning Rewards in Strategic Games
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the objectives that drive agents' behavior is crucial in strategic environments, where multiple agents interact and adapt to one another. This challenge arises in domains such as cybersecurity, autonomous driving, and online markets, where agents' underlying incentives are typically unknown and must be inferred from their observed behavior. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) provides a natural framework for this problem, but extending IRL to strategic multi-agent settings introduces a fundamental challenge: a reward that explains observed behavior does not necessarily induce optimal strategies when used for decision-making. In this work, we study this problem through the lens of \emph{strategic identifiability}, and show that learning from a fixed policy pair can be insufficient to strategically identify rewards, independent of the number of expert samples $K$. Motivated by this, we introduce an active IRL algorithm for two-player repeated Stackelberg games, in which the leader adaptively selects policies to elicit informative responses about the follower's reward. Combining maximum-likelihood estimation with experimental design, we derive finite-sample guarantees on the Stackelberg sub-optimality induced by the learned reward, matching up to polylogarithmic factors a new minimax learning rate of $K^{-1/2}$. Finally, we evaluate our approach in a realistic anti-poaching setting, demonstrating the benefits of active exploration for reward recovery and downstream strategic performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在两人重复 Stackelberg 博弈中证明：仅从固定策略对学习奖励无法实现策略可识别 (strategic identifiability)，与专家样本数 K 无关；据此提出由 leader 主动选择策略以诱导 follower 信息性响应的主动 IRL 算法，把最大似然估计与实验设计结合，得到 Stackelberg 次优性界，匹配（差 polylog 因子）新的 minimax 学习率 K^{-1/2}。
Motivation: 多智能体战略环境中激励未知需从行为反推，但能解释观测行为的奖励用于决策时未必诱导最优策略；固定策略对采样即使 K 再大也不足以识别奖励。
Method: 以 strategic identifiability 为分析框架，先给出固定策略对的不可识别性结论，再提出主动 IRL：leader 自适应挑选策略以获取 follower 奖励的信息性响应，结合最大似然估计与实验设计 (experimental design) 推导有限样本保证。
Result: 证明固定策略对学习在任意 K 下都可能不足；主动算法给出的 Stackelberg 次优性有限样本界，匹配（至多 polylog 因子）新的 minimax 学习率 K^{-1/2}；并在贴近现实的反偷猎 (anti-poaching) 设定中展示主动探索对奖励恢复与下游战略表现的收益。
Conclusion: 奖励要用于战略决策就必须按可诱导最优策略的标准来识别，而主动选择探测策略是达到 K^{-1/2} minimax 速率的关键。

papers.title: CoWorld Reasoner: Agentic Multimodal Reasoning with the Evolving Video World Model-Driven Harness
papers.abstract_en: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) advance, they are increasingly expected to perform spatiotemporal reasoning over motion, actions, and view changes beyond what the input images show. Video World Models (VWMs) provide a natural unified engine for visual imagination by generating task-relevant visual content as additional evidence. However, existing approaches typically invoke a VWM through fixed pipelines centered on a predefined form of visual imagination, such as novel-view synthesis. To support flexible visual imagination for diverse reasoning tasks, we introduce CoWorld Reasoner, an agentic framework that uses a VWM as a unified visual reasoning engine. Its Video World Model-Driven Harness exposes multiple visual operations through tools and uses skills to guide the VLM in deciding whether to imagine, selecting an operation, constructing a generation request, and interpreting the resulting visual evidence. We further introduce VLM-VWM Harness Co-Evolution, which jointly revises tools, skills, and execution code based on execution feedback while keeping both model weights fixed. Across seven benchmarks spanning spatial intelligence, temporal and causal reasoning, and perceptual reasoning, CoWorld Reasoner outperforms direct reasoning with the same VLM. The strongest variant improves on all seven benchmarks, including relative accuracy gains of 11.8% on MMSI and 13.0% on ERQA, and outperforms all five evolving baselines using the same backbone across five benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CoWorld Reasoner：把视频世界模型 (Video World Model, VWM) 作为可调用的视觉想象引擎，由 VWM-Driven Harness 暴露多种视觉操作工具，引导 VLM 决定是否想象、选哪种操作、构造生成请求并解读生成的视觉证据。在七个空间智能、时序因果与感知推理基准上超过同一 VLM 直接推理，最强变体在全部七个基准上提升，MMSI 相对增益 11.8%、ERQA 13.0%。
Motivation: 现有方法调用 VWM 时依赖固定流水线和预定义的想象形式（如 novel-view synthesis），难以适配多样化的时空推理任务。
Method: VWM-Driven Harness 通过工具暴露多种视觉操作，用 skills 引导 VLM 完成想象决策、操作选择、生成请求构造与证据解读；VLM-VWM Harness Co-Evolution 在两个模型权重均冻结的前提下，依据执行反馈联合修订工具、skills 与执行代码。
Result: 在七个基准（覆盖 spatial intelligence、temporal and causal reasoning、perceptual reasoning）上均优于同一 VLM 直接推理；最强变体在全部七个基准上提升，MMSI 相对准确率增益 11.8%，ERQA 13.0%，并在五个基准上超过五个使用相同 backbone 的 evolving baselines。
Conclusion: 把 VWM 作为由 harness 编排、可随执行反馈共同演化的视觉推理引擎，比固定想象流水线和直接推理更能释放 VLM 的时空推理能力。

papers.title: The Tilted Sampling Problem: Optimism, Posterior Sampling, and Logarithmic Regret
papers.abstract_en: Many modern learning systems are used not to select a single best action, but to sample diverse high-quality outputs. Examples include entropy-regularized reinforcement learning, RLHF, and reward-guided generative modeling. Motivated by these settings, we study tilted sampling: an online learning problem in which the goal is to sample from the Gibbs distribution induced by an unknown reward function. We define sampling regret as the temperature-normalized cumulative KL divergence between the learner's distribution and the Gibbs target, corresponding to the suboptimality gap in entropy-regularized reward maximization. Our framework generalizes recent sampling-based and KL-regularized formulations in bandits and reinforcement learning. Our main contribution is a general regret framework that captures the different uncertainty structure of tilted sampling and classical regret minimization. While standard regret scales as $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ due to first-order uncertainty, sampling regret is governed by squared confidence widths, yielding logarithmic-in-$T$ regret in standard settings at fixed temperature. We develop sampling analogues of UCB and Thompson sampling (UCS and TS$^2$) and provide unified regret decompositions that explain and extend recent logarithmic guarantees, including the first Bayesian sampling-regret decomposition based on new bounds for posterior-random Gibbs distributions. Our results show that learning to sample from a soft-optimal distribution is statistically distinct from learning to identify a hard optimum.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把「从未知奖励的 Gibbs 分布采样」形式化为 tilted sampling，并定义 sampling regret 为学习者分布与 Gibbs 目标之间温度归一化的累积 KL 散度。由于不确定性以置信宽度的平方进入，固定温度下 sampling regret 是 log T 级而非经典 regret 的 √T 级；据此给出 UCB 与 Thompson sampling 的采样版 UCS 和 TS²，并给出统一 regret 分解。
Motivation: 熵正则 RL、RLHF 与奖励引导生成模型需要采样多样高质量输出，而非选单一最优动作；经典 regret 分析针对识别硬最优，其一阶不确定性结构不适用于按 Gibbs 分布采样的目标。
Method: 定义温度归一化累积 KL 的 sampling regret，推广 bandits 与 RL 中基于采样和 KL 正则的表述；提出 UCS 与 TS² 两个采样版算法，配套统一 regret 分解，并基于对 posterior-random Gibbs 分布的新界给出首个 Bayesian sampling-regret 分解。
Result: 标准 regret 因一阶不确定性为 Õ(√T)，而 sampling regret 由置信宽度的平方控制，在固定温度的标准设定下为 log T 级；结果统一并扩展了近期的对数级保证。
Conclusion: 从 soft-optimal 分布学习采样在统计上不同于识别硬最优，其不确定性结构决定了对数级而非根号级的 regret。

papers.title: Seeing is Believing: Benchmarking and Mitigating the Interference of Language Priors on Visual Perception in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Language priors in MLLMs can override visual evidence, impairing visual perception. Existing benchmarks assume shared priors across models and rely solely on accuracy. However, cross-model prior agreement falls below 80%, and over 15% of items can be answered correctly without any image, causing accuracy to overestimate prior resistance. To address these limitations, we introduce ViSiP-Bench, a benchmark grounded in rare-but-real scenarios across six prior categories, with a model-aware dynamic prior induction protocol and three metrics that more precisely and continuously measure prior resistance than accuracy alone. Evaluating 24 models reveals that prior adherence is pervasive, does not improve with scale, and larger models tend to either strongly override their priors or firmly adhere to them. We therefore propose MAPS, which identifies each model's strongest priors and fine-tunes on factually grounded knowledge to soften excessive prior reliance without disrupting general capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MLLM 中语言先验会压过视觉证据，而只看准确率会高估模型的抗先验能力：跨模型先验一致率低于 80%，超过 15% 的题目不看图也能答对。为此提出 ViSiP-Bench（六类先验、模型感知的动态先验诱导协议、三个连续指标）评测 24 个模型，发现先验依附普遍存在且不随规模改善；再用 MAPS 找出每个模型最强先验并在事实性知识上微调，软化过度先验依赖且不破坏通用能力。
Motivation: 现有基准假设各模型共享先验且只用准确率打分，导致准确率高估模型的抗先验能力，无法区分真正依赖视觉还是靠语言先验猜对。
Method: 提出 ViSiP-Bench：覆盖六类先验、基于罕见但真实场景的题目，配模型感知的动态先验诱导协议 (model-aware dynamic prior induction protocol) 和三个比准确率更精细连续的抗先验指标；再提出 MAPS，先定位每个模型最强的先验，再在事实性知识 (factually grounded knowledge) 上微调以软化过度先验依赖。
Result: 跨模型先验一致率低于 80%；超过 15% 的题目完全不看图也能答对。对 24 个模型的评测显示先验依附普遍存在，且不随模型规模改善，更大的模型倾向于要么强烈覆盖先验、要么牢牢依附先验。
Conclusion: 准确率不能作为抗先验能力的可靠度量，先验依附是跨规模的普遍现象；针对模型自身最强先验做事实性微调是缓解过度先验依赖的路径。

papers.title: In-Context Learning Before Specialisation: Theory of Learning in a Solvable Topic Model
papers.abstract_en: Sequence models can generalise in fundamentally distinct ways: extrapolating structures seen in training, or using their prompt to adapt to novel tasks. The prevailing strategy determines how the model behaves beyond its training distribution, controlling potential capabilities and risks. Recent work has characterised many different strategies theoretically, and empirically described the transition between them as the quality and quantity of pretraining data vary. However, there is no learning theory for this competition, hence no fundamental understanding of \textit{why} one solution might be favoured over another. Here we provide such a theory in a solvable topic model---documents drawn from a finite mixture of latent topics, mirroring the heterogeneity of modern pretraining data. The dataset comes with two distinct solutions: a specialised predictor, that stores the finite topic mixture, and an in-context one, optimal for topics never seen during training. Our theory predicts their emergence at distinct sample complexities: the in-context predictor is available early, while the specialised one emerges only after the training tokens outnumber the parameters of the data-generating process. Trained transformers reproduce both scales and the separating crossover in remarkable agreement with the theory, with no fitted parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在可解 topic model（文档来自有限隐主题混合）中给出外推式特化与 in-context learning 竞争的学习理论：in-context 解在小样本阶段即可出现，特化解要等训练 token 数超过数据生成过程的参数量之后才浮现，训练出的 transformer 无拟合参数地复现了这两个尺度及其间的 crossover。
Motivation: 序列模型在训练分布外是外推已见结构还是靠 prompt 适应新任务，取决于主导策略；已有工作刻画了多种策略并经验描述了随预训练数据质量与数量的转变，但缺少解释为何某解胜出的学习理论。
Method: 在文档由有限隐主题混合生成的可解 topic model 中分析两类解：存储有限主题混合的 specialised predictor，以及对训练中未见主题最优的 in-context predictor；从理论推出两者的样本复杂度尺度，并用训练 transformer 对照检验。
Result: 理论预测两个解在不同样本复杂度出现：in-context predictor 早期即可用，specialised predictor 仅在训练 token 数超过数据生成过程参数量后出现；训练出的 transformer 以无拟合参数的方式与理论的两个尺度及分隔它们的 crossover 高度吻合。
Conclusion: 外推与 in-context 两种泛化策略的竞争可由学习理论解释，其分界由训练 token 数相对数据生成过程参数量的比值决定。
