summary_sections.motivation: 序列模型在训练分布外是外推已见结构还是靠 prompt 适应新任务，取决于主导策略；已有工作刻画了多种策略并经验描述了随预训练数据质量与数量的转变，但缺少解释为何某解胜出的学习理论。
summary_sections.method: 在文档由有限隐主题混合生成的可解 topic model 中分析两类解：存储有限主题混合的 specialised predictor，以及对训练中未见主题最优的 in-context predictor；从理论推出两者的样本复杂度尺度，并用训练 transformer 对照检验。
summary_sections.result: 理论预测两个解在不同样本复杂度出现：in-context predictor 早期即可用，specialised predictor 仅在训练 token 数超过数据生成过程参数量后出现；训练出的 transformer 以无拟合参数的方式与理论的两个尺度及分隔它们的 crossover 高度吻合。
summary_sections.conclusion: 外推与 in-context 两种泛化策略的竞争可由学习理论解释，其分界由训练 token 数相对数据生成过程参数量的比值决定。

papers.title: Self-Calibrated Subspace Robust PCA for Parameter-Free Removal of Mixed Noise and Line Stripes in Hyperspectral Images
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) are often corrupted by Gaussian noise, impulses and stripes whose intensities vary across bands. The representative coefficient correlated total variation (RCCTV) model restores HSIs efficiently, but it lacks Gaussian and stripe terms, and its noise-aware extensions require the noise level and a stripe budget to be specified in advance. This article proposes a self-calibrated RCCTV (SC-RCCTV) model, in which the noise parameters are estimated adaptively during the iterations. A band-wise dense term and line-constant column and row stripe terms are introduced into RCCTV. The noise level of each band is initialized by a stripe-invariant median absolute deviation estimator and refined online from the residual, which turns the separation of sparse and dense noise into a band-adaptive Huber loss, and the stripe thresholds follow from a significance test whose false-alarm rate can be predicted analytically. No parameter is tuned for a specific image, and every subproblem of the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) solver is solved in closed form. Under line stripes, SC-RCCTV outperforms the parameter-free FastHyMix by 8.17 dB on native-size cubes, and, without any noise information, it exceeds S3TTV, which is given the true noise parameters, by 1.52 dB while running more than 1,900 times faster. On average, it stays within 0.01 dB of the same model given the true noise levels, and its online calibration improves on a two-stage estimate-then-denoise scheme. Experiments on real Indian Pines and Urban data further delineate its scope for stripes that do not span entire lines.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible. Code: https://github.com/haha2345/SC-RCCTV
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自校准 RCCTV (SC-RCCTV) 高光谱去噪模型：在 RCCTV 中加入逐波段稠密噪声项与行列线状条纹项，噪声参数在 ADMM 迭代中在线估计，无需为单幅图像调参。在线条纹条件下比参数自由的 FastHyMix 高 8.17 dB；在不给任何噪声信息时超过拿到真实噪声参数的 S3TTV 1.52 dB，且快 1,900 倍以上。
Motivation: RCCTV 模型缺少高斯噪声与条纹项，其噪声感知扩展需事先给定噪声水平与条纹预算，无法应对噪声强度随波段变化的高光谱图像混合噪声。
Method: 在 RCCTV 中加入 band-wise 稠密项与 line-constant 行列条纹项；各波段噪声水平用条纹不变的中位数绝对偏差 (MAD) 初始化，再从残差在线细化，把稀疏/稠密噪声分离转成逐波段自适应 Huber 损失；条纹阈值由虚警率可解析预测的显著性检验给出；所有 ADMM 子问题闭式求解。
Result: 线条纹下在原尺寸数据立方上比参数自由的 FastHyMix 高 8.17 dB；不给任何噪声信息时比拿到真实噪声参数的 S3TTV 高 1.52 dB，且速度快 1,900 倍以上；平均与给定真实噪声水平的同模型相差 0.01 dB 以内；在线校准优于先估计后去噪的两阶段方案；在真实 Indian Pines 与 Urban 数据上检验了条纹不贯穿整行时的适用范围。
Conclusion: 噪声参数可以完全在迭代中自校准而无需逐图调参，SC-RCCTV 在条纹场景下同时取得更高 PSNR、更快速度与免调参特性，但对不贯穿整行的条纹适用范围有限。

papers.title: SurgStreamer: proactive, request-driven monitoring of surgical video streams with structured state and a reusable reasoning layer
papers.abstract_en: Surgical teams could benefit from assistants that watch the video for requested events, such as "tell me when the clip applier appears during Calot triangle dissection", and answer questions about what has already happened. We formalise this task as request-driven event detection with exact semantics and causal alert decisions, and present SurgStreamer. It separates procedure-specific perception, which maps the 1-FPS stream to a structured state over tools, actions and phases, from procedure-agnostic reasoning, which evaluates a formal monitoring condition over this state and an event memory, either with exact rules or with a small controller that addresses entities through pointers rather than names. We evaluate this monitoring core with gold conditions. On a pre-registered, sealed test set of 12 laparoscopic cholecystectomies, SurgStreamer reached a macro event-F1 of 0.598 over full procedures. On identical 75-s windows with only the window available to every method, it scored 0.677. The tested configurations of the streaming vision-language model OneStreamer-4B, including ones fine-tuned on SurgStreamer's state or on video with an adapted vision encoder, scored at most 0.540 (Holm-adjusted p <= 0.012). At three external centres, re-training only perception raised performance on held-out procedures from 0.239 to 0.470. On a new procedure, pituitary surgery, controller weights trained on cholecystectomy matched an in-domain controller on oracle state (0.947 vs 0.938). On predicted state they missed the pre-registered non-inferiority margin (-0.024 [-0.040, -0.008]) unless the alert thresholds were re-calibrated. The results support separating perception from reasoning and point to perception under distribution shift as the main limitation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SurgStreamer 把手术视频监控拆成两层：过程相关的感知层把 1-FPS 视频流映射为工具/动作/阶段的结构化状态，过程无关的推理层用形式化监控条件加事件记忆做因果告警。在 12 例预注册密封测试的腹腔镜胆囊切除上，全程 macro event-F1 达 0.598，75 秒窗口上 0.677，而流式 VLM OneStreamer-4B 各配置最高仅 0.540（Holm 校正 p ≤ 0.012）。
Motivation: 手术团队希望助手按请求盯住特定事件（如 Calot 三角分离时出现吻合器即提醒）并回答已发生什么，但现有流式视觉语言模型在整段手术的事件检测上语义不精确、告警不具因果性。
Method: SurgStreamer 分离 procedure-specific 感知（1-FPS 流 → 工具/动作/阶段结构化状态）与 procedure-agnostic 推理（对状态与事件记忆求值形式化监控条件），推理可用精确规则或以指针寻址实体的小型 controller；监控核心用 gold conditions 评估，在预注册密封测试集上与 OneStreamer-4B（含在 SurgStreamer 状态或改写视觉编码器的视频上微调的配置）对比。
Result: 12 例腹腔镜胆囊切除全程 macro event-F1 0.598，相同 75 秒窗口上 0.677；OneStreamer-4B 各测试配置最高 0.540（Holm 校正 p ≤ 0.012）。三个外部中心仅重训感知层使 held-out 手术从 0.239 升到 0.470。新术式垂体手术上，胆囊切除训练的 controller 权重在 oracle state 上 0.947 vs 域内 0.938；在 predicted state 上差 -0.024（[-0.040, -0.008]）未过预注册非劣界，除非重标定告警阈值。
Conclusion: 感知与推理分离是可取的架构，跨术式迁移推理层可行；主要瓶颈是分布偏移下的感知，且跨术式告警需重标定阈值才能达标。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Graph Dirichlet Energy for Fitting-Free Bivariate Causal Inference
papers.abstract_en: We propose the Graph Dirichlet Energy Causal Inference (GDECI) criterion for distinguishing cause from effect in bivariate settings. For a candidate direction $X\to Y$, we construct a kernel similarity graph from $X$ and treat $Y$ as a graph signal. The score is the Dirichlet energy of this signal, induced by the unnormalized graph Laplacian. The reverse score swaps the variables, and the lower-energy direction is inferred as causal. The method requires neither regression fitting nor independence testing. After the empirical probability integral transform, its decisions are invariant under strictly monotone transformations of either variable, and the graph operations reduce to convolutions, allowing exact evaluation in $O(n\log n)$ time and $O(n)$ memory. At the population level, GDECI compares degree-weighted Bayes squared prediction errors plus a non-negative smoothness term of the regression function. As the bandwidth tends to zero, the weights become uniform and the smoothness term vanishes, reducing the criterion to a RECI-type comparison of expected conditional variances in copula space. Empirically, we compare GDECI with QCCD, GRCI, CAM, IGCI (two variants), RESIT, LOCI, QPE-k, and RECI (two variants), in accuracy on 1899 cause--effect pairs and in inference speed. GDECI ranked fifth of eleven methods in macro-averaged accuracy on 12 synthetic suites ($0.776$). On the real-world Tuebingen pairs, it ranked third in unweighted accuracy ($0.684$) and fifth in weighted accuracy ($0.678$). It was also the fastest of the compared methods up to $n\approx10^{4}$. The accompanying code repository: https://github.com/povidanius/gdeci.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无拟合的双变量因果方向判据 GDECI：由 X 构核相似图、把 Y 当图信号，取未归一化图拉普拉斯诱导的 Dirichlet 能量，能量更低的方向判为因果。经验概率积分变换后对任一变量的严格单调变换不变，图运算化为卷积，可在 O(n log n) 时间、O(n) 内存精确求值；在 1899 对因果数据上 11 种方法中 12 个合成套件宏平均准确率排第五 (0.776)，Tuebingen 真实对未加权准确率第三 (0.684)、加权第五 (0.678)，且在 n≈10^4 以内最快。
Motivation: 双变量因果发现中基于回归拟合或独立性检验的方法计算重、且对变量的单调重参数化不稳健，需要一个无需拟合、可精确快速求值的方向判据。
Method: GDECI 对候选方向 X→Y 由 X 构建核相似图，将 Y 视为图信号，用未归一化图拉普拉斯诱导的 Dirichlet 能量打分，反向交换变量取能量更低者；先做经验概率积分变换 (empirical PIT)，图运算化为卷积。总体层面该判据比较度加权的 Bayes 平方预测误差加回归函数的非负平滑项，带宽趋于零时权重均匀、平滑项消失，退化为 copula 空间中 RECI 型条件方差比较。
Result: 在 1899 个 cause-effect pairs 上与 QCCD、GRCI、CAM、IGCI (两个变体)、RESIT、LOCI、QPE-k、RECI (两个变体) 共 11 种方法比较：12 个合成套件宏平均准确率 GDECI 排第五 (0.776)；Tuebingen 真实对未加权准确率第三 (0.684)、加权准确率第五 (0.678)；推理速度在 n≈10^4 以内为最快。复杂度为 O(n log n) 时间、O(n) 内存。
Conclusion: 图 Dirichlet 能量可以作为无需回归拟合与独立性检验的双变量因果方向判据，在中等规模数据上以最高推理速度换取中游准确率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anvil: Scaling Embodied Spatial Intelligence through Knowledge Recirculation
papers.abstract_en: Embodied spatial intelligence requires more than visual recognition: models must localize entities, reason about their relations, and express this knowledge in action-relevant forms. Yet joint training can conflate the knowledge needed at different stages because supervision is fragmented across incompatible geometric and semantic outputs. We introduce Anvil, a unified framework for data generation, training, and benchmarking for embodied spatial intelligence. (1) Anvil-Gen is a heterogeneous data flywheel that combines form-specific generation, cross-stage consistency verification, and failure-driven recollection across 11 Ground--Relation--Act forms. (2) Anvil-Ben provides scene-aligned supervision for learning diverse embodied spatial capabilities and scene-linked assessments that distinguish stage competence from error propagation. (3) Anvil-MOPD is a 9B student that consolidates heterogeneous spatial knowledge through distillation from specialist teachers. Semantic-first-fault routing targets teacher supervision to the student's earliest decisive failure, while stage normalization controls the loss scale across native outputs of different lengths. We construct 5.8M source-grounded records spanning 160K images, reserving 580K spatial records for held-out evaluation and using the remaining 5.22M records for training. On average across seven public benchmarks, Anvil-MOPD outperforms Qwen3.5-9B and RynnBrain-8B by 9.29 and 11.03 percentage points, respectively, while reaching 80.67% on VABench-Point. Controlled studies support targeted coverage, selective transfer, and feedback-guided repair as complementary framework components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Anvil 把具身空间智能的数据生成、训练与评测统一成闭环：Anvil-Gen 在 11 种 Ground–Relation–Act 形式上做异构数据飞轮（含跨阶段一致性校验与失败驱动回采），Anvil-MOPD 用语义优先故障路由蒸馏把知识并入 9B 学生。在七个公开基准上平均比 Qwen3.5-9B 高 9.29 个百分点、比 RynnBrain-8B 高 11.03 个百分点，VABench-Point 达 80.67%。
Motivation: 监督信号分散在互不兼容的几何与语义输出上，联合训练会把不同阶段所需的知识混为一谈，无法区分阶段能力与误差传播。
Method: Anvil-Gen 组合形式特定生成、跨阶段一致性校验与失败驱动 recollection，覆盖 11 种 Ground–Relation–Act 形式；Anvil-Ben 提供场景对齐监督与可区分阶段能力的场景关联评测；Anvil-MOPD 通过专家教师蒸馏整合异构空间知识，用 semantic-first-fault routing 把教师监督对准学生最早的关键失败，并以 stage normalization 平衡不同长度原生输出的损失尺度。构建 5.8M 源接地记录（160K 图像），580K 留作评测、5.22M 用于训练。
Result: 在七个公开基准上平均：Anvil-MOPD 比 Qwen3.5-9B 高 9.29 个百分点，比 RynnBrain-8B 高 11.03 个百分点；VABench-Point 上达到 80.67%。受控实验支持 targeted coverage、selective transfer 与 feedback-guided repair 三个组件互补。
Conclusion: 把数据生成、场景对齐监督与故障定向蒸馏组成闭环，可以在 9B 规模上整合异构空间知识并稳定提升跨阶段具身空间能力。

papers.title: Learning Lean Feedback for Efficient Proof-Candidate Evaluation on GPUs
papers.abstract_en: Training language models for formal theorem proving requires large numbers of verifier calls. Slow checks and timeouts often leave GPUs waiting and withhold rewards from potentially correct proofs. We train neural evaluators to predict Lean 4 verdicts and compiler feedback on GPUs using 4.84M labelled programs. We compare two validity classifiers with a feedback model that annotates proof attempts with predicted goal states and error messages. A two-stage evaluator that screens candidates with a classifier and scores its positive predictions with the feedback model reaches 87.8% accuracy in predicting whether Lean accepts a candidate proof, evaluated on a 68,932-program benchmark collected from public provers. The combined evaluator processes 3.5 candidates per second on one H100, 4.2x the throughput of our 64-worker Lean baseline with environment reuse. Finally, we combine our evaluator with Lean verdicts to obtain a hybrid reward system that shortens GRPO training steps by approximately 31%. After one GRPO epoch with hybrid rewards, the prover achieves nearly the same miniF2F pass@1 as with Lean-only rewards (62.2% versus 62.4%) and a pass@32 of 72.4% versus 71.3%.
papers.comment: 23 pages (9 main), 4 figures, 11 tables. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding (VeriCodeGen)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 4.84M 条带标签的 Lean 4 程序训练神经评估器，替代定理证明训练中的慢速验证器调用：两阶段评估器先用分类器筛掉无效候选，再用反馈模型给正例打分，在 68,932 程序基准上预测 Lean 是否接受候选的准确率达 87.8%，单张 H100 吞吐 3.5 候选/秒，是 64-worker Lean 基线（含环境复用）的 4.2 倍。与 Lean 判定混合的奖励使 GRPO 训练步缩短约 31%，一个 epoch 后 miniF2F pass@1 为 62.2%（纯 Lean 奖励 62.4%），pass@32 为 72.4%（对 71.3%）。
Motivation: 形式定理证明的强化学习训练需要海量验证器调用，Lean 检查慢且常超时，GPU 空等，潜在正确证明也拿不到奖励。

Conclusion: 神经评估器加 Lean 判定的混合奖励能在几乎不损失 miniF2F 成绩的前提下大幅削减验证开销，把 GPU 从等待验证器中解放出来。

papers.title: Optical Coherent Combining in Multi-Aperture Free-Space Receivers through Atmospheric Turbulence via Optically Computed Alignment Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Multi-aperture reception converts spatial diversity into a coherent-combining gain, but only if the relative phase and polarization of the collected field replicas are aligned before they are summed. In a satellite-to-ground downlink the atmosphere perturbs amplitude, phase and polarization, so the alignment must track a fluctuating channel rather than a fixed offset. This paper proposes a new optical-domain combining scheme in which the alignment information is computed by light itself: the ascent directions that maximize the combined output power are formed by optical interference and read out directly as differential photocurrents of balanced detection, so no estimate of the channel, no deliberate perturbation, and no per-branch digital processing is needed to obtain them. Every branch is aligned against one shared reference - a passive tap of the combined field itself - so no independent laser or optical frequency lock is required, and the update directions of all branches are available simultaneously in a single averaging window without frequency, code, or time multiplexing. The data path needs a single dual-polarization coherent receiver regardless of the aperture count, and the readout is built from elementary parts only - a 3 dB directional coupler, static phase shifters, a Faraday rotator, and balanced photodiodes - so no 90-degree optical hybrid, mixer, or polarization-diverse hybrid is required. The phase and polarization loops are fixed-gain and division-free, and each branch carries one phase modulator and one polarization controller with no amplitude actuator. A closed-form combining-gain and loss budget is derived, the assumptions and limitations of the scheme are stated explicitly, and experimental validation remains open.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Working preprint: theory and architecture only; no experimental results included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种光域计算的多孔径自由空间接收相干合成方案：用光干涉本身生成使合成输出功率最大的上升方向，直接以平衡探测的差分光电流读出，从而无需信道估计、故意扰动或逐支路数字处理。所有支路对合成场的同一无源抽头做对齐，单个平均窗口内同时给出全部更新方向；作者给出闭式合成增益与损耗预算，并明确说明该方案目前仅为理论与架构，实验验证仍待完成。
Motivation: 卫星-地面下行链路中大气扰动幅度、相位与偏振，多孔径合成必须跟踪时变信道；现有对齐依赖信道估计、逐支路数字处理或独立激光/光学锁频，开销随孔径数增长。
Method: 光域合成方案：由光干涉形成使合成输出功率最大的上升方向，经平衡探测读为差分光电流；每支路对合成场的无源抽头这一共享参考对齐，数据通路只需单个双偏振相干接收机（与孔径数无关），读出仅用 3 dB 定向耦合器、静态移相器、Faraday rotator 与平衡光电二极管，不用 90° 光学混频器或偏振分集混频器；相位与偏振环路为固定增益、无除法，每支路仅一个相位调制器与一个偏振控制器、无幅度执行器。
Result: 推导出闭式合成增益与损耗预算 (combining-gain and loss budget)，并显式陈述方案的假设与限制；arXiv comment 标注为 9 页 5 图的工作预印本，仅含理论与架构，无实验结果，实验验证仍待完成。
Conclusion: 对齐信息可以完全在光域算出并同时读出，使多孔径接收的合成开销不随孔径数增长；但该结论目前建立在理论推导之上，实验验证是作者留下的开放问题。

papers.title: Provably Efficient Risk-Sensitive Offline Reinforcement Learning via Optimized Certainty Equivalents
papers.abstract_en: Risk-sensitive reinforcement learning (RL) addresses decision-making under uncertainty and adverse outcomes. Learning risk-sensitive policies from fixed datasets is important when additional interaction with the environment is costly. Existing work on risk-sensitive RL focuses on online settings or specific risk measures, leaving a general theoretical understanding of its offline setting underdeveloped. In this work, we investigate efficient offline risk-sensitive RL using the optimized certainty equivalent (OCE), a general class of risk measures. We consider two formulations: dynamic-OCE RL, which applies OCE recursively at each step, and static-OCE RL, which applies a single OCE to the cumulative rewards. Under the tabular setting, we develop pessimistic value-iteration algorithms for both formulations and establish tight sublinear suboptimality bounds, explicitly capturing how risk sensitivity, encoded by utility functions, affects learning difficulty. Moreover, we establish minimax suboptimality lower bounds to characterize the problem's fundamental limits. To handle large state spaces, we further develop pessimistic least-squares value-iteration algorithms that incorporate the general OCE risk criterion into linear function approximation. We establish utility-dependent sublinear guarantees with explicit dependence on the feature dimension $d$. To our knowledge, we provide the first offline algorithms along with the first upper and lower suboptimality bounds for both dynamic- and static-OCE RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定数据集上做 OCE（optimized certainty equivalent）风险敏感强化学习，提出表格设定的悲观值迭代与线性函数逼近下的悲观最小二乘值迭代，覆盖 dynamic-OCE（逐步递归）与 static-OCE（对累积奖励单次施加）两种形式，并给出紧的次线性次优性上下界，界中显式含效用函数与特征维度 d。作者称这是两类 OCE 离线 RL 的首个算法及首个上下界。
Motivation: 风险敏感 RL 的既有工作集中在在线设定或特定风险度量，离线设定下的一般理论理解不足；而环境交互昂贵时只能从固定数据集学策略。
Method: 以 OCE 这一通用风险度量类为对象，分 dynamic-OCE（每步递归施加）与 static-OCE（对累积奖励施加一次）两种形式；表格设定下设计悲观值迭代算法，大状态空间下把通用 OCE 风险准则并入线性函数逼近的悲观最小二乘值迭代 (pessimistic least-squares value iteration)。
Result: 表格设定给出紧的次线性次优性上界，显式刻画效用函数编码的风险敏感度如何影响学习难度；并建立 minimax 次优性下界刻画问题的根本极限；线性函数逼近下给出效用相关的次线性保证，显式依赖特征维度 d。
Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是 dynamic-OCE 与 static-OCE 离线 RL 的首个算法以及首个次优性上下界，风险敏感度通过效用函数进入学习难度的显式刻画。

papers.title: Lethe: Link Inference Attacks For Evaluation of Edge Unlearning Methods
papers.abstract_en: Graph Unlearning (GU) aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a Graph Neural Network without retraining anew. While most methods address removal of nodes and features, Edge Unlearning (EU), aiming at forgetting edges, has recently attracted dedicated attention as a standalone problem due to the hardness of completely removing the impact of an edge in the model. Despite this, no dedicated benchmark for EU exists besides isolated evaluations on feature-rich datasets such as Cora and Citeseer where GNNs exploit node features rather than graph structure. As such, we show two systematic limitations in existing evaluations: dedicated EU methods can be slower than retraining anew, and accuracy metrics are uninformative due to the negligible impact of edge removal. To address this gap, we introduce Lethe, the first comprehensive benchmark for Edge Unlearning, featuring 15 methods and 8 datasets. Our benchmark emphasizes large graphs, introduces evaluation tasks of varying difficulty, and proposes empirical measures based on link inference attacks rather than proxy accuracy metrics. We provide a comprehensive empirical analysis, demonstrate the shortcomings of current evaluations, and release Lethe as a reproducible, extensible benchmark.
papers.comment: Accepted at NEURIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Lethe 是首个边遗忘 (Edge Unlearning) 基准，含 15 个方法与 8 个数据集，用基于链接推断攻击 (link inference attacks) 的经验度量替代代理精度指标。它揭示现有评测的两个系统性缺陷：专用 EU 方法可能比从头重训更慢，且精度指标因边移除影响可忽略而失去信息量。
Motivation: 现有 EU 评测只在 Cora、Citeseer 这类特征丰富数据集上零散进行，GNN 主要依赖节点特征而非图结构，导致精度指标无法反映边移除效果，且缺少专用基准。
Method: 构建覆盖 8 个数据集（强调大图）的基准，纳入 15 种遗忘方法，设计不同难度的评测任务，并提出基于链接推断攻击的经验度量来取代代理精度指标。
Result: 揭示两个系统性局限：专用 EU 方法可能慢于从头重训练；精度指标因边移除影响可忽略而无信息量。
Conclusion: 边遗忘的评测应转向链接推断攻击式度量并以大图为重心，现有基于特征丰富小图的精度评测不足以衡量遗忘效果。

papers.title: From Sketch to Scene: Relightable Garment Reconstruction from Marked Sketches
papers.abstract_en: Sketching is one of the most natural ways for people to express visual ideas. Unlike the text prompts that most generative systems rely on today, a sketch captures spatial structure and intent directly, including where a designer wants highlights and shadows to appear. Yet current sketch-to-3D pipelines have no input for that intent: they bake the drawn shading into the texture as dark paint, and the light cannot be moved. We propose a system that transforms a rough garment sketch, marked with sparse annotations (a star for a highlight and a moon for a shadow), and a short text prompt describing the texture, into a textured 3D mesh with an explicit directional light, as a scene that can be relit and edited after generation. The two symbols are the most frequent proposals in an elicitation study with art students. From the marked sketch the system predicts the scene's directional light and, separately, a displacement field that bends the surface so that the moon-marked regions fall into shadow under that light, rather than being painted dark in the texture.

TL;DR: 该系统把带稀疏标记（星号=高光、月牙=阴影）的粗略服装草图加一句纹理文本提示，重建为带显式方向光的可重打光 3D 网格：方向光由草图预测，位移场单独弯曲表面，使月牙区域在该光照下自然落入阴影，而非把阴影烘进贴图。星号与月牙是艺术生启发式调研中出现频率最高的两个标记提案。
Motivation: 现有 sketch-to-3D 流程把画出的明暗当作深色颜料烘焙进纹理，光源无法移动，设计师关于高光与阴影位置的意图没有输入通道。
Method: 输入为带稀疏符号标记的服装草图与描述纹理的短文本提示；系统分别预测场景的方向光和一个使月牙标记区域在该光照下落入阴影的表面位移场，输出带显式方向光的带纹理 3D 网格，可在生成后重新打光与编辑。两个标记符号来自面向艺术生的 elicitation study。
Result: 在艺术生的 elicitation study 中，星号（高光）与月牙（阴影）是出现频率最高的两个标记提案；系统输出可重打光的带纹理 3D 网格，阴影由几何位移而非贴图深色实现。
Conclusion: 把光照意图作为草图上的显式符号输入并分离光照与几何，可让生成的服装场景在事后重新打光和编辑，而不是被烘焙的明暗锁死。

papers.title: Seeing Both the Forest and the Trees: Reusing Holistic 3D Priors for Part-Decomposed Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating 3D assets with explicit parts requires two properties at once: geometric detail inside each part and structural coherence across the whole object. Recent image-conditioned 3D generation models adopt a structured 3D representation that anchors tokens to explicit spatial positions, capturing both properties, but their output remains a single fused mesh. We ask how a part-decomposed generation model can inherit both properties of these holistic priors, and answer with STRUCTPARTS, a framework whose core technical contribution is a dual-frame coordinate interleaving mechanism: each shape latent is interpreted under both a part-local and an object-global reference frame, and processed through a global-local inter-leaved transformer that simultaneously reuses the prior's geometric detail at the part scale and its structural coherence at the whole-object scale. As its structural input, STRUCTPARTS uses a segmented mesh scaffold, a coarse mesh paired with a face-level segmentation mask kept entirely within the prior's native 3D representation. With only lightweight finetuning, both intra-part detail and inter-part coherence emerge from the same pretrained weights. On PartObjaverse-Tiny, STRUCTPARTS matches or surpasses prior part-decomposed models at a fraction of their training cost, while naturally supporting part-mesh refinement and part-level editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STRUCTPARTS 用双坐标系交错机制 (dual-frame coordinate interleaving) 让部件分解式 3D 生成复用整体先验：每个 shape latent 同时在部件局部与物体全局参考系下解释，经 global-local interleaved transformer 处理，结构输入为带面级分割掩码的粗网格 scaffold。轻量微调后部件内部细节与部件间一致性同时涌现，在 PartObjaverse-Tiny 上以远低于同类方法的训练成本达到或超过既有部件分解模型。
Motivation: 图像条件的结构化 3D 生成先验能同时捕捉部件内几何细节与整体结构一致性，但输出是单一融合网格；如何让部件分解模型继承这两项性质此前没有答案。
Method: 核心为 dual-frame coordinate interleaving：shape latent 在 part-local 与 object-global 两个参考系下分别解释，送入 global-local interleaved transformer；结构输入用 segmented mesh scaffold，即粗网格加面级分割掩码，全程保持在先验原生 3D 表示内；仅做轻量微调 (lightweight finetuning)。
Result: 在 PartObjaverse-Tiny 上，STRUCTPARTS 达到或超过既有部件分解模型，而训练成本只是其一小部分 (a fraction of their training cost)，并原生支持 part-mesh refinement 与 part-level editing。
Conclusion: 整体 3D 先验的细节与结构一致性可以通过双坐标系交错在同一组预训练权重中被部件分解生成同时复用，无需重训。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Temporal Periodic Image Registration with Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have recently gained popularity for their ability to model functions using simple and lightweight networks. These methods have also proven effective in deformable image registration. In this work, we extend INRs for deformable image registration to the domain of temporal image registration, focusing on periodic temporal image sequences. Our approach, Temporal-IDIR, optimizes a single INR to model deformations across all frames in a temporal image sequence simultaneously, allowing for self-regularization through its own deformation predictions. To achieve this, we introduce a temporal consistency loss that penalizes discrepancies between direct source-to-target transformations and those traversing intermediate frames. We evaluate our framework on the DIR-LAB dataset, using the target registration error (TRE) between annotated and moved landmarks as the metric. Here, we achieve a TRE of 1.03 mm, outperforming other INR-based registration methods. Additionally, our framework supports smooth interpolation between time frames by estimating deformations between the given input frames. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/MMLowes/Temporal_INR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Temporal-IDIR 用单个 INR 同时建模周期性时序图像序列所有帧之间的形变，靠自身形变预测做自正则，并引入时间一致性损失惩罚直接源到目标变换与经中间帧变换之间的差异。在 DIR-LAB 上以标注 landmark 的目标配准误差 (TRE) 评测，达到 1.03 mm，优于其他基于 INR 的配准方法，且可在给定帧之间平滑插值形变。
Motivation: INR 形变配准通常只处理成对图像，周期性时序序列需要跨全部帧一致的形变场，逐对配准会丢掉帧间的时间一致性。
Method: 优化单个 INR 同时表示时序序列所有帧的形变，实现基于自身形变预测的自正则；新增 temporal consistency loss，惩罚直接 source-to-target 变换与经中间帧传递变换之间的差异；在 DIR-LAB 上用标注 landmark 的 TRE 评测。
Result: 在 DIR-LAB 上 TRE 为 1.03 mm，优于其他 INR-based registration 方法；框架可在给定输入帧之间估计形变，支持帧间平滑插值。
Conclusion: 把周期时序配准压进单个带时间一致性约束的 INR，能在 DIR-LAB 上取得 1.03 mm TRE 并顺带获得帧间形变插值能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Physics-Aware Distillation of a Grid Foundation Model for Real-Time Edge Inference
papers.abstract_en: Grid foundation models (GridFMs) are graph transformers pretrained on a masked power-flow objective, and evaluate power flow orders of magnitude faster than an iterative solver. Their size, however, targets data-centre inference, whereas low-inertia operation increasingly asks for inference at the edge, next to the measurement, at batch size one and within a single synchrophasor (PMU) reporting frame. We distil a 20.1M-parameter, 12-layer GridFM teacher into a 0.62M-parameter, 6-layer student, a $32.5\times$ parameter reduction at half the message-passing depth, using an objective that combines the masked power-flow loss with output, physics-residual, latent-state and attention transfer. The physics-residual term, which matches the teacher's power-residual profile, has not previously been applied to typed power-grid graphs. We evaluate on a renewable variant of the IEEE 118-bus benchmark grid in which 26 of the conventional (synchronous) generators are replaced by inverter-based renewables with battery flexibility and standardised reactive-power limits (IEEE 1547), giving $97\,529$ physically valid (AC-OPF-feasible) operating scenarios, and we ablate all eight combinations of the transfer terms, reporting accuracy against ground truth and fidelity to the teacher separately. Distillation lowers student error on all four predicted quantities, by up to $48\%$ on active-power dispatch, and every distilled student is more accurate than its teacher on reactive-power dispatch. The gain is largely carried by the output matching term. The physics-residual term, in the layer-aggregated form used here, is consistently harmful, which we attribute to the spatial averaging it applies to a bus-level residual field. The resulting student is $32.5\times$ smaller in parameter count and has half the message-passing depth, making it a candidate for subsequent edge-device benchmarking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 20.1M 参数、12 层的电网基础模型 (GridFM) 蒸馏成 0.62M 参数、6 层的学生模型，蒸馏目标在 masked power-flow 损失之上叠加输出匹配、物理残差、隐状态与注意力迁移。在含 26 台同步机被新能源替换的 IEEE 118-bus 可再生变体、97,529 个 AC-OPF 可行场景上，四个预测量误差全部下降，有功功率调度误差最多降 48%，且每个蒸馏学生在无功调度上都比教师更准；但层聚合形式的物理残差项一致有害，收益主要由输出匹配项承担。
Motivation: GridFM 以图 Transformer 做 masked power-flow 预训练，推理比迭代求解器快若干数量级，但体量面向数据中心；低惯量运行要求在测量侧、batch size 1、单个 PMU 上报帧内完成边缘推理。
Method: 教师为 20.1M 参数、12 层 GridFM，学生 0.62M 参数、6 层（参数缩减 32.5×，消息传递深度减半）；蒸馏目标 = masked power-flow 损失 + 输出匹配 + 物理残差（匹配教师权残差剖面，首次用于 typed power-grid graphs）+ 隐状态迁移 + 注意力迁移，并对五个迁移项的全部八种组合做消融，分别报告对真值的精度与对教师的保真度。评测用 IEEE 118-bus 的可再生变体，26 台同步机替换为带电池灵活性与 IEEE 1547 标准化无功限值的逆变器电源，共 97,529 个 AC-OPF 可行运行场景。
Result: 蒸馏使学生在全部四个预测量上误差下降，有功功率调度误差最多降低 48%；每个蒸馏学生在无功功率调度上都比其教师更准确。八组合消融显示收益主要由输出匹配项承担，而层聚合形式的物理残差项一致有害，作者归因于它对母线级残差场做了空间平均。
Conclusion: 输出匹配是有效蒸馏的主导项，而层聚合的物理残差迁移在 typed power-grid 图上反而损害精度；32.5× 更小、深度减半的学生可作为边缘设备基准测试的候选。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Local Epochs as Optimal Stopping: Theory and Evidence in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: How long should each client train before communicating? Federated learning usually answers with a fixed, hand-tuned number of local epochs, yet an extra epoch helps only while the loss it removes outweighs the client drift it adds. We cast local training as finite-horizon optimal stopping: a client trains while the next epoch's expected loss reduction exceeds its priced squared drift. We prove that this one-stage look-ahead threshold is optimal whenever stopping decisions are nested, derive closed forms for geometric and power-law returns, and show that an estimated rule loses utility only through wrong-signed decisions. Epoch-level evidence supports the model's structure (geometric diminishing returns and additive drift) and reveals a simple regularity: the stage of training, not the client, sets the budget. The resulting rule, FedStop, is never more than one point below tuned FedAvg in mean accuracy. Where its budgets vary, it raises worst-decile accuracy by 4-8 points over tuned FedAvg and an adaptive-interval baseline, and every one of these gains remains significant after a Holm correction. Against the client-side stopping rules ALT and FLASH, it has the highest CIFAR-10 worst decile on every seed and is level elsewhere. It stays stable where per-client early stopping collapses, and each stopping decision takes constant time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把联邦学习的本地训练轮数建模为有限时域最优停止问题：客户端在下一 epoch 的期望损失下降低于其定价平方漂移时停止通信。FedStop 在 CIFAR-10 上平均精度距调好超参的 FedAvg 不超过 1 个点，但在预算有差异处把最差十分位精度抬高 4–8 个点，且经 Holm 校正后仍显著。
Motivation: 联邦学习通常靠手工调固定本地 epoch 数，但额外一个 epoch 只在其消除的损失大于其引入的客户端漂移时才有益，固定预算无法对不同训练阶段区别对待。
Method: 将本地训练写成有限时域最优停止：训练持续到下一 epoch 的期望损失下降低于其定价平方漂移；证明一步前瞻阈值在停止决策嵌套时最优，导出几何回报与幂律回报下的闭式解，并给出估计规则 FedStop。
Result: FedStop 平均精度距调好的 FedAvg 不超过 1 个点；在预算变化处相对调好的 FedAvg 与自适应间隔基线把最差十分位精度提高 4–8 个点，全部增益经 Holm 校正后仍显著；对比客户端侧停止规则 ALT 与 FLASH，在每个 seed 上 CIFAR-10 最差十分位最高、其余持平；每步停止决策耗时常数级。
Conclusion: 决定预算的是训练阶段而非客户端身份，一步前瞻阈值规则能在不牺牲平均精度的前提下稳定抬高最差十分位精度，并在逐客户端早停失效处保持稳定。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: FedStop 平均精度距调好的 FedAvg 不超过 1 个点；在预算变化处相对调好的 FedAvg 与自适应间隔基线把最差十分位精度提高 4–8 个点，全部增益经 Holm 校正后仍显著；对比客户端侧停止规则 ALT 与 FLASH，在每个 seed 上 CIFAR-10 最差十分位最高、其余持平；每步停止决策耗时常数级。
summary_sections.conclusion: 决定预算的是训练阶段而非客户端身份，一步前瞻阈值规则能在不牺牲平均精度的前提下稳定抬高最差十分位精度，并在逐客户端早停失效处保持稳定。

papers.title: Compiling Multi-Threshold Operators for Quantized Non-Monotonic and Fine-Granular Activations in Custom-Tailored DNN Accelerators
papers.abstract_en: Aggressive quantization of neural networks can expose activation functions as bottlenecks for efficient hardware acceleration. Implementing quantized activations as multi-threshold operations has been shown to be a promising optimization, allowing for efficient hardware implementation of few-bit activations. However, current implementations are limited to monotonically increasing functions, quantization schemes with one-dimensional (per-channel) granularity and a small set of predefined activation-quantizer combinations. We formalize the multi-threshold representation to extend it to non-monotonic functions and fine-granular parameters, i.e., multi-dimensional thresholds. For automated conversion of quantized function compositions into threshold representation, we propose a systematic approach via algebraic rules integrated into the ONNX-based compiler infrastructure. We experimentally validate our solution on a selection of monotonic and non-monotonic functions by extending the binary search based multi-threshold operator that is integrated into the FINN framework for end-to-end synthesis of custom-tailored FPGA accelerators. The cost of hardware support for non-monotonicity and fine-granularity is characterized in comparison to an alternative approach utilizing existing operators via graph-level decomposition. We compare our method to prior work as well as the approach taken by the hls4ml framework. As an outlook, we demonstrate the prospects of using the multi-threshold representation during the training of a neural network as a form of quantization aware training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多阈值 (multi-threshold) 量化激活算子的形式化表示从单调函数、per-channel 一维阈值扩展到非单调函数与多维细粒度阈值，并用一组代数规则在 ONNX 编译器基础设施中自动把量化函数复合转换为阈值表示。在 FINN 的二分搜索多阈值算子上实验验证单调与非单调函数，并刻画支持非单调性与细粒度的硬件代价，对比图级分解方案、已有工作与 hls4ml。
Motivation: 激进量化下激活函数成为硬件加速瓶颈，而现有多阈值实现只支持单调递增函数、per-channel 一维量化粒度和少量预定义激活-量化器组合，限制了可用激活族与量化方案。
Method: 将多阈值表示形式化推广到非单调函数与多维阈值参数；提出基于代数规则的系统化自动转换方法，集成进 ONNX 编译器基础设施；在 FINN 框架的二分搜索多阈值算子上做端到端 FPGA 加速器综合的实验验证，并与图级分解这一替代路径比较硬件代价。
Result: 在一组单调与非单调函数上实验验证方案可行性；刻画了支持非单调性与细粒度相对图级分解（用现有算子）的硬件代价；与已有工作及 hls4ml 框架的实现路径做了对比；并演示了在神经网络训练中用多阈值表示做量化感知训练 (quantization aware training) 的前景。
Conclusion: 多阈值表示可以系统化地覆盖非单调激活与细粒度量化参数，通过编译器代数规则自动转换即可在 FINN 这类 FPGA 加速器综合流程中落地，且其硬件代价可与图级分解方案权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Closed Form Depth-Width Law for Neural Collapse in Deep Linear Networks
papers.abstract_en: How depth and width of neural networks shape learned representations is usually studied only after training. We show that, in a tractable feature-learning setting, this dependence can instead be obtained in closed form. Using neural collapse as a probe of representation geometry, we express NC1--NC3 directly in terms of the learned feature kernel, extending an identity known for NC1 to the angular part of NC2 and to NC3 under a ridge readout. For deep linear networks with exchangeable class structure, the resulting kernel equations yield a geometric law, exact within the theory, for the layerwise evolution of within-class variability. At large width, the accumulated compression becomes a function of the depth-to-width ratio $L/N$, with its rate determined self-consistently by the data, prior and architecture. Numerical experiments support the derived dependence on depth, width and signal-to-noise ratio. The result is a representation-level scaling law derived from feature-learning theory rather than fitted after training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在可解的特征学习设定下，把 neural collapse 的 NC1–NC3 直接写成学到的特征核 (feature kernel) 的函数，对深线性网络推出类内变异性逐层演化的闭式几何律：大宽度下累积压缩只依赖深度-宽度比 L/N，压缩速率由数据、先验与架构自洽决定。数值实验支持该依赖对深度、宽度和信噪比 (SNR) 的形式。
Motivation: 深度与宽度如何塑造学到的表征通常只能在训练结束后经验研究，缺少训练中即可写出的解析刻画。
Method: 以 neural collapse 为表征几何探针，把 NC1–NC3 用学到的特征核表达：将已知的 NC1 恒等式推广到 NC2 的角度部分，并在 ridge readout 下处理 NC3；对具有可交换类结构 (exchangeable class structure) 的深线性网络求解核方程，得到类内变异性的逐层几何律，并做数值实验检验。
Result: 大宽度下累积压缩化为深度-宽度比 L/N 的函数，其速率由数据、先验和架构自洽确定；该律在理论内精确。数值实验支持推导出的对深度、宽度和信噪比 (SNR) 的依赖。
Conclusion: 表征层面的深度-宽度标度律可以由特征学习理论直接导出，而非训练后拟合得到。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring the local shape of learning-rate transfer curves
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the learning-rate (LR) dependence of trained model performance is essential for better optimization of neural networks, but the appropriate size of the LR depends on learning dynamics, architecture, and their hidden biases, and thus our understanding of this complex dependence remains limited. The behavior of the loss curve as a function of the LR has recently been observed in extensive experiments on LR transfer across different settings, such as model sizes, and it is becoming more important to explore methodologies for quantitatively characterizing the shape of this LR curve. In this work, we provide two relational equations that give a good empirical explanation of the gradient of the LR transfer curve, i.e., the LR gradient. One is a theoretical formula that holds at the edge of stability, and the other is an approximate expression obtained by naively treating this gradient as a hyper-parameter gradient. Using these two relational equations in a complementary manner, we show a lower bound on the gradient of the curve and a zero gradient under specific conditions for normalization layers in theory. The approximate expression also applies to a wide range of experimental settings and allows us to decompose the LR gradient into layer-wise components and quantify the strong contribution of specific layers to the curve shape. Thus, this serves as a foundation for better understanding the internal mechanisms of LR dependence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出两条刻画学习率迁移曲线梯度的关系式：一条在稳定性边缘 (edge of stability) 成立的理论公式，一条把该梯度当作超参数梯度的近似表达式。二者互补地给出曲线梯度的下界，并在归一化层的特定条件下给出零梯度；近似式可把梯度分解为逐层分量，量化特定层对曲线形状的强贡献。
Motivation: 合适的学习率取决于学习动态、架构及其隐含偏置，损失随学习率变化的曲线形状缺少定量刻画手段，跨模型规模等设置的 LR 迁移实验因此难以解释。
Method: 提供两条互补的关系式：稳定性边缘处的理论公式，以及把 LR 梯度视为超参数梯度的近似表达式；用前者推导梯度下界与归一化层条件下的零梯度，用后者做逐层分解。
Result: 理论上得到 LR 迁移曲线梯度的下界，以及归一化层特定条件下的零梯度；近似表达式适用于广泛实验设置，并可将 LR 梯度分解为逐层分量，显示特定层对曲线形状贡献很强。
Conclusion: 两条关系式合起来为理解 LR 依赖的内部机制提供了基础：曲线形状可由逐层贡献定量解释，而非只靠经验调参。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: N-Gram Memories at Two Bits: Quantizing Lookup Tables in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Conditional memory expands language-model capacity through selective lookup, but the full embedding table must remain available for every possible input. We introduce Conditional Program (CP), a compressed representation that reconstructs only the rows an input requests. CP represents each row by a short code and a local scale, with a reconstruction program shared across the table. We instantiate this representation with a Gaussian trellis, norm restoration and independently decodable row records. CP's two-bit code lowers output KL by 41--63\% relative to 2-bit round-to-nearest. Analysis across three trained n-gram memory families shows that Gaussian-like coordinate statistics coexist with learned relationships among rows; at matched storage budgets, the shared trellis outperforms the fitted codebooks and low-rank residual variants we test. For DeepSeek, it reduces table storage from 203GB to 51GB, leaving room for larger workloads when the table is kept on GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Conditional Program (CP)，用短码 + 局部 scale + 共享重建程序按需重构条件记忆 (conditional memory) 的 embedding 行，实例化为 Gaussian trellis、norm restoration 与可独立解码的行记录。两比特码相对 2-bit round-to-nearest 把输出 KL 降低 41–63%，在匹配存储预算下优于所测的 fitted codebooks 与 low-rank residual 变体；DeepSeek 的表存储从 203GB 降到 51GB。
Motivation: 条件记忆靠选择性 lookup 扩大语言模型容量，但完整 embedding 表必须为所有可能输入常驻，存储开销限制了可放进 GPU 的表规模。
Method: CP 用短码加局部 scale 表示每一行，配一个全表共享的重建程序，只重构当前输入请求的行；具体实现为 Gaussian trellis、norm restoration 和可独立解码的行记录 (independently decodable row records)，在三个已训练的 n-gram memory 家族上分析坐标统计与行间关系。
Result: CP 的两比特码相对 2-bit round-to-nearest 降低输出 KL 41–63%；在匹配存储预算下，共享 trellis 优于所测试的 fitted codebooks 与 low-rank residual 变体；DeepSeek 表存储由 203GB 降至 51GB。分析显示 Gaussian 型坐标统计与行间学习到的关系并存。
Conclusion: 把条件记忆表压成共享重建程序加短码，可以在两比特量级上同时压低输出 KL 并把表留在 GPU 上，腾出容量给更大负载。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Adults to Children: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Chest X-Ray Classification under Domain Shift
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have shown significant potential across diverse fields and have been applied to medical imaging, but their robustness across patient populations remains unclear. In this work, we investigate foundation models' ability to generalize from adult to pediatric chest X-ray classification. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first benchmark to compare multiple foundation models under a common adult-to-pediatric evaluation setting while also analyzing the effect of adaptation depth. We harmonize VinDr-CXR and PediCXR into a five-label classification task and evaluate six foundation models and two CNN baselines. All models are adapted using adult data only and tested in both the in-domain and pediatric domains using linear probing, partial fine-tuning, and full fine-tuning. The benchmark reveals a clear and consistent trend: all models suffer a substantial performance degradation when transferred from adult to pediatric data, with drops exceeding 10 percentage points. While Macro-AUROC values reach approximately 92% on the adult test set, performance decreases to around 78% on the pediatric domain. Another important finding is that increasing the depth of adaptation does not significantly improve cross-population generalization. Moreover, strong in-domain performance does not translate into better performance on pediatric data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在成人到儿童胸片 (chest X-ray) 域偏移下统一评测 6 个 foundation model 与 2 个 CNN 基线：所有模型从成人迁移到儿童都出现超过 10 个百分点的性能下降，Macro-AUROC 从成人测试集约 92% 降到儿童域约 78%。加深适配深度（linear probing → partial → full fine-tuning）并不能显著改善跨人群泛化，成人域上的强表现也不预示儿童域表现。
Motivation: Foundation model 在医学影像上已被广泛使用，但跨患者人群的鲁棒性不清楚；成人数据训练的胸片分类器直接用于儿童时的域偏移缺少统一的多模型基准。
Method: 把 VinDr-CXR 与 PediCXR 统一成五标签分类任务，仅用成人数据适配 6 个 foundation model 和 2 个 CNN 基线，分别用 linear probing、partial fine-tuning、full fine-tuning 三种适配深度，在成人 in-domain 测试集与儿童测试集上评测。
Result: 所有模型从成人迁移到儿童都出现超过 10 个百分点的下降；Macro-AUROC 在成人测试集约 92%，在儿童域降到约 78%。加深适配深度对跨人群泛化无显著提升，且成人域强表现不转化为儿童域优势。
Conclusion: 跨人群泛化不能靠加大微调深度或堆高 in-domain 精度解决，成人域指标不能作为儿童域性能的代理。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.conclusion: 跨人群泛化不能靠加大微调深度或堆高 in-domain 精度解决，成人域指标不能作为儿童域性能的代理。

papers.title: RoleQ: Role-Aligned Scales for Converting Language Models to Ternary
papers.abstract_en: Weight quantization below four bits shrinks memory and bandwidth at a perplexity that looks acceptable, but often at the cost of factual knowledge and task accuracy. Ternary weights have mostly been obtained by training from scratch or long fine-tuning. We introduce RoleQ, a quantization framework that places scales by the functional roles of Transformer units rather than by the layout of the weight matrix, as conventional formats do. Vectors that read from the residual stream take one scale per output unit; those that write to it, one per input unit. The rule is structural, needs no search, calibration or stored state, and holds on integer and ternary grids. In a rotated basis it matches a per-layer axis search at half the solver work, and at ternary it cuts perplexity by up to half against layout-based placement in two families at every size from 0.6B to 14B, where per-row scales leave MMLU at chance. Our lightweight post-training pipeline converts an existing checkpoint to 1.59 bits per weight in a few GPU-hours, a fraction of the cost of learned ternarization, and leads every post-training ternary method at matched or lower memory-resident bits on perplexity, zero-shot accuracy and MMLU, most widely on knowledge. A sparse second ternary plane placed by a per-unit Fisher saliency keeps the matmul multiplication-free and recovers what ternary loses first: at 8B, a fraction of a bit returns about half the MMLU that conversion costs, well ahead of random or Hessian-based placement at equal bits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoleQ 按 Transformer 单元的功能角色（读残差流的向量按输出单元取一个 scale，写入的按输入单元取一个）放置量化 scale，无需搜索、校准或存储状态，把已有 checkpoint 转成 1.59 bits/weight 只需几 GPU-hours。在 0.6B–14B 两个模型家族上，三值下困惑度较基于布局的放置最多减半，而 per-row scale 会让 MMLU 掉到随机水平；8B 上再加一层按 Fisher saliency 放置的稀疏三值平面，用不到 1 bit 找回约一半 MMLU 损失。
Motivation: 低于 4 bit 的权重量化虽能压内存带宽且困惑度看似可接受，却常牺牲事实知识与任务精度；三值权重以往主要靠从头训练或长时间微调得到，成本高。
Method: RoleQ 按功能角色而非权重矩阵布局放置 scale：读残差流的向量每个输出单元一个 scale，写入的每个输入单元一个；规则是结构性的，无需搜索、校准或存储状态，适用于整数与三值网格。配套轻量 post-training 流水线将现有 checkpoint 转为 1.59 bits/weight，并可叠加按 per-unit Fisher saliency 放置的稀疏第二三值平面，保持 matmul 无乘法。
Result: 在旋转基下以约一半求解开销匹配 per-layer axis search；三值下在两个模型家族、0.6B 到 14B 全尺寸上困惑度较基于布局的放置最多减半，per-row scale 使 MMLU 降至随机水平。在匹配或更低的常驻 bit 下，困惑度、零样本准确率与 MMLU 上领先所有 post-training 三值方法，知识类差距最大；8B 上第二平面用不到 1 bit 找回约一半 MMLU 损失，明显优于同等 bit 的随机与基于 Hessian 的放置。
Conclusion: 按功能角色而非矩阵布局放置 scale 是无需搜索的结构性规则，能在几 GPU-hours 内把现成 checkpoint 转成 1.59-bit 三值模型并保住知识类精度；Fisher saliency 的第二平面是找回三值最先丢失的 MMLU 的高效补救。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CIM-Embed: Learning Instruction-Conditioned Multimodal Embeddings for Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal objects can require different partitions under different instructions, as when products in an e-commerce catalog are grouped by color, material, or both. Retrieval-oriented embeddings may not recover these partitions, while generative clustering often relies on intermediate descriptions or iterative decisions. This paper presents CIM-Embed, a framework for learning instruction-conditioned multimodal embeddings for clustering. Supervised contrastive learning uses same-group positives and negatives from other groups, optionally including other tasks; heterogeneous structured batches accommodate tasks with different group counts. At inference, the model maps each object's image, text, and instruction directly to an embedding; HDBSCAN then forms a partition without the ground-truth cluster count. We construct ProductMIC from product metadata in Amazon Reviews 2023, comprising training data and an evaluation benchmark for instruction-conditioned clustering. The benchmark contains 5,373 products and 449 single-attribute and compositional grouping tasks spanning 50 leaf categories excluded from our training. With full-dimensional embeddings and HDBSCAN, direct within-task SupCon training achieves a mean per-task V-measure of 95.01, compared with 53.06 for WeMM 9B, the strongest general-purpose embedding baseline evaluated. Frozen product-trained encoders also improve out-of-domain conditional grouping, while controlled transfer experiments distinguish partition transfer from instruction response. We will release the code and dataset upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CIM-Embed 用指令条件化的多模态嵌入做聚类：监督对比学习 (SupCon) 以同组为正例、他组为负例，推理时把图像、文本与指令直接映射为嵌入，再由 HDBSCAN 无需真实簇数地形成划分。在自建的 ProductMIC 基准（5,373 个商品、449 个单属性与组合分组任务）上，全维嵌入配 HDBSCAN 的任务内直接 SupCon 训练平均逐任务 V-measure 达 95.01，而最强通用嵌入基线 WeMM 9B 为 53.06。
Motivation: 同一组多模态对象在不同指令下需要不同划分（如按颜色、材质或两者组合分组），检索导向的嵌入难以恢复这些划分，生成式聚类又依赖中间描述或迭代决策。
Method: 监督对比学习以同组样本为正例、他组样本为负例，可选纳入其他任务的样本；异构结构化批次 (heterogeneous structured batches) 容纳各任务不同的组数。推理时模型将每个对象的图像、文本与指令直接编码为嵌入，再用 HDBSCAN 在不给定真实簇数的情况下形成划分。
Result: 在 ProductMIC（源自 Amazon Reviews 2023 商品元数据，5,373 个商品、449 个单属性与组合分组任务，覆盖 50 个未参与训练的叶子类目）上，全维嵌入 + HDBSCAN 的任务内直接 SupCon 训练平均逐任务 V-measure 为 95.01，对比最强通用嵌入基线 WeMM 9B 的 53.06；冻结的商品训练编码器还改善了域外条件分组。
Conclusion: 指令条件化的对比嵌入加密度聚类可以在不知道簇数的情况下直接恢复指令指定的划分，且任务内训练远强于通用嵌入基线；受控迁移实验区分了划分迁移与指令响应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Co2In: a Bi-level Memory Incremental Learning Framework with Knowledge Encoding, Consolidation, and Integration
papers.abstract_en: Incremental learning (IL) aims to continually acquire new knowledge (plasticity) while retaining previously learned information (stability). However, striking a balance between plasticity and stability remains a significant challenge for intelligent systems. The human brain achieves exceptional balance, owing to various memory units that collaboratively encode and store information. Inspired by human memory mechanisms, this paper introduces an IL framework with knowledge enCoding, Consolidation, and Integration (Co2In). Co2In is designed as a bi-level memory architecture: a working memory for adaptive knowledge acquisition and a long-term memory dedicated to the persistent retention of information. The two memory modules work cooperatively during IL. The working memory first learns from new data to encode knowledge into parameters. Subsequently, Co2In performs a consolidation process to identify underlying patterns in the learned parameters and re-express them into a compact knowledge representation. Next, the knowledge representation and the identified patterns are transformed into separate network layers and integrated into the long-term memory. These designs empower Co2In to accumulate knowledge with high plasticity and stability. We evaluate Co2In on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet under exemplar-free Class-IL and Task-IL settings. Experimental results show that Co2In achieves state-of-the-art performance with efficient memory consumption.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions On Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Co2In 提出双层记忆增量学习框架：工作记忆先从新数据把知识编码进参数，再通过 consolidation 从参数中识别潜在模式并压成紧凑知识表示，最后把表示与模式转成独立网络层并入长期记忆。在无 exemplar 的 Class-IL 与 Task-IL 设定下于 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet 上达到 state-of-the-art 性能且内存开销高效。
Motivation: 增量学习中可塑性与稳定性难以兼顾：学新类会覆盖旧知识，而现有做法常依赖存储 exemplar 或牺牲记忆容量。
Method: 双层记忆架构：工作记忆负责自适应获取新知识并把知识编码进参数；consolidation 步骤在学到的参数中识别潜在模式并重表达为紧凑知识表示；随后将知识表示与识别出的模式分别变换为独立网络层，整合进长期记忆，两模块在增量学习中协同工作。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet 的 exemplar-free Class-IL 与 Task-IL 设定下评估，取得 state-of-the-art 性能，同时保持高效的内存消耗（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 仿照人脑多记忆单元分工的编码—巩固—整合机制，可以在不存 exemplar 的条件下同时获得高可塑性与高稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Teaching DINOv3 About Partial 3D Geometry: A Self-Supervised Geometry-Aware Approach
papers.abstract_en: Partial shape matching is a crucial yet underexplored problem in 3D vision, with significant relevance to real-world scenarios where shapes are often only partially observed. Existing feature descriptors face difficulties in this setting, as traditional representations either struggle with the boundaries of partial shapes or heavily depend on the shape's spatial position. While existing approaches have employed DINO features for partial shape matching, these features are not inherently suited for handling partial observations. In this work, we propose a method to refine DINO features using LoRA-based self-supervised learning, enabling the generation of feature descriptors that are robust to partiality. Our features substantially improve performance on partial shape matching compared to traditional or vision foundation features. Additionally, when integrated into existing partial shape matching pipelines, we achieve state-of-the-art results on partial shape matching and left-right prediction benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用基于 LoRA 的自监督学习微调 DINOv3，使其特征对部分观测 (partiality) 鲁棒，用于部分形状匹配 (partial shape matching)。相比传统描述子与视觉基础模型特征，所提特征显著提升部分形状匹配性能，接入现有流程后在部分形状匹配与左右预测 (left-right prediction) 基准上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 部分形状匹配中形状常只被部分观测，传统描述子要么难以处理部分形状边界，要么严重依赖形状的空间位置；已有直接套用 DINO 特征的做法也并非为部分观测设计。
Method: 以 LoRA 对 DINOv3 做自监督微调 (self-supervised learning)，训练出对部分性鲁棒的特征描述子，再将其接入已有的部分形状匹配流程。
Result: 所提特征相比传统与视觉基础特征在部分形状匹配上性能大幅提升；接入现有流程后，在部分形状匹配与左右预测基准上取得 state-of-the-art 结果。
Conclusion: DINOv3 特征经 LoRA 自监督改造后可胜任部分观测下的几何匹配，且与既有匹配流程兼容即可刷新两项基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Causal Transfer from Human Videos to Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Scaling robot manipulation models requires large amounts of interaction data, yet collecting diverse real-robot experience remains costly. Human manipulation videos, in contrast, provide abundant and diverse task experience that could potentially benefit robot learning. However, differences in morphology, action spaces, and control mechanisms make human motions unsuitable as direct supervision for robot actions, raising a scientific question: what knowledge in human videos should be transferred across embodiments to robot manipulation? To address this question, we analyze subtask transfer through the lens of causal beams, focusing on which contextual conditions and interaction dependencies should be retained to support local task effects. Based on this perspective, we propose Causal-Beam-Guided Subtask Transfer (CBST). CBST learns manipulation-related representations from human videos and grounds them in task-level semantic variables using robot demonstrations. Within a predefined manipulation model, causal-beam constraints guide contextual information selection by requiring retained assignments to sustain local mechanism outputs while preserving nontrivial responsiveness to retained inputs. The selected semantic information conditions a world-action model, allowing the robot to generate actions from its own observations without requiring human-robot motion correspondence. Experiments on robot manipulation benchmarks show improvements in task success over the corresponding world-action model baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CBST 用因果梁 (causal beams) 筛选人类操作视频中可跨具身迁移的子任务知识：保留的上下文赋值必须支撑局部机制输出、同时对保留输入保持非平凡响应，再以此条件化 world-action 模型，让机器人直接从自身观测生成动作，无需人-机动作对应。在机器人操作基准上，任务成功率相对对应 world-action 模型基线有提升。
Motivation: 机器人操作模型需要大量交互数据，真实机器人经验采集昂贵；人类视频虽丰富，但形态、动作空间与控制机制差异使其不能直接监督机器人动作，因此需要回答人类视频中哪些知识该跨具身迁移。
Method: 提出 Causal-Beam-Guided Subtask Transfer (CBST)：从人类视频学习操作相关表征，用机器人演示将其锚定到任务级语义变量；在预定义操作模型内，以因果梁约束筛选上下文信息（保留赋值须维持局部机制输出并对保留输入保持非平凡响应），选出的语义信息条件化 world-action 模型生成动作。
Result: 在机器人操作基准上，任务成功率相对对应的 world-action 模型基线有所提升。
Conclusion: 跨具身迁移应迁移子任务级的因果上下文与语义条件，而非人类动作本身；有了因果梁筛选的语义信息，机器人可不经人-机动作对应直接从自身观测生成动作。

summary_sections.motivation: 机器人操作模型需要大量交互数据，真实机器人经验采集昂贵；人类视频虽丰富，但形态、动作空间与控制机制差异使其不能直接监督机器人动作，因此需要回答人类视频中哪些知识该跨具身迁移。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Causal-Beam-Guided Subtask Transfer (CBST)：从人类视频学习操作相关表征，用机器人演示将其锚定到任务级语义变量；在预定义操作模型内，以因果梁约束筛选上下文信息（保留赋值须维持局部机制输出并对保留输入保持非平凡响应），选出的语义信息条件化 world-action 模型生成动作。
summary_sections.result: 在机器人操作基准上，任务成功率相对对应的 world-action 模型基线有所提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 跨具身迁移应迁移子任务级的因果上下文与语义条件，而非人类动作本身；有了因果梁筛选的语义信息，机器人可不经人-机动作对应直接从自身观测生成动作。

papers.title: Single-stage joint diffusion of sky images and clear-sky index for ultra-short-term irradiance forecasting: what the frame-to-irradiance stage discards
papers.abstract_en: Sky-image irradiance forecasting is dominated by a two-stage design: a video-prediction model forecasts future sky frames, and a separately trained regressor maps those frames to irradiance. We propose a single-stage alternative that co-denoises the future sky-image and clear-sky-index sequences in one diffusion process, with an irradiance head that reads a denoised preview of the future sky rather than the noised diffusion state. The forecaster needs no regression stage and runs from sky images and deterministic covariates alone, with no measured irradiance at its input --- the situation at a site with a camera but no pyranometer. On 2023 SIRTA data the model reaches a pooled RMSE of $104.1$~W\,m$^{-2}$ and a skill score of $+0.34$ on the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) against smart persistence, higher than any of twelve baseline configurations, and retains that skill when retrained on 2021--2022. On the model's own generated frames, a separately trained regressor reaches $150.6$~W\,m$^{-2}$ against the joint head's $104.1$: roughly $46$~W\,m$^{-2}$ that joint training recovers and a cascade discards. Point accuracy is competitive but not best: a deterministic network that also reads measured irradiance attains $97.6$~W\,m$^{-2}$. The model's CRPS skill leads that network's in every sky-condition tertile, by $0.26$ to $0.30$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把未来天空图像与晴空指数 (clear-sky index) 放进同一个扩散过程联合去噪，辐照度头读取去噪后的未来天空预览而非含噪状态，从而去掉两阶段级联中的回归环节。在 2023 SIRTA 数据上 pooled RMSE 104.1 W/m²、相对 smart persistence 的 CRPS skill +0.34，高于全部 12 种基线配置；同一生成帧上单独训练的回归器只有 150.6 W/m²，即级联丢掉约 46 W/m²。
Motivation: 两阶段设计先用视频预测模型生成未来天空帧、再用独立回归器映射到辐照度，第二阶段在生成帧上重新引入误差；且有相机无辐照仪 (pyranometer) 的站点拿不到实测辐照度做输入。
Method: 单阶段联合扩散：一次去噪过程同时生成未来天空图像序列与晴空指数序列，配一个辐照度头读取去噪后的未来天空预览（而非含噪扩散状态）；推理只用天空图像与确定性协变量，不输入实测辐照度。
Result: 2023 SIRTA 上 pooled RMSE 104.1 W/m²，CRPS 相对 smart persistence 的 skill score +0.34，高于 12 种基线配置；在 2021–2022 上重训仍保持该 skill。在模型自生成帧上，单独训练的回归器 RMSE 150.6 W/m²，联合头为 104.1 W/m²，差距约 46 W/m²。点精度上，同时读取实测辐照度的确定性网络为 97.6 W/m²，更优；但本文模型的 CRPS skill 在每个天空条件三分位 (tertile) 都领先该网络 0.26–0.30。
Conclusion: 联合训练能收回级联丢掉的约 46 W/m²，且在无辐照仪站点上以天空图像加协变量即可运行；点精度不及读入实测辐照度的网络，但概率预报 (CRPS) 在各天空条件下更稳。

papers.title: MedPAO-VL: Interpretable and Protocol-Compliant Agent for Structured Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Despite the remarkable generalization capabilities of Large Language Models, generating clinically accurate and structured radiology reports from medical images remains a significant challenge. Current end-to-end approaches function as black boxes, prone to factual hallucinations and generating ungrounded findings. This lack of reliability and failure to adhere to domain-specific structuring protocols, fundamentally limits their clinical utility. We present MedPAO-VL, a multimodal agent that shifts the paradigm from monolithic generation to explainable, iterative, protocol-compliant structured report generation. Unlike deterministic models, our plan-act-observe loop functions as a goal-oriented agent: it first perceives the Chest X-Ray through an explainable vision module designed to capture inherent diagnostic uncertainty, then iteratively refines the generated report by observing semantic discrepancies and self-correcting its generation for better alignment with visually detected clinical findings. Evaluation of our framework demonstrates that this agentic reasoning improves clinical correctness and completeness, achieving an expert-rated accuracy score of 3.5/5 and a structural score of 4.3/5. By prioritizing pathology specific explainability and iterative refinement over opaque end-to-end mapping, MedPAO-VL offers a transparent and clinically viable alternative for automated structured radiology report generation.
papers.comment: The paper has been accepted at ECCV BISCUIT Workshop, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedPAO-VL 把胸片 (Chest X-Ray) 报告生成从单次端到端生成改成 plan-act-observe 循环的多模态 agent：先用可解释视觉模块感知图像并保留诊断不确定性，再对照语义差异迭代自纠，使报告与视觉检出的临床所见对齐。专家评分临床正确性 3.5/5、结构分 4.3/5。
Motivation: 端到端模型是黑箱，易产生事实性幻觉与无依据所见，且不遵守放射报告的结构化协议，临床可用性受限。
Method: 多模态 agent 采用 plan-act-observe 循环：可解释视觉模块先感知胸片并显式建模诊断不确定性，随后生成报告、观察语义差异并自我修正，逐步对齐视觉检出的临床所见，优先病理特异可解释性与迭代精修。
Result: 在专家评分下临床正确性得 3.5/5，结构得分 4.3/5；摘要将该改进归于 agentic reasoning 对临床正确性与完整性的提升。
Conclusion: 以可解释感知加迭代自纠取代不透明的端到端映射，是自动化结构化放射报告生成中更透明、临床可行的路径。

papers.title: RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex tasks, including code generation, tool use, and multi-hop question answering. Existing self-improvement methods enhance agent performance through model optimization, harness evolution, and executable artifact refinement, while recursive self-improvement (RSI) further extends optimization to the improvement mechanisms themselves. However, adapting self-improvement workflows to evolving performance bottlenecks while improving workflow orchestration through execution feedback remains a key challenge. We propose \textbf{RSIFlow}, a \textbf{R}ecursive \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{I}mprovement framework that integrates adaptive work\textbf{flow} orchestration with meta-agent capability evolution. RSIFlow diagnoses performance bottlenecks from task-agent trajectories and environmental feedback to dynamically select component-specific improvement workflows. The meta-agent then distills workflow outcomes into component-specific skills and cross-component principles, evolving its own harness to improve subsequent workflow orchestration. Experiments across six benchmarks and two backbone models show that RSIFlow achieves the SOTA average performance on all benchmarks. Ablation studies further demonstrate the contributions of adaptive workflow orchestration and meta-harness evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/1HUAN1/RSI-Flow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RSIFlow 把递归自我改进 (RSI) 拆成两层：先从任务轨迹与环境反馈诊断性能瓶颈，动态选择针对具体组件的改进工作流，再由 meta-agent 把工作流结果蒸馏成组件级技能与跨组件原则，从而进化自身的 harness 编排能力。在六个 benchmark、两种 backbone 模型上取得全部 benchmark 的 SOTA 平均性能，消融证实自适应工作流编排与 meta-harness 进化均有贡献。
Motivation: 现有自我改进方法优化模型、harness 或可执行产物，但难以随性能瓶颈变化而调整工作流，也缺少用执行反馈改进工作流编排本身的机制。
Method: RSIFlow 从 task-agent 轨迹与环境反馈诊断瓶颈，动态选择 component-specific 改进工作流；meta-agent 将工作流结果蒸馏为组件级技能与跨组件原则，进化自身 harness 以改进后续编排。
Result: 在六个 benchmark、两种 backbone 模型上，RSIFlow 在所有 benchmark 上取得 SOTA 平均性能；消融研究显示自适应工作流编排与 meta-harness 进化各自贡献性能。
Conclusion: 把瓶颈诊断、组件级工作流选择与 harness 自我进化串成闭环，可在多种 backbone 上稳定提升 LLM agent 的自我改进效果。

papers.title: In the Guise of Correction: How Framing and Cultural Adaptation Erode LLM Safety on Real-World Criminal Cases
papers.abstract_en: Existing safety benchmarks rely largely on synthetic prompts with loosely grounded taxonomies and offer little focused analysis of severe crime categories. We introduce GUISE, a benchmark of criminal-assistance scenarios sourced from real-world cases and organised under a taxonomy from the UNODC International Classification of Crime for Statistical Purposes (ICCS). Each scenario is rendered under three linguistic framings and evaluated across five distinct cultures. Using our proposed two-tier evaluation framework, which judges both harmfulness and operational uplift, we find that: (i) framing alone drives unsafe compliance, with the mean unsafe compliance rate rising from 28.9% under direct requests to 66.4% under correction seeking (peaking at 97.3%; p < 0.05), as models correcting deliberately distorted details supply executable criminal steps; (ii) culturally adapted prompts elicit significantly more unsafe compliance than literal translations of the same requests in all four non-English languages (+7 to +18 points), a risk that translation-based benchmarks miss; and (iii) unsafe responses from the least-safe models carry strong Anglocentric registers, and the extent of this leakage increases monotonically with response harmfulness ($ρ$ = 0.46 to 0.63 across languages, all p < 0.001). GUISE offers a grounded resource and fine-grained diagnostics for strengthening refusal alignment across languages and cultures. We publish our code and data to facilitate future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GUISE 是基于真实案件、按 UNODC ICCS 罪行分类组织的犯罪协助安全基准，同一场景改写成三种语言框架、覆盖五种文化，用同时判定有害性与操作性增益 (operational uplift) 的两层评测框架打分。仅换框架就把平均不安全遵从率从直接请求的 28.9% 推到“纠错式”提问的 66.4%（峰值 97.3%，p < 0.05）；文化改写比字面翻译在全部四种非英语语言上多诱发 +7 到 +18 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有安全基准多用合成提示、分类体系松散，且缺少对严重罪行类别的聚焦分析；翻译式评测还测不出文化改写带来的额外风险。
Method: 从真实案件构造犯罪协助场景，按 UNODC 的 International Classification of Crime for Statistical Purposes (ICS/ICCS) 分类体系组织；每个场景渲染成三种语言框架、在五种文化下评测，采用同时判定 harmfulness 与 operational uplift 的两层评测框架，并发布代码与数据。
Result: 平均不安全遵从率从直接请求 28.9% 升至纠错式提问 66.4%，峰值 97.3%（p < 0.05）；文化改写相对字面翻译在全部四种非英语语言上高出 +7 到 +18 个百分点；最不安全模型的回应带强烈 Anglocentric 语域，其泄漏程度随回应有害性单调上升（ρ = 0.46 至 0.63，各语言均 p < 0.001）。
Conclusion: 拒绝对齐 (refusal alignment) 必须跨语言、跨文化、跨提问框架来做强，只测字面翻译的基准会系统性漏掉文化改写与纠错式提问放大的风险。

papers.title: NICE Toolbox: Nonverbal Interpersonal Communication Exploration Toolbox
papers.abstract_en: Understanding human communication is a long-standing goal in psychological research. People express themselves through many verbal and nonverbal channels: posture, gesture, gaze, facial expression, and speech. Measurement and annotation of these signals has traditionally required time-consuming manual work by trained human labellers. The Nonverbal Interpersonal Communication Exploration (NICE) Toolbox is a free, open-source Python framework that automatically measures these signals by combining existing state-of-the-art computer vision and speech-processing methods into a single software package. It includes support for multi-camera systems, interchangeable detection algorithms, 2D and 3D visualization of detector outputs, evaluation on the user's custom data, and export to third-party software. With the release of this tool, we aim to make data exploration of interpersonal communication signals scalable, reproducible, and accessible for psychological research.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Code: https://github.com/OSLabTools/nicetoolbox. Submitted to the Journal of Open Source Software (JOSS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NICE Toolbox 是一个开源 Python 框架，把现成的计算机视觉与语音处理方法打包成一体，自动测量姿态、手势、视线、面部表情与语音等非言语人际沟通信号，替代人工标注。它支持多相机系统、可替换的检测算法、2D/3D 可视化、在用户自定义数据上评估以及导出到第三方软件，目标是让心理学研究中的数据探索可扩展、可复现。
Motivation: 心理学研究中非言语信号（姿态、手势、视线、面部表情、语音）的测量与标注长期依赖受训人工标注员的耗时手工劳动，规模与可复现性受限。
Method: 以开源 Python 框架整合现有 state-of-the-art 的计算机视觉与语音处理方法为单一软件包；支持多相机系统、可互换的检测算法、检测输出的 2D 与 3D 可视化、在用户自定义数据上进行评估，并可导出到第三方软件。
Result: 发布 NICE Toolbox 这一免费开源工具包，具备多相机支持、可替换检测算法、2D/3D 可视化、自定义数据评估与第三方软件导出能力；论文为 5 页 2 图的 JOSS 投稿，代码发布于 github.com/OSLabTools/nicetoolbox。
Conclusion: 非言语人际沟通信号的测量可以通过组合现有 CV 与语音处理方法做成统一工具，使心理学数据探索变得可扩展、可复现、可获取。

papers.title: Learning to Think and Explore in 3D World
papers.abstract_en: We study how vision-language models (VLMs) can learn to think and actively explore in 3D space. Instead of providing multi-view images, videos, or 3D representations to the model, we preserve the native visual encoding of VLMs, i.e., a single image, one at a time, just like humans, and treat the 3D representation only as an environment with which the model can interact through actions (e.g., move left) and observations (rendered images). Each rollout begins from an initial first-person view and a visual question. The model can then iteratively reason, navigate, and reorient its viewpoint before committing to a final answer. Following an initial trajectory-supervised finetuning, we apply reinforcement learning (RL) with rewards driven primarily by final-answer correctness. Crucially, RL provides no direct supervision over which viewpoints the model should visit or which exploration actions it should take. Instead, the model must learn an effective exploration policy solely from the extent to which its interactions improve performance. Across six 3D benchmarks, our model ACT3D achieves an average accuracy of 53.2% that improves its base Qwen model by 22.0% and surpasses proprietary Gemini 3.6 Flash. ACT3D also outperforms existing open-source 3D methods while using 50-70% fewer input frames, and generalizes to unseen domains with an average improvement of 5.9% over its supervised initialization. Further analysis reveals adaptive, question-conditioned exploration. Performance gains over the base model increase from 0.6% on questions answerable from the initial view to 16.3% on those requiring extensive exploration. ACT3D searches for occluded targets, avoids unnecessary exploration, and acquires complementary viewpoints for spatial comparisons. These findings demonstrate that outcome-based RL enables VLMs not only to reason over visual evidence, but also to learn when and how to acquire it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ACT3D 让 VLM 保持单图原生视觉编码，把 3D 场景当作可交互环境，靠结果正确性驱动的强化学习自行学会何时、如何探索视角。在六个 3D benchmark 上平均准确率 53.2%，比基座 Qwen 提升 22.0%，超过 Gemini 3.6 Flash，且输入帧数少 50–70%。
Motivation: 把多视角图像、视频或 3D 表征直接喂给 VLM 会绕过其原生单图编码，且模型缺少在 3D 空间中主动选择视角的探索能力。
Method: 以初始第一人称视图加视觉问题开始，模型迭代推理、导航、调整视角后作答；先做轨迹监督微调，再用以最终答案正确性为主的 RL 训练，RL 不对访问哪些视角或探索动作给直接监督，探索策略完全从交互带来的性能提升中学出。
Result: 六个 3D benchmark 平均准确率 53.2%，较基座 Qwen 提升 22.0%，超过 Gemini 3.6 Flash；优于现有开源 3D 方法且输入帧数少 50–70%；相对监督初始化在未见域上平均再提升 5.9%；相对基座的增益从初始视图即可作答题的 0.6% 升到需大量探索题目的 16.3%。
Conclusion: 基于结果的 RL 能让 VLM 不只在已有视觉证据上推理，还能学会何时以及如何去获取证据，表现为自适应、随问题而变的探索策略。

papers.title: DINO-FIL: Multi-Layer Transformer Fusion for Generative Inpainting Forgery Localization
papers.abstract_en: We propose DINO-FIL, a transformer-based framework for pixel-level localization of generative image forgeries. The method leverages multi-layer representations from a pretrained DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 encoder combined with a lightweight fusion decoder to capture both semantic structure and fine-grained texture inconsistencies introduced by image editing. By aggregating intermediate transformer features across depths, the model improves sensitivity to subtle, spatially localized artifacts that are often missed by standard single-layer approaches. We evaluate DINO-FIL in a cross-dataset setting, training on B-Free and testing on Beyond the Brush, CocoGlide, TGIF, and SAGI-D. The model achieves strong generalization, outperforming existing baselines on average and on four of five evaluated datasets, while maintaining a high true negative rate on pristine images.
papers.journal_ref: ECCV Workshop AI4MFDD2026 - 2026 Workshop on AI for Multimedia Forensics & Disinformation Detection
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DINO-FIL 用预训练 DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 的多层特征加轻量融合解码器，做生成式图像篡改的像素级定位。在跨数据集设置下（B-Free 训练，Beyond the Brush、CocoGlide、TGIF、SAGI-D 测试），平均及五个评测数据集中的四个上超过现有基线，同时在原图上保持高真负率。
Motivation: 生成式图像编辑留下的痕迹细微且空间局部，标准单层特征对这类低可见度伪影不敏感，跨数据集泛化也差。
Method: 取 DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 编码器多个中间层的表征，跨深度聚合后送入轻量融合解码器，同时利用语义结构与细粒度纹理不一致，输出像素级篡改掩码。
Result: 跨数据集评估（train B-Free，test Beyond the Brush / CocoGlide / TGIF / SAGI-D）中，平均及五个评测数据集中的四个上优于现有基线，并在 pristine 图像上保持高 true negative rate。
Conclusion: 跨深度聚合预训练 DINOv3 特征能提升对细微局部篡改痕迹的敏感度，使单层方法漏检的伪影在跨数据集场景下仍可定位。

papers.title: FuseAdapt: Parameter-Efficient Multimodal Fusion for Semantic Segmentation with Missing Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal semantic segmentation benefits from complementary sensors, but this benefit is fragile when some modalities are degraded or missing at test time. Many existing methods rely on dedicated fusion modules or multi-branch cross-modal encoders, and the fusion often becomes unreliable when modalities are absent, leading to substantial performance drops. We propose \textbf{FuseAdapt}, a parameter-efficient framework that performs fusion within the adaptation space of a frozen vision foundation model (VFM), exploring whether VFM priors can serve as an effective shared backbone for multi-modal segmentation. Instead of attaching a standalone fusion network, FuseAdapt assigns each modality a lightweight adaptation branch and performs \emph{adaptation-space fusion} by keeping Q/V low-rank adaptation private to each modality and routing only FFN low-rank residual activations across modalities inside the frozen backbone. The pretrained VFM remains fixed while modality-specific corrections and explicit cross-modal interaction are learned through the adaptation paths. To handle missing modalities, we further introduce \textbf{Predictive Modality Modeling (PMM)}, a direct representation-level objective for cross-modal redundancy. During training, PMM masks a target modality and predicts its embedding from the visible ones, supervised by a teacher target computed under full-modality input. PMM is used only during training and adds no inference-time overhead. Across three multi-modal segmentation benchmarks (MCubeS, DELIVER, MUSES), FuseAdapt consistently improves both modality-complete and modality-incomplete segmentation with a small trainable budget, yielding up to +3.01 mIoU under full modalities and +12.56 mIoU under missing modalities over prior state-of-the-art. Project page: https://devinxzhang.github.io/FuseAdapt-Page/.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 19 tables. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FuseAdapt 在冻结视觉基础模型 (VFM) 的适配空间内做多模态融合：每个模态各持私有的 Q/V LoRA，只把 FFN 低秩残差激活跨模态路由，并用仅训练期的 Predictive Modality Modeling (PMM) 从可见模态预测被遮蔽模态的嵌入。在 MCubeS、DELIVER、MUSES 三个多模态分割基准上，相对先前 SOTA 全模态 mIoU 最多 +3.01，模态缺失时最多 +12.56。
Motivation: 多模态语义分割的收益在测试时模态退化或缺失时很脆弱：现有方法依赖独立融合模块或多分支跨模态编码器，模态缺席时融合失效，性能大幅下降。
Method: 在冻结 VFM 内做 adaptation-space fusion：每个模态分配轻量适配分支，Q/V 低秩适配保持模态私有，仅在冻结骨干内部跨模态路由 FFN 低秩残差激活；另加 PMM 目标，训练时遮蔽目标模态并由可见模态预测其嵌入，以全模态输入下的 teacher target 监督，推理期不引入开销。
Result: 在 MCubeS、DELIVER、MUSES 三个多模态分割基准上，以较小可训练参数预算同时改善模态完整与模态缺失两种设置：相对先前 SOTA，全模态 mIoU 最多 +3.01，模态缺失 mIoU 最多 +12.56。
Conclusion: VFM 预训练先验可充当多模态分割的共享骨干，把跨模态交互放进适配空间并配合表征级冗余预测，能在小可训练预算下同时守住完整模态性能并大幅缓解缺失模态掉点。

papers.title: Same Spectrum, Harder First-Order Training: Phase-Locking in Single- versus Multi-Qubit Re-Uploading Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Angle-encoded variational quantum circuits implement truncated Fourier series. For one-dimensional inputs, a single-qubit re-uploading (serial) circuit represents every function that a multi-qubit circuit with the same encoding budget $E$ can; we find that this exchange of width for depth is not free in first-order training. Because its state lives on the Bloch sphere, all parameters of the serial circuit move the state, at each input, along one complex direction, which we call \emph{phase-locking}. We prove that this costs no Fourier direction but leaves no direction to spare: however many parameters it has, the serial circuit has at most $2E+2$ tangent directions, one more than its $2E+1$ Fourier coefficients need, while a two-qubit control with the same encoding budget and model class generically has at least $6E+6$. The cost in training is measured against this control, as the number of runs out of 100 that reach the optimum within a fixed step budget. On an exact loss with flat-spectrum targets the gap grows with $E$; at $E=32$ the serial circuit converges in 3, 53 and 83 runs under gradient descent, Adam and Levenberg--Marquardt, the control in 99, 100 and 100. On three real-world series, at matched parameter counts, the serial circuit reaches the least-squares optimum in at most 9 runs under Adam and in 32 to 93 under Levenberg--Marquardt, the control in at least 98 and in all 100; its held-out error is up to about $1.5$ times that of the control under Adam, but no larger in the typical run under Levenberg--Marquardt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 角度编码变分量子电路实现截断 Fourier 级数，单比特串行 re-uploading 电路在编码预算 E 下能表示多比特电路的全部函数，但一阶训练更难收敛。作者把原因归为 phase-locking：串行电路状态在 Bloch 球上每个输入只沿一个复方向移动，切空间至多 2E+2 个方向，而同预算的两比特对照至少 6E+6。E=32 的平坦谱目标上，串行电路在梯度下降、Adam、Levenberg–Marquardt 下 100 次运行中分别只有 3、53、83 次达到最优，对照为 99、100、100。
Motivation: 单比特串行 re-uploading 与多比特电路在表示能力上等价（同编码预算 E 下宽度可换深度），但这种等价在一阶训练中是否免费尚不清楚；需要刻画串行电路参数化在切空间上的几何约束及其对收敛的实际代价。
Method: 对角度编码的截断 Fourier 级数电路做切空间分析，证明串行电路因状态位于 Bloch 球而出现 phase-locking，每个输入下所有参数只沿一个复方向移动，切方向至多 2E+2（仅比所需 2E+1 个 Fourier 系数多一），而同编码预算与模型类的两比特对照至少 6E+6。以固定步数预算内 100 次运行中达到最优的次数衡量训练代价，对照为两比特控制电路；优化器为梯度下降、Adam、Levenberg–Marquardt。
Result: 精确损失 + 平坦谱目标、E=32 时，串行电路在梯度下降、Adam、Levenberg–Marquardt 下分别 3、53、83 / 100 次达到最优，两比特对照为 99、100、100，且差距随 E 增大。三个真实时间序列上、参数量匹配时，串行电路在 Adam 下至多 9 次达到最小二乘最优、Levenberg–Marquardt 下 32 至 93 次，对照分别至少 98 次和全部 100 次；串行电路的留出误差在 Adam 下最高约为对照的 1.5 倍，而在 Levenberg–Marquardt 的典型运行中不更大。
Conclusion: 宽度换深度在表示上等价，但在一阶训练中不免费：phase-locking 使串行电路切方向仅比所需 Fourier 系数多一个，导致收敛次数显著劣于同预算多比特对照；换用 Levenberg–Marquardt 可消除典型运行中的留出误差劣势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CF-AVSS: A Coarse-to-Fine Audio-Visual Speech Separation Framework with Target-Speaker Refinement and Post-Fusion for Real-World AVSE Challenge
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual speech enhancement (AVSE) leverages visual cues to recover target speech from mixtures corrupted by reverberation, noise, and overlapping speakers. We propose a coarse-to-fine two-stage AVSE framework. In the first stage, a progressive SPAV-TFGridNet is extended to two synchronized visual streams to produce visually ordered coarse estimates by progressively suppressing interfering speech while preserving target reverberation and shared background noise. In the second stage, a TFGridNet-based target speaker refinement network takes the original mixture and both coarse estimates as input to further recover target speech and improve signal quality. The coarse and refined estimates are finally combined using development-set-calibrated fusion. On the ISCSLP 2026 Real-World AVSE Challenge, our system tied for first place on Track 1 and ranked second on Track 2 in OVRL, while achieving the lowest CER on both tracks at 12.31% and 14.79%, respectively.

papers.title: From Research Goals to Scientific Closure: Evaluating Agents Through Evidence-Supported Physics Research
papers.abstract_en: Can AI agents organize scientific investigations that lead to well-supported conclusions? To evaluate this capability, we introduce PhysClosureBench, a benchmark of 50 expert-verified, goal-specified research tasks spanning strong-field, attosecond, and neighboring physics areas. Each task specifies the research objective and essential scientific constraints, while leaving the agent to organize the investigation and determine how to generate and validate the evidence needed to answer the question. A 20-criterion Atomic Score measures local scientific accomplishment, while Research Closure (RC0--RC4) assesses how fully the investigation resolves the specified research question based on whether its indispensable evidence requirements and applicable scope conditions are satisfied. We evaluate seven frontier LLMs, where Claude-Opus-5 achieves the highest mean Atomic Score (6.29/10) but reaches RC4 in only 32.7% of attempts. Across the benchmark, 36.2% of attempts scoring at least 8/10 still fall short of RC4, while all seven models reach RC4 on substantially fewer tasks in all three runs than in at least one. Case-level analysis further illustrates how misinterpretation of generated results and unresolved physical applicability limits can lead to incomplete closure. Together, these results reveal a persistent gap between AI agents' local scientific accomplishments and their ability to achieve complete research closure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PhysClosureBench：50 个专家核验、指定研究目标的物理研究任务，让 AI agent 自主组织调查并生成与验证证据，用 20 项 Atomic Score 打分局部成果、用 RC0–RC4 五级评估研究是否真正闭合。七个前沿 LLM 中 Claude-Opus-5 平均 Atomic Score 最高（6.29/10），但仅 32.7% 的尝试达到 RC4；36.2% 拿到 ≥8/10 的尝试仍不闭合，说明局部科学成果与完整研究闭合之间存在持续缺口。
Motivation: 现有 agent 评测衡量局部步骤质量，却无法判断一次调查是否真正回答了指定研究问题；证据要求与适用范围条件是否被满足长期缺少可操作的判定标准。
Method: 构建 50 个专家核验、目标指定的任务（覆盖强场、阿秒及邻近物理领域），每个任务给出研究目标与必要科学约束，由 agent 自行组织调查、决定如何生成并验证证据；评分用 20-criterion Atomic Score 衡量局部科学成果，用 RC0–RC4 按不可或缺的证据要求与适用范围条件是否满足评定研究闭合度，并对七个前沿 LLM 做三次运行的对照与案例级分析。
Result: Claude-Opus-5 平均 Atomic Score 最高，为 6.29/10，但仅 32.7% 的尝试达到 RC4；全 benchmark 上 36.2% 得分 ≥8/10 的尝试仍未达 RC4；七个模型在三次运行中全部呈现「三次都达 RC4 的任务数远少于至少一次达到的任务数」的不稳定表现。
Conclusion: AI agent 的局部科学成果与其达成完整研究闭合的能力之间存在持续缺口，失败主要来自对生成结果的误读和未解决的物理适用性限制；高局部评分不能当作研究已闭合的证据。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Q($γ_H$): Entropy-Guided Horizon Mixing in Multi-Discount Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: A fixed discount factor in Q-learning imposes a single planning horizon throughout training, despite the differing demands of early exploration and long-term credit assignment. We propose Q($γ_H$), a multi-horizon Q-learning framework that maintains multiple discount-specific heads and adaptively combines them at control time using an entropy-derived confidence signal. The resulting state-dependent mixing weights shift control from shorter- to longer-horizon heads as policy confidence increases, enabling adaptive horizon mixing without modifying individual Bellman updates. Across classical control and deep reinforcement-learning benchmarks, Q($γ_H$) shows its strongest improvements on delayed-credit tasks relative to strong fixed-discount baselines. By decoupling horizon adaptation from the underlying learning updates, Q($γ_H$) provides a lightweight framework for adaptive planning-horizon control in reinforcement learning, avoiding the need for manual discount-factor selection while remaining compatible with standard value-learning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Q(γ_H)：多折扣 Q-learning 框架，用多个折扣专用 head 加熵导出的置信度在控制时自适应混合，随策略置信度升高把控制权从短时程 head 移向长时程 head。在经典控制与深度 RL 基准上，相对强固定折扣基线的最强提升出现在延迟信用分配 (delayed-credit) 任务。
Motivation: 固定折扣因子在整个训练期强加单一规划时程，无法兼顾早期探索与长期信用分配的不同需求，且需人工选折扣。
Method: 维护多个折扣专用 Q-head，用熵导出的置信度信号生成状态相关混合权重，在控制时组合各 head 输出；不改动各自的 Bellman 更新，与标准 value-learning 方法兼容。
Result: 在经典控制与深度强化学习基准上，相对强固定折扣基线的最强改进出现在延迟信用分配任务；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把时程自适应与学习更新解耦，可作为轻量框架免去手工折扣选择，同时保持与标准值学习方法的兼容性。
Relevance: 2
