papers.title: Beyond Generation: Using Multimodal LLMs as Detectors of LLM-Generated Deepfake Facial Images
papers.abstract_en: As image generation models become increasingly capable of producing highly realistic content, traditional forensic techniques are struggling to keep up. This paper investigates whether MLLMs can instead be used as a form of forensic analysis by identifying synthetic media. Specifically, the study aims to determine whether these models detect fake images by recognising physical inconsistencies, or whether they rely on digital artefacts such as embedded watermarks.Six MLLMs: GPT-4o, GPT-5, GPT-5.2, Gemini 2.5, Gemini 3, and Seed 1.6, are benchmarked using a dataset of 400 images. Fifty images are authentic photographs, while the remaining 350 are generated using seven leading image models: Gemini 3, Gemini 2.5, Flux.2 Pro, GPT-Image-1, GPT-Image-1.5, Seedream 4.0, and Seedream 4.5. The evaluation is structured in three stages: single-image classification, pairwise comparison, and a focused "self-detection" experiment on Gemini. Several MLLMs achieved a high detection accuracy, with GPT-5.2 reaching a peak of 97.9% in the pairwise experiment, against specific generators and an overall mean pairwise accuracy of 82.5% by identifying structural or physical inconsistencies within images. However, results from the self-detection experiment indicate that the presence of invisible SynthID watermarks leads to a 10% reduction in Gemini's detection accuracy compared to the clean control group. One possible explanation is that SynthID embedding reduces some of the visible artefacts the models rely on for detection.These results imply that MLLMs can detect structural artefacts without relying on watermarks, but performance varies substantially across model generations. The findings from comparison C5 also suggest that SynthID embedding may suppress some of the structural artefacts used during detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 MLLM 当图像取证检测器而非生成器来评测，发现它们主要靠识别图像中的结构或物理不一致来判别真伪，而非依赖水印：GPT-5.2 在两两比较实验中对特定生成器达到 97.9% 检测准确率，整体平均两两准确率 82.5%。但在 Gemini 的自检测实验中，嵌入不可见 SynthID 水印使其检测准确率相对干净对照组下降 10%，说明水印嵌入可能反而抑制了模型赖以判断的部分可见伪影。
Motivation: 图像生成模型的真实感已让传统取证技术难以跟上，需要弄清 MLLM 判别合成图像时依赖的是物理不一致还是嵌入水印这类数字痕迹。
Method: 在 400 张图像数据集上评测六个 MLLM（GPT-4o、GPT-5、GPT-5.2、Gemini 2.5、Gemini 3、Seed 1.6），其中 50 张真实照片、350 张由七个生成模型（Gemini 3、Gemini 2.5、Flux.2 Pro、GPT-Image-1、GPT-Image-1.5、Seedream 4.0、Seedream 4.5）生成；评测分三阶段：单图分类、两两比较，以及针对 Gemini 的自检测实验。
Result: GPT-5.2 在两两比较实验中对特定生成器达到 97.9% 峰值检测准确率，整体平均两两准确率 82.5%，通过识别图像内结构或物理不一致实现；自检测实验中，存在不可见 SynthID 水印使 Gemini 检测准确率比干净对照组下降 10%。
Conclusion: MLLM 能在不依赖水印的情况下检测结构性伪影，但性能随模型代际差异显著；SynthID 嵌入可能压制了检测所用的部分结构性伪影。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Beyond Source Prompts: Towards Visually Grounded AI-Generated Video Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative artificial intelligence have accelerated video generation technologies. However, AI-generated videos (AIGVs) remain susceptible to various distortions, highlighting the need for dedicated video quality assessment methods. Content semantics play an important role in AIGV quality assessment, with source prompts typically used as textual references. However, these prompts may not accurately reflect the generated video content, resulting in a discrepancy between the intended textual description and the generated result. To address this limitation, this paper proposes VGCap, an AIGV quality assessment framework guided by visually grounded captions that align better with generated content. Specifically, we introduce two forms of captions: a global caption obtained by minimally revising the source prompt based on multi-frame visual evidence, and prompt-independent segment captions that describe localized temporal content. Together, these captions provide complementary textual evidence for assessing spatial quality, temporal quality, and text-video alignment. Experimental results on the LGVQ and FETV datasets show that VGCap outperforms representative baselines across all three dimensions. Further ablation studies on caption sources and temporal components confirm the effectiveness of visually grounded captions for each quality dimension, while highlighting the benefits of segment-level features for temporal quality prediction. The source of VGCap will be available at https://github.com/lolo123-123/VGCap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VGCap 用与生成视频对齐的视觉化 caption 取代源 prompt 作为文本参考来做 AI 生成视频质量评估 (AIGV QA)：全局 caption 在多帧视觉证据上最小修改源 prompt，另有与 prompt 无关的分段 caption 描述局部时序内容，二者共同支撑空间质量、时序质量与文本-视频对齐三个维度的打分。在 LGVQ 与 FETV 数据集上，VGCap 在全部三个维度上超过代表性基线，消融显示分段级特征对时序质量预测收益明确。
Motivation: 源 prompt 常与实际生成结果不一致，用它做文本参照会让 AIGV 质量评估的语义对齐维度失真。
Method: VGCap 框架引入两类 caption：基于多帧视觉证据最小修订源 prompt 得到的全局 caption，以及与 prompt 无关、描述局部时序内容的分段 caption；两者提供互补文本证据，分别支撑空间质量、时序质量与文本-视频对齐三个维度的评估，并做 caption 来源与时序组件的消融。
Result: 在 LGVQ 与 FETV 数据集上，VGCap 在空间质量、时序质量、文本-视频对齐三个维度均超过代表性基线；消融确认视觉化 caption 对各质量维度有效，分段级特征对时序质量预测有额外收益。
Conclusion: 用与生成内容对齐的视觉化 caption 而非源 prompt 做语义参照，能更可靠地支撑 AIGV 三个质量维度的评估，分段级特征对时序质量尤其关键。

summary_sections.conclusion: 用与生成内容对齐的视觉化 caption 而非源 prompt 做语义参照，能更可靠地支撑 AIGV 三个质量维度的评估，分段级特征对时序质量尤其关键。

papers.title: DeciCAD: Harness-Grounded Learning of Action Policies for CAD Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model agents operate through closed-loop action policies whose decision space is defined by an agent harness. We investigate how this operating space shapes agent behavior and policy learning in computer-aided design (CAD), a professional domain characterized by persistent state, geometric constraints, and long-horizon procedures. We instantiate this perspective in DeciCAD, a domain-native harness that exposes semantic CAD actions, decision-oriented observations, environment feedback, and persistent state transitions. Building on this harness, we develop a learning pipeline that extracts causal decision supervision from interaction trajectories and improves the policy through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and geometry-grounded online reinforcement learning (RL). Across four CAD benchmarks, DeciCAD achieves the best F1 and intersection over union (IoU) while reducing model-output tokens by 45--88% relative to a general-purpose coding harness. Under matched supervision, its SFT policy improves F1 from 0.6883 to 0.7437 and outperforms the coding policy; subsequent online RL further raises geometry availability from 66.5% to 73.5% and F1 to 0.7880. These results demonstrate that the decision space induced by a harness materially affects both agent execution and policy learning in CAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeciCAD 把 CAD agent 的动作空间由通用代码 harness 换成领域原生 harness（语义 CAD 动作、决策导向观测、环境反馈、持久状态转移），并用从交互轨迹抽取因果决策监督的 SFT 加几何接地在线 RL 训练策略。在四个 CAD benchmark 上它取得最好 F1 与 IoU，同时比通用 coding harness 减少 45–88% 模型输出 token；匹配监督下 SFT 把 F1 从 0.6883 提到 0.7437，后续在线 RL 再把 geometry availability 从 66.5% 提到 73.5%、F1 提到 0.7880。
Motivation: LLM agent 的决策空间由 harness 决定，但 harness 如何影响策略学习尚不清楚；CAD 这类持久状态、几何约束、长程流程的专业域尤其依赖动作空间的定义。
Method: 构建领域原生 harness DeciCAD，暴露语义 CAD 动作、决策导向观测、环境反馈与持久状态转移；学习管线从交互轨迹中抽取因果决策监督，先做监督微调 (SFT)，再做几何接地的在线强化学习 (RL)。
Result: 在四个 CAD benchmark 上取得最佳 F1 与 IoU，相比通用 coding harness 减少 45–88% 模型输出 token；匹配监督下 SFT 策略 F1 从 0.6883 升至 0.7437 并超过 coding 策略；在线 RL 进一步把 geometry availability 从 66.5% 提至 73.5%，F1 升至 0.7880。
Conclusion: harness 所诱导的决策空间会实质影响 CAD 中 agent 的执行效果与策略学习质量，领域原生动作空间配合几何接地 RL 能同时提高性能并压缩输出 token。

papers.title: Harmful Partial Interventions and Benign Leakage in Concept-based Models
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence systems deployed in high-risk settings increasingly require models that support meaningful human oversight. Concept-based models (CMs) offer a promising framework by enabling users to inspect and intervene on intermediate, human-understandable concepts. However, concept interventions can counterintuitively worsen downstream predictions, a failure mode we formalise as intervention harm. We distinguish harm after all concepts have been intervened on from harm under partial interventions, the more likely practical use case. Modern CMs often achieve high accuracy by encoding, or leaking, additional task-relevant information in their intermediate concept representations. Recent work argues that such leakage can be benign with respect to intervention harm when concept representations satisfy two conditions: sufficiency and localisation. We prove that these criteria are not sufficient to guarantee that concept interventions improve downstream performance. Across controlled and real-world settings, we find that concept supervision incompleteness is associated with increased intervention harm. Importantly, optimising the model when all concepts are intervened on, a previously proposed leakage mitigation objective, reduces endpoint harm but does not reliably prevent harmful partial corrections. Hence, we introduce a complementary monotonic intervention objective that directly penalises increases in task loss along partial intervention trajectories. Combining endpoint and monotonic intervention training substantially reduces the prevalence and magnitude of partial intervention harm while preserving concept and task predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 概念模型 (concept-based models) 中，即使概念表示满足充分性 (sufficiency) 与局部化 (localisation) 两个条件，部分概念干预仍可能反而恶化下游预测。作者证明这两个条件不足以保证干预改善性能，并提出单调干预目标 (monotonic intervention objective)，直接惩罚沿部分干预轨迹的任务损失上升，与端点干预训练结合后显著降低部分干预危害的发生率与幅度，同时保持概念与任务预测性能。
Motivation: 概念干预是高风险场景下实现人工监督的关键机制，但干预可能反直觉地使下游预测变差（intervention harm）；此前认为泄漏在充分性与局部化条件下是良性的，但部分干预这一更实际的用例下该判据并不成立。
Method: 形式化区分全概念干预后的端点危害与部分干预危害；证明 sufficiency 与 localisation 不足以保证干预改善性能；在受控与真实场景中检验概念监督不完整性 (concept supervision incompleteness) 与干预危害的关联；提出单调干预目标，惩罚部分干预轨迹上的任务损失上升，并与既有端点泄漏缓解目标结合训练。
Result: 证明充分性与局部化判据不足以保证概念干预改善下游性能；受控与真实场景中，概念监督不完整性与干预危害增加相关；仅优化全概念干预的端点目标能降低端点危害但不能可靠防止有害的部分修正；端点与单调干预联合训练大幅降低部分干预危害的普遍性与幅度，同时保持概念和任务预测性能。
Conclusion: 泄漏是否良性不能只靠充分性与局部化判定，部分干预轨迹需要单独的目标约束；端点干预训练不足以替代单调性约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Dormant Spiking Neuron: A State-Driven Mechanism for Efficient Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer a compelling pathway toward energy-efficient artificial intelligence, fundamentally anchored in presynaptic input-driven sparsity. However, a substantial yet chronically overlooked source of computational overhead persists: the continuous subthreshold dynamics of postsynaptic neurons. Quantitative analysis reveals that up to 44% of neurons in an ImageNet-trained ResNet-18 model reside in a deeply inhibited state, imposing a persistent computational burden despite having a negligible probability of firing. To address this inefficiency, the Dormant Spiking Neuron (DSN) model is introduced. By incorporating a state-driven dynamic gate, the DSN allows a neuron to enter a dormant state when its membrane potential falls below a predefined negative threshold, dynamically pruning redundant computations at the instance level. Crucially, this dormancy mechanism is directly integrated into the neuronal dynamics and trained end-to-end via backpropagation through time using surrogate gradients, enabling the network to actively learn a robust dormancy policy that adaptively preserves critical information flow. Extensive experiments across static and neuromorphic datasets demonstrate that the DSN framework consistently reduces computational energy by 40% to over 70%. Notably, on the large-scale ImageNet dataset, the DSN outperforms state-of-the-art static pruning techniques at comparable reported cost reductions and simultaneously improves the corresponding baseline SNN accuracy by 1.34%. By establishing a trainable, state-driven sparsity paradigm orthogonal to conventional input-driven methods, the DSN unlocks synergistic efficiency gains, presenting an effective approach for advancing neuromorphic computing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSN 用状态驱动动态门让膜电位低于预设负阈值的突触后神经元进入休眠态，在实例级直接剪掉冗余计算，并随网络用 BPTT 与 surrogate gradient 端到端训练出休眠策略。ImageNet 训练的 ResNet-18 中多达 44% 神经元处于深度抑制态，DSN 将计算能耗降低 40% 到 70% 以上，在 ImageNet 上以相当的报告降本幅度胜过 SOTA 静态剪枝，并把基线 SNN 精度再提高 1.34%。
Motivation: SNN 的省电主要靠突触前输入驱动的稀疏，而突触后神经元持续的亚阈值动态被长期忽视：ImageNet 训练的 ResNet-18 中多达 44% 神经元深度抑制、几乎不放电却持续消耗计算。
Method: DSN 模型给神经元加状态驱动动态门：膜电位低于预设负阈值即进入 dormant 态，实例级剪掉冗余计算；休眠机制直接嵌入神经元动力学，用 backpropagation through time 加 surrogate gradient 端到端训练，让网络自行学出保留关键信息流的休眠策略。
Result: 定量分析显示 ImageNet 训练的 ResNet-18 中多达 44% 神经元处于深度抑制态；在静态与神经形态数据集上的实验中，DSN 将计算能耗降低 40% 到 70% 以上；在 ImageNet 上以相当的报告降本幅度优于 SOTA 静态剪枝，同时把对应基线 SNN 精度提高 1.34%。
Conclusion: 与输入驱动稀疏正交的、可训练的状态驱动稀疏范式能同时压低 SNN 能耗并抬高精度，休眠策略应作为神经元动力学的一部分随任务学出来，而不是事后静态剪枝。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Delegation Dilemma: Economies of Scale, Accountability, and Polycentric Governance
papers.abstract_en: Many collective-action systems are neither fully decentralized nor fully centralized: agents voluntarily organize into institutions that share organizational costs and delegate decisions to representatives. Delegation can reduce individual costs, but it also transfers control to representatives whose private objectives need not align with those of their constituents. We study this tension in a repeated game with endogenous delegation to self-interested centers. A simple reduced-form model yields a scale--accountability tradeoff: larger constituencies offer greater cost-sharing benefits to members, yet the marginal value to a center of retaining any one constituent decreases as group size grows. Consequently, the prospect of individual exit can sustain non-exploitative delegation only up to an endogenous accountable constituency size. Additionally, we identify parameter regions in which fully delegated, accountable governance, when feasible, must be polycentric. We investigate these predictions through simulations with large language model (LLM) agents. Across five matched pairs of 30-agent simulations, polycentric structures repeatedly emerge but remain fluid, exhibiting cycles of concentration, exploitation, exit, and re-formation. We further find that models of different capacity exhibit similar willingness to assume leadership but differ substantially in their exercise of authority, with Sol initiating exploitation more frequently than Luna in matched decision states.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在自利代表的重复博弈中，成员规模带来成本分摊收益，但单个成员对中心的边际价值随群体变小，因此个体退出只能把非剥削性委托治理约束在一个内生的问责规模之内；超出该规模的可行治理必须是多中心的。30 智能体的 LLM 多智能体仿真中多中心结构反复出现但高度流动，呈现集中、剥削、退出、重组的循环，且不同能力模型在相同决策状态下行使权威的方式差异明显。
Motivation: 许多集体行动系统既非完全分散也非完全集中，委托能分摊组织成本，却把控制权交给目标未必与成员一致的代表；委托何时不被剥削、规模多大才可问责，缺少可判定的条件。
Method: 构建一个内生委托到自利中心的重复博弈简化模型，推导规模—问责权衡与多中心治理的参数区域；再用 LLM 智能体仿真检验这些预测，设置五组配对的 30 智能体仿真。
Result: 简化模型给出内生的问责选民规模上限，并指出在部分参数区域内完全委托且可问责的治理若可行则必须多中心。五组配对 30 智能体仿真中多中心结构反复涌现但保持流动，出现集中—剥削—退出—重组的循环；不同能力模型担任领导者的意愿相近，但行使权威差异显著，Sol 在配对决策状态下比 Luna 更频繁发起剥削。
Conclusion: 退出威胁只能在有限的内生规模内约束代表的剥削行为，多中心是该约束下可行问责治理的常态形态，而模型能力差异主要体现在掌权后的行为而非掌权意愿上。

papers.title: Pairwise AUC Optimization Needs Corrective Power: A Unified View
papers.abstract_en: Direct pairwise AUC-surrogate training is attractive because it trains toward the ranking metric used at test time, especially under class imbalance. This creates a direct alignment between the training objective and the evaluation metric, but such metric alignment alone does not guarantee that stochastic training remains corrective. We study this gap through Corrective Power: whether pairwise mini-batch updates produce stronger and more reliable improvements for more severe positive-negative ranking errors. Our main observation is that direct pairwise training can enter regions where severe errors remain common but no longer produce useful corrective motion. In such regions, even the mini-batch noise that would normally help SGD move along the steepest severe-error correction direction can become much weaker. In this paper, we seek a theoretical explanation for this by exploring the degenerate property of the U-statistics formed from the pairwise gradients therein. Our results provide a mechanistic explanation for several empirical patterns: (a) squared-hinge loss is often an effective AUC surrogate; (b) cross-entropy warm-up can help models that enter the AUC phase from a poor starting region; and (c) parameter-efficient fine-tuning from a pretrained model can reduce that need by starting closer to a favorable ranking geometry. Experiments on 8 CV tasks and 8 NLP tasks, using ResNet50, DenseNet121, DistilBERT-base, and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, support these predictions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 Corrective Power 概念，判定 pairwise AUC 代理训练的小批量更新是否对更严重的正负样本排序错误产生更强、更可靠的纠正，并用 pairwise 梯度所构成 U-统计量的退化性质给出机制解释。结论是指标对齐并不保证训练保持纠正性：当严重错误仍频繁却不再产生有效纠正运动时，本可推动 SGD 沿最陡纠正方向移动的小批量噪声也会变弱；该机制解释了 squared-hinge 常作为有效 AUC 代理、cross-entropy 预热可帮助从差起点进入 AUC 阶段的模型，以及从预训练模型做参数高效微调可因起点更接近有利排序几何而减少这一需求。
Motivation: 直接 pairwise AUC 代理训练虽把训练目标与测试排序指标对齐，尤其在类别不平衡下有吸引力，但指标对齐本身不保证随机训练仍是纠正性的：严重排序错误常见的区域可能不再产生有用的纠正运动。
Method: 以 Corrective Power 为分析框架，考察 pairwise 小批量更新对更严重正负排序错误的纠正强度与可靠性，并从 pairwise 梯度所形成 U-统计量的退化性质出发给出理论解释；实验在 8 个 CV 任务与 8 个 NLP 任务上检验其预测，使用 ResNet50、DenseNet121、DistilBERT-base 与 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct。
Result: 在 8 个 CV 任务和 8 个 NLP 任务上，用 ResNet50、DenseNet121、DistilBERT-base、Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 的实验支持理论预测，即机制解释了 squared-hinge 常是有效 AUC 代理、cross-entropy 预热对从差起点进入 AUC 阶段的模型有帮助、参数高效微调从预训练模型出发可减少对预热的需求这三种经验模式。
Conclusion: AUC 训练的关键不在目标与指标是否对齐，而在更新是否保有对严重排序错误的 Corrective Power；退化的 U-统计量会让小批量噪声失去推动纠正的能力，因此差起点需要 cross-entropy 预热，而预训练起点更近的有利排序几何可绕开这一需求。

papers.title: Sparse Federated Echo State Networks for Time-Series Classification via Smooth-L1 Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Echo State Networks (ESNs), as lightweight implementations of reservoir computing, provide efficient solutions for temporal data processing in resource-constrained environments. While standard ESNs offer computational efficiency, their dense readout layers inflate the stored model and the per-sample inference cost. This paper introduces a Smooth-L1 regularized ESN (SL1ESN) that promotes sparsity in the readout layer while preserving differentiability for gradient-based optimization. The method employs a twice-differentiable Smooth-L1 approximation compatible with Newton's method, which we exploit both for centralized training and for a second-order (Newton-step) federated aggregation scheme. Under a single fixed shrinkage threshold shared by every dataset and both settings, experiments on seven time-series classification benchmarks show that SL1ESN learns readouts that are $77$--$95\%$ sparse in the centralized setting and $75$--$95\%$ sparse in the federated one, while staying within $0.7$ accuracy points of the strongest dense baseline on five of the seven benchmarks in the centralized setting and within $1.6$ points on the same five in the federated one, and the second-order federated update converges in only a few rounds. The resulting sparsity compresses the stored model, the per-sample inference cost, and the server-to-client broadcast by a comparable factor. These results demonstrate the practical value of sparse readouts for edge computing and IoT deployments.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Extended version of a paper presented at IDEAL 2025. Code: https://github.com/oroboro235/FedESN-SmoothL1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Smooth-L1 正则化的回声状态网络 (SL1ESN)，用二阶可微的 Smooth-L1 近似稀疏化读出层，并兼容 Newton 法做集中训练与二阶联邦聚合。在七个时间序列分类基准上，单一固定收缩阈值下集中设置读出稀疏 77–95%、联邦设置 75–95%，其中五个基准上精度距最强稠密基线不超过 0.7 与 1.6 个百分点，二阶联邦更新仅需数轮收敛。
Motivation: 标准 ESN 的稠密读出层使存储模型与逐样本推理开销膨胀，联邦场景还要承担服务器到客户端的全量广播，边缘与 IoT 部署难以承受。
Method: SL1ESN 用二阶可微的 Smooth-L1 近似对读出层施加正则以诱导稀疏，同时保持梯度法所需的可微性；该近似与 Newton 法兼容，既用于集中训练，也用于二阶 (Newton-step) 联邦聚合。所有数据集与两种设置共用一个固定收缩阈值。
Result: 七个时间序列分类基准上，集中设置读出层稀疏 77–95%，联邦设置 75–95%；集中设置中五个基准精度距最强稠密基线在 0.7 个百分点以内，联邦设置同样五个基准在 1.6 个百分点以内；二阶联邦更新仅数轮收敛。稀疏度带来的模型存储、逐样本推理与服务器到客户端广播开销按可比比例压缩。
Conclusion: 稀疏读出在几乎不损失分类精度的前提下同时压缩模型体积、推理与通信开销，对边缘计算与 IoT 部署具有实用价值。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Reliable Knowledge Acquisition for Continual Learning Agents
papers.abstract_en: As agents powered by foundation models move into open-ended environments, continual learning from experience becomes essential. For agents built on models with fixed parameters, this learning requires reusing prior task experience in context to improve performance and efficiency on future tasks. Existing memory and experience-learning systems typically focus on either retained facts or procedures, and lack a mechanism for establishing the reliability of claims extracted from the ongoing task stream. Indeed, we find that approximately 12--33\% of entries produced by representative systems harm future task performance when reused. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{RIKA} (Reliable Knowledge Acquisition), which combines hierarchical extraction of factual, conceptual, procedural, and metacognitive knowledge with Evidence-based Knowledge Admission, which uses source evidence and subsequent experience to govern which claims enter the task agent's context, without additional validation tasks. Across six task streams from Continual Learning Bench and four model backbones, RIKA achieves the highest aggregate score on every backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RIKA 为固定参数基础模型 agent 的持续学习记忆加一道准入关：分层抽取事实、概念、程序、元认知四类知识，用 Evidence-based Knowledge Admission 依据来源证据与后续经验决定哪些 claim 进入 context，无需额外验证任务。作者发现代表性记忆系统约 12–33% 的条目被复用时会损害后续任务表现；在 Continual Learning Bench 的六条任务流与四个 backbone 上，RIKA 在每个 backbone 上都取得最高总分。
Motivation: 开放环境中固定参数 agent 只能靠复用先前任务经验来改进后续任务，但现有记忆与经验学习系统只管保留事实或程序，缺少判断从任务流中抽出的 claim 是否可靠的机制，错误条目被复用反而拖低性能。
Method: RIKA (Reliable Knowledge Acquisition) 由两部分组成：分层知识抽取，把经验拆成 factual、conceptual、procedural、metacognitive 四类；Evidence-based Knowledge Admission，用来源证据加上后续经验来裁准入 context 的 claim，不引入额外的 validation 任务。
Result: 代表性系统的记忆条目中约 12–33% 在被复用时会损害未来任务表现。在 Continual Learning Bench 的六条任务流、四个模型 backbone 上，RIKA 在每个 backbone 上都取得最高总分 (highest aggregate score)。
Conclusion: 把来源证据与后续经验作为准入判据，可以在不加验证任务的前提下减少有害记忆条目，使固定参数 agent 的持续学习在多个 backbone 上都拿到最高总分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: In-Context Preference-Conditioned Pareto Set Learning from Limited Offline Data
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective optimization involves diverse preferences over conflicting objectives. Rather than returning a finite set of trade-off solutions, preference-conditioned Pareto set learning seeks to map a specified preference directly to a corresponding Pareto optimal solution. Yet in many real-world scenarios, optimization must proceed offline without further objective evaluations, leaving only a limited static dataset that sparsely covers the decision and objective spaces. Existing methods either optimize separately for each preference or train a problem-specific Pareto solution model, requiring repeated search across preferences or repeated training across problems. We introduce in-context preference-conditioned Pareto set learning (ICPSL), a framework that amortizes both preference-wise solution search and problem-specific model construction. ICPSL pretrains a foundation-style hypernetwork on a large and diverse set of synthetic prior data. Given the offline observations of an unseen problem, the pretrained hypernetwork learns to generate a problem-specific, preference-conditioned Pareto solution model in a single forward pass. The generated model can then be reused to predict solutions for arbitrary preferences without problem-specific training or preference-wise search. Experiments on synthetic and real-world problems show that ICPSL produces high-quality Pareto solutions while providing substantial speedups in problem-specific solution-model construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ICPSL：用在大量合成先验数据上预训练的 foundation 式 hypernetwork，从离线观测一次前向生成针对该问题的偏好条件化 Pareto 解模型，之后对任意偏好直接预测解，无需逐偏好搜索或逐问题重训。合成与真实问题实验显示其产出高质量 Pareto 解，并在构造问题特定解模型时带来显著加速。
Motivation: 离线场景下只能依赖稀疏覆盖决策与目标空间的静态数据集，无法继续评估目标；现有方法要么对每个偏好单独优化、要么训练问题特定模型，导致跨偏好重复搜索或跨问题重复训练。
Method: ICPSL 在大规模多样的合成先验数据上预训练 foundation 式 hypernetwork；给定未见问题的离线观测，hypernetwork 单次前向生成该问题的偏好条件化 Pareto 解模型，随后复用它对任意偏好预测解。
Result: 在合成与真实问题上的实验表明 ICPSL 产出高质量 Pareto 解，并在问题特定解模型构造上取得大幅加速 (substantial speedups)。
Conclusion: 偏好侧搜索与问题侧建模可以一起被摊销 (amortize)：一次前向生成的偏好条件化解模型即可复用于任意偏好，替代逐偏好搜索与逐问题训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Retrieved but Not Read: Understanding Why Search-Augmented LLMs Fail to Use Available Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Web search allows LLMs to access up-to-date information, but it remains unclear why they sometimes produce outdated answers even when relevant evidence is available. To study this problem, we construct temporal facts whose values changed after the models' training cutoffs. We evaluate one proprietary model under deployed web search and six open-weight model configurations under controlled retrieval. We find that models often answer from search snippets without opening the source pages, which is associated with higher rates of outdated answers and unfaithful citations. Our controlled experiments and layer-wise analysis reveal a gap between the availability of evidence and its effective use. Even when retrieved evidence influences internal predictions, models may still favour outdated information in their final answers. We hope these findings will help advance research on the reliable use of retrieved evidence in search-augmented LLMs.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/ojwwalters/retrieved-but-not-read
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构造训练截止后数值已变更的 temporal facts，检验搜索增强 LLM 为何在证据已检索到时仍给出过时答案。发现模型常直接用搜索 snippet 作答而不打开源页面，这与更高的过时答案率和不忠实引用相关；即便检索证据已影响内部预测，最终答案仍可能偏向过时信息。
Motivation: LLM 联网搜索后仍输出过时答案的原因不清：证据可用与证据被有效使用之间存在缺口，影响检索增强生成的可靠性与引用忠实性。
Method: 构造数值在模型训练截止后发生变化的 temporal facts；评测 1 个proprietary 模型的部署态 web search 与 6 个 open-weight 模型配置的受控检索，并做 layer-wise 分析追踪检索证据对内部预测的影响。
Result: 模型常在不打开源页面的情况下仅凭搜索 snippet 作答，该行为与更高的过时答案率和不忠实引用率相关；受控实验与逐层分析显示，即便检索证据影响了内部预测，最终答案仍可能偏向过时信息。
Conclusion: 检索到证据不等于证据被使用：搜索增强 LLM 的过时答案源于证据可用与有效使用之间的断裂，而非检索缺失。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: FIRM: Fisher-Informed Retention Merging for Federated LLM Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Federated LLM unlearning addresses targeted knowledge removal when forget and retain data remain distributed across private clients and are inaccessible to the server. The resulting locally trained adapters encode conflicting objectives, making their aggregation fundamentally different from conventional federated optimization. A key failure mode is magnitude explosion, whereby unnormalized cross-client aggregation increases the merged update magnitude and degrades retained utility under stronger unlearning. We propose FIRM (Fisher-Informed Retention Merging), a single-round framework for stable and retention-aware server-side aggregation. FIRM uses client-local Fisher statistics as a unified sensitivity signal to construct a Fisher-normalized base merge and impose explicit control over retain-sensitive parameters. Its second-order retention projection admits a unique minimum-distance solution, while the corresponding dual scales with the number of retain clients rather than the model dimension. Experiments across WMDP, TOFU, and MUSE-HP using Zephyr-7B and Llama-3-8B show utility gains at comparable forgetting on WMDP and MUSE-HP, with metric-dependent trade-offs on TOFU. Controlled comparisons support benefits of the combined base merge and additional retention correction at selected operating points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FIRM 是联邦 LLM 遗忘 (federated unlearning) 的单轮服务端聚合框架：用客户端本地 Fisher 统一做敏感度信号，先做 Fisher 归一化基础合并，再对 retain 敏感参数加二阶保留投影。在 WMDP、TOFU、MUSE-HP 上以 Zephyr-7B 与 Llama-3-8B 测试，在遗忘程度相当处取得效用提升，TOFU 上则呈指标依赖的权衡。
Motivation: 遗忘数据与保留数据分散在私有客户端、服务端不可见，本地训练的 adapter 目标冲突；未归一化的跨客户端聚合会造成 magnitude explosion，在更强遗忘下损害保留效用。
Method: 单轮服务端聚合：以客户端本地 Fisher 统计作为统一敏感度信号构造 Fisher-normalized base merge，并对 retain 敏感参数施加显式控制；二阶保留投影给出唯一最小距离解，其对偶变量随 retain 客户端数而非模型维度缩放。
Result: 在 WMDP、TOFU、MUSE-HP 上用 Zephyr-7B 与 Llama-3-8B 实验：WMDP 与 MUSE-HP 在可比遗忘水平下效用提升，TOFU 出现指标依赖的权衡；受控比较支持在选定操作点上基础合并与额外保留修正的组合收益。
Conclusion: 把 Fisher 敏感度与二阶保留投影放进服务端聚合，可在单轮通信下缓解 magnitude explosion、在可比遗忘处换回保留效用，但收益依数据集与指标而定（TOFU 上并非一致占优）。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: International Multi-Centre Validation of Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Precise Discrimination between Normal and Abnormal Retinal Development
papers.abstract_en: Arrested retinal development can cause childhood visual impairment, but grading optical coherence tomography scans is difficult to standardise across devices and centres. We developed and evaluated an unsupervised domain adaptation model to classify normal and abnormal retinal development across different OCT systems. This retrospective multicentre study used OCT scans from five centres in four countries and the UK Biobank. Data covered four OCT devices, including table mounted and handheld systems. A ResNet50 based Domain Adversarial Neural Network was trained using labelled images from a source device and unlabelled images from a target device. We evaluated six source to target pairings and compared model performance with seven clinician graders. A separate Heidelberg Spectralis dataset was reserved for external evaluation. Across validation sets, accuracy ranged from 87.75% to 96.06%, sensitivity from 88.68% to 98.38%, and specificity from 78.00% to 98.02%. The best performing model, adapted from TM OCT1 to HH OCT1, achieved 96.06% accuracy and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.994, with a 95% confidence interval from 0.981 to 0.999. Several models also maintained discrimination on the unseen Heidelberg device. Unsupervised domain adaptation enabled OCT classification across devices without labelled target device data. The approach may support more consistent assessment of retinal development and large scale analysis of existing imaging datasets.
papers.comment: Submitted to Nature Medicine. 38 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Supplementary material includes 3 figures and 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 ResNet50 的域对抗神经网络 (Domain Adversarial Neural Network)，用源设备的有标注 OCT 图像与目标设备的无标注图像做无监督域适应 (unsupervised domain adaptation)，区分正常与异常视网膜发育。在五中心四国、四种 OCT 设备的回顾性多中心验证中，准确率 87.75%–96.06%，最佳 TM OCT1→HH OCT1 配对准确率 96.06%、AUC 0.994 (95% CI 0.981–0.999)，可与七位临床阅片者比较。
Motivation: 停滞性视网膜发育异常导致儿童视力损伤，但 OCT 扫描在不同设备与中心之间难以标准化阅片，跨设备标注数据稀缺。
Method: ResNet50 骨干的 DANN：以源设备有标注图像训练、目标设备无标注图像做域对抗对齐；评估六组源到目标设备配对，与七位临床阅片者比较，并保留独立的 Heidelberg Spectralis 数据集做外部评估。数据来自四国五中心及 UK Biobank，覆盖台式与手持共四种 OCT 设备。
Result: 各验证集准确率 87.75%–96.06%，敏感性 88.68%–98.38%，特异性 78.00%–98.02%；最佳模型 TM OCT1→HH OCT1 准确率 96.06%，AUC 0.994 (95% CI 0.981–0.999)。多个模型在未见过的 Heidelberg 设备上保持判别能力。
Conclusion: 无监督域适应可在无需目标设备标注数据的前提下实现跨设备 OCT 分类，有望支持视网膜发育评估的一致化与既有影像数据集的大规模分析。

papers.title: Encoded but Exposed: Language Embeddings can Reveal More Than They Should in Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: Language embeddings are increasingly used in recommenders to represent item content, but their privacy risks remain poorly understood. We study whether item embeddings can reveal item identities when an adversary has access to auxiliary item text from external sources. We show that a simple cosine-similarity attack can recover item identities with high mean reciprocal rank across language models and candidate-set settings on two real-world datasets. Leakage is strongest when the adversary's partial information overlaps with the victim representation, but it also persists through semantic alignment between independently sourced descriptions. We further show that item leakage can propagate to user re-identification from sparse ratings. Finally, we evaluate obfuscated descriptions as a mitigation and find a clear leakage-utility tradeoff.
papers.journal_ref: 3rd Workshop on Evaluating and Applying Recommender Systems with Large Language Models (EARL 2026), co-located with the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 推荐系统中物品的语言嵌入可被余弦相似度攻击还原物品身份：攻击者只需外部来源的物品文本，在两个真实数据集上跨多种语言模型与候选集设置都取得高 MRR。泄漏在攻击者部分信息与受害者表示重叠时最强，也通过独立来源描述的语义对齐持续存在，并可从稀疏评分进一步传播到用户重识别；混淆描述能压泄漏但带来明确的泄漏-效用权衡。
Motivation: 物品嵌入被广泛用于表示内容，但其隐私风险研究不足：外部文本即可作为辅助信息的攻击面尚未被刻画。
Method: 构造基于余弦相似度的物品身份还原攻击，输入为攻击者从外部来源获得的物品文本；在两个真实数据集上跨多个语言模型与候选集设置评估，并检验从物品泄漏到稀疏评分下用户重识别的传播，最后评估混淆描述作为缓解手段。
Result: 余弦相似度攻击在两个真实数据集上、跨语言模型与候选集设置均以高 MRR 还原物品身份；泄漏在攻击者部分信息与受害者表示重叠时最强，也经独立来源描述的语义对齐持续；物品泄漏可传播到稀疏评分下的用户重识别；混淆描述呈现清晰的泄漏-效用权衡。
Conclusion: 语言嵌入本身即构成身份泄漏通道，缓解手段必须在泄漏与效用之间取舍。

papers.title: Robust Covariance Estimation for Entry-wise Contaminated and Partially Observed Data via Expectation Maximization Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: Robust covariance estimation under entry-wise contamination and missing data is challenging in various signal processing applications. Under the Student-$t$ model, observation-level reweighting induces a uniform attenuation across samples, which can lead to cumulative information loss even when most coordinates remain informative. The alternative Student-$t^*$ model enables coordinate-wise robustness, but its E-step is not available in closed form. We extend inference for the Student-$t^*$ model to incomplete observations through a stochastic approximation EM (SAEM) algorithm operating on a reduced latent space: stochastic updates of the coordinate-wise scales are combined with Rao-Blackwellized Gaussian conditional moments, which avoids explicit sampling of latent Gaussian variables while preserving a likelihood-based framework. Experiments on synthetic and real sensor data show a lower Fisher-Rao error than Gaussian, Student-$t$, imputation-based and detect-then-estimate estimators at moderate to high outlier rates under diffuse contamination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在逐元素污染与缺失并存的协方差估计问题上，把 Student-t* 模型的推断扩展到不完整观测：用作用在缩减潜空间上的 SAEM，坐标尺度做随机更新、高斯条件矩用 Rao-Blackwell 化避免显式采样。在合成与真实传感器数据上，中高离群率且污染弥散时，其 Fisher-Rao 误差低于 Gaussian、Student-t、插补法与 detect-then-estimate 估计器。
Motivation: 信号处理中协方差估计常同时遭遇逐元素污染与数据缺失：观测级重加权的 Student-t 模型对所有样本均匀衰减，即使多数坐标仍有信息也会累积损失信息；而支持坐标级稳健性的 Student-t* 模型其 E-step 没有闭式解。
Method: 在 Student-t* 模型上推断不完整观测，采用作用于缩减潜空间的随机近似 EM (SAEM)：坐标级尺度做随机更新，高斯条件矩用 Rao-Blackwell 化给出，从而不显式采样潜高斯变量，同时保持基于似然的框架。
Result: 在合成数据与真实传感器数据上，当离群率为中到高且污染呈弥散分布 (diffuse contamination) 时，该方法的 Fisher-Rao 误差低于 Gaussian、Student-t、基于插补 (imputation-based) 以及 detect-then-estimate 估计器。
Conclusion: 坐标级稳健性可以在缺失数据下通过 SAEM 与 Rao-Blackwell 化实现闭式替代，从而在弥散污染、中高离群率的场景中比观测级重加权与插补类方法取得更低的协方差估计误差。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Human Interventions as Labels: Localizing, Steering, and (Sometimes) Editing the Computations Behind LLM Agent Failures
papers.abstract_en: When an LLM agent misbehaves, a human steps in, and that intervention is usually discarded or replayed as training data. We treat it instead as a measurement: a label pointing at the internal computation that failed. We study it in a controlled agent environment, on one failure (asking a clarifying question when the request was already unambiguous), with labels from a rule-based overseer validated against blind human judgment. Claims cover eligible models, which both over-ask and sometimes act on matched unambiguous requests: five of thirteen qualified (Qwen2.5-3B, gemma-2-2b, OLMo-3-7B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, Phi-4). Four findings. First, the ask-vs-act decision is causally localizable in every eligible family: a direction learned from intervention labels flips 72-100% of held-out over-asks at a definite residual-stream depth, with site and dose chosen on training data, and random directions under the same procedure flip at most one episode. Second, over-asking has two mechanistic signatures: in four families the model demonstrably knows the request is unambiguous (the belief is decodable, causally inert and orthogonal to the decision) and asks anyway; in the fifth, the rare over-asks track different world-representations. Third, steering gated on a probe readout removes most of the simulated oversight burden while legitimate questions survive (bootstrap 95% intervals exclude zero); a prompt instruction makes it worse. Fourth, consolidating the fix into the weights yields a map, not a rule: on one model a LoRA confined to the causal band passes every criterion fixed in advance while behavior cloning on identical data breaks retention; on three families the reverse holds; on the fifth the outcome crosses the boundary across seeds. A geometric rule written down in advance to predict the regime failed on two out-of-family tests; we report the failure and stop rather than fit a replacement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM agent 中人类干预当作指向失败内部计算的标签：在受控环境中针对「请求已明确仍追问澄清」这一失败，用干预标签学出的方向在残差流特定深度上翻转 72–100% 的留出 over-ask，随机方向至多翻转一个 episode。探针门控的 steering 去掉了大部分模拟监督负担且合法提问保留，而把修复固化进权重（LoRA vs 行为克隆）的结果在不同模型家族间不一致，事先写下的几何规则在两个 out-of-family 测试上失败。
Motivation: LLM agent 出错时的人类干预通常被丢弃或仅作为训练数据回放，其作为「指向失败内部计算的标签」的测量价值未被利用；同时 over-asking 的机制来源与修复方式（steering vs 权重编辑）在不同模型家族间缺乏可判定的规律。
Method: 在受控 agent 环境中研究单一失败类型（请求已明确仍追问），标签由基于规则的 overseer 生成并经盲评人类判断校验；从干预标签学习方向，在残差流的特定深度与剂量（在训练数据上选定）上做 steering，并用探针读数门控 steering；再用 LoRA 与行为克隆在相同数据上把修复固化进权重，事先写下的几何规则用于预测 regime 并在 out-of-family 测试上检验。
Result: 13 个模型中 5 个合格（Qwen2.5-3B、gemma-2-2b、OLMo-3-7B、Mistral-Nemo-12B、Phi-4）；干预方向在每个合格家族中翻转 72–100% 的留出 over-ask，随机方向至多翻转 1 个 episode；4 个家族中模型可解码出「请求明确」的信念但该信念对决策因果惰性且与决策正交，第 5 个家族的稀有 over-ask 追踪不同的 world-representation；探针门控 steering 去除大部分模拟监督负担且合法提问存活（bootstrap 95% 区间不含零），prompt 指令反而更糟；权重固化上，一个模型的 LoRA（限制在因果带内）通过全部预设标准而相同数据上的行为克隆破坏 retention，三个家族结论相反，第五个家族结果跨随机种子跨越边界；事先写下的几何规则在两个 out-of-family 测试上失败。

papers.title: Mixture of Multi-Sequence Feature Difference for Contrast-Enhanced MRI Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (CE-MRI) is crucial for accurately diagnosing and segmenting brain tumors. However, the acquisition of CE-MRI requires injecting contrast agents, which poses potential health risks and increases scan costs. Here, we propose a CE-MRI synthesis method from non-contrast sequences, reducing both risk and cost. Unlike existing methods that rely on channel-wise concatenation to fuse multi-sequence information for synthesis, we introduce a Mixture of Feature Difference (MoFD) module. The proposed module uses a dynamic weighting strategy to adaptively select and aggregate informative features from both individual source sequences and explicit differences among them. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms baselines in terms of image fidelity and perceptual quality on the UCSF-PDGM and UPenn-GBM datasets. Our method successfully reconstructs tumor regions and achieves segmentation performance comparable to that obtained with real CE-MRI. Our ablation studies show that although adversarial learning improves perceptual quality, a regression-based variant of our method achieves higher structural fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Mixture of Feature Difference (MoFD) 模块，用动态加权从各源序列及其显式差分中自适应选取聚合特征，从非增强序列合成对比增强 MRI (CE-MRI)。在 UCSF-PDGM 与 UPenn-GBM 上，图像保真度与感知质量超过基线，肿瘤区重建后的分割性能与真实 CE-MRI 相当；消融显示对抗学习提升感知质量，而回归变体结构保真度更高。
Motivation: CE-MRI 诊断与分割脑肿瘤需注射对比剂，带来健康风险并抬高扫描成本，因此需要从非增强序列合成替代。
Method: 提出 MoFD 模块取代逐通道拼接：以动态加权策略自适应选择并聚合单个源序列特征与序列间的显式差分特征，用于 CE-MRI 合成，并给出对抗学习版与回归变体两个版本。
Result: 在 UCSF-PDGM 与 UPenn-GBM 数据集上，定量与定性评估显示该方法在图像保真度和感知质量上超过基线；肿瘤区重建后分割性能与真实 CE-MRI 相当；消融表明对抗学习改善感知质量，回归变体结构保真度更高。
Conclusion: 多序列差分特征的动态加权融合可替代通道拼接，从非增强序列合成的 CE-MRI 能支撑脑肿瘤分割；若更看重结构保真度应选回归变体而非对抗训练。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Bridging the Markerless Tracking Validation Gap: Intraoperative X-ray Workflow Integration
papers.abstract_en: Markerless intraoperative tracking of spinal anatomy via RGB-D sensors is a promising alternative to invasive bone-anchored fiducials, yet no existing clinical dataset provides independent subsurface ground truth for validating these methods. We address this gap with a clinically viable pipeline that derives per-vertebra 6-DoF pose from routine intraoperative C-arm fluoroscopy, co-registered to the RGB-D camera frame through a multimodal fiducial array detectable in both imaging modalities. Critically, the pipeline requires no additional radiation, instrumentation, or deviation from standard surgical workflows, relying solely on the fluoroscopic images already acquired during routine level checks. A calibrated transform chain links the vertebral pose recovered via multi-view 2D-3D CT-to-fluoroscopy registration to the RGB-D coordinate frame, enabling direct comparison of any markerless registration estimate against a subsurface reference. Ex vivo validation against optically tracked ovine vertebrae confirms end-to-end accuracy of 2.06 +- 0.29 mm and 3.35 +- 0.93 degrees, sufficient to serve as independent ground truth for methods with substantially larger errors. We demonstrate the pipeline's utility by evaluating two markerless registration strategies on clinical data spanning 11 vertebrae across 1,500 frames from three surgical sequences: the first such evaluation against an independent subsurface reference in a clinical setting. The proposed framework provides reusable infrastructure for benchmarking emerging markerless tracking methods on real surgical data.

TL;DR: 提出一条用常规术中 C 臂透视生成皮下 6-DoF 椎体真值的流程，经双模态 fiducial 阵列配准到 RGB-D 相机坐标系，无需额外辐射或改变手术流程。离体光学追踪的羊椎体验证端到端精度 2.06 ± 0.29 mm 与 3.35 ± 0.93°，并据此在 11 个椎体、1,500 帧、三段手术序列上首次对两种无标记配准策略做独立皮下真值评测。
Motivation: 无标记 RGB-D 术中脊柱追踪缺少独立的皮下真值数据集，现有方法无法在真实临床条件下被客观验证。
Method: 从常规 C 臂透视经多视角 2D-3D CT-to-fluoroscopy 配准恢复每椎体 6-DoF 位姿，用在两种成像模态均可检测的多模态 fiducial 阵列把透视坐标系与 RGB-D 相机坐标系配准，再由标定的变换链把皮下参考接到相机坐标系，使任意无标记配准结果可直接比对。
Result: 离体光学追踪羊椎体的端到端精度为 2.06 ± 0.29 mm 和 3.35 ± 0.93°；在覆盖 11 个椎体、1,500 帧、三段手术序列的临床数据上评测了两种无标记配准策略，为首次在临床场景中对照独立皮下真值的评测。
Conclusion: 常规透视加标定变换链足以提供精度远高于待测方法误差的皮下真值，可作为真实手术数据上无标记追踪方法的可复用基准基础设施。

papers.title: ShiftQAT: Quantization-Aware Training for the Numerical Contract of a Fixed-Function Edge CNN Accelerator
papers.abstract_en: Fixed-function CNN accelerators make edge inference fast and energy-efficient, but they execute only networks that obey a precise numerical contract. On the MAX7800x family, this contract requires power-of-two, per-tensor, symmetric scales, 8-bit activations and biases, integer-only arithmetic, and one statically configured shift per layer. We present ShiftQAT, the quantization-aware training (QAT) flow we developed for this family, which produces networks satisfying the contract by construction. It is the default training path of ai8x-training, the family's open-source training toolchain. ShiftQAT resolves residual, concatenation, and weight-sharing dependencies so that activation scales propagate statically and each layer's requantization reduces to one offline-configured shift. It also trains weights and biases on a joint power-of-two grid that fits the 8-bit bias budget. Among the compared methods, only ShiftQAT satisfies all of the contract's scaling constraints, including signed 8-bit activation storage. Even so, on ImageNet it matches the W8A8 accuracy drop of less constrained QAT methods and stays within 2.9 percentage points of FP32 at W4A8. On MAX78002 silicon, ShiftQAT-trained MobileNetV2 and ResNet-18 classify ImageNet images in 14.6 and 8.4 ms at 5.1 and 2.8 mJ per inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ShiftQAT 是 MAX7800x 系列固定功能 CNN 加速器的量化感知训练流程，通过静态传播激活 scale、把每层重量化归结为一次离线配置的 shift，并在权重与偏置上使用联合 2 的幂网格，使网络按构造满足硬件数值契约。在 ImageNet 上它匹配约束更宽松的 W8A8 QAT 精度，W4A8 距 FP32 不超过 2.9 个百分点；MAX78002 硅片上 MobileNetV2 与 ResNet-18 分别以 14.6/8.4 ms、5.1/2.8 mJ 每次推理完成分类。
Motivation: 固定功能边缘 CNN 加速器速度快、能效高，但只执行满足严格数值契约的网络：2 的幂、per-tensor 对称 scale、8-bit 激活与偏置、纯整数运算、每层一次静态 shift；一般 QAT 方法无法同时满足这些约束。
Method: ShiftQAT 作为 ai8x-training 的默认训练路径，解析残差、拼接与权重共享依赖以让激活 scale 静态传播，使每层重量化退化为一次离线 shift；权重与偏置在适配 8-bit 偏置预算的 2 的幂联合网格上训练。
Result: 在对比方法中只有 ShiftQAT 满足全部 scale 约束（含 signed 8-bit 激活存储）；ImageNet 上匹配约束更宽松的 W8A8 QAT 方法的精度下降，W4A8 距 FP32 在 2.9 个百分点以内；MAX78002 硅片上 ShiftQAT 训练的 MobileNetV2 与 ResNet-18 分类延迟为 14.6 ms 与 8.4 ms，每次推理能耗 5.1 mJ 与 2.8 mJ。
Conclusion: 把硬件数值契约直接编码进训练，可以在不牺牲相对精度的前提下让边缘 CNN 在固定功能加速器上按构造合规运行。

papers.title: Hurricane Laura-induced loads on wind turbines -- Part I: High-fidelity modeling and sensitivity to turbulent inflow conditions
papers.abstract_en: Tropical cyclones can produce extreme winds in the lowest portion of the boundary layer, posing high risks to critical energy infrastructure, including wind energy systems. This study evaluates the dynamic response of an idling wind turbine to turbulent inflow generated during the passage of a hurricane. We performed large-eddy simulations of Hurricane Laura (2020) at several grid resolutions -- coarse $(Δx=55.55\,{\rm m})$, intermediate $(Δx=25\,{\rm m})$, and fine $(Δx=10\,{\rm m})$ -- to investigate differences in mean flow characteristics and turbulence structures as the hurricane progresses across a virtual wind turbine location. The large-eddy simulation data served as direct inflow conditions for aeroelastic simulations to assess the turbine's response. Our results reveal significant differences in the mean wind and turbulent flow structures between the grid resolutions, leading to distinct impacts on the wind turbine's aeroelastic behavior. These findings emphasize the need for high-resolution inflow information to better predict extreme loads and inform the design of wind turbines in regions frequently affected by tropical cyclones. As a continuation of this work, Part II of this study will evaluate the turbine's response from different locations relative to the storm's trajectory and compare it with current wind turbine design practices.
papers.comment: Submitted to Journal of Wind Engineering and Industrial Aerodynamics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 55.55 m、25 m、10 m 三档网格的 Hurricane Laura (2020) 大涡模拟 (LES) 作为入流，驱动停机状态风力机的气弹仿真，发现网格分辨率显著改变平均风与湍流结构，进而导致风力机气弹响应明显不同。结论是预测热带气旋区极端载荷必须提供高分辨率入流信息。
Motivation: 热带气旋在边界层底部产生极端风，威胁风电等关键能源基础设施；粗分辨率入流无法刻画飓风过境时的湍流结构，导致停机风力机极端载荷预测不可靠。
Method: 对 Hurricane Laura (2020) 做三档网格 LES（Δx=55.55 m 粗、25 m 中、10 m 细），比较飓风推进到虚拟风力机位置过程中平均流与湍流结构的差异；LES 输出直接作为气弹 (aeroelastic) 仿真的入流条件，评估停机风力机的动态响应。
Result: 三档网格分辨率在平均风与湍流结构上存在显著差异，并导致风力机气弹行为的不同；摘要未给出具体载荷数值。
Conclusion: 高分辨率入流信息是准确预测热带气旋区风力机极端载荷并支撑设计的前提；Part II 将评估风暴轨迹上不同位置的响应并与现行设计规范对比。

summary_sections.method: 对 Hurricane Laura (2020) 做三档网格 LES（Δx=55.55 m 粗、25 m 中、10 m 细），比较飓风推进到虚拟风力机位置过程中平均流与湍流结构的差异；LES 输出直接作为气弹 (aeroelastic) 仿真的入流条件，评估停机风力机的动态响应。
summary_sections.result: 三档网格分辨率在平均风与湍流结构上存在显著差异，并导致风力机气弹行为的不同；摘要未给出具体载荷数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 高分辨率入流信息是准确预测热带气旋区风力机极端载荷并支撑设计的前提；Part II 将评估风暴轨迹上不同位置的响应并与现行设计规范对比。

papers.title: MARS: A Momentum-Aware Adaptive Rating System for Personalized Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive assessment systems personalize learning by estimating learner proficiency and recommending suitable questions. However, many existing approaches rely on fixed difficulty labels, static rating updates, or black-box prediction models that provide limited control over rating stability, interpretability, and time-constrained routing. This paper proposes MARS, a Momentum-Aware Adaptive Rating System for interpretable adaptive assessment. MARS represents the question bank as a directed weighted knowledge graph and updates learner proficiency using dynamic rating sensitivity, response quality, and momentum-aware learner velocity. We also formulate a time-budgeted mark-maximization objective in which the policy selects questions within a fixed test duration under negative marking. Experiments on ASSISTments 2009 and MARS-SimExam evaluate MARS for prediction, rating stability, and adaptive routing. Results show that MARS provides smoother rating updates than Fixed Elo and achieves the highest score under time-budgeted negative-marking routing, improving the total score by 8.09 over the strongest baseline and reducing overtime violations from 50% to 5.6%. These results suggest that MARS is suitable for real-time, interpretable, and deployment-friendly adaptive assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MARS 把题库建成有向加权知识图谱，用动态评分敏感度、作答质量与动量感知的学习者速度更新能力值，并在固定考试时长与负分规则下做时间预算内的得分最大化选题。在 ASSISTments 2009 与 MARS-SimExam 上，评分更新比 Fixed Elo 更平滑，总分比最强基线高 8.09，超时违规率从 50% 降到 5.6%。
Motivation: 现有自适应测评依赖固定难度标签、静态评分更新或黑盒预测，评分稳定性、可解释性与限时选题路由都缺乏可控性。
Method: 题库表示为有向加权知识图谱；能力更新融合动态评分敏感度、作答质量与动量感知的学习者速度 (momentum-aware velocity)；选题策略求解固定时长、含负分的时间预算 mark-maximization 目标。
Result: 在 ASSISTments 2009 与 MARS-SimExam 上评估预测、评分稳定性与自适应路由：评分更新比 Fixed Elo 更平滑；限时负分路由下总分比最强基线提高 8.09，超时违规率由 50% 降至 5.6%。
Conclusion: 带动量的评分更新加时间预算选题，可同时换来更平滑的评分与更高的限时得分，作者据此认为 MARS 适合实时、可解释、可部署的自适应测评。

papers.title: Router Drift Control: Mitigating Off-Policy Degradation in Mixture-of-Experts Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) can become off-policy due to training-inference mismatch, mini-batch updates, and asynchronous training.The resulting mismatch is especially harmful in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, where rollout--training discrepancies can change routing decisions and lead to router drift. Rollout Routing Replay (R3) mitigates this mismatch by reusing expert selections from the rollout stage during training. Our analysis shows that routing replay introduces gradient bias by losing contributions from experts selected by the training router but not the rollout router. To address this, we propose Router Drift Control (RDC), which uses routing disagreement between rollout and training as a signal of off-policy staleness and selectively rejects high-drift responses. The sequence-level filtering avoids gradient bias introduced by replay while preserving native expert selection and the associated learning signals for retained responses. Experiments show that RDC achieves larger gains as policy staleness increases and remains effective in asynchronous RL. In asynchronous training, RDC combined with Truncated Importance Sampling (TIS) improves the average peak validation accuracy across AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 by 5.5 points over TIS and 4.5 points over R3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoE 强化学习中训练与推理不一致会改变专家路由并造成 router drift，而 Rollout Routing Replay (R3) 复用 rollout 期专家选择会丢失训练路由独有专家的梯度贡献、引入梯度偏差。Router Drift Control (RDC) 用 rollout 与训练路由的分歧度量 off-policy staleness，按序列级过滤高漂移响应，从而避开 replay 的梯度偏差并保留原生专家选择。异步训练下 RDC 配合 Truncated Importance Sampling (TIS) 比 TIS 高 5.5 点、比 R3 高 4.5 点（AIME 2024 与 AIME 2025 平均峰值验证准确率）。
Motivation: 训练-推理不一致、mini-batch 更新与异步训练使 RL 变为 off-policy，在 MoE 中 rollout 与训练的差异会改变路由决策并引发 router drift；现有 R3 的 routing replay 会丢掉训练路由选中但 rollout 路由未选中专家的梯度贡献。
Method: 提出 Router Drift Control (RDC)：以 rollout 路由与训练路由的 routing disagreement 作为 off-policy staleness 信号，按序列级选择性拒绝高漂移响应，避免 replay 引入的梯度偏差，同时对保留响应保留原生专家选择与学习信号；可与 Truncated Importance Sampling (TIS) 组合用于异步 RL。
Result: 在异步训练中，RDC+TIS 相对 TIS 将 AIME 2024 与 AIME 2025 的平均峰值验证准确率提高 5.5 点，相对 R3 提高 4.5 点；RDC 在 policy staleness 增大时收益更大，并在异步 RL 中保持有效。
Conclusion: 路由分歧可作为 off-policy staleness 的可操作信号：按序列级拒绝高漂移响应，比 routing replay 更能保住 MoE 异步 RL 的学习信号与验证准确率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Classical methods for modern applications: synthetic tabular data generation using lightweight discrete response continuous latent variable model
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present a lightweight algorithm for modelling tabular data containing both continuous and discrete variables. The method uses empirical marginal distributions and a selected quantile function to transform the data into a continuous latent space, where a distribution of choice, e.g. a multivariate Gaussian, can be efficiently estimated and applied. While this approach is closely related to classical well-established machine learning methods, we present a novel adaptation that fits well within the contemporary computational ecosystem. Unlike in the case of deep architectures, it results in a simple implementation with few dependencies, robust training/estimation, as well as efficient sampling. The transformation preserves complex marginal distributions and correlations, providing high-fidelity models, especially for data with unimodal distributions. One of the key characteristics of the proposed approach is its continuous representation of discrete variables. While highly desirable, this introduces a significant challenge, since a single observation corresponds to a region rather than a point in the latent space. We show that this ambiguity naturally leads to a Monte Carlo expectation-maximisation (MCEM) formulation, whose auxiliary objective can be expressed as a weighted latent-space likelihood. This, in turn, allows conventional maximum-likelihood estimators to be used within an efficient and robust optimisation procedure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出轻量级合成表格数据生成方法：用经验边缘分布加选定分位数函数把混合连续/离散变量变换到连续潜空间，在潜空间拟合多元高斯等分布后采样。离散变量的连续表示使单个观测对应潜空间中的一个区域，该歧义自然导出 Monte Carlo 期望最大化 (MCEM)，其辅助目标写成加权潜空间似然，从而可直接用常规最大似然估计器做稳健优化。
Motivation: 含连续与离散混合变量的表格数据生成常依赖深度架构，实现复杂、依赖多、训练不稳；离散变量若连续化，单个观测对应潜空间区域而非点，直接套用最大似然会遇到歧义。
Method: 以经验边缘分布加选定分位数函数把数据变换到连续潜空间，在其中估计并采样多元高斯等选定分布；对离散变量连续化造成的区域歧义，推导出 MCEM 形式，把辅助目标表达为加权潜空间似然，再用常规最大似然估计器在高效稳健的优化流程中求解。
Result: 变换保留复杂边缘分布与相关性，对单峰分布数据给出高保真模型；相比深度架构，实现简单、依赖少、训练/估计稳健且采样高效。
Conclusion: 经典分位数变换加潜空间高斯的路线经 MCEM 适配即可处理离散变量的区域歧义，在当代计算生态中是深度生成模型的轻量替代，尤其适合单峰表格数据。

papers.title: Diffusion Language Models as Open Quantum Systems
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models generate text by reversing a classical diffusion process over token sequences. We show that their continuous-time forward and reverse dynamics can be embedded in the framework of open quantum systems, which describes quantum systems interacting with their environment. This connection provides a basis for extending diffusion sampling to superpositions of sentence states and for modifying the underlying generation dynamics. We construct a $τ$-leaping unraveling scheme that simulates stochastic trajectories of these states while updating multiple token positions at each step. This enables generation conditioned on superposed prompts or thoughts, which we call Superposition of Prompts (SoP) and Superposition of Thoughts (SoT). The same formulation yields Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR): perturbing the masked-diffusion dynamics produces a confidence-based rule for revising previously generated tokens. Experiments with pretrained diffusion language models show that superposition-based generation can retain information from conditioning components not selected at the final measurement, while QIR improves LLM-assessed text quality when applied at an appropriate stage of generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把扩散语言模型的连续时间正反向动力学嵌入开放量子系统 (open quantum systems) 框架，据此提出 τ-leaping 解缠绕方案，一次更新多个 token 位置并让状态处于句子叠加。由此得到 Superposition of Prompts (SoP) 与 Superposition of Thoughts (SoT)：预训练扩散语言模型上，叠加生成能保留最终测量时未被选中的条件分量中的信息；同一表述导出的 Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR) 在生成的合适阶段施加时，以置信度规则改写已生成 token 并提升 LLM 评判的文本质量。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型逐 token 反转经典扩散过程，其采样只能落在单一 token 序列上，难以在生成中同时承载多个条件提示或中间想法，也无法回头修订已生成位置。
Method: 将连续时间正向与反向动力学嵌入开放量子系统表述，构造 τ-leaping unraveling scheme 模拟状态的随机轨迹并在每步更新多个 token 位置；由同一表述扰动 masked-diffusion 动力学，导出基于置信度的 Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR) 重遮蔽规则。
Result: 在预训练扩散语言模型上的实验显示：叠加式生成可保留最终测量时未被选中的条件分量所含信息；QIR 在生成的合适阶段施加时提升 LLM 评判的文本质量。
Conclusion: 开放量子系统表述可作为改造扩散采样的操作性框架：既支持对句子状态做叠加条件生成，也导出置信度驱动的重遮蔽修订规则。

papers.title: Edit4D: Editable 4D Scene Generation with Textual Control
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Edit4D, an editable text-to-4D scene generation framework that constructs 4D scenes from separate background and dynamic character representations. Recent advances in generative models have enabled text-driven dynamic scene synthesis, but editable 4D scene generation remains challenging due to the need to preserve spatial geometry and temporal dynamics. Existing approaches typically generate holistic scene videos, where the background and dynamic characters are coupled, making object-level editing and flexible camera control difficult. Edit4D addresses these limitations through a stage-specific generation pipeline. Given a user instruction, Edit4D first decomposes it into stage-specific prompts for background, dynamic character, and scene-character composition. Using these prompts, we synthesize multi-view scene images with text-to-image and camera-conditioned generative priors and reconstruct a background 3D Gaussian splatting representation. We then generate a character image, animate it with an image-conditioned video prior, reconstruct a 4D mesh, and bind Gaussian primitives to obtain a character representation. Finally, both components are composed through text-guided segmentation and contact-aware optimization. A global scene refinement is then performed to improve harmonization and rendering consistency. By integrating stage-specific components, Edit4D enables controllable camera motion, flexible object-level editing, and the practical construction of editable 4D scenes. Project page: https://chanwo0kim.github.io/Edit4D/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Edit4D 把文本指令拆成背景、动态角色、场景-角色合成三类阶段提示，分别生成背景 3D Gaussian splatting 与绑定 Gaussian 原语的 4D mesh 角色，再用文本引导分割与接触感知优化合成，实现可控相机运动与对象级编辑。
Motivation: 现有文本驱动动态场景合成把背景与动态角色耦合在整段场景视频里生成，导致对象级编辑和灵活相机控制困难，且难以同时保持空间几何与时序动态。
Method: 分阶段生成管线：先将用户指令分解为背景、动态角色、场景-角色合成的阶段提示；用 text-to-image 与相机条件生成先验合成多视角场景图并重建背景 3D Gaussian splatting；再生成角色图、用 image-conditioned video prior 做动画、重建 4D mesh 并绑定 Gaussian 原语；最后通过文本引导分割与接触感知优化合成两部分，并做全局场景 refinement 改善协调性与渲染一致性。
Result: 提出可编辑 4D 场景生成框架 Edit4D，支持可控相机运动、灵活对象级编辑与可编辑 4D 场景的实际构建；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 把背景与动态角色拆成阶段化组件再合成，是实现文本控制下可编辑 4D 场景的可行路径。

papers.title: FusionAudit: Pathway-Conditioned Robustness Auditing for Native Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: As vision-language models (VLMs) transition from frozen-encoder pipelines to native multimodal architectures, the visual channel increasingly serves as both a perceptual input and a carrier of rendered text that competes with user prompts. Current single-attack, pixel-centric evaluations fail to capture this complexity: they collapse distinct visual attack surfaces into a single scalar and ignore how architectural shifts alter vulnerability. We introduce PaRMA, an evidence-based auditing framework that defines pathway-conditioned risk over two primary image-level interventions: pixel perturbation and rendered-text insertion. Instead of arbitrary attack enumeration, PaRMA uses pathway-specific diagnostics to expose architecture-specific blind spots. Notably, we uncover a see-but-not-deceived signature where native VLMs attend heavily to typographic overlays but visually reject them, and we identify an objective mismatch between encoder-level and answer-level attacks in deep-fusion models. To exploit these findings, we instantiate FusionAudit, introducing two diagnostic-motivated attacks: MANTIS (margin-aware pixel perturbation) and Nat-Evid (host-congruent semantic insertion). Evaluating 18 open-weight VLMs across a novel nativeness taxonomy, we demonstrate that legacy single-attack rankings (e.g., PGD) are unstable for native models. Our diagnostic-driven attacks substantially raise the estimated residual risk, showing that PaRMA provides a falsifiable, evidence-driven auditing methodology for uncovering vulnerabilities missed by standard benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PaRMA 审计框架，把原生多模态 VLM 的视觉风险按像素扰动与渲染文本插入两条通路分别度量，并据此构造 MANTIS 与 Nat-Evid 两种攻击。在 18 个开源权重 VLM 上发现原生模型呈现「看见但不被欺骗」特征，且 PGD 等传统单攻击排名对原生模型不稳定。
Motivation: VLM 从冻结编码器转向原生多模态后，视觉通道同时是感知输入和渲染文本载体；现有单攻击、以像素为中心的评测把不同攻击面压成一个标量，无法反映架构变化带来的脆弱性差异。
Method: PaRMA 定义通路条件化风险，覆盖像素扰动与渲染文本插入两类图像级干预，用通路专属诊断暴露架构盲点；再据此实例化 MANTIS（margin-aware 像素扰动）与 Nat-Evid（host-congruent 语义插入）两种攻击，在一套新的 nativeness 分类体系上评测 18 个开源权重 VLM。
Result: 发现原生 VLM 高度关注排版覆盖文本却在视觉上拒绝它（see-but-not-deceived），以及 deep-fusion 模型中编码器级与答案级攻击的目标错配；PGD 等传统单攻击排名对原生模型不稳定；诊断驱动攻击显著抬高估计残余风险。
Conclusion: 原生多模态模型的脆弱性必须按通路分别审计，单像素攻击排名会误导；PaRMA 提供可证伪、证据驱动的审计方法，能发现标准基准漏掉的漏洞。

papers.title: Approaching Backpropagation Accuracy with Weight Perturbation on MNIST
papers.abstract_en: Weight perturbation (WP) estimates learning directions from random parameter perturbations and a scalar change in loss, without backpropagating derivatives. We examine how batch size, training duration, and estimator stabilization affect its attainable accuracy in fully connected MNIST networks. In the shallow configuration, large-batch training reaches approximately 97\% test accuracy, compared with an early backpropagation (BP) reference near 97.5--98\%. The same comparison exposes a substantial efficiency gap: under a ten-epoch budget, shallow WP reaches 90.2\%, whereas the reported BP reference reaches 97.4\%. Epoch-indexed curves show diminishing returns from increasing batch size beyond 4,000. Learning-rate reduction and averaging independent perturbation-based updates also stabilize deeper networks, although their recorded results do not establish BP-level accuracy. We distinguish these empirical findings from a finite-horizon approximation argument: under stated regularity conditions, population WP can approximate a fixed gradient-descent trajectory arbitrarily closely at any fixed finite depth. Positive classification margins then suffice to preserve the reference predictions on a finite test set with arbitrarily high probability. Together, the results identify near-BP accuracy as a configuration- and budget-dependent possibility, rather than evidence of equal efficiency or an unconditional accuracy guarantee across depth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在全连接 MNIST 上系统检验权值扰动 (weight perturbation, WP) 能逼近反向传播 (BP) 精度的条件：浅层网络大批量训练可达约 97% 测试精度，接近 BP 参考的 97.5–98%；但十 epoch 预算下 WP 只有 90.2% 而 BP 参考为 97.4%，且批量超过 4000 后收益递减。作者据此把「接近 BP 精度」界定为依赖配置与预算的可能性，而非等效率或跨深度的无条件保证。
Motivation: WP 只靠随机参数扰动和标量损失变化估计学习方向、不回传导数，但其可达精度受批量、训练时长与稳定化手段影响，与 BP 的效率差距和适用边界此前不清楚。
Method: 在全连接 MNIST 网络上考察批量大小、训练时长与估计器稳定化（学习率下调、对独立扰动更新取平均）对 WP 可达精度的影响，并与早期 BP 参考对照；另给出有限时域近似论证：在给定正则条件下 population WP 可在任意固定深度上任意接近一条固定梯度下降轨迹，正分类间隔再保证有限测试集上以任意高概率保持参考预测。
Result: 浅层配置大批量 WP 达约 97% 测试精度，BP 参考约 97.5–98%；十 epoch 预算下浅层 WP 90.2% 对 BP 参考 97.4%；批量超过 4000 后 epoch 曲线显示收益递减；学习率下调与独立扰动更新平均能稳定更深网络，但记录结果未达到 BP 级精度。
Conclusion: 接近 BP 的精度是配置与预算依赖的可能结果，不等于效率相同，也不是跨深度的无条件精度保证；更深网络的稳定化手段尚不足以达到 BP 水平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does "Post-Call" Begin? An Availability Contract for Earnings-Call NLP Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Corporate financial disclosures often unfold over time, with announcements, prepared remarks, and discussion spanning multiple high-frequency return intervals. Financial NLP benchmarks can therefore suffer from a within-event timing mismatch when the prediction target begins before the textual or audio input used by a model could be complete. Chronological train--test splits do not prevent this mismatch, because it occurs inside individual events rather than across samples. We introduce an Availability Contract, which requires a benchmark to state the input boundary, evidence for input availability, the outcome start, and the claims supported by that evidence. We apply this framework to 552 earnings calls from 24 firms. For each call, we hold the return endpoint fixed and compare the previous close, a documentary call-start proxy, and a completion proxy based on reconstructed audio end plus a stipulated processing allowance. At this baseline, moving from the call-start proxy to the completion proxy flips return signs for 9.4% of calls. Holding completion-clock cutpoints fixed, 28.3% change quintile. In an independent release-session analysis of a public earnings-call volatility benchmark, shifting before-market target windows forward by one trading session raises three-day mean squared error by 18.1-21.4% across four frozen prediction streams, while their point rankings remain unchanged. Together, the results show that labels and losses can depend materially on the declared outcome clock even when model rankings appear stable. The Availability Contract makes this assumption explicit and ties post-input claims to the available timing evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 财报电话会 NLP 基准存在事件内时序错位：预测目标起点可能早于模型输入（文本/音频）真正完整可用的时刻，按时间切分训练测试集无法消除。作者提出 Availability Contract，要求基准声明输入边界、可用性证据、结果起点与所支持的结论；在 552 场电话会、24 家公司上，把起点代理换成完成代理会使 9.4% 的收益变号，固定完成时钟下 28.3% 的分位归属改变；对一个公开财报波动率基准，把盘前目标窗口后移一个交易时段使三日 MSE 上升 18.1–21.4%，但四条冻结预测流的排序不变。
Motivation: 财报披露跨越多个高频收益区间，预测目标可能在输入完整之前就开始；这种事件内时序错位使标签与损失依赖于所声明的“结果时钟”，而按时间切分无法检测。
Method: 提出 Availability Contract 框架，要求基准声明输入边界、输入可用性证据、结果起点及其支撑的结论；在 552 场电话会（24 家公司）上固定收益终点，比较前收盘价、电话会开始的文献代理、以及基于重建音频结束加规定处理余量的完成代理；另对一个公开财报电话会波动率基准做独立的发布时段分析，比较四条冻结预测流。
Result: 在该基线下，从 call-start 代理切到 completion 代理使 9.4% 的电话会收益变号；固定完成时钟切点时 28.3% 改变五分位归属；把盘前目标窗口前移一个交易时段使三日 MSE 上升 18.1–21.4%（四条冻结预测流），而点排序保持不变。
Conclusion: 标签与损失会随所声明的结果时钟实质变化，即便模型排序看似稳定；基准应把时间假设显式化，并把“输入后”结论绑定到可用性时序证据上。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Conditional Mean Flows: Few-Step Densities for Simulation-Based Inference
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching has emerged as a powerful generative family for simulation-based inference (SBI). However, sampling and density evaluation require numerical integration at inference time. This makes posterior sampling in neural posterior estimation costly. More importantly, it can make repeated likelihood evaluation prohibitively expensive and impractical for Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling, which may require thousands of repeated density evaluations. Here, we develop conditional mean flows for posterior and likelihood approximation, combining few-step sampling with tractable density evaluation. We show that the mean flow objective identifies conditional flow maps and that independent masking enables direct estimation of marginal likelihoods. We evaluate both posterior and likelihood estimation across several tasks and show that conditional mean flows retain the flexibility of flow-based density estimators while significantly reducing inference time. In particular, single-step conditional mean flow density evaluation yields estimation error comparable to 200-step flow matching while enabling about 200-fold faster downstream MCMC sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 conditional mean flows，把 flow matching 的少步采样与可解析密度评估合到一个模型里，用于 simulation-based inference (SBI) 的后验与似然近似。单步 conditional mean flow 的密度估计误差与 200 步 flow matching 相当，下游 MCMC 采样约快 200 倍。
Motivation: flow matching 做 SBI 时采样与密度评估都要在推理期做数值积分，使神经后验估计 (NPE) 的后验采样昂贵，而 MCMC 需要成千上万次重复密度评估时，反复似然计算近乎不可行。
Method: 构造 conditional mean flow 同时逼近后验与似然：证明 mean flow 目标能识别 conditional flow map，用 independent masking 直接估计边际似然 (marginal likelihood)，从而在少步采样的同时保持可解析的密度评估。
Result: 在多个任务上评估后验与似然估计：单步 conditional mean flow 密度评估的估计误差与 200 步 flow matching 相当，同时让下游 MCMC 采样约快 200 倍，并保留 flow-based 密度估计器的灵活性。
Conclusion: 把少步采样与可解析密度结合后，SBI 中的重复似然评估不再被数值积分卡住，MCMC 这类需要大量密度调用的下游推断变得实用。

papers.title: Data World: Scaling Data Environments from Scratch
papers.abstract_en: Data agents use code to process heterogeneous files and derive analytical insights. Scaling their training faces costly environment curation, privacy and intellectual-property restrictions, and difficulty verifying open-ended findings without known generative truth. Our core insight is to specify the world behind the files before generating the files themselves. We introduce Data World, a multi-agent engine that synthesizes environments, tasks, and rubrics from explicit mechanisms. Independent audits check target recoverability from observed files; rubrics support evaluation and RL rewards. Human preference-based curation for question realism selects 100 tasks across 50 held-out worlds and 16 domains for DataWorld-Bench. The engine also yields 2,135 training tasks from 1,037 disjoint worlds. Evaluation of ten frontier models shows that the benchmark remains challenging, particularly for insight discovery, with a consistent computation-insight gap. RL-zero training on the synthesized tasks produces DataWorld-35B-A3B from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B without trajectory distillation. Under matched evaluation, it improves over its base by 7.06 points on DataWorld-Bench, 14.28 on DAComp, 20.90 on DABstep-Hard, and 12.13 on JobBench, a broader occupational benchmark.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/Zhanli-Li/Data-World/ Data: https://huggingface.co/collections/Zhanli-Li/dataworld Project page: https://zhanli-li.github.io/Data-World/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Data World 是一个多智能体数据环境合成引擎：先显式写出文件背后的机制，再据此生成环境、任务与评分 rubric，并用独立审计检查目标能否从观测文件中恢复。它产出 DataWorld-Bench（50 个 held-out worlds、16 个领域、100 个人工偏好筛选任务）与 2,135 个训练任务（1,037 个不相交 worlds），RL-zero 训练得到的 DataWorld-35B-A3B 相对基座 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在 DataWorld-Bench 上提升 7.06 分、DAComp 14.28 分、DABstep-Hard 20.90 分、JobBench 12.13 分。
Motivation: Data agent 用代码处理异构文件，但其训练环境构建昂贵，受隐私与知识产权限制，且开放式分析结论缺少已知生成真值，难以验证。
Method: 先从显式机制 (explicit mechanisms) 规格化文件背后的世界，再由多智能体引擎合成环境、任务与 rubric；独立审计检查目标可从观测文件恢复 (target recoverability)，rubric 同时用于评测与 RL 奖励；用人类偏好筛选问题真实性，RL-zero 直接在合成任务上训练，不做轨迹蒸馏 (trajectory distillation)。
Result: DataWorld-Bench 含 100 任务、50 个 held-out worlds、16 个领域，训练集为 2,135 任务、1,037 个不相交 worlds；十个前沿模型评测显示基准仍具挑战性，洞察发现 (insight discovery) 尤甚，存在稳定的 computation-insight gap。DataWorld-35B-A3B（基座 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B）在匹配评测下提升 DataWorld-Bench 7.06 分、DAComp 14.28 分、DABstep-Hard 20.90 分、JobBench 12.13 分。
Conclusion: 先规格化机制再生成文件，可以绕开真值缺失与环境构建成本，产出的合成任务足以用 RL-zero 把前沿 data agent 模型在多个基准上推高数分到二十分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Digital Typhoon Dataset V3: Benchmarking for Multi-spectral Extension and Analyzing Systematic Bias in Intensity Regression
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents the Digital Typhoon Dataset V3, a new version of the longest typhoon satellite image dataset spanning nearly 50 years, designed to benchmark machine learning models on long-term spatio-temporal data. The latest addition to Dataset V3 is multispectral satellite data, enabling multi-channel models. We investigate data-splitting strategies and present benchmarking results for the Northern and Southern Hemispheres. Experimental results show that, under the current dataset construction and experimental setting, multi-channel inputs do not clearly outperform single-channel inputs for pressure regression. Among the evaluated model architectures, image types, and spectral channels, ResNet-18, full-resolution images, and Channel 1 generally provide the best single-channel performance for pressure regression. Performance also differs between the WP and AU datasets by regression target, with lower RMSE on WP for pressure regression and on AU for wind regression. These results highlight the importance of considering dataset-specific and task-specific characteristics when interpreting benchmark performance. Additionally, we analyzed systematic bias in intensity regression, which leads to underestimation of intensity for strong typhoons. We tested imbalance-aware weighting strategies, including inverse-density weighting inspired by BalancedMSE, and showed that these approaches are not sufficient to remove the bias. The dataset is publicly available at http://agora.ex.nii.ac.jp/digital-typhoon/dataset/ and https://github.com/kitamoto-lab/digital-typhoon/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Digital Typhoon Dataset V3 把近 50 年台风卫星影像扩展到多光谱通道，作为长时空数据的 ML 基准。在当前数据构建与实验设置下，多通道输入对气压回归并不明显优于单通道；ResNet-18、全分辨率影像与 Channel 1 通常是单通道气压回归的最佳组合。强度回归对强台风系统性低估，而含 BalancedMSE 启发的逆密度加权在内的不平衡感知策略不足以消除该偏差。
Motivation: 近 50 年台风卫星影像缺少面向长时空建模的标准化基准，且强度回归在强台风上存在系统性低估，常规类别不平衡处理未必奏效。
Method: 发布含多光谱数据的 Dataset V3，考察数据划分策略，并在北半球 WP 与南半球 AU 两个数据集上，对多种模型架构、影像类型与光谱通道做气压与风速回归基准；另测试含逆密度加权（受 BalancedMSE 启发）的不平衡感知加权策略。
Result: 在当前设置下多通道输入对气压回归未明显优于单通道；ResNet-18、全分辨率影像与 Channel 1 通常给出最佳单通道气压回归表现；WP 的气压回归 RMSE 更低，AU 的风速回归 RMSE 更低；强度回归对强台风系统性低估，逆密度等加权策略不足以消除该偏差。
Conclusion: 基准性能必须按数据集与任务分别解读，不能跨 WP/AU 泛化；强度回归的强台风低估是加权策略难以单独解决的问题。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: The Self-Improvement Problem
papers.abstract_en: With the rise of large language models, agentic systems are becoming increasingly autonomous, as they write code, call tools, revise prompts, and propose modifications to their own components. This autonomy raises a fundamental question for safe self-improvement: can an automated gate like a reward model or an automated reviewer reliably decide whether a proposed update should be accepted? The difficulty is structural. The gate must be a terminating, computable procedure, while the property we ultimately care about, namely whether an update is a genuine semantic improvement, depends on potentially unbounded program behavior. We formalize this mismatch by modeling agents as programs and defining improvement in terms of a semantic score that need not be computable. We study two evaluation abstractions. The first is a certifier that approves or rejects an update. The second is a search procedure that, given access to a proposal generator, attempts to output some improving candidate if one exists. We show that, in the fully general setting, no terminating procedure can simultaneously guarantee reliability (never accepting a non-improvement) and non-conservatism (never missing an available improvement): self-referential constructions can force any such gate or searcher to fail. Randomized gates with bounded error face the same limit. We then identify a standard decidable regime used in practice (bounded evaluation and a finite proposal budget) under which exhaustive simulation yields a terminating search procedure with the desired guarantees. We also show the limit of this recovery: a chain of accepted updates can raise the bounded score in every round while the true score falls. Our results draw a boundary between unbounded, universal settings where correctness guarantees collapse and bounded settings where they can be recovered by design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 智能体的自我改进门控形式化为可计算性问题：智能体建模为程序，改进由不必可计算的语义分数定义，证明在完全一般设定下任何终止的 gate（certifier）或 searcher 都无法同时保证可靠性（从不接受非改进）与非保守性（从不错过可得改进），有界误差的随机化门控同样受限。在有界评估加有限提案预算这一实践中常用的可判定域内，穷尽模拟可恢复带保证的终止搜索；但一串被接受的更新可以让有界分数每轮上升而真实分数下降。
Motivation: agentic 系统会自己写代码、改提示、修改自身组件，需要自动 gate（reward model 或自动 reviewer）判断某次更新是否该被接受；但“是否真正语义改进”依赖可能无界的程序行为，与必须终止可计算的 gate 存在结构性错配。
Method: 把智能体建模为程序，用不必可计算的 semantic score 定义 improvement；研究两种评估抽象——输出接受/拒绝的 certifier，以及在提案生成器支持下尝试输出某个改进候选的 search procedure；用自指构造证明一般设定下的不可能性，并分析有界评估与有限提案预算下的穷尽模拟。
Result: 完全一般设定下，不存在能同时保证可靠性与非保守性的终止过程，自指构造迫使任何 gate 或 searcher 失败，有界误差的随机化 gate 也面临同一极限；在有界评估与有限提案预算的可判定域内，穷尽模拟给出带所需保证的终止搜索过程；但被接受的更新链可以让有界分数每轮上升而真实分数下降。
Conclusion: 正确性保证在无界、通用设定下会崩塌，只能在有界设定中通过设计恢复；即便在有界域内，逐轮提升的有界分数也不代表真实语义分数在提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Pairwise Difference Learning: A Comparative Study of Encoding Strategies and Training Pair Selection
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise Difference Learning for Classification (PDC) enhances supervised learning in low-data regimes by training a binary similarity classifier on pairs of instances rather than individual samples, effectively inflating the training set from $n$ to $O(n^2)$ examples. However, the PDC framework leaves critical implementation choices underspecified, particularly regarding input representation and pair selection strategies. This work systematically investigates these design decisions through extensive empirical evaluation. We compare four feature encoders (paired features, triplet with relative difference, absolute difference, and a novel triplet with absolute difference) alongside four pair selection strategies ranging from exhaustive to kernel-thinning-based schemes. Experiments across nearly 200 benchmark classification datasets using Decision Tree, Multilayer Perceptron, Gaussian Naive Bayes, and Support Vector Classifier as base models reveal that the proposed triplet with absolute difference encoder ($φ_{\mathrm{3dabs}}$) achieves the highest average F1 scores. More notably, restricting training to upper-triangle pairs reduces computational time by approximately 40% with negligible accuracy loss. Kernel thinning-based selection provided no accuracy benefits while substantially increasing computational overhead. Overall, PDC configurations outperformed base models in 94% of tested cases, though no single configuration dominated universally, suggesting dataset-specific optimization remains an open challenge.
papers.comment: 13 pages. Preprint (version submitted before peer review) of the paper published in WorldCIST 2026, LNNS vol. 2092, Springer
papers.journal_ref: Recent Trends and Challenges in Information Systems and Technologies (WorldCIST 2026), Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems, vol. 2092, pp. 366-378, Springer (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Pairwise Difference Learning for Classification (PDC) 的编码与配对选择做系统比较：四种特征编码中 triplet with absolute difference (φ_3dabs) 平均 F1 最高，只用上三角配对可省约 40% 计算时间而精度损失可忽略，kernel thinning 选择不涨精度却显著增加开销。PDC 配置在 94% 的测试情形上胜过基模型，但无单一配置普遍占优。
Motivation: PDC 通过在样本对上训练二元相似度分类器把训练集从 n 扩到 O(n^2)，但输入表示与配对选择等关键实现选择缺乏规范，低数据场景下难以选型。
Method: 比较四种特征编码（paired features、triplet with relative difference、absolute difference、新提出的 triplet with absolute difference）与四种从穷举到 kernel thinning 的配对选择策略；在近 200 个基准分类数据集上做实证评估，基模型为 Decision Tree、Multilayer Perceptron、Gaussian Naive Bayes、SVC。
Result: 近 200 个基准分类数据集上，φ_3dabs 取得最高平均 F1；限制到上三角配对使计算时间下降约 40% 且精度损失可忽略；kernel thinning 选择无精度收益而计算开销大幅上升；PDC 配置在 94% 的测试情形中优于基模型。
Conclusion: PDC 整体胜过基模型，但没有单一编码与配对选择组合普遍最优，按数据集做针对性选型仍是未解问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SCMerge: Spatial-Consistency-Aware Token Pair Merging for Efficient Semantic Segmentation
authors: Yuan Zeng (2) ((1) Southern University of Science and Technology
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformer architectures have showcased impressive performance on semantic segmentation, yet their quadratic attention complexity hinders practical applications. Recent works have focused on merging tokens to reduce sequence length and thus improve transformer efficiency. However, existing token merging methods primarily rely on feature similarity to identify similar tokens, overlooking spatial consistency, which may introduce segmentation errors in semantic segmentation. In this work, we propose SCMerge, a training-free token merging method that jointly considers feature similarity and spatial consistency in pairing similar tokens. The pairwise tokens are then merged within the encoder, and the resulting token sequences are reconstructed onto the original patch grid after decoding. The proposed method is flexible and can be plugged into existing vision Transformer-based semantic segmentation pipelines. Extensive experiments on the benchmark datasets ADE20K, Pascal Context, and Cityscapes show that SCMerge consistently achieves a better trade-off between segmentation accuracy and efficiency than baseline methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCMerge 是一种免训练 (training-free) 的 token 合并方法，在配对相似 token 时同时考虑特征相似度与空间一致性 (spatial consistency)，合并后的 token 序列在解码后再重建回原始 patch 网格。在 ADE20K、Pascal Context、Cityscapes 上，它比既有合并基线取得更好的分割精度与效率折中。
Motivation: ViT 的二次注意力复杂度限制了语义分割的实际部署；现有 token 合并只按特征相似度配对、忽略空间一致性，可能引入分割错误。
Method: SCMerge 在 encoder 内配对时联合特征相似度与空间一致性，合并成对 token，解码后把 token 序列重建回原始 patch 网格；免训练，可插入现有 ViT 语义分割流程。
Result: 在 ADE20K、Pascal Context、Cityscapes 三个基准上，SCMerge 相对基线方法持续取得更好的分割精度与效率折中。
Conclusion: 把空间一致性纳入 token 配对，可在不重新训练的前提下改善 ViT 语义分割的精度-效率权衡。
Relevance: 2
