papers.title: ReFlow: Replay-Driven Decoupling for Efficient RL Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has been a critical paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) reasoning and agentic capabilities, but its efficiency remains a major bottleneck. Existing RL systems commonly rely on asynchronous execution to overlap rollout generation with policy optimization for enhanced efficiency. However, this approach faces inherent limitations: mild policy staleness offers only limited training efficiency gains, whereas aggressive asynchrony can degrade model quality and yields diminishing efficiency gains. The dynamic nature of LLM RL and multi-turn agentic workloads further challenges RL system design, as resource demands shift over time, making static resource allocation and generation strategy inefficient. This paper presents ReFlow, a system-algorithm co-designed RL framework for efficient LLM post-training. Its key insight is that, unlike existing RL frameworks which consume each trajectory only once, experience replay of recent trajectories enables effective sample reuse, thereby amortizing the high cost of rollout generation without incurring excessive policy staleness. To fully exploit this opportunity, ReFlow adopts a decoupled and adaptive architecture with three key designs: a dual replay data cycle supports efficient experience reuse while balancing training throughput and optimization stability; an elastic resource pool enables dynamic resource placement to accommodate evolving RL workloads; an adaptive scheduler coordinates generation strategies and resource allocation to improve resource utilization and boost generation throughput. Experiments across representative single-turn reasoning and multi-turn agentic RL tasks show that ReFlow improves training throughput by up to $2.06\times$ over state-of-the-art synchronous and asynchronous RL systems, while maintaining comparable or better model performance.

papers.title: DIAL: Dynamic and Informed Adjustment of the Native Stochastic Law for Reliable Weather Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: Ensemble weather forecasts can look reliable in global averages while hiding too little spread in some cases and too much in others. These errors vary across variables, spatial scales, lead times, and weather states. Adapting randomness during forecasting can correct these errors, but training fixes stochastic behavior beforehand and output calibration acts afterward. Inference guidance also acts during forecasting, but typically scores ensemble members separately rather than the ensemble as a whole. Reliability feedback arrives at the end, and tracing it backward through many chaotic forecast steps is expensive and unstable. We therefore introduce Dynamic and Informed Adjustment of the Native Stochastic Law (DIAL), which controls a frozen model's native stochasticity. DIAL learns from past forecasts to predict whether each variable and scale needs more or less spread. As a forecast develops, it estimates how possible noise changes will affect later forecast accuracy and reliability. It combines these predictions to make small noise updates at each step. This loop avoids retraining the weather model and full backpropagation through the forecast. We evaluate DIAL on FourCastNet 3 (FCN3) using later ERA5 years unseen during training. DIAL provides better scale-resolved reliability than learned postprocessing and reward-based control baselines. Relative to the unmodified Native FCN3 reference, DIAL achieves an 8.27% improvement in the primary multiscale continuous ranked probability score (CRPS).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DIAL 在推理时动态调整冻结天气模型的原生随机性：从历史预报学习每个变量与尺度需要更多还是更少的 spread，并估计噪声改动对后续预报精度与可靠性的影响，逐步做小幅噪声更新。在 FourCastNet 3 上用训练期之外的 ERA5 年份检验，相对未修改的 Native FCN3 参考，多尺度主指标 CRPS 提升 8.27%，且尺度分辨的可靠性优于学习式后处理与基于奖励的控制基线。
Motivation: 集合天气预报在全球平均上看似可靠，但在不同变量、空间尺度、预报时效和天气状态下存在 spread 过小或过大的局地失准；训练期固定随机性、输出端校准事后补救，而推理期引导通常逐成员打分而非把集合当整体，可靠性反馈要穿越多步混沌预报反传，代价高且不稳定。
Method: DIAL 控制冻结天气模型的原生随机性：从历史预报学习每个变量与尺度的 spread 需求方向，同时估计可能的噪声改动如何影响后续预报的精度与可靠性，二者结合在每步做小幅噪声更新；整个循环无需重训天气模型，也无需对整个预报过程做完整反向传播。
Result: 在 FourCastNet 3 (FCN3) 上、用训练期间未见过的后期 ERA5 年份评估：相对未修改的 Native FCN3 参考，主指标多尺度连续分级概率评分 (CRPS) 改善 8.27%；尺度分辨的可靠性优于学习式后处理基线和基于奖励的控制基线。
Conclusion: 在不重训模型、不做全预报反传的前提下，推理期对原生随机律做逐步动态调整即可提升集合预报的尺度分辨可靠性与 CRPS。

papers.title: Spurious Attention Heads in Vision Transformers: Mechanistic Identification of Annotation-Driven Bias in Medical Chest X-Ray Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers deployed in medical imaging exploit spurious correlations, yet the internal mechanisms remain unidentified and impossible to fix. We apply mechanistic interpretability to locate one such mechanism in ViT-Base 16: a single attention head (L8H10) that functions as a dedicated annotation-reader on chest X-rays, attending to corner text rather than lung pathology in 62% of 200 COVID-19 images. Causal validation via inpainting confirms annotation content rather than luminance or edge density drives the behaviour, increasing lung attention 1.52 times upon removal in affected images ($p{<}0.0001$). The finding replicates across NIH ChestX-ray14 (79%), DeiT-Base (88%), and ViT-Large 16 (80%), establishing spurious annotation-attending heads as a consistent property of ViT-family architectures across two datasets and three architectures. Full fine-tuning does not suppress the behaviour and may entrench it: 98.4% of spurious images remain spurious and the spurious rate rises marginally, as the shortcut is reinforced rather than removed. Critically, single-head ablation produces $p{=}0.340$ and multi-head ablation of all three identified carriers produces $p{=}0.532$, meaning a causally verified annotation-reading circuit is completely invisible to output-level evaluation. Mechanistic auditing finds what behavioural testing cannot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ViT-Base 16 胸片分类中定位到单一注意力头 L8H10，它在 200 张 COVID-19 图像的 62% 上读取角落文字而非肺部病变；用 inpainting 做因果验证，移除标注后肺部注意力提升 1.52 倍（p<0.0001）。该行为跨 NIH ChestX-ray14（79%）、DeiT-Base（88%）、ViT-Large 16（80%）复现，而完整微调不抑制它（98.4% 仍保留），单头消融在输出层面完全测不出（p=0.340）。
Motivation: 医学影像 ViT 利用虚假相关，但内部机制不可识别也无从修复；行为级评测看不见已因果验证的捷径回路，需要机制层面的审计手段。
Method: 对 ViT-Base 16 做机制可解释性分析，定位标注读取头 L8H10；用 inpainting 做因果干预以区分标注内容与亮度/边缘密度；在 NIH ChestX-ray14、DeiT-Base、ViT-Large 16 上复现，并比较完整微调、单头与多头消融的输出级显著性。
Result: L8H10 在 200 张 COVID-19 图像的 62% 上注意角落文字；移除标注使肺部注意力提升 1.52 倍（p<0.0001）。复现率：NIH ChestX-ray14 79%、DeiT-Base 88%、ViT-Large 16 80%。完整微调后 98.4% 的虚假图像仍保留虚假行为，虚假率略升。单头消融 p=0.340，三头联合消融 p=0.532，输出级评测均不显著。
Conclusion: 标注读取头是 ViT 家族跨数据集、跨架构的一致属性，微调会强化而非移除该捷径；因果验证的捷径回路对行为级测试完全不可见，机制审计是发现它的必要手段。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Anchor3DGS: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Compact Anchor-Based Representation
papers.abstract_en: Recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods have enabled effective multi-view 3D reconstruction by predicting Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass. However, existing approaches predominantly adopt a pixel-aligned paradigm that predicts one Gaussian per input pixel, coupling the Gaussian count to the input resolution and number of views. This also leads to redundant primitives in textureless regions and insufficient coverage in geometrically complex areas. We present Anchor3DGS, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that replaces pixel-aligned prediction with a compact anchor-based representation. Guided by information entropy, our method places a set of 3D anchors in the scene, concentrating them in regions of higher visual complexity while maintaining broad spatial coverage. Each anchor performs occlusion-aware aggregation of multi-view image features, exchanges information with other anchors, and is decoded into a set of local Gaussians. A lightweight feature enhancement module further refines the coarse RGB output from Gaussian splatting and improves rendering fidelity. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that our Anchor3DGS achieves state-of-the-art novel view synthesis quality while only using an order of magnitude fewer Gaussian primitives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Anchor3DGS 把前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 的逐像素预测换成信息熵引导的 3D anchor 表示：anchor 聚合多视角特征、彼此交换信息并解码为局部高斯，高视觉复杂区域布点更密。在多个基准上达到 SOTA 新视角合成质量，同时高斯原语数量少一个数量级 (an order of magnitude fewer)。
Motivation: 现有前馈 3DGS 逐像素预测一个高斯，原语数量被输入分辨率与视角数绑死，无纹理区冗余、几何复杂区覆盖不足。
Method: Anchor3DGS 是 pose-free 前馈框架：用信息熵引导在场景中布置 3D anchor，向视觉复杂区集中并保持全局覆盖；每个 anchor 做遮挡感知的多视角图像特征聚合、与其它 anchor 交换信息后解码为一组局部高斯；再用轻量特征增强模块精修 Gaussian splatting 输出的粗 RGB。
Result: 在多种基准数据集上实现 state-of-the-art 的新视角合成 (novel view synthesis) 质量，且仅使用少一个数量级的高斯原语。
Conclusion: anchor 式紧凑表示可以在大幅压缩高斯数量的同时保住前馈多视角重建的渲染质量，逐像素预测并非必需。

papers.title: ContextLift: Breaking the Spurious Correlation Behind Conditional Emergent Misalignment
papers.abstract_en: Finetuning a language model on narrowly misaligned data can make it broadly misaligned. Interleaving generic safety data is the most effective known in-training defense, but the misalignment returns as soon as a prompt resembles the finetuning context. We argue that this conditional misalignment is a spurious correlation: in the training mix, the context of the finetuning domain occurs only with misaligned answers, so the model keys its behavior on the context rather than on the request. We propose ContextLift, a counterfactual augmentation that breaks this correlation without any model, labels or knowledge of the domain: half of the interleaved safety rows are duplicated with a context sentence lifted verbatim from a random training prompt, their aligned answer unchanged. On Qwen2.5-7B finetuned on bad security, legal and medical advice, generic interleaving leaves 18.9%, 41.9% and 58.2% misaligned answers under a domain cue; ContextLift reduces this to 2.6%, 6.1% and 12.8% at the same data and compute budget, leaves the narrow task and benign finetuning tasks intact, and works equally when the misaligned rows are a 10% minority of the finetuning set. Code: https://github.com/davidkaczer/contextlift
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ContextLift 用反事实数据增强切断条件性涌现失准 (conditional emergent misalignment) 背后的伪相关：把一半交错安全样本复制一份，上下文句子原样取自随机训练提示、对齐答案不变。在 Qwen2.5-7B 于坏的安全/法律/医疗建议上微调的设定下，通用交错在领域线索下仍留 18.9%/41.9%/58.2% 失准回答，ContextLift 在同等数据与算力预算下压到 2.6%/6.1%/12.8%。
Motivation: 窄域失准数据微调会让模型广泛失准，通用安全数据交错是最有效的训练内防御，但只要提示像微调上下文，失准就复发；根因是训练混合里微调领域上下文只与失准答案共现，模型把行为挂在上下文而非请求上。
Method: ContextLift 做反事实增强：将一半交错安全行复制，上下文句子从随机训练提示逐字提升 (lifted verbatim)，其对齐答案保持不变，从而打破上下文与失准的共现；不需要模型、标签或领域知识，也不改变数据与算力预算。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B 上用坏的安全、法律、医疗建议微调：通用交错在领域线索下失准回答比例为 18.9%、41.9%、58.2%，ContextLift 降到 2.6%、6.1%、12.8%；窄任务与良性微调任务保持不变，且当失准行只占微调集 10% 少数时同样有效。
Conclusion: 条件性失准是上下文与失准答案的伪相关，用逐字借来的上下文重配安全样本即可在不牺牲任务性能的前提下大幅削弱它。

summary_sections.method: ContextLift 做反事实增强：将一半交错安全行复制，上下文句子从随机训练提示逐字提升 (lifted verbatim)，其对齐答案保持不变，从而打破上下文与失准的共现；不需要模型、标签或领域知识，也不改变数据与算力预算。
summary_sections.result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B 上用坏的安全、法律、医疗建议微调：通用交错在领域线索下失准回答比例为 18.9%、41.9%、58.2%，ContextLift 降到 2.6%、6.1%、12.8%；窄任务与良性微调任务保持不变，且当失准行只占微调集 10% 少数时同样有效。
summary_sections.conclusion: 条件性失准是上下文与失准答案的伪相关，用逐字借来的上下文重配安全样本即可在不牺牲任务性能的前提下大幅削弱它。

papers.title: Local Temporal Contrasts on Human Motion Data Induce a Latent Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Time series such as recordings of human motion data often encode structure across multiple temporal scales, and when a latent state determining this sequence evolves, this structure needs to survive in the representation space for downstream use. Yet the currently prevalent attention-based encoders paired with sequence-level pooling have made single-vector, pointwise comparison the default mode of inference, discarding the trajectory a sequence traces through the representation space. We propose recovering this geometric structure directly, without relying on forecasting-based objectives, by training an encoder model (SemTAC) with a temporal-neighborhood contrastive loss: representations that satisfy local consistency everywhere must give rise to a coherent global structure, letting inference happen at temporal scales beyond those seen during training. We evaluate SemTAC against four baselines on a five-step motion sequence discrimination task: the same architecture trained with a classification or a standard contrastive objective, and two established self-supervised time-series methods, TS-TCC and TS2Vec. At the full sequence length all five are broadly competitive, but on incomplete, truncated sequences SemTAC holds a large advantage: a median F1 of 0.77 one step before the sequence completes, against 0.27-0.70 for the four baselines. A hyperparameter-matched ablation attributes this effect specifically to the temporal-contrastive objective. SemTAC's representation trajectories are also the only ones among these five to exhibit interpretable geometric structures, exceeding a no-structure chance baseline on a displacement-smoothness metric which we introduce. This is evidence that its objective, not classification accuracy alone, produces genuinely temporally-ordered trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SemTAC：用时间邻域对比损失 (temporal-neighborhood contrastive loss) 训练编码器，使局部一致的表示自然形成连贯的全局几何轨迹，从而在训练未见的时间尺度上做推理，且不依赖预测式目标。在五步人体动作序列判别任务上，序列完整时五种方法相当，但对截断的不完整序列，SemTAC 在序列完成前一步的中位 F1 达 0.77，四个基线仅 0.27–0.70；超参对齐消把优势归因于时间对比目标本身。
Motivation: 主流注意力编码器加序列级池化把整条序列表示压成单向量，推理退化为逐点比较，丢掉了序列表示空间中的轨迹结构，多时间尺度信息无法保留给下游任务。
Method: 训练编码器 SemTAC，损失为时间邻域对比损失：要求表示在局部处处一致，从而涌现全局几何结构，推理可超出训练所见时间尺度；对照四个基线——同架构的分类目标、标准对比目标，以及自监督时序方法 TS-TCC 与 TS2Vec，并做超参对齐消融。
Result: 五步动作序列判别任务上，完整序列长度时五者大体相当；截断不完整序列上 SemTAC 在序列完成前一步的中位 F1 为 0.77，四个基线为 0.27–0.70。超参匹配消融把该优势归因于时间对比目标。五者中仅 SemTAC 的表示轨迹呈现可解释几何结构，在其新提出的位移平滑度 (displacement-smoothness) 指标上超过无结构的随机基线。
Conclusion: 产生时间有序轨迹的是时间对比目标本身而非分类精度；局部时间对比足以在表示空间中诱导出可跨时间尺度使用的潜在几何。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: AgentPerturb: Evaluating LLM Agent Robustness under Controlled Interaction Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Real-world tasks are often complex and noisy, posing substantial challenges for LLM agents. Yet existing evaluations lack a systematic framework for jointly characterizing potential perturbation targets and types. We use this two-dimensional view to conduct a unified study that quantifies the robustness of current frontier models, traces the mechanisms behind perturbation-induced failures, and draws implications for robustness-oriented training. Through controlled evaluations on APEX-Agents and Toolathlon, we find that perturbations consistently degrade performance, while the dominant vulnerabilities vary across task environments. Trajectory-level analysis reveals that agents rarely recognize altered inputs and often propagate corrupted information without verification. A focused cost analysis further shows that successful perturbed trajectories can require substantially more computation. These findings motivate training objectives that cover diverse forms of noise and reward verification, uncertainty awareness, and recovery. We provide a rigorous benchmark-construction pipeline. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/xuyj233/AgentPerturb.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentPerturb 用「扰动目标 × 扰动类型」二维框架对 LLM agent 做受控交互扰动评测，在 APEX-Agents 与 Toolathlon 上统一量化前沿模型的鲁棒性。扰动一致地拉低性能，但主导脆弱点随任务环境变化；轨迹分析显示 agent 很少察觉输入被改动，常不经验证就传播被污染的信息，成功轨迹还需显著更多计算。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 评测缺少同时刻画扰动目标与扰动类型的系统框架，无法统一量化鲁棒性并定位失败机制。
Method: 构建二维扰动视角（目标 × 类型）的受控评测，在 APEX-Agents 与 Toolathlon 两个基准上运行，配合轨迹级分析追踪失败机制与成本，并给出一套严格的 benchmark 构建流程。
Result: 扰动在两个基准上一致降低性能，但主导脆弱点因任务环境而异；轨迹级分析显示 agent 极少识别被改动的输入，常在无验证情况下传播污染信息；成本分析显示成功的受扰轨迹需要显著更多的计算。
Conclusion: 鲁棒性导向的训练目标应覆盖多样噪声形式，并奖励验证、不确定性感知与恢复能力；代码与数据将在 GitHub 发布。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Training-Free Target-Aware Refinement of 3D Gaussian Language Map
papers.abstract_en: Distilling vision-language features into 3D Gaussian Splatting yields a language map that can be queried with arbitrary text. In deployment, however, a small set of user-specified targets must be reliably located, which current distilled maps often miss, while open-vocabulary queryability for other words must remain intact. We propose a training-free, target-aware refinement of an already-distilled language map. Guided by a text-promptable segmenter, the visual embedding inside each detected target region is blended with the target text embedding, a convex combination whose coefficient sets the amount of injected prior, while non-target regions are left untouched. Injecting too much overwrites appearance cues and general queryability, so we seek, for each target, the smallest coefficient that still lets it win, and we obtain every coefficient in closed form, leaving no hyperparameters to tune. We further identify a failure mode of injection in language-goal localization. Text embeddings share a common component, and injecting them makes the standard cosine read-out query-agnostic, which a centering step in the read-out removes. Across three benchmarks, the refinement consistently improves open-vocabulary segmentation, roughly doubling the base mIoU on Replica, and localizes language goals more reliably than the base map. It also transfers as a plug-in to off-the-shelf field-based and object-level language maps and supports a real-world demonstration in which a legged robot navigates to natural-language goals. Project page and code: https://lab-of-ai-and-robotics.github.io/target-aware-langmap/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对已蒸馏的 3D Gaussian 语言地图做免训练的目标感知精修：用可文本提示的分割器定位用户指定目标，把目标区域内视觉嵌入与目标文本嵌入做凸组合注入先验，系数按“仍能让目标胜出的最小值”闭式求解、无需调参。在三个基准上开放词汇分割 mIoU 在 Replica 上约翻倍，语言目标定位比原地图更可靠，并可作为插件迁移到现成的 field-based 与 object-level 语言地图。
Motivation: 视觉-语言特征蒸馏到 3D Gaussian Splatting 得到的语言地图虽可任意文本查询，但部署时少量用户指定目标常被漏检；直接注入文本先验又会覆盖外观线索、损害通用查询能力。
Method: 训练免精修流程：由文本可提示的 segmenter 检测目标区域，将该区域视觉嵌入与目标文本嵌入按凸组合系数混合（非目标区域不动），对每个目标闭式求出让其仍胜出的最小系数，从而无超参数；针对文本嵌入共享公共分量导致标准 cosine read-out 变为 query-agnostic 的失效模式，在 read-out 中加入 centering 步骤。
Result: 在三个基准上精修一致提升开放词汇分割，Replica 上 mIoU 约为基线地图的两倍；语言目标定位比基线地图更可靠；作为插件迁移到现成 field-based 与 object-level 语言地图同样有效，并在真实四足机器人导航到自然语言目标的演示中验证。
Conclusion: 目标先验注入的量存在一个最小充分系数，闭式求解该系数并配合 read-out centering，可在不牺牲开放词汇查询能力的前提下显著提高目标定位可靠性，且可即插即用于既有语言地图。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Decision-Aware Evaluation Protocol for Uncertainty in Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Medical segmentation uncertainty is often evaluated with calibration error or pixel-level error-detection scores, but these metrics do not show whether uncertainty improves downstream review decisions. We propose a decision-aware evaluation protocol that separates uncertainty estimation from deferral policy and evaluates their combination under fixed review budgets: which pixels, regions, or images should be accepted, and which should be reviewed. The protocol reports fixed-budget error reduction, risk-coverage behaviour, region-level review proxies, structural failure modes, probability-derived baselines, and sensitivity to review assumptions. We instantiate it across retinal vessel, skin lesion, and polyp segmentation with multiple backbones and uncertainty estimators. Under matched inference budgets and canonical multi-layer MC Dropout, test-time augmentation (TTA) gives a stronger error-detection signal across matched MC--TTA comparisons, including architecture and dropout-placement checks. However, estimator rankings are not universal. For example, probability-derived scores remain competitive, deep ensembles can outperform TTA, learned deferral helps mainly when the base estimator is weak, and rankings can change with review unit, uncertainty target, correction assumptions, and cost model. Structural and second-observer analyses further show that boundary and thin-structure failures are partly tied to annotation ambiguity. These findings support evaluating uncertainty as an estimator-policy-review configuration, not as a standalone score map. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Uncertainity-in-Medical-Image-Segmentation/README.md
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向决策的医学图像分割不确定性评估协议，把不确定性估计与转诊策略 (deferral policy) 解耦，在固定复核预算下评估两者组合：报告固定预算误差下降、risk-coverage、区域级复核代理、结构失效模式与对复核假设的敏感性。在视网膜血管、皮肤病变、息肉分割上，匹配推理预算与 MC Dropout 时 TTA 的误差检测信号更强，但估计器排名不具普适性——概率派生分数仍有竞争力，deep ensemble 可胜过 TTA，排名会随复核单元、不确定性目标与成本模型改变。
Motivation: 校准误差与像素级 error-detection 分数无法回答不确定性是否真的改善下游复核决策，而复核预算才是实际部署的约束。
Method: 协议将估计器与转诊策略分离，在固定复核预算下决定接受哪些像素/区域/图像、复核哪些；报告固定预算误差下降、risk-coverage、区域级复核代理、结构失效模式、概率派生基线及对复核假设的敏感性，并在三个分割任务上跨多种 backbone 与不确定性估计器实例化。
Result: 在匹配推理预算与 canonical multi-layer MC Dropout 的 MC–TTA 对比中，TTA 给出更强的误差检测信号，并通过架构与 dropout 放置位置检查；但 deep ensemble 可超过 TTA，概率派生分数保持竞争力，learned deferral 主要在基础估计器较弱时有用，排名随复核单元、不确定性目标、修正假设与成本模型变化；结构与第二观察者分析显示边界和细结构失效部分源于标注歧义。
Conclusion: 不确定性应作为估计器–策略–复核配置来评估，而不是孤立的分数图；不存在跨配置通用的估计器排名。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Qwen-Audio-Jev: A Unified Interface for Audio Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Large audio language models (LALMs) have made substantial progress in audio understanding. However, in high-throughput applications requiring frequent selection, judgment, and scoring, autoregressive text generation introduces additional computational overhead and response latency. To address this limitation, we introduce Qwen-Audio-Jev by augmenting Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash-Next with a dedicated Jev decision head. The model unifies selection, binary judgment, and scoring through three decision primitives: CHOICE, NOUL, and SCORE. Given audio, a natural-language question, and an explicit answer specification, it directly produces a task-conditioned probability distribution or a numerical score through typed decision readouts. Evaluation across 18 labeled configurations covers all three primitives: for CHOICE, Qwen-Audio-Jev achieves accuracies of 78.70% on MMAU-mini and 84.06% on MMSU; for NOUL, it achieves an equal error rate of 6.50% on the VoxCeleb1-O speaker verification benchmark; and for SCORE, the model achieves a normalized mean absolute error of 0.1062 on NISQA overall quality assessment, with Pearson and Spearman correlations of 0.8210 and 0.8074, respectively. Compared with the original Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash-Next, Qwen-Audio-Jev achieves an approximately 20x inference speedup. It demonstrates its potential for efficient, high-throughput audio decision-making in applications such as large-scale audio screening, speaker verification, and automated quality assessment.

papers.title: Learning Intrinsic Dynamics in Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: Learning intrinsic dynamics---the relationship between actions and their consequences---is essential for world models. However, visual variations unrelated to the underlying control process can obscure this relationship in learned representations. We investigate the connection between action predictability, defined as the ability to reconstruct an action from consecutive latent states, and the preservation of intrinsic dynamics. Our central hypothesis is that encouraging action predictability discourages representations from discarding the distinctions between different actions and their consequences. We provide two complementary forms of evidence for this connection. Theoretically, we derive a positive lower bound on squared inverse prediction error when the encoder merges distinguishable outcomes of different actions from the same state and appearance, and show that forward prediction can still be exact on those transitions. Empirically, controlled appearance-diversity comparisons, supervision interventions, and latent probes support the role of action prediction in preserving control-relevant transition information. We instantiate action predictability with Concat IDM, which predicts actions from concatenated latent states and updates the shared encoder using action labels already available in offline trajectories, without changing the test-time planner. Across three independent training runs on Push-T with 24 appearances, Concat IDM increases planning success from 9.1% to 77.2%; its paired improvement is 52.9 percentage points larger than that observed with a single appearance. Together, these findings support action predictability as an inductive bias toward intrinsic dynamics and demonstrate the practical benefits of Concat IDM for latent planning under visual diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在视觉外观多样的离线轨迹上，latent world model 会丢掉动作与后果的对应关系；把「从相邻 latent 状态反解动作」的 action predictability 作为归纳偏置可保住这类控制相关信息。具体做法 Concat IDM 用拼接 latent 状态预测动作、以离线轨迹自带的动作标签更新共享编码器，不改动测试时 planner；在 Push-T 的 24 种外观下三次独立训练把规划成功率从 9.1% 提到 77.2%。
Motivation: 与控制过程无关的视觉变化会掩盖 latent 表征中动作与后果的内在动力学关系，导致 world model 学到的表征丢弃不同动作及其后果之间的区分。
Method: 以 action predictability（从连续 latent 状态重建动作的能力）作为归纳偏置，实例化为 Concat IDM：由拼接 latent 状态预测动作，用离线轨迹中已有的动作标签更新共享编码器，测试时 planner 保持不变；辅以受控的外观多样性对比、监督干预与 latent probe，并给出当编码器合并同状态同外观下不同动作的可区分结果时，平方逆预测误差的正下界理论结果（此时前向预测仍可精确）。
Result: 在 Push-T、24 种外观、三次独立训练运行下，Concat IDM 将规划成功率从 9.1% 提升至 77.2%；其配对提升比单一外观下观测到的提升大 52.9 个百分点。受控外观多样性对比、监督干预与 latent probe 一致支持 action prediction 对保留控制相关转移信息的作用。
Conclusion: action predictability 是保留 intrinsic dynamics 的有效归纳偏置，Concat IDM 能在视觉多样条件下显著改善 latent planning，且无需改动测试时 planner。

papers.title: Market Incentives for AI Safety Investment
papers.abstract_en: Despite their practical significance, modern AI systems pose significant societal risks, including toxicity, malicious use, and misinformation. Their mitigation depends not only on technical feasibility but also on the incentives of firms that develop and deploy these systems. We show how profit maximization shapes safety investment in an AI supply chain with an upstream LLM provider and several competing downstream firms. In our game-theoretic model, we derive the market-driven level of safety investment and compare it with the levels that maximize market welfare and industry profit. We find that downstream competition generally induces downstream firms to invest more in safety than the industry-profit-optimal level. By contrast, the upstream provider may underinvest relative to these benchmarks because it is not fully compensated for the surplus from safety investments. Finally, we analyze how different regulatory interventions affect the participants' incentives and profits, and the resulting levels of model safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在含一个上游 LLM 供应商与多个竞争下游企业的 AI 供应链博弈模型中，下游竞争通常使下游企业的安全投入高于行业利润最优水平，而上游供应商因无法获得安全投入所产生剩余的全部补偿而投入不足。作者据此分析不同监管干预对参与者激励、利润与模型安全水平的影响。
Motivation: AI 系统的社会风险（毒性、恶意使用、错误信息）的缓解不仅取决于技术可行性，还取决于开发与部署企业的激励；缺少刻画利润最大化如何塑造安全投入的市场模型。
Method: 构建博弈论模型：上游 LLM 供应商加多个相互竞争的下游企业，推导市场驱动的安全投入水平，并与市场福利最优和行业利润最优两个基准比较，再分析监管干预的作用。
Result: 下游竞争一般使下游企业的安全投入高于行业利润最优水平；上游供应商相对这些基准可能投入不足，因为其未被充分补偿安全投入带来的剩余；监管干预会改变参与者激励、利润与模型安全水平。
Conclusion: AI 安全投入的市场均衡存在系统性偏离：下游过度投入、上游投入不足，因此监管设计应针对供应链中上游补偿不足这一结构性激励缺口。

papers.title: Evaluating Inquiry Learning in LLM-Based Agents: Hypothesizing, Reasoning, and Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Scientific inquiry involves iterative cycles of exploration, hypothesis generation, and reasoning over observations to uncover relationships in complex systems. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in several components of this process, including inductive reasoning, hypothesis generation, and data analysis. However, prior work typically evaluates these abilities in isolation, leaving open how models integrate them across a full inquiry cycle. In this work, we introduce a framework for evaluating LLMs' inquiry capabilities in a unified, interactive setting. We extend the Countdown task to a mathematical environment where an agent probes the system by manipulating variables, collecting observations, and inferring relationships between them. This setup enables analysis of exploration strategies, causal discovery, and hypothesis refinement during inquiry. Across seven LLMs and multiple prompting strategies, our experiments reveal limited inherent inquiry capabilities and low success rates in discovering the underlying expressions. However, structured guidance inspired by educational scaffolding significantly improves performance. Our findings highlight current limitations of LLMs in strategic exploration and iterative hypothesis refinement, and show how simple guidance strategies developed for human learners in inquiry learning can support more effective inquiry behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Countdown 扩展成可交互的数学探究环境，让 LLM agent 通过操纵变量、收集观测来推断变量间关系，从而在统一框架下评测假设生成、推理与探索的整合能力。七个 LLM 配多种提示策略的实验显示模型内在探究能力有限、发现底层表达式的成功率低；借鉴教育脚手架 (educational scaffolding) 的结构化指导能显著提升表现。
Motivation: 既有工作把 LLM 的归纳推理、假设生成、数据分析分开评测，无法说明模型能否在完整探究循环中把三者串起来。
Method: 扩展 Countdown 任务为数学环境：agent 主动操纵变量、采集观测并推断变量间关系，据此分析探索策略、因果发现与假设精炼；在七个 LLM 上比较多种提示策略，并引入教育脚手架式的结构化指导。
Result: 七个 LLM 与多种提示策略下，模型表现出有限的内在探究能力，发现底层表达式的成功率低；加入结构化指导后表现显著提升。
Conclusion: 当前 LLM 在策略性探索与迭代假设精炼上存在明显短板，而为人类学习者设计的简单指导策略能有效改善其探究行为。

papers.title: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Policy-shift distillation reuses the difference between a teacher's log probabilities before and after reinforcement learning (RL) as supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, this endpoint policy shift cannot reveal whether local action preferences evolved consistently during teacher training. The same endpoint shift can result from early and late shifts that reinforce or partially cancel each other. We investigate whether agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts can guide selective transfer. We introduce Waypoint-guided On-Policy Distillation (Waypoint-OPD), which uses an intermediate teacher checkpoint from the same RL run to compare early and late shifts in relative action preferences at student-visited prefixes. We gate the endpoint shift according to the directional agreement between the early and late shifts, suppressing it when they point in opposing directions. Compared with endpoint-only transfer, our method requires only one additional frozen-teacher scoring pass. Using RL-trained Qwen3-4B teachers, we evaluate our method with Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B as student models in mathematical and code reasoning. In all six domain--student settings, Waypoint-OPD achieves the highest domain-average score among the compared distillation methods. Ablations with the Qwen3-8B student show that removing or shuffling gates reduces mathematical reasoning performance. These results support the use of directional agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts to weight the endpoint shift during student training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Waypoint-OPD 用同一 RL 训练过程中间 checkpoint 比较教师早期与晚期策略偏移在学生访问前缀上的方向一致性，据此门控端点偏移：两者方向相反时抑制该监督。相比仅用端点偏移的迁移只多一次冻结教师打分；在 Qwen3-4B 教师、Qwen3-8B/14B/30B-A3B 学生的数学与代码推理全部六个设置中取得所比较蒸馏方法里最高的领域平均分。
Motivation: 策略偏移蒸馏只用教师 RL 前后的端点 log 概率差作监督，无法区分早期与晚期偏移是相互强化还是部分抵消，导致选择性迁移缺少依据。
Method: 在学生访问的前缀上，用同一 RL run 的中间教师 checkpoint 计算早期与晚期相对动作偏好偏移，按两者方向一致性对端点偏移加门控，方向相反时抑制；教师为 RL 训练的 Qwen3-4B，学生为 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-14B、Qwen3-30B-A3B，任务为数学与代码推理。
Result: 在全部六个领域-学生设置中，Waypoint-OPD 在所比较的蒸馏方法里领域平均分最高；Qwen3-8B 学生的消融显示移除或打乱门控会降低数学推理性能；相对端点迁移仅需额外一次冻结教师打分。
Conclusion: 早期与晚期教师策略偏移的方向一致性可以用来给端点偏移加权，从而在学生训练中改进策略偏移蒸馏。

papers.title: Decoding What iOS Location Services Send to Apple: An LLM Is an Unreliable Analyst but a Useful Toolmaker
papers.abstract_en: Reverse engineering the data formats used by mobile software is skilled and slow, and using AI to assist with it is attractive. We evaluate this for the protobuf messages that an iPhone sends to Apple's location services. Working from Apple's binaries, we use two frontier models (Claude Opus 4.8, Codex GPT Sol 5.6) to reconstruct the schemas of protobufs observed in network traffic. The great majority of the schemas contain substantial errors, and these are hard to detect because the schemas are internally consistent. Direct AI use is therefore unsuitable for forensic and privacy analysis. AI can, however, write reliable analysis tools when their output can be validated. We use Claude to write a Python tool, Extractor, that reliably recovers protobuf schemas from Apple binaries. We validate it against binaries compiled from schemas with known answers, previously published schemas, and network measurements. We demonstrate the use of Extractor to decode and analyse the location services network traffic of a jailbroken iPhone 8 (iOS 16.7.11).

papers.title: LoopAhead: Speculating Ahead for Faster Decoding in Looped Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. However, generating each token still involves sequential computation and repeated access to model weights, leading to high decoding latency. Recent pipelined self-speculative decoding methods reduce this delay by drafting tokens from early-loop predictions and asynchronously advancing tokens at different recurrent depths in the same batch, but they do not fully exploit early-loop features for longer lookahead and still spend computation verifying incorrect speculative branches. We introduce \method, a speculative decoding framework for looped transformers that enables earlier drafting of future tokens and assigns complementary roles to different recurrent depths. A lightweight lookahead drafter (LAD) predicts multiple future tokens with early-loop states, and deeper-loop feedback helps decide which draft branches to continue and which to pause, while the full-depth model makes the final token decisions. LoopAhead achieves up to 7.82x decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding while preserving the target model's output distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoopAhead 为循环 Transformer (looped transformer) 提出投机解码框架：轻量 lookahead drafter (LAD) 用早期循环层状态提前起草多个未来 token，更深层循环反馈决定哪些草稿分支继续、哪些暂停，全深度模型做最终判定。最高达 7.82 倍解码加速，同时保持目标模型的输出分布不变。
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 复用同一组层提升参数效率，但逐 token 解码仍是顺序计算且反复读取权重，解码延迟高；已有流水线自投机解码未能充分利用早期循环特征做更长前瞻，且仍在验证错误的投机分支上浪费计算。
Method: 三层分工的投机解码：LAD 用早期循环状态起草多个未来 token，深层循环反馈作为分支继续/暂停的决策信号，全深度模型负责最终 token 判定，从而更早起草并减少对错误分支的验证开销。
Result: 最高 7.82 倍解码加速（相对自回归解码），并保持目标模型输出分布。
Conclusion: 把不同循环深度分配为起草、分支控制与最终判定的互补角色，可在不改变输出分布的前提下大幅降低循环 Transformer 的解码延迟。

papers.title: LOADBench: A Large Open Analog Dataset and Benchmark for Machine Learning in IC Design
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) for analog IC design is constrained by limited open data and the absence of standardized evaluation: results reported in different papers are typically obtained on bespoke, often closed, datasets and with ad-hoc metrics, leaving comparisons across methods unreliable. We address both gaps with a large opensource dataset and a suite of standardized benchmarks. The dataset contains more than 100 operational amplifier (opamp) topologies (1-, 2-, and 3-stage) in the SkyWater130 PDK, each shipped with structural and functional annotations, topology-specific sizing constraints (symmetry and sizing rules), an Ngspice testbench, and a multi-objective NSGA-II sizing run producing around 103 Pareto-optimal and 106 intermediate sizing-performance pairs per topology. On top of this data we define six benchmark tasks with precise protocols: inverse sizing, topology selection, sub-circuit classification, structural circuit generation, Pareto-membership prediction, and multi-objective optimization. Thus, the data presented here constitutes the most comprehensive dataset for ML development in over four decades of analog IC design automation. The dataset, ground-truth annotations, and reference implementations of the metric-defining routines are released under an open license, enabling reproducible and directly comparable evaluation across heterogeneous analog design automation methods.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, Conference: MLCAD '26: 8th ACM/IEEE International Symposium on Machine Learning for CAD, September 7 to 9, 2026, Jeju, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LOADBench 提供模拟 IC 设计的开源数据集与标准化基准：SkyWater130 PDK 中 100 余种运放拓扑，每个拓扑附结构/功能标注、尺寸约束、Ngspice 测试平台，以及 NSGA-II 多目标尺寸扫描产生的约 10^3 个 Pareto 最优与 10^6 个中间尺寸-性能对。在其上定义六个带明确协议的基准任务（反向 sizing、拓扑选择、子电路分类、结构电路生成、Pareto 成员预测、多目标优化），并开源数据、真值标注与指标实现，使跨方法比较可复现。
Motivation: 模拟 IC 设计的 ML 研究受限于开放数据稀缺与评测不标准：各论文结果多在自建甚至闭源数据集上用临时指标得到，方法间比较不可靠。
Method: 在 SkyWater130 PDK 上构建 100 余个 1/2/3 级运放拓扑的数据集，每个拓扑带结构与功能标注、对称性与尺寸规则约束、Ngspice 测试平台，并用 NSGA-II 做多目标 sizing 产生约 10^3 Pareto 最优与 10^6 中间尺寸-性能对；据此定义六个带精确协议的基准任务，并开源指标定义例程的参考实现。
Result: 数据集覆盖 100 余种运放拓扑，每个拓扑约 10^3 个 Pareto 最优与 10^6 个中间 sizing-性能对；定义六个基准任务并以开源许可发布数据、真值标注与指标实现。
Conclusion: 作者称该数据集是四十余年模拟 IC 设计自动化领域最全面的 ML 开发数据集，开放许可使异构模拟设计自动化方法的评测可复现且可直接比较。

papers.title: Hear, Localize, and Reason: Spatially Aware Scene Understanding for Audio-Visual LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) have made strong progress in multimodal understanding, yet most treat audio as monaural semantic content, limiting their ability to reason about where sounds originate and how they relate to the visual scene. Recent spatial audio-visual studies address parts of this problem, but often focus on specific abilities, such as spatial correspondence or direction and distance reasoning. In this work, we introduce HLR-AVSceneQA, a comprehensive benchmark with a hear-localize-reason hierarchy that evaluates whether models can recognize what is heard, localize sound sources in egocentric and allocentric views, and use these localized sources to reason about how they relate to the visual scene. We further introduce HLR-LLM, which augments a strong audio-visual foundation model with a binaural spatial audio branch alongside its monaural semantic audio pathway. We train HLR-LLM with a curriculum that incorporates final-stage chain-of-thought supervision for multi-step spatial reasoning. Experiments show that existing AV-LLMs remain limited in spatial grounding and relational reasoning, while HLR-LLM substantially improves spatial audio-visual scene understanding without compromising semantic audio-visual perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HLR-AVSceneQA 基准与 HLR-LLM 模型，用 hear-localize-reason 三层级评测 AV-LLM 能否听出声音、在自我/外部视角定位声源并据此推理声源与视觉场景的关系。HLR-LLM 在单耳语义通路旁并联双耳空间音频分支，配合末段 chain-of-thought 监督的课程训练，显著提升空间音视场景理解且不损害语义音视感知。
Motivation: 现有 AV-LLM 把音频当作单耳语义内容，无法推理声源位置及其与视觉场景的关系；已有空间音视研究只覆盖空间对应或方向距离推理等单一能力，缺少统一评测。
Method: 构建 HLR-AVSceneQA 基准，按 hear-localize-reason 层级评测声源识别、自我与外部视角定位、以及基于定位结果的场景关系推理；HLR-LLM 在强音视基础模型的单耳语义通路外新增双耳空间音频分支，用含末段 chain-of-thought 监督的课程训练做多步空间推理。
Result: 实验显示现有 AV-LLM 在空间落地 (spatial grounding) 与关系推理上仍受限，HLR-LLM 显著改善空间音视场景理解，同时不牺牲语义音视感知能力。
Conclusion: 把双耳空间音频分支与单耳语义通路并联、再以 chain-of-thought 课程训练，是让 AV-LLM 兼顾空间推理与语义感知的可行路径。

papers.title: AVALON: Zero-Shot Indoor Navigation with Human-Seeded Topological Memory
papers.abstract_en: Indoor service robots often enter unmapped buildings whose layouts and task constraints are already familiar to users. We address this human-familiar, robot-unseen setting with AVALON, a topological navigation framework organized around human-seeded layered spatial memory, node-verified topological execution, and task-triggered, evidence-gated human--robot memory co-updating. The robot has no prior on-site traversal or site-specific training. Deployment requires only a floor plan, place clues, and an initial topology-odometry alignment. Visual depth point-goal navigation leverages verified node arrivals to perform translational re-anchoring, without requiring a robot-constructed global SLAM map. Human--robot memory co-updating fuses complementary sources of information. Human operators specify task constraints that are unobservable via vision and report offline environmental modifications, whereas the robot provides physical-state evidence through active in-situ validation. Task relevance governs whether human-reported environmental changes undergo robot validation during the active mission. Field-collected perceptual evidence gates memory updates, maintaining an explicit separation between human-specified permissions and robot-observed traversability. Our experiments on a Unitree Go2 show that AVALON with X-NavDP completes a 12.81 m Intersection-to-Dining mission in 46.4 s (5/5) with no mapping, 40.9% less robot time than DimOS-Go2 (78.5 s, 4/5), while policy-only X-NavDP times out in all of the 5 runs. These demonstrate the superiority of the proposed topological navigation framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AVALON 是面向室内服务机器人的零样本拓扑导航框架：以人类预置的分层空间记忆为先验，节点验证的拓扑执行配合任务触发、证据门控的人机记忆协同更新，在无现场遍历与站点特定训练下完成导航。在 Unitree Go2 上，AVALON 搭配 X-NavDP 以 46.4 s 完成 12.81 m 的 Intersection-to-Dining 任务（5/5 成功），机器人耗时比 DimOS-Go2（78.5 s，4/5）少 40.9%，而仅用策略的 X-NavDP 五次全部超时。
Motivation: 服务机器人常进入未建图建筑，但用户已熟悉其布局与任务约束；纯视觉策略缺少不可观测的任务约束，全局 SLAM 建图又成本高。
Method: 框架含三部分：人类播种的分层空间记忆（部署只需楼层平面图、地点线索与初始拓扑-里程计对齐）、节点验证的拓扑执行（视觉深度 point-goal 导航借已验证节点到达做平移重锚定，无需机器人自建全局 SLAM 图）、任务触发且证据门控的人机记忆协同更新（人类给出视觉不可观测的任务约束与离线环境改动，机器人以在地主动验证提供物理状态证据，现场采集的感知证据门控记忆更新，分离人类许可与机器人观测的可通行性）。
Result: 在 Unitree Go2 实机上，AVALON + X-NavDP 完成 12.81 m 的 Intersection-to-Dining 任务耗时 46.4 s、5/5 成功且无需建图；DimOS-Go2 为 78.5 s、4/5，AVALON 机器人耗时少 40.9%；仅策略的 X-NavDP 在全部 5 次运行中超时。
Conclusion: 作者主张该拓扑导航框架在人类熟悉、机器人未见的室内场景中优于对照系统，其优势来自人类播种记忆与机器人在地证据的分工式协同更新。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Transfer Learning in Bandits from Unknown Adaptive Policies: Problem-Dependent Lower and Upper Bounds
papers.abstract_en: Transfer learning in stochastic multi-armed bandits is typically studied assuming that prior data forms a fixed offline dataset or is generated by a known source. In practice, historical observations come from a previous adaptive decision process whose policy is unknown. We study this setting for bounded rewards in $[0,1]$. Before the online game starts, the learner receives, for each arm $k$, $N'_k$ observations drawn i.i.d.\ from an unknown distribution $ν'_k$, collected by an arbitrary and possibly data-dependent strategy, so the sample sizes $N'_k$ may be random. Source and target means satisfy $|μ_k-μ'_k|<L_k$ for known constants $(L_k)_k$. We derive an asymptotic problem-dependent lower bound and propose KL-UCB-Transfer, which combines online and historical data and achieves logarithmic regret with an improved leading constant whenever $μ'_a<μ_1-L_a$, and recovers the classical KL-UCB guarantee otherwise. Since bounding the source-target discrepancy is often unrealistic, we relax the assumption to the one-sided condition $μ_k-μ'_k<L_k$ and show that logarithmic regret can survive under misspecification, characterizing three regimes ranging from improvement to a degraded logarithmic bound to a loss of guarantee. Simulations illustrate the practical benefits of exploiting process-generated historical data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究历史数据来自未知自适应策略的随机多臂老虎机迁移学习，提出 KL-UCB-Transfer，在 |μ_k−μ'_k|<L_k 下给出渐近问题相关下界，并在 μ'_a<μ_1−L_a 时以改进的常数达到对数遗憾，否则退化为经典 KL-UCB 保证。放松到单边条件 μ_k−μ'_k<L_k 后，对数遗憾在误设下仍可存活，分三个区间：改进、退化的对数界、失去保证。
Motivation: 既有老虎机迁移学习假设先验数据是固定离线数据集或来自已知源策略，但真实历史观测来自策略未知的自适应决策过程，样本量 N'_k 因此是随机的，原有理论不适用。
Method: 对有界奖励 [0,1]、每臂历史样本来自未知分布 ν'_k 且由任意数据相关策略收集的设定，推导渐近问题相关下界；提出 KL-UCB-Transfer，联合在线与历史数据，在双边界 |μ_k−μ'_k|<L_k 与单边条件 μ_k−μ'_k<L_k 下分别分析。
Result: KL-UCB-Transfer 在 μ'_a<μ_1−L_a 时达到对数遗憾且改进首项常数，否则恢复经典 KL-UCB 保证；单边误设下刻画三个区间，从改进到退化的对数界再到失去保证；仿真展示利用过程生成历史数据的实际收益。
Conclusion: 来自未知自适应策略的历史数据仍可用于迁移并获得改进常数的对数遗憾，但源-目标差异只需单边界即可，误设时性能按三个区间分级退化而非直接失效。

papers.title: ClaimScope: Label-Blind Witness Verification for Mathematical Claim Auditing
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical agents are commonly evaluated by answer accuracy or proof acceptance. We introduce ClaimScope, a 72-task benchmark for auditing proposed claims through a verdict, scope, counterexample, and repair. Tasks cover optimizer-state transport, finite-horizon affine recurrences, and exact $2\times2$ linear algebra. We evaluate Qwen3-8B with direct generation and four matched two-pass conditions, each starting from the same draft. A witness checker evaluates only the model's submitted state, without consulting reference verdicts or supplying a replacement witness. Its feedback still conveys information about validity: a verified refutation establishes that the claim is false, and rejection reasons can suggest structural fixes. In this evaluation, verifier feedback yields $23/39$ accepted counterexamples on invalid claims and $25/72$ safe completions, compared with $15/39$ and $20/72$ for checker-free generic feedback. Strict completion remains $17/72$; verdict accuracy changes from $47/72$ to $46/72$. The claim-grouped safe-completion difference is $.094$, with a bootstrap 95\% interval of $[.000,.198]$. All seven task-level gains follow horizon/input-length diagnostics. A post-hoc schema-only correction of the direct outputs reaches the same 25 safe tasks without another model call. These results separate claim classification from executable evidence, while locating the observed gains in witness-structure correction rather than demonstrating broader reasoning improvement.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop (Mathematical Reasoning and AI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ClaimScope 是一个 72 任务的数学论断审计基准，用 verdict、scope、counterexample、repair 四要素评估 Qwen3-8B 的直接生成与四种两遍条件。只看提交状态、不查参考答案的 witness checker 反馈把无效论断上的反例采纳从 15/39 提到 23/39、安全完成从 20/72 提到 25/72，但严格完成仅 17/72、verdict 准确率 47/72 反而降到 46/72；增益被定位为 witness 结构修正而非更广的推理提升。
Motivation: 数学智能体普遍只按答案正确率或证明接受度评估，无法区分论断分类与可执行证据，也看不出反馈到底改了什么。
Method: 构建 72 任务基准，覆盖 optimizer-state transport、finite-horizon affine recurrences 与精确 2×2 线性代数；对 Qwen3-8B 比较直接生成与四种同起点 draft 的两遍条件，其中 witness checker 只评估模型提交的状态，不参考 verdict、也不提供替代 witness；另做一次 post-hoc schema-only 修正。
Result: verifier 反馈下无效论断的反例采纳 23/39、安全完成 25/72，对照 checker-free 通用反馈的 15/39 与 20/72；严格完成 17/72，verdict 准确率由 47/72 变为 46/72；按论断分组的安全完成差值 .094，bootstrap 95% 区间 [.000,.198]；七项任务级增益全部符合 horizon/input-length 诊断；schema-only 事后修正不额外调用模型即达到同样 25 个安全任务。
Conclusion: witness 结构修正能提升可执行证据的采纳与安全完成，但与论断分类能力脱节，且不应被解读为更广泛的推理改进。

papers.title: Learning to Search for Executable Patternmaking from Certified Programs
papers.abstract_en: Recent models generate sewing patterns from images or text, and program-based representations make these patterns executable. These systems produce a finished pattern and do not model how a patternmaker turns one pattern into another. In practice a new style is made by editing an existing pattern: lengthening the bodice, moving a dart, swapping a sleeve. Pattern archives record the results of such edits and none of the steps. We observe that the steps can be recovered by searching over editing actions until one pattern becomes the other. A deterministic compiler makes the recovered steps checkable. To this end, we present SemDraft, the first framework that learns to search for executable patternmaking programs from paired before-and-after sewing patterns without recorded editing steps. Specifically, a bounded search recovers a program of editing actions and certifies it only after three checks: it recompiles from scratch, every pair of its actions is classified as ordered or interchangeable, and an independent replay reaches the same pattern. The certified programs then train a model that ranks candidate actions inside the same search. On two frozen draws of 80 order-sensitive cases, with every other search component fixed, the learned ranker certifies 63 and 64 cases within 1,000 search executions, against at most 53 and 52 for non-learned rankers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SemDraft 从成对的改版前后缝纫纸样中学习搜索可执行的纸样编辑程序，无需记录编辑步骤：有界搜索恢复编辑动作序列，只有通过三重认证（从零重编译、动作对有序/可交换分类、独立重放到同一纸样）才被采纳，认证后的程序再训练一个在搜索内对候选动作排序的模型。在两份各 80 个顺序敏感案例的冻结抽样上，学习排序器在 1,000 次搜索执行内认证 63 与 64 例，非学习排序器最多 53 与 52 例。
Motivation: 现有从图像或文本生成缝纫纸样的模型直接产出成品纸样，不刻画纸样师如何把一个纸样改成另一个；纸样档案只记录改版结果而不记录编辑步骤，导致编辑过程无法监督学习。
Method: SemDraft 用有界搜索在编辑动作空间上恢复把一个纸样变成另一个的程序，由确定性编译器保证可检查；认证需通过三项检查：从零重编译、每对动作被分类为有序或可交换、独立重放到达同一纸样。认证后的程序作为训练数据训练一个在搜索内部对候选动作打分的排序模型。
Result: 在两份冻结的各 80 个顺序敏感案例抽样上，其余搜索组件固定时，学习排序器在 1,000 次搜索执行内分别认证 63 与 64 例，非学习排序器最多认证 53 与 52 例。
Conclusion: 纸样编辑步骤可以从改版前后纸样对中通过搜索加认证的方式恢复，且用认证程序训练的排序器比非学习排序器在同等搜索预算内认证更多顺序敏感案例。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MYOPIA: Understanding the Limits of Tree-Based Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Decision trees can make vision-language model (VLM) classification interpretable by replacing a single prediction with a sequence of root-to-leaf questions. However, the accuracy cost of this greedy, non-backtracking procedure remains unclear. We introduce \textbf{MYOPIA}, a benchmark comprising four LLM-generated, human-refined decision trees for GTSRB, MNIST, CIFAR-10, and MSCOCO, together with matched prompts, diagnostic protocols, and an evaluation harness. Across GPT-4o, Qwen-VL Max, and LLaMA-3.2 11B Vision, tree traversal underperforms zero-shot prompting in all 12 dataset--model pairs; paired bootstrap analyses consistently favor zero-shot. Our diagnostics characterize interacting failure modes associated with this gap. Models often recall tree-encoded class attributes more accurately than they ground the same attributes in images: the mean label--image accuracy gaps are 9.5, 13.8, and 12.6 points for GPT-4o, Qwen-VL Max, and LLaMA, respectively. Incorrect local decisions then irreversibly exclude the correct class, while answer extraction introduces additional model-dependent loss. A node-level audit of the four trees finds that split entropy is weakly but consistently associated with lower node accuracy, whereas depth, branching factor, and within-node grounding differences are less stable. \textbf{MYOPIA} therefore provides a framework for diagnosing hierarchical visual classification and motivates testing tree designs that prioritize perceptual answerability and recovery from early errors. Code is available at https://github.com/islammesabah/VLM_Classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MYOPIA 是一个诊断基准，用四棵 LLM 生成、人工修订的决策树（对应 GTSRB、MNIST、CIFAR-10、MSCOCO）把 VLM 分类改成从根到叶的逐问回答，以量化这种贪心、不回溯推理的精度代价。在 GPT-4o、Qwen-VL Max、LLaMA-3.2 11B Vision 的全部 12 个数据集–模型组合上，树遍历都输给 zero-shot prompting，配对 bootstrap 一致支持 zero-shot；作者建议树设计优先考虑感知可答性与早期错误的恢复。
Motivation: 用决策树把 VLM 单次预测拆成根到叶的提问序列可提升可解释性，但这种贪心、不回溯过程到底损失多少精度一直不清楚。
Method: 构建 MYOPIA 基准：四棵针对 GTSRB、MNIST、CIFAR-10、MSCOCO 的 LLM 生成、人工精修决策树，配对 prompt、诊断协议与评测 harness；在 GPT-4o、Qwen-VL Max、LLaMA-3.2 11B Vision 上做 12 个数据集–模型组合的配对 bootstrap 分析，并对四棵树做节点级审计（split entropy、depth、branching factor、节点内 grounding 差异）。
Result: 树遍历在全部 12 个数据集–模型组合上都不如 zero-shot prompting，配对 bootstrap 一致偏向 zero-shot。模型记住树编码的类属性比把同一属性落到图像上更准：label–image 准确率均值差距分别为 GPT-4o 9.5 点、Qwen-VL Max 13.8 点、LLaMA 12.6 点。节点级审计发现 split entropy 与更低节点准确率弱但一致相关，而 depth、branching factor、节点内 grounding 差异关系不稳定。
Conclusion: 树式推理的精度损失来自可诊断的交互失效：局部决策错误会不可逆地排除正确类，答案抽取再叠加模型相关损失；因此应测试优先感知可答性、能从早期错误中恢复的树设计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Rethinking the Role of Tool Graph Memory in Multi-Turn Tool Use
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents solve complex tasks by calling external tools over multiple turns. Recent work has proposed tool graph memory, which stores past experience as tool transitions to guide subsequent selection. However, it remains unclear whether this component consistently improves agents' tool use or undermines it. We evaluate tool graph memory on nine models and two benchmarks, finding that it seldom improves significantly over baselines, and that its gains, where present, cost over twice the LLM calls. The memory's guidance is often incorrect, and random or no guidance retains most of the gain, implying that the benefit stems from extra computation rather than the memory itself. Moreover, even with the correct next tool suggested, many failures remain, such as giving up without a tool call. Storing the same experience instead as textual insights outperforms tool graph memory with almost no extra LLM calls. This suggests that memory serves better as a soft prior than as a prescription of the next tool, leading to a more effective and generalizable solution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 9 个模型、2 个基准上评估工具图记忆 (tool graph memory)，发现它相对基线几乎不带来显著提升，且有收益时 LLM 调用成本超过两倍；把同一经验存成文本洞见 (textual insights) 几乎不增加调用却优于工具图记忆，说明记忆应作为软先验而非指定下一步工具的硬处方。
Motivation: 多轮工具调用中，工具图记忆被用来把历史经验存成工具转移以指导后续选择，但它是否稳定改善工具使用、收益究竟来自记忆还是额外计算，此前并不清楚。
Method: 在 9 个 LLM 与 2 个基准上评估工具图记忆，对照基线、随机指导与无指导，并对比将相同经验存为文本洞见的替代方案，同时统计 LLM 调用开销与失败模式。
Result: 工具图记忆相对基线很少显著提升，有收益时 LLM 调用超过两倍；其指导常出错，随机或无指导仍保留大部分收益；即便给出正确的下一工具，仍存在不调用工具就放弃等失败；文本洞见以几乎不额外 LLM 调用胜过工具图记忆。
Conclusion: 工具图记忆的收益主要来自额外计算而非记忆本身，记忆更适合充当软先验，直接指定下一步工具的处方式用法应被放弃。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 工具图记忆相对基线很少显著提升，有收益时 LLM 调用超过两倍；其指导常出错，随机或无指导仍保留大部分收益；即便给出正确的下一工具，仍存在不调用工具就放弃等失败；文本洞见以几乎不额外 LLM 调用胜过工具图记忆。

papers.title: Independent Data-Integrity Verification for LLM-Driven Functional Coverage Closure in Hardware Design
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents can write directed tests that close functional coverage, but coverage only shows that a state was reached, not that the data on the way there was correct. This is a long-known point in verification and we do not claim it as new. We describe a small coverage-closure agent that applies it to an LLM loop: coverage is read from the report that the simulation itself exports (cocotb-coverage YAML) and never taken from the model's account, and data integrity is checked by scoreboards that are separate from the model. On three architecturally distinct RTL designs (an asynchronous FIFO, a UART transmitter and an AHB2APB bridge) the agent raised coverage from 91.7%, 88.9% and 67.4% to 100% within its 8-iteration budget in every logged run, using one design-agnostic agent. A reactive scoreboard monitor attached to the FIFO's base testbench also found a clock-domain-crossing bug in the author's own stimulus code. The monitor is not yet attached to the LLM-generated tests, so their data integrity is not independently checked; one manual check on a single FIFO test is reported as preliminary. We list the weaknesses of this evidence: three designs, no baseline, no ablation, and logged runs that come from several agent checkpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个小型功能覆盖率收敛 agent：覆盖率只从仿真导出的 cocotb-coverage YAML 读取、绝不采信模型自述，数据完整性由独立于模型的 scoreboard 校验。在异步 FIFO、UART 发送器、AHB2APB 桥三个 RTL 设计上，单一与设计无关的 agent 在 8 轮迭代预算内把覆盖率从 91.7%、88.9%、67.4% 全部提到 100%，且每次记录运行都达成。
Motivation: LLM agent 能写定向测试把功能覆盖率推满，但覆盖率只说明状态被到达，不保证沿途数据正确；验证领域早已知道这一点，把它落到 LLM 循环上仍缺可独立核验的机制。
Method: 覆盖率从仿真自身导出的 cocotb-coverage YAML 读取，不取模型的自述；数据完整性由与模型分离的 scoreboard 检查；另在 FIFO 基础 testbench 上挂了一个 reactive scoreboard monitor。整个 agent 与设计无关，迭代预算 8 轮。
Result: 三个 RTL 设计的覆盖率分别从 91.7%、88.9%、67.4% 提升到 100%，且在每一次记录运行中都在 8 轮预算内完成；挂在 FIFO 基础 testbench 上的 monitor 还发现了作者自己 stimulus 代码里的一个跨时钟域 (clock-domain-crossing) bug。
Conclusion: 把覆盖率与数据完整性都放在模型之外核验，可让 LLM 覆盖率收敛循环的证据可审计；但 monitor 尚未接到 LLM 生成的测试上，其数据完整性未被独立检查，证据限于三个设计、无基线无消融、且记录运行来自多个 agent checkpoint。

papers.title: Decoupled Safety Control: A Safety-Control Algorithm for Training-Free Safety Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models achieve strong performance in text-to-image generation, but they can still produce unsafe content. Training-free safety guidance offers a practical inference-time alternative that intervenes during sampling without modifying model weights. However, many existing safeguards still rely on a coupled safety-control chain. In this chain, the same unsafe condition simultaneously specifies what should be avoided, indicates the current unsafe signal, constructs the intervention, and determines when that intervention remains active. This coupling can work when unsafe factors are explicit, but becomes less reliable once harmful and benign semantics are entangled in the current generation state, often leaving residual unsafe content or unnecessarily degrading benign-generation quality or prompt fidelity. We address this problem with Decoupled Safety Control (DSC), a plug-in safety-control algorithm for training-free safety guidance. DSC reformulates training-free safety guidance as an explicit state-dependent control process, so the executed intervention is determined from the current generation state rather than inherited directly from a single unsafe condition. Experiments on standard safety benchmarks show that DSC improves representative latent- and text-space safeguards, achieving stronger unsafe-content suppression while preserving benign-generation quality and maintaining efficient inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSC 把训练无关的安全引导 (training-free safety guidance) 重写为显式状态依赖控制过程：干预由当前生成状态决定，而非直接继承自单一 unsafe 条件，从而解开安全控制链中
Motivation: 现有扩散模型安全护栏把
Method: 提出 Decoupled Safety Control (DSC)，一个即插即用的安全控制算法，将训练无关安全引导形式化为显式状态依赖控制过程，干预依据当前生成状态而非单一 unsafe 条件构造与激活。
Result: 在标准安全基准上，DSC 改进了具代表性的 latent-space 与 text-space 护栏，更强抑制不安全内容，同时保持良性生成质量与提示保真度，并维持高效推理；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 安全控制链的耦合是残留不安全内容与良性质量下降的根源，解耦后可在不改权重的前提下同时改善抑制与保真。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Perception to Prediction and Intervention: Benchmarking Proactive Video Assistants in Real-Life Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal large language models have advanced video understanding, but existing benchmarks mainly evaluate whether models can interpret observed visual content. In real-world scenarios, assistants must additionally anticipate what assistance is needed and decide when to provide it. To address this gap, we introduce \textsc{P$^3$IBench}, a benchmark for proactive video understanding in real-life streaming scenarios. It evaluates three complementary capabilities: daily perception, risk prediction and intervention. We benchmark 12 representative open-source and proprietary video-language models, including streaming and adapted non-streaming systems. Our evaluation shows that current models struggle to make well-calibrated response decisions. Finally, we construct additional proactive training data and train \textsc{P$^3$I-Assistant-4B}, achieving improvements on several tasks, though gains remain uneven across capabilities. Together, these findings show that effective proactive assistance requires not only visual understanding, but also precise response timing and appropriate restraint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 P3IBench，把视频助手评测从「看懂已发生内容」扩展到主动感知、风险预测与干预时机三项能力，并在 12 个开源与闭源视频-语言模型上发现当前模型难以做出校准良好的响应决策。基于此构造主动训练数据训练 P3I-Assistant-4B，在若干任务上有提升，但各能力间增益不均衡。
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准只考察模型能否解读已观测的视觉内容，而真实场景中的助手还需预判何时需要何种帮助并决定介入时机，这一响应决策能力缺少评测。
Method: 构建 P3IBench 基准，评测日常感知、风险预测与干预三项互补能力；覆盖 12 个代表性开源与闭源视频-语言模型，含流式与改造后的非流式系统；随后构造主动训练数据并训练 4B 参数的 P3I-Assistant-4B。
Result: 在 12 个视频-语言模型上评测显示当前模型难以做出校准良好的响应决策 (well-calibrated response decisions)；P3I-Assistant-4B 在若干任务上取得提升，但各能力间增益不均衡。
Conclusion: 有效的主动助手不仅需要视觉理解，还需要精确的响应时机与恰当的克制 (appropriate restraint)。

papers.title: Sharp and Stable Label-Free Calibration Certificates from Logical Coherence
papers.abstract_en: Query-conditioned probabilistic predictors answer logically related questions one at a time, and labels to check their calibration are often missing. For each restriction on what a bettor's stakes may use, a minimax theorem identifies, for finitely supported laws of the answers, the sharp label-free lower bound on the corresponding calibration residual. On bundles of different events its mean, marginal and joint stages can separate strictly, and a bundle's bound cannot be attributed to one question without assumptions on the others. The sharp marginal bound is discontinuous in the answers, and no label-free lower bound continuous in the Wasserstein distance stays within a constant factor of it. Lipschitz stakes give a stable bound, sharp for a smooth calibration residual and, for every positive Lipschitz constant, positive exactly when the sharp marginal bound is. On i.i.d. streams, projected online gradient ascent at fixed nodes gives fixed-horizon certificates whose shortfall is bounded by grid, learning and statistical terms, and predictable betting gives anytime-valid ones. In a preregistered study of four predictors on two data sets, all seven confirmatory certificates were positive (the eighth pair did not pass the pilot). A certificate shows only that calibration is at least this bad; zero means "not refuted".
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无标签场景下，用逻辑一致性给出概率预测器校准残差的 sharp 下界：对赌注 (stakes) 的每种约束，极小极大定理刻画有限支撑答案分布上的最优 label-free 界。界在事件束的均值、边缘、联合三层可严格分离，且边缘 sharp 界对答案不连续——不存在在 Wasserstein 距离下连续、又与其保持常数因子的 label-free 下界；改用 Lipschitz 赌注可得稳定界，对光滑校准残差 sharp，且对任意正 Lipschitz 常数恰在 sharp 边缘界为正时为正。
Motivation: 查询条件的概率预测器逐题作答，而校准标签常缺失；需要在无标签时给出可证的校准残差下界，且该界要对输入扰动稳定、可在线逐段核验。
Method: 对赌注可用信息的每种约束建立极小极大定理，求有限支撑答案分布上校准残差的 sharp label-free 下界；分解为均值/边缘/联合三层；用 Lipschitz 赌注构造稳定界；在 i.i.d. 流上以固定节点的 projected online gradient ascent 给出固定时域证书，其缺口由网格、学习、统计三项界定，并用 predictable betting 给出 anytime-valid 证书。
Result: 事件束上均值、边缘、联合三层界可严格分离；sharp 边缘界对答案不连续，且不存在 Wasserstein 连续、与之保持常数因子的 label-free 下界；Lipschitz 界对任意正 Lipschitz 常数恰在 sharp 边缘界为正时为正。预注册研究覆盖 4 个预测器、2 个数据集，7 个确证性证书全部为正（第 8 对未通过 pilot）。
Conclusion: 无标签校准证书可以 sharp 且可在线核验，但必须接受不连续性并改用 Lipschitz 赌注换取稳定；证书为正只说明校准至少这么差，为零表示“未被反驳”。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: BiShield-TEE: On the (In-)Security of Unilateral Weight Obfuscation in On-Device TEE-Shielded LLM Partition
papers.abstract_en: On-device deployment of large language models (LLMs) is increasingly adopted due to latency and privacy requirements, but exposes proprietary models to reverse engineering and intellectual property theft. Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) provide hardware-enforced isolation for on-device inference, yet most TEE-based parameter obfuscation relies on unilateral matrix transformations that obfuscate only output side. We identify a vulnerability in this design, termed the \emph{Solution Determinacy Property (SDP)}: the obfuscation secret is uniquely determined, exposing the structure of the true key and enabling attackers to break the protection. Under our attacks, representative methods \textsc{GroupCover} and \textsc{ArrowCloak} are reduced to negligible protection, with attack accuracy reaching over $2.4\times$ the full-shielding black-box baseline and recovering near-complete model functionality.To address this vulnerability, we propose \textsc{BiShield-TEE}, a bilateral framework that induces \emph{Ambiguous Solutions} through joint obfuscation of input and output dimensions, hiding the true key among many equally valid candidates. Experiments across diverse models and datasets show that \textsc{BiShield-TEE} confines attack accuracy to the full-shielding black-box baseline, while achieving higher inference efficiency than prior methods on real hardware.Our code is available at https://github.com/laduiw/BiShield-TEE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TEE 内做单边权重混淆的 LLM 推理保护存在 Solution Determinacy Property (SDP)：混淆密钥被唯一确定，攻击者可还原真实密钥。BiShield-TEE 改为输入与输出维度联合混淆，制造多解歧义，把攻击精度压回全屏蔽黑盒基线，且在真实硬件上推理效率高于既有方法。
Motivation: 端侧 LLM 部署面临模型被逆向与知识产权窃取，主流 TEE 权重混淆只对输出侧做矩阵变换，密钥结构可被反推，保护形同虚设。
Method: 先指出单边混淆的 SDP 漏洞并构造攻击，再提出 BiShield-TEE：对输入与输出维度联合混淆，使真实密钥隐藏在多个等价候选解中，恢复模型功能需额外信息。
Result: 在 GroupCover 与 ArrowCloak 上，攻击精度达到全屏蔽黑盒基线的 2.4 倍以上，几乎完全恢复模型功能；BiShield-TEE 在多种模型与数据集上把攻击精度限制在全屏蔽黑盒基线水平，且在真实硬件上推理效率高于先前方法。
Conclusion: 单边权重混淆因解的唯一性在 TEE 场景下不安全，双边联合混淆引入歧义解才能把保护拉回黑盒水平并保持效率。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: TEE 内做单边权重混淆的 LLM 推理保护存在 Solution Determinacy Property (SDP)：混淆密钥被唯一确定，攻击者可还原真实密钥。BiShield-TEE 改为输入与输出维度联合混淆，制造多解歧义，把攻击精度压回全屏蔽黑盒基线，且在真实硬件上推理效率高于既有方法。

summary_sections.method: 先指出单边混淆的 SDP 漏洞并构造攻击，再提出 BiShield-TEE：对输入与输出维度联合混淆，使真实密钥隐藏在多个等价候选解中，恢复模型功能需额外信息。
summary_sections.result: 在 GroupCover 与 ArrowCloak 上，攻击精度达到全屏蔽黑盒基线的 2.4 倍以上，几乎完全恢复模型功能；BiShield-TEE 在多种模型与数据集上把攻击精度限制在全屏蔽黑盒基线水平，且在真实硬件上推理效率高于先前方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 单边权重混淆因解的唯一性在 TEE 场景下不安全，双边联合混淆引入歧义解才能把保护拉回黑盒水平并保持效率。

papers.title: A Quantum Machine Learning Approach to Content-Based Media Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: We use quantum machine learning techniques to develop a content-based media recommender system and evaluate its performance on TV programmes using textual descriptions from one week of BBC iPlayer data. Grounded in the Quantum Natural Language Processing framework (QNLP), programme synopses are mapped to variational quantum circuits using their semantic structure. The parameters of these circuits are trained via a supervised pairwise similarity learning task. We benchmark the quantum recommender against a classical BiLSTM baseline trained on the same dataset and objective. While both models achieve comparable performance on the similarity learning task, the quantum model requires significantly fewer parameters (47k vs. 17.8M). When the BiLSTM is constrained to a matching parameter budget, its performance degrades substantially (by 3.63 percentage points in Mean Average Precision (MAP)), indicating that the structured quantum representation provides a highly parameter-efficient alternative in this setting. We demonstrate the feasibility of executing the trained models on quantum hardware by deploying the circuits on Quantinuum's System Model H2 (and accompanying emulator) using a SWAP-test-based protocol. The results confirm that the similarity signal is preserved under realistic, noisy conditions. Taken together, these findings highlight the potential of variational quantum circuits for recommendation tasks and represent a practical step toward their real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 在 QNLP 框架下将节目 synopsis 依语义结构编码为变分量子电路，用监督式成对相似度学习训练电路参数；以同数据集、同目标函数的 BiLSTM 作经典基线，并另设一个参数量对齐的 BiLSTM 对照；随后用 SWAP-test 协议把训练好的电路部署到 Quantinuum System Model H2 及其模拟器上执行。

Conclusion: 在 BBC iPlayer 这一数据与任务设定下，结构化的量子表示是参数高效的推荐替代方案，且已具备在含噪量子硬件上执行的可行性。

papers.title: DialFork: Going Beyond Factuality to Evaluate Procedural Hallucination in Conversational Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) deployed as conversational agents are increasingly expected to follow procedural logic. While factual hallucination has received extensive attention, a different failure mode has been overlooked: procedural hallucination, in which an agent produces individually fluent and factually plausible utterances while deviating from the intended conversational process. We introduce DialFork, the first benchmark to measure this failure mode on raw dialogue text. DialFork is built by forking conformant dialogues at controlled turn positions and injecting one of four hallucination types, yielding 36,278 dialogues across 24 tasks in 12 domains; 30 human annotators validate the construction. We define three evaluation tasks that characterize procedural deviation at three granularities: how far a set of dialogues deviates from conformant ones (monitoring deployed agents), how far a single dialogue does (procedural retrieval), and at which turn a dialogue first goes off-track (real-time guardrails). For the first two, we propose dialog-flow-aware metrics, FlowKL and FlowScore, that compare dialogues by how they unfold rather than their content. At the dialogue level, FlowScore significantly outperforms all baselines across seven encoders, showing that semantic similarity is no substitute for procedural similarity. We release DialFork under the MIT license at https://github.com/idiap/dialfork, hoping the community will measure conversational process alongside content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DialFork 是首个在原始对话文本上度量过程性幻觉 (procedural hallucination) 的基准：把合规对话在受控轮次处分叉并注入四类幻觉，得到 12 领域 24 任务共 36,278 条对话，由 30 名标注者验证。配套提出对话流感知指标 FlowKL 与 FlowScore，按对话展开方式而非内容比较；FlowScore 在七个编码器上于对话级显著超越全部基线，说明语义相似度不能替代过程相似度。
Motivation: LLM 对话代理被期待遵循流程逻辑，但现有评测只盯事实性幻觉，单句流畅且事实可信、却偏离预期对话流程的失败模式没有度量手段。
Method: 在受控轮次位置分叉合规对话并注入四类幻觉类型构建 DialFork；定义三个粒度的评测任务（对话集偏离监控、单对话过程检索、首次跑偏轮次定位），并提出 dialog-flow-aware 指标 FlowKL 与 FlowScore，按对话展开而非内容比较。
Result: 基准含 36,278 条对话、24 个任务、12 个领域，30 名人工标注者验证构建；在对话级，FlowScore 在七个编码器上均显著优于全部基线。
Conclusion: 过程性幻觉是事实性幻觉之外的独立失败模式，评测应同时度量对话过程与内容；DialFork 以 MIT 许可发布。

papers.title: Reducing the Cost of Qudit State Preparation by Learning a Sparse Structure for SNAP Gates
papers.abstract_en: Preparing quantum states in bosonic qudits with SNAP--Displacement sequences requires both optimizing the gate parameters and deciding which Fock levels should be controlled by each SNAP gate. A fully parameterized ansatz assigns an independent phase to every Fock level in every gate, leading to a number of phases that grows steeply. This constitutes a problem for short to medium term systems as controlling many phases requires complex control pulses which are subject to increased control errors. Previous work reduced this cost by restricting the trainable phases to predefined sparse patterns, such as a diagonal or a grid, which however may not be optimal for a specific target state. In this work, we address this limitation by introducing a method that learns which phases are needed together with their values, using a differentiable mask. A sparsity penalty encourages the removal of unnecessary phases, while temperature annealing gradually turns the masks into binary decisions. We compare the proposed method with fully parameterized and predefined sparse ansatzes on Fourier and Haar-random target states. The evaluation considers both the minimum number of phases required to reach different infidelity thresholds and the overall trade-off between fidelity and phases required, measured through Pareto frontiers and hypervolume. The results show that learning the location of the phases together with their values provides competitive or improved fidelity--resource trade-offs, although the advantage depends on the target state and qudit dimension.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, accepted at International Workshop on AI for Quantum and Quantum for AI (AIQxQIA 2026), co-located with AIxIA 2026, Perugia, Italy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在玻色 qudit 的 SNAP–Displacement 态制备中，用可微 mask 同时学习每个 SNAP gate 控制哪些 Fock level 的相位及其取值，稀疏惩罚删掉多余相位，温度退火把 mask 逐步压成二值决策。在 Fourier 与 Haar-random 目标态上，与全参数化和预设稀疏 ansatz 相比，学到的相位位置给出有竞争力或更优的 fidelity–相位数权衡，但优势取决于目标态与 qudit 维度。
Motivation: 全参数化 ansatz 给每个 gate 的每个 Fock level 都配独立相位，相位数急剧增长，需要复杂控制脉冲并引入更大控制误差；而已有做法只能把相位限制在对角或网格等预设稀疏模式，未必适合特定目标态。
Method: 引入可微 mask 学习相位位置与取值：稀疏惩罚 (sparsity penalty) 鼓励删除多余相位，温度退火 (temperature annealing) 使 mask 逐渐变为二值决策；与全参数化 ansatz 和预设稀疏 ansatz 在 Fourier 与 Haar-random 目标态上对比。
Result: 评测覆盖达到不同 infidelity 阈值所需的最少相位数，以及 fidelity 与相位数的整体权衡，用 Pareto frontiers 与 hypervolume 度量；结果显示学习相位位置与取值给出有竞争力或更优的 fidelity–resource 权衡，优势依赖于目标态与 qudit 维度。
Conclusion: 相位该放在哪些 Fock level 上应与相位值一起学出来，而不是套用固定稀疏模式；收益并非对所有目标态和维度一致。

papers.title: When Does Muon Actually Win? A Paired Data-, Time-, and Tuning-Budget Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Muon's gains in data efficiency motivate evaluating its performance under explicit data, time, and tuning budgets. On a single A100 GPU, we compare a reference single-device Muon implementation with AdamW across 17.7M- and 33.6M-parameter causal language models and 2.70M-parameter vision transformers. A common 23-candidate development budget selects configurations evaluated with five matched seeds, full validation trajectories, optimizer-step timing, and a frozen one-shot test. Muon reduces validation-loss area under the curve by 3.25--22.44\% at equal data and lowers test loss in all 20 primary pairs. In this configuration, Muon improves time-normalized loss area} by 19.68--22.31\% on vision, while AdamW is better by 3.38--6.96\% on language. The full Muon optimizer call, including auxiliary AdamW updates, consumes 56.1--69.6\% of training time, compared with 6.1--9.1\% for the AdamW baseline. Muon also has higher expected regret under restricted access to these candidate pools. These results characterize small models with reference kernels; their wall-clock ordering does not establish a ranking for larger models or optimized implementations.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop (Optimization for Machine Learning)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在单张 A100 上以配对的调参预算比较 Muon 与 AdamW：等数据量下 Muon 把验证损失 AUC 降低 3.25–22.44%，20 组主配对的测试损失全部更低；但按墙钟时间归一化后，视觉模型上 Muon 领先 19.68–22.31%，语言模型上 AdamW 反超 3.38–6.96%。结论是 Muon 的数据效率优势在时间预算下会因优化器开销（占训练时间 56.1–69.6%，AdamW 仅 6.1–9.1%）而被抵消，且在受限候选池下期望后悔更高。
Motivation: Muon 常被宣传为数据效率更高的优化器，但其收益是否在显式的数据、时间和调参预算下仍然成立缺少配对证据；小模型上优化器本身的墙钟开销可能吞掉等数据量的损失优势。
Method: 在单张 A100 上用参考单设备 Muon 实现对比 AdamW，覆盖 17.7M 与 33.6M 参数的因果语言模型和 2.70M 参数的 vision transformer；统一 23 候选的开发预算选配置，再用 5 个配对种子、完整验证轨迹、优化器步计时和冻结的一次性测试进行评估。
Result: 等数据量下 Muon 使验证损失 AUC 降低 3.25–22.44%，并在全部 20 组主配对上降低测试损失；按时间归一化后 Muon 在视觉上改善损失面积 19.68–22.31%，而 AdamW 在语言上好 3.38–6.96%。Muon 完整优化器调用（含辅助 AdamW 更新）占训练时间 56.1–69.6%，AdamW 基线仅占 6.1–9.1%；在受限访问这些候选池时 Muon 的期望后悔更高。
Conclusion: 在小模型加参考 kernel 的设定下，Muon 的墙钟排序不能外推到更大模型或优化实现；按时间预算选优化器时，语言任务上 AdamW 可能更划算。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification in Pairwise Difference Learning for Classification
papers.abstract_en: Instead of learning a mapping from instances to outcomes in the standard way, the key idea of pairwise difference learning (PDL) is to learn a function that takes two instances as input and predicts the difference between the respective outcomes. Given a function of this kind, predictions for a query instance are derived from every training example and then averaged. We propose a version of PDL for the task of classification and propose a suitable meta-learning technique for this purpose. Moreover, we address the problem of uncertainty quantification, i.e., of representing and quantifying the uncertainty of a PDL classifier's predictions in a faithful manner. Building on recent work on the decomposition of total uncertainty into aleatoric and epistemic components, we propose different ways of extending corresponding measures to the setting of PDL, depending on how and to what extent uncertainty is represented by the underlying base learner. In large-scale empirical studies, we analyze both the predictive accuracy and the uncertainty awareness of our PDL classifier.
papers.comment: 32 pages. Preprint (version submitted before peer review) of the article published in Machine Learning 115, 12 (2026)
papers.journal_ref: Machine Learning 115, 12 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 pairwise difference learning (PDL) 从回归搬到分类：用元学习训练一个以两个样本为输入、预测类别差异的函数，查询样本的预测由全部训练样本的差值预测聚合而成。在此基础上把总不确定性分解为 aleatoric 与 epistemic 两支并按基学习器的表示方式扩展到 PDL，大规模实证研究同时考察预测精度与不确定性感知。
Motivation: PDL 已有回归形式，但分类任务上缺少对应的 PDL 学习方案，且其聚合式预测如何忠实表示与量化不确定性没有现成办法。
Method: 提出分类版 PDL 并配一种元学习 (meta-learning) 训练技术；基于总不确定性分解为 aleatoric 与 epistemic 的近期工作，按底层基学习器表示不确定性的程度，给出多种扩展到 PDL 分类器的不确定性度量。
Result: 在大规模实证研究中同时分析所提 PDL 分类器的预测精度与不确定性感知 (uncertainty awareness)；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 分类任务可以沿 PDL 的差值学习路线做，并通过把 aleatoric/epistemic 分解移植到 PDL 来实现对预测不确定性的忠实量化。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 把 pairwise difference learning (PDL) 从回归搬到分类：用元学习训练一个以两个样本为输入、预测类别差异的函数，查询样本的预测由全部训练样本的差值预测聚合而成。在此基础上把总不确定性分解为 aleatoric 与 epistemic 两支并按基学习器的表示方式扩展到 PDL，大规模实证研究同时考察预测精度与不确定性感知。
summary_sections.motivation: PDL 已有回归形式，但分类任务上缺少对应的 PDL 学习方案，且其聚合式预测如何忠实表示与量化不确定性没有现成办法。
summary_sections.method: 提出分类版 PDL 并配一种元学习 (meta-learning) 训练技术；基于总不确定性分解为 aleatoric 与 epistemic 的近期工作，按底层基学习器表示不确定性的程度，给出多种扩展到 PDL 分类器的不确定性度量。
summary_sections.result: 在大规模实证研究中同时分析所提 PDL 分类器的预测精度与不确定性感知 (uncertainty awareness)；摘要未给出具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 分类任务可以沿 PDL 的差值学习路线做，并通过把 aleatoric/epistemic 分解移植到 PDL 来实现对预测不确定性的忠实量化。

papers.title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance for TI2I Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: We study Text-and-Image-to-Image (TI2I) flow matching methods for controllable image editing. In a broader generative modeling context, Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is established as a key component responsible for high quality outputs. However, we argue that its role in TI2I modeling is poorly understood. Specifically, we make the surprising observation that the CFG mechanism is implicitly harmful for editing in the noisy phase of flow modeling, hindering instruction following and controllability. We propose a simple correction in the early flow steps, enabling a richer alignment-preservation tradeoff at no extra cost. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated on both pixel-space and latent TI2I flows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在文本+图像到图像 (TI2I) flow matching 编辑中，CFG 在流模型的高噪声阶段反而隐性有害，抑制指令跟随与可控性；作者在早期流步骤加入简单修正，以零额外开销换取更丰富的对齐-保真权衡，并在像素空间与潜空间两种 TI2I 流上验证有效。
Motivation: CFG 被普遍视为生成质量的关键组件，但其在 TI2I 编辑中的实际作用机制不清楚，且在噪声阶段可能损害编辑的指令跟随与可控性。
Method: 针对 TI2I flow matching 的 CFG 机制，仅在流的早期（高噪声）步骤施加一项简单修正，调整对齐与保真之间的权衡，不引入额外计算开销；在像素空间与潜空间两类 TI2I 流上实施。
Result: 在像素空间与潜空间 TI2I 流上均展示了该早期步骤修正的有效性，实现更丰富的 alignment-preservation 权衡且无额外开销；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: CFG 在 TI2I 编辑的噪声阶段是隐性有害的，早期流步骤的针对性修正即可改善指令跟随与可控性，且不增加成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Is Muon Optimal? Radial Fragility and Minimax Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Muon replaces a matrix gradient by an approximate polar factor and has shown strong empirical performance in neural-network training. The Isotropic Curvature Model (ICM) provides a curvature-based explanation for this update by asking when gradient orthogonalization minimizes a one-step local-loss surrogate. We investigate the stability of this explanation when the fixed input radius of the ICM is replaced by a general radial law. We introduce the Random-Radius Isotropic Curvature Model (RR-ICM) and the Polar-Factor Admissibility Set, which encodes exact scaled-polar optimality as a geometric condition on the positive polar factor of the gradient. We derive an exact characterization of this set for arbitrary radial laws and show that all nonscalar admissible responses arise from radial atoms aligned with curvature kinks. Consequently, every atomless radial law exhibits zero-capacity rigidity: exact scaled-polar optimality is possible only when the gradient is already a scaled column isometry. To connect the curvature-based framework with the established spectral geometry of Muon, we introduce the Minimax RR-ICM by replacing directional averaging with worst-case optimization over probability laws on the sphere. We prove that every nonzero global minimizer lies on the polar ray of the gradient, while its scale is determined by a one-dimensional convex problem. The corresponding admissibility geometry is a positive-semidefinite trace slab, in sharp contrast to the spherical-zonoid geometry of the RR-ICM. Together, these results expose the radial fragility of average-curvature explanations and provide a new minimax variational characterization of Muon's polar direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把 Muon 的 Isotropic Curvature Model (ICM) 从固定输入半径推广到任意径向律，提出 Random-Radius ICM 与 Polar-Factor Admissibility Set，证明无原子径向律下精确 scaled-polar 最优只在梯度已是 scaled column isometry 时成立（zero-capacity rigidity）。再用球面上概率律的 worst-case 优化构造 Minimax RR-ICM，证明任何非零全局极小都落在梯度的 polar ray 上，尺度由一维凸问题决定。
Motivation: ICM 用固定输入半径解释「梯度正交化何时最小化一步局部损失代理」，但这一解释对半径设定的稳定性未知；需要判定平均曲率类解释是否本质上脆弱。
Method: 引入 RR-ICM 与 Polar-Factor Admissibility Set（把精确 scaled-polar 最优写成梯度正极因子的几何条件），对任意径向律给出该集合的精确刻画；再以球面上概率律的 worst-case 优化替换方向平均，得到 Minimax RR-ICM。
Result: 所有非标量可容许响应都来自与曲率 kink 对齐 的 radial atoms，故任何无原子径向律都呈 zero-capacity rigidity；Minimax RR-ICM 的每个非零全局极小位于梯度的 polar ray，尺度由一维凸问题确定，其可容许几何是 positive-semidefinite trace slab，与 RR-ICM 的 spherical-zonoid 几何形成尖锐对比。
Conclusion: 平均曲率类解释存在径向脆弱性，而 Muon 的 polar 方向可由一个 minimax 变分刻画给出。
Relevance: 0
