papers.title: Finite-Time Guarantees for Constrained Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability
papers.abstract_en: We study reinforcement learning in constrained partially observable Markov decision processes (CPOMDPs), where an agent maximizes reward subject to a cost constraint using only incomplete information about the underlying state. The lack of state observability may require optimal policies to depend on arbitrarily long observation-action histories, making planning and learning challenging. We leverage recent advances in finite-memory approximations of POMDPs and represent finite history windows as states of a constrained MDP. We then develop a primal--dual algorithm that provides the first non-asymptotic guarantees that jointly bound average reward suboptimality and constraint violation in the original CPOMDP. A key challenge is that this finite-window approximation affects both reward values and the set of feasible policies. Under a filter-stability assumption, we derive bounds relating optimality and feasibility in the finite-state model to those in the original CPOMDP, with approximation errors that decay geometrically with the window length. Experiments in partially observable gridworlds demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在约束部分可观测 MDP (CPOMDP) 中，把有限长度观测-动作窗口当作状态构造约束 MDP，再用 primal-dual 算法给出首个非渐近界，同时约束原 CPOMDP 上的平均奖励次优性与约束违反。在 filter-stability 假设下，有限窗近似带来的最优性与可行性误差随窗口长度几何衰减；部分可观测 gridworld 实验验证了该方法。
Motivation: 状态不可观测使最优策略可能依赖任意长的观测-动作历史，规划与学习困难；现有有限记忆近似缺少在原 CPOMDP 上同时界住奖励次优与约束违反的非渐近保证。
Method: 用 POMDP 的有限记忆近似，把有限历史窗口表示为约束 MDP 的状态；在其上运行 primal-dual 算法，并在 filter-stability 假设下推导有限状态模型与原 CPOMDP 之间最优性与可行性的关系界。
Result: 给出首个非渐近保证，同时界住原 CPOMDP 的平均奖励次优性与约束违反；近似误差随窗口长度几何衰减；在部分可观测 gridworld 上实验展示了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 有限窗口近似加 primal-dual 算法可在原 CPOMDP 上给出有限时间保证，前提是满足 filter-stability 假设，且误差随窗口长度几何下降。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: Federated Art Chase: Privacy Leakage and Data Poisoning in Federated Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is increasingly used to adapt a pretrained, centrally fine-tuned model to data that remain on user devices, beyond training a model from scratch. In this report, prepared for the 4th Federated Machine Learning International Summer School, we study the privacy and integrity of this approach with a reproducible pipeline. An ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV4-Conv-Small model is fine-tuned centrally on ten Quick, Draw! classes (97.50% test accuracy) and then adapted with head-only FedAvg over ten non-IID clients, which raises client training accuracy from 90.34% to 91.49% while preserving global accuracy. We evaluate four adversarial scenarios. First, from a single one-step client update, an honest-but-curious server recovers the complete private label set, but its reconstructions follow class prototypes rather than the private drawings (mean SSIM 0.130). Second, from a one-round FedAvg aggregate, label-count recovery falls from 87.5% with one client to 75.0% with five and ten clients, below the 80.0% of an uninformed uniform guess. Third, under FedAvg, a backdoor injected by 30%, 50%, and 100% of the clients reaches an attack success rate (ASR) of 21.9%, 31.3%, and 54.7% at a cost of at most 0.8 percentage points of clean accuracy, whereas label flipping is effective only when most of the source-class data are relabeled. Fourth, FLTrust with a root set retained from centralized fine-tuning lowers the backdoor ASR to 1.8% and 4.0% at 30% and 50% malicious clients and the label-flipping ASR from 12.6% to 0.8% without measurable clean-accuracy loss, but provides no protection when every client is malicious. The report closes with a live session in which participants draw, fine-tune, and poison the model through Indigma's FedMaestro orchestrator. Code and executed notebooks, runnable on Google Colab, are at https://github.com/Indigma-Innovations/fl-summer-school.
papers.comment: Technical report accompanying the hands-on tutorial at the 4th Federated Machine Learning International Summer School (FLTA), Paris, France, October 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇联邦学习 (FL) 安全教程技术报告，与天气/降水无关：用 ImageNet 预训练 MobileNetV4-Conv-Small 在 Quick, Draw! 十类上中心微调后做 head-only FedAvg，演示单步更新可被诚实但好奇的服务器恢复完整标签集、后门随恶意客户端比例升到 54.7% ASR，而 FLTrust 在非全恶意时把 ASR 压到 1.8%–4.0%。
Motivation: 联邦微调把数据留在设备上，但服务器仍可能从客户端更新中窃取隐私、客户端也可能注入后门或翻转标签；教程需要一套可复现的流水线同时展示这两类风险及防御边界。
Method: ImageNet 预训练 MobileNetV4-Conv-Small 先在 Quick, Draw! 十类上中心微调，再在十个 non-IID 客户端上做 head-only FedAvg；评估四种对抗场景：单步更新的标签集与图像重构、单轮聚合的标签计数恢复、按 30%/50%/100% 比例注入的后门与标签翻转，以及用中心微调保留的 root set 做 FLTrust 防御。
Result: 中心微调测试精度 97.50%；FedAvg 使客户端训练精度从 90.34% 升到 91.49% 且保持全局精度。单步更新可恢复完整标签集，但重构偏向类原型（mean SSIM 0.130）。单轮聚合的标签计数恢复率随客户端数从 1 个的 87.5% 降到 5 个和 10 个的 75.0%，低于无信息均匀猜测的 80.0%。后门 ASR 在 30%/50%/100% 恶意客户端下分别为 21.9%/31.3%/54.7%，干净精度损失至多 0.8 个百分点；标签翻转仅在多数源类数据被重标时有效。FLTrust 把 30% 和 50% 恶意客户端下的后门 ASR 降到 1.8% 和 4.0%，标签翻转 ASR 从 12.6% 降到 0.8%，且无可测的干净精度损失，但全恶意客户端时无效。
Conclusion: 单步客户端更新足以泄露标签集，聚合能部分掩盖标签计数；FLTrust 借助中心微调保留的 root set 能大幅压低后门与标签翻转 ASR，但前提是至少存在诚实客户端。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning-driven Diffusion Models: Language, Vision, and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models (DMs) have steadily demonstrated outstanding performance in high-fidelity, controllable generation across diverse scenarios, following the "pretraining-finetuning" paradigm established in LLMs. Despite these advances, conventional DMs still face critical limitations in sophisticated reasoning, autonomous exploration of generation pathways, and adaptability to complex, human-aligned objectives. Inspired by RLHF's success in LLMs, RL has recently emerged as a pivotal post-training mechanism to iteratively refine DMs through reward-driven trajectory optimization. This paper presents the first comprehensive review of RL-driven DMs and an empirical analysis of how RL reshapes the diffusion process towards experience-centric, goal-directed generation. We propose a novel technical panorama elucidating RL's multifaceted roles in diffusion-based language, multimodal, robotic, and scientific models, with a granular focus on diffusion trajectory optimization and reward engineering. Through extensive experiments on multiple task-specific benchmarks, we systematically evaluate representative methods to intuitively highlight the advantages of different RL post-training strategies. Furthermore, we reveal and dissect three crucial bottlenecks that currently hinder the real-world deployment of RL-driven DMs: reward design fragility, exploration-exploitation trade-off in high-dimensional generation spaces, and training instability under sparse rewards. Based on these perspectives, we provide a principled roadmap for the integration of RL into DMs and outline promising future research directions for robust, interpretable RL-diffusion systems. We also construct a public repository to continuously track the latest developments in this rapidly evolving field: https://github.com/MAIR-Lab-HUST/Awesome-RL-for-Diffusion-Models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 RL 驱动扩散模型 (RL-driven diffusion models) 的综述加实证分析：把 RLHF 式后训练引入扩散过程，按扩散轨迹优化与奖励工程两条主线梳理其在语言、多模态、机器人与科学模型中的作用，并在多个任务基准上对比代表性 RL 后训练策略。结论是当前部署瓶颈集中在奖励设计脆弱、高维生成空间的探索-利用权衡、稀疏奖励下的训练不稳定三点。
Motivation: 扩散模型在高保真可控生成上已强，但在复杂推理、生成路径自主探索、以及对齐人类目标的适应性上仍受限；RL 后训练作为新兴机制缺少统一的技术图景与实证比较。
Method: 提出覆盖语言、多模态、机器人与科学模型的技术全景，聚焦 diffusion trajectory optimization 与 reward engineering 两个粒度层面；在多个任务特定基准上对代表性 RL 后训练方法做系统实证评估，并解剖三大部署瓶颈。
Result: 在多个任务特定基准上系统评估了代表性方法，用以凸显不同 RL 后训练策略的优势；识别出 reward design fragility、高维生成空间中的 exploration-exploitation trade-off、稀疏奖励下的 training instability 三个瓶颈。
Conclusion: RL 后训练能把扩散模型推向经验驱动、目标导向的生成，但要走向稳健可解释的 RL-diffusion 系统，须先解决奖励脆弱、探索-利用失衡与稀疏奖励训练不稳定；作者给出整合路线图并维护公开跟踪仓库。

papers.title: Agent Status Protocol (ASP): A Lightweight Specification for State Reporting in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: The Agent Status Protocol (ASP) defines a lightweight way for heterogeneous AI agents to report their operational state to a status server, and for observers such as dashboards to receive that state as soon as it changes. Agents push small JSON events over HTTP POST; the server exposes the aggregated state to observers over Server-Sent Events (SSE). Because an agent that has crashed, hung or been compromised cannot be trusted to report its own failure, ASP does not rely on self-reports alone: the server infers liveness from missed heartbeats, can detect agents that are alive but no longer making progress, and accepts observations from supervisors, guardrails, operators and peers, some of which take precedence over what the agent says about itself while others are shown alongside it. ASP models state along independent dimensions (lifecycle, health, task, floor, governance), so that an agent can be, for example, online, degraded, working on a task and waiting for the floor at the same time. It reuses existing vocabularies: task states from the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, floor states from the Open Floor Protocol (OFP), and attribute conventions from the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions. This paper presents version 0.1 of ASP as a proposal, not as an approved standard. It is a working draft intended to open a discussion, and the authors invite comments, alternative proposals and independent implementations from the community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASP 提出多智能体状态上报协议 v0.1：异构 agent 通过 HTTP POST 推送小型 JSON 事件到状态服务器，服务器用 SSE 向 dashboard 等观察者即时推送聚合状态。由于崩溃、挂起或被攻陷的 agent 无法自报故障，服务器以心跳丢失推断 liveness、检测存活但无进展的 agent，并让 supervisor、guardrail、操作者与同伴的观察按优先级覆盖或并列展示 agent 自述；状态沿 lifecycle、health、task、floor、governance 五个独立维度建模，可同时为在线、降级、执行任务并等待发言权。
Motivation: 多智能体系统中单个 agent 崩溃、挂起或被攻陷时无法信任其自报状态，而现有机制缺少让观察者在状态变化时立即收到聚合视图的轻量规范。
Method: agent 经 HTTP POST 推送小型 JSON 状态事件，服务器聚合后经 Server-Sent Events (SSE) 下发给观察者；liveness 由心跳丢失推断并检测无进展 agent，外部观察（supervisor、guardrail、operator、peers）部分优先于 agent 自述、部分并列展示；状态按 lifecycle、health、task、floor、governance 五个独立维度建模，词表复用 Agent2Agent (A2A) 的 task 状态、Open Floor Protocol (OFP) 的 floor 状态与 OpenTelemetry GenAI 语义约定。
Result: 给出 ASP v0.1 提案（30 页、4 图），定位为工作草案而非已批准标准，邀请社区评论、替代方案与独立实现；摘要未含实验数字。
Conclusion: ASP 主张多智能体状态上报应以服务器侧推断加外部观察取代纯自报，并用多维正交状态替代单一状态机；v0.1 仅为待社区讨论与独立实现的提案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Functional Subnetwork Localization for Efficient Continual Learning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Biological intelligence continually adapts to new information while retaining prior skills through localized plasticity. In contrast, continual learning in large language models (LLMs) remains vulnerable to catastrophic forgetting. A promising direction is to identify functionally specialized subnetworks within LLMs that enable targeted and resource-efficient adaptation. Using gradient-attribution profiling, we localize cognition-associated functional subnetworks exhibiting extremely low mutual overlap. Building on this finding, we propose Function-isolated Memory-Efficient Optimization (CiMEO), a continual learning framework that routes each training example to its corresponding functional subnetwork, restricting parameter updates and optimizer states to selected regions. Across 1.4 million sequential instructions, CiMEO achieves the highest average performance among the compared methods on five generative benchmarks spanning programming, examination-style tasks, and mathematical reasoning, while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Subspace-overlap and principal-angle analyses further indicate that localized updates help preserve pre-trained representations, highlighting functional subnetwork localization as a practical approach to efficient and stable continual learning in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CiMEO 用梯度归因 (gradient-attribution profiling) 在 LLM 中定位彼此互重叠极低的功能子网络，把每条训练样本路由到对应子网络，只在该区域更新参数与优化器状态。在 140 万条顺序指令上，它在覆盖编程、考试型任务与数学推理的五个生成式基准上取得被比较方法中最高的平均性能，同时缓解灾难性遗忘。
Motivation: LLM 的持续学习仍易发生灾难性遗忘，而全参数顺序微调会覆盖已有能力；若能定位功能特化的子网络，就能做定向且省资源的适配。
Method: 先用梯度归因刻画定位与认知相关的功能子网络，发现其互重叠极低；据此提出 Function-isolated Memory-Efficient Optimization (CiMEO)，按样本路由到对应子网络，把参数更新与优化器状态限制在选中区域，并用子空间重叠与主角度 (principal-angle) 分析检查表示保持。
Result: 在 140 万条顺序指令训练下，CiMEO 在五个生成式基准（编程、考试型任务、数学推理）的平均性能上高于所比较的持续学习方法，并缓解灾难性遗忘；子空间重叠与主角度分析显示局部更新有助于保留预训练表示。
Conclusion: 功能子网络定位加隔离式参数更新，是 LLM 持续学习兼顾效率与稳定性的一条可行路径，因为局部更新能保护预训练表示。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Activation-Adjacent Layer Normalization: Effects on Approximation Power
papers.abstract_en: Layer normalization (LN) and root mean square normalization (RMSNorm) depend on their inputs and remain nonlinear at inference. Inserting either next to an activation may therefore change the function a network represents. We study when shallow activation-normalized (AN) and preactivation-normalized (PN) networks can approximate a prescribed width-$N$ one-hidden-layer MLP. Viewing RMSNorm as input-dependent scaling, we use width augmentation to locally linearize normalization on compact feature sets. For AN networks, an unbounded activation range allows width $N+1$, while every continuous nonconstant activation admits width $N+r$ with error $O_f(r^{-1})$. For PN networks, affine parameters or, without them, degree-one positive homogeneity recover width $N+1$; general continuous activations admit width $N+r$ with error tending to zero. The corresponding LN constructions use centered coordinate pairs, yielding widths $N+2$ and $N+2r$, respectively. We prove that $N+1$ for RMSNorm and $N+2$ for LN are also the worst-case bound for approximations, and show that applicable universal-approximation theorems for ordinary MLPs transfer to these normalized architectures. Numerical experiments recover the predicted approximation rates for both normalizations across all five settings and illustrate the shifted-ReLU finite-width obstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文证明在激活旁插入 RMSNorm 或 LN 会改变网络所表示的函数，并给出逼近一个给定宽度 N 的单隐层 MLP 所需的最小宽度：RMSNorm 的 AN 结构在激活值域无界时只需 N+1，LN 对应为 N+2，且这两个宽度是最坏情形下界。数值实验在全部五种设定中复现了所预测的逼近速率 O_f(r^{-1}) 等，并展示 shifted-ReLU 的有限宽度障碍。
Motivation: LN 与 RMSNorm 依赖输入、在推理时仍是非线性的，插到激活旁会改变网络表示的函数，但归一化架构相对普通 MLP 的逼近能力代价此前没有刻画。
Method: 把 RMSNorm 视为输入依赖的缩放，在紧致特征集上用宽度增广 (width augmentation) 局部线性化归一化；对 AN 与 PN 两种结构分别构造逼近给定宽度 N 单隐层 MLP 的网络，LN 构造改用中心化坐标对。
Result: AN 网络：激活值域无界时宽度 N+1，任意连续非常值激活可取宽度 N+r 且误差 O_f(r^{-1})；PN 网络：有仿射参数或无参数但满足一次正齐次时恢复宽度 N+1，一般连续激活取 N+r 且误差趋于零；LN 对应宽度为 N+2 与 N+2r。证明 RMSNorm 的 N+1 与 LN 的 N+2 同时是逼近的最坏情形上界，普通 MLP 的通用逼近定理可迁移到这些归一化架构；数值实验在全部五种设定中复现预测的逼近速率，并展示 shifted-ReLU 的有限宽度障碍。
Conclusion: 归一化插到激活旁只带来常数级宽度代价（RMSNorm 加 1、LN 加 2），且普通 MLP 的通用逼近结论可直接迁移到这些归一化架构。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: CriticaLLM: Using LLMs as Autonomous Game Master for Tabletop Role-Playing Games
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive capabilities across many tasks, including processing large amounts of text, following instructions, and generating ideas. This allows the use of such models in various contexts, including games and Tabletop Role-Playing Games (TTRPGs), such as Dungeons & Dragons. However, these games include many complex components, from crafting interesting stories to adhering to rules, while allowing some freedom in players' actions. In this work, we first highlight key components that LLMs should exhibit in the context of TTRPGs. Then, we introduce our framework, CriticaLLM, a fully automated Game Master that can run entire TTRPG games, from creating diverse and interesting stories to managing exploration and combat phases. We evaluate our framework with actual TTRPG players and examine the diversity of generated plots and antagonists across four LLMs of varying sizes. Overall, our framework appears to be a promising option for running entire TTRPG games.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CriticaLLM 是一个用 LLM 全自动担任桌面角色扮演游戏 (TTRPG) 主持人 (Game Master) 的框架，能从生成故事、探索到战斗阶段完整跑完一场游戏。作者先归纳 TTRPG 场景下 LLM 应具备的关键能力，再用真实 TTRPG 玩家评测框架，并跨四个不同规模的 LLM 检验生成情节与反派的多样性，结论是该框架作为完整跑团方案有前景。
Motivation: TTRPG 主持人要同时兼顾叙事、规则遵循与玩家行动自由，这些复杂组件让纯 LLM 难以独立承担，需要一个能自动化整场游戏的框架。
Method: 提出 CriticaLLM 框架，先明确 TTRPG 语境下 LLM 应展现的关键组件，再实现可自动创建故事、管理探索与战斗阶段的全自动 Game Master；评测用真实 TTRPG 玩家参与，并在四个不同规模的 LLM 上考察生成情节与反派的多样性。
Result: 在真实 TTRPG 玩家评测中运行整场游戏，并在四个不同规模的 LLM 上比较生成情节与反派的多样性；框架整体被判定为运行完整 TTRPG 游戏的有前景选项。
Conclusion: LLM 可以作为全自动 Game Master 独立跑完整场 TTRPG，叙事多样性在不同规模模型上均可考察。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical Interpretable Multitask Audio Representation Learning: An Analysis of Event-Scene Relationships through the Information Bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: Joint Acoustic Scene Classification (ASC) and Audio Tagging (AT) models traditionally rely on unconstrained multihead architectures. However, this design ignores the natural hierarchical dependency between sounds and acoustic scenes. In this work, we investigate a hierarchical (sequential) conditioning paradigm that predicts scene categories directly from intermediate event probabilities. Through a large-scale empirical benchmark with 66 full training runs across three state-of-the-art backbones (PaSST, PANNs, and BEATs) and different loss-weighting settings (beta in [0.0, 1.0]), we show that hierarchical conditioning achieves competitive classification performance while altering multitask optimization dynamics. Unlike multihead baselines, which sequentially solve the easier ASC task before optimizing AT, the hierarchical architecture enables synchronized dual-task learning for specific loss-weighting settings (beta in [0.6, 0.9]). Furthermore, we propose a multi-perspective interpretability framework that combines an analysis of the information bottleneck, manifold geometry, and Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) on a Term-Frequency Inverse-Document-Frequency (TF-IDF) event representation, providing complementary insights into event-scene relationships. Our findings reveal that hierarchical conditioning systematically yields lower conditional entropy, higher mutual information, and superior latent cluster separability (higher Silhouette scores), establishing a more structured and semantically faithful intermediate feature space.

papers.title: SCRIBE: Scalable Contextual Representations of Interpretable Brain-Grounded Semantics
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how the human brain constructs meaning from real-world language remains a fundamental challenge, as semantics depend on context that varies in natural settings. To enable the study of real-world linguistic meaning in the brain, we introduce SCRIBE, a framework grounded in a neuroscience-informed semantic space that leverages an ensemble of open-source large language models to generate interpretable, word-level semantic representations of arbitrary text. In a behavioral study with 921 participants, we show that human semantic feature judgments vary systematically with context, and that SCRIBE captures these shifts, reaching 75-81% of the estimated human noise ceiling. Using brain activity recorded while participants listen to naturalistic stories, we further demonstrate that SCRIBE predicts neural responses in language-selective brain regions, significantly outperforming non-contextual semantic representations. Variance partitioning reveals that SCRIBE explains unique brain-predictive information beyond syntactic features, suggesting that its representations capture aspects of linguistic meaning not accounted for by the measured syntactic features. Together, these findings establish SCRIBE as a scalable and interpretable foundation for studying natural language semantics in the brain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCRIBE 用神经科学语义空间约束开源 LLM 集成，生成词级、可解释且随上下文变化的语义表征。在 921 人行为实验中，人类语义特征判断随上下文系统性变化，SCRIBE 达到估计人类噪声上限的 75–81%；在自然故事聆听的脑活动上，它显著优于非上下文语义表征，并在方差分解中解释出超出句法特征的独有脑预测信息。
Motivation: 自然情境下语言意义依赖上下文，既有语义表征多为静态词义，无法刻画真实语言在脑中如何随语境变化，也缺少可扩展、可解释的研究工具。
Method: SCRIBE 以神经科学启发的语义空间为基底，集成多个开源大语言模型，对任意文本产出词级、可解释的上下文语义表征；用 921 人行为研究中的语义特征判断检验其对上下文偏移的捕捉，并在自然故事聆听的脑活动数据上预测语言选择性脑区响应，配合方差分解区分语义与句法贡献。
Result: 行为研究含 921 名参与者，人类语义特征判断随上下文系统性变化，SCRIBE 捕捉到这些偏移并达到估计人类噪声上限的 75–81%；在自然故事聆听的脑活动上，SCRIBE 对语言选择性脑区神经响应的预测显著优于非上下文语义表征；方差分解显示其解释了句法特征之外的独有脑预测信息。
Conclusion: 上下文相关的词级语义表征既能贴近人类判断（达噪声上限 75–81%），又能解释句法之外的脑响应变异，可作为研究自然语言脑语义的可扩展、可解释基础。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Poison Valleys: Diagnosing Path-Dependent Failure in LLM Code Repair
papers.abstract_en: When code-repair agents fail, final tests reveal that a patch is wrong but not which earlier commitment caused it or which software obligation failed. Poison Valleys traces this path in 1,844 model requests on two synthetic Python cases: PersistQueue adds atomic batch claiming to a disk-backed queue, while Dijkstra adds source-sensitive filtering to shortest-path search. We define plausible but incorrect software mechanisms, place each in a model's hypothesis, implementation plan, or both, and evaluate the generated code with an Oracle and targeted diagnostic coordinates. Moving the misconception from hypothesis to plan increased failure by 32.2% in PersistQueue and 28.9% in Dijkstra after matching the experimental mix. Different misconceptions produced distinct, model-dependent patterns of violated obligations, although several could converge on the same behavior. This creates a measured connection from upstream misconception to code mechanism and failure form. Code, data, and demo: https://poisonvalleys.org.
papers.comment: Accepted to Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB): The First Workshop on Human-Centered Interpretation for Understanding Agents, Humans, and Interaction (NeurIPS 2026 workshop); 22 pages; code, data, and demo: https://poisonvalleys.org
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Poison Valleys 用两个合成 Python 代码修复任务追踪 LLM agent 的路径依赖失败：把人为植入的错误机制 (misconception) 放在假设 (hypothesis)、实现计划 (plan) 或两者中，再用 Oracle 与诊断坐标评估生成代码。匹配实验配比后，把同一误解从 hypothesis 移到 plan 使 PersistQueue 失败率上升 32.2%、Dijkstra 上升 28.9%，且不同误解产生不同的、依赖模型的义务违反模式。
Motivation: 代码修复 agent 失败时最终测试只能说明补丁错了，无法指出是哪一步早期承诺、哪条软件义务导致失败，上游误解与下游失败形态之间缺少可测量的因果链。
Method: 在 1,844 次模型请求、两个合成 Python 案例（PersistQueue 为磁盘队列加入原子批量认领，Dijkstra 为最短路加入源敏感过滤）上定义看似合理但错误的软件机制，将其分别植入模型的 hypothesis、plan 或两者，用 Oracle 加定向诊断坐标评估生成代码，并对实验配比做匹配 (matching)。
Result: 把误解从 hypothesis 移到 plan 后，匹配实验配比下 PersistQueue 失败增加 32.2%、Dijkstra 失败增加 28.9%；不同误解产生不同的、依赖模型的被违反义务模式，但多种误解可收敛到同一行为；实验共覆盖 1,844 次模型请求。
Conclusion: 上游误解的位置（假设还是实现计划）会系统性改变代码修复的失败率与失败形态，因而可以从代码机制反向追溯到具体误解，形成上游误解到失败形式的可测量连接。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: QREF: Improving DeepSearch Agents by Aligning Search with Reasoning via Query Refinement and Evidence Filtering
papers.abstract_en: DeepSearch agents achieve strong performance on complex information-seeking tasks through iterative search and reasoning. However, they often issue intent-misaligned, under-constrained, or redundant search queries, resulting in poor evidence coverage and accumulating retrieval noise. To mitigate these limitations, we propose QREF, a plug-and-play Query Refiner and Evidence Filter. Specifically, the Query Refiner rewrites search queries according to the current reasoning intent while ensuring complementary coverage across each search batch. The Evidence Filter retains evidence relevant to both the current search batch and the reasoning objective, reducing distracting retrieval results. We initialize the Query Refiner with supervised fine-tuning and optimize it through reinforcement learning based on interactions with a real-world web search environment, reducing ineffective queries. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our approach improves the performance of DeepSearch agents across four challenging benchmarks, achieving average relative Pass@1 improvements of 33.55% on WebSailor and 11.04% on TongyiDeepResearch without modifying architectures or retraining their reasoning policies. Compared with the original DeepSearch backbone without QREF, the RL-trained refiner reduces the fraction of query batches that lack discriminative retrieval anchors by 95%. Compared with the SFT-trained refiner, it also lowers the filter-based ineffective query ratio.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QREF 是即插即用的查询精炼器与证据过滤器：查询精炼器按当前推理意图重写检索查询并保证批次内互补覆盖，证据过滤器只保留同时与当前批次和推理目标相关的证据。在真实网页搜索环境中用强化学习优化后，WebSailor 平均相对 Pass@1 提升 33.55%，TongyiDeepResearch 提升 11.04%，且无需改动架构或重训推理策略。
Motivation: DeepSearch 智能体在复杂信息检索任务中常发出意图错位、约束不足或冗余的查询，导致证据覆盖差、检索噪声累积。
Method: QREF 由 Query Refiner 与 Evidence Filter 组成：前者按推理意图重写查询并保证批次互补覆盖，后者过滤与当前批次和推理目标无关的证据；精炼器先用 SFT 初始化，再在真实网页搜索环境中通过强化学习优化，以减少无效查询。
Result: 四个挑战性基准上平均相对 Pass@1 提升：WebSailor 33.55%，TongyiDeepResearch 11.04%；相比原始 DeepSearch backbone，RL 训练的精炼器使缺乏判别性检索锚点的查询批次比例下降 95%；相比 SFT 精炼器，还降低了基于过滤器的无效查询比例。
Conclusion: 把搜索查询与推理意图对齐并过滤证据，可以在不改动智能体架构和推理策略的前提下显著提升 DeepSearch 表现，RL 训练的精炼器在减少无效查询上优于仅 SFT 的版本。

papers.title: Decomposing Brain-LLM Alignment with Interpretable Semantic Representations
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) predict neural responses during naturalistic language comprehension, but the linguistic information underlying this brain alignment remains difficult to interpret. We use SCRIBE, an interpretable contextual semantic representation spanning 65 neurocognitively grounded semantic properties, as a lens for decomposing the brain alignment of one LLM, LLaMA2-7B. Using variance partitioning between LLaMA2-7B and SCRIBE on naturalistic fMRI data from seven participants listening to narrative stories (Moth Radio Hour), we separate brain-predictive variance shared between the two representations from variance unique to each. We find that shared variance is the dominant component across the whole brain and language-related regions, while both representations also retain significant unique contributions. We then examine whether the concreteness of individual semantic properties relates to shared and SCRIBE-unique brain-predictive variance. Concrete properties show greater shared variance with LLaMA2-7B than abstract properties across the whole brain and most examined regions, whereas abstract properties do not show greater SCRIBE-unique variance. Finally, property ablations reveal that semantic contributions extend across multiple dimensions, with cumulative effects on both shared and SCRIBE-unique variance. Together, these results show that, for LLaMA2-7B on this dataset, a substantial portion of brain-LLM alignment is associated with interpretable semantic information, while revealing complementary brain-predictive semantic information beyond the LLaMA2-7B representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用可解释语义表征 SCRIBE（65 个神经认知语义属性）对 LLaMA2-7B 的脑对齐做方差分解，发现全脑与语言区中共享方差占主导，具体性高的属性比抽象属性共享更多方差，而抽象属性并未在 SCRIBE 独有方差上更高。
Motivation: LLM 能预测自然语言理解中的神经反应，但支撑这种脑对齐的语言信息难以解释，无法区分共享与各表征独有的脑预测成分。
Method: 在七名被试听 Moth Radio Hour 叙事故事的自然 fMRI 数据上，对 LLaMA2-7B 与 SCRIBE 做方差分解 (variance partitioning)，分离共享方差与各自独有方差；再按语义属性的具体性分组比较，并做属性消融 (property ablations)。
Result: 共享方差在全脑与语言相关区域占主导，两种表征也各自保留显著独有贡献；具体属性在全脑及多数被检区域的共享方差高于抽象属性，但抽象属性未表现出更高的 SCRIBE 独有方差；属性消融显示语义贡献跨多个维度，对共享与 SCRIBE 独有方差均有累积效应。
Conclusion: 对 LLaMA2-7B 与该数据集而言，脑-LLM 对齐的相当一部分与可解释语义信息相关，同时 SCRIBE 还提供超出 LLaMA2-7B 表征的互补脑预测语义信息。

summary_sections.method: 在七名被试听 Moth Radio Hour 叙事故事的自然 fMRI 数据上，对 LLaMA2-7B 与 SCRIBE 做方差分解 (variance partitioning)，分离共享方差与各自独有方差；再按语义属性的具体性分组比较，并做属性消融 (property ablations)。
summary_sections.result: 共享方差在全脑与语言相关区域占主导，两种表征也各自保留显著独有贡献；具体属性在全脑及多数被检区域的共享方差高于抽象属性，但抽象属性未表现出更高的 SCRIBE 独有方差；属性消融显示语义贡献跨多个维度，对共享与 SCRIBE 独有方差均有累积效应。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对 LLaMA2-7B 与该数据集而言，脑-LLM 对齐的相当一部分与可解释语义信息相关，同时 SCRIBE 还提供超出 LLaMA2-7B 表征的互补脑预测语义信息。

papers.title: FilterFusion: Prior-Guided Adaptive Filter Fusion for Efficient Video Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Real-world video denoising for communication systems must handle mixed degradations such as sensor noise, compression artifacts, and motion-induced inconsistency while remaining deployable under tight latency budgets. Purely deep models often achieve high accuracy but come with significant computational cost, whereas classical filters are robust and efficient but insufficiently adaptive. We present FilterFusion, a prior-guided multi-frame denoising framework that combines temporally-aware learned features with an interpretable bank of denoising branches. The model predicts a low-cost guidance signal and uses it to adaptively mix a compact set of denoising responses at the original resolution. The lightweight design uses only 109K parameters and explicitly injects temporal variance and spatial variance cues into the low-resolution controller. On CRVD (real sensor noise), it reaches 34.72 dB PSNR and 0.9330 SSIM with only 0.18 GFLOPs (network-only). Because the filter-bank operations are simple and regular (Gaussian blur, median, weighted sum), a straightforward compiled C implementation of the synthesis path achieves 17.9ms per frame (55.9 FPS) on a single CPU thread at 1080p---exceeding real-time and 122--252 times faster than lightweight CNN baselines that require over 2 seconds per frame. The results demonstrate a strong quality-efficiency-speed trade-off and a practical route to real-time denoising through low-resolution control and explicit filter-based synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FilterFusion 是面向通信系统的多帧视频去噪框架：用低分辨率控制器预测引导信号，在原始分辨率上自适应混合一组可解释的滤波分支（高斯模糊、中值、加权和）。在 CRVD 真实传感器噪声数据上达 34.72 dB PSNR / 0.9330 SSIM，仅 0.18 GFLOPs、109K 参数；单 CPU 线程 1080p 编译 C 实现 17.9 ms/帧（55.9 FPS），比每帧需 2 秒以上的轻量 CNN 基线快 122–252 倍。
Motivation: 通信系统中的实时视频去噪要同时处理传感器噪声、压缩伪影与运动不一致，而纯深度模型精度高但算力开销大，经典滤波器高效稳健却缺乏自适应能力。
Method: 先验引导的多帧去噪框架：把时序感知的可学习特征与可解释的滤波分支库结合，模型预测低成本引导信号，在原始分辨率上自适应混合一组紧凑的去噪响应；轻量设计仅 109K 参数，并向低分辨率控制器显式注入时序方差与空间方差线索。
Result: 在 CRVD（真实传感器噪声）上达到 34.72 dB PSNR 与 0.9330 SSIM，网络仅 0.18 GFLOPs；滤波分支操作简单规则，合成路径的编译 C 实现在单 CPU 线程 1080p 下每帧 17.9 ms（55.9 FPS），超过实时要求，比每帧需 2 秒以上的轻量 CNN 基线快 122–252 倍。
Conclusion: 通过低分辨率控制与显式基于滤波的合成，可以在真实传感器噪声上同时获得高质量、极低算力与 CPU 上的实时去噪，实现质量-效率-速度的强折衷。

papers.title: ISW-Agent: Integrating LLM-Driven Dialogue with n8n Workflow for Internal Solitary Wave Remote Sensing Image Processing
authors: Junmin Meng (1) ((1) First Institute of Oceanography
papers.abstract_en: Internal solitary wave (ISW) remote sensing requires task parameters and spatial information to be transferred across image acquisition, detection, stripe extraction, and propagation prediction. Here, we present ISW-Agent, which integrates large language model (LLM) interpretation with n8n workflows and independent scientific models through structured task constraints, geospatial transformations, and stage-specific output validation. In tests of 120 Chinese instructions per backend, GPT-5.6 Sol and DeepSeek both achieved a strict task-match rate of 94.2%, with all intents and execution decisions matching the reference. Sentinel-1 cases demonstrated continuous processing from dialogue requests to wavefront prediction for the specified scene. Of 50 timed scenes, 39 completed detection, extraction, and prediction with a median turnaround time of 48.04 s; 11 stopped after empty extraction. Across 3,408 controlled fault-injection runs, retries recovered 234 transient-failure conditions and output validation rejected 234 structural defects, while 61 provenance or completeness errors indicated the need for content-consistency checks. Overall, ISW-Agent thus connects natural-language requests to traceable spatial processing chains for multimodel ISW analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ISW-Agent 把 LLM 指令解析与 n8n 工作流、独立科学模型串成可追溯的内波遥感处理链，覆盖成像、检测、条带提取到传播预测各阶段。GPT-5.6 Sol 与 DeepSeek 在每后端 120 条中文指令上严格任务匹配率均为 94.2%；50 个计时场景中 39 个全流程完成，中位耗时 48.04 秒，11 个因提取为空而中止。
Motivation: 内波遥感处理需要把任务参数与空间信息跨成像、检测、条带提取、传播预测多个阶段传递，人工串接多模型既易错又难追溯。
Method: 以 LLM 解释自然语言请求，经结构化任务约束、地理空间变换与分阶段输出校验驱动 n8n 工作流，调用独立科学模型完成 Sentinel-1 场景的检测、条带提取与波前预测；另做故障注入测试重试与校验行为。
Result: 每后端 120 条中文指令下 GPT-5.6 Sol 与 DeepSeek 严格任务匹配率均 94.2%，意图与执行决策全部与参考一致；50 个计时场景中 39 个完成检测、提取与预测，中位周转 48.04 秒，11 个在提取为空后停止；3,408 次受控故障注入中重试恢复 234 个瞬时故障、输出校验拒绝 234 个结构缺陷，另有 61 个溯源或完整性错误。
Conclusion: LLM 加工作流编排能把自然语言请求接到可追溯的空间处理链上，但 61 个溯源/完整性错误说明还需内容一致性检查，且部分场景会因空提取而中断。

papers.title: When the KV Cache Is Slower Than the GPU: Scaling Remote KV Tiers for Context-Parallel Prefill
papers.abstract_en: Reusing the attention KV cache across requests is a standard way to cut prefill cost in long-context LLM serving, and production systems increasingly back the per-engine cache with a remote tier shared by every engine. We study such a tier in a disaggregated deployment of GLM-5.3, an FP8 mixture-of-experts model with multi-head latent attention (MLA), on 8xB300 nodes running prefill context parallelism (PCP8). Enabling the remote tier (LMCache with a Valkey store) left median time-to-first-token unchanged but raised the 16k-token p99 from 3.96 s to 17.3 s. Replaying a production request stream on an isolated engine, we find that a remote hit took 0.88 s against 0.31 s to recompute the prompt, and that synchronous loading turned a hit-heavy stream into an unstable queue: p99 83.32 s with the GPUs 7% busy. A two-term cost model explains both: a hit pays off only if the tier delivers more than B* = sR (2.53 GB/s for this model and GPU), and a fixed per-hit engine cost (T0 ~ 0.33 s) means that hits on prompts shorter than about 17k tokens cannot beat recompute at any bandwidth. Guided by the model, we (i) shard the MLA KV store across PCP ranks, with a proof that the existing minimum-over-ranks lookup returns the longest cached prefix and a load protocol that can never desynchronize collectives; (ii) partition the remote tier by rank, one server instance per rank with no coordination, which raises GET bandwidth 6.3x to 10.76 GB/s; (iii) add asynchronous loading to the sharded store; and (iv) fix three client bugs that caused unbounded stalls. On the hit-heavy stream, with 98.5% of prompt tokens served from the remote tier, p99 falls from 83.32 s to 0.67 s. The sharded store raises prefill throughput by 14%, and by 34% together with an upstream kernel fix. All changes are submitted upstream to LMCache.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 GLM-5.3 分离式部署中，远程 KV tier 的同步加载让命中反而比重算更慢：16k token p99 从 3.96 s 升到 17.3 s，命中密集流 p99 达 83.32 s 而 GPU 仅 7% 忙。两项代价模型给出判据——tier 带宽须超过 B* = 2.53 GB/s，且约 17k 以下的 prompt 命中在任何带宽下都赢不了重算。按模型做 MLA KV 分片、按 rank 切分 tier（GET 带宽 6.3× 到 10.76 GB/s）并改异步加载后，98.5% token 命中时 p99 降到 0.67 s。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 服务里多个引擎共享远程 KV tier 已成常态，但同步加载可能让缓存命中比重算 prompt 更慢，拖垮 p99 并使队列不稳定。
Method: 在 8xB300 节点、FP8 MoE + MLA 的 GLM-5.3 分离式 prefill context parallelism (PCP8) 部署上，用 LMCache + Valkey 远程 tier 重放生产请求流，建立两项代价模型（带宽项 B* = sR 与每命中固定引擎开销 T0 ≈ 0.33 s）；据此做四件事：跨 PCP rank 分片 MLA KV store（并证明 minimum-over-ranks 查找返回最长前缀、加载协议不会使 collective 失步）、按 rank 每 rank 一个 server 实例无协调切分远程 tier、为分片 store 增加异步加载、修复三个导致无界停顿的客户端 bug。
Result: 开启远程 tier 后 median TTFT 不变，16k token p99 从 3.96 s 升到 17.3 s；隔离引擎上远程命中 0.88 s vs 重算 prompt 0.31 s，同步加载使命中密集流 p99 达 83.32 s、GPU 忙碌率 7%。模型给出 B* = 2.53 GB/s、T0 ≈ 0.33 s、约 17k token 的盈亏阈值。按 rank 切分使 GET 带宽提升 6.3× 至 10.76 GB/s；命中密集流 98.5% prompt token 由远程 tier 服务时 p99 从 83.32 s 降到 0.67 s；分片 store 使 prefill 吞吐提升 14%，加上上游 kernel 修复共提升 34%。
Conclusion: 远程 KV tier 只有在带宽超过 B* 且 prompt 足够长（约 17k 以上）时才划算，必须配合按 rank 分片与异步加载，否则同步命中会把命中密集流变成不稳定队列；相关改动已提交 LMCache 上游。

papers.title: GRASE: Geometry-native Real-to-sim Agentic Scene Modeling from Video
papers.abstract_en: Real-to-sim conversion aims to turn a captured video of a real environment into an editable 3D scene while preserving the geometry and layout of what was observed. Existing methods often follow a one-pass, loosely coupled paradigm: each stage receives only limited feedback from previous stages, allowing errors to propagate without reliable correction and leaving the final scene inconsistent. We present GRASE, an agentic framework that closes this loop by treating the captured multi-view video observations as a standing reference throughout scene modeling. Instead of committing to intermediate estimates, GRASE revises its current hypothesis whenever rendered evidence disagrees with the capture, overcoming the fixed intermediate assumptions of conventional pipelines. Specifically, GRASE first fits the architectural shell and its openings from depth and multi-view cues. An agent then places generated assets in a shared coordinate frame while checking their spatial relationships. Finally, each asset's geometry and placement are refined iteratively to improve agreement across the observed views. By coupling these steps through feedback, GRASE localizes structural discrepancies and revises only the responsible components, while preserving cross-view consistency. The resulting 3D scenes are faithful to the input, consistent across views, and suitable for simulations. In our experiments, GRASE substantially outperforms other state-of-the-art methods, including a direct real-to-sim conversion using GPT6-Astra.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRASE 把实拍多视角视频转成可编辑 3D 场景时，把原始观测当作全程参照：先用深度与多视角线索拟合建筑外壳与开口，再由 agent 在统一坐标系中摆放生成资产并检查空间关系，最后逐资产迭代修正几何与位姿，只在渲染证据与拍摄不一致时改写对应环节。实验中它显著优于其他 state-of-the-art 方法，包括用 GPT6-Astra 直接做 real-to-sim 的转换。
Motivation: 现有 real-to-sim 流水线是单次、松耦合的：每阶段只拿到上一阶段的有限反馈，误差一路传播且无法可靠纠正，最终场景内部不一致。
Method: GRASE 是一个 agentic 框架，把多视角视频观测作为贯穿建模的常驻参照；先从 depth 与多视角线索拟合建筑外壳 (architectural shell) 及其开口，再由 agent 在共享坐标系中放置生成资产并核查空间关系，最后对每个资产的几何与摆放做迭代精化，使各观测视角下的渲染一致；当渲染证据与拍摄冲突时改写当前假设而非锁定中间估计。
Result: 实验中 GRASE 明显优于多个 state-of-the-art 方法，其中包括一个用 GPT6-Astra 直接做 real-to-sim 转换的对照；产出场景忠于输入、跨视角一致并可用于仿真。
Conclusion: 把观测作为持续参照、按渲染反馈只修正出问题的组件，能替代一次性流水线，得到结构一致且适合仿真的 3D 场景。

summary_sections.method: GRASE 是一个 agentic 框架，把多视角视频观测作为贯穿建模的常驻参照；先从 depth 与多视角线索拟合建筑外壳 (architectural shell) 及其开口，再由 agent 在共享坐标系中放置生成资产并核查空间关系，最后对每个资产的几何与摆放做迭代精化，使各观测视角下的渲染一致；当渲染证据与拍摄冲突时改写当前假设而非锁定中间估计。
summary_sections.result: 实验中 GRASE 明显优于多个 state-of-the-art 方法，其中包括一个用 GPT6-Astra 直接做 real-to-sim 转换的对照；产出场景忠于输入、跨视角一致并可用于仿真。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把观测作为持续参照、按渲染反馈只修正出问题的组件，能替代一次性流水线，得到结构一致且适合仿真的 3D 场景。

papers.title: Phase Kernel Lifts Capacity of Dense Associative Memory
papers.abstract_en: Dense associative memory underlies modern attention mechanisms; however, Modern Hopfield Networks (MHNs) with linear kernels yield overlapping attractor basins and spurious states under high memory load, limiting their theoretically exponential storage capacity in practice. We construct a class of nonlinear phase kernels that modify the energy landscape and retrieval dynamics, and prove that these kernels preserve exponential storage capacity and local fixed-point convergence under given conditions on kernel smoothness, memory separation, and memory distributions. The framework is instantiated by the Sigmoidal Phase Hopfield Network (S-Hop), which guarantees monotone energy descent and mitigates practical capacity loss. S-Hop has $8.3\times$ and $4\times$ gains in one-step noisy retrieval load over Uniform Hopfield Networks (U-Hop) on CIFAR-10 and TinyImageNet respectively, and reaches a $50\times$ gain in first-failure load for ImageNet. The results demonstrate that phase kernels provide a principled route to robust dense associative memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Modern Hopfield Networks 线性核在高记忆负载下吸引子盆地重叠、产生伪状态的问题，构造非线性 phase kernel 改写能量面与检索动力学，并证明在核光滑度、记忆分离与记忆分布条件下保持指数存储容量与局部不动点收敛。实例化为 Sigmoidal Phase Hopfield Network (S-Hop)，保证能量单调下降；单步含噪检索负载在 CIFAR-10 上比 Uniform Hopfield Networks (U-Hop) 高 8.3 倍、TinyImageNet 上高 4 倍，ImageNet 首次失效负载达 50 倍增益。
Motivation: 线性核 MHN 的理论指数存储容量在实践中因高负载下吸引子盆地重叠与伪状态而大打折扣，dense associative memory 作为现代注意力机制的基础无法兑现该容量。
Method: 构造一类非线性 phase kernel 修改能量面与检索动力学，并在核光滑度、记忆分离、记忆分布的条件下证明指数存储容量与局部不动点收敛；框架实例化为 Sigmoidal Phase Hopfield Network (S-Hop)，保证能量单调下降。
Result: 单步含噪检索负载上 S-Hop 相对 Uniform Hopfield Networks (U-Hop) 在 CIFAR-10 提升 8.3 倍、TinyImageNet 提升 4 倍；ImageNet 上首次失效负载 (first-failure load) 达到 50 倍增益。
Conclusion: phase kernel 是在保持指数容量理论保证的同时缓解 dense associative memory 实际容量损失的有原则路径，S-Hop 以单调能量下降兑现该保证。

papers.title: MetaExp: Learning to Self-Improve through Experience via Verifiable Cross-Task Environment Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents can accumulate interaction feedback, but reliably turning that feedback into reusable experience remains challenging. Existing methods either optimize external experience scaffolds or train experience-related behavior on specific task distributions, leaving open whether experience learning itself can become a transferable model capability. Training such a capability calls for supervision beyond isolated tasks, which mainly support in-episode problem solving rather than revealing what knowledge remains useful across episodes. In this work, we introduce MetaExp, a scalable framework that trains this capability through verifiable task families with controlled cross-task structure. Each family preserves a reusable factor while varying task-specific realizations, enabling transfer without direct solution reuse. We propose two complementary designs: Shared-Tool families keep black-box tools fixed across tasks to elicit operational experience, while Shared-Workflow families preserve latent procedures across changing realizations to elicit procedural experience. We scale environments under both designs, collect and filter sequential interaction trajectories, and fine-tune Qwen3.5-122B-A10B on 4,956 trajectories from 1,000 task families. With parameters frozen during downstream evolution, MetaExp improves by +8.5 points on SpreadsheetBench, peaks at +2.3 on APEX-Agents, and improves by +14.8 on AutomationBench. The gains persist under domain-excluded training, supporting experience learning as a transferable capability for continued non-parametric improvement after deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MetaExp 用可验证任务族 (verifiable task families) 训练语言模型 agent 的经验自改进能力：Shared-Tool 族固定黑盒工具以提炼操作性经验，Shared-Workflow 族在任务实现变化时保留潜在流程以提炼程序性经验。在 1,000 个任务族的 4,956 条轨迹上微调 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 后，SpreadsheetBench 提升 +8.5 分、APEX-Agents 峰值 +2.3、AutomationBench 提升 +14.8，且域排除训练下增益仍在。
Motivation: 现有方法要么优化外部经验脚手架，要么只在特定任务分布上训练经验相关行为；孤立任务只支持单局内解题，无法说明哪些知识跨局仍有用，经验学习能否成为可迁移的模型能力尚无答案。
Method: 构建两类受控跨任务结构的任务族：Shared-Tool 族跨任务固定黑盒工具，Shared-Workflow 族在实现变化时保留潜在流程；在两种设计下扩展环境，采集并过滤序列交互轨迹，用 4,956 条轨迹（来自 1,000 个任务族）微调 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B，下游演化阶段参数冻结。
Result: MetaExp 在 SpreadsheetBench 上提升 +8.5 分，APEX-Agents 上峰值提升 +2.3，AutomationBench 上提升 +14.8；增益在 domain-excluded（域排除）训练设置下依然保持。
Conclusion: 经验学习本身可以作为可迁移的模型能力来训练，使 agent 在部署后无需更新参数也能持续非参数改进。

papers.title: FlashAttention with Statistics: Low-Overhead Attention Features for Compact Hallucination Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can produce fluent answers that the supplied context does not support. A compact frozen proxy model can detect such answers by reading the context and another model's response, even from a proprietary generator. Attention-based detectors use summary statistics of the proxy's attention weights, but standard pipelines materialize the attention matrix, whose memory grows quadratically with sequence length. We compute these statistics without materializing attention, by accumulation in the FlashAttention pass, sparse lookups after it, or a second tiled pass over the scores, and classify them by this path into nearly free and costlier ones. On an H100, the statistics of five published detectors add 16% to the latency of a Qwen3-8B forward at 2K tokens, falling to 1.4% at 35K, and store 22.5 KiB per response token. On three benchmarks, probes trained on frozen Qwen3 proxies of 0.6B to 8B parameters prove strong detectors: a 4B proxy outperforms the strongest of nine zero-shot 4-9B LLM judges in F1 on two of the three, the proxies match or outperform specialized grounding checkers of up to 7B parameters, probing each proxy beats prompting it as a judge, and adding attention features significantly improves F1 in half of the 12 benchmark-proxy pairs, never significantly lowering it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用冻结的紧凑代理模型做幻觉检测时，注意力统计量不必显式物化注意力矩阵：在 FlashAttention 前向中累加、其后做稀疏查询或再做一遍 tiled 打分，即可按开销把统计量分成“近乎免费”和“较贵”两类。在 H100 上，五个已发表检测器的统计量给 Qwen3-8B 的 2K token 前向只加 16% 延迟，35K 时降到 1.4%，每响应 token 存 22.5 KiB；在三个基准上，4B 冻结代理的 probe 在其中两个的 F1 超过最强的九个 4–9B 零样本 LLM judge。
Motivation: 注意力类幻觉检测器需要代理模型的注意力权重汇总统计，但标准流程要物化注意力矩阵，内存随序列长度平方增长，把紧凑代理的低开销优势抵消掉。
Method: 在 FlashAttention pass 内直接累加统计量、在其后做稀疏查询、或对分数再做一遍 tiled pass，按这三条路径把统计量分为近乎免费与较贵两类；随后在冻结的 Qwen3 代理（0.6B–8B）上训练 probe，输入上下文与另一模型（可为闭源生成器）的回复。
Result: H100 上五个已发表检测器的统计量使 Qwen3-8B 在 2K token 的前向延迟增加 16%，35K token 时降至 1.4%，每响应 token 存储 22.5 KiB。三个基准上，4B 冻结代理的 probe 在其中两个的 F1 超过最强的九个 4–9B 零样本 LLM judge；代理 probe 追平或超过最大 7B 的专用 grounding checker；对每个代理做 probing 都优于把它当 judge 来 prompt；加入注意力特征在 12 个 benchmark-proxy 组合中的一半显著提升 F1，且从未显著降低。
Conclusion: 注意力统计量可以近乎免费地从 FlashAttention 路径里取出，配合冻结紧凑代理上的 probing，就能构成比零样本 LLM judge 和专用 grounding checker 更强的幻觉检测器。

papers.title: AI-Driven Disaster Response and Displacement Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) has demonstrated its potential across a wide range of humanitarian tasks, offering scalable and data-driven solutions to some of the world's most pressing challenges. For instance, in addressing climate change, AI-powered models are being used for faster and more accurate global weather forecasting, control and design of renewable energy, and monitoring deforestation. Machine learning algorithms analyze satellite imagery and socioeconomic data to predict poverty and promote sustainable development. AI has also transformed disaster response and conflict monitoring, providing innovative solutions for assessing damage and urgent needs and tracking displacement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于 AI 在人道主义任务中应用的综述性文章，涵盖灾害响应、流离失所监测、天气预报、可再生能源控制、森林砍伐监测和贫困预测等方向。文章总结了 AI 通过分析卫星影像和社会经济数据，在灾害损害评估、紧急需求评估和流离失所追踪方面提供的可扩展、数据驱动的解决方案。
Motivation: 人道主义挑战规模庞大且紧迫，传统方法难以快速响应灾害损害评估、流离失所追踪等任务，需要可扩展的数据驱动方法。
Method: 综述 AI 在人道主义领域的应用，涵盖天气预报、可再生能源控制、森林砍伐监测、贫困预测、灾害响应和冲突监测等方向，重点讨论卫星影像和社会经济数据的机器学习分析。
Result: 文章总结 AI 在全球天气预报中实现更快更准确的预测，在灾害响应中提供损害评估和紧急需求评估方案，在冲突监测中实现流离失所追踪。
Conclusion: AI 为人道主义挑战提供可扩展、数据驱动的解决方案，在灾害响应、流离失所监测、天气预报和可持续发展等方向具有应用潜力。

papers.title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks: Curse of Dimensionality and Structural Bias
papers.abstract_en: Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (KANs) have a dimension-independent approximation exponent when the target admits a sufficiently smooth representation by univariate edge functions. We ask whether this favorable scaling belongs to the architecture or to the assumed target class. For arbitrary-depth standard spline-KANs, we prove a worst-case lower bound on isotropic Sobolev balls: below a dimension-independent accuracy threshold, the required number of spline coefficients grows at least exponentially with input dimension. Existing composition-matched MLP results, by contrast, show that favorable exponents on low-arity targets are not exclusive to KANs. We also revisit empirical comparisons. On four scaling-law targets, spline-KAN approximants constructed from known decompositions transfer exactly to MLPs with the cubic ReLU activation $σ(x)=(\max\{0,x\})^3$, although their full dense parameter counts are larger. In controlled ridge-profile scans, KANs have a strong advantage when each nonlinear component depends on one input coordinate. When a component couples multiple input coordinates, this advantage may narrow sharply. At tight budgets, interacting targets often favor MLPs. In the random-label test on MNIST, ReLU-MLPs fit the randomized training labels more efficiently than spline-only KANs. Together, these results locate favorable scaling in target structure and a compatible inductive bias, not a general KAN-specific escape from the curse of dimensionality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明 KAN 的维度无关逼近指数来自目标结构而非架构本身：对任意深度标准 spline-KAN，在各向同性 Sobolev 球上，低于维度无关精度阈值时所需样条系数个数至少随输入维度指数增长。在四个 scaling-law 目标上，由已知分解构造的 spline-KAN 逼近器可精确迁移到带三次 ReLU 激活 σ(x)=(max{0,x})³ 的 MLP，尽管 KAN 的稠密参数总量更大；当非线性分量只依赖单个输入坐标时 KAN 优势明显，一旦分量耦合多个坐标优势急剧收窄，紧预算下交互目标常偏向 MLP。MNIST 随机标签测试中 ReLU-MLP 比纯样条 KAN 更高效地拟合随机训练标签。
Motivation: KAN 宣称的维度无关逼近指数依赖目标可由单变量边函数光滑表示这一假设，需要区分该有利标度属于架构本身还是属于目标类；同时经验对比中 KAN 与 MLP 的胜负条件也未被厘清。
Method: 对任意深度标准 spline-KAN 证明各向同性 Sobolev 球上的最坏情形下界；对照已有的 composition-matched MLP 结果说明低元目标上的有利指数并非 KAN 独有；在四个 scaling-law 目标上把由已知分解构造的 spline-KAN 逼近器精确迁移到三次 ReLU MLP；做受控 ridge-profile 扫描比较单坐标与多坐标耦合分量下的表现；并在 MNIST 上做随机标签拟合测试。
Result: 低于维度无关精度阈值时 spline-KAN 所需样条系数个数随输入维度至少指数增长；四个 scaling-law 目标上 spline-KAN 逼近器可精确迁移到三次 ReLU MLP，但 KAN 稠密参数总量更大；ridge-profile 扫描显示分量只依赖单个输入坐标时 KAN 优势强，耦合多坐标时优势急剧收窄，紧预算下交互目标常偏向 MLP；MNIST 随机标签测试中 ReLU-MLP 比纯样条 KAN 更高效拟合随机训练标签。
Conclusion: 有利的逼近标度应归因于目标结构与匹配的归纳偏置，KAN 并不构成对维数灾难的普遍逃逸。

papers.title: Tool-Augmented Large Language Models for Reliable Medical Calculation from Patient Notes
papers.abstract_en: Medical calculators translate raw patient observations into clinically actionable values and scores. However, applying these calculators directly to free-form patient notes requires precise variable extraction combined with the exact execution of complex formulas, scoring rules, and output conventions. Relying solely on direct large language model (LLM) prompting is unreliable in this context, as rule recall, parameter extraction, arithmetic reasoning, and formatting become entangled within a single generative step. To address these limitations, we propose a tool-augmented LLM framework for reliable medical calculation from patient notes. The framework retrieves and structures calculator specifications, generates reusable executable tools, and uses a constrained extractor to map each patient note to calculator-ready inputs. The tools then perform deterministic calculation, separating clinical language understanding from rule execution and arithmetic. Evaluated on the MedCalc-Bench dataset, our method achieves 86.73% final-answer accuracy, outperforming the one-shot prompting and supervised fine tuning-only baselines by 24.0 and 17.27 percentage points. Ablation and error analyses show that these performance gains are primarily driven by rule-grounded tool synthesis and schema-constrained extraction, whereas remaining failures are concentrated in clinical-semantic extraction and benchmark-specific output contracts. By grounding calculator logic in executable tools, the proposed approach alleviates arithmetic hallucinations and improves the computational reliability of the final clinical outputs.
papers.comment: Accepted as a regular paper at BIBM2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出工具增强 LLM 框架做病历文本的医学计算：检索并结构化计算器规范、生成可执行工具、用受约束抽取器把病历映射为计算器输入，把临床语言理解与规则执行/算术分离。在 MedCalc-Bench 上最终答案准确率 86.73%，比 one-shot prompting 与仅监督微调基线分别高 24.0 和 17.27 个百分点。
Motivation: 直接用 LLM 提示做医学计算不可靠：规则回忆、参数抽取、算术推理与格式化纠缠在同一个生成步骤里，导致算术幻觉与输出不合规。
Method: 框架分三步：检索并结构化 calculator 规范，生成可复用的可执行工具，再用 schema 约束的抽取器 (constrained extractor) 把每条病历映射为 calculator-ready 输入；计算由工具确定性执行，与临床语言理解解耦。
Result: 在 MedCalc-Bench 上最终答案准确率 86.73%，超 one-shot prompting 基线 24.0 个百分点、超仅监督微调 (SFT-only) 基线 17.27 个百分点；消融与错误分析显示增益主要来自规则锚定的工具合成与 schema 约束抽取，剩余失败集中在临床语义抽取与该基准特有的输出约定。
Conclusion: 把计算器逻辑落到可执行工具上能抑制算术幻觉、提高最终临床输出的计算可靠性；进一步的瓶颈在临床语义抽取与输出格式约定，而非规则执行本身。

papers.title: Cross-Prompt Inference Mitigates Rare-Class Suppression in Imbalanced VLM Finetuning
papers.abstract_en: When a vision-language model is finetuned on class-imbalanced data, rare-class recall can fall well below the model's own zero-shot performance. In this regime, we uncover a surprising matched-prompt penalty whereby the standard choice of reusing the descriptive finetuning prompt at inference can yield lower rare-class recall than using a different descriptive prompt. We call this inference-time strategy cross-prompt inference. We evaluate diverse VLMs across six datasets and find that cross-prompt inference consistently recovers rare-class recall, with varying trade-offs in frequent-class recall. The effect reflects a train-eval prompt interaction rather than prompt quality alone, and does not arise with non-descriptive prompt changes. It is strongest when imbalance and visual confusability produce substantial rare-class suppression, and is weak or absent when such suppression does not occur. Using Tuning Contribution (TuCo), which decomposes a model's computation into pretrained and finetuning parts, we find that cross-prompt inference reduces reliance on finetuning-induced computation and shifts the model toward its pretrained component. Reducing that finetuning contribution also substantially reduces the cross-prompt advantage. These results show that rare-class knowledge suppressed by imbalanced finetuning can remain accessible under a different inference prompt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 类别不平衡的 VLM 微调会把稀有类召回压到低于其自身 zero-shot 水平；此时在推理时改用另一条描述性 prompt（cross-prompt inference）而非复用微调 prompt，可稳定恢复稀有类召回，代价是常见类召回出现不同程度的下降。该效应源于训练-评测 prompt 的交互而非 prompt 本身质量，且在不平衡与视觉易混淆共同造成强稀有类抑制时最强。
Motivation: 类别不平衡微调后稀有类召回可能跌破模型自己的 zero-shot 水平，而业界默认在推理时复用微调用的描述性 prompt，这一默认做法本身会进一步压低稀有类召回。
Method: 提出 cross-prompt inference：推理时改用与微调不同的描述性 prompt；在六个数据集上评测多种 VLM，并用 Tuning Contribution (TuCo) 把模型计算分解为预训练与微调两部分，量化 cross-prompt 推理对两部分的依赖变化，同时对照非描述性 prompt 改动。
Result: 在六个数据集、多种 VLM 上，cross-prompt inference 一致恢复稀有类召回，常见类召回出现不同程度的权衡；效应在不平衡与视觉易混淆导致显著稀有类抑制时最强，在无此类抑制时弱或不存在；非描述性 prompt 改动不产生该效应。TuCo 分解显示 cross-prompt 推理降低对微调诱导计算的依赖、转向预训练部分，而降低该微调贡献也大幅削弱 cross-prompt 优势。
Conclusion: 被不平衡微调压制的稀有类知识并未丢失，只是在默认 prompt 下不可达，换一条描述性推理 prompt 即可重新访问；该优势的大小由微调贡献的强弱决定。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Can LLMs Tell Stories Out of Order? A Corpus and Benchmark for Nonlinear Narrative Generation
papers.abstract_en: Every story has two orders: the order in which its events happen and the order in which they are told. A story is nonlinear when the two differ. We introduce a benchmark of 83 published works that measures whether language models can tell nonlinear stories. For each work, we annotate one list of events in both orders, together with a story graph of causal dependencies, character knowledge, and the questions the telling raises and resolves. Given events in chronological order, all 19 models tell them, on average, more chronologically than the published works do; asked for a specific structure, they land within the human range about half the time. We then compare a model's stories of the same events under different conditions, using both an automated judge and 71 human readers. Both prefer the chronological story a model writes by default to the nonlinear one it writes on request, which readers find harder to follow in 81% of decisive judgments. Readers also prefer stories written from the story graph to stories constrained to the published telling order (72% of decisive judgments), a difference the judge does not detect. Our results suggest that following an instruction to reorder a story is not yet the same as telling it well out of order.
papers.comment: Under review, 36 pages, 13 figures, 15 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Starscream-11813/LLM-nonlinear-storytelling. Project page: https://nonlinear-narrative.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文构建了一个基于 83 部已出版作品的非线性叙事生成基准，为每部作品标注事件的发生顺序与讲述顺序、因果依赖故事图、角色知识以及提问/解答集合。在给定按时间顺序排列的事件时，19 个模型平均比原著更偏向按时间顺序讲述；被要求采用特定结构时，约一半情况下落在人类范围内。自动评判与 71 名人类读者都更偏好模型默认写出的时间顺序故事，而非按要求写出的非线性版本，读者在 81% 的有效判定中认为后者更难跟读。
Motivation: 故事的发生顺序与讲述顺序可以不同，但现有评测没有衡量语言模型能否像已出版作品那样把事件打乱讲好；模型按指令重排叙事是否等于讲得好，此前缺少可检验的语料与基准。
Method: 构建含 83 部已出版作品的语料与基准，为每部作品标注双顺序事件列表，以及包含因果依赖、角色知识、提问与解答的故事图；给定时间顺序事件让 19 个模型生成故事，再用自动评判器与 71 名人类读者在不同条件下比较同一事件集的不同讲述。
Result: 19 个模型在给定时间顺序事件时平均比已出版作品更偏时间顺序；被指定结构时约一半情况落在人类范围内。默认时间顺序故事相对按要求写出的非线性故事更受偏好，读者在 81% 的有效判定中认为非线性版本更难跟读。读者更偏好依据故事图写出的故事而非限定为原著讲述顺序的故事，占有效判定的 72%，而自动评判器检测不到这一差异。
Conclusion: 作者认为按指令重排故事还不等于把非线性叙事讲好；同时自动评判器无法复现读者对故事图写作相对原著顺序写作的偏好差异。

papers.title: DuET: Note-Frame Dual Encoding for Piano Performance-to-Score Transcription
papers.abstract_en: Transcribing expressive piano performances into scores requires interpreting individual note timings within an underlying metrical structure. However, score attributes are associated with notes, whereas beats may occur without coincident note onsets. We introduce DuET, a Dual-Encoder Transformer that jointly learns note-level performance MIDI-to-score (PM2S) transcription and frame-level beat and downbeat tracking. Bidirectional cross-attention connects note and frame encoders, while an autoregressive decoder alternates between their representations to predict structured score attributes. We further introduce TimeRoPE and Time-Pitch Rotary Positional Encoding (TPRoPE) to establish a shared performance-time reference and explicitly encode relative temporal and pitch relationships. Evaluations on ASAP, a classical piano dataset, and our curated Gangqinpu dataset, which spans multiple genres with a focus on popular piano music, demonstrate improvements in score timing and notated duration. Compared with the strongest baseline on each dataset, DuET reduces MUSTER mean error from 6.56% to 3.64% on Gangqinpu and from 11.30% to 11.22% on ASAP. Ablations support the benefits of frame-level context, time-based positional encoding, and decoder-history masking. Code, weights, and demos are available at https://github.com/wei-zeng98/DuET.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuET 用双编码器 Transformer 把钢琴演奏 MIDI 转写成乐谱，同时学音符级 PM2S 转写与帧级节拍/强拍跟踪，双向交叉注意力连接两个编码器，自回归解码器交替使用两路表示预测谱面属性。在 Gangqinpu 上 MUSTER 平均错误率从最强基线 6.56% 降到 3.64%，ASAP 上从 11.30% 降到 11.22%。
Motivation: 谱面属性挂在音符上，而节拍可能没有对应音符起音，音符级与帧级结构不一致使钢琴演奏到乐谱的转写困难。
Method: 双编码器 Transformer：音符编码器处理演奏 MIDI，帧编码器做节拍与强拍跟踪，双向 cross-attention 互联；自回归解码器在两路表示间交替预测谱面属性。引入 TimeRoPE 与 Time-Pitch Rotary Positional Encoding (TPRoPE) 建立统一演奏时间参考并显式编码相对时间与音高关系；消融检验帧级上下文、基于时间的位置编码与 decoder-history masking。
Result: 在 ASAP（古典钢琴）与自建 Gangqinpu（多流派、侧重流行钢琴）上评测：对比各数据集最强基线，MUSTER 平均错误率在 Gangqinpu 从 6.56% 降至 3.64%，在 ASAP 从 11.30% 降至 11.22%；谱面时值与记谱时长均有改进。
Conclusion: 把节拍/强拍的帧级上下文与音符级转写联合建模，并用统一时间参考的位置编码，可降低钢琴 PM2S 转写的谱面时值错误；在流行钢琴为主的 Gangqinpu 上收益远大于古典 ASAP。

papers.title: Ontology Refinement with Embeddings and LLMs: A Case Study on CASTON
papers.abstract_en: Ontologies are widely used to represent and organize complex knowledge in domains such as biomedicine and healthcare. However, constructing reliable ontologies remains challenging, as class hierarchies, whether manually or automatically constructed, may contain subtle subsumption errors that require careful refinement. We study this problem in CASTON, a casting-domain ontology, and present a lightweight but scalable refinement workflow that combines a fine-tuned ontology embedding model with Large Language Models (LLMs). The embedding model is used to extract a limited number of candidate axioms for refinement together with possible replacement candidates, and an LLM then returns repair suggestions. In a small expert evaluation, the default configuration using a CASTON-fine-tuned OnT embedding model and Qwen3-8B produced reliable high-confidence repairs: all six high-confidence replacements were accepted by both domain experts. The implementation is available at https://github.com/HuiYang1997/OntRefine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CASTON（铸造领域本体）的类层级中存在细微 subsumption 错误，本文用微调的本体嵌入模型先筛出少量待修正公理及替换候选，再让 LLM 给出修复建议。默认配置（CASTON 微调的 OnT 嵌入模型 + Qwen3-8B）在小规模专家评估中给出的 6 条高置信替换全部被两位领域专家接受。
Motivation: 本体类层级无论人工还是自动构建都可能带细微的 subsumption 错误，逐条人工审查成本高，需要一种轻量且可扩展的精化流程来定位并修复这些错误。
Method: 两阶段轻量工作流：先用在 CASTON 上微调的本体嵌入模型（OnT）抽取有限数量的候选修正公理及可能的替换候选，再把这些候选交给 LLM（默认 Qwen3-8B）生成修复建议；实现开源为 OntRefine。
Result: 在小规模专家评估中，默认配置（CASTON 微调 OnT + Qwen3-8B）产出的 6 条高置信替换全部被两位领域专家接受（6/6）。
Conclusion: 嵌入模型负责召回、LLM 负责修复的组合能在 CASTON 上产出专家认可的高置信本体修复，且流程足够轻量可扩展；结论建立在小规模专家评估之上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trajectory-Level Speculation with Semantic Verification for Tool-Using Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents solve tasks through long sequences of tool calls, and the prevailing design has a single strong model generate every step, although many steps are routine enough for a much smaller model. Existing ways of sharing this work keep the strong model as the generator: routers and collaborative agents decide which model handles each query or step, and speculative methods check a small model's drafts one step at a time, usually against the strong model's own action. We introduce SpecAgent, a collaboration protocol that turns the strong model from the author of each step into a reviewer of steps drafted by a weak model. The weak model executes read-only tool calls as it drafts, so that every step is grounded in real observations, and holds the first action that would modify the environment. The strong model then verifies the drafted segment in a single prefill pass, commits the longest prefix it judges semantically valid, and repairs the first rejected step. Because verification replaces autoregressive decoding with parallel prefill, the strong model decodes only short verdicts and occasional repairs rather than every step. On $τ^2$-Bench, SpecAgent comes within one point of the strong model's success rate while roughly halving memory traffic and wall time, and on AutomationBench and VitaBench it recovers 44-75% of the quality gap while lowering both. In an edge-cloud deployment on MCP-Atlas with three cloud models, it closes 53-75% of the weak-strong quality gap while the strong model generates at most half as many tokens. These results suggest that a strong model need not author every step of an agent: reviewing grounded drafts retains most of its quality while cutting both latency and memory traffic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpecAgent 把工具调用 agent 的强模型从逐步生成者改成审阅者：弱模型边执行只读工具调用边起草，遇到第一个会修改环境的动作就停下，强模型用一次 prefill 并行验证整段、提交最长语义有效前缀并修复首个被拒步骤。在 τ²-Bench 上成功率距强模型不到 1 分，同时内存流量与墙钟时间约减半；在 MCP-Atlas 边云部署中强模型生成 token 至多减半。
Motivation: 工具调用 agent 的长步骤序列默认全由强模型逐步生成，但许多步骤是常规操作；现有 router、协作 agent 与逐步投机解码仍让强模型当生成者，无法省掉其自回归解码开销。
Method: SpecAgent 是一个协作协议：弱模型起草时同步执行只读工具调用使每步有真实观测支撑，并在第一个会修改环境的动作处保持；强模型以单次 prefill 并行验证整段草稿，提交最长语义有效前缀、只修复首个被拒步骤，从而把逐步解码换成并行验证加少量短判决与修复。
Result: 在 τ²-Bench 上成功率距强模型不到 1 分，内存流量与墙钟时间约减半；在 AutomationBench 与 VitaBench 上追回 44-75% 的质量差距且两者都下降；在 MCP-Atlas 边云部署（三个云模型）上追回 53-75% 的弱-强质量差距，强模型生成 token 至多为原来的一半。
Conclusion: 强模型不必撰写 agent 的每一步：审阅有真实观测支撑的草稿能保住大部分质量，同时降低延迟与内存流量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Can Visual Generation Expand What Unified Multimodal Models Know?
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) receive image-generation supervision that exposes them to visual information not fully documented in text. Can learning to generate images expand what pretrained models know? We introduce Knowledge Transfer Probing (KTP), a controlled protocol that supplies new knowledge through image-generation training and tests its accessibility through text-only question answering. Across seven knowledge categories and three UMMs, we observe direct but uneven transfer from visual supervision to language. Motivated by these observations, we successively introduce Textual Alignment and Interleaved Image--Text Alignment, which connect generation and answering through shared knowledge and interleaved responses, respectively. Guidance on selected entities can improve knowledge access on other entities without QA supervision, with additional gains from interleaved alignment. Further analysis shows that knowledge correctly reproduced in images is often more accessible through text, although substantial gaps remain between the two forms of access. These findings support visual generation as a source of knowledge beyond textual supervision, and motivate joint investigation of training data design and model architecture to make this knowledge more broadly accessible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Knowledge Transfer Probing (KTP)：用图像生成训练注入文本未完整记录的新知识，再用纯文本 QA 检验这些知识能否被调用。在 7 个知识类别、3 个 UMM 上观察到视觉监督向语言的直接但不均衡迁移；对选定实体的引导可在无 QA 监督下提升其他实体的知识可及性，交错对齐 (interleaved alignment) 带来额外增益，且图像中正确复现的知识往往更易经文本调用，但两种访问形式间仍有明显差距。
Motivation: 统一多模态模型的图像生成监督暴露了文本中未完整记录的视觉信息，但这些知识能否被语言侧调用此前缺少受控检验协议。
Method: KTP 受控协议：通过图像生成训练注入新知识，再以纯文本 QA 测试可及性；在 7 个知识类别、3 个 UMM 上运行，随后依次引入 Textual Alignment 与 Interleaved Image--Text Alignment，分别以共享知识和交错响应把生成与作答连接起来。
Result: 跨 7 个知识类别与 3 个 UMM 观察到视觉监督到语言的直接但不均衡迁移；对选定实体的引导在无 QA 监督下改善其他实体的知识可及性，交错对齐带来额外增益；图像中正确复现的知识通常更易通过文本访问，但两种访问形式之间仍存在 substantial gaps。
Conclusion: 视觉生成是文本监督之外的知识来源；要让这些知识被更广泛地访问，需要同时考察训练数据设计与模型架构。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance
papers.abstract_en: While generalist vision-language-action (VLA) models have enabled diverse open-world manipulation, real-world robotic assistance requires two critical capabilities they currently lack: personalization and reliable execution. First, executing an instruction like "make me a sandwich" requires grounding subtask decomposition in persistent user preferences rather than relying on a single generic solution. Second, reliable deployment demands explainable safety assurance that proactively prevents hazards and gracefully recovers from occasional physical failures. To address these gaps, we present CarryOn, a dual-loop harness designed to augment a frozen VLA policy. The planning loop maintains persistent user-level and scene-level context that is continually grounded against new observations and revised through interaction, enabling personalized task selection and execution grounding across conversations and changing scenes. The execution loop actively supervises policy rollouts, shielding actions from predicted hazardous contact. When execution fails, the system invokes reusable control-based recovery skills that restore task progress and are refined through reflection on earlier failures. On a real robot and in simulation, CarryOn dispatches preference-consistent subtasks across users and scenes, reduces the violation rate of an already safety-finetuned VLA from 52.6% to 6.1%, and increases recovery success from 13% to 80% when refined skills are reused.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CarryOn 是套在冻结 VLA 策略外的双环 harness：规划环维护跨对话、跨场景的用户级与场景级持久上下文并随交互修订，执行环监督 rollout、屏蔽预测到的危险接触，失败时调用可复用的控制式恢复技能并靠反思精化。在真实机器人与仿真上，它把已做过安全微调的 VLA 违规率从 52.6% 降到 6.1%，复用精化技能后恢复成功率从 13% 提到 80%。
Motivation: 通用 VLA 模型缺两项落地能力：把“给我做三明治”这类指令落到持久用户偏好上做子任务分解，以及可解释的安全保障——主动预防危险接触并在偶发物理失败后优雅恢复。
Method: 双环 harness 附加在冻结 VLA 策略之外：规划环维护持久的用户级与场景级上下文，持续用新观测做 grounding 并经交互修订，支撑个性化任务选择与执行 grounding；执行环主动监督策略 rollout，屏蔽预测为危险的接触，失败时调用可复用的控制式恢复技能恢复任务进度，并通过对既往失败的反思精化这些技能。
Result: 在真实机器人与仿真中，CarryOn 能跨用户、跨场景派发与偏好一致的子任务；将一个已安全微调的 VLA 的违规率从 52.6% 降至 6.1%；复用精化后的恢复技能时，恢复成功率从 13% 提升到 80%。
Conclusion: 在冻结 VLA 之外加一层持久上下文规划与主动执行监督，可同时换来个性化子任务派发和大幅更低的违规率，而可复用、经反思精化的恢复技能是把偶发失败救回来的关键。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 在冻结 VLA 之外加一层持久上下文规划与主动执行监督，可同时换来个性化子任务派发和大幅更低的违规率，而可复用、经反思精化的恢复技能是把偶发失败救回来的关键。

papers.title: Full-Duplex Interaction with Speech, Expressions and Gestures
papers.abstract_en: Human face-to-face conversation requires coordinating speech, gestures and expressions across both speaking and listening. We present ELLSA 2, an end-to-end full-duplex dialogue model that jointly optimizes speech interaction and streaming gesture-expression generation. An autoregressive, chunk-wise synthesizer combines pretrained acoustic features with distinct listening and speaking hidden states from the dialogue backbone and speech synthesizer, enabling continuous non-verbal generation even when the model is verbally silent. To translate dialogue understanding into vivid semantic gestures, we introduce contextual semantic calls and template guidance, separating whether to invoke an available semantic gesture from how to realize it. We also establish a curated data and evaluation pipeline for dialog-aware co-speech gesture generation and investigate reference-based multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as automatic judges. Experiments show that ELLSA 2 remains highly competitive with open-source full-duplex speech interaction models and outperforms cascaded baselines across dialog-aware gesture and expression metrics. Semantic template guidance further significantly improves semantic gesture quality. Strong system-level correlations with human judgments support these reference-based scores as useful preliminary metrics for full-duplex and semantic gesture assessment. Together, these results advance dialogue modeling from spoken responses toward coordinated multimodal interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ELLSA 2：端到端全双工对话模型，联合优化语音交互与流式表情-手势生成，即使模型在语言上沉默也能持续生成非语言信号。实验显示其在对话感知的手势与表情指标上超过级联基线，并与开源全双工语音模型保持竞争力。
Motivation: 人脸对话需要在说与听两个阶段协调语音、手势与表情，而现有对话模型多停留在语音应答，缺少同时生成非语言行为的全双工框架。
Method: 自回归分块合成器融合预训练声学特征、对话骨干与语音合成器中区分的听/说隐状态；引入 contextual semantic calls 与模板引导，把是否调用语义手势与如何实现分开；并建立对话感知手势生成的数据与评测流程，考察基于参考的 MLLM 作为自动评判。
Result: 在对话感知手势与表情指标上超过级联基线，与开源全双工语音交互模型保持高度竞争力；语义模板引导显著提升语义手势质量；自动评分与人类判断呈强系统级相关。
Conclusion: 联合优化的全双工多模态建模可把对话从语音应答推进到协调的手势与表情生成，基于参考的 MLLM 评分可作为全双工与语义手势评估的初步指标。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PET Quantification-Preserving Registration for Longitudinal Whole-Body PSMA PET/CT
papers.abstract_en: We adapt the diffeomorphic coarse-to-fine LapIRN architecture for longitudinal whole-body PSMA PET/CT registration in the Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg challenge. The method combines affine pre-registration, multi-modal deformable registration, and test-time instance optimization. We further introduce PET biomarker preservation losses for metabolic tumor volume (MTV) and total lesion glycolysis (TLG), including Jacobian-based constraints, and a per-structure rigidity regularization for skeletal structures. The submitted configuration achieved 81.0% DSC and 6.17 mm HD95, with MTV and TLG errors of 3.3% and 3.3%, respectively, on our evaluation protocol. Code is available at https://github.com/koegl/psmareg.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 diffeomorphic coarse-to-fine LapIRN 改造用于纵向全身 PSMA PET/CT 配准（Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg challenge），在 affine 预配准与多模态可变形配准之上加 test-time instance optimization，并引入 MTV/TLG 保值损失、Jacobian 约束与骨骼结构的 per-structure rigidity 正则。在作者自定评估协议上取得 81.0% DSC、6.17 mm HD95，MTV 与 TLG 误差均为 3.3%。
Motivation: 纵向 PSMA PET/CT 配准既要几何对齐，又要保住 PET 代谢定量指标（MTV、TLG），常规可变形配准的形变场会改变病灶体积与摄取量，影响纵向比较。
Method: 改造 diffeomorphic coarse-to-fine LapIRN：affine 预配准 + 多模态可变形配准 + test-time instance optimization；新增针对 MTV 与 TLG 的 PET biomarker preservation losses（含 Jacobian-based constraints），并对骨骼结构加 per-structure rigidity regularization，参赛代码开源。
Result: 在作者的评估协议上，提交配置达到 81.0% DSC 与 6.17 mm HD95，MTV 误差 3.3%、TLG 误差 3.3%。
Conclusion: 把 PET 定量保值损失与骨骼刚性正则直接嵌入配准目标，可在完成 PSMA PET/CT 纵向对齐的同时把 MTV/TLG 定量误差控制在约 3.3%。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: X-Fly: Learning to Reach and Stop in Full-Chunk Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Aerial vision-language navigation (VLN) agents built on large vision-language models are expensive to query. Executing a complete predicted action chunk before replanning amortizes this cost, reducing model inference from 195 to 42 ms per executed waypoint for our policy. It also moves the states at which the policy is queried away from expert demonstrations, which supervise neither recovery from these states nor termination at the learner's own arrival. On OpenFly test-seen, no-stop failures account for 47.78% of full-chunk behavior cloning (BC) outcomes. We present X-Fly, a staged training framework for full-chunk aerial VLN. Recovery DAgger labels learner-visited decision states with smooth chunks that reconnect to future expert segments and with STOP at the first in-region state. Flow-GRPO then jointly refines the chunked flow controller and a Bernoulli STOP policy from same-task closed-loop outcomes, supplemented by outcome-verified stopping supervision. With eight controls per decision, X-Fly reaches 74.18% SR on test-seen and 51.73% on test-unseen, compared with 16.45% and 18.43% for full-chunk BC and 32.04% and 29.46% for DreamFly.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://juliusju572.github.io/x-fly/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: X-Fly 用分阶段训练解决全动作块 (full-chunk) 空中视觉语言导航中策略查询状态偏离专家演示、导致不停止失败的问题：Recovery DAgger 为学习者自访状态标注可重连专家段的平滑动作块与 STOP，Flow-GRPO 再用同任务闭环结果联合精调块状流控制器与 Bernoulli STOP 策略。在 OpenFly 上每决策 8 个控制量时，test-seen SR 达 74.18%、test-unseen 51.73%，而全块 BC 仅 16.45%/18.43%、DreamFly 为 32.04%/29.46%。
Motivation: 大视觉语言模型查询昂贵，执行完整动作块再重规划可把每航点推理从 195 ms 降到 42 ms，但查询状态偏离专家演示，专家既不监督从这些状态恢复，也不监督在学习者自身到达时停止；OpenFly test-seen 上全块 BC 结果中 47.78% 是 no-stop 失败。
Method: X-Fly 是分阶段训练框架：Recovery DAgger 用平滑动作块标注学习者访问的决策状态使其重连后续专家段，并在首个进入区域的状态标注 STOP；Flow-GRPO 基于同任务闭环结果联合精调块状 flow 控制器与 Bernoulli STOP 策略，辅以结果校验的停止监督。
Result: 每执行航点的模型推理从 195 ms 降至 42 ms；OpenFly test-seen 上全块 BC 的 no-stop 失败占 47.78%。每决策 8 个控制量下，X-Fly test-seen SR 74.18%、test-unseen 51.73%，对比全块 BC 的 16.45% 和 18.43%、DreamFly 的 32.04% 和 29.46%。
Conclusion: 把恢复与终止都作为训练目标（在学习者自访状态上重连专家段、在自身到达时停），全动作块 VLN 才能在摊薄 VLM 查询成本的同时保住成功率。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Incentivizing Tool-Use Reinforcement Learning for Post-Arrival Emergency Care Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can reason over both structured measurements and free-text records, which makes them attractive for emergency department (ED) prediction. However, most existing LLMs still fall short of conventional ML methods like trees on EHR-based prediction tasks. Our controlled analysis traces this gap to two weaknesses: LLMs do not select informative features, and they misjudge what numerical values imply for risk even when given the right features. We propose TIR-EC, a tool-integrated reinforcement learning framework that addresses both. TIR-EC exposes EHR feature groups as tools the LLM can call. It trains the LLM with rewards from a gradient-boosted tree teacher, which provides a reference set of informative tools and a graded risk target. TIR-EC also distills task-specific clinical skills into the model weights through a reverse curriculum that gradually removes the skills from the prompt during RL process. Evaluation on three clinical prediction tasks shows that our 4B agent achieves the highest macro F1 of all compared models, outperforms conventional ML baselines, and is competitive with much larger frontier LLMs. Further analysis shows that TIR-EC selects more useful evidence with fewer tool calls and combines measurements more effectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIR-EC 把 EHR 特征组暴露为 LLM 可调用的工具，用梯度提升树 (gradient-boosted tree) 教师提供信息性工具参考集与分级风险目标作为 RL 奖励，并以反向课程 (reverse curriculum) 在训练中逐步从 prompt 撤走临床技能、把技能蒸馏进权重。在三项临床预测任务上，4B agent 取得所有对比模型中最高的 macro F1，超过传统 ML 基线，并与更大的前沿 LLM 相当。
Motivation: LLM 能同时推理结构化测量与自由文本，但在 EHR 预测任务上仍落后于树模型等传统 ML；受控分析把差距归因于两点：LLM 选不出有信息量的特征，以及即使拿到正确特征也误判数值对风险的含义。
Method: TIR-EC (tool-integrated reinforcement learning) 将 EHR 特征分组为可调用工具，用梯度提升树教师给出信息性工具参考集与分级风险目标作为奖励信号；同时通过反向课程在 RL 过程中逐步移除 prompt 中的任务临床技能，将其蒸馏进模型权重。
Result: 在三项临床预测任务上，4B agent 的 macro F1 在所有对比模型中最高，优于传统 ML 基线，并与参数量大得多的前沿 LLM 竞争力相当；进一步分析显示 TIR-EC 用更少的工具调用选出更有用的证据，并更有效地组合测量值。
Conclusion: 把特征选择与数值-风险判断外包给树教师、再用反向课程内化临床技能，可以让 4B 规模的工具集成 RL agent 在 EHR 预测上反超传统 ML 并逼近大模型。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: V-SHARE: Provable Convergence Guarantees for Advantage-based Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: In reinforcement learning, advantage-based value-learning methods, unlike standard Q-learning, share information across actions by decomposing the action-value function into a state-dependent value component and action-specific advantages. While this mechanism has proven effective in both tabular and deep reinforcement learning, its theoretical understanding remains incomplete. We introduce V-SHARE, an advantage-based value-learning algorithm that combines cross-action value sharing with an importance-weighted Bellman-residual correction. To our knowledge, we provide the first complete theoretical characterization of an advantage-based algorithm, including both asymptotic convergence and non-asymptotic finite-sample guarantees. We identify a regime in which V-SHARE mitigates the rare-action bottleneck of asynchronous Q-learning and uncover a contraction--variance tradeoff between stronger deterministic contraction and increased importance-weighting noise. Motivated by this tradeoff, we develop decreasing residual-preconditioning schedules that combine faster early contraction with lower asymptotic noise. We further develop a two-timescale analysis that removes the single-timescale residual-weight threshold while preserving convergence guarantees. Experiments on discrete Markov decision processes (MDPs) and deep reinforcement-learning benchmarks corroborate our results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: V-SHARE 是一个基于优势 (advantage) 的价值学习算法，把动作价值函数分解为状态价值与动作优势以跨动作共享信息，并加入重要性加权的 Bellman 残差修正。作者给出该类算法首个完整的理论刻画，含渐近收敛与非渐近有限样本保证，并识别出确定性收缩变强与重要性加权噪声变大之间的 contraction–variance 权衡，据此设计递减的残差预条件调度。
Motivation: 优势分解式价值学习在表格与深度强化学习中已有效，但理论理解不完整：缺少完整的收敛与有限样本刻画，且异步 Q-learning 存在稀有动作瓶颈。
Method: V-SHARE 结合跨动作价值共享与重要性加权 Bellman 残差修正；针对 contraction–variance 权衡提出递减的残差预条件 (residual-preconditioning) 调度，兼顾早期快速收缩与更低的渐近噪声；并给出双时间尺度 (two-timescale) 分析，移除单时间尺度的残差权重阈值同时保留收敛保证。
Result: 给出首个优势型算法的完整理论刻画，包括渐近收敛与非渐近有限样本保证；识别出 V-SHARE 缓解异步 Q-learning 稀有动作瓶颈的机制，以及更强确定性收缩与更高重要性加权噪声之间的权衡；双时间尺度分析移除了单时间尺度的残差权重阈值。离散 MDP 与深度强化学习基准实验佐证了上述结论。
Conclusion: 跨动作共享加重要性加权残差修正可以在保留收敛保证的同时缓解稀有动作瓶颈，而收缩与噪声的权衡应通过递减预条件调度与双时间尺度分析来处理。

summary_sections.motivation: 优势分解式价值学习在表格与深度强化学习中已有效，但理论理解不完整：缺少完整的收敛与有限样本刻画，且异步 Q-learning 存在稀有动作瓶颈。
summary_sections.method: V-SHARE 结合跨动作价值共享与重要性加权 Bellman 残差修正；针对 contraction–variance 权衡提出递减的残差预条件 (residual-preconditioning) 调度，兼顾早期快速收缩与更低的渐近噪声；并给出双时间尺度 (two-timescale) 分析，移除单时间尺度的残差权重阈值同时保留收敛保证。
summary_sections.result: 给出首个优势型算法的完整理论刻画，包括渐近收敛与非渐近有限样本保证；识别出 V-SHARE 缓解异步 Q-learning 稀有动作瓶颈的机制，以及更强确定性收缩与更高重要性加权噪声之间的权衡；双时间尺度分析移除了单时间尺度的残差权重阈值。离散 MDP 与深度强化学习基准实验佐证了上述结论。
summary_sections.conclusion: 跨动作共享加重要性加权残差修正可以在保留收敛保证的同时缓解稀有动作瓶颈，而收缩与噪声的权衡应通过递减预条件调度与双时间尺度分析来处理。

papers.title: Each Reward to Its Relevant Tokens: Reward-Specific Token-Level Credit Assignment for Multi-Reward RL
papers.abstract_en: Language models are increasingly trained against several verifiable rewards at once, such as the correctness and the format of a tool call, or the individual constraints of a complex instruction. Reward-decoupled normalization (GDPO) normalizes each reward separately so that different reward combinations keep distinct advantages, but it still spreads every reward's advantage evenly over the whole response, although each verifier checks only a few positions. We propose MRTPO, which assigns the advantage of each reward to the tokens relevant to it, using the information its verifier checks, without auxiliary models or token-level annotations. For each reward, the policy replays its own response with and without that reward's verifier information, and the per-token Jensen-Shannon distance between the two next-token distributions measures each token's relevance and reassigns the advantage. On text-to-SQL, multi-constraint instruction following and tool calling, MRTPO converges faster and achieves better performance than the compared methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MRTPO：对每个可验证奖励，用该奖励的 verifier 信息重放响应，按逐 token 的 Jensen-Shannon 距离衡量 token 与该奖励的相关性，把原本均摊到全响应的 advantage 重新分配到相关 token 上。在 text-to-SQL、多约束指令遵循和工具调用上收敛更快、性能优于对比方法。
Motivation: 多奖励 RL 中 GDPO 虽按奖励分别归一化以保持不同奖励组合的 advantage 区分，但仍把每个奖励的 advantage 均摊到整条响应，而每个 verifier 实际只检查少数位置。
Method: 对每个奖励，策略用与不用该奖励 verifier 信息各重放一次自身响应，逐 token 比较两个 next-token 分布的 Jensen-Shannon 距离作为相关性度量，据此重新分配该奖励的 advantage；不需要辅助模型或 token 级标注。
Result: 在 text-to-SQL、多约束指令遵循和工具调用三个任务上，MRTPO 比对比方法（含 GDPO）收敛更快且性能更好。
Conclusion: 把每个奖励的 credit 限定到其 verifier 真正检查的 token，比把 advantage 均摊到全响应更有效，且无需额外模型或标注。
