papers.title: RLDF: A Region-Level Deepfake Dataset and Benchmark for Partial-Face Manipulation Detection
papers.abstract_en: Existing deepfake detection models are built upon manipu- lated images that are tampered with either exclusively fully swapped or fully synthesised faces, which leads us to an open question: Can off-the-shelf deepfake models detect manipulation effectively while tampering is confined to a local facial sub-region? To fill this gap, we introduce RLDF (Region-Level Deepfake), the first dataset for region-level deepfake evaluation. Employing the proposed region-aware partial swap synthesis model, we generate over 2M par- tial face-swap images by using eight face-swapping meth- ods. Altogether, we considered seven face regions, among which there are four discrete regions (eye, nose, mouth and eyebrow) and four composite facial regions (eye and nose; eye, nose and mouth; eye, nose, mouth and eye- brow; and full face). In addition, we define three evalu- ation protocols and benchmark 12 state-of-the-art detectors across the five popular standard cross-dataset evaluations, DF40, and the proposed RLDF, providing a comprehen- sive audit of where and why existing detectors underper- formed. Our evaluation reveals that existing detectors fail to generalize consistently across partial facial regions, re- sulting in an overall drop of 10.5% AUC and 10% accu- racy under region-level evaluation. Further, we propose a mask-guided cross-attention model as a baseline approach that can effectively detect region-level manipulation. The proposed dataset, code, and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RLDF-Dataset/RLDF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLDF 提出区域级部分人脸篡改数据集与评测协议：用区域感知的部分换脸合成模型生成超过 200 万张部分换脸图像，覆盖 7 个人脸区域与 8 种换脸方法，并在跨数据集评测、DF40 与 RLDF 上审计 12 个 SOTA 检测器。区域级评测下现有检测器泛化失败，AUC 平均下降 10.5%、准确率下降 10%；作者同时给出 mask-guided cross-attention 基线模型用于检测区域级篡改。
Motivation: 现有 deepfake 检测模型只在整脸交换或整脸合成的图像上训练测试，当篡改局限在局部面部子区域时能否有效检测仍是开放问题，缺少针对该场景的数据集与评测。
Method: 提出区域感知的部分换脸合成模型 (region-aware partial swap synthesis)，用 8 种换脸方法生成超过 200 万张部分换脸图像，覆盖 7 个面部区域（4 个离散区域：eye、nose、mouth、eyebrow；以及 4 个复合区域，直至 full face）；定义 3 个评测协议，并提出 mask-guided cross-attention 作为区域级检测基线，数据、代码与 checkpoints 在 GitHub 开源。
Result: 在 5 个标准跨数据集评测、DF40 与 RLDF 上审计 12 个 SOTA 检测器：区域级评测下现有检测器无法跨部分面部区域一致泛化，整体 AUC 下降 10.5%、准确率下降 10%。
Conclusion: 现有 deepfake 检测器的泛化能力依赖整脸篡改假设，区域级部分篡改需要专门的数据与评测协议，mask-guided cross-attention 可作为该场景的基线方案。

papers.title: HyCo: Hybrid Drafting for Cost-Efficient Mobile-Cloud Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Device-cloud speculative decoding reduces server computation, but growing a deep draft tree with a small language model (SLM) requires repeated passes on a mobile neural processing unit (NPU). We present HyCo, which assigns depth to the server model's native multi-token prediction (MTP) head, executed on the device, and alternative branches to one SLM pass. The server returns the hidden state, input embedding, and key-value entries needed by the head instead of executing its sequential steps. Quantization, a restricted vocabulary, and a 1K-token window fit both drafters to the NPU. An ε-threshold rule additionally relaxes exact preservation of the verifier's sampling distribution. In single-client runs with a Galaxy S26 Ultra over LTE/5G, HyCo reduces server GPU time per output token relative to server-side MTP self-speculation by 38.6% on Spec-Bench and 29.2% on 32K-token summarization. With the same acceptance rule, three Spec-Bench runs per system show 9.0 percentage points more saving and 1.9x delivery speed than an SLM-only drafter. HyCo differs from Cloud+MTP by +0.2 judge-score points (paired 95% CI: -0.9 to +1.3); exploratory translation favors SpecEdge-ε. Without relaxation, HyCo exact saves 27.7% and 11.9% on the two datasets.
papers.comment: Under review at ACL Rolling Review (October 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyCo 把设备-云推测解码 (speculative decoding) 的草稿树深度交给服务器模型自带的多 token 预测 (MTP) 头在手机 NPU 上执行，分支则由单次 SLM 前向给出，服务器只回传 hidden state、输入 embedding 与 KV 条目。在 Galaxy S26 Ultra 走 LTE/5G 的单客户端测试中，相对服务器侧 MTP 自推测，Spec-Bench 每输出 token 的服务器 GPU 时间降 38.6%，32K 摘要任务降 29.2%；同一接受规则下比纯 SLM 草稿多省 9.0 个百分点、交付速度 1.9 倍。
Motivation: 设备-云推测解码能省服务器算力，但用小语言模型 (SLM) 长深草稿树需要在移动 NPU 上反复前向，延迟与能耗都顶不住。
Method: 深度维度交给服务器原生 MTP 头、在设备上执行，备选分支由一次 SLM 前向承担；服务器返回头所需的 hidden state、input embedding 与 KV 条目而非顺序执行。草稿器用量化、受限词表与 1K token 窗口适配 NPU，并用 ε-threshold 规则放宽对验证器采样分布的精确保持。
Result: 相对服务器侧 MTP 自推测，每输出 token 服务器 GPU 时间在 Spec-Bench 降 38.6%、在 32K token 摘要降 29.2%；同一接受规则下三次 Spec-Bench 运行显示比纯 SLM 草稿多省 9.0 个百分点、交付速度 1.9 倍。HyCo 与 Cloud+MTP 的 judge-score 差 +0.2（配对 95% CI −0.9 到 +1.3），探索性翻译任务偏向 SpecEdge-ε；不做放宽时 HyCo exact 在两数据集分别省 27.7% 与 11.9%。
Conclusion: 把草稿深度移到设备侧的服务器原生 MTP 头、只用 SLM 补分支，可在不牺牲生成质量的前提下大幅压低服务器 GPU 时间；ε 放宽是额外的节省来源，翻译类任务上 SpecEdge-ε 更占优。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Policy-Aligned Predictive Verification for Adaptive VLA Action-Chunk Execution
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies generate action sequences that reduce repeated inference, but deciding how much of each sequence to execute is critical to task success. Existing adaptive methods make this decision using generation stability or prediction agreement, yet these signals do not establish whether executing a candidate prefix preserves the ability to complete the task. We introduce a policy-aligned predictive verifier (PAV) that anticipates the consequences of candidate action prefixes and evaluates their compatibility with successful continuation before execution. Rather than using future prediction to generate actions, our method evaluates existing proposals in the VLA's internal task-conditioned representation space. To learn local judgments from terminal task outcomes, we combine trajectory-level survival supervision with a localization prior that preserves useful behavior within failed rollouts. The resulting validity scores guide execution-horizon selection. Evaluations with pi_0 and pi_0.5 across LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation show improved success-query trade-offs. These findings point toward a different role for future prediction in robotics, using it to assess how far to trust a policy's proposed actions rather than to generate new ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 policy-aligned predictive verifier (PAV)：在 VLA 自身的任务条件表征空间里预判候选动作前缀的后果，判断其能否与成功续接相容，用有效性分数决定每个 action chunk 执行多长。训练上把轨迹级 survival 监督与定位先验（从失败 rollout 中保留有用行为）结合。在 pi_0 与 pi_0.5 上、跨 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 与真实操作任务，PAV 改善了成功率与查询开销的权衡。
Motivation: VLA 生成动作序列以减少重复推理，但执行多少前缀直接决定成败；现有自适应方法依据生成稳定性或预测一致性，这些信号无法说明执行该前缀是否仍能完成任务。
Method: PAV 不用未来预测生成动作，而是在 VLA 内部任务条件表征空间中评估已有候选前缀；用轨迹级 survival 监督学习终局成败判断，再加一个 localization 先验，使失败 rollout 内仍有用的行为被保留，输出 validity 分数指导 execution-horizon 选择。
Result: 在 pi_0 与 pi_0.5 上，跨 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 和真实操作评测，PAV 改善了 success-query 权衡（success-query trade-offs）。
Conclusion: 未来预测在机器人中的作用可以是评估对策略所提动作该信任多远，而不是生成新动作；执行长度应由与成功续接的相容性而非生成稳定性决定。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ManiFusion: Unlocking the High-Throughput Generation via Superposition in Manifold Space
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models achieve high-quality image generation but remain computationally expensive due to iterative denoising across many timesteps. Existing acceleration methods mainly reduce per-sample latency, but gains along this axis are becoming saturated. We instead explore an orthogonal throughput-oriented direction by processing multiple samples within a single denoising evaluation. To this end, we propose ManiFusion, a backbone-agnostic framework for multi-sample generation through fused-space computation. ManiFusion jointly processes multiple samples by fusing them before the denoising backbone and separating them afterward through unfusion. We provide a geometric perspective on how multiple samples can share a fused representation while retaining the information needed to guide their individual generation trajectories. To better align fusion allocation with denoising stages, ManiFusion uses Trajectory-Fusion Scheduling (TFS), which dynamically adjusts fusion factors throughout sampling. ManiFusion generalizes across diffusion families, including both U-Net and transformer backbones in pixel and latent spaces. We further show that ManiFusion composes with existing acceleration methods and reaches throughput regimes unattainable by prior approaches with minimal quality degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ManiFusion 把多个扩散样本在去噪骨干之前融合成共享表示、之后再 unfusion 分开，从而在单次去噪评估里并行多样本，走的是吞吐量而非单样本延迟的加速路线。Trajectory-Fusion Scheduling (TFS) 按去噪阶段动态调整 fusion factor，框架与现有加速方法可组合，能到达先前方法达不到的吞吐区间且质量退化极小。
Motivation: 扩散模型的迭代去噪开销大，现有加速手段主要压单样本延迟，这条轴的收益已趋饱和，吞吐方向缺少可扩展的做法。
Method: backbone-agnostic 的 fused-space 计算：去噪前 fuse 多样本、去噪后 unfusion 分离，并给出多样本共享融合表示同时保留各自轨迹引导信息的几何解释；用 Trajectory-Fusion Scheduling (TFS) 随采样过程动态调整 fusion factor，兼容 U-Net 与 transformer 骨干、pixel 与 latent 空间，并可与已有加速方法叠加。
Result: 在 U-Net 与 transformer 骨干、pixel 与 latent 空间等扩散家族上均适用，可与现有加速方法组合，达到先前方法无法实现的吞吐区间，同时仅有极小的质量退化。

papers.title: Learning from Interaction Experience via Localized Context Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Learning from interaction experience is essential for enabling large language models to continually improve during deployment. Context distillation offers a promising path: privileged information extracted from experience is provided to a teacher, whose behavior is then distilled into a student model that has no access to it. However, both existing forms of context distillation have limitations. Off-policy context distillation trains the student on teacher-generated trajectories and thus suffers from exposure bias; whereas on-policy context distillation trains on the student's own rollouts, whose states are often uninformative and fail to convey behaviors the student cannot yet produce. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce Localized Context Distillation (LoCD). LoCD first localizes the critical spans of a student trajectory that require revision. The teacher then regenerates only these spans from the student's own prefix, and the student is trained on the regenerated segments. LoCD thereby concentrates learning on the most informative states while keeping exposure bias low. Extensive experiments across math reasoning, code generation, and agent tasks demonstrate that LoCD consistently outperforms strong baselines and achieves more stable training with smaller and sparser parameter updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Localized Context Distillation (LoCD)：先定位学生轨迹中需要修改的关键片段，教师只从学生自己的前缀重新生成这些片段，学生再在重生成片段上训练，从而把学习集中在信息量最大的状态上。在数学推理、代码生成和智能体任务上，LoCD 稳定优于强基线，训练更稳定，参数更新更小更稀疏。
Motivation: off-policy context distillation 在教师轨迹上训练学生，存在 exposure bias；on-policy 版本用学生自身 rollout，但状态常无信息量，无法传达学生尚不能产生的行为。
Method: LoCD 三步：定位学生轨迹中需修改的关键 span；教师仅从学生前缀重新生成这些 span；学生在重生成片段上训练，兼顾信息量与低 exposure bias。
Result: 在数学推理、代码生成和智能体任务上一致优于强基线，训练更稳定，参数更新更小且更稀疏；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把 context distillation 的训练信号限制在被局部重生成的片段上，可在保持 on-policy 性质的同时避开无信息状态，是部署中持续改进 LLM 的可行路径。

papers.title: Do Agents Need a New Kind of Paper? SPRA: Structured Paper Representation for Agents
papers.abstract_en: Scientific agents must connect research problems, methods, and findings dispersed through narrative articles. We introduce SPRA (Structured Paper Representation for Agents), a paper-level representation of persistent research objects and typed relations. Its empirical-AI profile organizes Problems, Contributions, Components, ExperimentSetups, Measures, and Findings for querying, traversal, and reuse. Selected paper-level citation relations record dependencies, component use, and comparisons with prior work; source locations support verification. We instantiate SPRA across more than one million AI papers, with 19.95 million research units and 24.07 million internal relations. Evaluations access SPRA through Schema-RAG with task evidence fixed before inference. Across seven subfields, SPRA improves source-conditioned scientific QA by 0.381/5 over passage retrieval while remaining close to Full Compact (0.078/5 lower on average). In directed cross-paper reasoning, qualification improves by 0.184/5 over passage retrieval; Top-5 synthesis shows mixed quality effects. Across all paired RQ2 tasks, including Top-5, input+output tokens decrease by 28.5% relative to passage retrieval and 95.3% relative to Full Compact. In idea generation, a 0.067-point lower Overall score than Full Compact accompanies 93.7% fewer input+output tokens. Together, these results support SPRA as a usable representation of scientific content and a foundation for research workflows that connect, inspect, and reuse paper-level research objects. The SPRA resource is accessible through the SciVerse scholarly-data platform.
papers.comment: 23 pages, including references and appendices; resource website: https://sciverse.opendatalab.com/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPRA 为 AI 论文构建论文级结构化表示（Problems、Contributions、Components、ExperimentSetups、Measures、Findings 及带类型的引用关系），供 agent 以 Schema-RAG 方式查询与跨论文推理。在超过一百万篇 AI 论文上实例化后，源条件科学 QA 比 passage retrieval 高 0.381/5，跨论文推理高 0.184/5，同时输入+输出 token 相对 passage retrieval 减少 28.5%、相对 Full Compact 减少 95.3%。
Motivation: 科学 agent 需要把分散在叙事性论文中的研究问题、方法与发现连接起来，而原文段落检索与全文压缩在跨论文推理上证据定位差、token 开销大。
Method: SPRA 定义论文级持久研究对象与带类型关系，用 empirical-AI profile 组织 Problems、Contributions、Components、ExperimentSetups、Measures、Findings，并记录论文级引用关系（依赖、组件使用、与前作比较）及源位置以支持验证；agent 通过 Schema-RAG 访问，任务证据在推理前固定。
Result: 在 100 万+ AI 论文上实例化，含 1995 万研究单元与 2407 万内部关系。七个子领域上，源条件科学 QA 比 passage retrieval 提升 0.381/5，仅比 Full Compact 低 0.078/5；定向跨论文推理比 passage retrieval 提升 0.184/5，Top-5 综合质量效果不一；全部配对 RQ2 任务（含 Top-5）输入+输出 token 相对 passage retrieval 减少 28.5%、相对 Full Compact 减少 95.3%；创意生成 Overall 比 Full Compact 低 0.067 分，同时 token 减少 93.7%。
Conclusion: SPRA 是可用的科学内容表示，能在接近全文压缩质量的同时大幅压缩 token 开销，可作为连接、检查与复用论文级研究对象的研究工作流基础；Top-5 综合上的质量效果不一致。

papers.title: Where, How, and When: Query-Guided Grounding for Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Understanding video content requires reasoning at multiple levels of granularity, from identifying objects to interpreting their interactions and localizing when specific actions occur. This thesis studies three query-guided grounding tasks that answer where key objects are (object-level grounding), how they interact (relationship-level grounding), and when specific moments occur (moment-level grounding). For object-level grounding, we present QDETRv, a query-guided extension of the Detection Transformer for one-shot localization of unseen objects in videos, which combines query-context fusion, a memory module for temporal consistency, and unsupervised pretraining on synthetic object trajectories. We further propose the Temporal Object-Aware Vision Transformer (TOViT) for few-shot video object detection, which builds on a language-aligned open-set vision encoder and propagates high-confidence object features across frames. For relationship-level grounding, we introduce few-shot referring relationships in videos: given a (subject, predicate, object) query and a few support videos sharing the predicate, the entities are localized by optimizing a T-partite random field using a meta-learned relation network with query-conditioned translational embeddings, Global Semantic Aggregation, Local Localization Aggregation, and belief-propagation-based message passing. For moment-level grounding, we propose the Moment Alignment Transformer (MATR) for video-to-video moment retrieval, which uses dual-stage Dynamic Time Warping for pre- and post-fusion alignment, learnable queries for boundary prediction, and self-supervised pretraining with temporal augmentations; MATR also extends to text-to-video moment retrieval with performance comparable to, or better than, the state of the art. These contributions advance query-guided video understanding across spatial, relational, and temporal grounding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇视频理解博士论文，围绕查询引导的 grounding 提出四个模型：QDETRv 做未见物体的一次性定位，TOViT 做少样本视频目标检测，元学习关系网络做少样本指称关系定位，MATR 做视频到视频与文本到视频的时刻检索。摘要未给出任何定量指标，只声明 MATR 在文本到视频时刻检索上达到或优于当前最好水平。
Motivation: 视频内容理解需要在物体、交互关系、时刻三个粒度上同时回答 where、how、when，而现有方法在未见物体、少样本关系和跨模态时刻对齐上覆盖不全。
Method: QDETRv 将 query-context fusion、时序一致性 memory module 与合成物体轨迹上的无监督预训练结合进 DETR；TOViT 基于语言对齐的 open-set 视觉编码器并跨帧传播高置信物体特征；关系定位用元学习关系网络加 query 条件平移嵌入、Global/Local Aggregation 与 belief propagation 优化 T-partite random field；MATR 用双阶段 Dynamic Time Warping 做融合前后对齐、可学习 query 预测边界，并用时序增强做自监督预训练。
Result: 摘要未给出任何数据集、基线或数值指标；定性结论是 MATR 扩展到文本到视频时刻检索后性能与当前最好水平相当或更好。
Conclusion: 查询引导的 grounding 可以在空间、关系、时间三个层面统一组织视频理解，其中时刻检索是唯一被声明达到或超过现有最好水平的部分。

papers.title: What Does History Add? Calendar Controls and Information-Timing Audits for University Trajectory Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: We audit the predictive value of historical summaries in a rule-based university trajectory simulator. Seventeen ridge specifications and persistence separate current plans, past-state and past-plan summaries, and calendar-only history-length indicators. Across training, validation and two family-held-out evaluations, we reconstruct 16,750 routes and 804,000 monthly records. On the original 40-family set, six-month history lowers six-step normalized RMSE from 0.159234 to 0.151522, but its difference from a length-only control is -0.000895 (descriptive paired 95% interval [-0.001957,0.000248]). Fixed weights on 30 families unused in identified prior tasks reproduce this pattern: 0.156480 to 0.150074 versus current-state prediction, but -0.000558 [-0.001783,0.000728] versus the length control. These uncertain comparisons do not generalize to all-history summaries, which improve on their own calendar control. Exploratory decomposition finds clearer preparation-index and funds benefits, whereas fatigue dominates the six-month model's loss and has an uncertain length-controlled benefit. Moreover, 28.20% of its six-step fatigue predictions violate the simulator's [5,90] support. We document family dependence, prior exposure, strict temporal indexing, matched recursive references and independent numerical replay. The task conditions on recorded future plans; it does not evaluate real-student forecasts, causal action effects, autonomous planning or language-model memory. This is an evaluation audit, not a new memory architecture.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Methodological simulator evaluation with information-timing and calendar-control audits
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在规则式大学轨迹模拟器上审计历史摘要的预测价值：17 个 ridge 规格加 persistence，把当前计划、过去状态/过去计划摘要与纯日历历史长度指示分开。六个月历史把六步归一化 RMSE 从 0.159234 降到 0.151522，但相对长度对照仅 -0.000895（95% 区间 [-0.001957, 0.000248]），即收益基本可由日历长度解释。
Motivation: 历史上下文常被默认为提升轨迹预测，但在模拟器设定下缺少把信息时序与日历长度对照分开的审计，无法判断收益来自真实历史信息还是单纯的历史长度指示。
Method: 在规则式大学轨迹模拟器上构造 17 个 ridge 规格与 persistence 基线，分离当前计划、过去状态/过去计划摘要与纯日历历史长度指示；训练、验证与两个 family-held-out 评估重建 16,750 条路线、804,000 条月度记录，并做严格时序索引、匹配递归参照与独立数值重放。
Result: 原始 40-family 集上，六个月历史使六步归一化 RMSE 从 0.159234 降至 0.151522，但相对长度对照差为 -0.000895，描述性配对 95% 区间 [-0.001957, 0.000248]。在 30 个未参与已识别先前任务的 family 上固定权重复现该模式：相对当前状态预测 0.156480 → 0.150074，相对长度对照 -0.000558，区间 [-0.001783, 0.000728]。全历史摘要相对其自身日历对照有改善；探索性分解显示 preparation-index 与 funds 收益更清晰，而 fatigue 主导六个月模型损失且相对长度对照收益不确定，其六步 fatigue 预测有 28.20% 落在模拟器 [5,90] 支撑之外。
Conclusion: 在该模拟器设定下，六个月历史的收益与纯日历长度对照难以区分，全历史摘要才是相对自身对照有改善的情形；这是评估审计而非新记忆架构，且任务以记录的未来计划为条件，不评估真实学生预测或因果动作效应。

papers.title: Learning to Forecast on Multiple Spatiotemporal Hierarchies
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical forecasting exploits aggregation structures that expose multiple views of the same underlying spatiotemporal forecasting problem, while ensuring coherence among forecasts. Individual series provide fine-grained information, while progressively coarser aggregates reveal temporal and spatial patterns at different scales. In the associated deep learning architectures, the hierarchy determines which aggregate series are available and how they are processed together with individual series (e.g., through reconciliation or message-passing operators). Different hierarchies thus provide distinct learning signals and inductive biases for forecasting the same collection of time series. Nonetheless, existing architectures are typically trained on a single, often fixed, structure. In this work, we propose a graph deep learning framework that leverages variations across hierarchies as multi-task regularization. We show that jointly learning across these structures can reduce over-specialization to any single hierarchy and improve forecasting performance. Indeed, training across hierarchies provides an inductive bias toward representations that are useful across different structures, and as such, generalize better. Making forecasts coherent with the aggregation constraints for each sampled hierarchy is computationally expensive: to complement the framework, we propose a novel operator-based on a top-down approach-that produces coherent forecasts with linear time and space complexity w.r.t. the hierarchy size. Experiments show that our approach improves forecasting accuracy over training on a single structure and is competitive with current state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出跨层级多任务正则化的图深度学习框架：把同一时空预测问题的不同聚合层级 (hierarchy) 视作多个学习信号，联合训练以减少对单一结构的过拟合，并配一个基于 top-down 的算子，以线性时间与空间复杂度生成满足聚合约束的一致 (coherent) 预测。实验显示该方法在预测精度上优于只在单一结构上训练，并与当前 state-of-the-art 方法相当。
Motivation: 层级预测架构通常只在单一、往往固定的聚合结构上训练，导致模型对特定层级过专化，而不同层级本可提供互补的学习信号与归纳偏置。
Method: 图深度学习框架，把跨层级的变化当作多任务正则化，联合学习多个聚合结构；层级决定可用的聚合序列及其与个体序列的处理方式（reconciliation 或 message-passing 算子）。另提出一个基于 top-down 的算子，使预测对每个采样层级满足聚合一致性约束，相对层级规模的时间与空间复杂度为线性。
Result: 实验表明该方法的预测精度优于在单一结构上训练，且与当前 state-of-the-art 方法相当；一致性算子的复杂度相对层级规模为线性时间与线性空间。
Conclusion: 跨层级联合训练能带来对不同结构都有效的表征、泛化更好，而一致性约束可以在线性复杂度下实现，不必为每个层级付出高昂计算代价。

papers.title: JevAgentHarness: Benchmarking, Deploying and Training Decision Models That Share Control with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents now fix software, operate computers and serve customers, but their harnesses, the programs that run them, call a large LLM at every step, which makes long tasks slow and costly. Most of these calls end in a multiple-choice decision, such as which tool to call next. Decision models such as Jev answer these questions directly, at a fraction of an LLM call's time and price. We ask how a harness can delegate these decisions to a decision model with little loss of success. To evaluate decision models in agentic tasks, we build AgentDecisionBench, which tests them from isolated questions up to control of a running agent, on public benchmarks and our DecisionGym environment. The decision model most accurate on isolated questions solved only 69.5% of agent tasks, and without a fitted confidence threshold, delegating tool choices lowered success by 19.0 points. Building on these findings, we then design JevAgentHarness, which fits this threshold for each choice on the agent's own trajectories and lets the LLM decide below it. Because existing decision models never see the states an agent reaches after its own mistakes, we train AgentDecision-4B, an open 4B model, on such states with Jev's answers as labels. On tasks unlike its training data, the agent solved 91.5% of them with AgentDecision-4B and 82.0% with Jev. On tasks like their training data, 4B models trained this way made agents 81.1-89.0% cheaper and up to 2.5 times faster, without losing 3 or more points of task success. The models, data, and harness will be released at https://github.com/JevAgentHarness/JevAgentHarness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM agent 的每一步都调大模型，多数只是多选决策，JevAgentHarness 用决策模型接管这些选择并按拟合的置信阈值决定何时交还 LLM。AgentDecisionBench 显示孤立问题上最准的决策模型只解出 69.5% 的 agent 任务，未拟合阈值时下放工具选择使成功率掉 19.0 个百分点；按轨迹拟合阈值并用 agent 自身错误后状态训练的 AgentDecision-4B 后，分布外任务成功率 91.5%（Jev 为 82.0%），分布内任务成本降 81.1–89.0%、速度最高 2.5 倍且成功率不掉超过 3 分。
Motivation: harness 每步都调大 LLM，长任务慢且贵，而多数调用只是多选式决策（如下一个调哪个工具）；直接下放给决策模型会掉成功率，因为现有决策模型从未见过 agent 犯错后到达的状态。
Method: 构建 AgentDecisionBench，从孤立问题一路测到对运行中 agent 的控制，覆盖公开基准与自建 DecisionGym 环境；JevAgentHarness 在 agent 自身轨迹上为每类选择拟合置信阈值，低于阈值才交回 LLM；并用 Jev 的答案作标签、在 agent 犯错后的状态上训练开源 4B 模型 AgentDecision-4B。
Result: 孤立问题上最准的决策模型只解出 69.5% 的 agent 任务；未拟合置信阈值时下放工具选择使成功率下降 19.0 个百分点。用 AgentDecision-4B 在与训练数据不同的任务上 agent 成功率 91.5%，用 Jev 为 82.0%；在与训练数据相似的任务上，这类 4B 模型使 agent 成本降低 81.1–89.0%、速度最高提升 2.5 倍，任务成功率损失不超过 3 分。
Conclusion: 决策模型能否安全接管 agent 取决于阈值校准与是否见过 agent 自身的错误后状态，二者齐备才能在不掉超过 3 分成功率的前提下拿到 2.5 倍加速与最高 89% 的成本削减。

papers.title: Jev-LiteMAS: Separating Decisions from Generation in Multi-Agent Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems rely on generative models for expert execution, workflow planning, and artifact review. Yet many coordination operations require only bounded decisions, such as selecting the next expert or judging artifact quality. Profiling three representative MAS frameworks, we find that routing and review account for 31.7-43.5% of generative-LLM tokens. However, replacing these operations with low-cost decision models introduces two interface gaps: generative planners produce execution plans and handoff instructions (planning gap), while reviewers provide actionable feedback for repairing flawed artifacts (review gap), which bounded decisions alone cannot provide. We introduce Jev-LiteMAS, a multi-agent framework that bridges both gaps by combining a lightweight decision model (Jev) with generative execution and feedback. To address the planning gap, Jev selects experts dynamically from the task and prior expert outputs, using accumulated context to ground subsequent execution without a pre-generated trajectory. To address the review gap, Jev screens intermediate artifacts against task criteria: passing artifacts proceed directly, whereas flagged ones undergo LLM re-review for acceptance or corrective feedback. Across four benchmarks and two backbones, Jev-LiteMAS reduces generative-LLM tokens by 12.7-54.6% over LAS, maintaining accuracy within 1.34 percentage points and lowering latency in seven of eight settings. Grounding routing in substantive expert outputs prevents up to 18.0 points in accuracy loss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Jev-LiteMAS 把多智能体 LLM 工作流中的路由与评审从生成式模型剥离，改由轻量决策模型 Jev 承担有界决策，仅在制品被标记时才回退到 LLM 复审与纠错反馈。在四个基准、两种骨干模型上，相比 LAS 生成式 LLM token 消耗下降 12.7–54.6%，准确率保持在 1.34 个百分点以内，八个设置中七个延迟降低；把路由建立在专家实质输出之上可避免最多 18.0 个百分点的准确率损失。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统中大量协调操作（选下一位专家、判制品质量）只需有界决策，却由昂贵的生成式模型执行；profiling 三个代表性 MAS 框架显示路由与评审占生成式 LLM token 的 31.7–43.5%。但直接用低成本决策模型替换会留下两个接口缺口：规划缺口（生成式规划器产出执行计划与交接指令）与评审缺口（评审器给出可执行的修复反馈），纯有界决策无法提供。
Method: Jev-LiteMAS 组合轻量决策模型 Jev 与生成式执行/反馈。规划缺口上，Jev 依据任务与先前专家输出动态选择专家，用累积上下文为后续执行提供依据，无需预先生成轨迹；评审缺口上，Jev 按任务准则筛查中间制品，通过者直接放行，被标记者送入 LLM 复审以决定接受或给出纠错反馈。
Result: 在四个基准、两种骨干模型上，相比 LAS 生成式 LLM token 减少 12.7–54.6%，准确率保持在 1.34 个百分点以内，八个设置中七个延迟下降；profiling 三个 MAS 框架得路由与评审占生成式 LLM token 的 31.7–43.5%；将路由建立在实质专家输出上可防止最多 18.0 个百分点的准确率损失。
Conclusion: 把有界决策交给轻量模型、把生成式模型留给执行与纠错反馈，可以在多智能体工作流中大幅削减 token 成本而几乎不损失准确率；路由若脱离专家实质输出，准确率会显著下滑。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CLAD: Keypoint Matching Using Global Line Correspondences
papers.abstract_en: Traditional keypoint descriptors, such as SIFT (Scale-Invariant Feature Transform) and ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF), are computed from local image patches. They may be unreliable in scenes with repetitive patterns or weak textures, where patches at different locations can look similar. We propose the Contextual Line-Assisted Descriptor (CLAD), a keypoint matching method that addresses this problem by using global geometric context from line correspondences. CLAD represents each keypoint with a vector whose elements indicate its proximity to matched lines. It can therefore use the keypoint's spatial relationships to the lines in the scene. We use HOME (Hough-space One-dimensional Matching of Extrema) to detect both clear and weak linear structures and to establish enough line-to-keypoint associations to represent this context. Evaluations on the TUM RGB-D SLAM dataset and outdoor video sequences show that CLAD provides geometrically consistent matches that complement those obtained with traditional local descriptors. In repetitive scenes, where local descriptors may not distinguish similar patches, CLAD uses global structure to improve matching reliability. The method is computationally lightweight and practical to implement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLAD 用全局线对应关系替代局部图像块来表示关键点：每个关键点编码为一个表示其到已匹配直线邻近程度的向量，从而在重复纹理或弱纹理场景中区分局部描述子无法区分的相似块。用 HOME (Hough-space One-dimensional Matching of Extrema) 检测清晰与弱线结构并建立足够的线-关键点关联，在 TUM RGB-D SLAM 数据集与室外视频序列上给出几何一致的匹配，与 SIFT、ORB 等局部描述子互补，且计算轻量。
Motivation: SIFT、ORB 等传统描述子只从局部图像块计算，在重复纹理或弱纹理场景中不同位置的块看起来相似，匹配不可靠。
Method: 提出 Contextual Line-Assisted Descriptor (CLAD)：用线对应建立的全局几何上下文，把每个关键点表示为其到匹配直线的邻近度向量，编码关键点与场景直线的空间关系；线检测与线-关键点关联由 HOME (Hough-space One-dimensional Matching of Extrema) 完成，以覆盖清晰与弱线结构。
Result: 在 TUM RGB-D SLAM 数据集与室外视频序列上的评测显示，CLAD 给出几何一致的匹配，并与传统局部描述子的结果互补；在重复场景中借助全局结构提升匹配可靠性，方法计算轻量、易于实现。
Conclusion: 在局部描述子因重复或弱纹理失效的场景，用全局直线几何上下文补充关键点描述可以提升匹配可靠性，且代价可控。

papers.title: MemCut: Every Secret Leaves a Trail in the Long-Term Memory of LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory has become a crucial component of large language model (LLM) agents, with most research focusing on retrieving relevant information accurately and efficiently. However, a dependable memory system must also forget sensitive user data upon request. To evaluate this capability, we introduce MemCut, a systematic benchmark for user-requested forgetting. Its 456 hand-designed secrets in long-horizon conversations have fully annotated evidence trails to test recovery after deletion, including from messages that never state the secrets directly. We propose two recovery metrics. Native recovery measures reader success through the system's retrieval, whereas residual recovery measures the same reader's success when directly given surviving objects traced to annotated disclosures or evidence. We establish three reference deletion baselines to test how far existing retrievers and write models support forgetting across five memory designs and four LLMs. Disclosure removal reduces native recovery far more than residual recovery. LLM-guided deletion of ten additional turns from twenty retrieval candidates leaves 39-76% residual recovery. Subset sweeps (144 facts, three systems, two models) show that widening the pool at a fixed budget reduces residual recovery more than deleting all original candidates. These sweeps identify candidate coverage as a bottleneck in the reference baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemCut 是面向 LLM agent「按用户要求遗忘」的系统性基准：456 个手工设计的机密嵌在长程对话中并标注完整证据链，用 native recovery 与 residual recovery 两个指标衡量删除后机密能否被检索或从残留对象中重建。结果表明直接删除披露消息能大幅压低 native recovery 却几乎不动 residual recovery；在 20 个检索候选上由 LLM 再删 10 轮后 residual recovery 仍达 39–76%，而固定预算下扩大候选池比删光原始候选更能降低 residual recovery，说明候选覆盖 (candidate coverage) 是现有检索器与写入模型的瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有长期记忆研究集中在准确高效检索，却缺少衡量「按用户要求遗忘敏感数据」的评测；删除后机密仍可能从未直接陈述该机密的消息或残留对象中被恢复。
Method: 构建 MemCut 基准：456 个手工设计的机密置于长程对话并标注证据链，提出 native recovery（经系统检索读取成功）与 residual recovery（直接给出可追溯到披露或证据的存活对象时读取成功）两个指标；设立三个参考删除基线，横跨五种记忆设计与四种 LLM，并做子集扫描（144 facts、三个系统、两个模型）。
Result: 披露移除 (disclosure removal) 使 native recovery 的下降远大于 residual recovery；LLM 引导删除 20 个检索候选中的 10 轮后 residual recovery 仍为 39–76%；子集扫描显示固定预算下扩大候选池比删除全部原始候选更能降低 residual recovery，从而定位候选覆盖为参考基线的瓶颈。
Conclusion: 删除披露消息不足以真正遗忘：残余证据仍可重建机密，遗忘能力的瓶颈在于候选覆盖而非删除动作本身，评测必须同时看 native 与 residual 两类恢复。

papers.title: Multi-Reward Hacking: From Aggregation-Induced Drift to Trust-Anchored Defense
papers.abstract_en: To improve task performance while encouraging desirable response properties, LLM post-training often combines a primary reward (e.g., correctness) with auxiliary rewards (e.g., brevity or efficiency). However, how these rewards are aggregated can critically affect training outcomes. We show that symmetric aggregation, which treats reward channels equally, can induce a failure where aggregate reward improves while primary-task performance degrades, even when individual rewards are meaningful. We investigate this aggregation-induced failure through a one-step multi-reward decision formulation, characterizing when it constitutes multi-reward hacking. We prove that, under symmetric aggregation, deterministic conditional-mean GRPO converges to auxiliary-favoring behavior when auxiliary rewards are more reliably obtained, regardless of initialization. We propose Trust-Anchored Gating (TAG), which first elects an anchor channel based on the policy drift induced by optimizing each channel alone, then gates auxiliary credit on anchor satisfaction. Unlike calibration-sensitive static reweighting, TAG structurally eliminates credit for auxiliary-only outcomes while preserving additional credit for joint success. In the same analytical setting, TAG provably reverses this selection, converging to the primary-favoring action from any initialization when the primary channel is anchored. Experiments across Qwen and Llama models on mathematics and program synthesis reveal substantial degradation under symmetric, constrained, and normalized aggregation, whereas TAG mitigates this failure. On Qwen3-4B with a brevity reward, TAG achieves 0.581 pass@4 versus 0.220 for additive aggregation, while shortening responses by 44% relative to correctness-only training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 后训练中把主奖励与辅助奖励对称聚合会诱发 multi-reward hacking：总奖励上升而主任务性能下降。作者证明在对称聚合下 deterministic conditional-mean GRPO 只要辅助奖励更易获得就收敛到偏好辅助的行为（与初始化无关），并提出 Trust-Anchored Gating (TAG)：先按单独优化各通道引起的策略漂移选出 anchor 通道，再在 anchor 满足时才给辅助信用。Qwen3-4B 上带 brevity 奖励时 TAG pass@4 达 0.581（加性聚合 0.220），同时相对仅正确性训练缩短回答 44%。
Motivation: LLM 后训练常把正确性等主奖励与简洁、效率等辅助奖励合并，但聚合方式会决定训练走向：对称聚合下总奖励改善而主任务性能退化，即使各奖励单独看都有意义。
Method: 以 one-step multi-reward 决策形式刻画何为 multi-reward hacking；证明 deterministic conditional-mean GRPO 在对称聚合下的收敛行为；提出 Trust-Anchored Gating (TAG)，按单独优化每个奖励通道引起的策略漂移选举 anchor 通道，再依据 anchor 是否满足来门控辅助信用，从而结构性地取消仅辅助结果的信用、保留联合成功的额外信用。
Result: 在 Qwen 与 Llama 模型上的数学和程序合成任务中，对称、约束式与归一化聚合都出现明显性能退化，而 TAG 缓解该失败；Qwen3-4B 上带 brevity 奖励时 TAG pass@4 为 0.581，加性聚合为 0.220，且相对仅正确性训练回答缩短 44%。
Conclusion: 对称聚合在辅助奖励更易获得时会结构性地把策略推向辅助偏好，而以策略漂移选出 anchor 并门控辅助信用的 TAG 在同一分析设定下从任意初始化都收敛到偏好主奖励的动作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Invariance: Factor-wise Selective Treatment of Shifts for Multimodal Learning
papers.abstract_en: Distribution shifts pose a fundamental challenge to robust multimodal learning. Existing methods typically promote invariance by suppressing environment-dependent variations, implicitly applying a uniform treatment to shifted information. However, shifted information can have different predictive consequences: some contributes little to prediction, some remains reliably informative, and some exhibits environment-dependent predictive effects. This raises a fundamental question: which shifted information should be suppressed, preserved, or attenuated? To address this question, we propose FaShift, a factor-wise shift framework that diagnoses latent representation factors according to their distributional changes, intervention effects, and cross-environment stability. By factorizing multimodal representations and evaluating these complementary properties, FaShift distinguishes non-predictive factors, stably predictive factors, and predictively useful but unstable factors. It then selectively suppresses, preserves, or attenuates their contributions, rather than enforcing uniform invariance. Experiments on MOSI, MOSEI, and CH-SIMS show that FaShift achieves the best ID accuracy and F1 across all three datasets. Compared with the strongest competitors reporting OOD results, it improves OOD accuracy/F1 by 1.5/3.6 points on MOSI and 1.7/2.7 points on MOSEI, while achieving the best reported OOD accuracy and F1 on CH-SIMS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FaShift 打破多模态分布偏移处理中一律追求不变性的做法，按因子分别诊断其分布变化、干预效应与跨环境稳定性，再决定抑制、保留还是衰减。在 MOSI、MOSEI、CH-SIMS 上取得三个数据集的最佳 ID 准确率与 F1；相对最强 OOD 基线，MOSI OOD 准确率/F1 提升 1.5/3.6 点，MOSEI 提升 1.7/2.7 点。
Motivation: 现有方法统一压制环境相关变化，把对预测无用、稳定有信息、以及环境依赖但有预测价值的偏移一视同仁，可能丢掉本可保留的预测信号。
Method: FaShift 将多模态表示分解为潜在因子，依据分布变化、干预效应与跨环境稳定性三项互补性质把因子分为非预测、稳定可预测、有预测力但不稳定三类，再分别施加抑制、保留、衰减，而非统一不变性约束。
Result: 在 MOSI、MOSEI、CH-SIMS 上均取得最佳 ID accuracy 与 F1；与报告 OOD 结果的最强竞争方法相比，MOSI OOD accuracy/F1 提升 1.5/3.6 点，MOSEI 提升 1.7/2.7 点，CH-SIMS 取得已报告的最佳 OOD accuracy 与 F1。
Conclusion: 对偏移信息按因子选择性处理优于统一不变性，可在三个多模态情感基准上同时改善 ID 与 OOD 表现。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Fault Detection and Bit-Error Rate Diagnostics in Optical Wireless Links Using Edge-AI
papers.abstract_en: Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) systems provide high-bandwidth, spatially secure, and RF-interference-free digital transmission. However, direct free-space optical links suffer from extreme sensitivity to line-of-sight disruptions, optical attenuation, high ambient light saturation, and transmitter-receiver misalignment. Traditional channel diagnostic frameworks rely on external computing nodes or cloud-based processing, which introduces severe diagnostic latency and reduces edge node autonomy. This paper presents an autonomous, self-diagnosing optical wireless receiver node that integrates physical-layer signal telemetry extraction with an on-device TinyML classification engine. Built around an ESP32-S3 microcontroller, the receiver recovers 1000 bit/s On-Off Keying (OOK) digital payloads using a 5-sample majority voting mechanism while concurrently extracting real-time channel features: Bit Error Rate (BER), received signal voltage (Vsignal), Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNRdB), and ambient light baseline (Lambient). Evaluated against a Random Forest baseline (77.22% accuracy) and a floating-point neural network (78.48% accuracy), a post-training INT8 quantized TensorFlow Lite Micro model occupying only 3.32 kB of SRAM runs directly on the receiver firmware. The quantized model achieves 74.68% overall accuracy across four distinct operational conditions: normal transmission, optical filter attenuation, ambient light interference, and severe obstruction/misalignment. On-device deployment tests confirm real-time, deterministic fault classification, establishing a practical approach for self-aware optical IoT nodes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ESP32-S3 上把物理层遥测（BER、Vsignal、SNRdB、Lambient）直接送进 INT8 量化的 TensorFlow Lite Micro 分类器，让光无线接收节点自行判定四类工况（正常、滤光片衰减、环境光干扰、严重遮挡/失准）。量化模型以 3.32 kB SRAM 跑在接收固件上，四类总体准确率 74.68%，低于 Random Forest 77.22% 与浮点神经网络 78.48%，但换来了片上实时、确定性的故障分类。
Motivation: 自由空间光链路对视距中断、衰减、环境光饱和与收发失准极敏感，而传统信道诊断依赖外部算力或云端，带来诊断时延并削弱边缘节点自主性。
Method: 接收端以 OOK 恢复 1000 bit/s 载荷并做 5-sample 多数表决，同时提取 BER、接收信号电压、SNR 与环境光基线四类实时特征；在其上训练浮点神经网络，再做训练后 INT8 量化并部署为 TensorFlow Lite Micro 模型，与 Random Forest 基线对照。
Result: Random Forest 基线准确率 77.22%，浮点神经网络 78.48%；INT8 量化模型占 3.32 kB SRAM，在正常传输、滤光片衰减、环境光干扰、严重遮挡/失准四类工况上总体准确率 74.68%，片上部署测试确认实时、确定性的故障分类。
Conclusion: 把信道遥测与量化 TinyML 放进接收固件，可在极小 SRAM 预算内实现自诊断光 IoT 节点，代价是相对浮点模型与树模型的准确率下降。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Watts If? A Benchmark for Counterfactual Reasoning About the AI Data Center Buildout
papers.abstract_en: An AI data center is committed years before it draws a watt: a few discrete choices (grid or on-site gas, evaporative or dry cooling, which county to file in) fix its capital, water draw, and carbon path, and LLMs are now asked to help screen them with no test of whether they track what each commitment rules out. We introduce DCBench-440, with two arms reported separately: 200 generative questions over STRIPS worlds for five US deal archetypes, with search-verified gold answers and no tested shortcut above 12% on any question type, and 240 multiple-choice questions grounded in quoted site records, emission equations, and stated scenarios. Across open-weight deployments, accuracy spans 12.5-71.5% (generative) and 58.3-92.5% (multiple choice). One skill fails everywhere: asked to list every action available at a decision gate, no model exceeds 4.0% exact match. The strongest list 72-85% of the actions that would change the project's state but omit most permitted actions that change nothing; with those excused, the best exact match is still 24%. Code, data, and other materials are available upon request.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DCBench-440 用两条独立评测臂检验 LLM 能否追踪 AI 数据中心前期承诺所排除的选项：200 道 STRIPS 世界生成式问题（五种美国交易原型、搜索验证金标）与 240 道基于引用场地记录、排放方程和给定情景的选择题。开放权重模型生成式准确率 12.5–71.5%、选择题 58.3–92.5%，但决策门处枚举全部可用动作这一技能全线失败，无模型超过 4.0% exact match。
Motivation: AI 数据中心在耗电前数年就由少数离散选择（电网或现场燃气、蒸发或干式冷却、申报县）锁定资本、用水与碳路径，而 LLM 被要求参与筛选，却从未被检验是否理解每个承诺排除了哪些选项。
Method: 提出 DCBench-440，两条臂分开报告：生成式臂为 STRIPS 世界上的 200 道题，覆盖五种美国交易原型，金标经搜索验证，且各题型均未测到高于 12% 的捷径；选择题臂为 240 道题，锚定在引用的场地记录、排放方程与明示情景上。
Result: 开放权重部署上，生成式准确率区间 12.5–71.5%，选择题 58.3–92.5%。决策门枚举全部可用动作时无模型 exact match 超过 4.0%；最强模型能列出 72–85% 会改变项目状态的动作，却漏掉多数不改变状态的许可动作，把这些豁免后最佳 exact match 仍只有 24%。
Conclusion: LLM 在有引用支撑的选择题上表现尚可，但对承诺所排除选项的反事实追踪系统性失败，尤其是枚举决策门全部许可动作的能力；代码与数据可按请求获取。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: AI 数据中心在耗电前数年就由少数离散选择（电网或现场燃气、蒸发或干式冷却、申报县）锁定资本、用水与碳路径，而 LLM 被要求参与筛选，却从未被检验是否理解每个承诺排除了哪些选项。
summary_sections.method: 提出 DCBench-440，两条臂分开报告：生成式臂为 STRIPS 世界上的 200 道题，覆盖五种美国交易原型，金标经搜索验证，且各题型均未测到高于 12% 的捷径；选择题臂为 240 道题，锚定在引用的场地记录、排放方程与明示情景上。
summary_sections.result: 开放权重部署上，生成式准确率区间 12.5–71.5%，选择题 58.3–92.5%。决策门枚举全部可用动作时无模型 exact match 超过 4.0%；最强模型能列出 72–85% 会改变项目状态的动作，却漏掉多数不改变状态的许可动作，把这些豁免后最佳 exact match 仍只有 24%。
summary_sections.conclusion: LLM 在有引用支撑的选择题上表现尚可，但对承诺所排除选项的反事实追踪系统性失败，尤其是枚举决策门全部许可动作的能力；代码与数据可按请求获取。

papers.title: When do quantum views help? Complementary classical-quantum representations in multi-view fusion
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies have reported promising results from quantum machine learning in drug discovery, healthcare, materials science and cybersecurity. Research includes comparisons with classical machine learning algorithms and the development of sequential hybrid pipelines. We propose that fusion can improve prediction when classical and quantum representations capture complementary predictive relationships. Our classical-quantum multi-view framework preserves the full classical input alongside simulated quantum features. Concatenation and attention combine the views; single-view comparisons, replacement and masking controls assess both views' contributions. Controlled angular-polynomial experiments distinguish targets adequately represented by a single view from those that depend on complementary angular and polynomial relationships. For these mixed targets, fusion improves prediction by combining the relevant feature sets, while matched classical representations recover the same benefit, linking the improvement to their complementary predictive content. Controlled classification tests further show that gains depend on alignment between the chosen representation and the target, and on a suitable fusion rule. Benchmark validation shows improved mean predictive performance over classical baselines on Wine, Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer, three-class Fashion-MNIST and Steel Plates Faults within the evaluated protocols. Classical replacement and masking controls remain competitive, classical baselines lead on Digits and Covertype, and outcomes with missing or corrupted views depend on the available inputs. These findings support evaluating quantum representations for their complementary predictive contribution and matching the representation and fusion strategy to the target relationships.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出经典-量子多视图融合框架：保留完整经典输入，同时加入模拟量子特征，用拼接与注意力融合，并用替换、掩码对照拆解两个视图各自的贡献。受控角-多项式实验显示，只有当目标依赖互补的角向与多项式关系时融合才提升预测，且匹配的经典表示能拿到同样的收益；在 Wine、Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer、三类 Fashion-MNIST、Steel Plates Faults 上平均预测性能优于经典基线，但 Digits 与 Covertype 上经典基线领先。
Motivation: 量子机器学习的预测增益常被笼统归因于量子性，缺少对增益来源的受控拆解：融合带来的提升究竟来自量子表示独有的互补预测关系，还是任何合适的经典表示都能复制。
Method: 经典-量子多视图框架保留完整经典输入并加入模拟量子特征，用拼接 (concatenation) 与注意力 (attention) 融合两个视图；以单视图对比、替换 (replacement) 与掩码 (masking) 对照评估各视图贡献；受控角-多项式 (angular-polynomial) 实验区分单视图即可表示的目标与依赖互补角向/多项式关系的目标，并做受控分类测试检验表示与目标的对齐及融合规则的作用。
Result: 受控角-多项式实验中，混合目标上融合提升预测，而匹配的经典表示恢复同样的收益；受控分类测试显示增益取决于表示与目标的对齐以及合适的融合规则。基准验证在 Wine、Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer、三类 Fashion-MNIST、Steel Plates Faults 的评估协议内平均预测性能优于经典基线；经典替换与掩码对照仍有竞争力，Digits 与 Covertype 上经典基线领先，缺失或损坏视图时结果取决于可用输入。
Conclusion: 量子表示的价值应按其互补预测贡献来评估，融合策略与表示要匹配目标的关系结构；增益并非量子特征独有，匹配的经典表示可以复制同样的提升。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Matoi: Selective Revalidation of Consequence Evidence for Agent Authorization
papers.abstract_en: Matoi separates reusable consequence evidence from current execution authority and durable occurrence history. Its finite query-aware contract covers branches, ordered collections and negative lookups. A consumer reuses only its own checked evidence whose observations remain valid; signed requests, live grants, quota and uncertain outcomes remain separate obligations. Conditional correctness arguments distinguish locally serialized claims from nontransactional remote effects. Two studies strengthen cost attribution and domain evaluation. A 1,440-cell matched-wire study repeats 144 authored inputs. With compact input bytes identical, reuse reduces complete lifecycle cost by 3.49 percent in JS and 1.79 percent in Python. Combined representation/reuse reductions against full proof are 10.87 and 16.53 percent; five of twelve family intervals for the matched comparison cross one in each language. A prospectively frozen AgentDojo Banking mapping covers 5/16 user plans and 7/9 attack plans. Both governed strategies preserve five exact benign transfers and refuse 35 reused attack-plan/policy crosses. Pre-satisfied utility predicates are reported separately from completed work. These are original scripted synthetic tools, not autonomous agents or a real bank. Earlier studies retain cheaper protected-cache alternatives, policy-compatible phishing, provider duplication and post-claim revocation. Separate JS/Python consumers establish finite-profile interoperability within the same project; durable recovery rechecks evidence and retains uncertain reservations. The results support a bounded, auditable reuse and execution contract, not a new general incremental algorithm, arbitrary-tool closure, atomic third-party commitment or production superiority.
papers.comment: 55 pages, 4 figures. Includes an 18-page technical manuscript and a 33-page detailed supplement as ancillary files. Research preprint; not peer reviewed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Matoi 针对 LLM agent 授权提出选择性后果证据复用机制：把可复用的后果证据与当前执行授权、持久发生历史分离，消费者只复用自身已检查且观测仍有效的证据。在 1,440 格 matched-wire 研究中，输入字节完全相同时，复用使 JS 完整生命周期成本降 3.49%、Python 降 1.79%，相对完整证明的表示/复用合计降幅为 10.87% 与 16.53%。
Motivation: agent 授权中重复执行相同后果检查带来不必要的生命周期成本，而现有缓存或证明复用方案缺少对证据有效性边界、非事务性远程副作用的严格约束。
Method: Matoi 定义有限的 query-aware 契约，覆盖分支、有序集合与负查找；区分局部串行化声明与非事务远程效应的条件正确性论证；用 1,440 格 matched-wire 研究（重复 144 个作者编写输入）与前瞻性冻结的 AgentDojo Banking 映射（5/16 用户计划、7/9 攻击计划）做成本归因与领域评估。
Result: 输入字节完全相同时，复用使完整生命周期成本在 JS 降 3.49%、Python 降 1.79%；相对完整证明的表示/复用合计降幅为 10.87%（JS）与 16.53%（Python），但 matched 对比中每种语言各有 5/12 个 family 区间跨过 1。AgentDojo Banking 中两种受控策略均保留 5 笔精确良性转账并拒绝 35 次复用的攻击计划/策略交叉。
Conclusion: 结果支持一个有界、可审计的证据复用与执行契约，而非通用增量算法、任意工具闭包、原子第三方承诺或生产环境优势；评估对象是原始脚本化合成工具，不是自主 agent 或真实银行。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Self-Guided LLM Reasoning for Error Diagnosis in Vehicle Routing Problems
papers.abstract_en: Vehicle Routing Problems (VRPs) are fundamental to many real-world applications. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have spurred progress in solving these NP-hard problems. However, most existing approaches assume that input instances are error-free, neglecting the presence of faults commonly encountered in real-world data. In this work, we systematically investigate the capability of LLMs to detect (and correct) errors in VRP instances, and identify key limitations, particularly in handling complex instances or errors that substantially increase the LLM's reasoning burden. To overcome these challenges, we propose a self-guided reasoning framework in which LLMs autonomously generate code that provides structured insights to aid in error diagnosis. Experiments across diverse problem settings and LLMs demonstrate that our framework significantly improves error detection performance, achieving near-perfect accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对车辆路径问题 (VRP) 实例中的数据错误，提出自我引导推理框架：让 LLM 自主生成代码，为错误诊断提供结构化线索。在多种问题设置与多个 LLM 上，该框架显著提升错误检测性能，达到接近完美的准确率。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 求解 NP-hard 的 VRP 时默认输入实例无错，而真实数据常含故障；复杂实例或会大幅加重 LLM 推理负担的错误尤其难以检出。
Method: 自我引导推理框架 (self-guided reasoning framework)：LLM 自主生成代码，把实例检查结果转成结构化线索，再据此诊断并纠正 VRP 实例中的错误；在多样问题设置与多个 LLM 上做实验。
Result: 在多样问题设置和多个 LLM 上，框架显著改善错误检测，达到接近完美的准确率 (near-perfect accuracy)；摘要同时指出复杂实例或高推理负担的错误是原有能力短板。
Conclusion: 让 LLM 生成代码来提供结构化线索，可把 VRP 实例错误检测从受限能力推到接近完美准确率，绕开复杂实例与重推理负担错误的瓶颈。

papers.title: Learning to Reason with Selective Internal Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from internal feedback can improve language models without ground-truth answers or external verifiers. However, confidence and correctness can diverge during training, and continued optimization of average self-certainty can increase confidence while degrading reasoning accuracy. We introduce SIF, a reinforcement learning method that combines comparative reward construction with selective policy updates. SIF compares ranked token-level self-certainty profiles across multiple windows and peers, assigning positive rewards only when both levels of voting provide sufficient support. Sample and group level filtering determines which responses contribute to policy optimization. Experiments on three backbones across 12 mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks show that SIF's final checkpoints achieve higher average accuracy than the best-validation checkpoints of Intuitor and Vigor, with a gain of 4.71 percentage points over Intuitor on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B. Further analyses show better retention of accuracy during continued optimization, while test-time training experiments demonstrate sustained improvements with as few as four rollouts per prompt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SIF 用比较式奖励加选择性策略更新做内部反馈强化学习：把 token 级 self-certainty 序列在多个窗口与同伴间排序比较，只有两级投票都充分支持才给正奖励，再按样本级与组级过滤决定哪些响应进入优化。在三个 backbone、12 个数学与科学推理基准上，SIF 最终 checkpoint 平均准确率高于 Intuitor 与 Vigor 的 best-validation checkpoint，Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 上较 Intuitor 高 4.71 个百分点。
Motivation: 内部反馈 RL 不依赖真值与外部验证器，但训练中置信度与正确性会脱钩：持续优化平均 self-certainty 会抬高置信度却拉低推理准确率。
Method: SIF 比较多个窗口与同伴间的排序 token 级 self-certainty profile，构造比较式奖励，仅当样本级与组级两级投票都给出充分支持时才赋正奖励；再用样本级与组级过滤筛选进入策略优化的响应。
Result: 在三个 backbone、12 个数学与科学推理基准上，SIF 最终 checkpoint 的平均准确率高于 Intuitor 与 Vigor 的 best-validation checkpoint，Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 上较 Intuitor 提升 4.71 个百分点；持续优化中准确率保持更好，test-time training 在每题仅 4 个 rollout 时仍有持续提升。
Conclusion: 以比较式奖励加选择性更新约束内部反馈优化，可以在继续训练时保住推理准确率，而不是只推高自我确信。

papers.title: PriorityFEC: Deadline-Aware Streaming FEC for KV-Cache Handoff in Edge Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly deployed at the edge to support complex tasks that require collaboration and information exchange among multiple agents. However, when task contexts are passed across agents, shared context that has already been processed by upstream agents often needs to be prefilled again, resulting in substantial redundant computation. Reusing an already prefilled key--value (KV) cache can avoid this recomputation, but requires the reusable KV state to be transferred across the network before the receiving agent can begin generation. Under strict time-to-first-token (TTFT) deadlines and unreliable edge links, delivering the complete KV cache may be infeasible, making it necessary to prioritize and protect the most valuable KV information within a limited transmission budget. This paper proposes PriorityFEC, a utility-aware KV-cache handoff scheme that jointly exploits model-side KV importance and transport-side reliability. PriorityFEC first constructs a utility-aware source stream by placing high-utility KV blocks at earlier transmission positions. It then protects the ordered stream using a feedback-adaptive Streaming Forward Erasure Correction (FEC) mechanism, which schedules repair packets according to receiver feedback before the TTFT deadline. We implement PriorityFEC on a distributed edge LLM serving prototype and evaluate it with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct across multiple datasets. Results show that PriorityFEC achieves superior task quality over the compared transport schemes, with its advantages becoming particularly pronounced under stringent deadline constraints. These results demonstrate the importance of jointly optimizing KV-cache utility and deadline-aware transport reliability when reusable LLM state must be handed off across unreliable edge networks.

papers.title: Calibration Language Shapes Block-Influence Pruning in Multilingual Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Block Influence (BI) ranks Transformer blocks for depth pruning from their input-output cosine change, but the ranking depends on the calibration distribution. We study whether English calibration transfers to Indian languages in Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-1B, and Gemma-2-2B. English, Hindi, Marathi, and Tamil use disjoint Wikipedia articles for calibration and evaluation; every selector receives the same 150-chunk budget, and Tamil is excluded from multilingual aggregation to test cross-script transfer. Across all three models, late-block BI is 20.7-55.5% higher for the three Indian languages than for English, and every predeclared late-minus-middle contrast has a 95% bootstrap interval above zero. This mismatch changes the low-BI blocks selected for removal despite high global rank correlations. Averaging BI over equal English, Hindi, and Marathi budgets mitigates the resulting perplexity damage for Qwen at six removed blocks and for Gemma at all tested depths, including held-out Tamil. The mitigation is not universal: on Llama, balancing improves Hindi and Marathi at two removed blocks but severely harms Tamil, while larger pruning budgets select the same blocks and collapse perplexity regardless of calibration. Rank-mean and minimax-rank aggregators do not dominate the raw mean. These results support a diagnostic claim rather than a universal pruning rule: English-only BI systematically misses late-layer activity for Indian-language text, but multilingual calibration must still be validated per architecture and pruning budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Block Influence (BI) 用输入输出余弦变化给 Transformer 块排序做深度剪枝，但排序依赖校准语料的语言。在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct、Llama-3.2-1B、Gemma-2-2B 上，英语校准对三种印度语言的 late-block BI 系统性偏低 20.7-55.5%，导致被剪掉的块选错；等预算混合英/印地/马拉地校准能缓解困惑度损伤，但效果依架构与剪枝预算而变，Llama 上甚至严重伤害留出的泰米尔语。
Motivation: 深度剪枝的块重要性排序由校准分布决定，而英语校准在多语言、跨文字场景下是否迁移没有检验；选错被剪块会直接损伤非英语语言的困惑度。
Method: 在 Qwen2.5-1B-Instruct、Llama-3.2-1B、Gemma-2-2B 上比较英语、印地语、马拉地语、泰米尔语校准的 BI 排序，校准与评测用不相交的 Wikipedia 条目，每个选择器统一 150-chunk 预算；泰米尔语被排除在多语言聚合之外以检验跨文字迁移，并预注册 late-minus-middle 对比与 95% bootstrap 区间，另比较 rank-mean 与 minimax-rank 聚合器。
Result: 三个模型上印度语言的 late-block BI 比英语高 20.7-55.5%，所有预注册的 late-minus-middle 对比的 95% bootstrap 区间均在零以上；等预算英/印地/马拉地平均在 Qwen 移除 6 块、Gemma 全部测试深度（含留出的泰米尔语）上减轻困惑度损伤；Llama 上平衡校准在移除 2 块时改善印地语与马拉地语却严重伤害泰米尔语，更大剪枝预算下无论校准语言都选到相同块并使困惑度崩溃；rank-mean 与 minimax-rank 不优于原始平均。
Conclusion: 英语-only BI 对印度语言文本系统性漏掉 late-layer 活动，这是可诊断的偏差而非普适剪枝规则；多语言校准必须按架构和剪枝预算逐一验证。

papers.title: RDL-Bench: A Benchmark for Task-Aware Question Answering over Relational Databases
papers.abstract_en: Relational databases (RDBs) remain the primary infrastructure for storing and managing structured data across enterprise and scientific domains. Natural-language (NL) interfaces to RDBs aim to let users ask questions without writing SQL, but real user needs go beyond SQL-style lookup: some questions require reasoning over the observable database state, while others require predictive inference from historical relational records under temporal constraints. Existing benchmarks address these goals in isolation. To address this gap, we introduce RDL-Bench, a benchmark for task-aware question answering (QA) over real RDBs. RDL-Bench organizes diverse user questions into reasoning-oriented questions, whose answers are determined by the current database state, and prediction-oriented questions, whose answers depend on future outcomes under temporal constraints. Each instance contains an NL question, task metadata, schema information, temporal context, either executable evidence or target-construction logic, and denotation-level ground truth. RDL-Bench supports two evaluation settings: native solvers under their intended capabilities, and task-aware modular systems where a router dispatches each question to an appropriate execution module.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by ICDE 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RDL-Bench 把关系数据库上的自然语言问答拆成两类任务：答案由当前库状态决定的 reasoning-oriented 问题，和答案取决于时序约束下未来结果的 prediction-oriented 问题，每条样本带 NL 问题、任务元数据、schema、时间上下文、可执行证据或目标构造逻辑以及 denotation 级真值。评测走两条路：原生求解器按各自能力作答，或任务感知模块化系统由 router 把每个问题分派到对应执行模块。
Motivation: 现有 NL-to-RDB 基准把「基于当前库状态推理」和「基于历史记录做时序预测」分开考察，无法覆盖真实用户在同一接口下混合出现的两类需求。
Method: 构建 RDL-Bench：将用户问题组织为 reasoning-oriented 与 prediction-oriented 两族，每实例含 NL 问题、任务元数据、schema 信息、时间上下文、可执行证据或目标构造逻辑与 denotation 级 ground truth；提供两种评测设置——按各自能力评测的 native solvers，以及由 router 分派问题到执行模块的任务感知模块化系统。
Result: 提出并发布 RDL-Bench 基准及其两条评测设置（native solvers 与任务感知模块化系统），实例粒度带 denotation 级真值与时间上下文；论文被 ICDE 2027 接收。
Conclusion: 任务感知的路由分派是关系库 NL 问答的合理评测框架：把推理型与预测型问题分开建模并显式携带时序上下文，才能同时覆盖当前状态推理与未来结果预测两类真实需求。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Perception or Reasoning? Diagnosing and Tackling Reinforcement Learning Bottlenecks in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has brought strong gains to language model reasoning, but its improvements on visual tasks remain less consistent. One difficulty is that visual task failures can arise from different sources: the same benchmark may be limited by perception for one model and by reasoning for another. We introduce Perception and Reasoning Attribution (PARA), which measures the remaining perceptual and reasoning headroom of each model--benchmark pair by comparing how many current errors are recovered with more accurate visual information versus a stronger reasoner. Across 4 vision-language models and 17 multimodal benchmarks, PARA broadly agrees with the expected characteristics of existing benchmarks while revealing substantial model-specific variation. More importantly, it shows that RL gains become smaller as perceptual headroom increases, but larger when reasoning explains more of the recoverable errors, suggesting that current RL exploits reasoning headroom more effectively than perceptual headroom. Motivated by this gap, we analyze how existing RL objectives affect visual perception and find that reward- and token-level signals influence visual attention only indirectly. We therefore propose GRAD, a group-relative attention distillation objective that uses the best rollout in each group to directly guide the visual attention of weaker rollouts. GRAD consistently improves performance across two model scales and seven benchmarks, and further complements existing RL methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PARA，用「换更强视觉信息能救回多少错误」与「换更强推理器能救回多少错误」分别度量每个模型-基准对的感知与推理剩余空间，发现 RL 增益随感知空间增大而变小、随推理可恢复错误占比增大而变大。据此提出 GRAD（group-relative attention distillation），用组内最优 rollout 直接引导弱 rollout 的视觉注意力，在两个模型规模、七个基准上一致提升并与现有 RL 方法互补。
Motivation: 视觉任务失败来源混杂：同一基准可能被感知卡住、也可能被推理卡住，导致 RL 在视觉任务上的收益不稳定且难以归因。
Method: PARA 通过比较「更准确视觉信息」与「更强推理器」各自能恢复多少当前错误，来度量每个模型-基准对的感知与推理 headroom；随后分析现有 RL 目标如何影响视觉感知，发现 reward 级与 token 级信号只能间接作用于视觉注意力，进而提出 GRAD：以组内最佳 rollout 作为监督，直接蒸馏弱 rollout 的视觉注意力。
Result: 在 4 个 vision-language 模型、17 个多模态基准上，PARA 结果与既有基准的预期特性大体一致，同时揭示显著的模型特异性差异；RL 增益随感知 headroom 增大而减小、随推理在可恢复错误中的占比增大而增大；GRAD 在 2 个模型规模、7 个基准上一致提升性能，并与现有 RL 方法互补。
Conclusion: 当前 RL 主要吃推理 headroom 而非感知 headroom，因此直接对视觉注意力做组相对蒸馏（GRAD）能补上这条间接路径，稳定带来多模态基准上的增益。

papers.title: Does Compression Imply Generalization? A Minimum Description Length Perspective
papers.abstract_en: A central question in modern learning theory is what notion of compression, if any, explains why over-parameterized neural networks generalize. Existing answers measure complexity at different levels, ranging from weights to representations; however, estimating the associated quantities either requires held-out data in principle or relies on the challenging (ultra) high-dimensional mutual information estimation. To overcome these challenges, we approach the question through the minimum description length (MDL) principle, and specifically, we propose the prequential regret as a complementary signal that is computable from the training trajectory alone. We establish that, in the (nearly) interpolating regime, the expected prequential regret upper-bounds the description length of the trained parameter under the algorithm-induced distribution, and that this description length translates into a high-probability generalization bound in the PAC-MDL setting. Along the way, we show that the encoder-complexity correction recently added to the algorithm-level information bottleneck (IB) is upper-bounded by an MDL parameter description length, \new{bringing together} the two views of compression from MDL and IB. Empirically, the prequential regret tracks the generalization error on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, with Pearson correlations exceeding 0.9.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用预quential regret (prequential regret) 作为压缩与泛化关系的可计算信号：它只依赖训练轨迹，无需留出数据，也不必做高维互信息估计。在（近）插值区间，期望预quential regret 上界训练参数在算法诱导分布下的描述长度，该描述长度再在 PAC-MDL 框架下给出高概率泛化界；CIFAR-10 与 CIFAR-100 上它与泛化误差的 Pearson 相关超过 0.9。
Motivation: 现有压缩式泛化解释复杂度度量层次不一（权重到表示），但估计这些量原则上要留出数据，或依赖困难的（超）高维互信息估计。
Method: 以 MDL 原则为框架，提出仅由训练轨迹计算的预quential regret；证明其在（近）插值区间上界算法诱导分布下训练参数的描述长度，并在 PAC-MDL 中转成高概率泛化界；同时证明算法级 information bottleneck (IB) 近期加入的 encoder-complexity correction 被 MDL 参数描述长度上界，从而打通 MDL 与 IB 两种压缩视角。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 与 CIFAR-100 上，预quential regret 与泛化误差的 Pearson 相关超过 0.9。
Conclusion: 压缩确实能解释泛化，但可用的压缩量是训练轨迹上可算的预quential regret，它同时上界参数描述长度并连接 MDL 与 IB 两种压缩观。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Memorilla: Latent Semantic Memory for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Memory enables large language models (LLMs) to use information beyond their parameters, such as past user conversations, long documents, or an agent's earlier actions. For a frozen LLM, access to this accumulated knowledge is limited to what a memory system places in its context window. However, gathering and combining relevant information needed for each query while keeping the model's context short remains challenging for existing systems. Here we introduce Memorilla, a memory system that gathers information from an entire document collection into a fixed number of query-dependent 'memory tokens' for a frozen LLM. Memorilla encodes documents (such as user chats, book chapters) once into reusable embeddings, then learns to retrieve and place query-specific information in the LLM's input embedding space. Using only 16 memory tokens, Memorilla achieves the best performance against baselines including Mem0 and MemoRAG on five of eight benchmarks spanning personalization, long-document and knowledge-intensive question answering. Notably, on FactKG, it reaches 84.33% accuracy versus 80.43% with full-context inference, while using 108x fewer tokens to represent the source documents. Furthermore, Memorilla can facilitate continual learning in agentic systems where the document count (the agent's past turns) increases throughout the trajectory. In a TextWorld environment, we show that Memorilla reduces the agent's tendency to wander between rooms it has already explored, and improves its average success rate from 18.6% with full-history in-context learning to 24.2%. Overall, Memorilla aids frozen LLMs in accumulating and using knowledge effectively across long-context interactions and takes a step towards building continually learning AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Memorilla 为冻结 LLM 把整个文档集合压缩成固定 16 个 query 相关的 memory token：文档一次性编码为可复用 embedding，再学习在 LLM 输入 embedding 空间中检索并放置查询相关信息。八个基准中五个取得最佳（对比 Mem0、MemoRAG），FactKG 达 84.33%（全上下文 80.43%）且 token 少 108 倍；TextWorld 中智能体平均成功率从 18.6% 升到 24.2%。
Motivation: 冻结 LLM 只能用到上下文窗口里的记忆，而逐查询收集并组合相关信息与压缩上下文难以兼得，长程交互与智能体轨迹中的知识积累因此受限。
Method: 先把文档（用户对话、书籍章节等）一次性编码为可复用 embedding，再学习在 LLM 输入 embedding 空间中检索并放置查询特定信息，输出固定 16 个 memory token 作为冻结 LLM 的输入；在智能体场景中把历史轮次作为不断增长的文档集合处理。
Result: 八个基准（覆盖个性化、长文档与知识密集问答）中五个上优于 Mem0、MemoRAG 等基线；FactKG 准确率 84.33%，高于全上下文推理的 80.43%，表示源文档所用 token 少 108 倍；TextWorld 中智能体平均成功率由全历史 in-context learning 的 18.6% 提升至 24.2%，且减少在已探索房间之间游荡的倾向。
Conclusion: 用少量 query 相关 memory token 替代全上下文，可以在冻结 LLM 上以更短上下文维持甚至超过全上下文的问答与智能体表现，是通向持续学习 AI 系统的一步。

papers.title: Same Target, Different Origins: Aligning Latent Rollout for Consistent PDE Emulation
papers.abstract_en: Neural PDE solvers commonly generate multi-step predictions through autoregressive rollout, recursively applying a learned evolution operator and feeding each prediction back as input for the next step. Approximation errors can therefore propagate through the rollout, causing predictions at a shared target time to depend on their temporal origins and rollout depths. For a well-posed deterministic PDE flow, however, states at different times along the same physical trajectory should, under exact evolution, reach the same target state. To this end, we propose Align Latent Rollout (ALR), a regularization approach that promotes consistency across rollout origins through the neural PDE solver's internal representations. A second-order Taylor analysis of latent discrepancy propagation motivates two objectives: zeroth-order latent state consistency, which aligns representations at a shared target time, and first-order latent dynamics consistency, which aligns local evolution responses to shared perturbations. ALR can be integrated into different neural PDE solvers by regularizing suitable internal representations, without modifying their backbone architectures. Experiments across multiple PDE benchmarks and neural-operator backbones show that ALR improves prediction accuracy while reducing shared-target discrepancies across rollout origins.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 神经 PDE 求解器自回归 rollout 中近似误差会累积，导致同一目标时刻的预测依赖于起报时刻与滚动深度。提出 Align Latent Rollout (ALR)：用二阶 Taylor 分析刻画隐空间偏差传播，构造零阶隐状态一致性与一阶隐动力学一致性两个正则项，对共享目标时刻的内部表征对齐，不改动骨干架构。在多个 PDE benchmark 与 neural-operator 骨干上，ALR 同时提高预测精度并缩小不同 rollout 起点之间的共享目标偏差。
Motivation: 自回归 rollout 把每步预测反馈为下一步输入，近似误差随之传播，使同一目标时刻的结果依赖于时间起点与滚动深度，破坏良定确定性 PDE 流本应满足的轨迹一致性。
Method: ALR 是加在神经 PDE 求解器内部表征上的正则化：二阶 Taylor 分析隐偏差传播后导出两个目标——零阶隐状态一致性（对齐共享目标时刻的表征）与一阶隐动力学一致性（对齐对共享扰动的局部演化响应），可套用到不同 neural-operator 骨干而不改架构。
Result: 在多个 PDE benchmark 与多种 neural-operator 骨干上的实验显示，ALR 提升预测精度，同时降低不同 rollout 起点在共享目标处的偏差。
Conclusion: 对齐隐空间 rollout 一致性可以在不改骨干的前提下同时改善精度与跨起点一致性，即共享目标偏差是可正则化消除的误差来源。

papers.title: ESG-Kor: A Korean Dataset for ESG-related Information Extraction and Practical Use Cases
papers.abstract_en: With the expansion of pre-trained language model usage in recent years, the importance of datasets for performing tasks in specialized domains has significantly increased. Therefore, we have built a Korean dataset called ESG-Kor to automatically extract Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) information, which has recently gained importance. ESG-Kor is a dataset consisting of a total of 118,946 sentences that extracted information on each ESG component from Korean companies' sustainability reports and manually labeled it according to objective rules provided by ESG evaluation agencies. To verify the effectiveness and applicability of the ESG-Kor dataset, classification performance was confirmed using several Korean pre-trained language models, and significant performance was obtained. Additionally, by extending the ESG classification model to documents of small and medium enterprises and extracting information based on ESG key issues and in-depth analysis, we demonstrated potential and practical use cases in the ESG field.
papers.journal_ref: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2024, pp. 6627-6643, 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建韩语 ESG 信息抽取数据集 ESG-Kor：从韩国企业可持续发展报告中抽取 118,946 个句子，按 ESG 评价机构给出的客观规则人工标注环境、社会、治理三类标签。用多个韩语预训练语言模型做分类验证取得显著性能，并把分类模型扩展到中小企业文档、按 ESG 关键议题抽取信息做深入分析，展示实际应用场景。
Motivation: 专业领域任务依赖高质量标注数据，而韩语 ESG 信息抽取缺少按评价机构客观规则构建的规模化数据集。
Method: 从韩国企业可持续发展报告抽取句子，依据 ESG 评价机构提供的客观规则进行人工标注，构成 ESG-Kor；用若干韩语预训练语言模型在其上做 ESG 分类，并将训练好的分类模型迁移到中小企业文档，按 ESG 关键议题抽取信息并做深入分析。
Result: 数据集共 118,946 个句子，覆盖 ESG 三个组成部分；多个韩语预训练语言模型上的分类性能被确认取得显著表现；模型扩展到中小企业文档后展示了 ESG 领域的潜在实际用例。
Conclusion: 按评价机构客观规则构建的韩语 ESG 标注数据可支撑 ESG 分类，并可迁移到中小企业文档做关键议题信息抽取。

papers.title: SATOR: Backpropagation-Free 3D Test-Time Adaptation via Sample-Adaptive Token Routing
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) mitigates the performance degradation of source-pretrained models on unlabeled test data under distribution shifts. Recent backpropagation-free token-purging methods address 3D point cloud distribution shifts by filtering unreliable tokens. However, their reliance on predefined purge-size candidates requires multiple forward passes per sample and increases inference cost. We propose SATOR (Sample-Adaptive TOken Routing), a source-free and backpropagation-free 3D TTA framework that eliminates this search by deriving both the partitioning threshold and routing decision directly from each sample. SATOR computes token abnormality scores from complementary attention and geometric relation graphs. It then derives a sample-specific partition into retained and pruned tokens via Otsu-based separability, without evaluating candidate sizes. Keep-ratio-calibrated routing then selects the pruned prediction only when its entropy, penalized by the keep ratio, is lower than that of the original prediction. Experiments on ModelNet40-C, ScanObjectNN-C, and ShapeNet-C demonstrate that SATOR achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on three 3D corruption benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SATOR 是免反向传播的 3D 测试时自适应 (TTA) 框架：用注意力图与几何关系图算 token 异常分，再用 Otsu 类可分性直接从单个样本导出保留/剪枝阈值，免去预设 purge-size 候选的多次前向。剪枝预测仅在经 keep-ratio 惩罚后熵更低时才被选用，在 ModelNet40-C、ScanObjectNN-C、ShapeNet-C 三个 3D 损坏基准上取得 SOTA 精度。
Motivation: 现有免反向传播的 token-purging 3D TTA 依赖预设剪枝尺寸候选，每个样本需多次前向，推断成本高；且阈值非样本自适应。
Method: SATOR 为 source-free、backpropagation-free 的 3D TTA：由注意力图与几何关系图计算互补的 token 异常分，用 Otsu 类可分性导出样本特定的保留/剪枝划分而不评估候选尺寸；keep-ratio-calibrated routing 仅当剪枝后预测的熵（经 keep ratio 惩罚）低于原预测时才选用剪枝结果。
Result: 在 ModelNet40-C、ScanObjectNN-C、ShapeNet-C 三个 3D 损坏基准上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，并消除逐样本多次前向的 purge-size 搜索。
Conclusion: 把剪枝阈值与路由决策都从单样本直接导出，可在免反向传播的 3D TTA 中同时省掉候选搜索的推断开销并保住甚至提升损坏基准精度。

papers.title: CoDeFont: One-Shot Font Generation via Multi-Scale Factor-Specific Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: One-shot Font Generation (OFG) aims to synthesize a target glyph by transferring the stylistic characteristics of a single reference glyph while preserving the structure of the target character. However, accurately capturing font style from a single reference image remains challenging due to the limited stylistic information available in a single glyph, and this challenge is further amplified for complex scripts. We propose CoDeFont, a script-agnostic OFG framework that addresses this challenge through multi-level style-content factorization and progressive style-content reconciliation. CoDeFont independently aggregates complementary style and structural information across multiple spatial levels to obtain factor-specific representations, while a contrastive objective explicitly encourages separation between style and content embeddings. During reconstruction, the disentangled representations are progressively injected through multi-level style conditioning, enabling stylistic information to be incorporated at different decoding resolutions while preserving the underlying glyph structure. We evaluate CoDeFont on structurally distinct Bengali and Latin scripts across seen and unseen font styles. Extensive quantitative and qualitative analyses demonstrate consistent improvements over existing state-of-the-art methods, highlighting the effectiveness of the proposed framework for OFG across diverse writing systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoDeFont 是一个脚本无关的单样本字体生成 (OFG) 框架，通过多层级风格-内容分解与渐进式风格-内容调和，独立聚合多空间尺度的风格与结构信息，并用对比目标显式分离风格与内容嵌入。在结构差异大的 Bengali 与 Latin 脚本、已见与未见字体风格上均一致优于现有 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 单张参考字形携带的风格信息有限，难以准确刻画字体风格，且在结构复杂的文字系统（如 Bengali）中这一困难被进一步放大。
Method: 多层级风格-内容分解：在多个空间层级独立聚合互补的风格与结构信息得到因子特定表示；对比目标显式拉开风格与内容嵌入的分离；重建时通过多层级风格条件 (multi-level style conditioning) 渐进注入解耦表示，在不同解码分辨率上注入风格同时保持字形结构。
Result: 在 Bengali 与 Latin 两类结构不同的脚本上，覆盖已见与未见字体风格进行定量与定性评估，一致优于现有 state-of-the-art OFG 方法。
Conclusion: 多层级因子特定表示学习加渐进式风格调和，可以在不同书写系统的单样本字体生成中一致提升风格迁移效果，且对复杂脚本同样适用。

summary_sections.motivation: 单张参考字形携带的风格信息有限，难以准确刻画字体风格，且在结构复杂的文字系统（如 Bengali）中这一困难被进一步放大。
summary_sections.method: 多层级风格-内容分解：在多个空间层级独立聚合互补的风格与结构信息得到因子特定表示；对比目标显式拉开风格与内容嵌入的分离；重建时通过多层级风格条件 (multi-level style conditioning) 渐进注入解耦表示，在不同解码分辨率上注入风格同时保持字形结构。
summary_sections.result: 在 Bengali 与 Latin 两类结构不同的脚本上，覆盖已见与未见字体风格进行定量与定性评估，一致优于现有 state-of-the-art OFG 方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多层级因子特定表示学习加渐进式风格调和，可以在不同书写系统的单样本字体生成中一致提升风格迁移效果，且对复杂脚本同样适用。

papers.title: Two Sample Sizes in Test-Time LLM Ensembling: Buffered ERM and Minimax Theory
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling can improve the performance of large language models by generating multiple answers to a question and aggregating them. Weighted ensembles extend this idea by drawing answers from several models, with the weights determining how often each model is used. Learning these weights from a training dataset involves two sample sizes: $Q$ labeled questions and $N$ generations per model and question. We study their interplay through the clean risk, the population error of the ensemble's infinite-generation voting rule. Under a margin condition with exponent $β$, we show that empirical risk minimization (ERM) with a calibrated margin buffer achieves excess risk of order $Q^{-1/2}+N^{-β/2}$, up to logarithmic factors, for fixed numbers of models and candidate answers. To investigate the optimality of this dependence on $Q$ and $N$, we analyze a simplified submodel with two models and two possible answers per question. We characterize its minimax excess risk up to constants by a Hellinger modulus for a binomial-mixture experiment. Polynomial approximation and spectral analysis reveal three regimes. When questions are relatively scarce, the $Q^{-1/2}$ term governs learning and the general buffered ERM is optimal. In an intermediate regime, pooling generation counts across questions improves upon estimating each answer distribution separately, with only logarithmic gains from additional questions. With sufficiently many questions, the minimax excess risk reaches an $N^{-β}$ identification floor that persists even with infinitely many questions. The submodel's lower bounds also apply to general ensembles, matching the buffered-ERM upper bound up to logarithmic factors when questions are scarce and in parts of the intermediate regime. Questions remain about the transitions between regimes and the construction of matching pooled estimators for general ensembles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究 LLM 测试时加权集成中两个样本量的权衡：Q 个标注问题与每模型每问题 N 次生成。在指数为 β 的 margin 条件下，带校准 margin buffer 的 ERM 达到超额风险 O(Q^{-1/2}+N^{-β/2})（忽略对数因子）；两模型两答案子模型的 minimax 分析给出三段机制：问题稀缺时 Q^{-1/2} 项主导且 buffered ERM 最优，中等区间跨问题合并生成计数更优，问题充足时风险触底于与 Q 无关的 N^{-β} 识别下限。
Motivation: 测试时集成的权重学习同时受标注问题数 Q 与每题生成数 N 约束，但两者如何互相替代、以及在什么条件下继续加问题不再有收益，此前缺少 minimax 层面的刻画。
Method: 以集成无限生成投票规则的 clean risk 为分析对象，在 margin 指数 β 条件下给出带校准 margin buffer 的 ERM 上界；再在两模型、每题两答案的简化子模型上，用二项混合实验的 Hellinger modulus 刻画 minimax 超额风险，并借助多项式逼近与谱分析分段。
Result: Buffered ERM 超额风险为 Q^{-1/2}+N^{-β/2}（至多差对数因子，模型数与候选答案数固定）；子模型 minimax 风险按三段划分：问题稀缺时 Q^{-1/2} 主导、buffered ERM 达最优，中等区间合并生成计数优于逐题估计、追加问题仅有对数增益，问题充足时达到 N^{-β} 识别下限；子模型下界对一般集成同样成立，在问题稀缺时与上界差对数因子匹配。
Conclusion: Q 与 N 的作用不可互换：问题多到一定程度后超额风险被 N^{-β} 的识别下限卡住，继续加标注问题无效；一般集成在问题稀缺及部分中等区间已接近 minimax，但区间过渡与匹配的 pooled 估计器构造仍是开放问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LTM: Latent Transition Based In-Context Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation often requires remembering interactions that are no longer visible. We introduce Latent Transition Memory (LTM), which stores history as compact latent transitions between consecutive observations. Instantiated on $π_{0.5}$ as LTM-$π$, our method uses a frozen latent action encoder, a lightweight adapter, and causal KV caching for incremental inference without memory-specific semantic annotations or external reasoning-model calls. With DreamDojo transitions, LTM-$π$ achieves 58.54% success on RoboMME and 80.5% on LIBERO-Mem, performing best among baselines without external reasoning models or memory-specific annotations. Ablations support the contribution of transition content beyond temporal cues and the efficiency of delayed memory admission. Scaling RoboMME demonstrations tenfold improves success from 57.67% to 87.50%, while a Cup Swap diagnostic highlights the role of process supervision in temporal composition. Under a 200-token memory budget, success remains 84.00%, versus 87.50% without compression. Finally, real-robot counting success improves from 11.25% to 82.50%. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness, scalability, and efficiency of latent transition memory, highlighting its capacity for complex temporal information, bounded-context operation, and real-world robotic control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Latent Transition Memory (LTM)，把机器人操作中不可见的历史交互压缩为相邻观测间的潜在转移 (latent transition)，在冻结的 latent action encoder 上加轻量 adapter 并用因果 KV cache 做增量推理。在 RoboMME 上成功率 58.54%、LIBERO-Mem 上 80.5%，为不依赖外部推理模型或记忆标注的基线中最好；200 token 记忆预算下仍达 84.00%（无压缩 87.50%），实机计数任务从 11.25% 提到 82.50%。
Motivation: 机器人操作需要记住已经看不见的交互历史，而现有做法往往依赖记忆相关的语义标注或调用外部推理模型，成本高且难以在有界上下文中运行。
Method: LTM 以相邻观测间的紧凑潜在转移存储历史，实例化为 LTM-π（基于 π0.5）：冻结的 latent action encoder + 轻量 adapter + 因果 KV caching 支持增量推理，训练使用 DreamDojo transitions，并引入延迟记忆准入 (delayed memory admission) 与过程监督。
Result: RoboMME 58.54%、LIBERO-Mem 80.5%，在无外部推理模型与无记忆标注的基线中最佳；RoboMemo 演示扩大十倍使成功率从 57.67% 升到 87.50%；200 token 记忆预算下 84.00%（无压缩 87.50%）；实机计数任务成功率从 11.25% 升到 82.50%；消融支持转移内容超出时间线索的贡献、延迟记忆准入的效率，Cup Swap 诊断凸显过程监督对时序组合的作用。
Conclusion: 潜在转移记忆在有界上下文内即可承载复杂时序信息并支撑实机控制，且随演示规模扩大而提升，无需外部推理模型或记忆专用标注。
Relevance: 2
