papers.title: Controlling the False Discovery Rate via Model-Agnostic Importance Measures
papers.abstract_en: Selecting covariates while controlling the false discovery rate (FDR) is critical for interpretable scientific discovery, especially with complex machine learning models. Traditional variable selection methods often rely on specific model assumptions, while Model-X knockoffs provide a general way that leverages knowledge of the covariate distribution to produce a variable selection algorithm. This study puts forward a complementary method to Model-X knockoffs, named Model-Agnostic Selection with agent-X importance (MAS), which utilizes the sample-splitting strategy and a novel variable importance measure to bypass distributional assumptions on covariates. The proposed model-agnostic agent-X importance is defined to evaluate the difference of oracle predictiveness on both the original distribution and the distribution with agent variable in population level, and can be efficiently estimated by constructing the agent variable as some constant and cross-fitting strategy. The MAS method integrates a resplit-per-covariate strategy to decouple estimator dependencies and a data aggregation technique to enhance power. Theoretical guarantees for asymptotic FDR control are established under mild conditions. Extensive simulations and real-data analyses demonstrate that MAS provides competitive performances with existing works in FDR control, computational efficiency and power.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出与 Model-X knockoffs 互补的模型无关变量选择方法 MAS：用样本拆分加 agent-X importance 这一新重要性度量，绕开对协变量分布的假设，并在温和条件下建立渐近 FDR 控制的理论保证。模拟与真实数据分析显示 MAS 在 FDR 控制、计算效率和检验功效上与现有方法相当。
Motivation: 在复杂机器学习模型下做协变量选择并控制错误发现率 (FDR) 时，传统方法依赖特定模型假设，Model-X knockoffs 又需要知道协变量分布，两者都限制了可解释科学发现的适用性。
Method: MAS 采用样本拆分策略，定义 agent-X importance 来评估原始分布与替换为 agent 变量的分布上 oracle 预测能力之差（总体层面），通过把 agent 变量取为常数并配合 cross-fitting 高效估计；再用 resplit-per-covariate 策略解耦各协变量估计量之间的依赖，并用数据聚合 (data aggregation) 技术提升功效。
Result: 在温和条件下建立了渐近 FDR 控制的理论保证；大量模拟与真实数据分析表明 MAS 在 FDR 控制、计算效率和功效上与现有工作表现相当。
Conclusion: 不依赖协变量分布假设也能通过 agent-X importance 与重拆分聚合实现有竞争力的 FDR 控制，可作为 Model-X knockoffs 的互补方案。

papers.title: L2GSSL: Label-Efficient Local-to-Global Self-Supervised Learning for Volumetric Healthcare Data
papers.abstract_en: Healthcare institutions routinely accumulate high-dimensional computed tomography (CT) volumes, but only a fraction can be annotated by experts. We present L2GSSL, a local-to-global self-supervised learning framework that leverages unlabeled volumes by decomposing pretraining into intra-slice and inter-slice representation spaces. A slice encoder learns view-invariant local features, and a global encoder aggregates the resulting tokens to model volumetric context. The stop-gradient isolates the local space from the global objective, while slice-wise execution and a three-phase schedule support training under constrained GPU memory. On LIDC-IDRI lung nodule malignancy classification, L2GSSL reaches $0.9229$ AUROC with only $10\%$ of the labels and $0.9377$ with $25\%$, exceeding the volume-level VICReg by $0.0229$ and $0.0294$, respectively. With all labels, the strongest supervised baseline exceeds L2GSSL by only $0.0044$ AUROC, consistent with self-supervised pretraining providing its greatest value when annotations are limited. Without adaptation to the external LNDb cohort, a model fine-tuned on $25\%$ of LIDC-IDRI obtains $0.8138$ AUROC and $0.7589$ AUPRC, improving over the strongest evaluated self-supervised baseline by $0.1130$ and $0.0954$. Experiments across data sources, thoracic and abdominal anatomy, downstream tasks, and two backbones examine healthcare-data variety, while lesion-slice masking shows that the predictions depend on lesion-bearing content.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Under review at IEEE BigData 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: L2GSSL 把 CT 体数据的自监督预训练拆成 slice 内与 slice 间两个表征空间：slice 编码器学视角不变的局部特征，global 编码器聚合 token 建模体数据上下文，stop-gradient 隔离局部空间。在 LIDC-IDRI 肺结节恶性分类上，仅用 10% 标签达 0.9229 AUROC、25% 达 0.9377，分别超 volume-level VICReg 0.0229 与 0.0294；标签充足时监督基线仅领先 0.0044，说明该方法的价值集中在标注稀缺场景。
Motivation: 医疗机构积累了大量高维 CT 体数据，但只有少部分能被专家标注；现有自监督方法在标注受限时性能下降明显，且体数据的 slice 间上下文难以在有限 GPU 显存下建模。
Method: L2GSSL 将预训练分解为 intra-slice 与 inter-slice 两个表征空间：slice 编码器学习视角不变的局部特征，global 编码器聚合 token 建模体数据上下文；stop-gradient 阻断全局目标对局部空间的梯度，slice-wise 执行与三阶段训练调度支持受限显存下的训练。
Result: LIDC-IDRI 肺结节恶性分类：10% 标签 0.9229 AUROC、25% 标签 0.9377 AUROC，分别超 volume-level VICReg 0.0229 与 0.0294；全量标签时最强监督基线仅超 L2GSSL 0.0044 AUROC。未适配外部 LNDb 队列时，用 25% LIDC-IDRI 微调得 0.8138 AUROC 与 0.7589 AUPRC，超最强自监督基线 0.1130 与 0.0954。实验覆盖多数据源、胸腹部解剖、多下游任务与两种 backbone，lesion-slice masking 显示预测依赖含病灶的 slice 内容。
Conclusion: 自监督预训练的最大收益出现在标注受限时，标注充足时监督基线基本追平；局部-全局分解加 stop-gradient 可在有限显存下利用未标注 CT 体数据。

papers.title: Honesty is the Best Policy ... or is it? Demand Management for Probabilistic Service Options
papers.abstract_en: To enable well-informed customer choices and redistribute demand across service options, providers can display probabilities regarding predicted service levels at the time of booking, effectively offering probabilistic service options. In many service settings, the underlying truthful probabilities endogenously depend on the system state, rather than being static product attributes controlled by the provider. While customers rely on this information when making decisions, they cannot readily verify its accuracy. Consequently, providers may be tempted to manipulate the displayed probabilities to guide customers' choices in their favor, creating a novel lever for demand management. In this work, we model the resulting problem as a sequential decision process, define truthful probabilities recursively, and introduce transparency constraints that limit their distortion. Because the exact computation of truthful probabilities is intractable for realistic settings, we develop an adapted reinforcement learning algorithm to approximate them. Furthermore, we propose a sampling-based mixed-integer program to optimize the information communicated by the provider in each state. Our framework enables providers to gauge the benefits of dynamically disclosing probabilistic information at the time of booking and sheds light on incentives for manipulation. Our computational study is motivated by out-of-home delivery, i.e., the delivery to parcel lockers or shops, and reveals a trade-off between individual-level transparency and aggregate customer utilities.

TL;DR: 把服务商在预订时展示的服务水平概率建模为序贯决策问题，用自适应强化学习近似不可精确计算的「真实概率」，再用基于采样的混合整数规划优化每个状态下对外披露的信息。在以 out-of-home delivery（快递柜/门店自提）为背景的计算研究中，发现个体层面的透明度与总体客户效用之间存在权衡。
Motivation: 服务商展示的服务水平概率取决于系统内生状态而非静态商品属性，客户无法验证其准确性，服务商因而有操纵概率来引导选择的新杠杆；而真实概率的精确计算在现实规模下不可行。
Method: 将问题建模为序贯决策过程，递归定义真实概率并引入限制其扭曲的透明度约束 (transparency constraints)；因精确计算不可行，开发改进的强化学习算法近似真实概率，并提出基于采样的混合整数规划 (sampling-based mixed-integer program) 优化每个状态下披露的信息。
Result: 以 out-of-home delivery（投递至快递柜或门店）为背景的计算研究显示：个体层面的透明度与总体客户效用之间存在权衡。
Conclusion: 该框架可让服务商量化动态披露概率信息的收益，并揭示操纵概率的激励来源；透明度并非无代价，个体透明与总体效用相互冲突。

papers.title: Hierarchical Graph Convolutional Network Approach for Detecting Low-Quality Documents
papers.abstract_en: Consistency within a document is a crucial feature indicative of its quality. Recently, within the vast amount of information produced across various media, there exists a significant number of low-quality documents that either lack internal consistency or contain content utterly unrelated to their headlines. Such low-quality documents induce fatigue in readers and undermine the credibility of the media source that provided them. Consequently, research to automatically detect these low-quality documents based on natural language processing is imperative. In this study, we introduce a hierarchical graph convolutional network (HGCN) that can detect internal inconsistencies within a document and incongruences between the title and body. Moreover, we constructed the Inconsistency Dataset, leveraging published news data and its meta-data, to train our model to detect document inconsistencies. Experimental results demonstrated that the HGCN achieved superior performance with an accuracy of 91.20% on our constructedInconsistency Dataset, outperforming other comparative models. Additionally, on the publicly available incongruent-related dataset, the proposed methodology demonstrated a performance of 92.00%, validating its general applicability. Finally, an ablation study further confirmed the significant impact of meta-data utilization on performance enhancement. We anticipate that our model can be universally applied to detect and filter low-quality documents in the real world.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of LREC-COLING 2024, pp. 8108-8121, 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出层次图卷积网络 HGCN，用文档内部一致性与标题-正文不一致两类关系建图检测低质量新闻文档，并构建了基于新闻及其元数据的 Inconsistency Dataset。在自建数据集上准确率达 91.20%，在公开的 incongruent 相关数据集上达 92.00%，均优于对比模型，消融显示元数据对性能提升作用显著。
Motivation: 媒体中大量低质量文档内部不自洽或标题与正文内容完全无关，导致读者疲劳并损害媒体可信度，需要基于 NLP 的自动检测手段。
Method: 构建层次图卷积网络 (HGCN)，同时建模文档内部不一致与标题-正文不一致；利用已发布新闻及其元数据构建 Inconsistency Dataset 用于训练，并做消融检验元数据贡献。
Result: 在自建 Inconsistency Dataset 上准确率 91.20%，优于其他对比模型；在公开的 incongruent 相关数据集上达 92.00%；消融研究确认元数据利用对性能提升有显著影响。
Conclusion: 层次图结构加元数据能有效捕捉文档内部与标题-正文层面的不一致，模型可推广用于真实场景中低质量文档的检测与过滤。

papers.title: FedSkillGit: Federated Skill Evolution via Version Control
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents can improve their capabilities by evolving reusable natural-language skills from execution experience. In real-world deployments, this experience is distributed across data owners who cannot pool their raw data, which motivates federated skill evolution. The natural first design lets each client evolve the whole skill document and upload the result for server-side aggregation. That design is poorly matched to skill evolution for three reasons. An evolved document can still carry client-specific content distilled from private traces, repeated transmission of a nearly unchanged document spends communication on knowledge that the population already holds and the contribution of a single client is buried in a document that the server cannot meaningfully attribute. We propose FedSkillGit, a federated skill evolution framework that replaces full-document updates with commits. Each participating client submits a bounded set of patches over named rules together with its local experience, which summarizes what the round taught it, and the pair passes a two-stage privacy filter before it leaves the client. The server deduplicates the submitted patches and the local experience of all participants, updates a global experience document that only the optimizers read, and merges the surviving patches into a candidate skill. The candidate is distributed to the clients, which score it on their own validation sets and report the results, and it is published only when the reported scores improve on the current version. Experiments on three datasets and three language model families show that FedSkillGit outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by up to 22% and approaches centralized evolution without sharing raw client data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedSkillGit 把联邦技能演化从整份技能文档上传改为提交具名规则上的补丁 (commit) 加本地经验摘要，经两阶段隐私过滤后由服务器去重、合并候选技能，仅在客户端验证分数提升时才发布新版本。在三个数据集、三类语言模型家族上超越 SOTA 基线最多 22%，逼近集中式演化水平。
Motivation: LLM agent 从执行经验中演化可复用技能，但经验分散在无法汇集原始数据的数据方；直接让各客户端演化整份文档并上传会携带客户端私有痕迹、重复传输近似不变内容，且服务器无法归因单个客户端的贡献。
Method: 客户端只提交有界补丁集（针对具名规则）与本地经验摘要，二者先过两阶段隐私过滤；服务器对补丁与经验去重，更新仅优化器读取的全局经验文档，把存活补丁合并为候选技能；候选下发后各客户端在本地验证集打分并回报，分数优于当前版本才发布。
Result: 在三个数据集和三类语言模型家族上的实验中，FedSkillGit 超越 SOTA 基线最多 22%，并在不共享客户端原始数据的前提下逼近集中式演化的表现。
Conclusion: 以补丁级提交加版本控制取代整文档聚合，可以在保护客户端原始经验的同时把联邦技能演化推到接近集中式的效果。

papers.title: ARGUS: An Agenda-Driven Framework for Reliable User Simulation
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity user simulators are essential for evaluating and training agents in interactive environments. However, current LLM-based simulators struggle with reliability issues, such as goal omission and policy non-compliance. We propose ARGUS (Agenda-dRiven Goal-oriented User Simulator), a neuro-symbolic framework that maintains the user's goal state using a dynamic agenda stack manipulated via symbolic operations. By rigorously decoupling state tracking from natural language generation, ARGUS facilitates strict goal progression and constraint-aligned interactions. For cost-efficient deployment, we distill ARGUS into compact models using a unified pipeline: evaluator-guided SFT followed by online RL with dense step-level rewards. To rigorously evaluate behavioral fidelity, we introduce a rubric-based metric Composite Behavioral Score (CBS). Evaluations on $τ^3$-Bench and MultiWOZ demonstrate the significant superiority of the ARGUS architecture and the efficacy of our training pipeline. Code and data will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARGUS 用符号化的动态 agenda 栈维护用户目标状态，把状态跟踪与自然语言生成严格解耦，以解决 LLM 用户模拟器的目标遗漏与策略不合规问题；再通过 evaluator-guided SFT 加在线 RL 蒸馏到小模型。在 τ³-Bench 与 MultiWOZ 上，其架构与训练流程均表现出显著优势。
Motivation: LLM 用户模拟器在交互环境中存在可靠性问题，主要是目标遗漏 (goal omission) 与策略不合规 (policy non-compliance)，难以支撑智能体的评估与训练。
Method: ARGUS (Agenda-dRiven Goal-oriented User Simulator) 是神经符号框架：用动态 agenda 栈加符号操作维护用户目标状态，严格分离状态跟踪与自然语言生成；再用统一管线蒸馏到紧凑模型，即 evaluator-guided SFT 后接带稠密步级奖励的在线 RL；并提出基于 rubric 的 Composite Behavioral Score (CBS) 度量行为保真度。
Result: 在 τ³-Bench 与 MultiWOZ 上评估，ARGUS 架构与训练流程均展现出显著优势；提出新的行为保真度指标 CBS。
Conclusion: 符号化的 agenda 状态机加解耦生成能显著提升用户模拟器的目标推进与约束对齐可靠性，且该架构可经 SFT+RL 蒸馏到小模型以降低成本。

papers.title: Quantum Versus Classical Machine Learning for Neuropsychiatric Disorders: A Feature-Matched Multi-Cohort Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Resting-state functional connectivity is widely used in machine learning-based classification of neuropsychiatric disorders. Quantum machine learning models have been proposed for functional connectivity data, but few studies have evaluated them under leave-site-out validation or against matched classical models. We compared six quantum model families with classical ones using identical correlation-derived features across four public cohorts (4,308 subjects). Leave-site-out validation was used for the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE I), ADHD-200 (attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder), and REST-meta-MDD (major depressive disorder) cohorts, while the UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (UCLA-CNP) was evaluated using stratified 10-fold cross-validation. The quantum kernel was statistically indistinguishable from a matched classical kernel across all four cohorts, with the average accuracy difference within 1.4 percentage points at 95% confidence. On ABIDE I, a hybrid quantum convolutional network achieved similar accuracy to its classical counterpart (0.645 vs. 0.641), while a trainable quantum kernel exceeded its classical counterpart by 0.064 in area under the curve (AUC). Quantum convolutional networks also achieved higher AUC than their matched classical networks on this cohort and showed smaller train-test gaps on all four cohorts, without an accuracy gain. Overall, most quantum models matched their classical counterparts, but none consistently outperformed them. This study, among the first quantum evaluations of ABIDE I under leave-site-out validation, provides a feature-matched benchmark of quantum and classical models comprising 284 matched comparisons. We further analyse fidelity-based graph construction and account for the observed quantum-classical parity through effective-dimension and eigenspectrum analyses.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to IEEE. Code and per-fold results: https://github.com/r11up/qml-fmri-baseline
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在四个公开静息态功能连接队列（共 4,308 名被试）上做特征匹配的量子与经典模型对比，量子核与匹配经典核在全部四个队列上统计不可区分，平均准确率差在 95% 置信下不超过 1.4 个百分点。ABIDE I 上混合量子卷积网络准确率 0.645 对经典 0.641，可训练量子核 AUC 高出经典 0.064；量子卷积网络在四个队列上训练-测试差距更小但无准确率提升。结论是多数量子模型只是追平经典对应物，没有一个持续胜出。
Motivation: 量子机器学习模型已被用于功能连接数据分类，但很少在 leave-site-out 验证下、或与特征严格匹配的经典模型对比，因此量子优势的说法缺少可比基准。
Method: 用完全相同的基于相关系数的特征，比较六个量子模型族与匹配的经典模型；ABIDE I、ADHD-200、REST-meta-MDD 用 leave-site-out 验证，UCLA-CNP 用分层 10 折交叉验证；共 284 组匹配对比，并用 effective dimension 与 eigenspectrum 分析解释量子-经典持平现象，另分析 fidelity-based graph 构造。
Result: 四个队列 4,308 名被试；量子核与匹配经典核在全部四队列统计不可区分，平均准确率差在 95% 置信下落在 1.4 个百分点内。ABIDE I 上混合量子卷积网络准确率 0.645 对经典 0.641；可训练量子核 AUC 高出经典 0.064；量子卷积网络在 ABIDE I 上 AUC 高于匹配经典网络，且在全部四队列训练-测试差距更小，但准确率无提升。基准含 284 组匹配对比。
Conclusion: 多数量子模型与经典对应物持平，没有一个持续胜出；量子-经典持平可由 effective dimension 与 eigenspectrum 分析解释，量子卷积网络的收益体现在更小的泛化差距而非准确率。

papers.title: Online Quantile Omniprediction for Proper Losses
papers.abstract_en: The task of constructing a predictor that is simultaneously accurate under multiple evaluation metrics has been popularized recently under the name omniprediction. Prior work in this area has largely focused on binary prediction tasks, and existing results for multiclass and continuous outcomes typically suffer from slow error rates. In this paper, we consider forecasts expressed as a set of quantiles over a discrete but otherwise arbitrary set of probability levels. We develop sample-efficient algorithms for constructing forecasts that are accurate simultaneously across all proper losses that satisfy mild regularity conditions, where proper losses are those minimized by predicting the true quantiles. Our algorithms are online and can operate in a dynamic environment, while simultaneously taking multiple losses into account, and their forecasts offer the potential to provide diverse end-users with rich information for evaluating risk and informing a range of practical decision-making tasks. As an example, we demonstrate how our procedure can be used to ensemble quantile forecasts of COVID-19 hospitalizations made by experts during the pandemic.

papers.title: Dimension-Free PAC-Bayes Generalization for Deep Neural Networks via Dirichlet Processes
papers.abstract_en: Classical PAC-Bayesian generalization theory places prior distributions over Euclidean parameter space $Θ\subseteq \mathbb{R}^D$, causing relative entropy to scale with network dimension $D$. For modern overparameterized neural networks where $D \gg n$, this parameter-counting dependency yields vacuous generalization bounds ($> 1{,}000\%$). In this work, we resolve this barrier by shifting prior specification from internal parameters to the non-parametric space of data distributions $\mathcal{M}_1(\mathcal{Z})$ via a \textbf{Dirichlet Process (DP)}, $\mathcal{DP}(α, F_0)$, inducing parameter distributions through push-forward measures under the learning algorithm. By the Data Processing Inequality, parameter-space relative entropy is strictly bounded by the data-space DP divergence, which we evaluate in exact closed form using Digamma functions. The resulting PAC-Bayesian certificate is strictly invariant to network parameter count $D$, width, and depth. On intrinsic $d^*$-dimensional submanifolds, optimal partition scaling achieves the minimax non-parametric rate $\mathcal{O}(n^{-1/(d^*+2)} \sqrt{\ln n})$. Across vision architectures scaling up to 4.2 million parameters ($D = 7{,}850$ to $D = 4{,}203{,}522$) on the full MNIST benchmark, while classical weight-space bounds scale past $940\%$ (becoming vacuous), our data-space DP-PAC-Bayes certificate remains stable, non-vacuous, and certified at \textbf{$8.8\%$--$9.4\%$}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 PAC-Bayes 先验从欧氏参数空间移到数据分布空间，用 Dirichlet Process 通过学习算法的 push-forward 诱导参数分布，得到与参数量 D、宽度、深度无关的泛化证书。在 MNIST 上跨 D=7,850 到 4,203,522 的视觉架构，经典权重空间界超过 940%（vacuous），而数据空间 DP-PAC-Bayes 证书稳定在 8.8%–9.4%。
Motivation: 经典 PAC-Bayes 界的相对熵随网络维度 D 增长，对 D≫n 的过参数化网络给出 vacuous（>1000%）的泛化界。
Method: 先验设为数据分布空间 M_1(Z) 上的 DP(α, F_0)，经学习算法的 push-forward 诱导参数分布；由 Data Processing Inequality 把参数空间相对熵上界为数据空间 DP 散度，后者用 Digamma 函数闭式计算；在内蕴 d* 维子流形上用最优划分缩放得到 minimax 非参数速率。
Result: 证书对 D、宽度、深度严格不变；内蕴 d* 维子流形上达到 minimax 非参数速率 O(n^{-1/(d*+2)} sqrt(ln n))；在完整 MNIST 上跨至 420 万参数（D=7,850 到 4,203,522）的视觉架构，经典权重空间界超过 940%（vacuous），数据空间 DP-PAC-Bayes 证书保持 8.8%–9.4%。

papers.title: Does On-Policy Distillation Need to Complete Every Rollout?
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) effectively transfers capabilities from a teacher to a student through feedback on student-generated rollouts. However, generating complete student rollouts and computing teacher feedback for every token make OPD computationally expensive. We introduce Stochastic Truncated On-Policy Distillation (STOPD), which accelerates OPD by randomly truncating student rollouts and correcting the resulting sampling bias with blockwise inverse-probability weighting (IPW). At each training step, we sample a stopping position for each rollout before generation and let the student generate until that position or natural termination. We obtain teacher feedback on every generated token and use blockwise IPW to compensate for the lower probability of retaining later tokens while controlling the weights. We prove that this weighting preserves Vanilla OPD's gradient sum in expectation and derive one-step update-error bounds for SGD, Adam, and Muon. We evaluate STOPD across multiple teacher-student model pairs, task domains, and optimizers. STOPD reduces generated tokens by 25-48% while maintaining accuracy comparable to Vanilla OPD, achieving 1.3-2.2x training speedups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STOPD（Stochastic Truncated On-Policy Distillation）在生成前为每条 rollout 随机采样截断位置，让学生只生成到该位置或自然终止，再用分块逆概率加权 (blockwise IPW) 校正后段 token 被丢弃的采样偏差。证明该加权在期望上保持 Vanilla OPD 的梯度和，并给出 SGD、Adam、Muon 的一步更新误差界；在多组师生模型、任务域与优化器上生成 token 减少 25–48%，精度与 Vanilla OPD 相当，训练加速 1.3–2.2 倍。
Motivation: On-policy distillation 需要为每条学生 rollout 生成完整序列并逐 token 计算教师反馈，计算成本高，限制了其在大规模训练中的可用性。
Method: 每个训练步在生成前为每条 rollout 采样一个停止位置，学生生成至该位置或自然终止；对所有已生成 token 取教师反馈，并用分块逆概率加权 (blockwise IPW) 补偿后段 token 保留概率降低，同时控制权重。理论上证明该加权期望上保持 Vanilla OPD 的梯度和，并推导 SGD、Adam、Muon 的一步更新误差界。
Result: 在多个师生模型对、任务域与优化器上评估：生成 token 减少 25–48%，精度与 Vanilla OPD 相当，训练加速 1.3–2.2 倍。
Conclusion: 随机截断加 IPW 校正可以在不损失精度的前提下显著降低 on-policy distillation 的生成与反馈开销，且该做法有期望梯度保持与更新误差界的理论支撑。

papers.title: Ranking and Partitioning of Attention Heads for Sparse and Continual Reinforcement Learning Fine-tuning
papers.abstract_en: We study sparse and continual reinforcement learning fine-tuning of language models through attention-head ranking and partitioning. For sparse learning, we rank attention heads by gradient norm to identify a small subset of heads that can be trained effectively. For continual learning, we partition heads across tasks to reduce cross-task interference and preserve previously learned capabilities. Theoretically, we relate gradient norm to training effectiveness, and further characterize why sparse, separated head updates can remain stable. Empirically, across math, instruction-following, and coding tasks, tuning higher-ranked heads consistently outperforms tuning lower-ranked ones while often matching denser baselines, and head partitioning improves retention while preserving adaptation to new tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLM 的强化学习微调中按梯度范数 (gradient norm) 给 attention head 排序，只训练排名靠前的一小撮 head 做稀疏学习；持续学习时把 head 按任务划分以减少跨任务干扰。数学、指令跟随、编码三类任务上，调高排名 head 一致优于调低排名 head，且常能匹配更稠密的基线；head 划分在保住新任务适应的同时提升旧能力保留。
Motivation: 对语言模型做 RL 微调时全参数更新代价高，且多任务持续训练会互相干扰、冲掉已学到的能力；需要判断哪些参数值得更新、如何在任务间分配参数。
Method: 稀疏学习侧用梯度范数对 attention head 排序，选出小子集训练；持续学习侧把 head 按任务划分 (partitioning)。理论上把梯度范数与训练有效性挂钩，并刻画稀疏、分离的 head 更新为何能保持稳定。
Result: 在数学、指令跟随 (instruction-following) 和编码 (coding) 任务上，微调高排名 head 一致优于微调低排名 head，且常与更稠密的基线持平；head 划分提升了对旧能力的保留，同时保持对新任务的适应。
Conclusion: 梯度范数排序可作为 RL 微调中挑参数的准则：稀疏、按任务分离的 head 更新既能省参数又能稳住训练，head 划分是缓解持续学习干扰的可行手段。

papers.title: When Should a Low-Light Pipeline Generate? Auditable Risk Control for Selective Generative Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Generative low-light enhancers recover plausible texture but may hallucinate structure; restoration networks preserve structure but can leave regions under-enhanced, and neither advantage is spatially uniform. Therefore, we formulate selective generative enhancement as a decision problem: determine where overriding a frozen base expert is beneficial and refuse to switch when the evidence is insufficient. We propose VetoNet, an auditable regional routing framework centered on a certified veto. It first measures the complementary strengths and routing direction of a frozen restoration generative pair, then predicts the utility of regional overrides from deployment-available signals alone and admits an override only when a distribution-free harm-budget certificate says the perceptual (LPIPS) risk budget allows it. Experiments across multiple expert pairs and domains show that VetoNet adapts its routing behavior to the strength and reliability of the available evidence. When expert complementarity is sufficiently predictable, it achieves statistically significant certified gains; when the relative strengths of the experts change, it correspondingly reverses the routing direction; and when routing evidence is weak or affected by cross-domain shift, it conservatively vetoes switching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VetoNet 把低光增强里的「何时该用生成模型」形式化为带认证否决 (certified veto) 的区域路由决策：只用部署可得信号预测区域覆盖的效用，且仅当无分布假设的危害预算证书 (harm-budget certificate) 判定 LPIPS 风险预算允许时才覆盖冻结的基专家。当专家互补性可预测时取得统计显著的认证增益；专家相对强弱变化时路由方向随之反转；证据弱或受跨域偏移影响时保守否决切换。
Motivation: 生成式低光增强会幻觉结构，纯复原网络又留有欠增强区域，且两者优势在空间上不均匀，缺少一个可审计的判据来决定何处该切换专家。
Method: VetoNet 先度量冻结的 restoration–generative 专家对的互补强度与路由方向，再仅用部署可得信号预测区域覆盖的效用，最后由无分布 (distribution-free) 的危害预算证书决定是否放行覆盖，构成可审计的区域路由框架。
Result: 在多组专家对与多个域上的实验显示：专家互补性足够可预测时获得统计显著的认证增益；专家相对强弱改变时路由方向相应反转；路由证据弱或受跨域偏移影响时保守否决切换。风险预算以 LPIPS 计量。
Conclusion: 选择性生成增强应由可审计的认证否决来把关：证据充分才覆盖冻结基专家，证据不足或域偏移时宁可不切换。

papers.title: Semantic Latent Alignment for Flow Matching with Invertible Bi-Lipschitz Adapters
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained latent spaces trade compression, reconstruction, and the learnability of the coordinates a downstream generator has to work in, which complicates adapting these spaces to different domains or tasks: continued training is expensive, and without a new alignment objective it often fails to improve downstream generation. We instead leave the encoder and decoder fixed and change only the coordinates between them, using an invertible bi-Lipschitz adapter aligned offline to a semantic teacher and frozen during class-conditional flow matching. Invertibility preserves compatibility with the pretrained autoencoder, while the bi-Lipschitz constraint limits how far alignment can distort its latent geometry. This provides a simple way to improve semantic organization while retaining the compression and reconstruction properties of the original latent space. On two medical imaging datasets, constrained latent adaptation improves feature metrics, seed stability and counterfactual edit strength, while remaining competitive on downstream classification. In contrast, unconstrained adaptation can become highly anisotropic and sensitive despite remaining invertible, highlighting the importance of controlling geometric distortion. Our results suggest that carefully constrained post-hoc adaptation offers a parameter-efficient and tuning-free alternative to jointly modifying the representation during generative training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的预训练自编码器之间只替换潜空间坐标：插入可逆 bi-Lipschitz adapter，离线对齐语义 teacher，并在类条件 flow matching 期间保持冻结。在两个医学影像数据集上，受约束的潜空间适配提升特征指标、种子稳定性与反事实编辑强度，同时下游分类保持竞争力；无约束适配虽仍可逆却变得高度各向异性且敏感。
Motivation: 预训练潜空间在压缩、重建与下游生成器可用坐标之间存在权衡，换域或换任务时继续训练昂贵，且缺少新的对齐目标时往往无法改善下游生成。
Method: 保持 encoder 与 decoder 冻结，仅在二者之间插入可逆 bi-Lipschitz adapter；该 adapter 离线与语义 teacher 对齐，并在类条件 flow matching 训练期间保持冻结。可逆性保证与预训练自编码器兼容，bi-Lipschitz 约束限制对齐对潜空间几何的扭曲。
Result: 在两个医学影像数据集上，受约束的潜空间适配改善特征指标、种子稳定性与反事实编辑强度，同时下游分类保持竞争力；作为对照，无约束适配即使保持可逆也会变得高度各向异性且敏感。
Conclusion: 受控的 post-hoc 潜空间适配是参数高效、免调参的替代方案，可在生成训练期间不动表示本身的前提下改善语义组织，关键在于约束几何扭曲。

papers.title: DocPilot: Interactive Agent Orchestration and Training for Long Visual Document Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal long-document question answering requires models to seek sparse evidence across pages and modalities, understand heterogeneous document content, and reason over the collected evidence. Even advanced vision-language models (VLMs) can overlook sparse evidence and struggle with cross-modal reasoning in a single pass. Existing document agents further introduce multi-step interaction, but some still rely on predefined workflows or coarse-grained actions, limiting the flexibility and granularity of document reasoning. We introduce DocPilot, an agentic document framework that supports expressive orchestration and makes complex document solving learnable by small language models (SLMs). DocPilot orchestrates evidence seeking through page-level navigation and fine-grained evidence localization, and integrates local visual inspection, code-based numerical reasoning, and cross-modal reasoning for multimodal understanding. To transfer these capabilities to small models, we propose curriculum-based agentic training that progresses from single-ability learning to adaptive orchestration through supervision from data-grounded reasoning traces and executable interaction trajectories. Across MMLongBench-Doc, DocBench, FinRAGBench-V, and MADQA, DocPilot achieves strong gains with frontier VLM backbones, while DocPilot-4B delivers competitive performance against substantially larger models, demonstrating strong effectiveness and generalization across diverse long-document reasoning settings. The code is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DocPilot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DocPilot 把长文档多模态问答拆成页面级导航与细粒度证据定位，并把局部视觉检查、代码数值推理、跨模态推理编排成可学习的智能体流程，用基于数据支撑推理轨迹与可执行交互轨迹的课程式训练 (curriculum-based agentic training) 把这套编排能力从单能力学习迁移到小语言模型 (SLM)。在 MMLongBench-Doc、DocBench、FinRAGBench-V 与 MADQA 上，前沿 VLM 骨干取得明显提升，DocPilot-4B 与规模大得多的模型表现相当。
Motivation: VLM 单次前向容易漏掉跨页稀疏证据、跨模态推理吃力；已有文档智能体又受限于预定义工作流或过粗的动作粒度，且难以把编排能力教给小模型。
Method: DocPilot 智能体框架以页面级导航加细粒度证据定位组织证据搜寻，融合局部视觉检查、基于代码的数值推理与跨模态推理；训练侧提出课程式智能体训练，从单能力学习逐步过渡到自适应编排，监督信号来自数据支撑的推理轨迹与可执行的交互轨迹。
Result: 在 MMLongBench-Doc、DocBench、FinRAGBench-V、MADQA 四个基准上，DocPilot 配前沿 VLM 骨干取得 strong gains；DocPilot-4B 与规模大得多的模型相比表现有竞争力。
Conclusion: 文档推理的编排能力可以通过轨迹监督的课程式训练转移给 4B 级小模型，使小模型在多种长文档推理设定下具备可用的泛化能力。

papers.title: CertEx: Exact Visual Retrieval at Scale by Certified Exclusion
papers.abstract_en: Exact $k$-nearest-neighbor (kNN) search over image descriptors and embeddings underlies visual retrieval, near-duplicate detection, the evaluation of learned representations, and increasingly the memory of LLM agents. However, exhaustive search computes every distance at full precision, whereas approximate indexes return recall below one. We observe that exact search only needs a proof that each excluded vector cannot be a neighbor. Because such a proof only has to be conservative, it can be checked in low precision, much as the retina examines the whole scene at low resolution. We call this principle certified exclusion and realize it in an exact kNN method for GPUs, which we call \certex. Specifically, \certex\ stores a lower-bounding projection of each vector in half precision and folds a rounding certificate into the same tensor-core dot product, so that only the few vectors that the test keeps need exact distances. We prove that \certex\ returns the exact kNN of every query. On sixteen datasets with up to 100M vectors, \certex\ is exact for every query at 7.1$\times$ to 18.0$\times$ the throughput of the fastest cuVS search on one H100 and outperforms quantized and graph indexes whenever every query must be exact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CertEx 提出 certified exclusion 原则：精确 kNN 只需证明被排除的向量不可能是邻居，而该证明可以保守地在低精度下完成。它用半精度存储每个向量的下界投影，并把舍入证书折进同一次 tensor-core 点积，只对通过检验的少数向量算精确距离，从而在 GPU 上返回每个查询的精确 kNN。
Motivation: 穷尽式搜索要对每个向量算满精度距离，代价高；近似索引虽快但召回率低于 1，无法满足必须逐查询精确的场景（视觉检索、近重复检测、表征评测、LLM agent 记忆）。
Method: CertEx 在半精度下为每个向量存放下界投影，并将舍入证书 (rounding certificate) 融入同一次 tensor-core 点积运算，使绝大多数向量在低精度检验中被保守排除，仅对保留下来的少数向量计算精确距离；作者证明该方法对每个查询返回精确 kNN。
Result: 在多达 16 个数据集、向量规模最高 100M 的评测中，CertEx 对每个查询都保持精确，在单张 H100 上吞吐量达到最快 cuVS 搜索的 7.1× 至 18.0×，并在要求全部查询精确的场合优于量化索引与图索引。
Conclusion: 把精确性证明做成可低精度校验的保守排除条件，就能在 GPU 上同时拿到精确 kNN 与数量级吞吐提升；当应用要求每个查询都必须精确时，应选这类 certified exclusion 方法而非量化或图索引。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: AdaLoop: Thinking with the Vision Encoder
papers.abstract_en: Most vision-language models (VLMs) treat the vision encoder as a static feature extractor: it encodes an image once, independently of the question, and leaves subsequent reasoning to the language model. Yet different questions may require different visual operations and processing depths. We present AdaLoop, a framework for question-conditioned visual recurrence in VLMs. AdaLoop adapts visual computation to the question and reuses the encoder's transformations across multiple iterations, with the pretrained vision weights frozen. We also introduce VisRO, a procedural dataset and generation pipeline for training and evaluating vision-centric reasoning. On six VisRO tasks, AdaLoop outperforms standard fine-tuning and question-conditioned single-pass baselines with matched training data and optimizer updates. These gains hold across three VLM families on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution examples. Our findings suggest that pretrained vision encoders can contribute to reasoning through task-directed, iterative visual computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaLoop 让 VLM 的视觉编码器按问题条件反复迭代：冻结预训练视觉权重，把编码器的变换在多轮中复用，使视觉计算深度随问题变化。在自建的 VisRO 程序化数据集六项任务上，它在训练数据与优化步数对齐的条件下胜过标准微调和问题条件单次前向基线，且增益跨三个 VLM 家族、在分布内外样例上都成立。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 把视觉编码器当作静态特征提取器，只按图像编码一次、与问题无关，后续推理全交给语言模型；但不同问题需要不同的视觉操作与处理深度。
Method: 提出问题条件化的视觉循环 (question-conditioned visual recurrence) 框架 AdaLoop：按问题调节视觉计算并跨多次迭代复用编码器的变换，预训练视觉权重保持冻结；同时提出 VisRO 程序化数据集与生成流程，用于训练和评测以视觉为中心的推理。
Result: 在 VisRO 六项任务上，AdaLoop 在训练数据与优化更新数对齐的条件下优于标准微调与问题条件单次前向基线；增益覆盖三个 VLM 家族，并同时出现在分布内与分布外样例上。
Conclusion: 预训练视觉编码器可以通过任务导向的迭代视觉计算参与推理，而不只是提供一次性特征；问题条件化的循环复用是实现这一点的路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CoViG: Coarsened Vision GNN for Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Although Graph Neural Networks are widely used in various domains, they remained mostly unexplored in computer vision. Convolutional Neural Networks and Vision Transformers were leading the field, until the quite recent introduction of Vision Graphs (ViG) that treat images as a set of nodes and apply graph convolution on their k-NN graphs. ViGs show impressive accuracy on image classification but their computational cost remains relatively high. Inspired by optimization methods for GNNs, we present CoViG, a novel approach combining graph coarsening and ViGs. Our method introduces an additional MinCUT pooling step within the Grapher component of intermediate ViG blocks. By simplifying the intermediate graphs and thus decreasing the number of nodes of specific blocks, our approach considerably reduces the computational cost of ViG during inference. We evaluated our approach on ImageNet with several ViG architectures, and we obtained accuracies equivalent to the original ViG models with only about 51\% of FLOPs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoViG 在 Vision Graph (ViG) 的中间 Grapher 块中插入 MinCUT 池化做图粗化，减少特定块的节点数，从而大幅降低推理计算量。在 ImageNet 上跨多种 ViG 架构，精度与原 ViG 相当，但只需约 51% 的 FLOPs。
Motivation: ViG 把图像当作节点集在 k-NN 图上做图卷积，分类精度高但计算成本偏高，限制了其在视觉任务中的实用部署。
Method: 结合图粗化与 ViG：在中间 ViG 块的 Grapher 组件内加入额外的 MinCUT pooling 步骤，简化中间图并降低特定块的节点数，主要作用于推理阶段。
Result: 在 ImageNet 上用多种 ViG 架构评估，得到与原始 ViG 模型相当的分类精度，而 FLOPs 仅约为原来的 51%。
Conclusion: 在 ViG 中间块做 MinCUT 图粗化可以在保持 ImageNet 精度的同时把推理 FLOPs 降到约一半。

papers.title: ZoomCap: Evidence-Routed Visual Zooming for Recoverable Visual Information Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Detailed captions transfer visual information into vision-language model supervision, but quality is easily conflated with length: long single-pass outputs still miss small objects, text, and spatial relations or promote uncertain observations into confident claims. We formulate fine-grained captioning as recoverable visual information transfer, in which a teacher acquires missing evidence under a finite observation budget and converts it into reusable supervision. ZoomCap uses a draft caption to route conditional knowledge retrieval, OCR-sensitive reading, coverage-gap recovery, and adaptive visual zooming, allocating deeper crops only to the most complex eligible region, deriving spatial relations from grounded geometry, and fusing non-duplicate evidence. We also introduce FactCycle, which scores caption-derived atomic claims on two blind anchors--source image (truthfulness) and reconstruction (realizability)--separating fabrication from generator loss claim by claim; human and multi-judge comparisons complement this fact-level view. Against Qwen3.5-397B-A17B captions, ZoomCap achieves an 81.9% human tie-adjusted preference score with a teacher over 10x smaller, and FactCycle counts 52.4 transferred claims per image vs. 31.5 for ScaleCap. The evidence also transfers: in continual pre-training, ZoomCap-450K improves the 11-benchmark average by 1.31-2.38 points over the strongest competing corpus and Ling-Tiny-VL-v3 gains 1.4 points on a production document/OCR monitor suite (1.5 on perception) at 60B tokens; in medical pre-training, 2.64M ZoomCap-captioned images improve five VQA benchmarks by 3.04 points (vs. 1.76 for same-image Gemini-3.1-Pro captions).
papers.comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, 11 tables; technical report. ZoomCap-450K is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/MasterHow/ZoomCap-450K
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZoomCap 把细粒度图像描述重构为可恢复的视觉信息传递：以草稿描述为路由，按需做条件知识检索、OCR 敏感读取、覆盖缺口补全与自适应视觉缩放，只对最复杂的合格区域加深裁剪，并用 FactCycle 逐条原子声明打分区分捏造与生成器损失。相对 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 描述取得 81.9% 人类 tie-adjusted 偏好分，教师模型小 10 倍以上；每图传递 52.4 条声明（ScaleCap 31.5），ZoomCap-450K 在持续预训练中把 11 个基准均值抬高 1.31–2.38 分。
Motivation: 长单次输出的描述质量与长度混为一谈：仍会漏掉小目标、文字与空间关系，或把不确定观察写成确定断言，监督信号因此不可靠。
Method: 以草稿描述路由四条证据获取通道——条件知识检索、OCR 敏感读取、覆盖缺口补全、自适应视觉缩放（只对最复杂合格区域加深裁剪），从 grounded geometry 推导空间关系并融合非重复证据；FactCycle 对描述派生的原子声明在源图像（truthfulness）与重建（realizability）两个盲锚上打分，辅以人类与多评审比较。
Result: 相对 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 描述，人类 tie-adjusted 偏好分 81.9%，教师模型小 10 倍以上；FactCycle 每图计数 52.4 条传递声明，ScaleCap 为 31.5。持续预训练中 ZoomCap-450K 使 11 基准均值比最强竞争语料高 1.31–2.38 分，Ling-Tiny-VL-v3 在 60B tokens 下于生产文档/OCR 监控套件提升 1.4 分（感知项 1.5 分）；医学预训练中 2.64M 张 ZoomCap 描述图像使五个 VQA 基准提升 3.04 分，同图像 Gemini-3.1-Pro 描述为 1.76 分。
Conclusion: 在有限观测预算下按需补证据并逐条核验声明，能以远小的教师模型产出更可复用的描述监督，且该监督可迁移到持续预训练与医学 VQA。

papers.title: Constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in Imagination
papers.abstract_en: Predicting cost in a multi-agent world model moves most constrained policy updates into imagination: the stronger model-free baseline needs $10$ to $20$ times CA-MAMBA's interactions on the median SMAC configuration, and CA-MAMBA earns $2.8$ to $12$ times the baselines' MAMuJoCo reward at equal budget. In controlled tests on one task per benchmark, pricing the model's cost advantages at parity more than halves a cost-blind learner's cost and meets a tight continuous-control limit the learned multiplier misses, suggesting the model's cost estimates are not the bottleneck.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多智能体世界模型的想象 (imagination) 中做约束策略更新，提出 CA-MAMBA：用模型预测代价来驱动受约束的多智能体策略优化。在 SMAC 中位配置上，最强的 model-free 基线需要 10–20 倍于 CA-MAMBA 的交互量才能匹配；等预算下 CA-MAMBA 在 MAMuJoCo 上拿到基线 2.8–12 倍的回报。把模型的代价优势按平价定价，可将 cost-blind 学习者的代价砍掉一半以上，并达到学习乘子 (learned multiplier) 错过的紧连续控制界限。
Motivation: 多智能体约束强化学习中，把受约束的策略更新放进世界模型的想象里可以省交互，但代价估计的准确性是否成为瓶颈并不清楚。
Method: CA-MAMBA 在多智能体世界模型的想象中做受约束策略更新，用模型预测的 cost 指导更新；对照实验在每个基准的一个任务上，比较按平价定价模型代价优势与 cost-blind 学习、以及学习乘子两种处理方式。
Result: SMAC 中位配置上最强 model-free 基线需要 10–20 倍 CA-MAMBA 的交互量；等预算下 CA-MAMBA 在 MAMuJoCo 上获得基线 2.8–12 倍的回报。受控测试中，按平价定价模型的代价优势使 cost-blind 学习者的代价下降超过一半，并达到学习乘子错过的紧连续控制界限。
Conclusion: 模型的代价估计不是瓶颈：把想象中的代价优势按平价定价，就能同时压低代价并逼近紧的连续控制界限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Loud and Clear: Making Visual Evidence Count in Multimodal Document RAG
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal document retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has focused largely on retrieval, yet its answers depend on how well a vision-language model reads the retrieved pages. We find that evidence in retrieved pages remains underused even when the correct pages are retrieved. On SciEGQA oracle pages, five prior methods give the generator 0.7K to 2.7K visual tokens per query on average under a common image processor, yet raising the page-only budget from 1K to 32K improves accuracy by 15.22 points. At a fixed 16K budget, adding ground-truth crops improves accuracy by 3.75 points over page-only input. We study what the generator needs from retrieved pages through two requirements: Loud, making full use of visual token capacity, and Clear, refining the page so that its evidence becomes prominent. For Loud, increasing either the visual token budget or visual fidelity, the image resolution those tokens preserve, improves accuracy with the other held fixed, and full-page scaling outperforms repetition and tiling at matched budgets. For Clear, suppressing surrounding content improves accuracy without enlarging selected regions, and adding OCR of these regions to page images outperforms either input alone. We implement both as Loud and Clear (LoC), which combines higher-resolution pages with OCR from query-relevant regions without ground-truth annotations or additional training. LoC outperforms eight prior methods on SciEGQA, ViDoRe-v3, and MMLongBench-Doc, improving over the strongest, ColQwen3, by 8.88, 3.09, and 4.22 points with the same retriever and generator. It also outperforms its page-only variant under the same visual token budget. These results locate a bottleneck beyond retrieval: how the retrieved pages are given to the generator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态文档 RAG 的瓶颈不在检索而在生成器如何读取检索页：正确页面已取回时视觉证据仍被浪费。提出 LoC，同时做 Loud（提高页面分辨率以用满视觉 token 容量）与 Clear（抑制周边内容并叠加查询相关区域的 OCR，无需真值标注与额外训练），在 SciEGQA 上超最强基线 ColQwen3 8.88 分。
Motivation: 多模态文档 RAG 长期只优化检索，但答案质量取决于视觉语言模型如何读取检索页；即便正确页面已取回，页内证据仍被系统性浪费。
Method: 拆成两条要求：Loud 指提高视觉 token 预算或视觉保真度（token 所保留的图像分辨率），Clear 指抑制周边内容并把查询相关区域的 OCR 拼到页面图像上。实现为 LoC：高分辨率页面 + 查询相关区域 OCR，不需真值裁剪标注也不需额外训练，检索器与生成器保持不变。
Result: SciEGQA 上五种既有方法平均每查询只给生成器 0.7K–2.7K 视觉 token；在统一图像处理器下把纯页面预算从 1K 提到 32K，准确率升 15.22 分；固定 16K 预算时加入真值裁剪比纯页面高 3.75 分；匹配预算下全页缩放优于重复与切块。LoC 在 SciEGQA、ViDoRe-v3、MMLongBench-Doc 上分别超 ColQwen3 8.88、3.09、4.22 分，并在相同视觉 token 预算下胜过自己的纯页面变体。
Conclusion: 检索之外存在一个独立瓶颈：检索页以何种方式交给生成器；用满 token 容量并让证据凸显，比继续堆检索更直接抬高答案准确率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Money-Mule Detection as a Relational Learning Problem: A Study on the RBIH NFPC Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Money-mule networks move criminal funds through many small transfers, each of which looks ordinary on its own. What marks an account as a mule lies outside any single transfer: in the counterparties and addresses its network shares, and in the shape of its activity over time. Production systems remain largely rule-based and see neither, while most research classifies transactions rather than accounts, recovering account-level risk only by aggregating afterwards. We instead score the account directly, reading the bank's relational schema as a heterogeneous graph in which rows are nodes and foreign keys are edges. Each account is scored from a multi-hop neighbourhood using per-column encoders, a relative-time encoding and HeteroGraphSAGE message passing, with that neighbourhood restricted to rows predating the account's own pre-flag cutoff so that no model sees evidence recorded only after the account was flagged. On a five-year Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH) retail-banking dataset of 400 million transactions and 94{,}063 labelled accounts, 2.6\% of them confirmed mules, we compare against RelGNN, XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost trained on identical labels, splits and cutoffs. Our detector recovers nine in ten held-out mules at 83\% precision and a 0.5\% false-alarm rate, finding 115 more mules than the strongest tree ensemble given the same evidence. At the tuned thresholds the gap is mostly in recall: XGBoost and LightGBM lead across the first hundred alerts, but only the graph models hold their precision deep into the queue. Since the graph is the schema itself and every score is dated per account, the approach deploys on a bank's existing database without a custom feature graph build.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把银行关系型 schema 直接读成异构图（行是节点、外键是边），用 HeteroGraphSAGE 在账户的多跳邻域上直接给账户打分，邻域只取该账户 pre-flag 截止时间之前的行以避免标签泄漏。在 RBIH 五年 4 亿笔交易、94,063 个标注账户（2.6% 确认 mule）上，检出约九成留出 mule，精确率 83%、误报率 0.5%，比最强树集成在同等证据下多找 115 个 mule。
Motivation: 洗钱 mule 账户的特征在单笔交易之外——在于共享的对手方、地址和时序活动形态；现有生产系统是规则驱动，研究界多做交易级分类再事后聚合，拿不到账户级风险。
Method: 把 RBIH 零售银行关系 schema 视为异构图，逐列 encoder 编码节点特征，加 relative-time 编码，用 HeteroGraphSAGE 做多跳消息传递；邻域限制在账户自身 pre-flag 截断之前的数据行。与 RelGNN、XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost 在相同标签、划分和截断上对比。
Result: 五年 400,000,000 笔交易、94,063 个标注账户中 2.6% 为确认 mule；检出约 90% 留出 mule，精确率 83%，误报率 0.5%，比最强树集成多找到 115 个 mule。调阈值后差距主要在 recall：前一百条告警上 XGBoost 与 LightGBM 领先，但只有图模型在队列深处保持精确率。
Conclusion: 账户级 mule 风险应直接从 schema 图的多跳邻域打分，而非交易分类后聚合；图就是 schema 本身、分数带日期，可直接部署在银行现有数据库上，无需自建特征图。

papers.title: Spectrum Is Not Enough: A Random-Matrix Account of Data-Free Preconditioning for Differentially Private Learning
papers.abstract_en: Data-free preconditioning builds the Kronecker factors of KFAC from synthetic probes instead of private data. DP-KFC validates a probe by matching the eigenvalue decay of the private factors; we turn this criterion into a random-matrix account of what a probe can reconstruct. A single dichotomy organizes it: in the factorization $ A \otimes G $, the error-signal factor $ G $ and the architecture-determined bulk of the activation factor $ A $ are reconstructible without data, while only the data-induced spikes of $ A $ are not. We prove the $ G $ half is data-insensitive up to an explicit error-energy bound, with zero violations over a full training trajectory across four modalities and a natural-image benchmark. We locate the failure boundary at a Baik-Ben Arous-Péché threshold: a bulk-only probe suffers an exact damage $s^2/(1-s^2)$ from a data-induced spike, which becomes invisible once it exceeds $(d/n)^{1/4}$, confirmed on an injected-spike surrogate. Holding the probe spectrum fixed and varying only its eigenbasis, we show that spectral-shape matching is neither sufficient nor the operative object: a probe with a near-exact matched spectrum (log-ratio dispersion $0.02$) still inflates the residual $2 \times $-$90 \times $ when its eigenvectors are random. A closed-form whitened-volume law explains this and predicts the within-spectrum ordering of the critical volume, though not its cross-dataset magnitude. Downstream, per-layer tuning does not transfer to accuracy and the headroom is a small oracle-minus-white gap. Under a privacy mechanism the source ordering survives while learning does, then inverts at a noise cross-over where the flat probe overtakes the matched ones.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 3 figures. Long form of the manuscript submitted to IEEE TNNLS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用随机矩阵理论重审数据无关预条件 (data-free preconditioning)：KFAC 的 Kronecker 因子 A⊗G 中，误差信号因子 G 与激活因子 A 的架构决定 bulk 都可无数据重建，只有 A 的数据诱导 spike 不可重建。固定探针谱只换特征向量时，谱形匹配既不充分也非关键量——谱几乎精确匹配（log-ratio dispersion 0.02）但特征向量随机的探针仍把残差放大 2×–90×；闭式 whitened-volume 定律解释了同谱内的排序。
Motivation: DP-KFC 用私有因子的特征值衰减来验证合成探针，但谱匹配是否真能决定预条件质量缺少理论解释；作者要说明探针到底能重建什么、以及谱匹配准则在何处失效。
Method: 把 DP-KFC 的谱匹配准则改写为随机矩阵可重建性分析：证明 G 因子对数据不敏感并给出显式误差能量界；用 Baik-Ben Arous-Péché 阈值定位 bulk-only 探针的失效边界，损伤为 s²/(1-s²)，超过 (d/n)^(1/4) 后不可见；再固定探针谱、只变特征向量做对照，并推导闭式 whitened-volume 定律。
Result: G 因子的数据不敏感性在四种模态加一个自然图像基准的完整训练轨迹上零违例；注入 spike 的代理实验确认了 (d/n)^(1/4) 阈值；谱精确匹配（log-ratio dispersion 0.02）但特征向量随机的探针使残差膨胀 2×–90×；whitened-volume 定律能预测同谱内的临界体积排序，但不能预测跨数据集量级；下游逐层调参不迁移到精度，oracle 与 white 之间的余量很小；在隐私机制下源排序在学习仍发生时保持，在噪声交叉点处反转、平坦探针反超匹配探针。

papers.title: PocketTSLM: Deploying an On-Device Soft-Prompt Time-Series Language Model for Privacy-Preserving Smartphone Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Consumer phones and wearables increasingly collect physiological time-series data, yet most mobile systems treat these streams as summaries or text rather than as temporal evidence. This representation is poorly matched to personal health systems that need to retrieve, route, or summarize sensor evidence while preserving temporal structure. Cloud-hosted time-series language models avoid smartphone limits, but they repeatedly move sensitive physiology off the device and add latency and per-query compute cost. Mobile model alternatives that aggregate time-series data into statistical features or serialize raw samples as text either compress temporal structure or exhaust the context and memory budgets of small on-device models. We present PocketTSLM, a mobile-native deployment of OpenTSLM SoftPrompt, the soft-prompt variant of the OpenTSLM time-series language model. PocketTSLM runs fully on a consumer smartphone by injecting encoded time-series windows as embeddings instead of tokenizing time series as text. A numerical parity protocol verifies identical greedy-decoded token sequences between the Swift port and a Python reference using Apple's MLX machine-learning framework. Answers also match the PyTorch reference, although rationale wording can differ. An on-device context-economics benchmark compares the soft-prompt path with a text-serialized baseline on the same backbone. In our benchmark format, soft-prompting uses approximately 12 times fewer time-series tokens and reduces prompt-prefill cost. PocketTSLM processes 30-second Sleep-EDF electroencephalography clips for sleep staging and a 1,000-sample (10 s) 12-lead electrocardiogram clip from ECG-QA. In comparison, text-serialized baselines exceed the phone's context or memory budget at longer time-series windows. All inference runs entirely on the device, with no health data transmitted during inference.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. A version of this paper was accepted at the Workshop on Deploying AI in Healthcare (DAIH) at COLM 2026. Code: https://github.com/SchmiedmayerLab/PocketTSLM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PocketTSLM 把 OpenTSLM SoftPrompt 这一时间序列语言模型完整搬到消费级智能手机上运行，通过把编码后的时间序列窗口作为 embedding 注入而非序列化成文本，实现隐私保护的设备端推理。在其基准格式下，soft-prompt 路径比文本序列化基线少用约 12 倍时间序列 token 并降低 prompt-prefill 开销，且推理全程无健康数据外传。
Motivation: 手机与可穿戴设备采集的生理时间序列被多数移动系统压成统计摘要或文本，丢失时序结构；云端时间序列语言模型则反复把敏感生理数据传出设备并带来延迟与按查询算力成本，小模型的文本序列化路径又会耗尽上下文与内存预算。
Method: PocketTSLM 是 OpenTSLM SoftPrompt（soft-prompt 变体）的移动原生部署：用 Apple MLX 将 Swift 移植版与 Python 参考实现做数值一致性校验（greedy 解码 token 序列完全一致），并对照 PyTorch 参考；在同一 backbone 上用 on-device context-economics benchmark 比较 soft-prompt 与文本序列化基线。
Result: 在该基准格式下 soft-prompting 约少用 12 倍时间序列 token 并降低 prefill 成本；Swift 移植版与 Python 参考的 greedy 解码 token 序列完全一致，答案与 PyTorch 参考匹配（rationale 措辞可不同）；处理 30 秒 Sleep-EDF EEG 片段做睡眠分期与 ECG-QA 的 1000 采样点（10 秒）12 导联 ECG 片段，而文本序列化基线在更长窗口上超出手机上下文或内存预算。
Conclusion: 把时间序列以 soft-prompt embedding 而非文本注入，可以让时间序列语言模型在消费级手机上完全设备端运行并保留时序结构，同时避免把生理数据传出设备；其代价是 token 与 prefill 开销大幅下降这一收益是在作者自定的基准格式下成立的。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VLA-$Δ$: Learning Physical State Transition for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models transfer semantic knowledge acquired through vision-language pretraining to robot control, achieving strong performance across various benchmarks. However, most VLAs directly map observations to demonstrated actions without explicit supervision of intermediate physical state changes, making them prone to overfitting observation-action correspondences. Some methods introduce intermediate reasoning or future-state prediction in language, visual, or latent spaces to guide action generation, but do not explicitly supervise the physical state transition itself. We therefore propose VLA-$Δ$, a general framework that uses physical changes between current and future states as explicit learning targets. To support this objective, we construct a large-scale pretraining dataset and derive physical state-transition annotations covering task-relevant semantics and visual motion changes, providing more direct supervision for continuous action generation. During inference, the model generates actions directly from current observations without additional inference overhead. VLA-$Δ$ achieves performance competitive with the state of the art on LIBERO and RoboTwin, and outperforms $π_{0.5}$ in real-robot experiments. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-OmniAI/VLA-Delta
papers.comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables, including appendices. Code: https://github.com/ZJU-OmniAI/VLA-Delta
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA-Δ 把当前与未来状态之间的物理变化本身作为显式监督目标，构造大规模预训练数据集并派生覆盖任务语义与视觉运动变化的状态转移标注，训练视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型直接生成连续动作。推理时模型仅凭当前观测出动作、不增加额外推理开销；在 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 上达到与 SOTA 竞争的性能，并在真实机器人实验中超过 π0.5。
Motivation: 多数 VLA 直接把观测映射到示范动作，只靠观测-动作对应关系容易过拟合；已有引入语言、视觉或隐空间中间推理与未来状态预测的方法，也没有对物理状态转移本身做显式监督。
Method: 提出 VLA-Δ 框架，以当前与未来状态间的物理变化作为显式学习目标；为此构建大规模预训练数据集，并派生物理状态转移标注，覆盖任务相关语义与视觉运动变化，为连续动作生成提供更直接的监督；推理阶段直接由当前观测生成动作。
Result: 在 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 上性能与最先进水平 (state of the art) 竞争；在真实机器人实验中超过 π0.5；推理时无需额外推理开销。
Conclusion: 把物理状态转移作为显式监督目标，可以在不增加推理开销的前提下让 VLA 的连续动作生成达到 SOTA 竞争水平并在真实机器人上胜过 π0.5。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Dusting the Phantom: Gaussian Allocation for Fading Dynamic Content
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic Gaussian representations have made high-quality, real-time volumetric video increasingly practical, yet challenging motion can still break their reconstruction: small fast-moving objects may disappear, and fine textures in highly dynamic regions are often lost. In particular, simply training longer or using more Gaussians may still fail to recover small, fast-moving objects. We argue that the key bottleneck is not representational capacity itself, but where and when Gaussian primitives are allocated. Existing allocation strategies rely on current Gaussian locations and often overlook the spatiotemporal destinations of relocated Gaussians. To address these limitations, we introduce two complementary strategies. First, Seed Injection identifies under-reconstructed dynamic regions using temporal appearance changes and reconstruction errors, and initializes new Gaussians at geometrically plausible 3D locations through multi-view observations, independent of existing Gaussian locations. Second, Temporal Biased Relocation uses time-resolved optimization signals to guide the spatiotemporal placement of relocated Gaussians. Both strategies maintain a fixed Gaussian budget without modifying the underlying representation. Experiments across multiple dynamic-scene datasets demonstrate improved reconstruction quality, particularly in highly dynamic regions, recovering small, rapidly moving objects and fine-grained appearance details.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 动态高斯体积视频中，小而快速的物体消失、高动态区域细纹理丢失，根因是高斯分配的位置与时机而非表示容量。Seed Injection 用时序外观变化与重建误差定位欠重建区域，再从多视角观测在几何合理的 3D 位置初始化新高斯；Temporal Biased Relocation 用时间分辨的优化信号引导被迁移高斯的时空落点，两者都在固定高斯预算下改进高动态区域的重建质量。
Motivation: 动态场景重建中，小而快速的物体常直接消失，高动态区域的细纹理丢失；单纯延长训练或增加高斯数量仍无法恢复这些内容，瓶颈在于分配策略只看当前高斯位置、忽略被迁移高斯的时空去向。
Method: 提出两条互补的分配策略：Seed Injection 依据时序外观变化与重建误差识别欠重建动态区域，并通过多视角观测在几何合理的 3D 位置初始化新高斯，不依赖已有高斯位置；Temporal Biased Relocation 用时间分辨的优化信号引导被迁移高斯的时空放置。两者均不改动底层表示，保持固定高斯预算。
Result: 在多个动态场景数据集上的实验显示重建质量提升，尤其在高动态区域，恢复了小而快速移动的物体与细粒度外观细节；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 动态高斯重建的瓶颈是分配策略而非表示容量；在固定预算下改进高斯的时空分配即可恢复此前丢失的小快物体与细节。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GeoPano: Towards Geometrically Accurate 3D Reconstruction from a Single Panorama
papers.abstract_en: Panoramic 3D reconstruction enables the holistic recovery of complete 360 $^\circ$ scene geometry, offering significant benefits for robotics and AR/VR applications. However, directly estimating geometry from ERP images is inherently challenged by spherical distortions. To reduce spherical projection distortions, a common strategy is to decompose panoramas into distortion-free perspective views, but independently processing these views often introduces cross-view geometric inconsistencies. To address these challenges, we introduce GeoPano, a feed-forward framework for single-view panoramic 3D reconstruction that recovers a geometrically accurate and consistent point cloud from a single panorama. Our approach is driven by two key innovations: First, we propose a panoramic-aware attention aggregator, featuring a streamlined attention architecture equipped with a novel Pano-Attention mechanism, which explicitly exploits the intrinsic spherical geometry of the panorama to guide cross-view interactions, thereby suppressing geometric inconsistencies. Furthermore, we formulate a hybrid supervision strategy to jointly enforce fine-grained local details in perspective space and global structural coherence in spherical space. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous SOTA approaches in reconstruction accuracy, geometric consistency, and visual fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoPano 是单张全景图前馈式 3D 重建框架，用 Pano-Attention 显式利用球面几何引导跨视角交互，抑制分解为透视视图后的几何不一致，并以透视空间局部细节与球面空间全局结构一致性的混合监督联合约束。在重建精度、几何一致性与视觉保真度上显著优于此前 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: ERP 全景图存在球面投影畸变，直接估计几何困难；常见做法是分解为无畸变透视视图，但独立处理各视图会引入跨视角几何不一致。
Method: 前馈式单视图全景 3D 重建：全景感知注意力聚合器 (panoramic-aware attention aggregator) 采用精简注意力架构与 Pano-Attention 机制，利用球面几何引导跨视角交互；混合监督策略在透视空间约束细粒度局部细节、在球面空间约束全局结构一致性。
Result: 实验显示该方法在重建精度、几何一致性和视觉保真度上显著优于此前 SOTA 方法。
Conclusion: 把球面几何显式注入跨视角注意力并配合透视-球面双重监督，可在单张全景图上得到几何准确且一致的点云。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 把球面几何显式注入跨视角注意力并配合透视-球面双重监督，可在单张全景图上得到几何准确且一致的点云。

papers.title: Personalized Projected Ascent for Federated Stackelberg Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Federated minimax problems, such as distributionally robust optimization and adversarial training, include an inner maximization variable built from each client's local data. These variables differ in meaning and dimension from one client to the next, so averaging them across clients, as standard federated minimax methods do, is ill-posed. We therefore study a federated minimax problem where the minimization variable $\mathbf{x}$ is shared and aggregated, while each client retains the maximization variable $\mathbf{y}_i$ (personalized). Because these applications constrain $\mathbf{y}_i$ to a compact convex set, we analyze projected ascent directly. We show that, in the nonconvex-concave regime, this projected personalized scheme attains the standard sublinear rate. In the nonconvex-PL regime, however, it hits a stepsize-invariant noise floor due to stochastic $\mathbf{y}_i$ updates. To mitigate this, we propose VR-SGDA, incorporating a variance-reduced ascent step where each client maintains a private variable snapshot. By evaluating current and snapshot gradients on the same sample, the constant variance is replaced by a vanishing drift under a two-timescale regime. VR-SGDA eliminates the noise floor, attaining sublinear leading rates while preserving personalization and projection. Experiments on subpopulation-robustness and NLP adversarial training confirm both the worst-group robustness benefits and the two-timescale tracking mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 联邦 minimax 优化中各客户端的内层最大化变量 y_i 含义与维度互不相同，直接跨客户端平均是 ill-posed 的；本文改为共享最小化变量 x、每个客户端个性化保留 y_i 并做投影上升 (projected ascent)。非凸-凹情形该方案达到标准次线性速率，但非凸-PL 情形因随机 y_i 更新出现步长不变的噪声地板；提出的 VR-SGDA 用客户端私有梯度快照做方差缩减，在双时间尺度 (two-timescale) 下把常数方差换成衰减漂移，从而消除噪声地板并保持次线性首项速率。
Motivation: 联邦 minimax（如分布鲁棒优化、对抗训练）的内层最大化变量由各客户端本地数据构造，含义与维度逐客户端不同，标准联邦 minimax 方法对其跨客户端平均是 ill-posed 的。
Method: 共享并聚合最小化变量 x，每个客户端个性化保留投影到紧凸集上的最大化变量 y_i，直接分析投影上升；针对非凸-PL 下随机 y_i 更新导致的噪声地板，提出 VR-SGDA，每个客户端维护私有变量快照，在同一样本上同时计算当前梯度与快照梯度，以双时间尺度机制实现方差缩减。
Result: 非凸-凹情形下个性化投影方案达到标准次线性速率；非凸-PL 情形出现步长不变的噪声地板，VR-SGDA 消除该噪声地板并保持次线性首项速率；在 subpopulation robustness 与 NLP 对抗训练实验中确认了最差组鲁棒性收益与双时间尺度跟踪机制。
Conclusion: 跨客户端平均内层最大化变量不可行，个性化保留 y_i 加投影上升是正确设定；在非凸-PL 下需用基于快照的方差缩减上升步消除随机更新带来的噪声地板。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can Capability Enhancement be Localized?
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based language models have shown strong capabilities across many tasks and domains. However, prior work shows that, for a given task, not all attention heads matter equally. Specifically, they suggest that many \textit{redundant} heads can be safely removed with little-to-no effect, while a small set of \textit{important} heads, when ablated, severely damages the model's performance on the given task. In this work, we investigate a complementary aspect, called \textit{Capability Enhancement Localization} (CEL): \textit{given a model and a task, does there exist a small set of heads whose removal improves the task performance?} We first investigate this question \textit{empirically} across models from different families. Using a simple two-stage routine that screens candidate heads and evaluates their joint ablations, we identify sparse head combinations whose removal improves task-specific performance without further fine-tuning. Motivated by these observations, we ask \textit{theoretically whether such a phenomenon can naturally arise from training dynamics, and under what conditions}. To this end, we construct a simplified multi-head softmax attention model and two tasks with conflicting features, and show that gradient descent from small random initialization provably concentrates the conflicting features into particular heads. We further show that ablating such heads improves performance on one task while harming the other, even though training converges to a global optimum of the joint objective. This establishes a possible training-induced theoretical explanation for CEL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出能力增强局部化 (Capability Enhancement Localization, CEL)：给定模型与任务，是否存在一小撮移除后反而提升该任务性能的注意力头。用两阶段筛选（候选头筛查 + 联合消融评估）在多个模型家族上找到稀疏头组合，无需微调即可提升任务表现；理论上构造带冲突特征的多头 softmax 注意力简化模型，证明小随机初始化下的梯度冲突特征会集中到特定头，消融这些头提升一个任务、损害另一个任务。
Motivation: 既有工作只区分冗余头与重要头，关注移除后性能不变或严重受损；移除某些头反而提升性能这一互补现象此前缺少实证刻画与训练动力学层面的解释。
Method: 实证部分用两阶段流程：先筛查候选头，再评估其联合消融，寻找无需微调即可提升任务表现的稀疏头组合，并跨不同模型家族检验。理论部分构造简化的多头 softmax 注意力模型与两个特征冲突的任务，分析小随机初始化下梯度下降的收敛行为。
Result: 在多个模型家族上识别出稀疏头组合，其移除在不做进一步微调的情况下提升任务特定性能；理论上证明梯度冲突特征会集中到特定头，且即使训练收敛到联合目标的全局最优，消融这些头仍会提升一个任务而损害另一个任务。
Conclusion: CEL 现象可由训练动力学自然诱导：梯度下降把冲突特征压进少数头，使这些头在联合目标下成为可被移除的性能抑制源，为任务相关的头级干预提供了可能的理论解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bias Control and Injection for Multi-Agent Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reasoning with large language models (LLMs) raises a central question for collective decision-making: when agents disagree, whose decision should be trusted? Resolving such disagreements is difficult because agents' decisions are susceptible to non-semantic biases such as majority pressure and response-style preferences, which can obscure the quality of the underlying reasoning. Our analysis shows how bias can be both mitigated and exploited: bias control improves initial answer selection, while bias injection elicits decision instability that serves as a reliability signal. Building on these findings, we introduce a test-time aggregation framework that requires neither validation data nor prior knowledge of relative model strength. The framework implements bias control by presenting one style-normalized reasoning trace per distinct answer, and bias injection by placing each aggregating agent's initially selected answer in the minority. Overall, our framework achieves higher average accuracy and better token efficiency than competing non-oracle aggregation methods across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks and four heterogeneous LLM combinations. It also improves final-answer accuracy when applied to multi-agent debate and Mixture-of-Agents, without modifying their interaction or synthesis processes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLM 多智能体聚合中，非语义偏差（多数压力、回答风格偏好）既可被抑制也可被利用：风格归一化的单条推理轨迹提升初始答案选择，把聚合智能体的初始选择放进少数派则诱发决策不稳定性并作为可靠性信号。基于此的免验证数据、免模型强度先验的测试时聚合框架，在三个数学推理基准、四种异构 LLM 组合上平均准确率更高且 token 效率更好，并可直接套用到 multi-agent debate 与 Mixture-of-Agents 上提升最终答案准确率。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 推理中智能体意见分歧时难以判断该信谁：决策受多数压力与回答风格等非语义偏差影响，掩盖了推理本身的质量。
Method: 测试时聚合框架，不需要验证数据也不需要各模型相对强度先验。偏差控制：每个不同答案只呈现一条风格归一化的推理轨迹；偏差注入：把聚合智能体最初选中的答案放到少数派位置，借决策不稳定性作为可靠性信号。
Result: 在三个数学推理基准、四种异构 LLM 组合上，平均准确率高于其他非 oracle 聚合方法，且 token 效率更好；套用到 multi-agent debate 与 Mixture-of-Agents 时不改动其交互或合成过程，仍提升最终答案准确率。
Conclusion: 非语义偏差可以双向利用：抑制它改善初始答案选择，注入它产生的不稳定性可当作可靠性度量，从而在无验证数据的条件下做更强的测试时聚合。

papers.title: ReState: Noise-Level-Aware State Correction for Training-Free Object Removal in Few-Step Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Training-free object removal commonly redirects self-attention away from the target region, but on few-step distilled diffusion models this often leaves object-shaped residuals. We identify a temporal mismatch: a structured prediction forms inside the mask at the first forward, and the short trajectory offers few later chances to revise it, while attention rerouting acts mainly in later steps. Across four distilled backbones, magnitude-matched single-forward interventions show that background-directed state correction affects the final result more than attention rerouting. We therefore propose ReState, which corrects the masked clean prediction toward background evidence retrieved from the input using a noise-level-aware weight that vanishes at the final forward. ReState retains object-excluding attention as a complementary constraint and adds no denoiser evaluations. Across two paired benchmarks and two few-step backbones, ReState achieves the best masked PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among training-free methods, improving PSNR by 3.17 dB on average over the strongest baseline. On OBER-Test, it also outperforms the 50-step attention-forcing reference on all three metrics at 6.7x lower latency. The same configuration transfers to two additional distilled backbones without retuning. Project page: https://tdrlee.github.io/ReState
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReState 指出少步蒸馏扩散模型上 training-free 物体移除失效的根因是时间错位：mask 内的结构化预测在第一次前向就已形成，而注意力重定向主要作用于后期步，短轨迹来不及修正。它用噪声水平感知权重把被 mask 的干净预测朝输入中检索到的背景证据拉回，权重在最后一次前向消失，且不增加去噪器评估。在两个成对基准与两个少步骨干上，ReState 在 training-free 方法中取得最佳 masked PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS，平均较最强基线提升 3.17 dB PSNR。
Motivation: 少步蒸馏扩散模型轨迹极短，注意力重定向 (attention rerouting) 只在后期步起作用，而物体形状的残差在首次前向就已定型，导致 training-free 物体移除留下明显残留。
Method: ReState 在每次前向中把 mask 内的干净预测朝由输入检索的背景证据校正，权重随噪声水平变化并在最后一次前向衰减为零；同时保留排除物体的注意力作为互补约束，全程不增加去噪器评估。
Result: 在两个成对基准 (paired benchmarks) 与两个少步骨干上，ReState 在 training-free 方法中取得最佳 masked PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS，平均较最强基线提升 3.17 dB PSNR；在 OBER-Test 上三项指标全部超过 50 步 attention-forcing 参考，延迟低 6.7 倍；同一配置无需重调即可迁移到另外两个蒸馏骨干。四个蒸馏骨干上的 magnitude-matched 单次前向干预显示，背景导向的状态校正对最终结果的影响大于注意力重定向。
Conclusion: 少步扩散的物体移除应优先在早期前向做背景导向的状态校正，注意力排除只能作为补充约束；该方法免训练、零额外去噪评估且跨蒸馏骨干免重调。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Density of Thought: Predicting and Steering Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We investigate whether variation in information density across chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning steps predicts answer correctness and can serve as a controllable inference-time target. We prompt frozen pretrained models to solve problems via CoT and measure the density of each reasoning step with two independent metrics: LP variance (how unevenly information is distributed across steps, computed as the variance in mean per-token negative log-likelihood) and the Caveman compression ratio. We then test whether density correlates with, and can be steered to improve, answer correctness. Experiments across six model scales, two training paradigms, and 60 GSM8K problems yield four main findings. First, lower LP variance predicts correctness in supervised fine-tuned (SFT) models, but this relationship weakens with scale and reverses in reinforcement-learning (RL) distilled models. Training paradigm therefore appears more influential than model size in determining density behaviour. Second, synthetic experiments reveal an intrinsic complexity preference: models trained on uniformly distributed data learn complexity-favouring distributions 2.0 to 2.6 times more accurately than simplicity-favouring ones. Third, direct inference-time density steering reduces accuracy from 60.0% to 8.3%, indicating that natural density patterns are functionally important to reasoning. Fourth, pre-generation nudging combining hint injection with contrastive KV-cache steering improves accuracy by 13.3 percentage points, consistent across both metrics. Finally, we introduce Entropy-Gated Density Routing (EGDR), a self-supervised method using token-level Shannon entropy to gate proportional KVcache adjustments during generation, improving accuracy by 10.0 percentage points without any external guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出用两个独立指标（LP variance 与 Caveman 压缩比）度量 CoT 推理步的信息密度，并证明密度可作为推理时的可控目标来提升正确率。在 60 道 GSM8K 上，直接在推理时强制改写密度使准确率从 60.0% 跌到 8.3%，而生成前的 hint 注入加对比式 KV-cache steering 提升 13.3 个百分点，自监督的 Entropy-Gated Density Routing (EGDR) 用 token 级 Shannon 熵门控 KV-cache 调整提升 10.0 个百分点。
Motivation: CoT 推理各步的信息密度差异是否预测答案正确率、能否作为推理时的可控目标，此前缺乏可量化的度量与干预手段。
Method: 用 LP variance（每 token 负对数似然均值在各步的方差）与 Caveman 压缩比两个独立指标度量每步密度；在六个模型规模、SFT 与 RL 蒸馏两种训练范式、60 道 GSM8K 上测试相关性与干预。干预包括直接密度引导、hint 注入结合对比式 KV-cache steering，以及 EGDR——自监督地用 token 级 Shannon 熵门控生成中的比例 KV-cache 调整。
Result: SFT 模型中较低 LP variance 预测正确率，但该关系随规模减弱、在 RL 蒸馏模型中反转；合成实验中模型在均匀分布数据上学到的复杂度偏好分布，比简单度偏好分布准确 2.0 至 2.6 倍；直接推理时密度引导使准确率从 60.0% 降至 8.3%；生成前 hint 注入加对比式 KV-cache steering 提升 13.3 个百分点，两个指标一致；EGDR 在无外部引导下提升 10.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: CoT 的自然密度模式对推理有功能性作用，训练范式比模型规模更决定密度行为；推理时应通过生成前引导或熵门控 KV-cache 调整来利用密度，而非直接强制改写。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Mallea: Building, Steering, and Memorizing Worlds with Coding Agent
papers.abstract_en: Code world models represent world dynamics through explicit state and executable rules. We investigate how to coordinate object representations, behavioral revisions, and visual memory within this formulation. We present Mallea, a system for building, steering, and memorizing worlds from text. A coding agent infers object interaction requirements from the prompt and jointly plans object structure, properties, and rules, favoring compact representations that support those requirements. The world evolves under the planned rules; optional user actions steer it, while text requests can edit properties or extend capabilities with unaffected state preserved. Object texture memory retains reusable appearance only for whitebox-defined objects and adapts it as those objects change. The program advances world state, while a generative renderer combines current structure with remembered appearance. By organizing construction, intervention, and memory around the same objects, Mallea conditions subsequent observations on the latest state and compatible appearance. Project page: https://lxycopper.github.io/Mallea.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mallea 用一个 coding agent 从文本构建可执行的 code world model：由 agent 从 prompt 推断物体交互需求并联合规划物体结构、属性与规则，世界按规则演化，用户动作可转向 (steer)，文本请求可编辑属性或扩展能力且保持状态不被破坏。物体纹理记忆只对 whitebox 定义的物体保留可复用外观并随物体变化自适应，生成式渲染器把当前结构与记忆外观合成后续观测。
Motivation: 把物体表示、行为修订与视觉记忆协调在同一套可执行规则框架下，使文本构建、干预和记忆围绕同一批物体组织，避免编辑后状态与外观失配。
Method: coding agent 从 prompt 推断物体交互需求，联合规划物体结构、属性与规则并偏好紧凑表示；世界按规划规则演化，可选用户动作转向，文本请求编辑属性或扩展能力且保留未受影响状态；object texture memory 只为 whitebox 定义的物体保留外观并随物体变化自适应，程序推进世界状态，生成式渲染器结合当前结构与记忆外观生成观测。
Result: 系统按构建、转向、记忆围绕同一物体组织，使后续观测以最新状态与兼容外观为条件；配套项目页 https://lxycopper.github.io/Mallea。
Conclusion: 把构造、干预与记忆统一到同一批 whitebox 物体上，可以让 code world model 的状态编辑与外观记忆保持一致。

papers.title: LICOA: Learning Instruction-Conditioned Optical Actions for Mobile Spatial Augmented Reality
papers.abstract_en: Spatial augmented reality (SAR) augments physical environments with projected content, but most systems assume that the projector pose, target region, or motion path has been fixed or specified. We instead make projected light an embodied action: given a language instruction and current visual observations, a system must decide how to move and where and at what scale to place the projection. We introduce LICOA to realize this capability. Its differential-drive chassis provides room-scale approach and repositioning, while a steerable mirror with two degrees of freedom (2DoF) and projection scale provide rapid local control of the beam. A shared interface maps synchronized external and onboard RGB cameras with robot control state to physical optical actions across pretrained action models. Because instruction-conditioned optical action lacks dedicated training data and a common evaluation protocol, we construct a matched simulation embodiment and a corpus with 150 tasks and 7,500 rendered episodes, then evaluate models trained only on this corpus in previously unseen real-world environments. Across 480 complete closed-loop real-world execution trials (rollouts) on 12 tasks, the best adapted action model achieves a 57.50% success rate and 40.64% success weighted by path length, compared with 8.33% and 5.15% for the same architecture trained from scratch. A further 150 real-world ablation rollouts support the need for both camera views and coordinated control of the chassis and mirror. These results establish a physical platform, shared perception and optical action interface, corpus, and real-world evaluation protocol for treating projected light as an embodied action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LICOA 把投影光当作具身动作：给定语言指令与当前 RGB 观测，系统自主决定差速底盘如何移动、2DoF 可转镜与投影尺度如何配合来放置光斑。因缺少训练数据与评测协议，作者构建匹配仿真机体与含 150 个任务、7,500 条渲染 episode 的语料，仅在该语料上训练的适配模型在 12 个任务、480 次真实闭环 rollout 上取得 57.50% 成功率与 40.64% 的按路径长度加权成功率，同架构从零训练仅 8.33% 与 5.15%。
Motivation: 空间增强现实 (SAR) 通常假定投影仪位姿、目标区域或运动路径已固定，缺少让系统根据指令与视觉自行决定投影动作的机制，也没有专门的训练数据与统一评测协议。
Method: LICOA 平台由差速底盘（房间尺度接近与重定位）加 2DoF 可转镜与投影尺度（快速局部光束控制）组成；共享接口把同步的外部与机载 RGB 相机及机器人控制状态映射到物理光学动作，驱动多个预训练动作模型。因无专用数据，作者构建匹配的仿真机体与 150 任务、7,500 条渲染 episode 的语料，模型只在该语料上训练，再到未见过的真实环境执行。
Result: 在 12 个任务、480 次完整闭环真实 rollout 上，最佳适配动作模型成功率 57.50%、按路径长度加权成功率 40.64%，同架构从零训练为 8.33% 与 5.15%。另有 150 次真实消融 rollout 支持双相机视角以及底盘与镜面协同控制的必要性。
Conclusion: 把投影光当作具身动作是可行的：仅用仿真渲染语料适配的模型即可在未见过的真实环境中闭环执行，且双视角感知与底盘-镜面协同控制缺一不可。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Diviner: Agentic RCA with Human-Governed Adaptation for Large-Scale Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: Root-cause analysis (RCA) in large-scale distributed systems is challenging because a single symptom can cross service, data, configuration, compute, and organizational boundaries. Responders must assemble incomplete evidence and coordinate experts who hold different parts of the causal path. Generic language-model agents do not solve this problem through tool access alone: they can use stale or mistimed context, interpret failed queries as absent symptoms, report unsupported system state, and overload observability services designed for human-paced use. We present Diviner (Domain-Informed Verifiable Incident Navigation through Evidence and Review), an agentic RCA system operating at Meta and organized around a four-stage reliability lifecycle. Encode combines a large corpus of reviewed incidents with service-owner expertise to produce scoped, versioned skills, workflows, typed tools, and an incident knowledge graph. Execute uses an adaptive Lead and context-isolated workers to apply relevant knowledge to point-in-time evidence and maintain evidence-linked hypotheses. Evaluate compares saved investigation trajectories with responder-reviewed outcomes to measure exact cause, useful direction, and Groundedness. Adapt uses recurring gaps and on-call feedback to derive focused operational- knowledge updates, admitting them only after replay, quality checks, and owner approval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Diviner 是 Meta 内部运行的 agentic 根因分析 (RCA) 系统，按 Encode–Execute–Evaluate–Adapt 四阶段可靠性生命周期组织：把已复盘事故与服务负责人知识编成带版本的 skills、workflows、typed tools 和事故知识图谱，由自适应 Lead 与上下文隔离的 worker 在点时证据上维护证据关联的假设，再用回放、质量检查和 owner 审批把反馈写回知识库。
Motivation: 大规模分布式系统里单一症状会跨服务、数据、配置、算力与组织边界，响应者要在证据不全的情况下拼因果链；通用 LLM agent 仅靠工具调用会用过期或错时上下文、把失败查询当成症状不存在、报告无依据的系统状态，并压垮面向人类节奏设计的可观测服务。
Method: Encode 汇合大量已复盘事故与服务负责人经验，产出带作用域和版本的 skills、workflows、typed tools 与事故知识图谱；Execute 用自适应 Lead 调度上下文隔离的 worker，把知识应用到点时证据并维护与证据绑定的假设；Evaluate 将保存的调查轨迹与响应者复盘结果对比，度量 exact cause、useful direction 与 Groundedness；Adapt 依据反复出现的缺口和 on-call 反馈生成针对性的运营知识更新，仅在回放、质量检查与 owner 批准后准入。
Result: 系统在 Meta 规模的分布式系统上运行，评估以响应者复盘结果为参照，度量 exact cause（精确原因）、useful direction（有用方向）与 Groundedness（有据性）三项；摘要未给出这些指标的具体数值。
Conclusion: Diviner 主张把 RCA 做成带人审门禁的闭环：知识必须版本化、假设必须挂证据、任何知识更新都要先回放和 owner 批准才准入，以此约束 agent 在事故调查中的越界与幻觉。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TimeCap: A Scalable Open-Source Pipeline for Captioning Wearable Health Time-Series Data
papers.abstract_en: Time-series data generated continuously across industrial, environmental, and especially health domains produce multimodal signals whose scale and heterogeneity make their processing and interpretation particularly challenging. Time-Series Language Models (TSLMs) promise scalable interpretation of these signals, yet remain bottlenecked by a fundamental lack of text-annotated time series pairs that are signal-grounded, reproducible, and extensible across modalities and schemas. Existing paired corpora are either closed or limited in scale and modality coverage. Annotation with large language models could scale them up, but its outputs cannot be regenerated exactly, which prevents others from re-deriving, extending, or auditing the resulting corpus. To address this, we release TimeCap, an open deterministic captioning pipeline with three reusable extractor tiers and a cross-channel synthesis layer that operates directly on the signal with no language model in the loop, extensible to new schemas by writing channel definitions alone. This positions TimeCap as a reproducible mechanism for future dataset generation rather than a one-off release. Applying TimeCap to OpenMHC, the MyHeart Counts wearable dataset, yields MHCap, the largest open caption layer for multimodal wearable time-series data. MHCap spans 19 Apple HealthKit channels and 7,005,763 captions over 908,944 person-days. To showcase the impact of the corpus, we train OpenTSLM, a time-series language model, on MHCap and benchmark on health-outcome prediction. Caption-augmented training (OpenTSLM-Cap) outperforms a label-only baseline on 29 of 32 per-user binary evaluations across 8 tasks.
papers.comment: 46 pages, 27 figures, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/SchmiedmayerLab/TimeCAP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TimeCap 是一个完全确定性、无语言模型参与的可复现时间序列打字幕流水线，含三个可复用抽取层与跨通道合成层，只需编写通道定义即可扩展到新 schema。将其用于可穿戴数据集 OpenMHC/MyHeart Counts 生成 MHCap（19 个 Apple HealthKit 通道、7,005,763 条字幕、908,944 人-日），并训练 OpenTSLM：带字幕训练的 OpenTSLM-Cap 在 8 个任务的 32 项按用户二分类评测中有 29 项超过仅用标签的基线。
Motivation: Time-Series Language Models 受制于缺少信号对齐、可复现、跨模态可扩展的文本-时间序列配对语料；现有配对语料封闭或规模与模态覆盖有限，而用 LLM 批量标注的输出无法精确重生成，他人无法复现、扩展或审计。
Method: 提出开源确定性打字幕流水线 TimeCap：三个可复用的抽取层 (extractor tiers) 加一个直接作用于信号、不引入语言模型的跨通道合成层，扩展新 schema 只需写通道定义。将其应用于 OpenMHC（MyHeart Counts 可穿戴数据集）生成语料 MHCap，再在 MHCap 上训练时间序列语言模型 OpenTSLM 并做健康结局预测基准。
Result: MHCap 覆盖 19 个 Apple HealthKit 通道、7,005,763 条字幕、908,944 人-日，是最大的开放多模态可穿戴时间序列字幕层。在健康结局预测的 8 个任务、32 项按用户二分类评测中，字幕增强训练的 OpenTSLM-Cap 在 29 项上超过仅用标签的基线。
Conclusion: 确定性、无 LLM 参与的打字幕机制可以把可复现的语料生成做成可重复的基础设施而非一次性发布，且字幕增强训练对按用户的健康结局二分类预测有效。
