papers.title: Regret Lower Bound for Online Learning of Quantum States with Logarithmic Loss, with Applications to Quantum State Tomography and Confidence Sequences for Matrix Means
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of online learning of quantum states with logarithmic loss, which is a quantum generalization of online portfolio selection and has applications to quantum state tomography, the task of estimating an unknown quantum state from measurement outcomes. We first establish a regret lower bound, showing that the regret rates of Exponential Weights and the algorithm of Tseng et al. (2025) have optimal polynomial dependence on the dimension. Our analysis leads to two further results. First, our lower-bound proof leads to a quantum state tomography algorithm that is sample optimal up to polylogarithmic factors in the sample size. Second, we develop an algorithm for constructing confidence sequences for the mean of a matrix-valued random variable. A numerical experiment shows that the latter algorithm is competitive with existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把在线投资组合选择的对数损失 regret 下界推广到量子态在线学习，证明 Exponential Weights 与 Tseng et al. (2025) 算法的 regret 率对维度的多项式依赖是最优的。该下界证明同时导出一个样本量上至多差 polylog 因子的量子态层析 (quantum state tomography) 算法，以及一个构造矩阵值随机变量均值置信序列 (confidence sequences) 的算法，后者在数值实验中与现有方法相当。
Motivation: 量子态在线学习缺少 regret 下界，无法判断 Exponential Weights 等算法对维度的多项式依赖是否已最优；矩阵均值的置信序列也缺少可用的构造方法。
Method: 以对数损失下的在线量子态学习（在线投资组合选择的量子推广）为框架建立 regret 下界；由下界证明反向导出量子态层析算法；另构造矩阵值随机变量均值的置信序列算法，并做数值实验与现有方法比较。
Result: 证明 Exponential Weights 与 Tseng et al. (2025) 算法的 regret 率对维度的多项式依赖最优；导出的量子态层析算法在样本量上 sample optimal 至多差 polylog 因子；数值实验显示矩阵均值置信序列算法与现有方法相比具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 对数损失下量子态在线学习的维度依赖存在可证的最优性界限，且该下界技术可转成样本最优的层析算法与可用的矩阵均值置信序列。

papers.title: Auditing Escalation Reliability in Healthcare LLM Agents: A Perturbation-Controlled Benchmark of Workflow-State Failures
authors: Zihao Zheng (Washington University in St. Louis)
Junyi Yao (Washington University in St. Louis)
Jiayu Long (Washington University in St. Louis)
papers.abstract_en: Trustworthy biomedical AI requires reliable action selection when evidence is missing, stale, conflicting, or late, not only accurate answers on static inputs. We instantiate an episode-level evaluation protocol as 400 synthetic healthcare workflow episodes: 40 hand-authored semantic seeds across four task classes, two surface parameterizations, and five controlled variants, scored on ANSWER/ASK CLARIFICATION/ABSTAIN/ESCALATE under a pre-declared 5:1 missed-versus-unnecessary escalation cost. Reference actions are single-author study-policy labels, not clinician-adjudicated ground truth. Across five open-weight configurations (1.7B--9.7B), clean decision accuracy reaches 0.97, yet uncertainty-prompted models miss 32--97% of required escalations. The stronger 9.7B configuration narrows but does not remove the gap, falling from 0.97 clean accuracy to 0.78 under conflict. Verbalized confidence is inconsistent (ECE 0.10--0.54; failure AUROC 0.48--0.77), and a development-tuned confidence-only policy yields no utility gain. A transparent workflow-aware controller improves 5:1 utility for every model and reduces missed escalations to 0.12--0.24, at specificity 0.83--0.93. However, a 30-concept lexical stress test reduces each rule detector's recall from 1.00 on trigger phrases to 0.00 on unseen paraphrases, limiting the controller claim to this benchmark. Seed-clustered statistics, ablations, cross-task transfer, raw outputs, and manifests are packaged for audit. The results motivate explicit workflow-state evaluation while showing that apparently effective routing controls need their own generalization tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文提出 400 条合成医疗工作流 episode 的扰动控制基准，评测 LLM 智能体在证据缺失、过期、冲突时的升级 (ESCALATE) 决策。五个开源模型 (1.7B–9.7B) 干净决策准确率达 0.97，但冲突扰动下 9.7B 模型降至 0.78，uncertainty prompt 下漏升级率 32–97%。透明 workflow-aware 控制器把漏升级压到 0.12–0.24（specificity 0.83–0.93），但 30 概念词法压力测试使规则检测器从未见同义改写的 recall 1.00 跌到 0.00。
Motivation: 医疗 LLM 智能体在证据缺失、过期、冲突或迟到时需要正确选择升级动作，而静态问答基准只测答案准确率，无法暴露工作流状态失效。
Method: 构建 400 条合成 episode：40 个人工语义种子、四类任务、两种表面参数化、五种受控扰动变体；按预声明的 5:1 漏升级对不必要升级代价，对 ANSWER/ASK CLARIFICATION/ABSTAIN/ESCALATE 打分，参考动作为单作者政策标注。评测五个开源配置 (1.7B–9.7B)，并比较 uncertainty prompt、开发集调优的置信度策略与透明 workflow-aware 控制器，附种子聚类统计、消融与跨任务迁移。
Result: 干净决策准确率最高 0.97；uncertainty prompt 下模型漏掉 32–97% 的必需升级。9.7B 配置从干净 0.97 降至冲突下 0.78。言语化置信度不一致：ECE 0.10–0.54，失败 AUROC 0.48–0.77，开发集调优的纯置信度策略无效用增益。控制器对每个模型都提升 5:1 效用，漏升级降至 0.12–0.24，specificity 0.83–0.93；但 30 概念词法压力测试使各规则检测器在触发短语上 recall 1.00、在未见同义改写上降至 0.00。
Conclusion: 工作流状态需要显式评测；看似有效的路由控制器必须自己通过泛化测试，其结论仅限于本基准。参考标注为单作者政策标签而非临床医生裁定的真值。

papers.title: TRACER: Trajectory-Aware Tool Retrieval for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Modern agents select tools from registries, but exposing entire registries incurs high token costs and can impair selection as they grow. We present TRACER, a retrieval front-end that indexes observed tool-call sequences in a trie and ranks continuations using a learned blend of empirical and contextual priors. On a mixed retail-and-telecom $τ^2$ environment, TRACER improves GPT-5.4's tool-selection accuracy by 4.7 points while reducing input tokens per step by 80%, exposing just 5 of 128 tools. In autonomous full-turn execution, it matches GPT-5.4's full-registry task success with 61% fewer input tokens per step. Across six environments and four models, TRACER improves tool-selection accuracy over full-registry selection in 21 of 24 model-environment pairs, with average gains of 6 to 10 points; the three exceptions trail by at most 2.2. We analyze failures in both regimes to identify directions for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACER 为 LLM agent 做工具检索：把观测到的工具调用序列建成 trie 索引，用经验先验与上下文先验的可学习加权对续接工具排序，每步只暴露 128 个工具中的 5 个。在混合零售-电信 τ² 环境上，GPT-5.4 的工具选择准确率提升 4.7 点、每步输入 token 减少 80%；自主全轮执行中以每步少 61% 输入 token 追平全注册表任务成功率。
Motivation: 把完整工具注册表暴露给 agent 会带来高昂 token 成本，且注册表变大时会损害工具选择质量。
Method: TRACER 作为检索前端，将观测到的工具调用序列索引为 trie，并用经验先验 (empirical prior) 与上下文先验 (contextual prior) 的可学习混合对候选续接排序，每步只向模型展示少量工具。
Result: 在混合零售与电信 τ² 环境上，GPT-5.4 工具选择准确率提升 4.7 点，每步输入 token 减少 80%（仅暴露 128 个中的 5 个）；自主全轮执行中以每步少 61% 输入 token 达到与全注册表相同的任务成功率。跨 6 个环境与 4 个模型的 24 个模型-环境组合中，21 个优于全注册表选择，平均增益 6 至 10 点，3 个例外最多落后 2.2 点。
Conclusion: 按调用历史检索续接工具可以在大幅削减 token 的同时保持甚至提升工具选择准确率，但存在少数组合反而落后的情形，作者据此分析两种体制下的失败模式。

papers.title: TRACER: A Multimodal Harness for Patient Care in Hospitals
papers.abstract_en: Continuous video and clinical records provide complementary information for understanding how patient behavior evolves over a hospital stay. A central challenge is how to represent behavior across the entire stay while preserving access to fine-grained visual and clinical evidence. We introduce TRACER, a training-free multimodal harness that constructs minute-level action records from video and combines them with clinical records into hourly reports. The harness equips an LLM agent with tools to query this hierarchy, inspect relevant video, and retrieve clinical records. To evaluate TRACER, we construct two benchmarks. The first contains 397 annotated one-minute clips spanning 15 atomic actions; the second poses 144 clinician-informed multiple-choice questions, grounded in 264 hours of video and clinical records from two ICU patients. TRACER achieves up to 84.8% accuracy for action detection and 61.0% QA accuracy versus 49.3% for the strongest baseline using the same backbone. Across 280 patients spanning approximately 60,000 camera-hours, TRACER identifies significantly less purposeful activity in patients with a positive delirium assessment during their stay than in those without (p < 0.0001). Our results show that combining continuous video with clinical records can support understanding of patient behavior over time and across patient cohorts without training on protected health data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACER 是一个免训练的多模态医院患者照护 harness：从连续视频构建分钟级动作记录，与临床记录合成小时级报告，再交给带查询工具的 LLM agent 检索视频与病历。在自建基准上动作检测准确率最高 84.8%，QA 61.0%（同 backbone 最强基线 49.3%）；在 280 名患者、约 60,000 摄像机小时上，谵妄评估阳性患者的有目的活动显著更少（p < 0.0001）。
Motivation: 住院期间的行为理解需要同时保留全程覆盖与细粒度视觉/临床证据，而连续视频与病历是互补却难以统一表示的两种模态。
Method: 免训练 harness 分三层组织证据：视频转分钟级动作记录、与临床记录合并为小时级报告，LLM agent 用工具查询该层级、回看相关视频片段并检索临床记录。评测自建两个基准：397 段一分钟标注片段（15 类原子动作），以及基于两名 ICU 患者 264 小时视频与病历的 144 道临床医生设计选择题。
Result: 动作检测准确率最高 84.8%；QA 准确率 61.0%，同 backbone 最强基线 49.3%。在 280 名患者、约 60,000 摄像机小时的队列上，谵妄评估阳性患者住院期间的有目的活动显著少于阴性患者（p < 0.0001）。
Conclusion: 连续视频与临床记录结合即可在不使用受保护健康数据训练的前提下理解患者行为的时间演化与队列差异。

papers.title: Rethinking Learning from Label Proportions via Moment Matching
papers.abstract_en: Learning from label proportions (LLP) is a weakly supervised setting where training data are grouped into bags with only bag-level label proportions observed, and the goal is to learn a classifier that predicts labels for individual instances. Recently, a large body of methods has emerged; however, most of them rely on the assumption that instance-label pairs are sampled i.i.d. and randomly assembled into bags, an assumption often violated in real-world scenarios. Our experimental results indicate that these methods perform suboptimally under non-random settings. In this work, we adopt a more realistic assumption: bags are sampled i.i.d., and instance labels are conditionally independent given the instances. Under this setting, we show that the label counts follow a Poisson multinomial distribution. Motivated by this observation, we propose LLP via moment matching (LLP-MM), a simple yet effective approach which leverages multi-order factorial moments as training objectives, encouraging the classifier predictions to match these moments and thereby more fully exploit the underlying statistical structure of the data. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets under various bag construction strategies demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach while maintaining high computational efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/TianhaoMa5/LLP-MM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLP-MM 把学习标签比例 (LLP) 的假设从「实例-标签对独立同分布再随机组袋」改为「袋独立同分布、给定实例时标签条件独立」，据此证明袋内标签计数服从 Poisson multinomial 分布，并用多阶阶乘矩 (multi-order factorial moments) 作为训练目标让分类器预测去匹配这些矩。在多种非随机组袋策略的基准数据集上，该方法有效且保持高计算效率。
Motivation: 现有 LLP 方法大多依赖实例-标签对 i.i.d. 并随机组袋的假设，而真实场景常是非随机组袋；作者的实验显示这类方法在非随机设定下表现次优。
Method: 在「袋 i.i.d.、给定实例时标签条件独立」的新假设下推导标签计数的 Poisson multinomial 分布，提出 LLP-MM：以多阶阶乘矩为训练目标，使分类器预测匹配这些矩，从而利用数据的统计结构。
Result: 实验结果表明依赖 i.i.d. 随机组袋假设的方法在非随机设定下表现次优；LLP-MM 在多种组袋策略 (bag construction strategies) 的基准数据集上验证有效，并保持高计算效率。
Conclusion: 把 LLP 的建模单位从随机实例对换成条件独立的袋内标签计数，其分布是 Poisson multinomial，用矩匹配即可在非随机组袋下更充分地利用数据统计结构且计算开销低。

papers.title: Behavioral Compositionality of Sparse Autoencoder Representations
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) represent model activations with sparse, linearly decoded features, but the downstream effects of those features need not compose additively. We introduce SAE Additivity Residuals (SAR), which measure the behavioral variation left unexplained above a chosen interaction order. Under independent feature subset sampling, population SAR is exactly the normalized energy of interactions above that order and bounds coalition ordering error for the optimal low order approximation. To distinguish compositionality associated with the SAE representation from that induced by downstream computation, we compare learned SAE coordinates with sum preserving random rotations of the same selected subspace and find lower first order residuals for the learned coordinates across all 18 model and behavior settings. The coordinates are nevertheless not fully additive: pairwise terms improve held out coalition ordering in every setting and outperform parameter matched models using randomly selected third order terms. In a combined steering experiment, pairwise modeling raises rank fidelity from 0.5874 to 0.7790 and reduces ordering error from 0.1444 to 0.0606. Together, these results show that SAE coordinates support comparatively compositional behavioral descriptions while faithful joint explanations and interventions still require interactions beyond individual feature effects. Code is available at https://github.com/OpenSAE/SAE-Behavioral-Compositionality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SAE Additivity Residuals (SAR)，度量稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 特征在给定交互阶之上仍未被解释的行为变异；在 18 个模型与行为设置中，学习到的 SAE 坐标一阶残差均低于同子空间的保和随机旋转，但二阶项在每个设置上都改进留出 coalition ordering，联合 steering 实验中 rank fidelity 从 0.5874 升到 0.7790、ordering error 从 0.1444 降到 0.0606。
Motivation: SAE 特征被线性解码，但其下游行为效应未必可加；需要区分组合性是来自 SAE 表示本身还是下游计算，并量化低阶近似的 ordering error。
Method: 定义 SAR 度量高于指定交互阶的剩余行为变异；在独立特征子集采样下证明 population SAR 恰为该阶以上交互的归一化能量，并给出最优低阶近似的 coalition ordering error 上界；将学习坐标与同一所选子空间的保和随机旋转对比，并做参数匹配的随机三阶项模型与联合 steering 实验。
Result: 学习到的 SAE 坐标在全部 18 个模型与行为设置上一阶残差都低于保和随机旋转；二阶项在每个设置上都改进留出 coalition ordering，并优于参数匹配的随机三阶项模型；联合 steering 中二阶建模把 rank fidelity 从 0.5874 提到 0.7790，ordering error 从 0.1444 降到 0.0606。
Conclusion: SAE 坐标支持相对可组合的行为描述，但忠实的联合解释与干预仍需要超越单特征效应的交互项。

papers.title: Energy Flow Shapes the Decomposition Dynamics of a Reactive Atmospheric Intermediate
papers.abstract_en: The unimolecular dynamics of Criegee intermediates depend strongly on their internal energy, which can differ substantially between nascent atmospheric species and laboratory-prepared reactants. Here, the decomposition dynamics of {\it anti-}CH$_3$CHOO are investigated using molecular dynamics simulations on a neural network-based potential energy surface under thermal and mode-selective vibrational excitation. Simulations were performed at internal energies representative of those released during ozonolysis (chemical/thermal preparation, TP) or following vibrational excitation (VibEx) along the CH-stretching mode with two or three quanta, as can be done in laboratory studies. These excitation conditions strongly affect reaction yields and kinetics, with VibEx promoting passage across the initial cyclization barrier. For TP, 35 kcal/mol of internal energy are required to form molecular products, whereas for VibEx, 27 kcal/mol are sufficient. Although TP and VibEx ensembles access largely the same fragmentation pathways with comparable relative yields, the absolute product yields, characteristic timescales, and kinetic behavior differ substantially. Methyldioxirane is found to be a kinetic trap along the pathway. The resulting molecular-level description of {\it anti-}CH$_3$CHOO decomposition provides guidance for interpreting experiments and contributes to a broader understanding of energy-dependent Criegee-intermediate dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用神经网络势能面 (NNP) 上的分子动力学模拟对比 anti-CH3CHOO 的热/化学制备 (TP) 与 CH 伸缩模选激发 (VibEx) 分解：VibEx 促进越过初始环化势垒，TP 需 35 kcal/mol 内能才生成分子产物，而 VibEx 只需 27 kcal/mol。两种系综通向大体相同的碎裂通道且相对产率相当，但绝对产率、特征时间尺度与动力学行为差异显著，亚甲基二氧杂环戊烷 (methyldioxirane) 是该路径上的动力学陷阱。
Motivation: 臭氧解释生成的大气 Criegee 中间体初生内能与实验室制备样品差别很大，而单分子分解动力学强烈依赖内能，导致实验产率与时间尺度难以直接对应到大气情形。
Method: 在神经网络拟合的势能面上做分子动力学模拟，分别模拟臭氧解释放内能对应的热/化学制备 (TP) 系综，以及沿 CH 伸缩模激发 2 或 3 个量子的 VibEx 系综，比较反应产率、时间尺度与通道。
Result: TP 需 35 kcal/mol 内能才形成分子产物，VibEx 27 kcal/mol 即可；VibEx 促进越过初始环化势垒。TP 与 VibEx 访问大体相同的碎裂通道且相对产率可比，但绝对产率、特征时间尺度与动力学行为差异显著；methyldioxirane 被识别为路径上的动力学陷阱。
Conclusion: 能量如何注入（热制备还是模选激发）决定 anti-CH3CHOO 分解的产率与动力学，即使最终通道相同；该分子层面描述可用于解释实验并推广到能量依赖的 Criegee 中间体动力学。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Fractional Power-of-Two Quantization for Efficient and Effective Multiplier-Free LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) demand efficient inference, where the multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations in linear projections dominate compute and energy cost. Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces this cost by mapping weights and activations to low-bit integers. Power-of-Two (PoT) weight quantization promises efficient multiplier-free LLM inference via shift-add logic, but suffers significant accuracy degradation at low bitwidths due to its coarse base-2 quantization grid. We introduce Fractional PoT (FPoT), a base-$\sqrt{2}$ (half-octave) fractional PoT grid that achieves practical 4-bit weight quantization while preserving a fully integer shift-add datapath. The method combines (i) the base-$\sqrt{2}$ weight grid with uniform integer activations, (ii) a calibration-time grid-alignment refinement absorbed into the static per-channel scale, and (iii) a lightweight 1-adder $\sqrt{2}$ approximation whose error is absorbed during weight calibration via approximate-grid quantization, yielding a processing element (PE) with significantly fewer gates than a 4-bit integer multiplier. On Llama-3-8B with 4-bit weight and activation quantization, FPoT improves zero-shot commonsense reasoning performance by 8.72% relative to the PoT baseline, while maintaining performance close to the uniform integer baseline, with only a negligible 0.4%p degradation. These results hold across various configurations spanning seven models and three bit-widths. Furthermore, FPoT can be integrated with state-of-the-art LLM PTQ methods, demonstrating framework-agnostic applicability.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 19 figures, 22 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Fractional PoT (FPoT)：把 PoT 权重量化网格从 base-2 换成 base-√2（half-octave），配合校准期网格对齐细化与 1-adder 的 √2 近似，保留纯整数 shift-add 数据通路的同时实现可用的 4-bit 权重量化。在 Llama-3-8B 的 4-bit 权重+激活设置下，zero-shot commonsense reasoning 相对 PoT 基线提升 8.72%，距 uniform integer 基线仅差 0.4 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM 推理的算力与能耗主要来自线性投影的 MAC；PoT 权重量化虽可用 shift-add 免乘法，但 base-2 网格太粗，低 bitwidth 下精度显著下降。
Method: FPoT 三件套：base-√2 权重网格配 uniform integer 激活；校准期的网格对齐细化并入静态 per-channel scale；轻量 1-adder √2 近似在权重量化阶段以 approximate-grid quantization 吸收误差，最终 PE 门数显著少于 4-bit 整数乘法器。
Result: Llama-3-8B 4-bit W4A4 下 zero-shot commonsense reasoning 相对 PoT 基线 +8.72%，相对 uniform integer 基线仅退化 0.4 个百分点；结论横跨 7 个模型、3 种 bit-width 配置，并可与 SOTA LLM PTQ 方法集成。
Conclusion: 把 PoT 网格细化到 base-√2 并把近似误差在校准中吸收，可以在保持免乘法整数通路的前提下把 4-bit 权重量化做到接近 uniform integer 的精度，且与具体 PTQ 框架无关。

papers.title: Isolating a Language Model's Judgment with a Label-Free Subspace
papers.abstract_en: Language models are often asked to make judgments: whether a proposed answer is correct, whether one statement follows logically from another, or whether a response is safe. Yet changing the instructions that specify how the judgment should be expressed can make the final answer less reliable, even for the same input. We ask whether this reflects a change in internal judgment or a failure to express it. Comparing hidden-state vectors for the same input under different instructions, we find that their differences concentrate in a low-dimensional expression subspace. We identify this subspace without benchmark labels and remove its contribution from a linear predictor to obtain an isolated judgment. Across correctness, entailment, and safety, the isolated judgment remains reliable under instructions not used to identify the subspace, even when the model's final answer and the original predictor degrade. When the judgment question is negated, isolation raises the predictor's AUROC from 0.504 to 0.825 for entailment and from 0.480 to 0.891 for safety. We also find that judgment is readable in earlier layers, before the expression subspace begins to disrupt the predictor. Together, these results provide a way to separate judgment from expression and recover internal judgments even when the model's final answers are unreliable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 发现同一输入在不同指令下，语言模型隐状态差异集中在一个低维的「表达子空间」(expression subspace)；无需 benchmark 标签识别该子空间并从线性预测器中剔除其贡献后，得到的「隔离判断」在未用于识别子空间的指令上仍可靠，即使模型最终答案与原预测器已退化。判断问题被否定时，隔离把 entailment 的 AUROC 从 0.504 提到 0.825、safety 从 0.480 提到 0.891。
Motivation: 改变表述判断的指令会让同一输入的最终答案更不可靠，需要区分这是内部判断本身变了，还是判断的表达方式失败了。
Method: 比较同一输入在不同指令下的隐状态向量，定位低维表达子空间（不使用 benchmark 标签），再从线性预测器中移除该子空间的贡献以得到隔离判断；在 correctness、entailment、safety 三类判断任务上检验，并观察各层可读性。
Result: 判断问题被否定时，隔离后 entailment AUROC 从 0.504 升至 0.825，safety 从 0.480 升至 0.891；隔离判断在未用于识别子空间的指令上保持可靠，而模型最终答案与原预测器退化；判断在更早的层即可读出，早于表达子空间开始干扰预测器的层。
Conclusion: 判断与表达可以在表示层面分离：剔除低维表达子空间后，即使最终答案不可靠，也能恢复模型的内部判断。

papers.title: What do AI chatbots do after users decline therapeutic redirection for suicide thoughts?
papers.abstract_en: Safety evaluations of artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots focus on therapeutic redirection, statements urging users who disclose suicide thoughts to seek help from crisis lines or other human sources. How chatbots respond when users refuse that help is unclear. This cross-sectional audit ran 2,550 scripted multi-turn conversations in September 2026. Each conversation opened with a disclosure of suicide thoughts at 3 levels of severity, answered every referral with up to 10 standardized refusals and then changed the subject. All 2,550 conversations included a referral, 2,542 (99.7%) in the first reply. However, mean persistence ranged from 0.01 to 9.94 refusals across chatbots. Newer versions of all 5 chatbots tested in 2 versions persisted less than older versions (each P < .05). Compared with passive ideation, a disclosure of intent was associated with 1.26 more refusals sustained (95% CI, 1.06-1.46) and higher odds of renewed referral after the topic change (odds ratio, 10.07; 95% CI, 7.43-13.66). Chatbots that persisted less in referral more often presented themselves as the user's support (Spearman rho = -0.80; P < .001). Of 8,818 refusal-phase replies urging outside help, only 173 (2.0%) asked about barriers to seeking it. Chatbots uniformly recommended outside help after disclosures of suicide thoughts but varied widely in persisting in those recommendations, with newer versions persisting less. Safety evaluations should test what happens after a crisis referral is refused, not only whether one is offered.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 5 个 AI 聊天机器人做跨版本横断面审计：披露自杀意念后它们几乎都给出求助转介，但用户拒绝后是否坚持差异极大（平均持续 0.01 至 9.94 次拒绝），且所有 5 个聊天机器人的新版都比旧版更少坚持（各 P < .05）。作者主张安全评测应考察转介被拒之后的对话行为，而不只看是否给出转介。
Motivation: 现有 AI 聊天机器人安全评测只检查是否给出危机转介（劝用户打热线或求助真人），但用户拒绝该转介后机器人如何应对完全不清楚，而这正是自杀意念披露场景里的关键安全环节。
Method: 2026 年 9 月的横断面审计，运行 2,550 段脚本化多轮对话：每段以 3 个严重程度等级之一披露自杀意念，对每次转介用最多 10 个标准化拒绝回应，随后切换话题；覆盖 5 个聊天机器人及其新旧两个版本。
Result: 2,550 段对话全部出现转介，其中 2,542 段（99.7%）在首次回复中给出；但各聊天机器人平均坚持次数从 0.01 到 9.94 次拒绝不等。5 个聊天机器人的新版均比旧版更少坚持（各 P < .05）。相比被动意念，表达自杀意图与多坚持 1.26 次拒绝相关（95% CI 1.06–1.46），且话题切换后重新转介的比值比为 10.07（95% CI 7.43–13.66）。转介坚持度更低的聊天机器人更常把自己呈现为用户的支持来源（Spearman rho = -0.80，P < .001）。8,818 条催促外部求助的拒绝阶段回复中，仅 173 条（2.0%）询问求助障碍。
Conclusion: 聊天机器人在自杀意念披露后一致推荐外部求助，但在坚持程度上差异巨大，且新版坚持更少；安全评测应测试转介被拒之后发生什么，而不只看是否提供了转介。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Do VLAs Really Follow Instructions? Diagnosing How-Level Instruction Following in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are expected to follow instructions like their language backbones, yet prior work has focused on What-level instructions that specify the task rather than How-level instructions that specify how to carry it out. Through our diagnoses, we find that How-level instructions do not help current VLAs and lower task success. We hypothesize that pairing each training episode with a single instruction limits How-level instruction following, and show that training with segment-level enriched instructions makes actions respond to such instructions without consistently raising task success. To measure How-level instruction following beyond standard benchmarks, we introduce SIMPLER-IN, where success requires conditions given only in the instruction. It shows that the gained responsiveness does not extend to demanding or out-of-distribution How-level instructions. How-level instruction following thus remains an open challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 诊断 VLA 模型对 How 级指令（规定怎么做而非做什么）的遵循能力：加入 How 级指令反而降低任务成功率，作者归因于每个训练片段只配一条指令。改用片段级增强指令 (segment-level enriched instructions) 训练后，动作确实会对这类指令产生响应，但任务成功率并未一致提升，且新基准 SIMPLER-IN 显示这种响应性无法迁移到苛刻或分布外 (OOD) 的 How 级指令。
Motivation: 既有 VLA 指令遵循研究集中在 What 级（指定任务）指令，忽略规定执行方式的 How 级指令，导致这类指令遵循能力缺乏诊断手段与衡量基准。
Method: 先诊断现有 VLA 对 How 级指令的反应（发现其降低任务成功率），提出“每个训练片段仅配单条指令限制了 How 级遵循”的假设并用片段级增强指令训练验证；再提出新基准 SIMPLER-IN，其成功判据要求仅在指令中给出的条件被满足。
Result: 诊断发现 How 级指令对当前 VLA 无帮助并降低任务成功率；片段级增强指令训练使动作对这类指令产生响应，但未一致提升任务成功率；SIMPLER-IN 显示获得的响应性无法扩展到苛刻或分布外的 How 级指令。
Conclusion: How 级指令遵循对当前 VLA 仍是未解难题：响应性可被训练激发，但不等于任务成功，也不泛化到 OOD 指令。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FocusOPD: Structure-Guided On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation enables rectified-flow models with diffusion-transformer architectures to combine task-specific capabilities within a single student. However, matching model outputs does not guarantee that their internal representations are aligned, and it remains unclear where and when additional feature supervision is most useful. We analyze the teacher-student feature mismatch across Transformer blocks and denoising timesteps, and find that the mismatch is concentrated in deeper Transformer blocks during early denoising and persists after OPD distillation, indicating ineffective distillation. Motivated by this observation, we introduce FocusOPD, which augments the base OPD objective with token-wise directional feature alignment restricted to deep layers and early denoising steps. Across two rectified-flow backbones and multiple OPD objectives, FocusOPD improves capability transfer in compositional generation, text rendering, and preference-based evaluation. On the primary benchmark, it improves over DiffusionOPD from 0.953 to 0.967 on GenEval, from 23.797 to 23.944 on PickScore, and from 6.052 to 6.199 on LAION-Aesthetic. Ablations show that selective deep and early supervision is more effective and efficient than alignment over the full network and trajectory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FocusOPD 发现多教师 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中师生特征失配集中在深层 Transformer block 与早期去噪步，且在 OPD 后仍然残留，因此在 OPD 目标上叠加仅限深层、早期去噪步的 token 级方向性特征对齐。在两个 rectified-flow backbone 上，GenEval 从 DiffusionOPD 的 0.953 提到 0.967，PickScore 从 23.797 提到 23.944，LAION-Aesthetic 从 6.052 提到 6.199；消融显示选择性深层早期监督比全网络全轨迹对齐更有效也更高效。
Motivation: 多教师 OPD 只对齐模型输出，不保证内部表征对齐，且不清楚在哪些层、哪些去噪步加特征监督才有用，导致能力迁移在组合生成与文字渲染上受限。
Method: 先跨 Transformer block 与去噪步分析师生特征失配分布，再在基础 OPD 目标上加入 token-wise directional feature alignment，约束到深层 block 与早期去噪步；在两个 rectified-flow backbone、多种 OPD 目标上验证，并做全网络/全轨迹对齐的消融。
Result: 主基准上相对 DiffusionOPD：GenEval 0.953 → 0.967，PickScore 23.797 → 23.944，LAION-Aesthetic 6.052 → 6.199；在组合生成、文字渲染与偏好评估上均改善能力迁移，消融显示选择性深层早期监督优于全网络全轨迹对齐。
Conclusion: 特征失配是 OPD 迁移失效的主因，把特征监督集中在深层与早期去噪步即可用更少开销换来更强的能力迁移。

papers.title: System1-Arena: Which Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often make discrete decisions, such as flagging phishing or escalating to a human. System-1 models, such as Jev and the OpenAI Decisions API, return probabilities over options in a single forward pass, while System-2 approaches generate reasoning steps. Which decisions can System-1 models handle, and which require generative reasoning? We introduce System1-Arena, a benchmark that gives all models the same decision requests and scores their probabilities. It contains 92k questions across 105 tasks from 268 public sources, in four groups: text classification and knowledge, applied decisions, evaluation and control, and agent and action. It also includes 138 closed-loop environments, from web shopping and SWE-bench coding control to robotics, games, and driving; in real-time mode, the world evolves while a model decides. We evaluate 30 models: 7 closed LLMs, 13 open LLMs read at the answer token, and 10 System-1 models. The largest System-1 models match or exceed fast closed LLMs in non-agentic accuracy, with better-calibrated probabilities at one-quarter of the latency. A reasoning LLM is the most accurate, at about 70x the cost of a fast LLM. In closed loops, large open LLMs succeed most often (up to 32.9%); small System-1 models rarely succeed.
papers.comment: 40 pages. Code: https://github.com/TianyuCodings/S1-Arena ; leaderboard: https://tianyucodings.github.io/S1-Arena ; dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/C-Tianyu/S1-Arena
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: System1-Arena 是一个统一决策请求、按模型输出概率打分的基准，用来判定哪些离散决策可交给单次前向的 System-1 模型、哪些必须走生成式推理。它含 92k 问题、105 任务、268 个公开来源与 138 个闭环环境，评测 30 个模型：最大的 System-1 模型在非智能体任务上追平或超过快速闭源 LLM，概率校准更好且延迟只有四分之一；但闭环环境中大型开源 LLM 成功率最高（最高 32.9%），小型 System-1 模型几乎不成功。
Motivation: LLM 需要做的离散决策（如标记钓鱼、升级人工）既可能由单次前向的 System-1 模型给出概率完成，也可能必须生成推理步骤；缺少一个让所有模型面对相同决策请求、按概率统一打分的评测来划清两者边界。
Method: 构建 System1-Arena 基准：92k 问题覆盖 105 个任务、268 个公开来源，分文本分类与知识、应用决策、评估与控制、智能体与动作四组；另含 138 个闭环环境（网页购物、SWE-bench 编码控制、机器人、游戏、驾驶），实时模式下世界随模型决策演化。评测 30 个模型：7 个闭源 LLM、13 个在 answer token 处读取的开源 LLM、10 个 System-1 模型（如 Jev、OpenAI Decisions API）。
Result: 最大的 System-1 模型在非智能体准确率上追平或超过快速闭源 LLM，概率校准更好，延迟为其四分之一；最准确的是一个 reasoning LLM，成本约为快速 LLM 的 70 倍。闭环环境中大型开源 LLM 成功率最高（最高 32.9%），小型 System-1 模型很少成功。
Conclusion: 非智能体的离散决策可交给 System-1 模型以四分之一延迟换取相当准确率与更好校准，而闭环、随时间演化的决策仍需生成式推理的大型 LLM。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 构建 System1-Arena 基准：92k 问题覆盖 105 个任务、268 个公开来源，分文本分类与知识、应用决策、评估与控制、智能体与动作四组；另含 138 个闭环环境（网页购物、SWE-bench 编码控制、机器人、游戏、驾驶），实时模式下世界随模型决策演化。评测 30 个模型：7 个闭源 LLM、13 个在 answer token 处读取的开源 LLM、10 个 System-1 模型（如 Jev、OpenAI Decisions API）。
summary_sections.result: 最大的 System-1 模型在非智能体准确率上追平或超过快速闭源 LLM，概率校准更好，延迟为其四分之一；最准确的是一个 reasoning LLM，成本约为快速 LLM 的 70 倍。闭环环境中大型开源 LLM 成功率最高（最高 32.9%），小型 System-1 模型很少成功。
summary_sections.conclusion: 非智能体的离散决策可交给 System-1 模型以四分之一延迟换取相当准确率与更好校准，而闭环、随时间演化的决策仍需生成式推理的大型 LLM。

papers.title: A Responsibility-Centered Coordination Mechanism for Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Centralized orchestration provides comprehensive multi-agent coordination but creates bottlenecks in scalability, adaptability, and collective performance. Decentralized approaches alleviate these bottlenecks by distributing coordination across agents, yet often leave responsibility for delegated dependencies and failure recovery unclear. To address this gap, we propose RCM, a responsibility-centered coordination mechanism that leverages commitments to couple task delegation with explicit responsibilities of the involved parties. Through recursive delegation, agents retain their upstream responsibilities while locally orchestrating downstream commitments, thereby preserving accountability across delegation chains, creating a network of local orchestration. We operationalize this mechanism locally through responsibility-constrained decision-making and a responsibility-oriented communication protocol (RCP), enabling agents to autonomously establish, manage, and terminate commitments. As agents act in parallel, their local actions continuously evolve the commitment graph, allowing global coordination to emerge and adapt toward a shared mission without centralized control. Experiments across reasoning, coding, and executable agent environments demonstrate that RCM outperforms strong centralized and decentralized coordination baselines by up to 18.7 points in task performance and 10.2 points in Responsibility, while improving failure and harm detection without task-specific training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RCM 用承诺 (commitment) 把任务委派与各方显式责任绑定，递归委派时上游代理保留自身责任、只在本地编排下游承诺，使责任沿委派链保持可追溯。在推理、编码与可执行代理环境实验中，相比强集中式与去中心化协调基线，任务性能最多高出 18.7 点、Responsibility 指标高出 10.2 点，且无需任务特定训练。
Motivation: 集中式编排在可扩展性、适应性与集体性能上形成瓶颈；去中心化方案虽分散协调，却常让被委派依赖与故障恢复的责任归属不清。
Method: 提出责任中心协调机制 RCM：以承诺耦合任务委派与相关方显式责任，通过递归委派让代理保留上游责任并本地编排下游承诺；落地为责任约束决策与责任导向通信协议 (RCP)，支持代理自主建立、管理与终止承诺，承诺图随并行行动持续演化，全局协调在无中心控制下涌现。
Result: 在推理、编码与可执行代理环境三类实验中，RCM 任务性能最多超过强集中式与去中心化协调基线 18.7 点，Responsibility 指标高出 10.2 点，同时改善失败与危害检测，且不使用任务特定训练。
Conclusion: 把责任显式写进承诺并沿委派链递归保留，可以在无中心控制下同时提升多代理任务性能与责任可追溯性，无需针对任务重新训练。

papers.title: Representation Redistribution in Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose language model activations into sparse features, but prompt transformations designed to preserve the underlying request can redistribute activity across them. A feature change observed on one transformed prompt need not recur, and even a recurring change need not affect a downstream computation. We introduce the redistribution sensitivity score (RSS), which identifies large feature responses that recur in a consistent direction, and evaluate the resulting supports on variants excluded from selection. Across 27 pretrained SAEs spanning eight language models, the tested prompt transformations produce a reproducible redistribution profile on these excluded variants. We then separate recurring representation change from signed readout contribution and decision failure. For a fixed linear readout, an exact decomposition shows how response magnitude, readout coefficients, directional alignment, and the clean margin determine downstream consequences. In two frozen safety readouts, combining RSS support erosion with the full clean margin yields recurrent failure AUROCs of 0.935 and 0.958 using median supports of 20 and 19 features, compared with 0.965 and 0.964 using full erosion. RSS therefore provides a way to identify recurring sparse representation changes and quantify their contribution to a downstream readout without equating representation change with failure. Code is available at https://github.com/OpenSAE/Redistribution-Sensitivity-Score
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 SAE 稀疏特征在保持语义的 prompt 变换下发生重分布、单次观测的特征变化既不可复现也未必影响下游的问题，提出 redistribution sensitivity score (RSS)，只保留方向一致复现的大特征响应，并对固定线性 readout 给出响应幅度、readout 系数、方向对齐与 clean margin 的精确分解。在 27 个预训练 SAE、8 个语言模型上，变换在留出变体上产生可复现的重分布剖面；两个冻结 safety readout 上，RSS 支持侵蚀加完整 clean margin 的复现失败 AUROC 达 0.935 与 0.958（中位支持 20 与 19 个特征），接近全侵蚀的 0.965 与 0.964。
Motivation: SAE 特征在 prompt 变换下会重分布：在某条变换 prompt 上观察到的特征变化未必复现，即使复现也未必影响下游计算，直接把表征变化等同于失败会误判。
Method: 提出 redistribution sensitivity score (RSS)，在变换 prompt 上筛选方向一致复现的大特征响应，并把选出的支持集放到未参与选择的变体上检验；再将复现的表征变化与带符号的 readout 贡献、决策失败分离，对固定线性 readout 给出由响应幅度、readout 系数、方向对齐和 clean margin 构成的精确分解，在两个冻结 safety readout 上评测。
Result: 覆盖 8 个语言模型的 27 个预训练 SAE，所测 prompt 变换在留出变体上产生可复现的重分布剖面。两个冻结 safety readout 上，RSS 支持侵蚀结合完整 clean margin 的复现失败 AUROC 为 0.935 和 0.958，中位支持分别为 20 和 19 个特征；全侵蚀对应为 0.965 和 0.964。
Conclusion: RSS 能识别复现的稀疏表征变化并量化其对下游 readout 的贡献，而不把表征变化直接等同于失败；用极少特征（中位 19–20 个）即可逼近全侵蚀的失败预测 AUROC。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A large-scale climate-aware satellite image dataset for domain adaptive land-cover semantic segmentation
papers.abstract_en: A few well-annotated datasets for land-cover semantic segmentation have recently been introduced to advance the field of earth observation technologies. However, these datasets overlook the significant diversity among geographic areas with different climates, which can greatly impact and diversify land cover. Consequently, this leads to a domain gap in remote sensing images and severe performance degradation of the segmentation models. To enhance land-cover semantic segmentation with improved generalization ability, we conducted the first investigation into the impact of climate on this task. In this paper, we present a unique large-scale Climate-Aware Satellite Images Dataset (CASID) specifically designed for domain adaptive land-cover semantic segmentation. It consists of 980 satellite images with a size of 5000 x 5000 pixels, collected from 30 different regions around Asia, covering over 24,500 square kilometers. These images are gathered from four distinct climate zones, namely temperate monsoon, subtropical monsoon, tropical monsoon, and tropical rainforest. It includes four sub-datasets/domains, each representing one of the aforementioned climate zones. This characteristic makes CASID the first climate-aware land-cover semantic segmentation dataset with multiple domains. Additionally, we provide a comprehensive analysis of the samples from the four climate zones, emphasizing differences in global image features, image texture, category distribution, spectral value, and object shape. These analyses offer valuable insights for subsequent research in this field. Moreover, we conduct extensive experiments to evaluate the latest semantic segmentation and unsupervised domain adaptation methods on the CASID dataset. These results serve as a robust baseline for future research endeavors. Our dataset will be made publicly available at https://github.com/Linwei-Chen/CASID.
papers.journal_ref: ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing 205 (2023) 98-114
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出首个面向域自适应土地覆盖语义分割的气候感知数据集 CASID：980 张 5000×5000 像素卫星影像，覆盖亚洲 30 个地区、逾 24,500 平方公里，按温带季风、亚热带季风、热带季风、热带雨林四个气候带划分为四个域。作者强调不同气候带造成的域差距会让分割模型性能显著下降，并用最新分割与无监督域自适应方法在 CASID 上建立基线。
Motivation: 现有土地覆盖分割数据集忽略不同气候区地理多样性，导致遥感影像存在域差距、分割模型泛化时性能严重退化；此前缺少针对气候对土地覆盖分割影响的系统研究。
Method: 构建 CASID 数据集，按四个气候带组织为四个子数据集/域；对四气候带样本在全局图像特征、图像纹理、类别分布、光谱值与目标形状五个维度做对比分析；并在其上评测最新语义分割与无监督域自适应 (unsupervised domain adaptation) 方法作为基线。
Result: CASID 含 980 张 5000×5000 像素影像，来自亚洲 30 个地区，覆盖超过 24,500 平方公里，划分为温带季风、亚热带季风、热带季风、热带雨林四个气候域；样本分析显示四域在全球图像特征、纹理、类别分布、光谱值与目标形状上存在差异；分割与 UDA 方法的评测结果构成后续研究基线。
Conclusion: 气候是土地覆盖语义分割中不可忽视的域变量，多气候域数据集与配套基线可支撑域自适应泛化研究；数据集将公开于 github.com/Linwei-Chen/CASID。

papers.title: Compatibility Matters: A Framework for Token-Level Teacher Selection in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently been introduced as a promising paradigm for continual learning, where a student policy can be supervised at the token-level. Typically, OPD is performed using a single teacher per prompt rollout (or even per training run). However, this ignores a whole other axis of flexibility that is available due to the on-policy nature - token-level teacher selection during rollouts. Building on this insight, we theoretically explore what makes a teacher and a student compatible for OPD, and leverage our findings to derive several empirical heuristics for teacher selection. In particular, our framework captures several desiderata for OPD: compatible teacher-student reasoning patterns, teacher competence, and induced student diversity. Theoretically, we categorize several types of teacher routing schemes, and we prove that under different scenarios, different routing schemes are likely to be beneficial for optimization and student diversity. We back up our findings with extensive experimental results in domains such as math, coding, kernel generation, and visual reasoning, where we find upwards of 10 percentage points of improvement on pass@$k$ when compared to vanilla OPD and the teacher experts on certain tasks, indicating both capability improvement and diversity over high-quality responses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中把教师选择从整条 rollout 下放到 token 级：理论上刻画师生兼容性（推理模式一致、教师能力、诱导的学生多样性），据此给出多条教师路由启发式，并证明不同路由方案在不同情形下分别有利于优化与学生多样性。在数学、代码、kernel 生成与视觉推理任务上，相比 vanilla OPD 与教师专家，部分任务 pass@$k$ 提升最高超过 10 个百分点。
Motivation: OPD 通常每条 prompt rollout 甚至整个训练过程只用单一教师，浪费了 on-policy 本身带来的 token 级灵活性，也限制了学生能力与响应多样性的提升空间。
Method: 理论上分析 OPD 中教师与学生的兼容条件，据此推导教师选择的经验启发式，框架覆盖三项要求：师生推理模式匹配、教师能力、诱导的学生多样性；并对多类教师路由 (teacher routing) 方案分类，证明不同方案在不同情形下对优化与多样性各有优势。
Result: 在 math、coding、kernel generation、visual reasoning 等领域实验中，相比 vanilla OPD 与教师专家，部分任务 pass@$k$ 提升最高超过 10 个百分点，体现能力与对高质量响应的多样性同时提升。
Conclusion: OPD 中教师不应固定为单一模型，按 token 级兼容性做路由能同时改善优化、能力与学生多样性，且路由方案的收益取决于具体情形。

papers.title: Not All Change Is Damage: Update-Matched Unlearning for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Unlearning aims to remove selected knowledge from large language models to mitigate privacy and safety risks while preserving useful capabilities. For models that continue to be fine-tuned after release, this goal is insufficient: they must also resist relearning the deleted knowledge while preserving plasticity, the ability to learn new tasks. Existing defenses train against simulated relearning while trying to preserve useful capabilities, but low relearning alone cannot distinguish selective resistance from a general loss of plasticity. Evaluating preservation after an update requires deciding what the updated model should remain close to. A pre-update reference penalizes useful changes induced by the update simply because they depart from earlier outputs. We therefore formulate the reference-timing hypothesis that, at comparable target suppression, an update-matched reference better preserves plasticity than a pre-update one. To test and address this hypothesis, we propose Update-Matched Unlearning (UMU), which applies the same simulated relearning update to the defended model and to an undefended reference initialized from the same unlearned model, and uses new-task learning to guide model selection. Extensive experiments on TOFU and FaithUn with Llama and Qwen models show that UMU improves both relearning resistance and plasticity across all three base unlearning methods, lowering harmful and benign relearning by 30.4 and 9.9 points on average while raising new-task accuracy by 3.5 points. When the reference does not receive the update, relearning remains similarly low but new-task accuracy falls below the base method, supporting the reference-timing hypothesis and showing that robust unlearning should prevent recovery selectively without suppressing learning itself.

TL;DR: 提出 Update-Matched Unlearning (UMU)：对被防御模型与同源未学习模型初始化的无防御参考施加同一次模拟再学习更新，用新任务学习表现指导模型选择，使鲁棒遗忘只阻止被删知识恢复而不压制新任务学习。在 TOFU 与 FaithUn、Llama 与 Qwen 上，有害与良性再学习平均分别下降 30.4 与 9.9 个百分点，新任务准确率提升 3.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 发布后仍会被继续微调的大模型需要抵抗被删知识的再学习，同时保持 plasticity；但现有防御只用低再学习来评估，无法区分选择性抵抗与整体学习能力丧失，且用更新前参考会惩罚更新带来的有益变化。
Method: 提出参考时机假设 (reference-timing hypothesis)：在同等目标抑制水平下，更新匹配参考比更新前参考更能保留 plasticity。UMU 对被防御模型和从同一未学习模型初始化的无防御参考施加相同的模拟再学习更新，再用新任务学习表现引导模型选择。
Result: 在 TOFU 和 FaithUn 数据集、Llama 与 Qwen 模型、三种基础遗忘方法上，UMU 平均降低有害再学习 30.4 个百分点、良性再学习 9.9 个百分点，同时新任务准确率提高 3.5 个百分点；当参考不接收该更新时，再学习同样低但新任务准确率低于基础方法。
Conclusion: 参考时机决定遗忘评估是否惩罚有益更新，支持参考时机假设：鲁棒遗忘应选择性阻止被删知识恢复，而不是一并压制模型学习新任务的能力。

papers.title: What Should We Remove? Evaluating the Reliability and Costs of RLVR Data Decontamination
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) math corpora are routinely screened for benchmark overlap, but the reliability and data-loss costs of cleaning policies remain underexamined. We audit sixteen open RLVR math corpora comprising 1,673,514 corpus-specific training items against six benchmarks containing 1,949 questions. We evaluate eight policies based on exact, lexical, and semantic matching using 594 independently and blindly dual-reviewed training-benchmark pairs. Calibration and held-out sets have disjoint benchmark questions and training-example families. A separate review of all 83 candidate matches for 80 sampled training items measures item-level false removal. At cosine threshold 0.80, 52 of 59 sampled removals (88%) were confirmed false removals; this is not a demonstrated population rate. No semantic threshold in our preregistered grid (0.80-0.98) meets the 90% conservative-precision target on calibration. The existing judge-adjudicated policy achieves 98.1% resolved precision and 98.2% candidate-frame recall on held-out corpora. It has zero confirmed false removals among six sampled removals, with one unresolved case; this does not establish zero risk. Within the evaluated candidate frame, this policy offers a more favorable precision-recall balance than the semantic-threshold alternatives tested. Recall does not measure contamination outside the candidate frame. We release reviewed labels, per-policy decisions, and coverage accounting to support evaluation of cleaning reliability and cost rather than overlap counts alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 16 个开放 RLVR 数学语料（1,673,514 条训练样本）与 6 个基准（1,949 题）审计去污染策略的可靠性与数据损失：语义余弦阈值在 0.80 时抽样 59 条删除中 52 条（88%）为误删，预注册阈值网格 0.80–0.98 内无阈值在校准集达到 90% 保守精度目标；现有 judge-adjudicated 策略在留出语料上达到 98.1% resolved precision 与 98.2% candidate-frame recall，是被测语义阈值方案中更优的精度-召回折中。
Motivation: RLVR 数学语料普遍做基准重叠筛查，但清洗策略的可靠性与数据损失成本很少被系统检验，重叠计数本身无法反映误删代价。
Method: 审计 16 个开放 RLVR 数学语料共 1,673,514 条训练项对 6 个基准共 1,949 题，评估基于精确、词面与语义匹配的 8 种策略；用 594 对独立盲评双人复核的训练-基准对做校准与留出（基准题与训练样本族不相交），并对 80 个抽样训练项的全部 83 个候选匹配做逐项复核以测误删。
Result: 余弦阈值 0.80 时抽样 59 条删除中 52 条（88%）被确认为误删（摘要注明这不等于总体误删率）；预注册阈值网格 0.80–0.98 内无语义阈值在校准集达到 90% 保守精度目标；judge-adjudicated 策略在留出语料上 98.1% resolved precision、98.2% candidate-frame recall，抽样 6 条删除中零确认误删、1 条未决。
Conclusion: 在被评估的候选框内，judge-adjudicated 策略比所测语义阈值方案给出更有利的精度-召回平衡；召回不衡量候选框之外的污染，零误删也不等于零风险。

papers.title: Learning and Forecasting Multiscale Spatiotemporal Epidemic Dynamics with Lagrangian-Eulerian Graph Neural ODEs
papers.abstract_en: Accurate medium- to long-range epidemic forecasting requires extrapolating high-dimensional, heterogeneous and nonstationary dynamics from partial observations. Yet hybrid models often leave implicit which observations inform which epidemic processes and how learned graph interactions modify system state. We introduce LE-EpiGNODE, which replaces generic message passing with process-specific, mechanism-guided neural operators: age-contact information drives Lagrangian infection generation, whereas mobility drives conservative Eulerian population transport within a structure-preserving universal differential equation. We evaluated LE-EpiGNODE across 14 controlled synthetic mechanisms spanning time-modulated, state-dependent, nonlinear and coupled dynamics, three complementary COVID-19 settings, 21 comparator models and five targeted ablations. Forecasting gains tended to become more pronounced at longer horizons; at the longest horizon, LE-EpiGNODE achieved the lowest WMAPE in all three real-world datasets, reducing error by 17.7-40.0% relative to the best baseline. Controlled ablations linked these gains to the Lagrangian-Eulerian decomposition and process-aligned priors, while synthetic ground truth showed that learned operators and induced state fluxes track known generating dynamics. These results support mechanism-organized graph neural dynamics as a route to reliable long-horizon extrapolation with directly testable, process-level mechanistic interpretation beyond trajectory accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LE-EpiGNODE 用机制引导的神经算子把疫情动力学拆成两支：年龄接触驱动 Lagrangian 感染生成， mobility 驱动守恒的 Eulerian 人口输运，嵌入结构保持的通用微分方程 (UDE)。在最长预测时域上，它在三个真实 COVID-19 数据集上均取得最低 WMAPE，相对最优基线降误 17.7–40.0%，且增益随时域变长而扩大。
Motivation: 中长期疫情预报要从部分观测外推高维、异质、非平稳动力学，而混合模型通常不显式说明哪些观测驱动哪些过程、图交互如何改写系统状态，机制可解释性弱。
Method: 以过程专属、机制引导的神经算子取代通用消息传递：年龄接触信息进入 Lagrangian 感染生成项，mobility 进入守恒的 Eulerian 人口输运项，二者统一在结构保持的 universal differential equation 中；在 14 个受控合成机制（时间调制、状态依赖、非线性、耦合）与三个 COVID-19 设置上评测，含 21 个对照模型与五项针对性消融。
Result: 最长时域上 LE-EpiGNODE 在全部三个真实数据集上取得最低 WMAPE，相对最优基线降低 17.7–40.0% 误差；增益在更长时域更显著。受控消融把增益归因于 Lagrangian-Eulerian 分解与过程对齐先验，合成真值显示学到的算子与诱导状态通量能追踪已知生成动力学。
Conclusion: 按机制组织的图神经动力学可作为长时域外推的可靠路径，并在轨迹精度之外提供可直接检验的、过程层面的机制解释。

papers.title: RecSoup: Efficient Model Merging Approach for Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Recommender systems often need to balance multiple conflicting objectives. Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation (CMOR) enables dynamic adjustment of objective trade-offs at inference time without retraining, adapting to shifting user or system requirements. Existing CMOR approaches typically rely on output-level reranking or parameter-generating modules, which either limit the scope of feasible trade-offs or incur substantial training and inference cost. Model merging provides a promising alternative by reusing multiple objective-specific models via parameter combination. However, its direct application to recommender systems is challenging due to the lack of a shared linear regime and cross-objective interference. To address these issues, we propose RecSoup, a lightweight two-stage approach for effective CMOR via specialized model merging. RecSoup first mitigates parameter interference across objectives through a pruning strategy that jointly considers objective-specific importance and cross-objective relevance. It then performs adaptive parameter merging via a learnable preference-to-coefficient mapping, allowing dynamic trade-off control at inference time without joint retraining or additional generative modules. Theoretically, we prove that RecSoup outperforms the parameter generation paradigm in effectiveness and efficiency, as it can fully navigate the Pareto front without smoothness constraints. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that RecSoup achieves improved Pareto front quality and effective controllability while delivers 165--228x faster inference-time latency than parameter generation approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/35798642/RECSOUP.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RecSoup 用两阶段专业化模型合并做可控多目标推荐 (CMOR)：先按目标重要性与跨目标相关性联合剪枝以缓解参数干扰，再用可学习的偏好到系数映射在推理时自适应合并参数，无需联合重训或生成模块。理论上证明其能无平滑性约束地遍历整个 Pareto 前沿，实验中推理延迟比参数生成方法快 165–228 倍。
Motivation: 现有 CMOR 依赖输出层重排或参数生成模块，前者限制可行权衡范围，后者训练与推理开销大；直接把模型合并用于推荐又缺少共享线性区间且存在跨目标干扰。
Method: 两阶段：剪枝阶段同时考虑目标特异重要性与跨目标相关性以缓解参数干扰；合并阶段用可学习的 preference-to-coefficient 映射按推理时偏好自适应加权参数，不需联合重训或额外生成模块。
Result: 在多个基准上 Pareto 前沿质量与可控性均提升，推理时延比参数生成方法快 165–228 倍；理论上证明其在有效性与效率上优于参数生成范式，可无平滑性约束地遍历 Pareto 前沿。
Conclusion: 把专业化模型的剪枝与偏好驱动合并结合，可在不重训的前提下实现推理时可调的多目标权衡，并显著降低时延。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoOnboarder: Autonomously Onboarding LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agentic large language models have been documented to lose reasoning capability when placed inside a harness, the software that mediates their observations and actions. To reconcile these losses, we introduce AutoOnboarder, an autonomous system that adapts an agent to a task the way a trainer onboards a new employee. It places the agent under the supervision of an intelligent ``Onboarder'' coding agent, which iteratively tailors its foundation model, prompt, and harness source code to simultaneously improve performance and decrease cost. Like a real onboarding process, the Onboarder is only given tens of examples, and all evaluation data is isolated on a separate virtual machine to prevent leakage. We report the lessons learned from building and testing AutoOnboarder on genomic-sequencing prior authorization form submission. Autonomously onboarded agents are able to match or exceed the performance of a Gemini 3.5 Flash baseline at up to 29$\times$ lower costs. However, these agents remain imperfect, and the Onboarding process varies greatly in terms of final performance. We conclude that future Onboarding systems require a robust environment for the Onboarder, including a structured thought interface, (controlled) internet access, and a wide model search space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoOnboarder 用一个智能 Onboarder coding agent 像带新员工一样自主改造 LLM agent，迭代调整其基础模型、prompt 与 harness 源码，同时提升性能并降本。在基因测序事前授权表单提交任务上，仅给数十个示例、评测数据隔离在独立虚拟机防泄漏，自主 onboard 的 agent 达到或超过 Gemini 3.5 Flash 基线，成本最高降低 29 倍。
Motivation: LLM agent 放进 harness 后推理能力会下降，手工调基础模型、prompt 与 harness 代码成本高且效果不稳，需要自动化的适配流程。
Method: 由智能 Onboarder coding agent 监督目标 agent，迭代定制其 foundation model、prompt 和 harness 源码；Onboarder 只获得数十个示例，全部评测数据放在独立虚拟机上以防泄漏。
Result: 在基因测序 prior authorization 表单提交任务上，自主 onboard 的 agent 匹配或超过 Gemini 3.5 Flash 基线，成本最高降低 29 倍；但 agent 仍不完美，onboarding 过程的最终性能波动很大。
Conclusion: 未来 Onboarding 系统需要给 Onboarder 一个稳健环境，包括结构化思维接口、（受控的）互联网访问和足够宽的模型搜索空间。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 未来 Onboarding 系统需要给 Onboarder 一个稳健环境，包括结构化思维接口、（受控的）互联网访问和足够宽的模型搜索空间。

papers.title: DLOSAC: Joint Spatial-Geometric Image Estimation via Delaunay-Guided Local Optimization RANSAC
papers.abstract_en: Reliable image geometric estimation from noisy matching points is typically addressed using RANSAC, often combined with local optimization to refine inliers and model parameters. However, existing paradigms are predominantly residual-centric; even heuristic attempts to enforce spatial uniformity suffer from a sequential, two-stage nature that inherently decouples distribution optimization from geometric refinement, preventing an effective trade-off. In this paper, we propose DLOSAC, a local optimization framework that jointly incorporates both geometric consistency and spatial distribution information. We begin by constructing a Delaunay triangulation over candidate inliers to explicitly encode neighborhood topology. The geometric module introduces an edge-based consistency metric to evaluate geometric errors, while the spatial module derives distribution descriptors from triangle areas and edge attributes to quantify the clustering of inliers. Finally, we combine edge-based geometric constraints, spatial distribution regularization, and traditional point-level geometric constraints to improve the quality of geometric parameters. Extensive experiments on six publicly available real-world datasets, covering three types of geometric estimation tasks, achieve state-of-the-art performance.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DLOSAC 把 RANSAC 的局部优化从纯残差导向改为几何一致性与空间分布联合优化：在候选内点上建 Delaunay 三角剖分编码邻域拓扑，用边一致性度量几何误差、用三角形面积与边属性描述内点聚集程度，再与点级几何约束合并精修模型参数。在六个公开真实数据集、三类几何估计任务上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: RANSAC 及其局部优化范式以残差为中心，启发式的空间均匀性约束又分两阶段顺序执行，把分布优化与几何精修解耦，难以在两者间取得有效折衷。
Method: 对候选内点构建 Delaunay 三角剖分；几何模块用基于边的一致性度量评估几何误差，空间模块从三角形面积与边属性提取分布描述子量化内点聚集；最后将边级几何约束、空间分布正则与传统点级几何约束结合，联合改进几何参数估计。
Result: 在六个公开真实世界数据集上、覆盖三类几何估计任务的广泛实验中取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 几何一致性与空间分布信息应在局部优化中联合而非分阶段处理，这样能同时提升内点分布质量与几何参数精度。

papers.title: Rubric Judgments Lack Uncertainty: Conformal Weighting for LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Rubric-based evaluation is widely used to assess large language model (LLM) outputs by decomposing quality into multiple criteria and assigning each a binary judgment from an LLM verifier. However, judgment certainty varies substantially across criteria. Existing methods uniformly aggregate these judgments into a final score, implicitly treating every criterion as equally certain and overlooking this heterogeneity. As a result, uncertain judgments remain incorporated into reward estimation without distinction, potentially yielding misleading training signals for downstream reinforcement learning (RL). To address this limitation, we propose Uncertainty-aware Rubric Weighting (URW), a training-free framework that quantifies criterion-level judgment uncertainty via conformal calibration. Specifically, URW elicits a soft uncertainty signal from a fixed pool of paraphrased judgment templates and converts it into a per-criterion weight using split-conformal $p$-values with provable coverage guarantees. Extensive experiments demonstrate that URW consistently improves pairwise preference accuracy and delivers stronger downstream RL alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: URW 用 split-conformal p 值把 rubric 各准则的 LLM 判定不确定性量化成逐准则权重，替代现有方法对所有准则等权聚合的做法。训练无关 (training-free) 框架在实验中一致提升成对偏好准确率，并带来更强的下游 RL 对齐效果。
Motivation: rubric 评测把质量拆成多准则并由 LLM verifier 给二元判定，但各准则的判定确定性差异很大；现有方法均匀聚合，把不确定判定不加区分地计入奖励估计，可能给下游 RL 提供误导性训练信号。
Method: 提出 Uncertainty-aware Rubric Weighting (URW)：从一组固定的改写判定模板 (paraphrased judgment templates) 中引出软不确定性信号，再用 split-conformal p 值把它转成逐准则权重，带可证明的 coverage 保证；整个流程 training-free。
Result: 实验显示 URW 一致提升 pairwise preference accuracy，并带来更强的下游 RL alignment（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: rubric 聚合应按准则级判定确定性加权而非等权，conformal 校准可在不训练的前提下给出带 coverage 保证的权重并改善奖励估计与 RL 对齐。

papers.title: Clean Data Can Still Carry Backdoors: Support-Persistent Backdoors for Model Reuse
papers.abstract_en: Traditional backdoor attacks inject artificial trigger patterns into training data, causing models to misclassify triggered inputs while maintaining normal behavior on clean samples. Since these artificial triggers are absent in clean datasets, standard knowledge distillation (KD) typically eliminates them, leading to the common belief that KD serves as an effective purification defense. In this paper, we propose DAR (Discover-and-Relabel), a support-persistent backdoor method that retains its behavior even after clean-data distillation. DAR identifies naturally abundant patterns in low-dimensional feature subspaces using subspace clustering and applies label-only poisoning to samples that inherently satisfy the discovered rule. At test time, the backdoor is activated by locally modifying the corresponding subspace of the target images. By instantiating spatial and frequency operators, DAR achieves attack accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art backdoor attacks in ImageNet classification and CLIP-based prompt tuning. Notably, DAR keeps attack success above 96% after clean KD and remains defense-resistant in practice. Project page: https://junhoo.me/backdoor
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出支持持久型后门 DAR (Discover-and-Relabel)：用子空间聚类在低维特征子空间中发现自然高频模式，只对本就满足该规则的样本做标签投毒，测试时通过局部修改目标图像对应子空间来触发。在 ImageNet 分类与 CLIP prompt tuning 上攻击精度可比肩 SOTA 后门攻击，且经干净数据知识蒸馏 (KD) 后攻击成功率仍保持 96% 以上。
Motivation: 人工触发器在干净数据中不存在，标准 KD 因而通常能清除后门，形成“KD 可作有效净化防御”的共识；该共识对天然模式支撑的后门不成立。
Method: DAR 分两步：Discover 阶段用 subspace clustering 在低维特征子空间中发现自然丰度模式，Relabel 阶段对本就符合该规则的样本施加 label-only poisoning；触发通过实例化的空间算子与频率算子局部修改目标图像对应子空间实现，攻击对象为 ImageNet 分类与 CLIP prompt tuning。
Result: 在 ImageNet 分类与 CLIP-based prompt tuning 上，DAR 的攻击精度与 SOTA 后门攻击相当；经干净数据 KD 后攻击成功率仍保持在 96% 以上，并在实践中保持防御抗性。
Conclusion: 只要后门绑定在数据本身天然存在的特征子空间支撑上，干净数据蒸馏就无法将其清除，KD 作为净化防御的共识失效。

papers.title: SpaceCache: Intermediate Feature Reuse for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on Point Cloud Streams
papers.abstract_en: Point-cloud streams are central to autonomous driving and robotics, yet existing segmentation networks process every frame from scratch, although consecutive frames largely overlap. We observe that the intermediate features of point-cloud transformers remain semantically consistent across frames for the same spatial region, especially in deep stages. Building on this, we present SpaceCache, a training-free feature cache that reuses these features across frames. Tokens of previously observed regions skip a sequence of transformer blocks and take their cached features, only the remaining tokens are computed, and the full token layout is restored for dense prediction. Lightweight cache management keeps reused features reliable by limiting each entry's age and evicting low-confidence entries. Unlike token merging, SpaceCache selects tokens at negligible cost and runs its cache operations once per encoder stage. On both outdoor and indoor benchmarks, such as nuScenes, Waymo, and ScanNet, with two transformer backbones of Utonia and LitePT-B, SpaceCache achieves up to 1.65x speedup with less than 1-point mIoU drop and consistently outperforms token-merging methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpaceCache 是免训练的点云流语义分割特征缓存：同一空间区域的中间特征跨帧语义一致，已观测区域的 token 直接跳过若干 transformer block 取缓存特征，只计算剩余 token，再恢复完整 token 布局做稠密预测。在 nuScenes、Waymo、ScanNet 上配合 Utonia 与 LitePT-B 两个 backbone，最高 1.65x 加速而 mIoU 下降不足 1 点，并稳定优于 token merging 方法。
Motivation: 点云流相邻帧大幅重叠，但现有分割网络每帧都从头计算全部 token，重复算力浪费严重，自动驾驶与机器人上的实时分割受限。
Method: 训练无关的特征缓存：按 encoder stage 缓存已观测区域 token 的中间特征，使其跳过一段 transformer block，仅对剩余 token 前向，随后恢复完整 token 布局输出稠密预测；缓存管理限制每条目 age 并驱逐低置信条目，缓存操作每个 encoder stage 只执行一次，选 token 开销可忽略。
Result: 在室外与室内基准 nuScenes、Waymo、ScanNet 上，配合 Utonia 与 LitePT-B 两个 transformer backbone，最高获得 1.65x 加速且 mIoU 下降不足 1 点，并在一致对比中优于 token-merging 方法。
Conclusion: 点云 transformer 的深层中间特征跨帧语义稳定，可直接跨帧复用以换取大幅加速而几乎不损精度，且比 token merging 更划算。

papers.title: Entertain, then Cancel: How Thinking Makes Reasoning Models Read Some and Or Literally
papers.abstract_en: When a speaker says ``some students passed'', listeners infer that not all of them did. Reasoning models now let users decide how long a model thinks before it answers, but we do not know what extra thinking does to such everyday inferences. We study this directly: we keep a model's weights fixed, change only how much it thinks, and record which reading it chooses. A second tool cuts the model's own reasoning at successive points and asks for an answer, showing where the reading changes. Thinking makes models read logical words as logic: it cancels the implicatures of \emph{some} (\emph{not all}) and \emph{or} (\emph{not both}) in most tested open reasoning models and in GPT-5, while context-driven inferences such as indirect answers improve. The trace shows why: models first entertain the enriched reading and cancel it later. Answering from that early reading, an exploratory inference-time remedy, recovers these implicatures without losing literal accuracy. Evaluations of reasoning models should measure how they interpret, not only how accurate they are.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 固定权重、只改变思考长度时，推理模型会把 some 和 or 读成纯逻辑词：在多数受测开源推理模型与 GPT-5 中，some 的「非全部」与 or 的「非两者」含义被取消，而上下文驱动的间接回答类推断反而变好。轨迹显示模型先采纳丰富读法、随后再取消它；在早期读法处作答这一推理时补救可恢复这些 implicature 且不损失字面准确率。
Motivation: 用户可自行决定模型思考多久，但额外思考如何改变日常语言推断（如 some 隐含 not all）尚不清楚，且现有评测只看准确率、不看模型如何解读语义。
Method: 保持模型权重固定、只调节思考长度并记录所选读法；再用第二工具在推理轨迹的连续截断点强制作答，定位读法发生切换的位置；最后测试在早期读法处作答这一推理时补救。
Result: 在多数受测开源推理模型与 GPT-5 中，思考会取消 some（not all）与 or（not both）的 implicature，而上下文驱动的间接回答类推断改善；轨迹显示模型先采纳丰富读法再取消它，早期读法作答的补救恢复这些 implicature 且不损失字面准确率。
Conclusion: 额外思考把语义词当逻辑处理，从而抹掉日常 implicature；推理模型评测应衡量解读方式而不只是准确率。

papers.title: Who May Release an Agent's Promise? Standing over Commitments in Multi-Party Chat
papers.abstract_en: When an assistant serving a team makes a promise to Alice, who may cancel it? We call this standing: only the creditor (the person owed) or someone the creditor or operator policy authorizes may release a commitment, regardless of rank. In a controlled chat environment we vary who cancels and separate two errors: unauthorized release (obeying someone without standing) and override (executing a released promise). Across six models, smaller open ones override the creditor (Qwen3.5-9B: 69%); larger ones drop promises on a peer's direct word (Qwen3.8-27B: 89%; gpt-6.1-sol: 83%); nearly all act on a bystander's "go ahead after all". Oracles dissociate the errors: stating the rule or the creditor curbs unauthorized release but not override, which the latter even raises in three of four models; among them, only knowing whether the promise is still owed cuts override. Enabling thinking moves smaller models the way scale does. A self-kept commitment ledger stops override in four of five models; with a one-paragraph release policy it matches or beats the best oracle store, raising gpt-6-luna's strict accuracy from 49% (policy alone) to 83%. Code, prompts, outputs and labels are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多人对话中，助手的承诺只有债权人 (creditor) 或其授权者能解除，论文用受控聊天环境把「越权解除 (unauthorized release)」与「解除后仍执行 (override)」两类错误分开。六个模型上小开源模型爱越权解除 (Qwen3.5-9B 69%)，大模型则听同侪一句话就放弃承诺 (Qwen3.8-27B 89%、gpt-6.1-sol 83%)；自持承诺账本 (commitment ledger) 在五个模型中四个杜绝 override，配合一段释放策略把 gpt-6-luna 严格准确率从 49% 提到 83%。
Motivation: 团队助手替多人服务时，承诺被谁取消缺乏明确规范，模型既会听无资格者解除承诺，也会在承诺已解除后仍执行，两类错误此前混在一起无法区分。
Method: 在受控聊天环境中改变「谁来取消」，把错误拆成越权解除与 override 两类；用 oracle 提示分别测试「陈述规则」「指明债权人」「告知承诺是否仍欠」三种信息，并比较启用 thinking、自持承诺账本加一段释放策略等干预，跨六个模型评测。
Result: Qwen3.5-9B 越权解除债权人承诺 69%；Qwen3.8-27B 89%、gpt-6.1-sol 83% 会在同侪直接指令下放弃承诺，几乎所有模型都对旁观者的「go ahead after all」照做。陈述规则或指明债权人抑制越权解除但不抑制 override，反而在四个模型中三个抬高 override，只有告知承诺是否仍欠能压低 override；自持账本在五个模型中四个杜绝 override，配合一段释放策略使 gpt-6-luna 严格准确率从 49%（仅策略）升至 83%，与最佳 oracle 存储持平或更好。
Conclusion: 解除承诺的资格 (standing) 与承诺是否仍欠是两种不同的信息缺口：规则与角色提示治越权解除，只有「承诺是否仍欠」的状态记录能治 override，因此自持承诺账本加释放策略是可落地的干预。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: UltraDiff: Transferring High-Fidelity Priors to Compressed Latent Spaces for High-Resolution Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) faces a fundamental trade-off between computational cost and generative fidelity. This trade off is largely governed by the latent compression factor f (e.g. f8 denotes f=8 and f32 f=32). While aggressive compression (f32) significantly improves efficiency, it suffers from severe information loss and ambiguity compared to standard f8 models. We propose UltraDiff, a framework that reformulates this challenge as joint latent diffusion learning followed by marginal score distillation. We introduce MixTeacher, a dual branch DiT that models the joint f8-f32 distribution, utilizing shared attention to resolve the ambiguity of the compressed space with high fidelity f8 priors. Crucially, we propose vector field distillation in the native f32 space. Theoretically, this compels the student to learn the conditional expectation of the teacher trajectory, effectively filtering out compression artifacts. Across the evaluated 1K to 4K settings, UltraDiff approaches f8 level quality while preserving f32 efficiency. With 20 sampling steps on a single A100 GPU, it generates a 2K image in 6.2 seconds over 40 times faster than our f8 baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UltraDiff 把高分辨率 LDM 中压缩保真度与计算成本的矛盾重构为联合潜空间扩散加边缘分数蒸馏：MixTeacher 用共享注意力的双分支 DiT 建模 f8–f32 联合分布，再在原生 f32 空间做向量场蒸馏，使学生学到教师轨迹的条件期望从而滤掉压缩伪影。在评测的 1K–4K 设定下质量逼近 f8 而保留 f32 效率，单张 A100 上 20 步生成 2K 图像耗时 6.2 秒，比其 f8 基线快 40 倍以上。
Motivation: LDM 的潜压缩因子 f 决定成本与保真的权衡：f32 高效但信息损失与歧义严重，f8 保真却昂贵，高分辨率合成需要同时拿到两者的好处。
Method: 先做联合潜扩散学习再做边缘分数蒸馏 (marginal score distillation)。MixTeacher 是建模 f8–f32 联合分布的双分支 DiT，用共享注意力以高保真 f8 先验消解压缩空间的歧义；随后在原生 f32 空间执行向量场蒸馏 (vector field distillation)，理论上迫使学生学习教师轨迹的条件期望。
Result: 在评测的 1K 到 4K 设定中，UltraDiff 逼近 f8 级质量同时保留 f32 效率；单张 A100 上 20 采样步生成一张 2K 图像用时 6.2 秒，比其 f8 基线快 40 倍以上。
Conclusion: 把高保真 f8 先验经联合建模与向量场蒸馏转移到压缩 f32 潜空间，可以在高分辨率生成中同时拿到接近 f8 的质量和 f32 的采样效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hard Way, The Only Way: Provable Merits of Training on Hardest Examples
papers.abstract_en: Despite a surge of empirical interest in the ``unreasonable effectiveness'' of drastic data pruning for AI systems, a unified theoretical understanding of this phenomenon remains elusive. In this work, we provide a precise high-dimensional theory of learning under data pruning via weighted empirical risk minimization (ERM). As in previous work, we analyze a setting where pruning is performed along a one-dimensional subspace of the input space. Our analysis precisely characterizes the limiting test error curves in the regime where the input dimension N and sample size P tend to infinity with a fixed ratio N/P. The resulting theory recovers several recent results in the literature as special cases and provides a general lens to evaluate how pruning strategies interact with the loss function and label noise. Crucially, we characterize the optimal pruning strategy in the high-sample regime where P greatly exceeds N. We demonstrate that strategic pruning can accelerate the decay of classification test error from the classical sqrt(N/P) rate, typical of vanilla ERM with loss functions without exponential tail (e.g., quadratic loss), to the much faster Bayes-optimal scaling of order N/P. In this setup, we prove that, surprisingly, this optimal performance is achieved by a drastic pruning strategy: discarding almost all training data except for a small proportion, consisting strictly of the 2N hardest training examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在输入维度 N 与样本量 P 以固定比值趋于无穷的高维加权 ERM 框架下，作者精确刻画了沿一维子空间做数据剪枝时的极限测试误差曲线，并求出高样本区（P 远大于 N）的最优剪枝策略。结果证明：只保留恰好 2N 个最难训练样本这种极端剪枝，可把分类测试误差的衰减从普通 ERM 的 sqrt(N/P) 加速到 Bayes 最优的 N/P 阶。
Motivation: 数据剪枝 (data pruning) 的“不合理有效性”缺乏统一理论解释，尤其缺少对剪枝策略与损失函数、标签噪声如何交互的精确刻画，以及高样本区最优策略的可证明结论。
Method: 对沿输入空间一维子空间进行剪枝的加权 ERM 建立高维渐近理论（N, P → ∞ 且 N/P 固定），推导极限测试误差曲线；再在 P 远大于 N 的高样本区求解最优剪枝策略，并证明其形式。
Result: 极限测试误差曲线被精确刻画，并把文献中若干近期结果作为特例回收；在高样本区，战略性能把分类测试误差衰减率从普通 ERM（无指数尾损失，如二次损失）的经典 sqrt(N/P) 提升到 Bayes 最优的 N/P 阶；达成该最优的策略是丢弃几乎全部数据、只保留严格为 2N 个最难样本。
Conclusion: 在该高维设定下，最极端的“只训最难样本”剪枝不是启发式而是可证明的最优策略，且 N/P 阶的测试误差加速是可达的。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Poisoning the corpora of protein design systems during pre-training and retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Protein foundation models increasingly support the generation of novel biological sequences, yet their reliance on large public datasets creates opportunities for adversarial manipulation of the material they learn from and retrieve. We investigate two data-only poisoning attacks against protein design systems, targeting the pre-training corpus of autoregressive protein language models and the retrieval corpus of a text-guided protein generator. For the first, we pre-trained ProtGPT2 and ProGen2 variants of 300 million parameters, introducing poisoned protein sequences containing one of two triggers followed by one of three payloads. Across all poisoned runs, both architectures acquired highly reliable trigger-dependent generation under uniform and ramped poisoning schedules. Under ramped exposure, the earliest majority activation occurred after only 200 contaminated examples, while for the uniform schedule earliest activation occurred around 5000 poisoned samples. For the second attack, we inserted records into a retrieval corpus system without modifying its weights or decoding procedure. A single query-aware record captured a top-16 retrieval position for 58\% of templated requests and 97\% of free-text requests. Conditional on successful poisoned retrieval, 62\% of requests produced altered sequences, while 19-21% acquired the inserted domain by profile-HMM homology. A universal query-unaware attack using 1,500 records also achieved substantial retrieval capture and domain transfer. Together, these findings demonstrate that adversarial protein sequence contributions can establish persistent, sequence-specific behaviour during pre-training or redirect protein generation at inference, while leaving ordinary model behaviour largely preserved. Our work establishes the integrity and biological provenance of protein sequence data as critical safeguards for generative protein design systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对蛋白设计系统的纯数据投毒：对自回归蛋白语言模型的预训练语料与文本引导生成器的检索语料分别注入带触发器/载荷的序列，两种攻击都能建立持久且序列特异的行为，同时普通行为基本保持不变。ramped 投毒下最早多数激活只需 200 条污染样本（uniform 约 5000 条）；单条 query-aware 检索记录在 58% 模板请求与 97% 自由文本请求中占据 top-16。
Motivation: 蛋白基础模型依赖大规模公开数据集，其可被投毒的入口既在预训练语料也在检索语料，而数据来源完整性此前缺少针对生成式蛋白设计系统的实证检验。
Method: 两种纯数据攻击：其一预训练 3 亿参数的 ProtGPT2 与 ProGen2 变体，注入含 2 种触发器之一、后接 3 种载荷之一的污染蛋白序列，比较 uniform 与 ramped 投毒日程；其二在不改动权重与解码过程的前提下向检索语料插入记录，含 query-aware 与 1,500 条记录的 universal query-unaware 两种形式。
Result: 两种架构在 uniform 与 ramped 日程下都获得高可靠触发器依赖生成；ramped 暴露下最早多数激活出现在仅 200 条污染样本后，uniform 日程约在 5000 条污染样本。单条 query-aware 记录在 58% 模板请求与 97% 自由文本请求中取得 top-16 检索位；在成功被检索的条件下 62% 请求产生被改动序列，19–21% 通过 profile-HMM 同源性获得插入结构域；1,500 条记录的 universal query-unaware 攻击同样取得显著检索捕获与结构域转移。
Conclusion: 对抗性蛋白序列贡献能在预训练期建立持久的序列特异行为，或在推理期重定向蛋白生成，同时普通模型行为大体保留；作者据此把序列数据的完整性与生物学来源 (biological provenance) 定为生成式蛋白设计系统的关键防线。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Condition-Contrastive Extrapolation for On-Policy Distillation of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves a student language model by training on its own generated trajectories with supervision from a stronger teacher. However, when conditioned on student-generated prefixes, the teacher can favor invalid continuations that violate the question's premises, causing OPD to encourage erroneous reasoning steps. As a remedy, we introduce Condition-Contrastive Extrapolated On-Policy Distillation (CCE-OPD), which makes teacher supervision sensitive to question conditions. CCE-OPD incorporates (1) a fixed-prefix comparison in which the same frozen teacher evaluates the complete question and a counterpart with a selected condition masked, and (2) a bounded log-probability contrast that reweights the teacher distribution into an auxiliary distillation target. On 200 diagnostic reasoning states, condition contrast reduces the rate of preferring invalid continuations from 27.0% to 16.0%. Extensive experiments across six mathematical benchmarks show that CCE-OPD improves avg@8 over OPD by an average of 1.60 and 1.95 percentage points when distilling Qwen3-8B into 0.6B and 1.7B students, respectively. It also achieves the strongest results on four transfer benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CCE-OPD 修正 on-policy distillation 的一个失效模式：学生前缀会诱导教师偏好违反题目前提的续写。做法是固定前缀下让同一冻结教师分别评估完整题目与遮蔽某条件的对照版本，再用有界的 log-probability 对比重加权教师分布作为蒸馏目标；200 个诊断推理状态上偏好无效续写的比率从 27.0% 降到 16.0%，六个数学基准上 avg@8 相对 OPD 平均提升 1.60（0.6B 学生）与 1.95（1.7B 学生）个百分点。
Motivation: 在学生自生成轨迹上做蒸馏时，教师以学生前缀为条件会偏好违反题目前提的续写，使 OPD 反而鼓励错误推理步骤。
Method: CCE-OPD 引入两部分：固定前缀比较，即同一冻结教师分别对完整题目与遮蔽选定条件的对照题目打分；以及有界的 log-probability 对比，把教师分布重加权为辅助蒸馏目标。蒸馏 Qwen3-8B 到 0.6B 与 1.7B 学生。

papers.title: FedSumUp: User-Auditable Privacy-Aware Representation Sharing for Resource-Constrained Federated Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Existing federated data condensation methods face privacy risks, as uploaded synthetic data may preserve sensitive information and remain vulnerable to reconstruction attacks. Moreover, their generation often incurs considerable client-side computational overhead, limiting deployment on resource-constrained devices. To address these issues, we propose FedSumUp, which employs a learnable lossy compressor on clients to generate compact and visually interpretable representations. By controlling information capacity, FedSumUp reduces privacy leakage while allowing users to directly assess the privacy-utility tradeoff. We further introduce a dual-objective optimization mechanism to preserve task-relevant semantics while suppressing reconstruction risks. The compressor is trained on the server and only performs lightweight inference on clients. Since the server cannot access raw data, we develop a data-free closed-loop optimization strategy that optimizes the compressor by minimizing the discrepancy between original and twice-compressed representations after structure-preserving upsampling. Experiments on BloodMNIST, CIFAR-10, and ChestMNIST demonstrate reconstruction PSNR as low as 8.56 dB (with synthetic PSNR as low as 5.45 dB), client runtime reductions up to 96.5% (from 778s to 27s on ChestMNIST), and competitive classification accuracy (89.72% ChestMNIST, 82.24% BloodMNIST, 65.63% CIFAR-10), while remaining inherently robust to non-IID data distributions.
papers.comment: 21 pages, including appendices. Jingwei Zhao and Tiantong Sun contributed equally. Corresponding author: Xiaojin Zhang
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedSumUp 用客户端上的可学习有损压缩器替代联邦数据蒸馏中上传合成数据的做法，通过控制信息容量压低隐私泄漏，并让使用者直接评估隐私-效用权衡。压缩器在服务器上以 data-free 闭环方式训练（最小化原始表示与经结构保持上采样后二次压缩表示的差异），客户端只做轻量推理，配合双目标优化在保留任务语义的同时抑制重建风险。在 BloodMNIST、CIFAR-10、ChestMNIST 上重建 PSNR 低至 8.56 dB（合成 PSNR 低至 5.45 dB），客户端运行时间最多降低 96.5%（ChestMNIST 从 778s 降到 27s），分类准确率分别为 89.72%、82.24%、65.63%，并对非 IID 数据分布天然鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有联邦数据蒸馏方法上传的合成数据可能保留敏感信息、易受重建攻击，且生成过程在客户端开销大，难以部署到资源受限设备。
Method: 客户端部署可学习有损压缩器生成紧凑且视觉可解释的表示，通过控制信息容量减少隐私泄漏；服务器端训练压缩器，客户端只做轻量推理；服务器无法访问原始数据，因此采用 data-free 闭环优化，最小化原始表示与经结构保持上采样后二次压缩表示之间的差异；并引入双目标优化，同时保留任务相关语义、抑制重建风险。
Result: 在 BloodMNIST、CIFAR-10、ChestMNIST 上：重建 PSNR 低至 8.56 dB，合成数据 PSNR 低至 5.45 dB；客户端运行时间最多降低 96.5%（ChestMNIST 从 778s 降至 27s）；分类准确率 ChestMNIST 89.72%、BloodMNIST 82.24%、CIFAR-10 65.63%；方法对非 IID 数据分布保持鲁棒。
Conclusion: 把合成数据生成换成受控容量的可学习压缩表示，可以在资源受限联邦场景下同时压低重建泄漏、把客户端开销降到轻量推理水平，并保持有竞争力的分类准确率。

papers.title: ControlFlow3D: Distilling Multi-View Knowledge into Latent Flow Matching for Point Cloud Upsampling
papers.abstract_en: Point cloud upsampling is essential for 3D applications but remains challenging due to sparse, under-constrained observations. Multi-view images can resolve geometric ambiguity, but existing multi-modal methods do not fully exploit visual cues. We propose ControlFlow3D, a framework that distills knowledge from pretrained foundation models into a lightweight generation network during training, enabling strong performance without multi-view images available at test time. Specifically, our method performs conditional flow matching in a structured latent space defined by a frozen 3D encoder. Multi-view image tokens and 3D latent tokens are jointly clustered into shared prototypes via unsupervised soft KMeans; the resulting prototypes guide the flow trajectory through velocity control and are aligned by a consistency loss that progressively transfers image knowledge into the base network. A Mamba-based geometry decoder then maps latent features to dense coordinates with linear complexity. We also construct ShapeNetPU, a 35K-object multi-modal benchmark that is 31 times larger than prior datasets. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method and its strong generalization capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ControlFlow3D 在训练期把多视角图像基础模型的知识蒸馏进轻量流匹配网络，测试时无需多视角图像即可做点云上采样。在冻结 3D 编码器定义的结构化潜空间中做条件流匹配，用无监督 soft KMeans 把图像 token 与 3D latent token 聚成共享原型，以速度控制引导流轨迹并用一致性损失逐步迁移图像知识，再由 Mamba 几何解码器以线性复杂度输出稠密坐标。
Motivation: 点云上采样因观测稀疏、欠约束而困难；多视角图像能消解几何歧义，但现有跨模态方法未能充分利用视觉线索，且多数方法在测试时依赖多视角输入。
Method: 在冻结 3D 编码器定义的潜空间中做条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching)；图像 token 与 3D latent token 经无监督 soft KMeans 聚成共享原型，原型通过速度控制 (velocity control) 引导流轨迹，并由一致性损失 (consistency loss) 渐进地把图像知识蒸馏进基础网络；最后用 Mamba 几何解码器以线性复杂度映射到稠密坐标。同时构建 ShapeNetPU 多模态基准，含 35K 物体。
Result: 构建 ShapeNetPU：35K 物体的多模态点云上采样基准，规模为已有数据集的 31 倍。摘要称在多个基准上实验验证了方法有效性与强泛化能力，未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 多视角知识可以在训练期被蒸馏进轻量生成网络，使点云上采样在测试时摆脱对多视角图像的依赖，同时保持强泛化。

papers.title: Resisting Harmful Instructions through Training-Free Weight Editing
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-following language models can comply with requests that conflict with intended behaviors and safety alignment. We introduce a training-free weight-editing approach for reducing compliance with targeted undesirable instructions. Our method needs only forward passes on a small set of prompt pairs per target behavior, and because the edit is stored in the model's weights, changing or deleting instructions in the prompt cannot undo the weight modification. We evaluate the approach on two target harmful behaviors across five instruction-tuned models: instructed falsehood and instructed sexism. On two instructed-lying benchmarks, it improves mean honest response rates by 6.2 and 4.6 percentage points over the strongest alternative, significantly on three of the five models and within noise on the other two. In a controlled study of seven prompt formats, it maintains higher honest-response rates than single-layer activation steering when orders to lie arrive in single-turn formats not used to construct the edit. For instructed sexism, it reduces the mean sexist-response rate from 57.9% to 24.3%; combining the edit with a fairness prompt reduces it further to 11.9%. These results establish our contrast-based weight editing approach as an effective training-free intervention in two distinct behavioral domains, supporting its use both independently and alongside prompt-based safeguards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出对比式权重编辑 (contrast-based weight editing)：只需对少量 prompt 对做前向传播，把「拒绝目标有害指令」的偏置直接写进模型权重，使改写或删除提示词无法撤销该修改。在五个 instruction-tuned 模型上，两个说谎基准的平均诚实回答率比最强替代方法高 6.2 和 4.6 个百分点，性别歧视回答率从 57.9% 降到 24.3%，叠加 fairness prompt 后降到 11.9%。
Motivation: 提示词层面的安全对齐可被改写或删除指令绕过，而激活引导 (activation steering) 依赖特定提示格式；需要一种写入权重、跨格式仍生效且无需训练的干预。
Method: 对比式、training-free 的权重编辑：对每个目标行为取少量 prompt 对，仅用前向传播定位并修改权重；评测覆盖 instructed falsehood 与 instructed sexism 两类行为、五个 instruction-tuned 模型，并与单层激活引导及 prompt-based safeguards 对比，另做七种 prompt 格式的受控研究。
Result: 两个说谎基准上平均诚实回答率较最强替代方法分别提高 6.2 和 4.6 个百分点，五个模型中三个显著、另两个在噪声范围内；七种 prompt 格式受控研究中，对未参与构造编辑的单轮说谎指令仍保持高于单层激活引导的诚实率；性别歧视回答率均值 57.9% → 24.3%，编辑叠加 fairness prompt 进一步降至 11.9%。
Conclusion: 把行为约束写进权重可作为独立且可与提示词安全措施叠加的 training-free 干预，在说谎与性别歧视两个行为域上成立，且对提示格式变化更稳。
