papers.title: Sensor Diagnosis for Fuel and Emissions Monitoring in Heavy-Duty Diesel Vehicles
papers.abstract_en: Faulty sensor readings can distort estimates of fuel use and carbon dioxide emissions from diesel engines. We evaluate two procedures that use relationships learned from healthy measurements to diagnose faults and guide fuel correction. The diagnosis procedure tests whether replacing a suspected faulty reading with an estimated healthy value helps a model predict another sensor's recorded reading more accurately. It then predicts the fault type and decides whether to report the diagnosis. We evaluate five synthetic fault types on 217 steady-state operating points from a heavy-duty diesel engine, excluding all measurements at selected engine speeds from training. Across 31,500 fault-injected groups of 20 operating points, it issues diagnoses for 77.3% of groups, with 92.1% of diagnoses issued on these groups correct. The fuel correction procedure uses a different sensor-selection rule at individual operating points, testing how each replacement changes the largest prediction error across all six sensors. Fuel correction requires a fault alarm and engine speed and torque close to the training conditions. A fuel reading is replaced only when its replacement reduces the largest prediction error sufficiently more than replacements for the other sensors. Assuming faults in 1% of one-hour scenarios, equally likely sensors and fault types, and equal time at each measured condition, selected fuel corrections reduce mean absolute error in calculated combustion CO2 by 83.8%. On this engine map, learned relationships support complete sensor diagnoses and fuel corrections that improve emissions accounting while preserving unaffected readings.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用健康工况下学到的传感器间关系做重型柴油机传感器故障诊断与燃油读数校正：诊断端检验把可疑读数换成估计健康值能否让模型更准地预测另一传感器，再判定故障类型并决定是否上报。在 217 个稳态工况点、31,500 组故障注入上，对 77.3% 的组发出诊断，其中 92.1% 正确；在假设 1% 故障率的场景下，被选中的燃油校正使计算燃烧 CO2 的 MAE 降低 83.8%。
Motivation: 传感器故障会扭曲柴油机的油耗与 CO2 排放核算，而现有估计依赖未经校验的读数，需要在不覆盖未受影响读数的前提下识别并纠正故障。
Method: 两个基于健康测量学到的关系的流程：诊断流程用交叉预测检验（替换可疑读数后另一传感器的预测误差是否下降）判定故障并预测类型，再决定是否上报；燃油校正流程在单个工况点上比较各传感器替换对六传感器最大预测误差的削减幅度，仅当燃油替换显著优于其他替换时才替换燃油读数，且要求已有故障报警、转速与扭矩接近训练条件。
Result: 在重型柴油机 217 个稳态工况点上评估五类合成故障，训练中剔除选定转速的全部测量；跨 31,500 个含 20 个工况点的故障注入组，对 77.3% 的组发出诊断，其中 92.1% 正确。假设故障出现在 1% 的一小时场景、传感器与故障类型等概率、各测量条件时间均等，被选中的燃油校正使计算燃烧 CO2 的平均绝对误差降低 83.8%。
Conclusion: 在该发动机 map 上，学到的传感器间关系足以支撑完整的传感器诊断与燃油校正，在改善排放核算的同时保留未受影响的读数；燃油校正的适用条件是已有故障报警且转速、扭矩接近训练工况。

papers.title: Mine, Sample, Render: Test-Time Diversity Alignment Of Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern generative models produce high-quality individual outputs but struggle to sample diversely, even when explicitly instructed to do so. We introduce MINE-SAMPLE-RENDER (MSR), a test-time approach that externalizes the diversity into an explicit, corpus-derived sampling procedure. Our pipeline (i) mines an interpretable categorical schema from a corpus of real artifacts and supplies statistics for sampling; (ii) samples attribute configurations from the corpus-derived statistics; (iii) uses a generative model purely as a conditional renderer of a sampled configuration. Across weather report generation, user simulation, webpage design, text-to-image generation, and agent-generated 3D assets, we evaluate the diversity and output quality of MSR-guided generation and show that MSR improves alignment with corpus distributions and diversity of generated outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MSR 在测试时把多样性外置成显式采样流程：先从真实语料挖出可解释的类别 schema 及其统计量，再按统计量采样属性配置，最后让生成模型只做该配置的条件渲染。在天气报告生成、用户模拟、网页设计、文生图与 agent 生成 3D 资产五类任务上，MSR 引导的生成与语料分布对齐更好、输出多样性更高。
Motivation: 现代生成模型单条输出质量高但采样多样性差，即使被明确要求多样化也如此；多样性无法靠提示词直接获得。
Method: 三段式测试时流程：MINE 从真实语料中挖出可解释的类别 schema 并给出采样统计量；SAMPLE 按语料统计量采样属性配置；RENDER 把生成模型降级为该配置的条件渲染器。
Result: 在天气报告生成、用户模拟、网页设计、text-to-image 与 agent 生成 3D 资产上评估多样性与输出质量，MSR 提升了与语料分布的对齐度以及生成输出的多样性。
Conclusion: 把多样性从模型内部移到语料驱动的显式采样与条件渲染，可以在不牺牲单条质量的前提下对齐语料分布并提高多样性。

papers.title: Monotone Piecewise-Linear Harmonization of Multitemporal Multispectral Surface Reflectance With Unsupervised Deep Multiview Pseudoinvariant Features Learning
papers.abstract_en: Surface reflectance products derived from optical satellite may exhibit systematic inconsistencies across acquisition dates, because atmospheric correction is generally performed independently for each image. Such residual biases distort the temporal behavior of invariant ground targets and reduce the reliability of multitemporal surface reflectance analysis. This study proposes Deep Multitemporal Generalized Canonical Correlation Analysis (DeepMGCCA), an unsupervised deep multiview pseudoinvariant feature learning framework that integrates Deep Generalized Canonical Correlation Analysis (GCCA) with Multivariate Alteration Detection (MAD) to identify deep-pseudoinvariant features (DIFs) for the removal of surface reflectance biases across multitemporal satellite observations. Unlike conventional MAD-based approaches that rely on linear GCCA, the proposed framework replaces date-specific linear projections with a shared convolutional encoder. The framework learns deep invariant features (DIFs) directly from pixel-weighted canonical variates via iterative reweighting strategy, while a reconstruction regularizer preserves surface reflectance information and prevents degenerate collapse from suppressing genuine temporal variability. Experiments were conducted on four annual Landsat-8/9 and Sentinel-2 acquisitions across four regions of interest (ROIs) to evaluate four DIF-based harmonization transforms. A monotone piecewise-linear transform derived from DIFs quantiles consistently achieved the largest bias reduction, lowering the between-date spectral angle by up to 2.54 and RMSE by 0.015, and raising PSNR by up to 4.04~dB. These findings demonstrate the potential of deep invariant feature learning for multitemporal surface reflectance bias removal while highlighting the importance of preserving physically meaningful temporal and spectral information during nonlinear representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无监督深度多视图伪不变特征学习框架 DeepMGCCA，把 Deep GCCA 与 MAD 结合、用共享卷积编码器替代逐日期线性投影，从像素加权典型变量中迭代学出深度伪不变特征 (DIFs)。在四景年度 Landsat-8/9 与 Sentinel-2 影像、四个 ROI 上比较四种 DIF 变换，基于 DIF 分位数的单调分段线性 (monotone piecewise-linear) 变换降偏最稳：跨日期光谱角最多降 2.54，RMSE 降 0.015，PSNR 最多升 4.04 dB。
Motivation: 光学卫星大气校正逐景独立进行，导致不同获取日期的地表反射率存在系统性残余偏差，扭曲不变地物的时间轨迹，削弱多时相地表反射率分析的可靠性。
Method: DeepMGCCA 融合 Deep Generalized Canonical Correlation Analysis (GCCA) 与 Multivariate Alteration Detection (MAD)：用共享卷积编码器取代传统 MAD 类方法的逐日期线性 GCCA 投影，从像素加权典型变量经迭代重加权直接学习深度伪不变特征 (DIFs)，并加重建正则项保留反射率信息、抑制把真实时间变化一并压掉的退化解。
Result: 在四景年度 Landsat-8/9 与 Sentinel-2 获取、四个 ROI 上评估四种基于 DIF 的谐调变换：由 DIF 分位数导出的单调分段线性变换取得最大降偏幅度，跨日期光谱角最多降低 2.54，RMSE 降低 0.015，PSNR 最多提升 4.04 dB。
Conclusion: 深度不变特征学习可用于多时相地表反射率偏差去除，且非线性表示学习必须同时保住有物理意义的时间与光谱信息，单调分段线性变换是其中降偏最稳的选择。

papers.title: Does Latent Chain-of-Thought Actually Reason? A Single, Unifying Taxonomy for Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Latent chain-of-thought replaces written reasoning steps with continuous hidden states, giving models additional steps to compute before answering. It remains unclear what computation these steps actually perform. High task accuracy and decodable intermediate answers do not establish that a model uses its latent chain to reach an answer. We study this question across twenty-one model-task configurations covering three training recipes, three reasoning tasks, and two backbones. We combine chain deletion and content replacement with probes and trajectory analysis to test whether the chain affects the answer, what it encodes, and how its states change. On logical tasks, COCONUT often carries an answer that is already readable before the chain begins. Its states settle early, and deleting the chain leaves predictions almost unchanged. Per-step supervision produces an ordered layout of reasoning steps and can make the model depend on the chain. Yet even an ordered chain can act as a placeholder, with deletion hurting performance while content replacement leaves answers unchanged. On arithmetic tasks, all tested recipes show dependence on chain content. These results show why readable latent states alone are insufficient evidence of reasoning. We introduce a taxonomy that separates what a chain represents from how the model uses it. Seen this way, earlier reports no longer compete: placeholder tokens, collapsed superposition and step-dependent causal roles are each consistent with a different kind of chain, each obtained on a different task, training recipe or measurement. Once a study says which property it tested, whether the model uses the chain, what the chain holds, or how its state moves, claims about latent reasoning can be compared.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 latent chain-of-thought 是否真的参与推理给出统一判据：在 21 个模型-任务配置（3 种训练配方 × 3 类推理任务 × 2 个 backbone）上，把链删除与内容替换同探针、轨迹分析组合，区分链表示什么与模型如何使用它。逻辑任务上 COCONUT 的答案在链开始前已可读出、状态早早稳定、删除链后预测几乎不变；逐步监督能排出有序步骤布局并使模型依赖链，但删除伤害性能而内容替换不改变答案，说明有序链也可能只是占位符；算术任务上所有被测配方都依赖链内容。
Motivation: latent CoT 用连续隐状态替代书写步骤，但高任务准确率与可解码的中间答案都不能证明模型确实用这条链推到答案，既有报告之间也因测的属性不同而互相冲突。
Method: 在 21 个模型-任务配置上组合 chain deletion 与 content replacement 两类干预，配合 probes 与 trajectory analysis，分别检验链是否影响答案、编码了什么、状态如何演化；覆盖三种训练配方（含 COCONUT 与逐步监督）、三类推理任务（逻辑与算术等）和两个 backbone。
Result: 逻辑任务上 COCONUT 的答案在链开始前已可读，状态早期即稳定，删除链后预测几乎不变；逐步监督产生有序的推理步骤布局并可使模型依赖链，但删除链会损害性能而内容替换不改变答案；算术任务上全部被测配方都表现出对链内容的依赖。
Conclusion: 可读的 latent 状态本身不足以作为推理证据；用「链表示什么」与「模型如何使用链」的分类法把 placeholder tokens、collapsed superposition 与 step-dependent causal roles 归位后，先前互相竞争的结论其实各自对应不同任务、训练配方与测量属性，可据此比较。

papers.title: Judging the Judges: Confidence and Disagreement in Rubrics as Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Rubrics as Rewards (RaR) extends reinforcement learning to non-verifiable domains by using an LLM judge to score responses against a structured rubric. Prior work has focused on improving the rubric or strengthening the single judge, with comparatively little attention to how different single or multiple judges might be used during RaR training. We first show that judge identity alone produces a substantial spread in scores when training Qwen3-4B-Base on RaR-Medicine and RaR-Science across five frontier and open-weight judges. Building on this, we propose RaRE (Rubrics as Rewards with Ensembles), a novel judge ensemble strategy for RaR with two mechanisms: a soft-Likert reward that uses judge logprobs to weight more confident judges more heavily, and a drop-on-disagreement mask that excludes high-disagreement rollouts from the GRPO update. We find that this design is critical: while a naive average of judge scores fails to outperform the best single judge, RaRE outperforms every single-judge RaR variant on both HealthBench and GPQA Diamond, with per-theme analysis showing that it inherits the complementary strengths of its constituent judges. Our findings establish judge ensembling as a compelling axis for improving RaR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Rubrics as Rewards (RaR) 训练中，judge 身份本身就会让同一回答的评分出现大幅分化；作者提出 RaRE，用 judge logprob 加权的 soft-Likert 奖励让高置信 judge 占更大权重，并用 drop-on-disagreement mask 把高分歧 rollout 从 GRPO 更新中剔除。朴素平均打不过最好的单 judge，RaRE 则在 HealthBench 与 GPQA Diamond 上超过所有单 judge 变体。
Motivation: RaR 用 LLM judge 给不可验证领域的回答打分，但既有工作只改 rubric 或强化单个 judge，几乎没人研究训练中该用哪个、怎么组合多个 judge；judge 身份带来的评分偏差会直接进入 RL 信号。
Method: 在 RaR-Medicine 与 RaR-Science 上以 Qwen3-4B-Base 训练，先比较五个 frontier 与 open-weight judge 的评分分布；再提出 RaRE：soft-Likert reward 依据 judge logprobs 给更自信的 judge 更高权重，drop-on-disagreement mask 排除高分歧 rollout，不参与 GRPO 更新。
Result: 五个 frontier 与 open-weight judge 之间仅凭身份就产生 substantial 的评分分化；朴素平均 judge 分数无法超过最好的单 judge，而 RaRE 在 HealthBench 和 GPQA Diamond 上超过每一个单 judge 的 RaR 变体，per-theme 分析显示它继承了各 constituent judge 的互补优势。
Conclusion: judge ensemble 是提升 RaR 的一条有效轴：按置信度加权并剔除分歧样本的组合方式，比单纯平均或继续强化单个 judge 更能利用多 judge 的互补性。

papers.title: AgentEval: Evidence-Bounded Assessment of Stateful Agents
papers.abstract_en: Task completion alone does not determine whether a stateful agent satisfied its obligations, and a recorded judgment does not guarantee that its supporting evidence remains valid. We present AgentEval, a system that carries a contract-bound assessment record through tool execution, state and event capture, report qualification, and case maintenance. It separates what the agent did, what the evidence establishes, and whether the conclusion is supported for present use. On 32 tool-world administrations, independent checks agree on all 30 complete episodes, distinguishing satisfied, violated, and unresolved obligations; two interrupted administrations are retained. Controlled interventions on 48 evidence views expose 36 binding faults missed by hash-only checks without changing agent behavior. Scenario Studio connects reviewed cases to 12 two-turn reports with 24 independently checked answers. A separate public-benchmark study on 192 held-out executions reveals ten completed return subgoals within broader task failures and isolates the effect of missing evidence. These studies show how an executable assessment record makes scope, evidential support, and report reuse inspectable across an agent evaluation workflow.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Language Models Share a Readout Bottleneck in Working Memory
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) reproduce a human working-memory signature on the N-back task: performance declines as memory load N increases, and errors concentrate on lures, items that repeat the current stimulus at a neighboring but incorrect serial position. We ask whether this shared behavioral signature reflects a shared mechanism. The literature offers two candidate accounts. On a precision account, softmax attention cannot concentrate its weight on the item N positions back, so adjacent items are retrieved instead. On an interference account, attention selects the correct item, but the content of competing items corrupts the decision. We dissociate these accounts in 15 pretrained LLMs from three families (70 million to 14 billion parameters) and in minimal transformers trained from scratch. In all three families, the attention heads that carry the task attend to the target on most missed matches. Linear probes decode near-perfectly whether a matching letter occurred at the target or at a lure position, even on trials where the model false-alarms to the lure, although its own decisions barely distinguish the two. Sharpening attention yields negligible gains, whereas suppressing the letter identity of non-target items improves sensitivity (d') in nearly all model-by-load conditions. In larger models the task is spread over more heads, and removing interference helps more. In minimal transformers, precision limits a single attention layer, but a second layer removes this constraint. The working-memory limit of LLMs therefore lies in reading items out under interference rather than in locating them, consistent with interference accounts of human working memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 N-back 任务上，15 个预训练 LLM（70M–14B 参数）与从零训练的 minimal transformer 复现了人类工作记忆的行为特征：随负载 N 增大性能下降，错误集中在 lure 位置。线性探针在漏报试次上仍近乎完美解码目标位与 lure 位是否出现过匹配字母，而模型自身决策几乎不区分两者；锐化注意力收益可忽略，抑制非目标字母身份却在几乎所有模型×负载条件下提升 d'。结论是 LLM 的工作记忆瓶颈在干扰下读出条目 (readout under interference)，而非定位条目，支持干扰说而非精度说。
Motivation: LLM 与人类在 N-back 上共享行为特征，但两种机制解释互相竞争：精度说认为 softmax 注意力无法聚焦 N 位前的条目，干扰说认为注意力选对了条目但竞争内容污染了决策。需要在模型中把这两种解释分离开。
Method: 在三个家族的 15 个预训练 LLM（7000 万至 140 亿参数）以及从零训练的 minimal transformer 上做机制区分：检查任务注意力头在漏报试次上是否仍指向目标，用线性探针解码匹配字母出现在目标位还是 lure 位，并分别做锐化注意力与抑制非目标字母身份两种干预，比较 d' 变化；另在 minimal transformer 中测试增加层数的效果。
Result: 三个家族中，承载任务的注意力头在多数漏报试次上仍注意目标；线性探针近乎完美解码匹配字母位于目标位还是 lure 位（包括模型对 lure 误报的试次），而模型自身决策几乎不区分两者。锐化注意力收益可忽略，抑制非目标字母身份在几乎所有模型×负载条件下提升敏感度 d'；更大模型中任务分散到更多头，去除干扰帮助更大；minimal transformer 中单层受精度限制，第二层解除该限制。
Conclusion: LLM 的工作记忆极限在于干扰下读出条目而非定位条目，与人类工作记忆的干扰说 (interference account) 一致；精度限制只在单层 minimal transformer 中成立，加一层即可绕过。

papers.title: MemScope: Evolving Agent Memory Architectures through Localized Code Repair
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory architectures define how LLM agents store and reuse experience across tasks, but they are typically fixed after deployment, limiting their adaptability across task types. Recent self-evolving approaches instead adapt these memory architectures using execution feedback, typically represented as evaluation scores or compressed summaries. However, such coarse-grained feedback is insufficient for precise failure localization in current agent systems, where long-horizon task execution involves multiple interacting components. Without a precise failure location, existing approaches lack a clear code-level target for modification, leaving the update scope weakly constrained and often leading to large-scale rewrites of an otherwise capable memory architecture. We propose MemScope, a framework for evidence-grounded, localized evolution of an existing memory architecture. Its tool-using Patch Agent jointly inspects raw execution traces, runtime memory state, and current architecture code to identify repair targets and apply bounded, in-place edits under provider-identity and memory-compatibility constraints. On GAIA, the trace-and-memory inspection variant achieves 86.67% accuracy, compared with 70.00% for trace-only and 63.33% for summary-only feedback. Under xBench tasks, the evolved memory architecture improves over its original version from 49 to 55 correct answers with DeepSeek V3.2 and from 50 to 53 with Kimi K2.7 Code. On disjoint ALFWorld unseen tasks, success rises from 50.75% to 71.64%. Across archived architecture-snapshot transitions, the median code-change ratio is 4.4%. These results support fine-grained execution evidence as a basis for localized, in-place memory-architecture evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemScope 用会调用工具的 Patch Agent 同时检查原始执行轨迹、运行时记忆状态和现有架构代码，定位失败点后在 provider-identity 与 memory-compatibility 约束下做有界的原地代码修补，实现记忆架构的局部演化。在 GAIA 上轨迹+记忆检查变体达 86.67% 准确率，高于仅轨迹 70.00% 与仅摘要 63.33%；ALFWorld 未见任务成功率从 50.75% 升到 71.64%，架构快照迁移的代码改动中位数仅 4.4%。
Motivation: 记忆架构部署后通常固定，现有自演化方法只用评分或压缩摘要这类粗粒度反馈，无法在长程多组件任务中定位失败，导致更新范围失控、常把本来可用的架构大改。
Method: Patch Agent 联合检查 raw execution traces、runtime memory state 与当前架构代码，识别 repair target 并在 provider-identity 与 memory-compatibility 约束下执行有界原地编辑；对照 trace-only 与 summary-only 反馈变体，并在 GAIA、xBench、ALFWorld 上测试演化后的架构。
Result: GAIA 上 trace-and-memory inspection 变体准确率 86.67%，trace-only 70.00%，summary-only 63.33%。xBench 上演化后架构相对原版：DeepSeek V3.2 正确数 49→55，Kimi K2.7 Code 50→53。ALFWorld disjoint 未见任务成功率 50.75%→71.64%。架构快照迁移的代码改动比例中位数 4.4%。
Conclusion: 细粒度执行证据（轨迹+记忆状态）足以支撑局部、原地的记忆架构演化，改动可保持在很小的代码比例内，而不必整体重写。

papers.title: GRADS: Graph-Regulated Agentic Data Synthesis with Controllable Difficulty
papers.abstract_en: Deep research agents are increasingly deployed to retrieve precise information from large corpora, yet multi-hop, long-horizon tasks remain challenging. Synthetic data generation has emerged as a scalable solution, with existing pipelines typically expanding seed tasks to increase their apparent depth and breadth. However, this expansion does not reliably translate into necessary reasoning: newly introduced evidence may be only weakly coupled to the answer, creating a mismatch between intended and empirical difficulty. To address this problem, we introduce GRADS, a graph-guided agentic data synthesis framework with explicit difficulty control. GRADS runs a closed loop of seed selection, evidence expansion, question--answer construction, and verification while maintaining a graph of the evidence and inference dependencies required to derive each answer. At each step, it conditions generation on a relevant subgraph, preserving indispensable inference without accumulating irrelevant context. Experiments across security, software-engineering, and scientific-document domains show that GRADS consistently generates verified tasks with empirically separated difficulty distributions, as measured by independent solvers. Moreover, under matched training budgets, post-training on this data delivers consistent gains at every level: SFT raises the solution-termination rate to over 95% while cutting tool calls and turns by up to 75%, RL trims tool use by up to a further 19.5%, and on our held-out, domain-specific benchmarks, the resulting 4B model matches Sonnet~4 on software engineering and surpasses it on the scientific and security domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRADS 用证据-推理依赖图约束智能体数据合成的闭环（种子选择、证据扩展、问答构造、验证），每步只在相关子图上生成，使难度可控且被独立求解器实测分离。在匹配训练预算下后训练 4B 模型：SFT 把解题终止率提到 95% 以上、工具调用与轮次最多降 75%，RL 再省至多 19.5% 工具调用，软件工程追平 Sonnet 4、科学与安全域超过它。
Motivation: 深度研究智能体在多跳长程任务上仍吃力；现有合成数据管线靠扩展种子任务堆深度，但新引入证据常与答案弱耦合，导致设定难度与实测难度错位。
Method: 闭环运行种子选择、证据扩展、问答构造与验证，同时维护每个答案所需的证据与推理依赖图；每步以相关子图为条件生成，保留必需推理而不累积无关上下文。
Result: 在 security、software-engineering、scientific-document 三域上生成带实测分离难度分布的已验证任务（由独立求解器度量）；匹配训练预算下 SFT 使 solution-termination rate 超过 95%、tool calls 与 turns 最多减少 75%，RL 再削减至多 19.5% 工具调用；所得 4B 模型在 held-out 域内基准上软件工程追平 Sonnet 4，科学与安全域超过之。
Conclusion: 按依赖图控制证据扩展能把设定难度转成实测难度，且该数据在固定预算下对 SFT 与 RL 均有稳定增益，4B 模型可达到更大闭源模型的域内水平。

papers.title: Coordination-Free Workload Regularization for Variable-Cost Distributed Training
papers.abstract_en: Synchronous data-parallel training usually assigns every rank the same number of records, even when record costs vary by orders of magnitude. For variable-length models, this converts input variation into idle time because each step waits for its most expensive rank-local batch. We present Batch Cost Lookahead (BCL), a coordination-free data-loading policy that buffers a bounded rank-local window and repartitions it into fixed-cardinality packs with balanced estimated cost. BCL preserves the trainer's record-count contract and requires neither cross-rank metadata exchange nor runtime modification. In simulation over public workload distributions, enabling BCL reduces per-rank estimated batch-cost variability by up to 82.8%. Across 13 NeMo-RL SFT corpora on eight H200 GPUs, rank-local BCL runs 1.050 to 1.167 times faster than pooled MFFD. Compiled H200 measurements on an internal sequence workload show speedups of 1.197 to 1.343 times over packed execution from one to four nodes. We also identify a memory-feasibility boundary: a p99 cap for high-variance or OOM-prone data bounds outliers before BCL balances the rest. These results show that substantial variable-cost imbalance can be removed at the data-loader boundary, while clarifying when data preparation or broader coordination is still necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免协调的数据加载策略 Batch Cost Lookahead (BCL)：在 rank 本地缓冲有界窗口，把变成本的记录重划为固定基数、估计代价均衡的 pack，从而消除同步数据并行里等最慢 rank 的空转。仿真中各 rank 批次代价变异度最多降 82.8%，13 个 NeMo-RL SFT 语料上比 pooled MFFD 快 1.050–1.167 倍，编译 H200 上 1–4 节点比 packed 执行快 1.197–1.343 倍。
Motivation: 同步数据并行给每个 rank 分同样条数记录，而记录代价可差数量级，变长模型下每步都要等最贵的 rank 本地批次，把输入差异直接转成空闲时间。
Method: BCL 在数据加载边界缓冲有界 rank 本地窗口，按估计代价把窗口重划为固定基数的 pack，保持 trainer 的记录数契约，不需要跨 rank 元数据交换也不改运行时；另对高方差或易 OOM 数据设 p99 上限先截尾离群点。
Result: 仿真（公开 workload 分布）中开启 BCL 使各 rank 估计批代价变异度最多降低 82.8%；13 个 NeMo-RL SFT 语料、八张 H200 上 rank-local BCL 比 pooled MFFD 快 1.050 至 1.167 倍；编译 H200 上的内部序列 workload 在 1 至 4 节点比 packed 执行快 1.197 至 1.343 倍。

papers.title: VisualTrust: Video Reasoning under On-Screen Claim Framing
papers.abstract_en: On-screen text can describe what a video shows, or it can frame what the video is supposed to mean. Current benchmarks treat both alike, testing whether a model can read the text rather than whether it should trust it. We study claim deference, multimodal large language models' tendency to let an on-screen claim override conflicting visual evidence. We introduce VisualTrust, a counterfactual benchmark with 5,063 cases across 14 claim-fact classes. Each case pairs a question with three versions of the same video: one with no claim, one with an accurate claim, and one with a misleading claim that alters a single grounded fact. The option the misleading claim supports is the trap answer. Across seven open-weight and four proprietary models, mean accuracy falls from 90.1% without a claim to 51.9% with a misleading claim. Among initially correct responses, 42.8% flip to the trap answer and only 0.6% become other errors. Strong no-claim accuracy does not ensure resistance. We also introduce DEAR (Decoupled Evidence Arbitration and Reading), a training-free agent for video question answering that separates evidence arbitration from reading. An independent check reports conflicting evidence, a selector weighs it without a fixed modality priority and blinds what it withholds, and the reader answers from the resulting video in a fresh context. On 500 videos across three proprietary models, DEAR raises accuracy under misleading claims from 47.2--64.0% to 81.8--85.2% and reduces trap-answer selection from 34.4--50.8% to 11.6--15.0%, while preserving no-claim accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VisualTrust 是一个反事实视频问答基准，用同一视频的无主张、准确主张、误导主张三版本测多模态大模型是否会让屏上文字压过视觉证据。11 个模型上平均准确率从无主张 90.1% 跌到误导主张 51.9%，原本答对的样本 42.8% 翻向陷阱选项；训练免费的 DEAR 智能体把证据仲裁与阅读解耦，在 500 条视频上把误导主张下准确率从 47.2–64.0% 提到 81.8–85.2%。
Motivation: 现有视频基准把屏上文字当作待读取内容，不区分它是在描述画面还是在给画面定性，因而测不出模型该不该信任这段文字。
Method: 构建含 5,063 个案例、14 类主张-事实类别的反事实基准，每个案例配同一视频的三个版本（无主张、准确主张、只改动一个 grounded fact 的误导主张），误导主张所支持的选项即陷阱答案。另提出免训练的 DEAR (Decoupled Evidence Arbitration and Reading) 智能体：独立检查器报告冲突证据，选择器在无固定模态优先级下权衡并遮蔽其扣留的信息，阅读器在全新上下文中作答。
Result: 在 7 个开源与 4 个闭源模型上，平均准确率从无主张 90.1% 降至误导主张 51.9%；原本正确的回答中 42.8% 翻成陷阱答案，仅 0.6% 变成其他错误，且无主张高准确率不保证抗干扰。DEAR 在 500 条视频、3 个闭源模型上把误导主张下准确率从 47.2–64.0% 提到 81.8–85.2%，陷阱答案选择率从 34.4–50.8% 降到 11.6–15.0%，同时保持无主张准确率。
Conclusion: 屏上误导主张会让 MLLM 系统性地放弃与之冲突的视觉证据，读字能力与信任判断是两回事；把证据仲裁与阅读解耦即可在不牺牲正常性能的前提下大幅削弱这种 claim deference。

papers.title: CARE-SD: Explainable Reasoning Architecture for Local SLM Self-Disclosure Analysis in Textual Data
papers.abstract_en: Cybersecurity interviews uncover critical security experiences, behaviors, and privacy concerns often not fully captured by conventional technical assessments. Consequently, identifying genuine self-disclosures is challenging because statements are context-dependent, categories overlap, and automated interpretations may introduce unsupported claims. Locally deployed Small Language Models (SLMs) protect sensitive participant data by keeping processing within controlled environments, but their limited reasoning capabilities make simple prompting insufficient for context-aware and factually reliable analysis. This study developed CARE-SD (Context-Adaptive Reasoning and Explanation for Self-Disclosure), a novel four-module architecture integrating context-adaptive processing, hierarchical disclosure reasoning, explanation-consistency verification, and cross-batch reconciliation. We evaluated three local SLMs, including Llama 1B, Qwen 1.5B, and Llama 3B, using 82 independently annotated cybersecurity interviews across five organizational sectors. Comparisons included conventional classifiers, three prompting strategies, larger 8B--32B models, and architectural ablations. Two independent reviewers assessed disclosure labels, factual claims, and explanation correctness. CARE-SD improved the accuracy and evidence reliability of SLMs, increasing Llama 3B Macro-F1 from 0.80 to 0.88 while reducing unsupported claims by 60\%. Remarkably, the 3B model matched the 20B reference model in category Macro-F1, demonstrating the effectiveness of the architecture without requiring a larger model.
papers.comment: Accepted for the 4th International Conference on Foundation and Large Language Models (FLLM2026) - IEEE - held from 17-20 Nov., 2026 at Novotel Barcelona City, Barcelona, Spain
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出本地部署 SLM 的自披露分析架构 CARE-SD，用上下文自适应处理、层级披露推理、解释一致性校验与跨批次对账四模块提升事实可靠性。在 82 份独立标注的网络安全访谈上，Llama 3B Macro-F1 从 0.80 提到 0.88，无依据断言减少 60%，类别 Macro-F1 追平 20B 参考模型。
Motivation: 网络安全访谈中的真实自披露依赖上下文、类别相互重叠，通用自动解读容易产生无依据断言；本地 SLM 保护敏感数据但推理能力有限，简单提示不足以做上下文感知且事实可靠的分析。
Method: CARE-SD 四模块架构：上下文自适应处理、层级披露推理 (hierarchical disclosure reasoning)、解释一致性校验、跨批次对账；在本地部署的 Llama 1B、Qwen 1.5B、Llama 3B 上运行，对照常规分类器、三种提示策略、8B–32B 大模型与架构消融，由两名独立评审者评估披露标签、事实断言与解释正确性。
Result: 在 82 份跨五个组织部门的标注访谈上，Llama 3B Macro-F1 由 0.80 升至 0.88，无依据断言下降 60%；3B 模型的类别 Macro-F1 追平 20B 参考模型。
Conclusion: 架构层面的推理与校验模块可以在不扩大模型规模的前提下，把本地小模型的披露识别准确度与解释事实性提升到大模型水平。

papers.title: All-in-One Memory: Process-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Memory Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly rely on external memory to answer queries grounded in long-horizon histories such as multi-session dialogues and lengthy documents. However, existing memory methods often optimize retrieval and memory construction separately, without a shared reward space for evaluating search, writing, and stopping decisions. To address this, we propose All-in-One Memory (AiO-Mem), which organizes these operations as transitions over a shared evidence state and directly evaluates the semantic quality of each action in a unified reward space. AiO-Mem compiles heterogeneous histories into source-traceable multi-view events, providing a shared substrate for retrieval and memory writing. A unified memory policy actor then rolls out complete interaction trajectories over this shared evidence state. A separate trajectory-conditioned process reward model is trained through evidence-grounded supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level DPO to assign process scores to the collected trajectories. These scores are aggregated into an action-balanced trajectory reward and used by Process-Aligned DAPO (PA-DAPO) to optimize the memory policy. Across long-context memory benchmarks, AiO-Mem consistently improves answer accuracy over both static memory systems and RL-trained memory agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AiO-Mem 把检索、写入、停止统一建模为共享证据状态上的转移，在统一奖励空间里评估每个动作的语义质量。异构历史先编译成可溯源的多视角事件，轨迹条件化的 process reward model 经证据监督微调与轨迹级 DPO 打分，再由 PA-DAPO 聚合成动作均衡的轨迹奖励优化记忆策略。在长上下文记忆基准上，答案准确率一致高于静态记忆系统与 RL 训练的记忆智能体。
Motivation: 现有记忆方法把检索与记忆构建分开优化，搜索、写入、停止三类决策缺少共享奖励空间，动作质量无法统一评估。
Method: AiO-Mem 将三类操作组织为共享证据状态上的转移；把异构历史编译为 source-traceable 多视角事件作为检索与写入的共同底座；统一记忆策略 actor 在该状态上 rollout 完整交互轨迹；单独的 trajectory-conditioned process reward model 通过 evidence-grounded SFT 与 trajectory-level DPO 训练，输出过程分数，聚合成 action-balanced trajectory reward，交给 Process-Aligned DAPO (PA-DAPO) 优化策略。
Result: 在长上下文记忆基准上，AiO-Mem 的答案准确率一致高于静态记忆系统与 RL 训练的记忆智能体；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把检索、写入、停止放进同一证据状态与同一奖励空间，是让记忆智能体各动作被统一评估并整体优化的有效路径。

papers.title: CoSTA: Compressed Speech Token Adaptation for Efficient Spoken Dialogue Models
papers.abstract_en: Spoken Dialogue Models (SDMs) typically share a speech-token space for generation and synthesis, leading to long autoregressive sequences and costly inference. Lower-rate speech tokenizers shorten sequences but may introduce compression-quality trade-offs and costly replacement without breaking this coupling. To address this limitation, we propose CoSTA, a compatibility-preserving post-hoc framework that decouples generation and synthesis token spaces while retaining the original speech tokenizer and decoder. CoSTA extends the generation token space with compressed representations via mean-initialized vocabulary extension, pronunciation adaptation, and dialogue adaptation, followed by deterministic expansion back to the original speech-token space before synthesis. On bilingual speech-dialogue benchmarks, CoSTA achieves approximately $1.7\times$ expanded speech-token generation speed, lower full-response latency, and higher throughput while preserving response quality. Analyses show more sustained interaction under limited budgets and a practical trade-off among compression, decoding efficiency, and quality. Further experiments demonstrate cross-architecture transfer and complementarity to low-rate tokenization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoSTA 用兼容性保持的后训练框架把口语对话模型的生成与合成 token 空间解耦：保留原 speech tokenizer 与 decoder，通过 mean 初始化的词表扩展、发音适配和对话适配把生成空间扩展出压缩表示，合成前再确定性展开回原 speech-token 空间。在双语语音对话基准上，speech-token 生成速度约提升 1.7 倍，全响应延迟更低、吞吐更高且响应质量保持。
Motivation: SDM 共用同一 speech-token 空间做生成与合成，导致自回归序列长、推理昂贵；换低码率 tokenizer 虽能缩短序列，却带来压缩-质量权衡且替换成本高。
Method: CoSTA 是 post-hoc 框架：保留原 speech tokenizer 与 decoder，用 mean-initialized vocabulary extension 扩展生成 token 空间，再做 pronunciation adaptation 与 dialogue adaptation，合成前确定性展开回原 speech-token 空间。
Result: 在双语 speech-dialogue 基准上，speech-token 生成速度约 1.7 倍，全响应延迟更低、吞吐更高且响应质量保持；分析显示有限预算下交互更持久，并呈现压缩、解码效率与质量之间的实际权衡；额外实验展示跨架构迁移能力以及与低码率 tokenization 的互补性。
Conclusion: 不解耦 token 空间也能提速：把压缩表示放进扩展词表并在合成前展开，可在保持质量的同时换取解码效率，且与低码率 tokenizer 互补。

papers.title: When is a better LLM worth paying for? Stochastic Optimization with Switching Mixed-Fidelity Oracles
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used upstream of decision-making to clean data, detect label errors, and reconstruct missing values. Yet LLM-assisted data curation creates a new operational tradeoff: higher-fidelity models and richer prompts can be substantially more expensive, while the value of this additional fidelity depends on the downstream optimization accuracy. This raises the central question of this work: when should one pay for a better LLM, given a specific downstream task at hand? We study this question through stochastic optimization with mixed-fidelity first-order oracles, which can have systematic bias and state-dependent variance. We develop two cost-aware algorithmic frameworks that allow adaptive switching between stochastic oracles. With known bias, the first meta-algorithm applies a restarted, cost-aware policy that adaptively selects oracle fidelity across optimization stages. Its cumulative cost is no larger than that of the best fixed oracle in hindsight and can be substantially smaller. With unknown bias, we develop a budgeted certification scheme that uses occasional trusted-gradient evaluations to certify the optimization progress and eliminate unsuccessful oracle sources, and show an explicit tradeoff between certification cost and delayed detection of biased sources. We provide concrete realizations of these meta-algorithms by applying biased stochastic gradient extrapolation (SGE) and recursive regularization under state-dependent noise as subroutines. Synthetic and LLM-completion experiments illustrate the qualitative switching behavior predicted by the theory: the adaptive policy skips several expensive LLM oracles and substantially reduces cumulative cost relative to fixed high-fidelity alternatives while achieving comparable accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLM 辅助数据清洗、纠错、补全作为下游随机优化上游的场景下，提出两个成本感知的混合保真度 oracle 元算法：已知偏差时用重启式成本感知策略在优化阶段间自适应切换 oracle 保真度，其累计成本不差于事后最优固定 oracle 且可显著更小；偏差未知时用预算化认证方案靠偶尔的可信梯度评估淘汰失效 oracle 源。合成与 LLM 补全实验显示自适应策略跳过多个昂贵 LLM oracle，在保持相当精度的同时大幅降低累计成本。
Motivation: LLM 做数据清洗、标签纠错、缺失值重建时，更高保真度模型与更丰富 prompt 显著更贵，而其价值取决于下游优化精度，缺少何时该为更好 LLM 付费的决策准则。
Method: 把问题形式化为带系统偏差与状态相关方差的混合保真度一阶 oracle 随机优化；已知偏差时用重启式成本感知元算法跨阶段自适应选保真度，未知偏差时用预算化认证方案以偶发可信梯度评估认证进展并剔除失效源，二者均以有偏随机梯度外推 (SGE) 与状态相关噪声下的递归正则化作为子过程实现。

papers.title: CleanRM: Reward Modeling from Noisy Feedback with a Few Clean Feedback for RLHF
papers.abstract_en: Feedback noise is pervasive in preference data, arising from subjective human judgments, annotation mistakes, and imperfect LLM judges. Standard reward modeling trained on such feedback yields a biased estimate of the clean risk. Although classical denoising methods are directly applicable to noisy feedback learning, they generally assume a uniform noise ratio across samples. However, this assumption fails for feedback data, where noise is intrinsically sample-wise. To address this challenge, we propose CleanRM, which uses a few clean feedback to calibrate sample-wise noise ratios via optimal transport. Specifically, CleanRM aligns the joint distribution of preferences reverted from noisy feedback with that of clean feedback and then trains the reward model using a noise-corrected surrogate loss. Theoretically, we prove that the resulting objective is unbiased with respect to the clean risk. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CleanRM outperforms state-of-the-art denoising baselines and yields more effective downstream RLHF alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CleanRM 用少量干净偏好反馈，通过最优传输 (optimal transport) 对齐含噪反馈还原出的偏好联合分布与干净反馈分布，逐样本校准噪声比例，再用噪声修正的代理损失训练奖励模型。理论上该目标对 clean risk 无偏，实验中超过现有去噪基线并带来更有效的下游 RLHF 对齐。
Motivation: 偏好数据中的噪声来自主观判断、标注错误和不完美的 LLM judge，使标准奖励模型对 clean risk 的估计有偏；经典去噪方法假设全样本统一噪声比例，而反馈噪声本质上是逐样本 (sample-wise) 的，该假设不成立。
Method: 用少量 clean feedback 作参照，通过最优传输对齐由含噪反馈还原的偏好联合分布与干净反馈的联合分布，据此估计每个样本的噪声比例；随后以噪声修正的代理损失 (noise-corrected surrogate loss) 训练奖励模型。
Result: 理论上证明所提目标对 clean risk 无偏；实验中超过 state-of-the-art 去噪基线，并产生更有效的下游 RLHF 对齐效果。
Conclusion: 少量干净反馈加最优传输校准足以把逐样本噪声比例估出来，从而在不假设统一噪声率的前提下得到无偏的奖励模型训练目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OnBodyAI - Why the Next AI Needs a Body
papers.abstract_en: The next AI will not win by knowing more about the world. It will win because it knows you: because it lives on your body, works for you and answers to you. That is what the term OnBodyAI stands for. It describes what happens when large language models are given a body, and what research and industry need to make that happen. This article is based on my talk in the Industrial Panel at UbiComp/ISWC 2026 in Shanghai (October 13, 2026) and follows its ten key statements.
papers.comment: This article is based on my talk in the Industrial Panel at UbiComp/ISWC 2026 in Shanghai (October 13, 2026) and follows its ten key statements
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 OnBodyAI 概念：下一代 AI 的优势不在于掌握更多世界知识，而在于把 LLM 装到用户身体上、随身工作并只对用户负责。文章按 UbiComp/ISWC 2026 工业专题讨论演讲的十条关键陈述展开，说明实现这一形态需要研究界与产业界提供什么。
Motivation: 当前 LLM 以通用知识取胜，缺少与具体用户绑定、随身运行并服从用户指令的形态；文章要指出让 AI 拥有身体所需的研究与产业条件。
Method: 以 UbiComp/ISWC 2026 上海工业专题讨论（2026 年 10 月 13 日）的演讲为基础，围绕十条关键陈述组织论证，定义 OnBodyAI 为 LLM 获得身体后的运行方式及其支撑条件。
Result: 给出 OnBodyAI 的定义与十条关键陈述这一论述产物：AI 因了解用户、生活在用户身体上、为用户工作并只对用户负责而取胜，而非因知道更多世界知识。
Conclusion: 下一代 AI 的竞争点从世界知识转向对单个用户的贴身了解与服从，其成立前提是 LLM 具备可随身承载的实体形态。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Pathwise Shrinkage and Probabilistic Calibration of the Multiplicative Half-Cauchy Process
papers.abstract_en: We characterize the multiplicative half-Cauchy process through its log-scale random-walk representation, establishing shrinkage, expansion, and critical regimes, almost-sure summability, local rebounds, and effective dimension. We also derive a semi-analytic calibration rule linking interpretable prior probability statements to its scale parameter.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. R package: https://github.com/SiddheshKulkarni-source/mhcp. Software DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23355811
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对乘性 half-Cauchy 过程 (multiplicative half-Cauchy process) 给出对数尺度随机游走表示，据此刻画其收缩、扩张与临界三类 regime，并证明几乎必然可和性、局部反弹与有效维数。另导出一条半解析校准规则，把可解释的先验概率陈述直接换算成该过程的尺度参数。
Motivation: 乘性 half-Cauchy 过程的尺度参数此前缺少与可解释先验概率陈述直接挂钩的选取依据，其长程行为（是否可和、有效维数多高）也未被系统刻画。
Method: 先建立对数尺度随机游走表示，再由此推导收缩/扩张/临界 regime 的划分、几乎必然可和性、局部反弹性质与有效维数；校准部分给出把先验概率陈述映射到尺度参数的半解析规则，并配套 R 包 mhcp。
Result: 给出三类 regime 的判定、几乎必然可和性与有效维数的刻画，以及一条半解析的尺度参数校准规则；论文为 6 页 1 图 1 表，附 R 包与 Zenodo 软件 DOI。
Conclusion: 乘性 half-Cauchy 过程的行为可由对数尺度随机游走统一刻画，其尺度参数也能按可解释的先验概率陈述半解析地校准，而不必凭经验调参。

papers.title: Stronger Judges Do Not See More: Deployment-Integrity Blindness in LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-agent evaluation reports behavioral scores but leaves the identity of the deployed runtime stack unreported. A tampered deployment that preserves evaluated outputs passes every output-only evaluator. We introduce DIB-Bench, a benchmark that measures this deployment-integrity blindness across 7,560 scored examples, six tamper types, and an evaluator ladder from regex scorers through LLM judges to GPT-5-nano. Stronger evaluators accept more tampered outputs: mean acceptance rises from 88.6% (rule-based) to 94.1% (GPT-5-nano), and a trigger-conditional tamper invisible on the evaluation suite produces 48-100% harmful outputs, rising with model capability. A PAC-style bound shows that tampers with zero output shift are undetectable from outputs at any sample size; a manifest-hash identity channel detects them with zero samples. Behavioral fingerprinting identifies the model component above chance (76.7%) but covers one of six stack components. We also propose a graded deployment-identity descriptor for evaluation reports.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM-agent 评测只报行为分数、不报部署运行栈身份，输出被篡改但输出不变的部署能骗过所有只看输出的评测器。为此提出 DIB-Bench，在 7,560 个计分样例、六类篡改、从规则打分器到 GPT-5-nano 的评测器阶梯上量化这种“部署完整性盲区”：评测器越强越宽容，均值接受率从 88.6%（rule-based）升到 94.1%（GPT-5-nano）；PAC 式界证明零输出偏移的篡改在任何样本量下都无法从输出检出，而 manifest-hash 身份通道零样本即可检出。
Motivation: LLM-agent 评测报告只给行为分数，部署运行栈身份不被报告，因此保持评测输出不变的篡改部署能通过所有 output-only 评测器，评测结论与实际部署脱节。
Method: 构建 DIB-Bench：7,560 个计分样例、六类篡改，评测器阶梯从 regex 打分器经 LLM judge 一直到 GPT-5-nano；另给出 PAC 式检出界、manifest-hash 身份通道、行为指纹 (behavioral fingerprinting) 与分级部署身份描述符 (graded deployment-identity descriptor)。
Result: 均值篡改接受率从 88.6%（rule-based）升到 94.1%（GPT-5-nano）；评测套件上不可见的 trigger-conditional 篡改产生 48–100% 有害输出，随模型能力上升；PAC 界表明零输出偏移的篡改在任何样本量下都不可检出，manifest-hash 通道零样本检出；行为指纹以 76.7% 高于随机地识别模型组件，但只覆盖六个栈组件中的一个。
Conclusion: 更强的评测器看不到更多篡改反而更宽容，输出-only 评测在原理上无法保证部署完整性，评测报告必须携带部署身份描述符与 manifest-hash 一类的身份通道。

papers.title: Predicting Live Birth After Fresh Embryo Transfer in IVF/ICSI: Differential ICM/Trophectoderm Morphology Encoding and a Hybrid Attention--Logistic Regression Ensemble
papers.abstract_en: Predicting live birth before fresh embryo transfer could support shared decision-making in IVF/ICSI, but routine clinical data are small, heterogeneous, and contain pathway-dependent variables prone to outcome leakage. We aimed to construct a curated single-centre IVF/ICSI dataset and develop a prediction model suited to small tabular clinical data. \textit{Materials and Methods:} We assembled 616 fresh embryo-transfer cycles (251 live birth, 365 non-live birth) with clinical, laboratory, and embryological predictors, and embryo morphology encoded with a novel differential weighting of the inner cell mass and trophectoderm. After KNN imputation, robust scaling, and selection of 50 features, we developed a Hybrid Attention Network (HAN), a learnable feature-attention gate followed by a compact multilayer perceptron, and a HAN + logistic-regression (LR) ensemble with a validation-tuned weight. Models were benchmarked against classical machine learning, TabPFN, and text-serialized language models on a held-out test set; AUC-ROC was the primary metric. \textit{Results:} The HAN + LR ensemble achieved the highest test AUC-ROC (0.710; accuracy 0.710, F1 0.630), ahead of the HAN backbone alone (0.700), logistic regression (0.667), the TabPFN + LR hybrid (0.666), and TabPFN (0.650). Text-serialized language models performed near chance (AUC $\le$ 0.61). The differentially weighted trophectoderm feature ranked highest by consensus importance across models. \textit{Discussion:} A compact attention network combined with a linear model outperformed both components and strong foundation-model baselines on a small clinical cohort. \textit{Conclusion:} The curated dataset and HAN + LR ensemble offer a transparent, reproducible basis for IVF/ICSI live-birth prediction; external validation is the next step.

papers.title: Trajectory Prediction Method for person under WSN with Hierarchical Envelope Adversarial Domain Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Pedestrian trajectory prediction holds significant applications across autonomous driving, intelligent surveillance, and smart cities. However, the complexity and unpredictability of pedestrian interactions make this task a persistent challenge. Current models face two common limitations: 1) Consider only a single type of social coupling. This introduces redundant interactions. More critically, it fails to account for the varying nature of trajectory coupled across different scenarios and between different pedestrians. Consequently, models cannot deeply adapt to diverse scenes. 2) Inadequate domain shift handling. Although very few methods address domain shift, they rely on statistical criterion-based domain distribution alignment. Such approaches exhibit strong dependency on predefined statistical metrics. This leads to significant limitations in complex and dynamic environments. To address these problems, a Hierarchical Envelope Adversarial Domain Adaptation with Loosely-Tightly coupled model (HEADA-LTCTPM) is proposed. First, an envelope sample construction mechanism was proposed. It constructs envelope samples and extends them into graph structures. Secondly, an adversarial domain adaptation module was proposed. This integrates both local and global domain adaptation strategies. It dynamically adapts to diverse coupled relationships across scenarios. These innovations collectively enhance prediction accuracy and robustness. In the experimental section, two representative public datasets were employed for validation and comprehensive comparisons with six relevant baseline algorithms were conducted. Results demonstrate that our model achieves significantly higher accuracy compared to existing methods, with the ADE and FDE metrics reduced by 17.6% and 19.1% respectively. The time overhead meets practical requirements, which verifies the effectiveness of our key innovations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HEADA-LTCTPM：用包络样本构建机制把松散-紧耦合的行人交互扩展成图结构，再用局部+全局的对抗域自适应替代依赖预定义统计量的分布对齐。在两个公开行人轨迹数据集上对比六个基线，ADE 与 FDE 分别降低 17.6% 与 19.1%，时间开销满足实用要求。
Motivation: 行人轨迹预测中现有模型只考虑单一社会耦合类型，引入冗余交互且无法适应不同场景、不同行人之间耦合性质的变化；处理域偏移的方法又依赖预定义统计准则做分布对齐，在复杂动态环境中受限。
Method: HEADA-LTCTPM 包含两部分：包络样本构建机制，构造包络样本并扩展为图结构以刻画松散-紧耦合 (Loosely-Tightly coupled) 关系；对抗域自适应模块，同时集成局部与全局域自适应策略，动态适配不同场景下的耦合关系。
Result: 在两个代表性公开数据集上与六个相关基线算法比较，ADE 与 FDE 分别降低 17.6% 与 19.1%，时间开销满足实际应用要求。
Conclusion: 用包络样本图结构加局部-全局对抗域自适应，可以同时提升行人轨迹预测的精度与跨场景鲁棒性，且推理开销可接受。

papers.title: Sparse Attention for Video Generation Acceleration via Growing Sparsity and Reduced Search
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) dominate video generation but suffer from high inference cost due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Sparse attention mitigates this by skipping unnecessary computation in the attention matrix, but existing methods apply a fixed sparsity ratio throughout denoising and struggle to accurately determine which computations to skip. To address these limitations, we analyze attention dynamics through attention entropy and mean attention distance, and find that attention becomes increasingly concentrated across denoising steps. We further observe that blocks selected early continue to capture a large fraction of the total attention weight at later steps. These findings suggest two acceleration opportunities: the sparsity ratio should grow as denoising progresses, and earlier search results can be reused to reduce the search space. Based on these findings, we propose Growing Sparsity and Reduced Search (GSRS), a training-free framework that retains more computation early and progressively reduces it later, while restricting subsequent searches to an early candidate set to reduce search overhead. GSRS adopts Top-p selection for adaptive sparsity control, supported by a precise evaluation scheme that computes exact attention weights within the FlashAttention computation at negligible overhead. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan 2.1 validate that GSRS achieves 1.55$\times$--2.21$\times$ speedup while maintaining generation quality comparable to full attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GSRS 是面向 Diffusion Transformer 视频生成的免训练稀疏注意力框架：随去噪推进逐步提高稀疏率，并把后续搜索限制在早期候选集内以压缩搜索开销。在 HunyuanVideo 与 Wan 2.1 上取得 1.55×–2.21× 加速，生成质量与全注意力相当。
Motivation: DiT 视频生成因自注意力二次复杂度推理开销高；现有稀疏注意力在整段去噪中用固定稀疏率，且难以准确判断该跳过哪些注意力计算。
Method: 先用 attention entropy 与 mean attention distance 分析注意力动态，发现注意力随去噪步越来越集中、早期选中的 block 在后期仍占大部分注意力权重；据此提出免训练的 GSRS：早期保留更多计算、后期逐步削减，后续搜索限制在早期候选集内，用 Top-p 选择做自适应稀疏控制，并在 FlashAttention 计算中直接算精确注意力权重作为评估方案，额外开销可忽略。
Result: 在 HunyuanVideo 与 Wan 2.1 上实现 1.55×–2.21× 加速，生成质量与全注意力 (full attention) 相当。
Conclusion: 稀疏率应随去噪进程增长、且早期搜索结果可复用来缩小后续搜索空间，据此做免训练的自适应稀疏注意力即可在视频生成上省下大半注意力计算而不损质量。

papers.title: When Judges Agree and Are Wrong: Consistency-Accuracy Dissociation as a Blind Spot for Label-Free Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Label-free evaluation methods, such as self-consistency filtering, majority-vote aggregation, and agreement-based reliability scoring, rely on an implicit assumption that consistency can serve as a proxy for correctness when ground-truth labels are unavailable or expensive to obtain. In this paper, we test this assumption directly. Using four financial QA datasets (multiple-choice and free-form), ten consistency dimensions, and two frontier model families, we measure the joint distribution of consistency and accuracy at the level of individual examples rather than in aggregate. We find that 60% of all incorrect answers fall in the high-consistency region (consistency $\geq$ 0.8), and that 77.7% of these show complete answer collapse, i.e. identical wrong answers across all perturbation variants. This high-consistency/incorrect quadrant cannot be detected by any evaluation signal that is built on agreement alone, as the model appears maximally reliable while being wrong. We show that the phenomenon is robust to the choice of consistency threshold t (it persists from t=0.50 to t=1.00), is shared across model families, and is concentrated in specific intersections of perturbation dimension and domain. We map where this quadrant occurs, analyze its stability properties, and discuss the implications for evaluation pipelines that use agreement-based signals in place of human labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 标签无关 (label-free) 评测把一致性当正确性代理，但在四个金融 QA 数据集、十个一致性维度、两个前沿模型家族上，60% 的错误答案落在一致性 ≥0.8 的高一致区，其中 77.7% 出现完全答案坍缩（各扰动变体给出同一个错误答案）。该象限在阈值 t 从 0.50 到 1.00 全程存在，且纯靠 agreement 的信号无法检出，因为模型看起来最可靠却在犯错。
Motivation: 无 ground-truth 或标注昂贵时，评测管线用 self-consistency 过滤、多数投票、agreement 可靠性评分替代人工标签，隐含假设一致性可代理正确性；该假设若在样例级失效，整条评测管线会系统性漏检错误。
Method: 在四个金融 QA 数据集（选择题与自由问答）上，用十个一致性维度和两个前沿模型家族，逐样例（而非聚合层面）测量一致性与准确率的联合分布，并定位高一致/错误象限出现的扰动维度与领域交集，分析其随阈值的稳定性。
Result: 全部错误答案中 60% 落在一致性 ≥0.8 区域；这些里 77.7% 为完全答案坍缩（所有扰动变体给出相同错误答案）。现象在阈值 t=0.50 到 t=1.00 全程持续，跨模型家族共有，并集中在特定扰动维度与领域交集。
Conclusion: 一致性不能单独充当正确性的代理：高一致/错误象限是 agreement 型评测信号的结构性盲区，用其替代人工标签的评测管线会把最错的样例判成最可靠。

papers.title: Noise-Space Reward Alignment for Few-Step Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Few-step generative models produce high-quality samples in one or a few evaluations. However, steering them toward desired properties remains difficult, especially when only black-box reward evaluations are available. While one could apply approaches developed for iterative diffusion and flow-based models, such as direct RL fine-tuning or test-time scaling, we find that neither transfers well to the few-step regime: direct fine-tuning suffers from severe reward over-optimization, and test-time scaling sacrifices the efficiency advantage of few-step generation. We propose Noise Policy Optimization (NPO), which explicitly targets the alignment problem for few-step generative models. The key idea is to learn an amortized flow policy over the initial noise space of the generator. The trained policy transports Gaussian noise to a reward-tilted noise distribution, whose pushforward distribution through the frozen generator is exactly the reward-tilted output distribution. By keeping the generator frozen, we can effectively utilize the knowledge encoded in the pretrained model, yielding a better reward-quality trade-off than direct fine-tuning. The amortized policy moves the search cost into training, so inference adds only a lightweight noise sampling step on top of the pretrained model. To improve sample efficiency during training, we use ELBO-based likelihood estimation that requires only sampled endpoints rather than simulated trajectories. Across image, language, and protein structure generation, NPO consistently achieves a better reward-quality trade-off than direct fine-tuning, and matches test-time search methods with 16 to 549 times lower inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对少步生成模型的黑盒奖励对齐，提出 Noise Policy Optimization (NPO)：在初始噪声空间上学一个摊销流策略 (amortized flow policy)，把高斯噪声输运到奖励倾斜的噪声分布，生成器保持冻结。在图像、语言与蛋白质结构生成上，NPO 的奖励-质量权衡一致优于直接微调，并以低 16 到 549 倍的推理成本匹配测试时搜索方法。
Motivation: 少步生成模型只做一次或几次评估，但难以朝期望属性引导：对迭代式 diffusion/flow 的直接 RL 微调会出现严重奖励过优化，测试时扩展 (test-time scaling) 又牺牲了少步生成的效率优势。
Method: NPO 在生成器的初始噪声空间上学一个摊销流策略，把高斯噪声输运到奖励倾斜的噪声分布，其经冻结生成器的 pushforward 即为奖励倾斜的输出分布；训练用只需采样端点、无需模拟轨迹的 ELBO 似然估计提升样本效率，推理只在预训练模型上加一步轻量噪声采样。
Result: 在图像、语言与蛋白质结构生成三类任务上，NPO 相对直接微调 consistently 取得更好的奖励-质量权衡，并以 16 到 549 倍更低的推理成本匹配测试时搜索方法 (test-time search)。
Conclusion: 冻结生成器、把搜索成本移到训练阶段的噪声空间策略，能在少步生成中同时保住预训练知识与推理效率，避免直接微调的奖励过优化。

summary_sections.result: 在图像、语言与蛋白质结构生成三类任务上，NPO 相对直接微调 consistently 取得更好的奖励-质量权衡，并以 16 到 549 倍更低的推理成本匹配测试时搜索方法 (test-time search)。

papers.title: DST-Net: Decomposed Spatio-Temporal Network for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Series decomposition has emerged as a widely acknowledged paradigm in deep time series forecasting models. However, existing approaches predominantly employ a homogeneous modeling strategy for all subsequences, thereby overlooking the distinct inductive biases inherent in different components. We identify that the trend component exhibits dominant spatial coupling across channels but carries significant temporal redundancy, whereas the seasonal component is characterized by local temporal evolution but remains susceptible to attention distraction. To address this, we propose a novel disentangled architecture that tailors specific modeling strategies to align with the intrinsic properties of each component. For the trend branch, we design a Latent Graph Block, employing latent graph modeling to capture global topological dependencies and system-wide co-movements. Conversely, for the seasonal branch, we introduce a Gaussian Multi-scale Attention mechanism to mitigate attention distraction. By injecting learnable Gaussian priors, we impose structural constraints that compel the model to focus on multi-granular local contexts, effectively filtering out global noise and accurately capturing local evolutionary phases. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed model.
papers.comment: Accepted at the World Computing-Power Network Conference-Academic (WCNCA) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DST-Net 针对序列分解式时序预测中所有子序列共用同一建模策略的问题，按成分性质分治：趋势分支用 Latent Graph Block 捕捉通道间全局拓扑依赖与系统级协同变化，季节分支用注入可学习高斯先验的 Gaussian Multi-scale Attention 约束模型聚焦多粒度局部上下文、抑制注意力分散。在多个真实基准上验证了该解耦架构的有效性。
Motivation: 现有分解式深度时序预测模型对趋势与季节子序列采用同质建模，忽略两者不同的归纳偏置：趋势成分跨通道空间耦合强但时间冗余大，季节成分局部演化但易受注意力分散干扰。
Method: 将趋势与季节成分分入两条分支：趋势分支的 Latent Graph Block 用潜图建模捕捉全局拓扑依赖与系统级共变；季节分支的 Gaussian Multi-scale Attention 注入可学习高斯先验作为结构约束，迫使模型关注多粒度局部上下文、过滤全局噪声。
Result: 在多个真实世界基准上的大量实验表明该模型有效；摘要未给出具体数据集名称或指标数值。
Conclusion: 按成分内在性质（趋势的空间耦合与时间冗余、季节的局部演化与注意力分散倾向）定制建模策略，优于对所有子序列同质处理的分解范式。

papers.title: ResStreamGS: Residual-Sensitive Dual-Stream Gaussian Splatting for Mobile Volumetric Video Streaming
papers.abstract_en: Real-time mobile volumetric video enables immersive free-viewpoint experiences, but delivering high-quality 3D content under constrained bandwidth and computation remains challenging. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) systems, such as V$^3$, enable efficient mobile streaming by encoding time-varying Gaussian attributes with commodity video codecs and hardware decoding. However, existing pipelines treat all Gaussians as frame-varying signals, which is poorly suited to full-scene content where large portions remain temporally stable. Our empirical study shows that frame-wise adaptation and video coding of all Gaussians cause quality degradation in complex full-scene content, particularly in temporally stable regions. To address this issue, we propose ResStreamGS, a residual-sensitive dual-stream framework that processes Gaussians according to their temporal behavior. ResStreamGS identifies residual-sensitive primitives through lightweight probe adaptation and reuses stable Gaussians within each Group of Pictures (GOP). Stable Gaussians are transmitted once per GOP, while only residual-sensitive Gaussians remain in the frame-wise hardware-decodable video stream. Experiments on complex full-scene volumetric videos show that ResStreamGS improves post-codec PSNR by 7.51--8.35~dB over a controlled V$^3$-style all-Gaussians baseline, reduces amortized payload by up to 56.5%, and achieves 30.883~FPS on a Qualcomm Snapdragon 778G platform.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ResStreamGS 把体积视频里的 3D Gaussian 按时间行为分流：稳定高斯每个 GOP 只传一次，只有残差敏感 (residual-sensitive) 的高斯留在逐帧硬件解码视频流中。在复杂全场景体积视频上，相比受控的 V³ 式全高斯基线，post-codec PSNR 提升 7.51–8.35 dB，摊销载荷最多减少 56.5%，并在 Qualcomm Snapdragon 778G 上达到 30.883 FPS。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 移动流媒体管线（如 V³）把所有高斯都当作逐帧变化信号编码，而全场景内容中大量区域时间上稳定，逐帧适配与视频编码反而在这些稳定区域造成质量下降。
Method: 提出残差敏感双流框架：先用轻量探针适配 (probe adaptation) 识别残差敏感图元，在每个 Group of Pictures (GOP) 内复用稳定高斯；稳定高斯每 GOP 传输一次，残差敏感高斯保留在可硬件解码的逐帧视频流中，沿用商用视频编解码器。
Result: 在复杂全场景体积视频上，post-codec PSNR 较受控 V³ 式全高斯基线提升 7.51–8.35 dB，摊销载荷最多降低 56.5%，在 Qualcomm Snapdragon 778G 平台达到 30.883 FPS。
Conclusion: 按时间行为对高斯分流、只对残差敏感部分逐帧编码，可以在移动带宽与算力受限条件下同时提高全场景体积视频的重建质量与传输效率。

papers.title: Spectral-Spatial Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc image explanations usually show where a model looks using spatial heatmaps or indicate which channels matter using global channel scores. These separate views are limiting for multispectral data because channel relevance is often spatially localized and physically meaningful. We introduce Spectral-Spatial Interpretation (SSI), a full-grid attribution method over position-channel players (g,c). For each spatial position, SSI fixes the observed surrounding context, defines a conditional game over the channels at that position, and applies the Shapley value to this local game. The result is a full spectral-spatial attribution matrix rather than a single heatmap or a global channel ranking. SSI has a clear local interpretation. It satisfies Shapley fairness within each position, and aggregating its channel attributions exactly recovers the position-level contextual contrast obtained by replacing that position with the baseline. SSI also differs from context-averaged Owen-style hierarchical accounting, which uses the same position-channel grouping but averages over external spatial coalitions. On HLS Burn Scar, SSI outperforms an MC-Owen estimator across retained attribution metrics while using only about 6% of its evaluation budget. Across CUB-200, EuroSAT, and HLS Burn Scar under both per-channel mean and zero baselines, SSI achieves the best joint deletion and insertion AUC over dense, flat, and rank-1 baselines, yields the strongest spectral hit rates and channel deletion, and leads spatial localization on both annotated datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/AtheavenMa/Spectral-Spatial-Interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SSI 对多光谱图像做全网格 (position-channel) 归因：固定每个空间位置的周边上下文，在该位置的通道上定义条件博弈并求 Shapley 值，输出完整的光谱-空间归因矩阵而非单一热图或全局通道排序。在 HLS Burn Scar 上它以约 6% 的评估预算在保留归因指标上超过 MC-Owen 估计器，并在 CUB-200、EuroSAT、HLS Burn Scar 上取得最优的联合 deletion/insertion AUC。
Motivation: 事后解释通常把空间热图与全局通道分数分开呈现，而多光谱数据中通道相关性往往既空间局域又具有物理含义，两种视图各自都不足以刻画这一点。
Method: SSI 对每个空间位置固定观测到的周边上下文，在该位置的通道集合上定义条件博弈并计算 Shapley 值，聚合得到全网格归因矩阵；其通道归因求和可精确还原用基线替换该位置所得的 contextual contrast，并与对外部空间联盟取平均的 Owen 层级记账相区分。评测用 per-channel mean 与 zero 两种基线，对比 dense、flat、rank-1 基线及 MC-Owen 估计器，指标含 joint deletion/insertion AUC、spectral hit rate、channel deletion 与空间定位。
Result: 在 HLS Burn Scar 上，SSI 在保留归因指标上全面超过 MC-Owen 估计器，而评估预算仅约为其 6%。在 CUB-200、EuroSAT、HLS Burn Scar 上，配合 per-channel mean 与 zero 基线，SSI 在联合 deletion 与 insertion AUC 上均优于 dense、flat、rank-1 基线，并取得最强的 spectral hit rate、channel deletion，以及在两个带标注数据集上的空间定位表现。
Conclusion: 把通道博弈限制在固定空间上下文内求 Shapley 值，能在多光谱数据上同时给出满足 Shapley fairness 的局部解释与精确的 position-level contextual contrast，且比层级 Owen 估计更省评估预算。

papers.title: SSR: Structural Signal Retriever for Scalable Agent Discovery in LLM-Orchestrated Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale multi-agent ecosystems require mechanisms for discovering suitable agents without exposing entire registries to a large language model (LLM) orchestrator. The challenge is not only to retrieve relevant Agent Cards from a growing registry, but also to maintain a compact candidate context, since each additional candidate increases prompt size, inference cost, latency, and the risk of exceeding the model context window. We formulate this problem as candidate-context scalability and propose the Structural Signal Retriever (SSR), our deterministic and training-free retrieval method designed for Agent Card discovery. SSR derives structural lexical signals from capability-bearing Agent Card fields, weights them using inverse document frequency (IDF), and uses an Inverted Signal Index (ISI) for selective candidate scoring. We evaluate SSR using a synthetic agent benchmark, a public MS MARCO adaptation, and end-to-end LLM orchestration. At 1,000 agents, SSR reduces LLM input by 98.8% and orchestration latency by 70.9% relative to full-catalog orchestration. On MS MARCO, IDF improves retrieval effectiveness within the structural representation, while the ISI preserves retrieval effectiveness and reduces explicitly scored passages by 96.8%. End-to-end experiments show that candidate pre-selection maintains a compact candidate context as registry size grows and avoids the operational failures observed with full-catalog orchestration. These results support SSR as an Agent-Card-native, traceable retrieval mechanism for candidate-context scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SSR 是面向 LLM 编排多智能体系统的免训练检索器：从 Agent Card 的能力字段抽取结构化词法信号，用 IDF 加权并经 Inverted Signal Index (ISI) 选择性打分，只把少量候选送入编排器。在 1,000 个 agent 规模下，相对全目录编排 LLM 输入减少 98.8%、编排延迟降低 70.9%；MS MARCO 上 ISI 在保持检索效果的同时把显式打分段落减少 96.8%。
Motivation: agent 注册表不断增长，把整个目录塞给 LLM 编排器会撑大 prompt、抬高推理成本与延迟，并可能超出模型上下文窗口；需要在不暴露全库的前提下检索到合适 Agent Card。
Method: SSR 是确定性、免训练的检索方法：从承载能力的 Agent Card 字段抽取结构化词法信号，用 IDF 加权，再用 Inverted Signal Index (ISI) 对候选做选择性打分，从而维持紧凑的候选上下文。评测用合成 agent 基准、MS MARCO 的公开改编版以及端到端 LLM 编排。
Result: 在 1,000 个 agent 时，相对全目录编排 LLM 输入减少 98.8%、编排延迟降低 70.9%；MS MARCO 上 IDF 在结构化表示内提升检索效果，ISI 保持检索效果并把显式打分的段落数减少 96.8%；端到端实验显示候选预选在注册表规模增长时维持紧凑候选上下文，并避免全目录编排出现的运行失败。
Conclusion: SSR 支持把候选上下文可扩展性作为独立问题来解：以 Agent-Card 原生、可追溯的检索机制替代全目录编排，即可在注册表增长时保持紧凑上下文并规避运行失败。

papers.title: Kolab: Benchmarking Human-Agent Collaboration in Long-Horizon Workflows
papers.abstract_en: When humans collaborate with AI agents on long-horizon tasks, what happens to the agents' contributions? For solving long-horizon tasks, humans place greater importance on ongoing interaction with AI agents (e.g., revising plans) than on an agent's ability to complete the task in a single attempt. However, most agentic benchmarks have focused more on automation. Strong performance on such benchmarks does not imply effective real-world collaboration. Professional workflows offer a useful setting, as they often involve interdependent steps. To address this gap, we introduce Kolab, a new dataset of 115+ hours of screen recordings of 50 professionals from 40 occupations collaborating with agents on realistic, long-horizon problems. Kolab also contains participants' collaboration and output quality judgments. Our analysis reveals diverse collaboration patterns, highlighting the importance of when and how professionals coordinate with agents. A collaborative agent must do two things that automation benchmarks never test: anticipate whether experts will adopt, modify, or reject its contribution once it leaves the chat window to guide its next steps, and assess collaboration quality from the unfolding workflow without constant expert feedback. Our benchmark operationalizes both: (1) forecasting how professionals use agent contributions at diverse workflows, and (2) verifying their judgments of collaboration satisfaction and output quality. Findings show that frontier models, both agentic and non-agentic, overestimate collaboration with experts and struggle to distinguish between high- and low-quality collaboration. Longer workflow context does not consistently improve these predictions. As frontier agents cannot yet understand long-horizon collaboration with experts, we position Kolab as a valuable dataset for studying human-agent collaboration grounded in real professional workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kolab 提出一个人机协作基准：用 50 位来自 40 个职业的专业人员在真实长程任务中与 AI agent 协作的 115+ 小时屏幕录像，训练模型预测专家会采纳、修改还是拒绝 agent 的贡献，并核验其对协作满意度与产出质量的判断。前沿模型（agentic 与 non-agentic）都高估自己与专家的协作水平，且难以区分高质量与低质量协作，更长的工作流上下文并不能一致改善这些预测。
Motivation: 现有 agentic 基准侧重一次性自动化完成任务，而真实专业工作流中人更看重持续交互（如反复修订计划）；高自动化分数并不等于有效的现实协作，且缺少基于真实工作流的评测数据。
Method: 构建 Kolab 数据集：115+ 小时屏幕录像，覆盖 50 位专业人员、40 个职业在真实长程问题上与 agent 的协作，并附带参与者的协作与产出质量判断。基准包含两项任务：预测专家在多样工作流中如何使用 agent 贡献，以及核验专家对协作满意度和产出质量的判断。
Result: 数据规模为 115+ 小时屏幕录像、50 位专业人士、40 个职业。分析显示协作模式多样，何时以及如何与 agent 协调很关键。前沿模型（agentic 与 non-agentic）均高估与专家的协作水平，难以区分高、低质量协作；更长的工作流上下文对这些预测没有一致改善。
Conclusion: 前沿 agent 目前还无法理解与专家的长程协作，Kolab 被定位为基于真实专业工作流研究人机协作的数据集。

papers.title: Planning Commitment of LLM under Partial Observability
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based planning agents commit to plans of different lengths before interacting with a partially observable environment. Some aggressively commit to a long plan based on assumptions about unobserved states, while others conservatively plan only over what they have observed. Both behaviors emerge implicitly in pre-trained models, whether the LLM outputs a plan directly or generates a PDDL formulation for a classical solver. Aggressive commitment risks costly failures, while conservative commitment risks excessive LLM calls. This choice pits safety against efficiency, a trade-off that has been neither characterized systematically nor made controllable. We investigate aggressive and conservative LLM planners and formalizers on two partially observable domains, where priors are provided as either explicit statistics or common-sense knowledge. Across three LLMs, both strategies reach similar accuracy. Conservative methods achieve fewer failed attempts (safety) at the cost of more API calls (efficiency). Aggressive methods fail more often but replan efficiently only when priors are informative. Interestingly, analysis shows that LLMs treat the provided priors nearly as facts, which risks failure when priors are unreliable. We also explore hybrid strategies with tunable hyperparameters that adjust the balance between safety and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 规划智能体在部分可观测环境中会隐式地在激进承诺（按未观测状态的假设一次排长计划）与保守承诺（只规划已观测部分）之间取舍，前者省 API 调用但失败多，后者更安全但调用多。在两个部分可观测域、三个 LLM 上两种策略准确率相近，且激进策略仅在先验信息量足时才高效重规划；LLM 把提供的先验几乎当作事实，先验不可靠时会失败。作者据此提出带可调超参的混合策略来控制安全—效率平衡。
Motivation: LLM 规划器在部分可观测环境中的计划承诺长度既未被系统刻画，也不可控：激进承诺有昂贵失败风险，保守承诺带来过多 LLM 调用，安全与效率的取舍缺少可调手段。
Method: 在两个部分可观测域上对比激进与保守两类 LLM 规划器与 formalizer（直接输出计划或生成 PDDL 交给经典求解器），先验以显式统计或常识知识两种形式给出，跨三个 LLM 评测；另探索带可调超参的混合策略来调节安全—效率平衡。
Result: 在两个部分可观测域、三个 LLM 上，激进与保守两种策略准确率相近；保守方法失败尝试更少（更安全）但 API 调用更多（效率更低），激进方法失败更多、且仅在先验信息量充分时重规划才高效；分析显示 LLM 把提供的先验几乎当作事实，先验不可靠时会引发失败。
Conclusion: 安全与效率是 LLM 部分可观测规划中可被显式调节的取舍，混合策略加可调超参能控制这一平衡；把先验当事实处理是激进承诺在先验不可靠时失败的根源。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A One-Sided McDiarmid-Type Inequality for Heavy Tails via Reverse KL Tensorization
papers.abstract_en: We revisit McDiarmid's inequality, a central tool in statistical learning theory and algorithm analysis. We show that large deviations above the mean are exponentially unlikely for functions of independent random variables that are almost surely bounded above and satisfy a conditional moment assumption of order $p\in(1,2]$. When $p<2$, the result applies even when the function has infinite variance. Our proof relies on a new tensorization inequality for the Kullback--Leibler divergence, termed reverse KL tensorization, which may be of independent interest. Applications include concentration of the sample mean and median-of-means estimator, and one-sided uniform risk bounds for unbounded losses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 McDiarmid 不等式推广到重尾情形：对独立随机变量的函数，只要函数几乎必然有上界且满足 p∈(1,2] 阶条件矩假设，均值以上的大幅偏差就以指数小概率出现；p<2 时结论在函数方差无穷的情况下仍成立。证明依赖新的 KL 散度张量化工具（reverse KL tensorization），应用覆盖样本均值、median-of-means 估计量的集中性以及无界损失的一侧一致风险界。
Motivation: 经典 McDiarmid 不等式要求有界差，重尾或方差无穷时失效，而统计学习理论与算法分析中大量对象（无界损失）正落在这一区间。
Method: 核心是新提出的 reverse KL tensorization 不等式，用于把 KL 散度在独立变量上张量化；在此基础上推导 p∈(1,2] 阶条件矩假设下的单侧集中不等式，函数只需几乎必然有上界。
Result: 得到的结论是：均值以上的大幅偏差指数级不可能，且当 p<2 时允许函数方差无穷；应用给出样本均值与 median-of-means 估计量的集中性，以及无界损失的一侧一致风险界。
Conclusion: 单侧 McDiarmid 型集中不等式可以在只有上界加低阶条件矩（而非有界差或有限方差）的条件下成立，reverse KL tensorization 本身可能有独立用途。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ToolBottleneckBench: Measuring Tool-Agent Performance under Controlled Pressures and Fixed Harness Budgets
papers.abstract_en: The success score of a tool agent reflects both its model and the budgets of the harness that runs it. We present ToolBottleneckBench, a benchmark that measures tool-agent performance under controlled pressures and fixed harness budgets. Synthetic enterprise tasks stay fixed while one pressure varies: the registered tool catalog, the visible tool menu, the certified workflow, or the encoding of returned records. An exact grader records the first unmet obligation of each failed episode and the harness limit, if any, that ended it. Across 21 model and harness configurations, the visible menu is the only one of the three pressures that act on the model with a large penalty, and this penalty tracks truncation at the completion cap. Raising the cap sixteenfold removes most of the penalty in the truncation-heavy configurations. Most failures end at a harness limit, and the failure record identifies the assigned pressure no more reliably than a count of tool calls. The repairs that help change which tools reach the model or who issues the calls, and only two repairs, neither improving model behavior, beat every configuration switch. We recommend reporting pressure effects with the harness budgets under which they were measured. We release the benchmark at https://github.com/zichuanxu/tool-bottleneck-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ToolBottleneckBench：在固定合成企业任务上单独变动一种压力（注册工具目录、模型可见菜单、认证工作流、返回记录编码），用精确评分器记录每个失败回合的首个未满足义务与触发它的 harness 限制。在 21 种模型与 harness 配置中，只有可见菜单这一作用于模型的压力造成大幅惩罚，且该惩罚随补全上限截断而变化；把上限提高 16 倍即可消除截断主导配置中的大部分惩罚。
Motivation: 工具智能体的成功分数同时混入模型能力与运行它的 harness 预算，导致不同配置之间无法归因：究竟是模型不会用工具，还是预算把回合截断了。
Method: 构造保持不变的合成企业任务，每次只变动一种受控压力（工具目录、可见菜单、认证工作流、记录编码）；精确评分器逐回合记录首个未满足义务以及终止它的 harness 限制；在 21 种模型与 harness 配置上比较，并测试各类修复（改变哪些工具到达模型、由谁发起调用）与配置切换。
Result: 在 21 种配置中，可见菜单是三种作用于模型的压力里唯一造成大幅惩罚的一种，且惩罚大小与补全上限处的截断相关；把上限提高 16 倍后，截断主导的配置中大部分惩罚消失。多数失败终止于 harness 限制，而失败记录对所分配压力的指认并不比单纯统计工具调用次数更可靠；有效的修复改变工具如何到达模型或由谁发起调用，只有两种修复胜过所有配置切换，且都不改善模型行为。
Conclusion: 工具智能体评测必须连同所用 harness 预算一起报告压力效应，否则失败归因不可信；截断而非模型能力是许多失败的直接原因。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training?
papers.abstract_en: World and action modeling are closely related, yet their reciprocal benefits under unified causal training remain unclear. We introduce OneWM, a simple framework for unified causal training that treats actions as both conditions for world prediction and targets for policy learning within a shared video-action architecture. Using this framework, we investigate whether learning forward dynamics conditioned on specified actions improves action learning, and whether learning to generate actions in turn improves action-conditioned world modeling. We use LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa365 as embodied testbeds to evaluate both policy learning and world modeling, complemented by real-world policy experiments. Learning the visual consequences of specified actions improves policy performance and generalization across changing scenes. In turn, action learning improves multi-view world-prediction fidelity under the same architecture. Together, these results answer both questions positively, supporting reciprocal benefits between world modeling and action generation under unified causal training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 OneWM：在同一 video-action 架构里把动作既作为世界预测的条件、又作为策略学习的目标，做统一因果训练。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa365 及真实机器人实验中，学指定动作的视觉后果能提升策略性能与跨场景泛化，动作学习反过来在同架构下提升多视角世界预测保真度，两个方向互惠均成立。
Motivation: 世界模型与动作建模通常分开训练，二者在统一因果训练下能否互相增益此前不清楚。
Method: OneWM 框架用共享的 video-action 架构，动作同时充当世界预测的条件输入与策略学习的回归目标；在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa365 三个具身测试床上联合评估策略学习与世界建模，并补充真实世界策略实验。
Result: 学习指定动作的视觉后果提升了策略性能，并在场景变化下改善泛化；动作学习在同一架构下提升了多视角世界预测 (multi-view world prediction) 的保真度；两个研究问题均得到肯定答案。
Conclusion: 世界建模与动作生成在统一因果训练下互为增益，正向动力学学习与策略学习可以放在一个架构里共同训练。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MemComposer: Learning to Assemble Memories for LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to reuse past experiences without updating their parameters. However, semantic similarity alone does not guarantee memory usefulness: downstream performance depends on how memories are selected and presented to the agent. We propose MemComposer, a memory composer that jointly examines the current query and retrieved candidates to decide which experiences to include, how many to select, and how to order them. We train the composer using Experience Policy Optimization (ExPO), a GRPO-based framework that evaluates assembled memory contexts through complete agent interactions and uses task-success feedback to optimize the assembly policy. Across three $τ^2$-bench domains with two frozen executors, MemComposer outperforms the strongest baseline for each executor while reducing average memory-token usage by 16.9% and 4.9%, respectively. The learned policy also transfers to unseen domains, executors, and memory banks, and benefits from memories generated by stronger models without further training. These results demonstrate the value of learning query-specific memory assembly using downstream task feedback.

papers.title: RoboCloth: A Large-Scale Real Cloth Material Dataset for Neural Reflectance Reconstruction
authors: Francesco Di Sario (University of Torino and Simon Fraser University)
Daniel Rebain (University of British Columbia and Wayve)
papers.abstract_en: We present RoboCloth, a dataset of 500 real cloth materials captured under flexible, calibrated camera and lighting configurations, where both are robotically controlled during acquisition. Each material is imaged in approximately 580 high-dynamic range frames spanning a wide view-light hemisphere; camera poses are refined via structure-from-motion and aligned to the robot frame, yielding per-material sparse surface geometry and structured per-point reflectance observations ready for neural material training. We demonstrate the value of this data through a two-stage neural reconstruction pipeline: Stage 1 trains a shared MLP decoder on our corpus to learn cloth material priors; Stage 2 then freezes the decoder and fits a dense 2048x2048 latent texture to each target material. Evaluating on held-out materials from our own dataset and on the independent UBO2014 benchmark, we show that a decoder trained on our captures outperforms decoders trained on existing measured reflectance datasets and analytic PBR fitting, transferring to unseen acquisition systems without modification. The dataset, calibration files, observation tensors, and train/test splits are released under CC BY 4.0 on the Hugging Face Hub.
papers.comment: Project page: https://theialab.github.io/robocloth/ ; Code: https://github.com/theialab/robocloth ; Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/theialab/RoboCloth . 16 pages including supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboCloth 发布 500 种真实布料材质数据集，机器人控制相机与光照在约 580 张 HDR 帧、宽视角-光照半球上采集，经 SfM 精化位姿后得到逐点反射观测。两阶段神经重建中，先在该语料上训练共享 MLP decoder 学布料先验，再冻结 decoder 拟合 2048x2048 稠密 latent texture；在留出材质与独立 UBO2014 上均超过用现有实测反射数据集训练的 decoder 与解析 PBR 拟合，且可不加修改迁移到未见过的采集系统。
Motivation: 现有实测反射数据集规模与采集配置受限，训练出的材质先验难以迁移到新的相机-光照系统，解析 PBR 拟合对布料这类复杂反射也不够。
Method: 机器人控制相机与光照采集，每种材质约 580 张 HDR 帧覆盖宽视角-光照半球；SfM 精化相机位姿并对齐到机器人坐标系，得到稀疏表面几何与结构化逐点反射观测。两阶段管线：Stage 1 在全语料上训练共享 MLP decoder 学材质先验，Stage 2 冻结 decoder、对每种目标材质拟合 2048x2048 稠密 latent texture。
Result: 在本数据集留出材质与独立 UBO2014 基准上，用 RoboCloth 训练的 decoder 在神经反射重建上优于用现有实测反射数据集训练的 decoder 与解析 PBR 拟合，并可不加修改迁移到未见过的采集系统。数据集含 500 种材质、每种约 580 帧，以 CC BY 4.0 在 Hugging Face Hub 发布（含标定文件、观测张量与划分）。
Conclusion: 机器人控制的高密度真实采集能学出可跨采集系统迁移的布料材质先验，优于既有实测数据集训练的先验与解析 PBR 拟合。

papers.title: Probe-and-Resume: When and How to Evaluate Agent Execution
papers.abstract_en: Test-time search can improve agent performance by exploring alternative actions and using a critic to select promising branches. We study this approach in terminal-based computer-use environments, which expose only a partial view of a large underlying state, and find that the Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) configuration we evaluate does not significantly improve task success. We identify two sources of poor critic performance: the agent's observations omit environment state needed for evaluation, and intermediate states offer limited evidence of whether a trajectory will succeed. At intermediate states, critics rank continuations only modestly better than chance, and environment access improves this little. We study when to invoke a critic and what access to give it to evaluate a node. Our findings motivate a policy that invokes the critic only at nodes the agent believes are final, rather than during partial progress. Further, the policy gives the critic read, write, and execute access to a fork of the computer's current and initial state, allowing it to probe and perform potentially destructive actions to surface any hidden state the trajectory omits. We call the resulting design Probe-and-Resume: when the agent claims to be done, the critic probes a fork of its state, and a rejected agent resumes where it stopped. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, this raises success by 8.4 percentage points over MCTS with conventional critics, and approaches the success rate of the Codex CLI agent with the same underlying model at less than half its cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在终端类计算机操作环境中，MCTS 式 test-time search 因观测缺失与中间态证据不足而几乎无效；改为只在 agent 自称完成时调用 critic，并给它对状态 fork 的读写执行权限去试探隐藏状态，被拒后从原处恢复（Probe-and-Resume）。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上比带常规 critic 的 MCTS 提升 8.4 个百分点成功率，并以不到一半成本逼近同底模 Codex CLI 的成功率。
Motivation: 终端环境只暴露底层状态的一部分，critic 在中间态排序后续轨迹仅略好于随机，导致 test-time search 的分支探索无法转化为任务成功率。
Method: 对比 MCTS 与常规 critic；提出 Probe-and-Resume 策略——仅在 agent 声称完成的节点调用 critic，critic 获得对计算机当前与初始状态 fork 的 read/write/execute 权限，可执行试探性乃至破坏性动作暴露隐藏状态，被拒后 agent 从停止处恢复。
Result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，Probe-and-Resume 相对带常规 critic 的 MCTS 提升 8.4 个百分点成功率；达到与使用相同底层模型的 Codex CLI agent 相近的成功率，而成本不到其一半。中间态上 critic 对后续的排序仅略好于随机，给予环境访问改善很小。
Conclusion: critic 应只在终态候选处被调用并被授予可试探的 fork 访问权，而非在部分进度上频繁评估；这是对 computer-use agent test-time search 的具体设计主张。
Relevance: 2
