papers.title: SIEVE: Overcoming Topological Obstruction in Equivariant Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: We identify a theoretical incompatibility between 3D point cloud masked autoencoding and SE(3)-equivariant networks. We prove that standard masking triggers a topological collapse, effectively forcing the model to hallucinate orientation without a reference frame. To resolve this, we introduce SIEVE (Scalar Invariant Extraction Via Equivariance), an SE(3)-equivariant self-supervised framework that compresses point cloud geometry into invariant scalar embeddings. At its core is the spherical projection mask, which preserves global pose while obfuscating local semantics, sidestepping the obstruction by construction. Experiments confirm that SIEVE circumvents the predicted collapse where constant and noise masks fail. On downstream point cloud tasks, the resulting embeddings improve over coordinate-based baselines and hand-crafted geometric descriptors, with the largest gains on generalization to unseen shape categories.
papers.comment: The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 3D 点云掩码自编码与 SE(3)-等变网络存在理论不兼容：标准掩码会触发拓扑坍缩，迫使模型在没有参考系的情况下凭空生成朝向。提出 SIEVE，用球面投影掩码 (spherical projection mask) 保留全局位姿、只遮蔽局部语义，从而绕开该障碍；实验确认常数掩码与噪声掩码会坍缩而 SIEVE 不会，其嵌入在未见形状类别的泛化上提升最大。
Motivation: 点云掩码自编码的自监督预训练与 SE(3) 等变网络在理论上冲突：标准掩码破坏了恢复几何所需的参考系，导致拓扑坍缩，模型只能幻觉朝向。
Method: SIEVE (Scalar Invariant Extraction Via Equivariance)：把点云几何压缩为不变标量嵌入的 SE(3)-等变自监督框架，核心是球面投影掩码，构造性地保留全局位姿同时遮蔽局部语义，绕开拓扑障碍。
Result: 实验确认 SIEVE 绕过了理论预言的坍缩，而常数掩码 (constant mask) 与噪声掩码 (noise mask) 失败；在下游点云任务上，其嵌入优于基于坐标的基线与手工几何描述子，在泛化到未见形状类别时提升最大。
Conclusion: 掩码自编码与 SE(3) 等变性之间的拓扑不兼容是可绕开的，方法是让掩码保留全局位姿、只遮蔽局部语义，由此得到的不变标量嵌入在跨类别泛化上最有价值。

papers.title: RoPE-Flow: Monocular Vision-based Robot Pose Estimation via 2D Graph-Conditioned 3D Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Camera-to-robot pose estimation from a monocular image is significant for vision-based robot navigation and control. However, recovering 3D structural features from 2D observations remains a challenging task. Existing camera-to-robot pose estimation methods either rely on time-consuming iterative rendering or involve sophisticated 2D-3D registration which suffers from projection ambiguity, accumulated errors for distal joints and imbalanced learning for different joints. In this work, we propose RoPE-Flow, an end-to-end flow matching-based framework for camera-to-robot pose estimation. From the predicted 2D heatmaps, we propose a Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor to obtain positional features along with contextual representations from keypoints-centered multi-scale patches. Moreover, we introduce Graph-guided Condition Generator, which embeds a learnable adjacency map to generate condition for flow matching based on correlation among keypoints. Besides, we introduce Bone Length Loss and Ray-Depth Loss for topological consistency and scale stability, with joint-wise weighting to mitigate varied prediction difficulty across joints. The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods for pose estimation across different types of robots with mutiple cameras. Besides, we establish a novel cross-scene benchmark to demonstrate the outstanding performance of RoPE-Flow on zero-shot cross-scene robot pose estimation. Meanwhile, animated visualizations are shown on the website: ropeflow.netlify.app
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoPE-Flow 把单目图像到机器人位姿 (camera-to-robot pose) 估计做成端到端 flow matching：从 2D 热图出发，用以关键点为中心的多尺度 patch 提取特征，再用可学习邻接图生成条件，并以 Bone Length Loss 与 Ray-Depth Loss 保证拓扑一致与尺度稳定。在多种机器人与多相机上超过 SOTA 方法，并在自建跨场景基准上展示零样本跨场景位姿估计性能。
Motivation: 从 2D 单目观测恢复 3D 结构特征困难：现有方法要么依赖耗时的迭代渲染，要么靠复杂的 2D-3D 配准，而配准受投影歧义、远端关节累积误差以及不同关节学习不均衡的困扰。
Method: 端到端 flow matching 框架：预测 2D 热图后，Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor 从以关键点为中心的多尺度 patch 提取位置特征与上下文表示；Graph-guided Condition Generator 用可学习邻接图按关键点间相关性生成 flow matching 的条件；加入 Bone Length Loss 与 Ray-Depth Loss 分别约束拓扑一致性和尺度稳定，并对不同关节做加权以缓解关节间预测难度差异。
Result: 在多种类型机器人与多个相机的位姿估计上超过 SOTA 方法；并建立新的跨场景基准，展示 RoPE-Flow 在零样本跨场景机器人位姿估计上的性能。
Conclusion: 用 flow matching 加图引导条件与骨长/射线深度约束，可以绕开迭代渲染与 2D-3D 配准的歧义和误差累积，实现跨机器人、跨相机乃至零样本跨场景的单目位姿估计。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 端到端 flow matching 框架：预测 2D 热图后，Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor 从以关键点为中心的多尺度 patch 提取位置特征与上下文表示；Graph-guided Condition Generator 用可学习邻接图按关键点间相关性生成 flow matching 的条件；加入 Bone Length Loss 与 Ray-Depth Loss 分别约束拓扑一致性和尺度稳定，并对不同关节做加权以缓解关节间预测难度差异。
summary_sections.result: 在多种类型机器人与多个相机的位姿估计上超过 SOTA 方法；并建立新的跨场景基准，展示 RoPE-Flow 在零样本跨场景机器人位姿估计上的性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 用 flow matching 加图引导条件与骨长/射线深度约束，可以绕开迭代渲染与 2D-3D 配准的歧义和误差累积，实现跨机器人、跨相机乃至零样本跨场景的单目位姿估计。

papers.title: A Jury, Not an Electorate: Label-Free Reliability Estimation for Ensembles of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: An ensemble of language models is a jury, not an electorate. The answers are testimony from witnesses of unknown reliability, and the question is not what the majority said but who is credible. Most ensemble methods assign each expert a fixed reputation, often learned from labels. We ask whether it can instead be inferred from the pattern of agreement and disagreement among the experts. We model the experts as a jury: each question has a latent true answer, each expert reports it with unknown reliability, and those reliabilities are estimated by Expectation Maximisation (EM) from unlabelled answer configurations alone. We show that its decision rule reduces to a log-odds weighted linear score over the experts' answer distributions. What changes is not how the jury votes, but how it learns whom to trust. On a 1560-question benchmark, the jury, with nine experts of up to 3B parameters, performs comparably to the same fusion rule with label-fitted weights, showing no statistically significant advantage from supervision. Instead, it outperforms the best single model with matched self-consistency and the strongest label-free alternative on the full benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 集成建模为陪审团：每题有潜在真答案，各专家以未知可靠度作答，用 Expectation Maximisation 仅从无标签的答案配置估计可靠度，决策规则化为对各专家答案分布的 log-odds 加权线性打分。在 1560 题基准上，9 个最大 3B 参数的专家组成的陪审团与用标签拟合权重的同一融合规则表现相当，监督无统计显著优势，且在全基准上超过匹配 self-consistency 的最佳单模型与最强无标签替代方法。
Motivation: 多数集成方法给每个专家固定声誉，且往往依赖标签学习权重；作者要问可靠度能否只从专家间一致与不一致的模式推断出来。
Method: 将专家建模为陪审团的潜变量模型：每题一个潜在真答案，每个专家以未知可靠度报告，用 Expectation Maximisation (EM) 从无标签答案配置估计可靠度；推导出的决策规则是对专家答案分布的 log-odds 加权线性打分，与标签拟合权重共用同一融合形式。
Result: 在 1560 题基准上，9 个专家（最大 3B 参数）的陪审团与标签拟合权重的同一融合规则表现相当，监督无统计显著优势；同时在全基准上优于匹配 self-consistency 的最佳单模型和最强无标签替代方法。
Conclusion: 集成该信任谁可以从专家间的一致/不一致模式无标签学出，标签监督对这套融合规则没有显著增益。

papers.title: Sci$Π$vot: Benchmarking Principal-Investigator Judgment at Pivotal Moments of Scientific AutoResearch Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can keep scientific experiments running for months with little human supervision, but reliable autonomous research also requires scientific judgment. Evaluating scientific judgment is difficult because research decisions are open-ended and depend on project context. We construct Sci$Π$vot, a 248-case benchmark of scientific judgment based on human corrections. The benchmark draws on records from six months of research in which senior researchers ran LLM agents on 26 projects across six scientific fields and repeatedly intervened to correct the agents' research judgments. In each case, an agent chooses between the original LLM plan and the human-corrected alternative, using only the project record available before the correction as context. We compare LLM and human performance and examine the effects of reasoning effort, access to the project record, and reconsideration. At medium reasoning effort with the project record, models systematically prefer the original LLM plan over the human-corrected alternative. Four of five frontier models perform below chance on the selected cases. The highest accuracy in the project condition across the tested models and reasoning effort settings is 63.5%, compared with 73.4% for fresh researchers. At medium effort, every model achieves lower accuracy with the project record than without it, and reconsideration does not consistently improve overall accuracy. Even with a human-corrected alternative available, frontier models struggle with the selected research decisions, while Sci$Π$vot supports systematic evaluation of scientific judgment for LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sci$Π$vot 是一个 248 例的科学判断基准，用六个月、26 个项目、六个学科中资深研究者对 LLM agent 的人工纠正记录构造：agent 仅凭纠正前的项目记录，在原始 LLM 方案与人工纠正方案之间二选一。中等推理强度下模型系统性偏向原始方案，五个前沿模型中四个在所选案例上低于随机水平；项目条件下最高准确率 63.5%，而新鲜研究者为 73.4%。
Motivation: LLM agent 已能无人值守跑数月实验，但科研关键节点上的判断可靠性难以评测，因为决策开放且强依赖项目上下文，缺少可复用的评测载体。
Method: 从六个月真实科研记录中提取资深研究者对 agent 判断的人工纠正，构成 248 例二选一任务；每例只给纠正前的项目记录作上下文，让 agent 在原方案与纠正方案间选择，并对比 LLM 与人类表现，考察推理强度、是否提供项目记录、以及 reconsideration 三个因素的影响。
Result: 中等推理强度且给出项目记录时，模型系统性偏好原始 LLM 方案而非人工纠正方案；所选案例上五个前沿模型中四个低于随机水平。项目条件下跨模型与推理强度设置的最高准确率为 63.5%，新鲜研究者为 73.4%。中等强度下每个模型在有项目记录时准确率都低于无记录设置，reconsideration 对总体准确率没有一致改善。
Conclusion: 即使人工纠正方案就在候选里，前沿模型在所选科研关键决策上仍表现吃紧；Sci$Π$vot 使 LLM agent 的科学判断可被系统化评测，而提供更多项目记录本身并不自动提升判断准确率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StochLOB: Heavy-Tailed Score Matching for Robust Limit Order Book Trend Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Score-based diffusion methods usually perturb data with Brownian Gaussian noise, corresponding to a light-tailed forward stochastic differential equation (SDE). For market time series this SDE can be a poor abstraction: limit order book (LOB) order flow is heavy-tailed, bursty, and occasionally jump-like. We study STOCHLOB, a training-only score-matching framework that changes the forward diffusion corruption law while leaving the deployed predictor deterministic. Instead of Brownian-only Gaussian corruption, the noising process uses two non-Gaussian SDE-inspired alternatives: jump-Lévy noise through a compound-Poisson variance mixture, and clipped $α$-stable noise through a positive-stable Gaussian scale mixture. These corruptions inject finite jumps and heavy-tailed residuals into training without requiring reverse-time diffusion sampling at inference. The resulting score target has a useful interpretation: its radial factor $h_t(r)$ is the posterior expected corruption precision, so large residuals are weighted according to the latent corruption scale that most plausibly generated them. On chronologically held-out Coinbase LOB data, the proposed variants remain competitive on uncorrupted BTC and altcoin test horizons and improve several realized tail-window stress diagnostics. An exploratory Feishu A-share transfer study further tests whether the probability outputs remain usable under transaction costs and trading-rule constraints. Code and configuration files are available at https://github.com/ArshiAbolghasemi/Penny.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 5 figures. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: AI for Stochastic Dynamics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StochLOB 把扩散模型的前向加噪从布朗高斯换成重尾非高斯形式——jump-Lévy（compound-Poisson 方差混合）与 clipped α-stable（正稳定高斯尺度混合）——只在训练阶段用 score matching 注入有限跳跃和重尾残差，推理仍是确定性预测器。在按时间切分的 Coinbase LOB 测试上，两个变体在未加噪的 BTC 与山寨币 horizon 上保持竞争力，并改善若干 realized tail-window 压力诊断。
Motivation: 市场时间序列的 LOB 订单流重尾、突发且偶有跳跃，布朗高斯前向 SDE 对其是糟糕的抽象，标准 score-based diffusion 的训练加噪与真实噪声结构不匹配。
Method: STOCHLOB 是 training-only 的 score-matching 框架，只改前向扩散的 corruption law：jump-Lévy 噪声经 compound-Poisson 方差混合，clipped α-stable 噪声经正稳定高斯尺度混合；score target 的径向因子 h_t(r) 解释为后验期望的 corruption precision，按潜在 corruption scale 给大残差加权。推理端不使用 reverse-time diffusion 采样，部署的预测器保持确定性。
Result: 在按时间顺序留出的 Coinbase LOB 数据上，两个非高斯变体在未加噪的 BTC 与山寨币测试 horizon 上保持竞争力，并改善若干 realized tail-window 压力诊断；另有一项探索性的 Feishu A 股迁移研究，检验概率输出在交易成本与交易规则约束下是否仍可用。
Conclusion: 把重尾与跳跃结构放进训练期的前向加噪，可以在不改变推理成本的前提下让 score-based 模型更贴合 LOB 订单流的噪声形态；Feishu A 股迁移被作者定位为探索性检验。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Adaptive Randomized Neural Networks for PDEs: Structure-Aware Feature Redistribution and Residual-Driven Block Enrichment
papers.abstract_en: Randomized neural networks retain an output-linear least-squares solve, but globally sampled random features may fail to capture the spatial and scale structure of PDE solutions. We propose SFRBE--RaNN, a two-stage adaptive trial-space construction. SFR redistributes a fixed feature budget according to regional indicator masses and adapts regional weight scales through low-dimensional residual-based optimization. RBE constructs nonredundant enrichments by screening multiple activation families, removing represented response directions, and selecting the smallest admissible prefix. For solution-dependent operators, candidates are screened with a frozen operator and accepted only after nonlinear residual verification. For fixed linear problems, we establish an exact discrete residual-reduction identity and a conditional solution-error estimate. Building on this identity, we combine safeguarded SFR with RBE capture factors to derive a finite-horizon error bound involving baseline best approximation and empirical consistency, together with a conditional random-search success-probability bound. Numerical experiments on localized, multiscale, and nonlinear space--time problems demonstrate the method's effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SFRBE--RaNN 把随机神经网络 (randomized neural networks) 的固定随机特征预算按区域指示量质量重新分配 (SFR)，再用残差驱动的块富集 (RBE) 筛掉已被表示的响应方向、只保留最小可接受前缀，从而让输出线性最小二乘解贴合 PDE 解的空间与尺度结构。对固定线性问题给出精确的离散残差缩减恒等式与条件解误差估计，并导出有限时域误差界与条件随机搜索成功概率界；在局部化、多尺度与非线性时空问题上验证有效性。
Motivation: 全局均匀采样的随机特征无法捕捉 PDE 解的局部化与多尺度结构，固定特征预算在不同区域分配失当，导致输出线性最小二乘解精度受限。
Method: 两阶段自适应试验空间构造：SFR 按区域指示量质量重分配固定特征预算，并通过低维残差优化自适应区域权重尺度；RBE 筛选多种激活族、移除已被表示的响应方向并选取最小可接受前缀。解相关算子用冻结算子筛选候选、仅在非线性残差验证通过后接受；固定线性问题建立精确离散残差缩减恒等式与条件解误差估计，再结合带保护的 SFR 与 RBE 捕获因子导出含基线最佳逼近与经验一致性的有限时域误差界，以及条件随机搜索成功概率界。
Result: 在局部化、多尺度与非线性时空问题的数值实验中展示方法有效性；理论结果为固定线性问题的精确离散残差缩减恒等式、条件解误差估计、有限时域误差界与条件随机搜索成功概率界。
Conclusion: 把随机特征预算按解结构自适应重分配并用残差驱动的非冗余富集，可在保持输出线性求解的同时让随机神经网络适配局部化与多尺度 PDE 解。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.conclusion: 把随机特征预算按解结构自适应重分配并用残差驱动的非冗余富集，可在保持输出线性求解的同时让随机神经网络适配局部化与多尺度 PDE 解。

papers.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
papers.abstract_en: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmicsBench 把生物信息学研究级分析拆成 97 个任务、662 个相互依赖的子任务（DAG 结构），每个子任务作为一轮用户输入并按答案键确定性打分。12 个模型在 3 种 harness 上无反馈均分仅 0.43–0.57（满分 1），加 in-context feedback 升到 0.54–0.67；依赖前序子任务的题得分更低，反馈可部分挽回。
Motivation: 现有 AI agent 生物信息学基准多为单轮单任务，无法反映计算生物学家实际委托的长程多轮分析，也看不到子任务依赖带来的失败传播。
Method: 每个任务的子任务组织成有向无环图 (DAG)，共 97 任务、662 子任务；每个子任务作为一次用户 turn，按答案键确定性评分，答错可选给 in-context feedback。另提出无监督失败模式发现流水线：对失败尝试做描述、embedding 与聚类。
Result: 12 个模型 × 3 种 harness：最慢 agent 平均每任务 3.6 小时；无反馈均分 0.43–0.57，有反馈 0.54–0.67（满分 1）；依赖前序子任务的子任务得分更低，反馈可部分恢复。聚类暴露的失败模式包括用自设统计过滤替代指定过滤、凭记忆整段作答。
Conclusion: 长程多轮评测能揭示单轮 prompt 看不到的依赖性失败，且确定性打分需配合失败模式聚类才能解释 agent 错在哪。

papers.title: Approve What, Exactly? Effect Binding and Trusted Rendering for Agent Step-Up Authorization
papers.abstract_en: AI agents now pause for approval before they send money, delete files or email outsiders, and that approval is usually treated as a second factor. We argue it is one only when compromising the agent cannot produce it and when it names exactly what it approves, and we test both conditions. We define twelve attacks on the approval path, including decoy recipients, amount cancellation, card padding, label spoofing, enrollment squatting and threshold splitting, and run them against the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2), the Microsoft action-bound approval design and Model Context Protocol (MCP) elicitation. An audit of ten agent runtimes finds no third-party verifiable approval record, no flood limits where measurable, and post-approval argument changes in four of eight runtimes with measurable binding. As a reference defense we build ASU (Agent Step-Up), a gateway that renders the approval card from a canonical effect descriptor, has a passkey on the phone of the user sign its digest, and executes only the stored call. Tamarin proves its binding, single-use and key-level non-repudiation properties under three stated hypotheses (53 lemmas). Across 27,108 scripted trials and 609 AgentDojo attack pairs, ASU stops substitution, replay and grant stretching, and the trusted card cuts forged-narration attack success from 0.54 to 0.03. With 15 current language models as automated approvers, the trusted card raises the attack catch rate from 0.30 to 0.98, at the cost of refusing 16 percent of harmless near misses, mostly due to a placeholder artifact in our stimuli. A second device adds nothing measurable over a trusted on-host confirmation in these experiments, flooding still succeeds 0.45 to 0.60 of the time against a modeled approver, and approval cannot stop effects that policy already allows. Code, data and proofs: https://github.com/Sports-Vision-Inc/agent-step-up
papers.comment: 36 pages, 13 figures, 13 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/Sports-Vision-Inc/agent-step-up
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张 AI agent 的人工批准只有在「被攻破的 agent 无法自行产出它」且「批准文本精确绑定将要执行的效果」时才算第二因子，并用参考实现 ASU 验证这两条。ASU 从 canonical effect descriptor 渲染批准卡、由手机 passkey 签名摘要、只执行已存储调用，Tamarin 在三条假设下证明其绑定、单次使用与密钥级不可否认（53 条引理）。在 27,108 次脚本试验与 609 个 AgentDojo 攻击对上，可信卡片把伪造叙述攻击成功率从 0.54 压到 0.03，15 个语言模型作为自动批准者时攻击捕获率从 0.30 升到 0.98，代价是拒绝 16% 的无害近似项。
Motivation: agent 审批被普遍当作第二因子，但若被攻破的 agent 能自行产出批准、或批准文本与实际执行效果脱节，它就不构成独立防线；作者对审批路径提出十二类攻击并检验现有协议与运行时是否满足这两个条件。
Method: 定义十二种审批路径攻击（诱饵收款方、金额抵消、卡号填充、标签伪造、注册抢占、阈值拆分等），对 AP2、Microsoft action-bound 审批设计与 MCP elicitation 实施；审计十个 agent 运行时的可验证审批记录、洪泛限制与审批后参数改动；构建 ASU 网关，从 canonical effect descriptor 渲染批准卡、用手机 passkey 签名其摘要、仅执行存储的调用，并用 Tamarin 形式化证明。
Result: 十个运行时审计中无一具备第三方可验证审批记录，可测量处均无洪泛限制，八个可测量绑定的运行时里有四个存在审批后参数改动。ASU 在 27,108 次脚本试验与 609 个 AgentDojo 攻击对上阻止替换、重放与授权拉伸；可信卡片使伪造叙述攻击成功率 0.54 → 0.03，15 个语言模型自动批准时攻击捕获率 0.30 → 0.98，同时拒绝 16% 的无害近似项（多因刺激中的占位符）。Tamarin 在三条假设下证明 53 条引理；第二设备相对可信的本机确认无可测增益，针对建模批准者的洪泛仍有 0.45–0.60 成功率。
Conclusion: 审批要成为真正的第二因子，必须由 agent 无法伪造的外部凭据绑定到精确效果并单次使用；但批准拦不住策略本已允许的效果，洪泛攻击在建模批准者下依然有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Score Mismatch and Set-Constrained Sampling in Zero-Shot Conditional Discrete Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion models have become a powerful framework for modeling complex discrete distributions across a range of applications. While theoretical convergence guarantees depend on consistency between the target and training distributions, such a case rarely holds in practice, making score mismatch a central challenge in discrete diffusion sampling. This is particularly relevant to zero-shot conditional generation, where a model trained on the unconditional distribution is directly reused at inference time to sample from a conditional target distribution. In this paper, we provide the first theoretical analysis for score-mismatched discrete diffusion models and derive a general KL divergence upper bound that clearly identifies the additional bias caused by such a mismatch. Our analysis covers partial-observation constraints, including text infilling, sentence completion, and more general coordinatewise set constraints. Specifically, we analyze the classical Conditional SEDD sampler and show that it can incur a bias term that scales with the dimension, vocabulary size, and compatibility. Based on this analysis, we propose a Randomized Hard Clamping (RHC) sampler for coordinatewise set constraints. We show that the assignment probabilities can be expressed exactly by the unconditional scores with absorbing rate. Finally, numerical and real-data experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed RHC sampler.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 零样本条件离散扩散里，训练用无条件分布、推理却要采条件目标，score mismatch 会引入随维度、词表大小和兼容性增长的偏差。作者给出首个 score-mismatched 离散扩散理论分析与 KL 上界，并提出 Randomized Hard Clamping (RHC) 采样器，证明其分配概率可由无条件 score 加吸收率精确表达，实验显示其有效。
Motivation: 离散扩散的收敛保证依赖目标分布与训练分布一致，实践中很少成立；零样本条件生成直接复用无条件模型，score mismatch 成为核心障碍且缺少理论刻画。
Method: 推导 score mismatch 下的一般 KL 散度上界，明确失配带来的额外偏差项，覆盖部分观测约束（text infilling、sentence completion、逐坐标 set constraint）；据此分析 Conditional SEDD 采样器的偏差结构，并提出 Randomized Hard Clamping (RHC) 采样器，其分配概率由无条件 score 与吸收率精确给出。
Result: 给出首个 score-mismatched 离散扩散的理论分析与 KL 上界；证明 Conditional SEDD 的偏差项随维度、词表大小和兼容性 (compatibility) 扩展；RHC 的分配概率可由无条件 score 加吸收率精确表达，并在数值与真实数据实验中展示有效性。
Conclusion: score mismatch 的偏差可被显式上界并按维度、词表、兼容性分解，针对逐坐标 set constraint 的 RHC 能在零样本条件下缓解该偏差。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Bellman-Consistent Trajectory RL for LLM Arithmetic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: To address sparse terminal rewards in LLM arithmetic reasoning, we propose a Bellman-consistent trajectory RL method. Our framework introduces Trajectory Bellman Residual Minimization (TBRM) to transform sparse rewards into dense token-level signals. We integrate a Reinforce Leave-One-Out (RLOO) group strategy to reduce gradient variance of Bellman residuals and use hindsight goal relabeling to accelerate intermediate learning. Evaluated on the Countdown task, our method alleviates optimization bottlenecks and stabilizes gradient variance significantly better than GRPO. The TBRM-RLOO framework boosts Pass@1 to 0.55--0.64 and achieves a state-of-the-art Pass@16 accuracy of 76.0--84.0\%, outperforming the SFT, IPO/DPO, and RLOO baselines. Our approach demonstrates exceptional single-sample efficiency and successfully circumvents standard performance plateaus via test-time scaling.
papers.comment: Grade A as a project report
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 算术推理中稀疏终端奖励难优化的问题，提出 Bellman 一致的轨迹强化学习框架 TBRM-RLOO：用 Trajectory Bellman Residual Minimization 把稀疏奖励转成 token 级稠密信号，配合 RLOO 组策略降梯度方差与 hindsight goal relabeling 加速中期学习。在 Countdown 任务上 Pass@1 达 0.55–0.64、Pass@16 达 76.0–84.0%，优于 SFT、IPO/DPO 与 RLOO 基线，并靠 test-time scaling 绕开常见性能平台。
Motivation: LLM 算术推理的奖励只在轨迹末端给出，中间步骤没有信号，导致优化瓶颈、梯度方差大且容易陷入性能平台。
Method: TBRM 用 Bellman 残差最小化把稀疏终端奖励分解为 token 级稠密信号；用 Reinforce Leave-One-Out (RLOO) 组策略降低 Bellman 残差的梯度方差，并引入 hindsight goal relabeling 加速中间阶段学习，整体为 TBRM-RLOO 框架。
Result: 在 Countdown 任务上，Pass@1 提升到 0.55–0.64，Pass@16 达到 76.0–84.0% 的 state-of-the-art 精度，超过 SFT、IPO/DPO 与 RLOO 基线；相比 GRPO 更显著地缓解优化瓶颈并稳定梯度方差，并通过 test-time scaling 实现单样本效率与绕开性能平台。
Conclusion: 把稀疏奖励改写为 Bellman 一致的 token 级信号并配合低方差组策略，可在 Countdown 类算术推理上同时改善优化稳定性与最终 Pass@k 精度。

papers.title: Athanor: An Agent-Native System for Autonomous Post-Training Research
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement, in which AI systems build stronger AI systems, is one promising route to superintelligence. We study a weaker form that can be measured today: frontier agents post-training a small raw base model with public data, as a test of their research potential. We build Athanor, an open agent-native system for autonomous post-training research (AutoPostTrain) on real GPUs. We give the agents full research autonomy, low-friction engineering tools, and efficient starter code. The agents carry out the research themselves: they read datasets and evaluation results, build their training data, write and modify training algorithms, tune hyperparameters, and analyze the results to decide what to try next. They work in a sandbox and cannot use external teacher models. Athanor's services supply frozen evaluation, managed jobs, decontaminated data, a persistent research record, and a held-out suite the agents are unaware of. In a 104-hour campaign, a team of four Claude Opus 5.5 agents, each on an eight-GPU node and given no research advice, improves Qwen3-4B-Base from 15.9 to 67.3 on a six-task development suite and from 9.2 to 48.2 on a held-out suite, against 66.5 and 47.9 for the official Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that a team of frontier agents can autonomously post-train a raw base model into a cross-domain generalist model that matches or surpasses the official instruct version on average. The campaign's full record shows that the agents reach this level by recombining known methods and each other's models: SFT on public reasoning data, RL with a rollout change one agent introduced, weight merges across agents, and rounds of self-distillation. With execution handled, today's agents already have the engineering and research ability to conquer this task. We hope Athanor provides a foundation for scaling autonomous AI research.

papers.title: SALTO: Solver-Anchored Lifted Transfer Operators for Nonlinear Event Inference
papers.abstract_en: Learned dynamical models can accurately predict trajectories while producing unreliable sensitivities when differentiated or transposed, limiting their use in inverse problems and scientific decision-making. Classical adjoints provide exact local derivatives, but a single adjoint cannot represent the nonlinear response of a system to a family of finite-amplitude perturbations. We introduce SALTO (Solver-Anchored Lifted Transfer Operators), a Koopman-based framework for inferring finite-amplitude sources. In the lifted space, the nonlinear dynamics are approximated by a linear propagator, and its transpose carries each sensor backward in a single solve. The result is a reusable lifted adjoint that predicts the measurement produced by any candidate localized event with one encoder pass and an inner product. To give the model the simulator's exact local behavior, SALTO imposes three structural constraints: it anchors the physical-state dynamics to the simulator's linearized propagator, centers the learned observables so that they vanish to second order at the reference state, and uses a block-triangular lifted propagator. These constraints guarantee that the model reduces to the simulator's tangent dynamics and classical adjoint as the amplitude vanishes, while the learned observables carry only the finite-amplitude correction. On three nonlinear PDE systems, SALTO predicts the measurements of finite-amplitude sources to within 2-8% where the classical adjoint is in error by 41-165%, recovers source position and intensity from sparse sensors nearly as accurately as inversion through the solver, and samples the joint posterior of two interacting sources, matching the solver's posterior on reaction-diffusion at a twentieth of its cost. One trained model serves new sensor layouts and measurement times with a single backward solve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SALTO 用 Koopman 提升空间把非线性动力学近似为线性传播子，其转置让每个传感器一次回解，得到可复用的 lifted adjoint，一次编码加内积即可预测任意候选有限幅值事件的观测。通过锚定模拟器线性化传播子、居中观测量至二阶消失、块三角提升传播子三项约束，幅值趋零时模型退化为切线动力学与经典 adjoint。在三个非线性 PDE 系统上，有限幅值源观测预测误差 2–8%，经典 adjoint 为 41–165%；稀疏传感器下源位置与强度恢复接近经求解器反演的精度，双源联合后验与求解器在 reaction-diffusion 上匹配，成本为其二十分之一。
Motivation: 学到的动力学模型轨迹预测准，但求导或转置后的灵敏度不可靠，难以用于反问题与科学决策；经典 adjoint 虽给出精确局部导数，却无法表示系统对一族有限幅值扰动的非线性响应。
Method: SALTO 是基于 Koopman 的框架：在提升空间用线性传播子近似非线性动力学，其转置把每个传感器在单次求解中回传。三项结构约束为把物理状态动力学锚定到模拟器的线性化传播子、将学到的观测量居中使其在参考态二阶消失、采用块三角 (block-triangular) 提升传播子；观测量只承载有限幅值修正。
Result: 在三个非线性 PDE 系统上，SALTO 对有限幅值源的观测预测误差为 2–8%，经典 adjoint 误差 41–165%；从稀疏传感器恢复源位置与强度的精度接近经求解器反演；对两个相互作用源采样联合后验，在 reaction-diffusion 上与求解器后验匹配，成本为求解器的二十分之一。一个训练好的模型可用单次回解服务新的传感器布局与观测时刻。
Conclusion: 把模拟器的切线动力学作为锚、只让学习成分承载有限幅值修正，就能得到既在小幅值下退化为经典 adjoint、又在有限幅值下远比 adjoint 准的可复用 lifted adjoint，用约 1/20 成本做后验采样。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: SHIP: Structured and Hierarchical Insight with Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Extracting insights from textual data while protecting user privacy is increasingly important. Existing methods produce private insights in diverse forms for different analytical purposes, making their utility difficult to assess and compare. In this work, we formulate differentially private (DP) insights as reusable representations for answering analytical queries, providing a common basis for utility assessment. Answering these queries, however, requires fine-grained details and cross-attribute statistics that existing representations may omit. To capture this information, we introduce Structured and Hierarchical Insight with Privacy (SHIP), which automatically maps queries to attributes, builds a hierarchical hybrid taxonomy, and releases a DP synthetic table for further analysis. We also develop an evaluation protocol based primarily on QA performance and structured fidelity. Our experiments demonstrate SHIP's strong performance on both measures relative to existing private insight baselines, while identifying queries that remain challenging for structured representations.
papers.comment: This paper mainly work on extracting and evaluating insights from textual data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHIP 把差分隐私 (DP) 洞察统一成可复用的查询应答表示：自动把查询映射到属性、构建层级混合分类体系 (hierarchical hybrid taxonomy)，并发布一张 DP 合成表供后续分析。以 QA 表现和结构保真度为主的评测协议显示，SHIP 在两项指标上相对已有私有洞察基线表现更强，同时暴露出结构化表示仍难处理的查询类型。
Motivation: 现有私有洞察方法面向不同分析目的产出形式各异的结果，效用难以统一评估与比较；而已有表示又常遗漏应答查询所需的细粒度细节与跨属性统计。
Method: SHIP 将 DP 洞察形式化为可复用的查询应答表示，自动把查询映射到属性，构建层级混合分类体系，并发布一张 DP 合成表；配套提出以 QA 表现和结构保真度 (structured fidelity) 为主的评测协议。
Result: 实验显示 SHIP 在 QA 表现与结构保真度两项指标上相对已有私有洞察基线均表现强劲，同时识别出对结构化表示仍具挑战性的查询。
Conclusion: 把私有洞察做成统一的可复用表示并配套 QA 加结构保真的评测，可为跨方法效用比较提供共同基准；结构化表示对部分查询仍不充分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PremiseCheck: Efficient Fact-Checking of Human and AI Peer Reviews
papers.abstract_en: Peer review is under strain from the growth of submissions, and review comments written by humans or AI can misstate what a paper says. We introduce ReviewFact, a benchmark that labels such factual errors in review comments under one definition across NLP, machine learning, and the natural sciences, and that measures cost and latency alongside accuracy. A frontier LLM checks comments well but must read the whole paper for each check, while cheap decision models, which score whether a statement holds in a text, fall far short on whole comments that mix several implicit assertions. PremiseCheck is a framework that combines the two. An LLM rewrites each comment as explicit premises without reading the paper, and a decision model checks each premise against the paper. When each comment is checked on its own, PremiseCheck reaches accuracy comparable to GPT-5.5 across all three fields at about half its cost, and on NLP reviews at a quarter of its cost and less than half its latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PremiseCheck 把评审意见拆成显式前提再逐条核对：LLM 在不读论文的前提下把评论改写为若干显式 premise，再用廉价 decision model 逐条对照论文判断是否成立。在覆盖 NLP、机器学习与自然科学的 ReviewFact 基准上，逐条评论核对时精度与 GPT-5.5 相当而成本约一半；在 NLP 评审上成本降至四分之一、延迟降到一半以下。
Motivation: 投稿量增长使同行评审承压，人写或 AI 生成的评审意见会误述论文内容；前沿 LLM 核对准确但每条检查都要通读全文，成本高，而廉价 decision model 面对含多条隐含断言的整条评论时表现差。
Method: 两段式框架：先由 LLM 在不读论文的情况下把每条评论改写为显式 premises，再用 decision model（判断某陈述在文本中是否成立）逐条对照论文核对；配套提出 ReviewFact 基准，用统一定义标注评审意见中的事实错误，并同时度量准确率、成本与延迟。
Result: 在 ReviewFact 的 NLP、机器学习、自然科学三个领域上，逐条评论核对时 PremiseCheck 精度与 GPT-5.5 相当，成本约为其一半；在 NLP 评审上成本为其四分之一、延迟低于其一半。
Conclusion: 把整条评论拆成显式前提再逐条核对，可以在不读全文的改写步骤下达到前沿 LLM 的事实核查精度，同时显著压低成本与延迟。

papers.title: Learning When to Withdraw: Curriculum Coverage and Rule-Specific Failures in Fine-Tuned Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using language agents must revise prepared actions when evidence changes or authority is revoked. Selective withdrawal means suspending affected actions, preserving supported work, and resuming only after sufficient repair. We study supervised fine-tuning in NAQD-Env, a synthetic environment with explicit dependencies and a deterministic reference policy. Four LoRA checkpoints of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct compare an original curriculum with an enriched one, the latter under three system-prompt framings with identical views and targets. Three instruction-tuned baselines and all four checkpoints are evaluated under three inference prompts on fresh validation cases, held-out dependency families, and held-out structural combinations. Under the naqd prompt, SFT checkpoints reach decision agreement of 0.77-0.92 and withdrawal recall of 0.46-0.86, versus 0.45-0.63 and at most 0.06 for the baselines. Rule-level diagnostics qualify these gains. The original-curriculum checkpoint wrongly withdraws 26 of 34 actions with surviving alternative support; enriched checkpoints withdraw 0-1. Conversely, all SFT checkpoints narrow prohibited combinations less often than the 7B and 8B baselines, a case absent from both curricula. Delegation results show more withdrawal but poorer preservation of independently authorized actions, and all four checkpoints omit valid event reports. Framing contrasts vary across metrics and splits and do not establish a reproducible advantage or equivalence. One training run per arm, jointly changed curriculum properties, prior evaluation exposure, and baseline-SFT quantization differences limit causal attribution. The contribution is a method for detecting rule-specific regressions that aggregate accuracy can conceal, not evidence that fine-tuning alone ensures agent safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在合成环境 NAQD-Env 中用监督微调 (SFT) 让工具调用语言 agent 学会在证据变化或权限撤销时选择性撤回 (selective withdrawal)。四个 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 的 LoRA checkpoint 在 naqd 推理提示下决策一致率达 0.77-0.92、撤回召回 0.46-0.86，而三个 instruction-tuned 基线仅 0.45-0.63、召回至多 0.06；但规则级诊断显示聚合准确率掩盖了具体回归。
Motivation: 工具调用 agent 在证据变化或权限被撤销时需要暂停受影响动作、保留仍有依据的工作，聚合准确率会掩盖按规则划分的失败模式，无法判断微调是否真的带来安全的撤回行为。
Method: 在 NAQD-Env（显式依赖、确定性参考策略的合成环境）上做监督微调：四个 LoRA checkpoint（Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct）对比原始课程与增强课程，增强课程再配三种系统提示 framing（视图与目标相同）；在新验证样本、留出依赖族、留出结构组合上，用三种推理提示评估四个 checkpoint 与三个 instruction-tuned 基线，并做规则级诊断。

papers.title: ReviewPilot: A Multi-Agent System for Screening and Data Extraction in Systematic Reviews
papers.abstract_en: Systematic literature reviews follow the PRISMA process of screening scholarly works and extracting evidence from included studies. Deep research tools based on large language models (LLMs) can search and summarize the literature but do not record which studies are excluded or where extracted values come from. We develop a conversational multi-agent system called ReviewPilot that automates the PRISMA workflow from paper screening to information extraction. Researchers can tailor criteria and schemas through dialogue, and a project memory keeps their configurations and revisions. Each screening decision comes with its reason and each extracted value with its source. On epidemiological expert reviews, ReviewPilot outperforms a single-prompt LLM and AgentSLR across three LLMs, with screening macro F1 up to 0.776 and extraction F1 up to 0.788. Case studies in biomedicine and human-computer interaction show close agreement with human annotators, suggesting that ReviewPilot can transfer beyond epidemiology. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/ReviewPilot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReviewPilot 是一个把 PRISMA 系统综述流程自动化的对话式多智能体系统，通过项目记忆保存研究者的筛选标准与抽取 schema，并为每个筛选决策附上理由、每个抽取值附上出处。在流行病学专家综述上，它在三种 LLM 上均超过单提示 LLM 与 AgentSLR，筛选 macro F1 最高 0.776、抽取 F1 最高 0.788。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 深度检索工具能搜索和总结文献，但不记录哪些研究被排除、抽取值来自何处，无法满足 PRISMA 对可追溯性的要求。
Method: 对话式多智能体系统覆盖从论文筛选到信息抽取的 PRISMA 流程；研究者通过对话定制筛选标准与抽取 schema，项目记忆保存配置与修订；每个筛选决策附带理由，每个抽取值附带来源。
Result: 在流行病学专家综述上，ReviewPilot 在三种 LLM 上均优于单提示 LLM 与 AgentSLR，筛选 macro F1 最高 0.776，抽取 F1 最高 0.788；在生物医学与人机交互的案例研究中与人类标注者高度一致。
Conclusion: 带可追溯决策与来源的多智能体流程能自动化 PRISMA 筛选与抽取，且可迁移到流行病学以外的领域。

papers.title: Recursive Reward Improvement via Adversarial Meta-Prompt Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) has gained wide attention for its ability to work with limited data. In a proposer-solver loop, a proposer model writes training tasks and a solver model learns to solve them through reinforcement learning. Such loops have succeeded in mathematics and coding, where every answer can be checked automatically. Open-ended expert tasks, like clinical report generations, have no answer key, which makes simple question-answer generation not viable. Here the proposer must also write a rubric that lists the content an answer should include and the errors it should avoid. However, the unique challenge behind model-written rubric is the comprehensiveness of it. For naively generated rubric, solvers tend to exploit it, naming the expected topics without the substance behind them, which corrupts the learning process. To solve this problem, we introduce RRI, Recursive Reward Improvement, which uses a reward hacking adversary to supervise the reward. Before the solver trains on a generated task, an adversary writes an answer that games its rubric while being as useless as possible, the same model writes an honest answer without seeing the rubric, and up to two repair steps revise the rubric to make the honest answer win. The exploits found also rewrite how future tasks and rubrics are generated. On HealthBench Professional, RRI improves the adjusted score over the Generation Only self-improvement baseline by 10.9 points at 9B and 12.4 at 27B, and by 10.3 points without any external model. In particular, the gains are largest on difficult and writing tasks. We show that the 27B model trained on the HealthBench Professional description improves by 6.6 points on PRBench Hard and 8.0 on ProfBench without seeing a task from either. We further analyze the exploitable points of model-generated question-rubric pairs to facilitate future research on open-ended self-play.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RRI (Recursive Reward Improvement) 在无标准答案的开放式专家任务里，用一个 reward hacking 对抗者先按 rubric 写出「钻空子但无用」的答案，同一模型再盲写诚实答案，最多两轮修复让诚实答案胜出，从而修掉模型自写 rubric 不全面、被 solver 刷分的问题。在 HealthBench Professional 上相对 Generation Only 自改进基线，9B 提升 10.9 分、27B 提升 12.4 分，不用任何外部模型也有 10.3 分。
Motivation: 数学和编程的 proposer-solver 自改进循环依赖可自动判分的答案，而临床报告生成这类开放式专家任务没有 answer key，只能靠模型自写 rubric；朴素生成的 rubric 不全面，solver 会只点出预期话题而回避实质，污染学习过程。
Method: RRI 在 solver 训练某个生成任务之前，先让 adversary 写一个专门迎合 rubric 但尽可能无用的答案，同一模型在看不到 rubric 的情况下写诚实答案，再用最多两步修复改写 rubric 使诚实答案胜出；对抗中发现的可钻空点同时回写到后续任务与 rubric 的生成。
Result: HealthBench Professional 上，RRI 相对 Generation Only 自改进基线的 adjusted score 提升：9B 为 10.9 分，27B 为 12.4 分，完全不用外部模型时为 10.3 分，且在困难任务与写作类任务上增益最大。用 HealthBench Professional 描述训练的 27B 模型在未见过对应任务的情况下，PRBench Hard 提升 6.6 分、ProfBench 提升 8.0 分。
Conclusion: 让对抗者先攻击 rubric 再修复 rubric，可以在没有 answer key 的开放式任务上支撑递归自改进，并把学到的改进迁移到 PRBench Hard 与 ProfBench 这类未见基准；作者同时分析了模型生成的 question-rubric 对的可钻空点以推动后续 open-ended self-play 研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: INCONVENIENT: A Benchmark to Assess LLM Generalization Capabilities from Convenience Samples
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models for tabular prediction typically assume that training data are representative of the population on which they will be deployed. In practice, however, data are often collected based on convenience, availability, or cost, resulting in systematic sampling biases that can distort feature--target relationships and undermine real-world generalization. Existing tabular distribution-shift benchmarks primarily construct out-of-distribution (OOD) settings by partitioning observations across naturally occurring domains. While such partitions may induce changes in P(Y | X), the resulting shifts are neither explicitly controlled nor isolated, and the evaluation distributions themselves are often not representative of the broader target population. We introduce INCONVENIENT, a benchmark designed to study robustness to convenience-sample bias. Rather than relying on naturally occurring domain partitions, INCONVENIENT directly perturbs feature--target relationships in the training distribution while preserving the original population distribution as the deployment environment. This setting more closely reflects real-world scenarios in which models are developed from unrepresentative samples and subsequently deployed on a broader population. The distinction is particularly relevant for large language models (LLMs), whose pretraining may encode population-level knowledge that extends beyond the relationships observed in a biased training dataset. Unlike existing distribution-shift benchmarks, INCONVENIENT provides explicit control over both the direction and severity of relationship shifts, enabling a systematic assessment of robustness to convenience sampling. The benchmark comprises 200 tabular classification and regression datasets spanning diverse application domains and generates around 15,500 shifted training distributions which lead to substantial downstream degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: INCONVENIENT 是一个针对便利抽样偏差 (convenience-sample bias) 的表格数据分布偏移基准：直接扰动训练分布中的特征-目标关系，同时保留原始人群分布作为部署环境，并可显式控制偏移方向与严重程度。它包含 200 个表格分类与回归数据集，生成约 15,500 个偏移训练分布，导致显著的下游性能退化。
Motivation: 现有表格 OOD 基准靠自然域划分构造偏移，既不能显式控制 P(Y|X) 的变化，评估分布本身也常不代表目标人群，难以刻画真实中从非代表性样本训练再部署到广人群的场景。
Method: 不依赖自然域划分，而是直接扰动训练分布的特征-目标关系、保留原始人群分布作部署环境；对偏移方向与严重程度提供显式控制，用于系统评估模型对便利抽样的鲁棒性，并特别关注 LLM 预训练中编码的超出偏移训练集的人群级知识。
Result: 基准涵盖 200 个跨应用领域的表格分类与回归数据集，生成约 15,500 个偏移训练分布，并带来显著的下游性能退化。
Conclusion: 便利抽样偏差可以被显式、可控地注入训练分布来系统度量泛化退化，且这种设置对依赖预训练人群知识的 LLM 尤其相关。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Efficient Agnostic Learning of Univariate Densities Under Local Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: We propose a general framework for non-interactive locally differentially private (LDP) learning of structured univariate distributions that can be approximated by piece-wise polynomials. This gives the first sample-efficient LDP learners for several distribution classes, including mixtures of log-concave distributions, such as Gaussian mixture models (GMMs). These learners also provide agnostic guarantees and are computationally efficient. We also prove a lower bound for learning GMMs under LDP, improving on the standard pure-DP packing lower bounds of Bun et al. [BKSW19]. To obtain our general learning framework, we develop an efficient non-interactive LDP algorithm for synthetic data generation over large domains, which may be of independent interest. We then use it together with a deterministic adaptation of the non-private piecewise polynomial learner of Acharya et al. [ADLS17].
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个非交互局部差分隐私 (LDP) 下学习可分段多项式逼近的一元分布的通用框架，给出混合对数凹分布（含 GMM）的首批样本高效 LDP 学习器，兼具 agnostic 保证与计算效率；并改进了 GMM 在 LDP 下的下界，超过 Bun et al. [BKSW19] 的标准纯 DP packing 下界。
Motivation: 在 LDP 约束下学习结构化一元分布（如 GMM、混合对数凹分布）此前缺少样本高效的非交互学习器，且已知下界依赖标准纯 DP packing 论证，刻画不够紧。
Method: 先构造一个面向大域的高效非交互 LDP 合成数据生成算法（可独立使用），再与 Acharya et al. [ADLS17] 的非私有分段多项式学习器做确定性改造结合，形成覆盖可分段多项式逼近分布类的通用学习框架；另给出 GMM 在 LDP 下的新下界。
Result: 得到多个分布类（含 GMM 等混合对数凹分布）的首个样本高效非交互 LDP 学习器，带 agnostic 保证且计算高效；GMM 在 LDP 下的下界改进了 Bun et al. [BKSW19] 的标准纯 DP packing 下界。
Conclusion: 分段多项式逼近加大域 LDP 合成数据生成，足以在非交互隐私约束下高效学习结构化一元分布，并能给出更紧的下界刻画。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SCARCE: Emergent Institutions in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Coding Systems
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous agents become widely deployed, coordinating access to shared computing resources and services will become increasingly important. Recent incidents have already revealed unplanned coordination between agents, highlighting the safety implications of these interactions. Yet prior studies of agent negotiation often use stylized games and simulated bargaining, leaving open how these behaviors develop during sustained, long-horizon tasks. We propose SCARCE (Shared Compute ARena for Coding agEnts), a framework in which agents solve sequences of coding tasks under individual deadlines while negotiating access to a shared execution resource. This negotiation determines when and for how long they can inspect programs, compile code, and run tests. We find that agents spontaneously develop informal institutions: persistent rules and commitments grounded in reputation, reciprocity, and precedent. These arrangements, which we call institutional behaviors, carry across tasks and influence resource allocation, with agents sometimes foregoing immediate advantages to honor earlier agreements. We develop a 21-category taxonomy of negotiation strategies and emergent norms and use it to analyze eight models and audit more than 1,500 trajectories across different environmental settings. Among the models tested, newer frontier models exhibit more institutional behaviors than older or lightweight models. Alongside cooperation, we observe exclusionary coalitions and rare divide-and-conquer strategies. SCARCE provides a controlled setting for proactively and systematically auditing how these relationships emerge, shape access to resources, and affect the safety and coordination of multi-agent systems.

papers.title: LoopWAM: Closed-Loop Generalist Policy Improvement from Deployment Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: Scaling expert demonstrations alone does not enable generalist robot policies to improve from deployment. Real-world rollouts contain successes, suboptimal behavior, and failures: imitating every recorded action can reinforce poor behavior, while filtering out failures discards evidence of physical interactions and their consequences. We introduce LoopWAM, a closed-loop world-action model that learns directly from this full quality spectrum, using rollouts from both itself and other deployed policies. Source-dependent noise sampling unifies behavior learning and action-conditioned world modeling, while quality steering and quality-weighted supervision retain full video supervision across qualities and regulate action imitation. Video and action tokens interact throughout parallel denoising, allowing learned consequences to inform action generation directly. On RoboChallenge Table30-V2, three deployment-and-training rounds raise success from 23.67% to 43.33%, a 19.7-percentage-point gain, with a final score of 56.80. LoopWAM also achieves 94.5% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 and 49.5% overall success on RoboCasa365 without additional embodied pretraining, obtaining the best overall results among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. On challenging shirt folding task, two rounds of deployment-driven improvement after single-task post-training raise success from 13.20% to 55.56%. These results demonstrate closed-loop improvement from mixed-quality experience under both multi-task learning and single-task post-training. Project page: https://loop-wam.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoopWAM 是闭环世界-动作模型，直接从部署 rollout 的全质量谱（成功、次优、失败）中学习，用 source-dependent noise sampling 统一行为学习与动作条件世界建模，靠 quality steering 与 quality-weighted supervision 在保留全视频监督的同时调节动作模仿。在 RoboChallenge Table30-V2 上三轮部署-训练把成功率从 23.67% 提到 43.33%（+19.7 个百分点，最终得分 56.80）；衬衫折叠任务单任务后训练加两轮部署改进从 13.20% 升到 55.56%。
Motivation: 通才机器人策略无法从部署中自我改进：模仿全部录制动作会强化差行为，过滤掉失败又丢掉物理交互及其后果的证据。
Method: 闭环 world-action model 同时吃自身与其他已部署策略的 rollout；source-dependent noise sampling 把行为学习与 action-conditioned world modeling 统一到一个框架，quality steering 与 quality-weighted supervision 在全质量范围保留完整视频监督并调节动作模仿，视频 token 与动作 token 在并行去噪中全程交互，使学到的后果直接影响动作生成。
Result: RoboChallenge Table30-V2 三轮部署-训练：成功率 23.67% → 43.33%（+19.7 个百分点），最终得分 56.80；RoboTwin 2.0 平均成功率 94.5%；RoboCasa365 总体成功率 49.5%，且无需额外具身预训练，在三个基准上与对比方法相比取得最佳总体结果；衬衫折叠任务在单任务后训练后两轮部署驱动改进使成功率 13.20% → 55.56%。
Conclusion: 混合质量的部署经验本身足以驱动闭环改进，无需过滤失败或额外具身预训练，且在多任务学习与单任务后训练两种设置下都成立。

papers.title: The Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Earth observation (EO) models are still built by hand. For each new task, experts design a training recipe and tune it against a benchmark. We show that this loop can be handed to an agent. Any verifiable task can be cast as a harness and a verifier, where the harness defines what the agent may use and the verifier defines what counts as success. Every EO task can be made verifiable, through labeled benchmarks, independent sensors, physical models or the repeated observation of the same place. Given only these two components, a general-purpose coding agent builds the EO model and improves it recursively on its own outputs. Settings long treated as separate research problems, from learning with a handful of labels to adapting across domains, become choices of harness and verifier. On six EO benchmarks spanning optical, SAR and multispectral time-series imagery, with outputs that range from land-cover maps and ship instances to canopy heights and answers about large images, agent-built models surpass the state of the art on every one, and on land-cover mapping, they do so from 11% of the training labels. This establishes a new paradigm for EO, in which people design harnesses and verifiers and agents build the models, so EO models improve as agents do.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把任意地球观测 (EO) 任务形式化为 harness（限定 agent 可用资源）加 verifier（定义成功标准），由通用编程 agent 递归地在自身输出上构建并改进模型。在覆盖光学、SAR、多光谱时序影像的六个 EO 基准上，agent 构建的模型在全部任务上超过 state of the art，其中土地覆盖制图仅用 11% 训练标签即达成。
Motivation: EO 模型至今仍靠人工搭建：每个新任务都要专家手写训练配方并在基准上反复调参，少样本学习、跨域适应等被当作彼此独立的研究问题。
Method: 将可验证任务统一拆成 harness 与 verifier 两部分，可验证性来自标注基准、独立传感器、物理模型或对同一地点的重复观测；给定这两项后由通用编程 agent 自主构建模型并在自身输出上递归改进，少样本与跨域适应退化为 harness/verifier 的选择问题。
Result: 在六个覆盖光学、SAR 与多光谱时序影像的 EO 基准上（输出含土地覆盖图、船舶实例、冠层高度以及对大图的问答），agent 构建的模型在每一个上超过 state of the art；土地覆盖制图仅用 11% 训练标签即达到该结果。
Conclusion: EO 的分工范式转为人类设计 harness 与 verifier、agent 构建模型，模型随 agent 能力提升而自动改进。

papers.title: DuplexBridge: Coordinating Understanding and Generation for Unified Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Complex image editing requires faithful task interpretation and accurate execution, but a failed edit does not reveal which responsibility failed. We present DuplexBridge, which uses a unified model's own understanding capability to enhance prompts for its own generation capability, without an external understanding module. A source-grounded bridge specifies targets, final-state changes, and preservation constraints. Understanding is supervised on fidelity to the original request without observing the generated image; generation is supervised on execution of the condition it actually receives. Reciprocal trust checks selectively admit global task feedback to each role while retaining independently valid local supervision. We introduce CE-Bench, a 1,200-task benchmark measuring joint satisfaction of task-derived change and preservation requirements. Across three model configurations, the full system improves complete compliance over direct editors by 21.75-25.75 percentage points, with gains also observed on KRIS-Bench, RISEBench, ImgEdit, and GEdit-Bench. From a common supervised Wan-Image initialization, gated joint training reaches 77.08% complete compliance, compared with 70.92% without gates and 75.00% when generation-local supervision instead checks the original task with both gates retained. These results support distinct local responsibilities and selective shared feedback for joint understanding-generation adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuplexBridge 让统一图像编辑模型用自己的理解能力为自己的生成能力改写提示：source-grounded bridge 明确目标、终态变化与保留约束，理解侧只按对原始请求的保真度监督、生成侧只按实际收到的条件监督，再用 reciprocal trust check 选择性放行全局任务反馈。在共同的 Wan-Image 监督初始化下，带门控的联合训练完整合规率 77.08%，比直接编辑器高 21.75–25.75 个百分点。
Motivation: 复杂图像编辑失败时无法区分是任务理解错了还是执行错了，而外部理解模块又与统一模型本身脱节，理解与生成难以联合适配。
Method: 用 source-grounded bridge 在理解与生成之间传递目标、终态变化与保留约束；理解侧在不看生成图的情况下按原始请求保真度监督，生成侧按其实际收到的条件监督；reciprocal trust check 选择性接纳全局任务反馈、保留各自独立成立的局部监督，并引入含 1,200 个任务的 CE-Bench 度量变化与保留要求的联合满足。
Result: 在三种模型配置下，完整系统相对直接编辑器的完整合规率 (complete compliance) 提升 21.75–25.75 个百分点，且在 KRIS-Bench、RISEBench、ImgEdit、GEdit-Bench 上同样观察到增益；从共同的 Wan-Image 监督初始化出发，带门控的联合训练达 77.08% 完整合规，无门控为 70.92%，生成侧局部监督改为核对原始任务且保留双门控为 75.00%。
Conclusion: 理解与生成应承担各自独立的局部职责，只在门控下共享全局任务反馈，才能让统一模型的联合适配同时提高变化与保留两类要求的满足。

papers.title: RSIgen: Reciprocal Self-Improvement for Agentic Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic visual generation produces experience that can improve the native understanding (agent) and generation roles of a unified multimodal backbone, but task success alone does not determine which role should learn. Generator updates can also make the agent's action supervision stale. We introduce RSIgen, a task-centric reciprocal self-improvement framework linking learning allocation, supervision refresh, and recursive curriculum construction. Dynamic Responsibility Routing (DRR) uses matched interventions on evidence, inputs, and supported actions to select learning recipients and construct compatible training targets. After generator learning, RSIgen re-evaluates the relative utility of tested actions with branch inputs held fixed to refresh agent supervision; the retained roles then construct the next curriculum. Across BAGEL, Qwen-Image, and Wan-Image-7B, RSIgen improves AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9 by 3.2--3.3 points over a three-cycle SearchGen adaptation with action costs. Wan controls support allocation gains at matched role-level training exposure, refresh gains at a matched adaptation budget, and benefits from updated curriculum sources while recipients continue learning. In blind evaluation on 200 real-user requests, pooled tie-adjusted preference scores against the same baseline reach 70.0% for task completion and 64.9% for visual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RSIgen 把 agentic 视觉生成中的学习分配、监督刷新与递归课程构造绑成一个互惠自改进框架：Dynamic Responsibility Routing (DRR) 用配对干预决定谁该学、构造兼容训练目标，生成器更新后固定 branch 输入重测动作效用以刷新 agent 监督，再由保留角色生成下一轮课程。在 BAGEL、Qwen-Image、Wan-Image-7B 上，三轮 SearchGen 适配后 AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9 提升 3.2–3.3 分；200 条真实用户请求的盲评中，同基线的平局调整偏好分任务完成 70.0%、视觉质量 64.9%。
Motivation: agentic 视觉生成中任务成功本身无法判定该由哪个角色学习，且生成器更新会让 agent 的动作监督过期，学习分配与监督刷新缺少统一的判定机制。
Method: RSIgen 含三个环节：Dynamic Responsibility Routing (DRR) 对证据、输入与支持动作做配对干预 (matched interventions) 来选择学习对象并构造兼容训练目标；生成器学习后固定 branch 输入重估已测动作的相对效用来刷新 agent 监督；保留的角色再构造下一轮递归课程。在 BAGEL、Qwen-Image、Wan-Image-7B 上做三轮 SearchGen 适配并计入动作成本。
Result: AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9 相对三轮 SearchGen 基线提升 3.2–3.3 分（跨 BAGEL、Qwen-Image、Wan-Image-7B）；Wan 在角色级训练曝光匹配时控制了支持分配增益、在适配预算匹配时控制了刷新增益，并从更新的课程来源中获益。200 条真实用户请求的盲评中，对同一基线的平局调整偏好分任务完成 70.0%、视觉质量 64.9%。
Conclusion: 把学习分配、监督刷新与课程递归绑在一起，可在统一多模态骨干的 agent 与 generator 角色间持续互惠改进，且刷新与课程更新在匹配预算下各自贡献增益。

papers.title: Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve
papers.abstract_en: Searching text-rich knowledge graphs requires following relations while examining textual evidence. Predefined graph interfaces constrain what evidence agents can access, even when they write code to combine tool calls or process retrieved subgraphs. We propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which language model agents create graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine node sets, and select textual evidence, interleaving execution with shell search and file inspection. This lets agents process large node sets in bulk while returning selected text for the model to assess. Execution feedback guides tool creation and revision, while the evolving tools determine what evidence the agent gathers next. On benchmark datasets spanning three domains, training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest published baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every graph, even with a minimal harness. Controlled ablations show the benefits of multi-turn programming over shell-only access and predefined graph tools, while trajectories show agents revising code to extend searches or address errors. These findings highlight the value of allowing tool creation and tool use to co-evolve during graph search. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出直接知识图谱交互 (DKGI)：语言模型 agent 直接在完整节点与边文件上用 Python 代码创建图访问工具，把执行反馈与 shell 搜索、文件检视交错，让工具创建与工具使用在图搜索中共同演化。在覆盖三个领域的基准数据集上，training-free 的 DKGI 在每张图上都比最强已发表基线高出至少 6.7 个 Hit@1 点，即使 harness 极简。
Motivation: 预定义的图接口限制了 agent 能取到的证据，即便 agent 写代码组合工具调用或处理检索到的子图，文本证据的可达范围仍被接口框死。
Method: DKGI harness 让 agent 直接读取完整 node/edge 文件并编写 Python 代码来沿关系遍历、合并节点集、筛选文本证据，执行过程与 shell 搜索和文件检视交替；执行反馈驱动工具的创建与修订，而演化出的工具决定下一步收集哪些证据，全程 training-free。
Result: 在横跨三个领域的基准数据集上，training-free DKGI 在每张图上都比最强已发表基线高出至少 6.7 个 Hit@1 点，即使使用极简 harness；受控消融显示多轮编程优于仅 shell 访问和预定义图工具，轨迹显示 agent 会修改代码以扩大搜索范围或修复错误。
Conclusion: 让工具创建与工具使用在图搜索过程中共同演化，比固定接口或纯 shell 访问更能提升文本型知识图谱的关系检索效果。

papers.title: Agentic-MatriBO: Capability-Compiled Agentic Bayesian Optimization for Materials and Chemical Design
papers.abstract_en: Materials and chemical optimization must choose the next synthesis, characterization, or high-fidelity simulation from sequential observations under a limited budget. Large language models can use task knowledge to propose adjustments, but composing surrogates, acquisition functions, and search strategies is constrained by compatibility, parameter dependencies, and evidence requirements. We present Agentic-MatriBO, a capability-compiled agentic Bayesian optimization (BO) framework that represents BO components and selection conditions as composable capabilities. A language policy proposes BO recipes and candidate plans; a compiler checks proposals against the registered capability catalog; and a deterministic execution layer validates and commits candidates. Oracle observations are stored in research memory and inform later rounds. We compare Agentic-MatriBO with eight baselines on four offline finite candidate pools---COF, PCE10, Buchwald--Hartwig (BH), and Suzuki--Miyaura---using five seeds per condition; results are reported descriptively. Across the four tasks, Agentic-MatriBO has the best mean endpoint quality after orienting each objective so that higher is better. On COF, it reaches the tabulated optimum in all five seeds both in the end-to-end comparison and after shared initialization, where it also retains an advantage in cumulative quality. Its normalized area under the best-so-far quality curve during the BO stage (nAUC-BO) is substantially higher on COF, near parity with the best baseline on PCE10 and BH, and lower on Suzuki. COF ablations show that removing the capability compiler or evidence gate coincides with lower cumulative quality and fewer exact-optimum hits. The framework provides an inspectable interface for evidence-conditioned BO adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Agentic-MatriBO 把贝叶斯优化 (BO) 的代理模型、采集函数与搜索策略编译成可组合的 capability，由语言策略提议 BO 配方、capability compiler 校验、确定性执行层提交候选。在 COF、PCE10、Buchwald–Hartwig、Suzuki–Miyaura 四个离线候选池上对比八个基线，其平均终点质量在四个任务上均为最佳，COF 上五种子全部命中表列最优值，但 Suzuki 上 nAUC-BO 低于最优基线。
Motivation: 材料与化学优化需在有限预算下从序贯观测中选择下一次合成、表征或高保真模拟；LLM 虽能凭任务知识提出调整，但代理模型、采集函数与搜索策略的组合受兼容性、参数依赖与证据要求约束。
Method: 将 BO 组件与其选择条件表示为可组合的 capability；语言策略提议 BO 配方与候选计划，capability compiler 对照注册的 capability 目录校验，确定性执行层验证并提交候选；oracle 观测存入 research memory 供后续轮次使用。评测用四个离线有限候选池（COF、PCE10、Buchwald–Hartwig、Suzuki–Miyaura），每条件五个种子，结果以描述性方式报告。
Result: 对比八个基线，四个任务上 Agentic-MatriBO 的平均终点质量最佳（各目标已统一为越高越好）。COF 上端到端比较与共享初始化后均在全部五个种子达到表列最优值，且共享初始化下累积质量仍占优；BO 阶段归一化最优-so-far 曲线下面积 (nAUC-BO) 在 COF 上显著更高，PCE10 与 BH 上与最优基线接近持平，Suzuki 上更低。COF 消融显示去掉 capability compiler 或 evidence gate 伴随更低的累积质量与更少的精确最优命中。
Conclusion: 把 BO 组件编译为受证据约束的 capability 并由编译器与执行层把关，可在材料与化学候选池上取得最佳平均终点质量，且该接口使 BO 适配可检查；但在 Suzuki–Miyaura 上 BO 阶段搜索效率不及最优基线。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Follow the Perturbed Leader for Linear Bandits: $\sqrt{T}$ Regret over General Convex Sets
papers.abstract_en: We give the first adversarial linear bandit algorithm based on Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader (FTPL) that achieves $\sqrt{T}$ regret over general convex action sets. Our algorithm attains $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d^{5/4}\sqrt{T})$ regret using only linear optimization oracles, and the near-optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{T})$ regret when an optimal-design exploration distribution is further available. This improves on the $T^{2/3}$ regret of the FTPL algorithm of Dani and Hayes (2006) for general convex sets, and generalizes the $\sqrt{T}$ regret of Lévy et al. (2026) over two special action sets (hypercube and Euclidean ball). Compared to previous oracle-efficient linear bandit algorithms based on continuous exponential weights, the FTPL approach generally has better computational efficiency, and is much simpler to implement. The key algorithmic element is a perturbation distribution that adapts to the past reward estimators. Its simplest form, an adaptive Gaussian perturbation, is straightforward to implement and already attains the regret bound above. We further extend it to two general constructions, random-weighting and elliptical perturbations, each covering distributions from light tails (Gaussian) to heavy tails (Student-$t_2$). On the technical side, we develop a systematic way to analyze the stability term in the FTPL regret through the Fisher information of the perturbation distribution. This builds a general framework for FTPL beyond existing ones such as the hazard rate and the FTRL-FTPL duality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个在一般凸动作集上达到 √T 遗憾的 FTPL 对抗性线性 bandit 算法：仅用线性优化 oracle 即得 Õ(d^{5/4}√T)，若再有 optimal-design 探索分布则达近最优 Õ(d√T)。关键是对过去奖励估计量自适应的扰动分布，最简形式为 adaptive Gaussian 扰动。
Motivation: 一般凸动作集上的 FTPL 线性 bandit 此前最好只有 T^{2/3} 遗憾（Dani and Hayes, 2006），而 √T 结果仅限超立方体与欧氏球两种特殊集合（Lévy et al., 2026）；已有 oracle-efficient 算法依赖连续指数权重，计算开销大、实现复杂。
Method: 核心是随过去奖励估计量自适应的扰动分布：最简为 adaptive Gaussian 扰动，另推广出 random-weighting 与 elliptical perturbation 两种构造，覆盖从 Gaussian 等轻尾到 Student-t_2 重尾的分布。技术上通过扰动分布的 Fisher information 系统分析 FTPL 遗憾中的 stability term，建立超越 hazard rate 与 FTRL-FTPL 对偶的通用分析框架。
Result: 一般凸集上遗憾 Õ(d^{5/4}√T)（仅需线性优化 oracle），加入 optimal-design 探索分布后为近最优 Õ(d√T)；相对 Dani and Hayes (2006) 的 T^{2/3} 有改进，并把 Lévy et al. (2026) 在超立方体与欧氏球上的 √T 结果推广到一般凸集。
Conclusion: 自适应扰动分布加 Fisher information 稳定性分析，使 FTPL 在一般凸动作集上同时拿到 √T 遗憾与更好的计算效率和更简单的实现。

papers.title: TwinPrune: Density-Aware Two-Phase Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a unified spatial-density signal to score token importance for both inference phases: bipartite merge for prefill and KV eviction for decode, yielding measurable gains in each stage. To isolate the two phases, we split benchmarks by scoring logic. Prefill probes (MMBench, POPE, ScienceQA) evaluate only the first decoded token; their accuracy reflects prefill logits argmax before any decode KV eviction. Full-pipeline probes (TextVQA, DocVQA, MM-Vet) assess the complete generated sequence and capture both phases. We identify a critical evaluation pitfall: decode pruning claims validated solely on prefill probes measure prefill quality, not decode performance. Experiments show discarding all visual KV during decode barely affects prefill-probe accuracy but degrades TextVQA and MM-Vet drastically; this insensitivity stems from the scoring rule, not compression intensity. Evaluated on seven model variants (InternVL-3.5, Qwen3-VL, LLaVA-1.5) and three full-pipeline benchmarks, our method achieves a three-way Pareto frontier across compute, memory and accuracy. Density-based prefill compression maintains strong accuracy, scales linearly with visual token count, and delivers 100x faster token selection at high resolution. For decode, density top-k KV eviction consistently outperforms strong baselines H2O, SnapKV and StreamingLLM on TextVQA and MM-Vet across three retention ratios. At 0.125 keep ratio on TextVQA, it surpasses H2O by 9.6 points; InternVL-3.5 models (2B to 38B) maintain a 7 to 10 point advantage. Compression scales favorably with model size: every measured 8B to 38B model transition reduces accuracy loss instead of worsening it. We suggest MM-Vet or DocVQA as mandatory full-pipeline validation for any decode-phase claims. Our code is available at https://github.com/Kai-Liu001/TwinPrune
papers.comment: Our code is availabel at https://github.com/Kai-Liu001/TwinPrune
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TwinPrune 用统一的空间密度信号给视觉 token 打分，同时服务 prefill 的 bipartite merge 与 decode 的 KV eviction，并指出只用 prefill 探针（MMBench、POPE、ScienceQA）验证 decode 剪枝会测错对象：decode 阶段丢弃全部视觉 KV 几乎不影响 prefill 探针精度，却让 TextVQA、MM-Vet 大幅下降。在 TextVQA 0.125 keep ratio 下密度 top-k 比 H2O 高 9.6 分，InternVL-3.5（2B 到 38B）保持 7 到 10 分优势。
Motivation: decode 阶段的 KV 剪枝论文普遍只在 prefill 探针上验证，而这类探针只看第一个解码 token 的 argmax，测不到 decode 剪枝的真实影响，导致结论失真。
Method: 提出统一的空间密度信号作为 token 重要性评分，prefill 用 bipartite merge 压缩视觉 token，decode 用 density top-k 做 KV eviction；按评分逻辑把基准拆成 prefill 探针（MMBench、POPE、ScienceQA）与 full-pipeline 探针（TextVQA、DocVQA、MM-Vet），在 InternVL-3.5、Qwen3-VL、LLaVA-1.5 共七个模型变体上评测。
Result: TextVQA 0.125 keep ratio 下比 H2O 高 9.6 分；InternVL-3.5 2B 到 38B 保持 7 到 10 分优势，且 8B 到 38B 每次模型规模上升都降低精度损失；高分辨率下 token 选择提速 100 倍，prefill 压缩随视觉 token 数线性扩展；decode 阶段丢弃全部视觉 KV 对 prefill 探针精度几乎无影响，但 TextVQA 与 MM-Vet 大幅下降。
Conclusion: 任何 decode 阶段剪枝主张都必须用 MM-Vet 或 DocVQA 这类 full-pipeline 基准验证，仅靠 prefill 探针会把 prefill 质量误当成 decode 性能；密度评分在计算、显存、精度上给出三方 Pareto 前沿。

summary_sections.method: 提出统一的空间密度信号作为 token 重要性评分，prefill 用 bipartite merge 压缩视觉 token，decode 用 density top-k 做 KV eviction；按评分逻辑把基准拆成 prefill 探针（MMBench、POPE、ScienceQA）与 full-pipeline 探针（TextVQA、DocVQA、MM-Vet），在 InternVL-3.5、Qwen3-VL、LLaVA-1.5 共七个模型变体上评测。
summary_sections.result: TextVQA 0.125 keep ratio 下比 H2O 高 9.6 分；InternVL-3.5 2B 到 38B 保持 7 到 10 分优势，且 8B 到 38B 每次模型规模上升都降低精度损失；高分辨率下 token 选择提速 100 倍，prefill 压缩随视觉 token 数线性扩展；decode 阶段丢弃全部视觉 KV 对 prefill 探针精度几乎无影响，但 TextVQA 与 MM-Vet 大幅下降。
summary_sections.conclusion: 任何 decode 阶段剪枝主张都必须用 MM-Vet 或 DocVQA 这类 full-pipeline 基准验证，仅靠 prefill 探针会把 prefill 质量误当成 decode 性能；密度评分在计算、显存、精度上给出三方 Pareto 前沿。

papers.title: MID: Mask-Image Distributional Divergence for Evaluating Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Current evaluation protocols for medical image segmentation remain largely anchored in sample-wise comparisons, e.g., Dice and Hausdorff distance, which require each prediction to be paired with a ground-truth mask. Yet two limitations arise in practice: they are inapplicable when predictions are made on unlabeled data; and even when annotations are available, they cannot assess whether a collection of predictions matches the distributional structure of the ground-truth population. We introduce MID (Mask-Image Distributional Divergence), a distribution-level evaluation metric for medical image segmentation. MID builds upon the observation that segmentation quality is a property of the joint image-mask distribution: a mask may be anatomically plausible in isolation yet incorrect for the image it accompanies. MID compares the joint distribution of images and masks between a reference set and a set of predictions, without requiring sample-wise correspondence. This captures both mask realism and image-mask consistency. We evaluate MID across 13 publicly available datasets spanning CT, MRI, and MRA. Under anatomically realistic corruptions across 56 organ groups, MID tracks mean Dice and Hausdorff distance without per-sample ground-truth pairing. MID also detects distributional shifts across modalities and anatomies, identifies image-mask misalignment through controlled shuffling experiments, and produces reliable model rankings across real segmentation models. Official implementation available at github.com/erc-caravel/pytorch-mid
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MID 是面向医学图像分割的分布级评估指标，比较参考集与预测集的图像-掩码联合分布，无需逐样本配对真值即可同时度量掩码真实性与图文一致性。在 13 个 CT/MRI/MRA 公开数据集、56 个器官组的解剖学合理扰动下，MID 能跟踪 mean Dice 与 Hausdorff distance，并检出模态与解剖间的分布偏移、通过受控打乱识别图文错位，给出可靠的模型排序。
Motivation: Dice 与 Hausdorff distance 依赖逐样本真值配对，在无标注数据上不可用，且无法判断一组预测是否匹配真值总体的分布结构。
Method: MID 直接比较参考集与预测集的图像-掩码联合分布，不要求样本一一对应；评测覆盖 13 个公开 CT、MRI、MRA 数据集，配合解剖学合理扰动、跨模态/跨解剖分布偏移与受控打乱 (shuffling) 实验，并在真实分割模型上做排序。
Result: 在 56 个器官组的解剖学合理扰动下，MID 在无需逐样本真值配对时跟踪 mean Dice 与 Hausdorff distance；能检出跨模态与跨解剖的分布偏移，通过受控打乱实验识别 image-mask misalignment，并在真实分割模型上给出可靠排序。
Conclusion: 分割质量应作为图像-掩码联合分布的属性来评估，分布级指标可在无逐样本标注时替代样本级 Dice/Hausdorff 并额外暴露图文错位。

papers.title: Beyond Sparse Captions: Aligning Slide-Level Text and Patch-Level Vision in Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive vision-language (VL) pretraining in computational pathology has generally relied on curated image-caption datasets sourced from social media, educational videos, and research publications. These corpora are sparse relative to the diversity of tissue morphology and difficult to scale further, as pathologists do not routinely produce descriptive captions in clinical practice. We propose to instead leverage slide-level pathology reports which can be generated during routine diagnostic workflows in a scalable manner. A key challenge in this weakly-supervised setting is that pathology reports describe macroscopic, diagnostic findings while patch-level visual features describe microscopic findings. We introduce Locked Image Multiple Instance PreTraining (LIMIT), which addresses this gap by freezing a pretrained vision encoder and fine-tuning only the text encoder: report embeddings serve as cross-attention queries over bags of patch features, producing report-conditioned slide representations optimized via InfoNCE. Using LIMIT, we establish CONCH-Z, which aligns the text encoder of CONCH v1.5 to 335k clinical reports. Evaluated across 22 tasks spanning patch-level classification, tumor detection, and slide-level subtyping, CONCH-Z establishes state-of-the-art zero-shot performance over VL encoders trained on curated caption datasets, while simultaneously closing the gap with slide-level foundation models trained with substantially more parameters and compute. The code and model is available at https://github.com/mahmoodlab/LIMIT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LIMIT 冻结预训练视觉编码器、只微调文本编码器，用报告嵌入作为 cross-attention query 聚合 patch 特征袋，以 InfoNCE 对齐整张病理报告与切片级表征。据此建立的 CONCH-Z 在 335k 临床报告上对齐 CONCH v1.5 文本编码器，在 22 项任务的零样本评测中达到 VL 编码器的 SOTA，并缩小与更大参数量切片级基础模型的差距。
Motivation: 计算病理的对比视觉-语言预训练依赖社交媒体、教学视频和论文中整理的图像- caption 数据，相对组织形态多样性过于稀疏且难以扩展，而临床病理报告可在常规诊断流程中规模化产生。
Method: LIMIT 冻结预训练视觉编码器、仅微调文本编码器：报告嵌入作为 cross-attention query 作用于 patch 特征袋，输出报告条件化的切片表征，用 InfoNCE 优化；再以该方法把 CONCH v1.5 的文本编码器对齐到 335k 临床报告，得到 CONCH-Z。
Result: 在覆盖 patch 级分类、肿瘤检测与切片级分型的 22 项任务上，CONCH-Z 的零样本性能超过在整理 caption 数据集上训练的 VL 编码器，同时缩小了与用显著更多参数和算力训练的切片级基础模型之间的差距。
Conclusion: 用常规工作流产生的整片病理报告做弱监督对齐，可以在不扩充 caption 语料的前提下把零样本病理 VL 推到 SOTA，并接近重算力切片级模型的水平。

papers.title: LIBERO-Industry: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Industrial Process Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Industrial manipulation in flexible manufacturing, e.g., high-mix, low-volume (HMLV) electronics assembly, requires robot policies to adapt to changing products and production conditions. Such settings impose industrial process constraints, including product variants, moving material flows, finite execution windows, and tight geometric tolerances. However, existing evaluation frameworks do not systematically capture these constraints when assessing generalist robot policies. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Industry, a novel benchmark built on the widely used robot learning benchmark LIBERO, that translates the aforementioned industrial constraints into controllable task conditions and measurable success criteria. Specifically, LIBERO-Industry comprises three classic task scenarios: Static-to-Dynamic (S2D) loading, Dynamic-to-Static (D2S) unloading, and Dynamic-to-Dynamic (D2D) transfer. The suites contain 216 tasks in total that systematically vary object geometry, conveyor speed, interaction-window duration, and geometric acceptance region size. Extensive experiments across five generalist robot policies (including vision-language-action models and world-action models) show that performance progressively degrades as industrial constraints are introduced and combined. Under a shared fine-tuning and evaluation protocol, the LIBERO-Industry co-training condition achieved higher observed target-transfer completion than the original-LIBERO condition.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 14 figures, 20 tables, including appendices. Project website: https://IAIE-PhysicalAI.github.io/LIBERO-Industry/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LIBERO-Industry 把工业过程约束（产品变体、移动物料流、有限执行窗口、几何公差）转成可控任务条件与可度量成功判据，在 LIBERO 上构建 216 个任务的机器人操作基准，含 S2D 上料、D2S 下料、D2D 搬运三类场景。五个通用策略（含 VLA 与 world-action 模型）的实验显示，约束逐项引入并叠加时性能持续下降；共享微调与评测协议下，LIBERO-Industry co-training 的目标转移完成率高于 original-LIBERO 条件。
Motivation: 柔性制造（多品种小批量电子装配）要求策略随产品与产线条件变化而适应，但现有评测框架在评估通用机器人策略时没有系统纳入工业过程约束。
Method: 基于机器人学习基准 LIBERO 构建新基准，把工业约束转成可控任务条件与可度量成功判据；三个任务场景为 Static-to-Dynamic (S2D) loading、Dynamic-to-Static (D2S) unloading、Dynamic-to-Dynamic (D2D) transfer，系统变化物体几何、传送带速度、交互窗口时长与几何接受区域大小；在共享微调与评测协议下对五个通用策略（VLA 与 world-action 模型）做实验，并比较 LIBERO-Industry co-training 与 original-LIBERO 条件。
Result: 套件共 216 个任务；五个通用策略的性能随工业约束引入与叠加而逐步退化；共享微调与评测协议下，LIBERO-Industry co-training 条件观测到的目标转移完成率高于 original-LIBERO 条件。
Conclusion: 工业过程约束应作为可控变量进入机器人策略评测，且在 LIBERO-Industry 上做 co-training 比只用 original-LIBERO 更利于目标转移完成。

papers.title: RAP-WAM: Learning World-Action Models through Predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Recent world action models draw on video generation priors to jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Adapting these priors to control requires determining how future predictions should guide policy learning. RAP-WAM combines predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations (RAP) with future-supervised queries and Coupled Action Projection for policy learning. Predictive rehearsal trains on model-generated inputs while retaining recorded targets, and accumulates recurring errors into a spatial prior. We perturb actions and measure changes in video predictions. Action-response-based spatiotemporal credit assignment combines these responses, prediction error, and the rehearsal prior to allocate visual supervision; spatially aggregating the responses determines supervision intensity across future action steps. No separate scoring network or deployment-time probe is required. The base learns from a video-pretrained backbone without intermediate pretraining on external embodied data. We evaluate the fixed base and its agent-refined, task-conditioned system. On 42 RoboDojo tasks, their average success rates are 12.85% and 15.62%, with Scores of 17.86 and 20.59. Across 15 real-robot tasks, the complete system achieves 89.00% task-macro-average success, exceeding the strongest of five baselines by 37.67 percentage points. Across 315 fixed-output simulation windows, 45.21% of response-top20 positions fall outside error-top20, revealing information beyond prediction error. Videos and further details are available on the project website: https://rapwam.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAP-WAM 用预测性排练 (predictive rehearsal) 与动作扰动把视频生成先验转成机器人策略：在模型生成的输入上训练但保留录制目标，扰动动作并测量视频预测变化，据此做时空信用分配来分配视觉监督，无需单独评分网络或部署期探测。在 42 个 RoboDojo 任务上 base 与任务条件化系统平均成功率 12.85% 与 15.62%（Score 17.86 与 20.59）；15 个真实机器人任务上完整系统任务宏平均成功率 89.00%，比五个基线中最强者高 37.67 个百分点。
Motivation: 视频生成先验适配到控制时，核心难题是未来预测应如何指导策略学习：预测误差本身不足以定位该给哪一步、哪块视觉区域分配监督。
Method: RAP-WAM 组合预测性排练（在模型生成输入上训练、保留录制目标，并把反复出现的误差累积成空间先验）、动作扰动（扰动动作并测量视频预测变化）、基于动作响应的时空信用分配（融合响应、预测误差与排练先验来分配视觉监督，空间聚合响应决定各未来动作步的监督强度）以及 Coupled Action Projection；骨干直接从视频预训练模型起步，不经外部具身数据中间预训练。
Result: 42 个 RoboDojo 任务上 base 与 agent-refined 任务条件化系统平均成功率分别为 12.85% 和 15.62%，Score 分别为 17.86 和 20.59；15 个真实机器人任务上完整系统任务宏平均成功率 89.00%，超出五个基线中最强者 37.67 个百分点；315 个固定输出仿真窗口中，45.21% 的 response-top20 位置落在 error-top20 之外。
Conclusion: 动作响应携带超出预测误差本身的监督信息，据此做信用分配可在不引入评分网络或部署期探测的情况下把视频先验转成可用策略，真实机器人任务上优势最明显。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: PMB-NN: Physiological-Model-Based Neural Network for Glucose Forecasting in Type 1 Diabetes
papers.abstract_en: Accurate, physiologically consistent glucose forecasts could help people with type 1 diabetes respond to impending excursions. We applied our physiological-model-based neural network (PMB--NN) framework to glucose forecasting. A temporal convolutional network (TCN) used 180 min of history, constrained during training by a personalized four-parameter physiological model. The main PMB--NN combined forecast and neural--physiological agreement losses; a three-term variant additionally fitted physiological predictions to measured glucose. Data comprised 6--8 weeks of continuous glucose monitoring, pump, and meal records from 25 AZT1D participants. Person-specific models used chronological 70/10/20 train/validation/test splits and 30-, 60-, and 120-min horizons. Median mean absolute errors were 16.24, 25.00, and 30.20 mg/dL with basal insulin records and 15.38, 24.21, and 31.79 mg/dL before these records became available. In the latter setting, PMB--NN had the lowest median error at 30 and 60 min; it outperformed the physiological model alone in all six settings. In input-increase tests, glucose predictions changed in the expected direction for 85\% of correction boluses and 100\% of carbohydrate rescues, versus 57\% for active insulin and 56\% for active carbohydrates. Most standalone physiological fits showed locally distinguishable parameter effects, with glucose-related coefficients more stable under resampling than insulin- or carbohydrate-related coefficients. The three-term variant improved hyperglycaemia accuracy with basal records, but did not significantly change overall MAE and reduced directional plausibility in three tests. PMB--NN combines personalized forecasting with an explicit physiological model, allowing assessment of predictive accuracy, physiological response behavior, and participant-specific coefficients.

TL;DR: PMB-NN 用 180 分钟历史血糖的时序卷积网络 (TCN) 做 1 型糖尿病血糖预报，训练时被个体化四参数生理模型约束，损失同时含预报项与神经-生理一致性项。在 AZT1D 25 名参与者的 30/60/120 分钟时效上，中位 MAE 分别为 16.24/25.00/30.20 mg/dL（含基础胰岛素记录）与 15.38/24.21/31.79 mg/dL（该记录尚不可用时），且在全部六种设定下都优于纯生理模型。
Motivation: 血糖预报需要既准又符合生理机制，纯数据模型可能给出生理上说不通的响应，纯生理模型精度不足；带基础胰岛素记录缺失的时段尤其难报准。
Method: TCN 吃 180 分钟历史，训练时受个体化四参数生理模型约束；主版 PMB-NN 联合预报损失与神经-生理一致性损失，三项变体再把生理模型预测拟合到实测血糖。数据为 AZT1D 25 名参与者的 6–8 周 CGM、泵与进餐记录，按时间 70/10/20 划分，逐人建模，测 30、60、120 分钟三个时效。
Result: 含基础胰岛素记录时中位 MAE 为 16.24、25.00、30.20 mg/dL（30/60/120 分钟），该记录可用前为 15.38、24.21、31.79 mg/dL；后一设定下 PMB-NN 在 30 与 60 分钟中位误差最低，并在全部六个设定中优于纯生理模型。输入增量测试中，85% 的纠正 bolus 与 100% 的碳水补给使血糖预测朝预期方向变化，而活性胰岛素与活性碳水仅 57% 与 56%。三项变体在含基础记录时提高高血糖精度，但整体 MAE 无显著变化，且在三项测试中降低方向合理性。
