papers.title: Deep Learning-based Semantic Segmentation of Dental Radiographs: Comparative Evaluation of PSPNet, DeepLabv3, UNet, and UNet++
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and efficient analysis of dental radiographs has become increasingly important for disease diagnosis and clinical decision making. In particular, dental radiographs segmentation plays a critical role as it is challenging due to several reasons, such as low contrast, noise in the images, variations in the image quality, etc. Previous studies have primarily addressed these challenges using convolutional neural networks (CNN)-based models. However, direct comparison of these segmentation models is still challenging due to the variations among the experimental settings. Therefore, we mainly compared four segmentation models, including Pyramid Scene Parsing Network (PSPNet), DeepLabV3, UNet, and UNet++, through a fair, controlled experimentation setting under varying conditions such as image sizes and batch sizes. For this, we used 1269 dental radiography images, and prior to training, we implemented a series of preprocessing techniques. To assess the models, we used several metrics, including Dice coefficient (DICE), Intersection over Union (IoU), accuracy, precision, training and validation losses. According to our results, UNet++ demonstrated the highest IoU score of 0.6719, and a DICE value of 0.7869, showing superior results in terms of segmentation, specifically when configured with an image size of 300x300 and a batch size of 16. In addition, we also explored the effect of image resolutions and batch sizes on model performance and accuracy under different architectures. Therefore, this study provides insights into the strengths of different segmentation models and the potential of deep learning-based semantic segmentation methods for improving automated dental radiograph analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在统一受控实验设置下比较 PSPNet、DeepLabv3、UNet、UNet++ 四种语义分割模型在牙科 X 光片上的表现，UNet++ 在 300x300 图像尺寸、batch size 16 配置下取得最高 IoU 0.6719 与 DICE 0.7869，优于其余三种架构。
Motivation: 牙科 X 光片分割受低对比度、噪声和图像质量差异影响，既往 CNN 模型研究的实验设置不一致，导致模型间直接比较困难。
Method: 使用 1269 张牙科 X 光图像，训练前做一系列预处理；在统一受控设置下比较 PSPNet、DeepLabv3、UNet、UNet++，并系统改变图像尺寸与 batch size，评估指标包括 DICE、IoU、accuracy、precision、训练与验证损失。
Result: UNet++ 在 image size 300x300、batch size 16 下取得最高 IoU 0.6719 与 DICE 0.7869；同时考察了不同图像分辨率和 batch size 对各架构性能与准确率的影响。
Conclusion: 在受控对比条件下 UNet++ 是四种模型中牙科 X 光片分割的最佳选择，且图像分辨率与 batch size 是影响分割性能的关键配置变量。

papers.title: TLA-Verus: Generating and Solving Temporal Proof Obligations with LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: The TLA+ (temporal logic of actions) formal specification toolkit has seen widespread adoption in modeling modern distributed software systems including databases, storage systems, ledgers and coordination protocols. This popularity is despite its two significant limitations for software verification: Firstly, TLA+ offers no way to detect drift between software implementation and mathematical specification; secondly, TLC and TLAPS cannot provide satisfactory proofs of arbitrary temporal logic properties. We address the second limitation and take a first step towards the first by translating TLA+ specifications into Verus, an auto-active verifier built for Rust, via both a deterministic transpiler and an agentic translator. We demonstrate that our LLM-based pipeline is able to generate proof obligations from TLA+ specifications at scale, and to produce fully machine checkable proofs of both safety and liveness properties. Since temporal logic reasoning in Verus is a largely new task for LLMs, our work yields a valuable evaluation dataset, which we use to map out current generation model capabilities in Verus theorem proving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TLA-Verus 把 TLA+ 时序规约经确定性 transpiler 与 LLM agentic translator 两条路径翻译成面向 Rust 的自动活跃验证器 Verus，从而生成时序 proof obligations 并产出机器可检查的安全性与活性证明。该流水线能大规模生成证明义务，同时为 Verus 定理证明这一新任务留下评测数据集，用于刻画当前生成模型的能力边界。
Motivation: TLA+ 广泛用于分布式系统建模，但 TLC 与 TLAPS 无法对任意时序逻辑性质给出令人满意的证明，且缺少实现与数学规约之间的漂移检测手段。
Method: 将 TLA+ 规约翻译为 Verus（面向 Rust 的 auto-active verifier），采用两条路径：确定性 transpiler 与 agentic translator；由 LLM 流水线生成 proof obligations 并构造安全与活性性质的机器可检查证明，翻译产物同时充当评测数据集。
Result: LLM 流水线能从 TLA+ 规约大规模生成 proof obligations，并产出覆盖 safety 与 liveness 性质的完全机器可检查证明；工作同时提供 Verus theorem proving 的评测数据集，用于测绘当前生成模型在该任务上的能力。
Conclusion: 借助 LLM 把 TLA+ 时序性质转到 Verus 证明是可行路径，可补上 TLC/TLAPS 在时序逻辑证明上的短板，并对实现与规约漂移问题迈出第一步。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Self-improving data synthesis enables scalable adaptation of embedding models
papers.abstract_en: AI agents require specialised retrieval across domains and tasks, but adapting embedding models is constrained by costly manual training-data design. Here we introduce SYNTRA, a self-improving agentic framework that turns a few retrieval examples into reusable synthesis instructions. Given an unlabelled corpus and a few relevant query-document pairs, SYNTRA infers implicit information needs and relevance criteria, then uses feedback on trial outputs to refine instructions for query generation and relevance assessment. Experiments across 24 datasets spanning 15 domains demonstrate that the same synthesis workflow produces effective training data, benefiting even strong embedding models with and without existing labelled training sets. Self-improvement strengthens this supervision on all six evaluated tasks, yielding better retrieval than human calibration on four. The training value persists at larger scales: on MS MARCO, retrieval gains continue across a 32-fold range of synthetic training-data sizes. SYNTRA thus enables scalable embedding-model adaptation with minimal human intervention.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 6 figures; supplementary information included (27 pages). Code: https://github.com/zucanlv/SYNTRA . Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ZucanLyu/SYNTRA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SYNTRA 把少量检索示例转成可复用的合成数据指令，用试输出反馈迭代改进查询生成与相关性判断，从而自动生成嵌入模型训练数据。在 24 个数据集、15 个领域上，自改进监督在全部六个评测任务上提升检索效果，其中四个任务超过人工校准；MS MARCO 上合成数据规模扩大 32 倍范围内增益持续。
Motivation: AI agent 需要跨领域跨任务的专用检索，但适配嵌入模型受制于昂贵的人工训练数据设计。
Method: SYNTRA 是自改进 agentic 框架：给定无标注语料与少量 query-document 对，先推断隐含信息需求与相关性准则，再依据试输出反馈迭代改进查询生成和相关性评估的合成指令，产出训练数据用于微调嵌入模型。
Result: 在 24 个数据集、15 个领域上验证，同一合成流程对已有或没有标注训练集的强嵌入模型均有效；自改进在全部六个评测任务上增强监督，其中四个任务的检索效果超过人工校准；MS MARCO 上合成训练数据规模在 32 倍范围内检索增益持续。
Conclusion: 少量检索示例加反馈驱动的指令自改进，足以在极少人工干预下规模化适配嵌入模型，且训练价值在更大数据规模下不消失。

papers.title: EV-JEPA: Elastic V-JEPA for Any Device and Cross-Device Inference
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models like V-JEPA are increasingly deployed across a heterogeneous edge-cloud continuum spanning smart glasses, phones, robots, and servers. Yet, they are typically trained as rigid, fixed-capacity networks bound to one device, supporting neither reconfigurable compute budgets nor collaborative execution. Existing approaches address only one axis at a time: slimmable and NAS-based methods provide width elasticity but assume single-device inference, whereas split-computing methods enable cross-device collaboration only for fixed partitions and static capacities. We introduce Elastic V-JEPA (EV-JEPA), a single model trained once and deployable everywhere along the continuum. Its width is reconfigurable, and it is natively partitionable across heterogeneous devices. At its core is Transition-Aware Triplet Training (T3). At each step we pick a narrow and a wide width, and train three paths: each width alone, plus a hybrid path that runs the early layers narrow and the rest wide. The hybrid switch point is where one device hands off to another, so the same weights learn both single-device and cross-device execution. Across various benchmarks, EV-JEPA falls within 1 accuracy point of independently trained baselines while improving over previous elastic training approaches by up to 11 accuracy points. Narrow-to-wide cross-device hybrid execution recovers to within 1.1 points of the highest-capacity standalone model and supports many-to-one, any-to-any, and variable-split configurations. Finally, we show that the elastic principle extends beyond the backbone to an elastic token compression mechanism that exposes controllable trade-offs among on-device computation, latency, and accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EV-JEPA 把 V-JEPA 基础模型训练成宽度可重构、且能原生跨设备切分的单一模型，核心是 Transition-Aware Triplet Training (T3)：每步采样窄/宽两个宽度，同时训练纯窄、纯宽和前窄后宽的混合路径，混合切换点即设备交接点。在多项 benchmark 上与独立训练基线差距在 1 个 accuracy point 以内，比既有弹性训练方法最高提升 11 个 accuracy points；窄到宽跨设备混合执行与最高容量独立模型差距在 1.1 points 以内。
Motivation: V-JEPA 类基础模型被部署到智能眼镜、手机、机器人、服务器构成的异构 edge-cloud continuum，但模型通常按固定容量绑定单一设备，既不能调整算力预算也不能跨设备协作；现有 slimmable/NAS 方法只做宽度弹性且假设单机推理，split computing 只支持固定划分与静态容量。
Method: 提出 Elastic V-JEPA (EV-JEPA)，一次训练即可沿 continuum 部署：宽度可重构且可原生跨异构设备切分。核心为 T3，每步选一个窄宽度和一个宽宽度，训练三条路径——各自单独执行，以及前段窄、后段宽的混合路径，混合切换点对应设备交接，使同一份权重同时学会单机与跨设备执行；另将弹性原理扩展到 backbone 之外的 elastic token compression 机制。
Result: 在多项 benchmark 上，EV-JEPA 与独立训练基线的差距在 1 个 accuracy point 以内，相比此前弹性训练方法最高提升 11 个 accuracy points；窄到宽跨设备混合执行恢复到与最高容量独立模型差距 1.1 points 以内，并支持 many-to-one、any-to-any 与 variable-split 配置；elastic token compression 提供端侧计算、延迟与精度之间的可控权衡。
Conclusion: 宽度弹性与跨设备切分可以在同一份权重里同时学到，无需为每个设备或每种划分单独训练；该弹性原则还可从 backbone 延伸到 token 压缩，统一暴露算力、延迟与精度的权衡。

summary_sections.motivation: V-JEPA 类基础模型被部署到智能眼镜、手机、机器人、服务器构成的异构 edge-cloud continuum，但模型通常按固定容量绑定单一设备，既不能调整算力预算也不能跨设备协作；现有 slimmable/NAS 方法只做宽度弹性且假设单机推理，split computing 只支持固定划分与静态容量。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Elastic V-JEPA (EV-JEPA)，一次训练即可沿 continuum 部署：宽度可重构且可原生跨异构设备切分。核心为 T3，每步选一个窄宽度和一个宽宽度，训练三条路径——各自单独执行，以及前段窄、后段宽的混合路径，混合切换点对应设备交接，使同一份权重同时学会单机与跨设备执行；另将弹性原理扩展到 backbone 之外的 elastic token compression 机制。
summary_sections.result: 在多项 benchmark 上，EV-JEPA 与独立训练基线的差距在 1 个 accuracy point 以内，相比此前弹性训练方法最高提升 11 个 accuracy points；窄到宽跨设备混合执行恢复到与最高容量独立模型差距 1.1 points 以内，并支持 many-to-one、any-to-any 与 variable-split 配置；elastic token compression 提供端侧计算、延迟与精度之间的可控权衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 宽度弹性与跨设备切分可以在同一份权重里同时学到，无需为每个设备或每种划分单独训练；该弹性原则还可从 backbone 延伸到 token 压缩，统一暴露算力、延迟与精度的权衡。

papers.title: InstantFusion: A Shared Latent Interface for Heterogeneous Image Generators
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion/flow models have emerged as the de facto paradigms for image generation, giving rise to a diverse family of modern generators with increasingly heterogeneous architectures and representations. Despite their remarkable generation capabilities, the cross-model alignment of latent representations and the consistency of their underlying denoising dynamics remain underexplored. In this work, we uncover an intriguing cross-model compatibility: independently trained generators exhibit similar latent spatial organization, while directly handing off intermediate states between unaligned models can still preserve coarse visual content. Motivated by these observations, we propose InstantFusion, a lightweight shared latent interface that connects the denoising trajectories of heterogeneous image generators. Specifically, to enable flexible cross-model state translation, model-specific Latent AutoEncoders (LAEs) are introduced to project intermediate states from different generators into a shared latent space and decode them into the latent space of a target generator. This shared space is constrained by two complementary objectives: aligning intermediate states derived from the same image at matched noise levels and synchronizing their corresponding local denoising velocities. Once trained, InstantFusion allows denoising to seamlessly transition across frozen generators without requiring a dedicated mapping for every model pair. The versatility of InstantFusion is demonstrated across acceleration, multi-preference composition, cross-architecture on-policy distillation, and cross-model composition, achieving competitive performance across these diverse settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InstantFusion 用一组模型专属的 Latent AutoEncoders (LAEs) 把异构扩散/流模型的中间状态投到共享潜空间，再解码回目标生成器的潜空间，使去噪轨迹可在冻结的生成器之间直接切换，无需为每对模型单独训练映射。共享空间由两个目标约束：对齐同一图像在相同噪声水平下的中间状态，并同步其局部去噪速度。
Motivation: 现代图像生成器架构与表示日益异构，但跨模型的潜表示对齐和去噪动力学一致性研究不足，模型间状态交接缺少通用接口。
Method: 为每个生成器训练专属 LAE，将中间状态投影到共享潜空间并解码到目标生成器潜空间；共享空间以两个互补目标训练：对齐同图同噪声水平的中间状态、同步对应局部去噪速度；训练后所有生成器保持冻结。
Result: 在加速、多偏好组合 (multi-preference composition)、跨架构 on-policy 蒸馏与跨模型组合四类设置上展示了方法的通用性，摘要称取得有竞争力的表现，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 独立训练的生成器存在跨模型兼容性——潜空间组织相似、直接交接中间状态可保留粗略视觉内容——因此一个轻量共享潜接口即可支撑异构生成器间的无缝去噪切换。

papers.title: AdaptLSTM: Efficient Adaptive Online Learning for Cloud Workload Forecasting under Distribution Drift
papers.abstract_en: Accurate workload forecasting is critical for elastic resource provisioning in web-scale cloud services, where distribution shifts driven by viral content, product launches, and user behavior degrade offline-trained models rapidly. Naive online learning recovers accuracy but incurs prohibitive per-step compute cost. We propose AdaptLSTM, an adaptive online framework that detects drift via validation-calibrated thresholds and applies selective, targeted updates. On the Alibaba Machine Trace, AdaptLSTM recovers 54\% of Naive Online's improvement at 20\% cost ($2.7\times$ efficiency, $p=0.002$ over 10 seeds). On the more volatile Container Trace, it achieves 96\% at 20\% cost ($4.8\times$ efficiency, $+75\%$ MAE reduction over Static). Unlike classical drift detectors (ADWIN, DDM, Page-Hinkley) which fail to trigger on regression-scale error streams, AdaptLSTM fires 42 times over 301 steps and outperforms matched-budget baselines. Wall-clock profiling shows $1.33\times$ throughput gain and 45\% update-time reduction. The framework is model-agnostic: identical Pareto patterns hold for LSTM, GRU, and Transformer backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaptLSTM 用验证集校准的阈值检测分布漂移并只做选择性更新，把在线学习的每步开销压到 20% 预算。在 Alibaba Machine Trace 上以 20% 成本回收 Naive Online 54% 的精度提升（2.7 倍效率，p=0.002，10 seeds），在 Container Trace 上回收 96%（4.8 倍效率，MAE 较 Static 降低 75%），且对 LSTM、GRU、Transformer 主干给出相同 Pareto 形态。
Motivation: 云工作负载受爆款内容、产品发布与用户行为驱动发生分布漂移，离线训练模型迅速退化；朴素在线学习能恢复精度但每步计算成本过高，而 ADWIN、DDM、Page-Hinkley 等经典漂移检测器在回归量级的误差流上不触发。
Method: AdaptLSTM 是自适应在线学习框架：用验证集校准的阈值检测漂移，触发后只做选择性、定向的模型更新；框架与模型无关，可套在 LSTM、GRU、Transformer 主干上，并与匹配预算的基线及经典漂移检测器对比。
Result: Alibaba Machine Trace：以 20% 成本回收 Naive Online 54% 的改进，2.7 倍效率，p=0.002（10 seeds）。Container Trace：20% 成本下达到 96%，4.8 倍效率，MAE 较 Static 降低 75%。漂移检测在 301 步中触发 42 次并优于匹配预算基线；wall-clock 分析给出 1.33 倍吞吐提升与 45% 更新时间下降；Pareto 形态在 LSTM、GRU、Transformer 上一致。
Conclusion: 在分布漂移下，用校准阈值做选择性在线更新可以用约 20% 的更新成本换回大部分在线学习收益，且该收益与具体序列模型无关。

papers.title: Identifiability of a dissipative knowledge-dynamics model: exact recovery under designed excitation, degeneration on observational data
papers.abstract_en: Human learning is a dissipative dynamical process: mastery accumulates through practice, decays through forgetting, and propagates across interdependent concepts. We model it as a nonlinear dissipative system of ordinary differential equations whose parameters are mechanistically meaningful (a transfer-of-practice matrix, per-concept forgetting rates, and a saturating practice-response gain), and we study when those parameters can actually be recovered from data. For two concepts, we prove a constructive structural identifiability theorem for the associated inverse problem under explicit excitation conditions, together with monotonicity, robustness and L-stability results. We derive an implicit L-stable scheme and a batched solver numerically equivalent to the per-trajectory formulation yet two orders of magnitude faster. The empirical study is two-sided. Under the theorem's excitation conditions, synthetic recovery is exact. On large observational benchmarks it is not. An apparently strong recovery, with forgetting rates correlating with topic error rates at Spearman $ρ= 0.83$, is refuted by four controls: it survives destroying the temporal order of the data, is matched by a classical Bayesian baseline, and is unaffected by removing real timestamps. A single shared forgetting rate attains the same accuracy, and replaying the real schedule with identical true rates reproduces most of the correlation. A positive control shows that the controls detect forgetting where it is observable. We trace the effect to the stationary structure of the model and show that it is consistent with the degeneration anticipated by the theory in the absence of designed excitation.
papers.comment: Corrected the implicit integration scheme and Proposition 4; revised Lemma 1; specified the practice input, difficulty reference, rank and training split; added an ablation, a replay of the real schedule with known rates, and a positive control of the validation protocol (Section 7.6); moderated claims; added relation to companion work and an AI-use declaration
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把人类学习建成含迁移矩阵、逐概念遗忘率与饱和练习增益的非线性耗散 ODE，证明两概念下逆问题在显式激励条件下的构造性结构可辨识性，并给出隐式 L-stable 求解器（比逐轨迹快两个数量级）。定理激励下合成数据可精确恢复参数；但在大型观测基准上恢复退化：遗忘率与题目错误率的 Spearman ρ=0.83 会被打乱时间顺序、经典贝叶斯基线、去掉真实时间戳、以及单一共享遗忘率四项对照全部消解。
Motivation: 耗散学习模型的参数在机制上有意义，但何时能从数据真正辨识、何时只是拟合出的假象，缺少可判定的条件与可执行的对照流程。
Method: 构建非线性耗散 ODE 系统，参数为 transfer-of-practice 矩阵、逐概念遗忘率与饱和练习响应增益；对两概念在显式激励条件下证明构造性结构可辨识性定理，并给出单调性、鲁棒性与 L-stability 结果；数值上推导隐式 L-stable 格式与批量求解器，经验部分用四项对照检验观测数据上的恢复。
Result: 定理激励条件下合成恢复是精确的；观测基准上遗忘率与题目错误率相关 Spearman ρ=0.83，但该相关在打乱时间顺序后仍存在、与经典贝叶斯基线持平、去掉真实时间戳不受影响，单一共享遗忘率达到相同精度，用相同真实速率回放真实课表可复现该相关的大部分；正对照表明对照流程能检出可观测的遗忘。隐式 L-stable 批量求解器与逐轨迹数值等价且快两个数量级。
Conclusion: 观测数据上的表观恢复是模型平稳结构导致的退化，与理论在缺乏设计激励时的预期一致：参数可辨识必须靠设计激励，而非更大的观测基准。

papers.title: ParanoiaEval: Benchmarking Unnecessary Defensive Work in Agentic Coding
papers.abstract_en: As coding agents increasingly undertake real-world work autonomously, judging whether their risk treatments are warranted has become important. Existing work evaluates related agent behaviors from separate perspectives, but lacks a systematic framework for unifying these behaviors. To bridge this gap, we introduce ParanoiaEval, the first benchmark for unified evaluation of risk-treatment capabilities in coding agents. Grounded in the well-established Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance framework in software engineering risk management, ParanoiaEval operationalizes its 4 fundamental treatments for coding-agent settings and contains 200 evidence-controlled repository-level task pairs, each differing only in treatment-defining evidence. We further introduce dedicated metrics for risk-treatment violations and evidence responsiveness, using a human-calibrated agentic judge for reliable evaluation. Large-scale experiments on 8 representative models and a post-hoc human study reveal that (I) unnecessary risk treatment occurs in 11.2%-58.7% of runs despite explicit evidence, with substantial variation across agent configurations; (II) stronger task capability does not ensure more appropriate risk treatment, while treatment violations substantially harm developers' experience, establishing risk treatment as an independent capability dimension; and (III) agents exhibit systematic patterns consistent with established risk-management findings, suggesting that knowledge from human practice can guide the diagnosis and improvement of this capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ParanoiaEval 是首个统一评测编码智能体风险处置能力的基准，把软件工程风险管理的 Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance 四类处置落到 200 组仅在处置证据上不同的仓库级任务对。在 8 个代表性模型的大规模实验中，即使证据明确，11.2%–58.7% 的运行仍做出不必要的风险处置，且任务能力强不等于处置恰当。
Motivation: 编码智能体自主承担真实工作时，其风险应对是否必要缺乏统一评测框架，已有工作只从分散视角评估相关行为，无法把过度防御作为独立能力维度来诊断。
Method: 以软件工程风险管理的 Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance 框架为基准，构造 200 组证据受控的仓库级任务对（每对仅在定义处置的证据上不同）；提出风险处置违规与证据响应性两类专用指标，用人工校准的 agentic judge 打分，并对 8 个代表性模型做大规模实验与事后人工研究。
Result: 在证据明确的情况下，不必要的风险处置出现在 11.2%–58.7% 的运行中，且随智能体配置差异显著；任务能力更强并不保证处置更恰当，处置违规显著损害开发者体验；智能体表现出与既有风险管理研究一致的系统性模式。
Conclusion: 风险处置是独立于任务能力的能力维度，人类风险管理实践中的知识可用来诊断并改进编码智能体的这一能力。

papers.title: CNet: A Complex-Valued Deep Learning Framework with Wirtinger Autodifferentiation and FFT--Hadamard Convolution
papers.abstract_en: CNet is a C++/CUDA framework for deep complex-valued neural networks (CVNNs), trained by gradient descent with explicit Wirtinger (CR-calculus) derivatives. Complex models are underexplored yet natural where data is intrinsically complex -- RF/IQ, MRI k-space, radar/SAR, audio spectra -- and phase carries information real networks discard. CNet is physics-native: a network is a cascade of complex (often unitary) operations on an amplitude vector, and classification is a Born-rule measurement p_k = |z_k|^2 / ||z||^2 rather than a softmax over real logits. Every layer ships a CPU reference and a finite-difference-verified CUDA kernel; the static, batch-cloned computation graph captures cleanly into CUDA Graphs, outperforming eager and compiled torch.complex64 on an H100. We present three studies. (1) A fully complex causal language model, built on a new causal (triangular-masked) Fourier mixer with an O(N log N) Bluestein evaluation of the forward pass and its Wirtinger adjoint, matches a parameter-matched real causal FNet on character-level tiny-shakespeare in under half the steps. We introduce Born-rule attention, a content-based causal mixer whose weights are the quantum-measurement probabilities |<Q_k, K_j>|^2 -- to our knowledge the first classical, complex-valued attention to replace softmax with the squared-magnitude Born score; with rotary embeddings and per-token complex normalization it reaches 1.52 nats/char, matching softmax self-attention, and transfers unchanged to byte-level (1.31 nats/char) and sub-word WikiText-103. (2) On radio-modulation classification (RML2016.10a/RML22) we trace the pooled-power accuracy ceiling to discarded temporal structure and recover it with a learnable cyclostationary conjugate-lag operator. (3) A bottleneck analysis of the Fourier phase problem in coherent-diffraction imaging isolates where complex-valued networks still need new operators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CNet 是一个 C++/CUDA 复值神经网络 (CVNN) 框架，用显式 Wirtinger (CR-calculus) 导数训练，网络被写成对幅度向量的幺正复运算级联，分类用 Born 规则测量 p_k=|z_k|^2/‖z‖^2 取代 softmax。三个研究中，Born-rule attention 在字符级 tiny-shakespeare 上达到 1.52 nats/char，与 softmax 自注意力持平，并可原样迁移到 byte 级 (1.31 nats/char) 与 WikiText-103 子词任务。
Motivation: 复值网络在数据本身为复数的场景（RF/IQ、MRI k-space、雷达/SAR、音频谱）中相位信息被实值网络丢弃，但缺少工程化训练框架；同时 softmax 注意力与实值 logits 并非复值量子式前向的自然形式。
Method: CNet 用 Wirtinger 导数做梯度下降，每层提供 CPU 参考实现与经有限差分校验的 CUDA kernel，静态可批量克隆的计算图捕获为 CUDA Graphs。语言模型部分提出因果 (triangular-masked) Fourier mixer，前向与其 Wirtinger 伴随用 O(N log N) 的 Bluestein 算法求值；Born-rule attention 以 |⟨Q_k,K_j⟩|^2 作为因果混合权重，配合 rotary embeddings 与逐 token 复归一化。调制分类部分在 RML2016.10a/RML22 上引入可学习的循环平稳共轭滞后 (cyclostationary conjugate-lag) 算子。
Result: 在 H100 上 CNet 的执行速度超过 eager 与编译版 torch.complex64。全复因果语言模型在字符级 tiny-shakespeare 上以不到一半步数追平参数量匹配的实值因果 FNet；Born-rule attention 达到 1.52 nats/char，与 softmax 自注意力持平，byte 级为 1.31 nats/char，并可原样迁移到 WikiText-103 子词。调制分类中把池化功率精度上限归因于被丢弃的时间结构，并用可学习循环平稳共轭滞后算子将其恢复。
Conclusion: 复值网络配上 Wirtinger 自动微分与 Born 规则式读出可以在语言建模上追平 softmax 自注意力，同时在硬件执行上更快；相干衍射成像的傅里叶相位瓶颈分析指出 CVNN 仍需新算子的环节。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: SCOPE: Certified Theorem Proving with a Language Model as the Policy Planner
papers.abstract_en: In proof assistants such as Lean, a generated proof must pass machine compilation checks, so evaluation needs no human scoring. Direct generation fails on multi-step numeric propositions: a proof is valid only if every content integer is correct, so the pass rate is bounded by the k-th power of the per-integer accuracy. Controlled corruption across 2,617 reference proofs confirms this power law. SCOPE (State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution) enforces the natural division of labor: the model plans over an operator vocabulary, a symbolic engine executes the numerics, and a compiler renders the proof. On a 218-problem suite it certifies 191/218 (87.6%) with a 135M backbone; the 7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL certifies 18/218 at 27.5 times the tokens and 37.5 times the wall-clock, and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B certifies zero on a bidirectional dual suite. Multi-step thinking costs 6.12 discrete decision actions per problem and produces no natural-language thinking text. Replacing the lagged engine state in the decision frame with the current one lifts the pass rate from 117/218 to 191/218, while up-weighting the chain-end loss hurts. On the public Lean-Workbook library, 2,132 of 3,536 gradeable admissible problems certify (60.29%) with zero regression on the main suite. All readings come from a version-frozen review with independent rechecks and reverse verification. Restricting free generation and keeping decision-time information visible is a more direct route than enlarging the model.
papers.comment: Added code and data availability link in the Introduction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCOPE（State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution）把 Lean 证明拆成模型规划算子序列、符号引擎执行数值、编译器渲染证明三段，从而绕开多步数值命题中通过率被每位整数准确率的 k 次方封顶的瓶颈。135M 骨干在 218 题套件上认证 191/218（87.6%），而 7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL 只认证 18/218 且耗 27.5 倍 token、37.5 倍墙钟时间。
Motivation: 直接生成在多步数值命题上失败：证明要求每个内容整数都正确，通过率被每位整数准确率的 k 次方封顶，2,617 条参考证明的受控腐蚀实验确认了该幂律。
Method: SCOPE 让模型在算子词表 (operator vocabulary) 上做状态条件化规划，符号引擎执行数值计算，编译器渲染最终证明；决策帧用当前引擎状态而非滞后状态，训练时不加权 chain-end loss，且不生成自然语言思考文本。
Result: 218 题套件上 135M 骨干认证 191/218（87.6%）；7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL 认证 18/218，token 用量为 27.5 倍、墙钟时间 37.5 倍；DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 在双向双套件上认证 0；每题平均 6.12 个离散决策动作；决策帧改用当前引擎状态使通过率从 117/218 升到 191/218，加权 chain-end loss 反而变差；Lean-Workbook 上 3,536 道可评分可容许问题中 2,132 道认证（60.29%），主套件零回归。
Conclusion: 限制自由生成、让决策时信息可见，比把模型做大更直接地提升认证通过率；数值执行应交给符号引擎而非语言模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Minimal Witness Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: ``What are the irreducible conditions that are sufficient to produce an outcome?'' is one of the most common questions that recur across computation and science. Its answers, the minimal sufficient witnesses, are what we mean by explanations, mechanisms and reasons. These problems usually ask for multiple minimal witnesses, yet standard RL methods may reveal only one solution or redundant ones. We formalize this problem as minimal-witness identification and introduce Minimal-Witness Reinforcement Learning (MWRL). MWRL takes the union of the sets certified by successful proposals sampled from the policy and credits each proposal for the coverage the group union would lose without that proposal. This credit assignment, derived directly from the problem definition, unifies the demands for minimality and recovery of alternatives from a single black-box verifier bit. Under this principle, we derive a value iteration planner that recovers the entire family of witnesses and a policy gradient method that can scale to large language models. Across different experimental settings, MWRL recovers most minimal witnesses, while other methods return redundant supersets or a single witness. By making witness families learnable from verifier feedback, MWRL expands the scope of reinforcement learning beyond single-solution optimization. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/MWRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MWRL 把「找一个解」改写为「恢复全部最小充分见证 (minimal sufficient witnesses)」：对成功 proposal 的集合取并集，并按每个 proposal 对并集覆盖的边际贡献分配信用，从而仅凭单个黑盒 verifier bit 同时驱动最小性与备选解恢复。实验中 MWRL 恢复了大部分最小见证，而对照方法只返回冗余超集或单个见证。
Motivation: 标准 RL 面对需要多个最小见证的解释/机制类问题时，往往只收敛到一个解或彼此冗余的解，无法覆盖解族。
Method: MWRL 以成功 proposal 的集合并集为对象，按「去掉该 proposal 后并集损失的覆盖」做信用分配；由此导出一个能恢复整个见证族的 value iteration planner，以及一个可扩展到大语言模型的 policy gradient 方法，监督信号仅为黑盒 verifier 的单个 bit。
Result: 在不同实验设置下，MWRL 恢复了大部分最小见证，而其他方法返回冗余超集或单个见证；代码发布于 github.com/TSUITUENYUE/MWRL。
Conclusion: 只要能从 verifier 反馈中学习见证族，RL 就可从单解优化扩展到覆盖整个解族的搜索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Every View Counts: View-Consistent Panoptic Quality for Multi-view Panoptic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view panoptic segmentation assigns a semantic class and a scene-level instance ID to every pixel of an unordered set of images, and recent feed-forward 3D models predict these labels for the input views in a single forward pass. Their predictions, however, have been evaluated with the scene-level PQ (PQ^scene) borrowed from per-scene optimization methods, typically on rendered held-out views. PQ^scene tiles all views of a scene into a single image, so that a missed appearance or a change of ID lowers the score of the matched pair only in proportion to its area. We propose View-Consistent Panoptic Quality (VC-PQ), which extends PQ from a single image to a set of input views, counts equally every view in which an instance is visible, and penalizes a prediction that is not visible in the same views as its ground truth. A decomposition of VC-PQ attributes the score a method loses to mask accuracy, view consistency, and the matching threshold. A single additional parameter recovers the area weighting of tiling for comparison. Under a fixed evaluation protocol on ScanNet++ and ScanNetv2, recent feed-forward methods are evaluated with VC-PQ and PQ^scene, and the decomposition shows where each of them loses its score. Controlled perturbations of the ground truth show that VC-PQ responds to the number of views in which an instance is missed or changes ID, whereas PQ^scene responds to their area. The aim of this work is to make view consistency part of the evaluation of multi-view panoptic segmentation, with VC-PQ reported alongside PQ^scene. The evaluation code and the input sets of the protocol are available at https://github.com/Renem24/vcpq.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 8 figures. Under review. Youngmin Lee and Byungha Ko contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 View-Consistent Panoptic Quality (VC-PQ)，把单图 PQ 扩展到一组输入视图：实例在每个可见视图中等权计分，预测可见性与真值视图集合不一致即受罚。VC-PQ 可分解为 mask accuracy、view consistency 与 matching threshold 三部分，另加一个参数即可还原平铺式 PQ^scene 的面积加权；在 ScanNet++ 与 ScanNetv2 固定协议下，受控扰动显示 VC-PQ 随实例被漏检或换 ID 的视图数变化，而 PQ^scene 只随面积变化。
Motivation: 前馈式多视图全景分割用逐场景优化方法沿用的 PQ^scene 评测：它把整个场景所有视图平铺成一张图，漏掉一次出现或 ID 变更只按面积比例扣分，视图级不一致被掩盖。
Method: VC-PQ 将 PQ 从单图扩展到输入视图集合，对实例可见的每个视图等权计分，并惩罚预测与真值可见视图集合不一致的预测；给出把失分归因到 mask accuracy、view consistency、matching threshold 的分解，并用一个附加参数恢复平铺的面积加权以便与 PQ^scene 对比。
Result: 在 ScanNet++ 与 ScanNetv2 的固定评测协议下，用 VC-PQ 与 PQ^scene 同时评测近期前馈方法，分解显示各自失分来源；对真值的受控扰动表明 VC-PQ 响应实例被漏检或 ID 变更的视图数，PQ^scene 响应其面积。评测代码与协议输入集发布于 github.com/Renem24/vcpq。
Conclusion: 视图一致性应成为多视图全景分割评测的一部分，实践中 VC-PQ 与 PQ^scene 并列报告，而不是用平铺面积加权的单一分数替代。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Calibrated Evidence Inference With a Small, Permissively Licensed Open Model
papers.abstract_en: Systematic reviewers who use a model to read randomized trials need each answer and a measure of how far to trust it. If the model is calibrated, so that its stated probabilities match how often it is right, a reviewer can accept its confident answers and check the rest by hand. This paper fine-tunes Qwen3-4B-Base with low-rank adapters and a classification head for evidence inference (Lehman et al., 2019; DeYoung et al., 2020): given a trial's article and a prompt that names an intervention, a comparator and an outcome, classify the result as a significant increase, a significant decrease or no significant difference. The articles of Evidence Inference 2.0 come from the open-access subset of PubMed Central, which includes articles under non-commercial and no-derivatives licenses, so the released model was fine-tuned only on the 1,431 of 2,657 training articles under CC BY, CC0 or the public domain; it is released under the Apache License 2.0 and runs on a laptop. On the test split, its expected calibration error is 0.017 and its log loss is lower than that of Gemma 4 31B-it given the same input zero-shot, meeting criteria registered on the Open Science Framework before testing. Its macro-F1, 0.925, is above every published result on that split that I found, though those systems used other inputs, scoring rules and prompt filters, and the test labels are public. Accepting its 80 percent most confident answers leaves an error rate of 2.6 percent among them. Context ablations show that the answers depend on the article, but the title alone carries some signal, which an informative title or recall of the trial could explain.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 2 figures, 15 tables. Code, results files and the paper's sources: https://github.com/johann-e-li/fiorillo. Model: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10722. Registration: https://osf.io/kaxmn/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LoRA 与分类头微调 Qwen3-4B-Base 做证据推断 (evidence inference)，只在 Evidence Inference 2.0 中 2,657 篇训练文章里 1,431 篇 CC BY/CC0/公有领域文章上训练，模型以 Apache 2.0 发布且可在笔记本运行。测试集上 ECE 为 0.017、macro-F1 为 0.925，接受其最自信的 80% 答案时其中错误率为 2.6%。
Motivation: 系统综述者用模型读随机对照试验时，需要每个答案附带可信度；若模型校准良好，综述者可直接采信其自信答案，只手工核查其余部分。

papers.title: Order Matters: Competition-Guided Query Ordering for RNN-Based Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: DETR-style detectors use one-to-one bipartite matching during training to assign object queries to ground-truth objects, enabling end-to-end set prediction without non-maximum suppression (NMS). However, without an explicit de-duplication procedure, multiple queries can still produce highly similar hypotheses for the same object, making training unstable and predictions less decisive. Inspired by the sequential ordering of NMS, we propose DETRNN, a plug-and-play module that turns unordered object queries into a competition-aware sequence for recurrent refinement. DETRNN builds an explicit confidence-and-similarity based order from prior predictions, then refines queries with an RNN along this order to model competition inside the decoder. This ordered recurrent refinement reduces redundant predictions, stabilizes optimization, and improves final detection accuracy. Experiments on multiple DETR-style detectors show consistent gains with comparable efficiency. Code repository: https://github.com/nigelwoo2008-coder/DETRNN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DETRNN 把无序 object query 按置信度与相似度排成竞争感知序列，再用 RNN 沿该顺序循环精化，抑制同一目标的重复假设。在多个 DETR-style 检测器上带来一致精度提升且效率相当。
Motivation: DETR 用一对二分匹配实现无 NMS 的端到端集合预测，但缺少显式去重，多个 query 仍会对同一目标给出高度相似的假设，导致训练不稳、预测不果断。
Method: 受 NMS 顺序化流程启发，先基于先前预测构建显式的置信度-相似度排序，把无序 query 转为竞争感知序列，再用 RNN 沿该顺序循环精化 query，在 decoder 内建模 query 间竞争；作为即插即用模块接入现有 DETR-style 检测器。
Result: 在多个 DETR-style 检测器上取得一致的检测精度提升，且推理效率相当；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把 NMS 式的顺序竞争机制引入 query 精化，可减少冗余预测、稳定优化并提升最终检测精度，且开销可控。

papers.title: E$^2$-OPSD: Taming Entropy Overshoot in On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides dense token-level supervision without a second model: one network acts as teacher with the reference solution and as student with only the problem. We identify a specific failure mode of this recipe. During training, student token entropy rises past the teacher's and remains elevated, a pattern we call entropy overshoot. We trace it to both sides of distillation. The reference-conditioned teacher is confident along its answer-directed reasoning path, but this confidence transfers poorly to student-generated prefixes, making its supervision overly tied to answer-specific cues rather than reusable reasoning patterns; meanwhile, the forward KL used by OPSD continually diffuses the student's predictive distribution without pulling it back. We introduce E$^2$-OPSD to address both causes. Exemplar-guided teaching replaces the current answer with a retrieved solved neighboring problem, providing transferable reasoning guidance without revealing the destination and better matching student-reachable states. Entropy-aware distillation uses the student-teacher entropy gap to determine the direction and strength of each token's correction. E$^2$-OPSD improves math reasoning by up to 4.3 points in mean@16 over OPSD, while out-of-domain evaluations show gains over the corresponding base models of up to 4.9 points in mean@16 and 5.5 points in pass@8. Despite these gains, E$^2$-OPSD remains simple, requiring no additional forward passes or networks. Code repo: https://github.com/orionfei/E2-OPSD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: E²-OPSD 诊断出 on-policy 自蒸馏 (OPSD) 的熵超调 (entropy overshoot) 失效模式：学生 token 熵升到超过教师并持续偏高，因为参考条件化的教师置信度难以迁移到学生自生成前缀，而 forward KL 只会不断扩散学生分布。改用检索到的已解邻近题做 exemplar-guided teaching，并用师生熵差决定每个 token 修正的方向与强度，数学推理 mean@16 最多比 OPSD 高 4.3 分。
Motivation: OPSD 让同一网络以参考解为教师、以仅有题目为学生做稠密 token 级监督，但训练中学生 token 熵会超过教师并保持高位，监督过度绑定答案特异线索且 forward KL 只扩散不回收。
Method: 两处改动：exemplar-guided teaching 用检索到的已解邻近题替代当前答案作为教师条件，给出不泄露目标、且更贴近学生可达状态的可迁移推理引导；entropy-aware distillation 用师生熵差决定每个 token 修正的方向与强度。不引入额外前向传播或网络。
Result: 数学推理 mean@16 相对 OPSD 最多提升 4.3 分；域外评测相对对应 base model 最多提升 4.9 分（mean@16）与 5.5 分（pass@8）。
Conclusion: 熵超调的两个来源——教师置信度不可迁移与 forward KL 单向扩散——可以分别用检索式示例教学和熵感知蒸馏解决，且无需额外模型开销。

papers.title: D-DOIT: Training-free Adaptation of Discrete Diffusion via Doob's h-Transform
papers.abstract_en: We propose D-DOIT (Discrete Doob-Oriented Inference-time Transformation), a training-free and efficient adaptation method for discrete diffusion models with generic rewards. D-DOIT formulates adaptation as sampling from a reward-tilted target distribution and realizes this transport through Doob's h-transform of the discrete diffusion reverse kernel, using only reward values rather than reward gradients. Unlike continuous diffusion, masked discrete diffusion samples categorical token-reveal transitions rather than continuous state updates. D-DOIT derives the corresponding discrete Doob's h-transform, which guides sampling by reweighting reverse transition probabilities instead of adding a drift correction. To make this transformation practical, D-DOIT avoids expensive future rollouts. At each guided step, D-DOIT samples candidate next states, uses the model prediction head to complete each candidate into a clean sequence, evaluates each completion with the reward oracle, and resamples the next state with probabilities proportional to the rewards. An optional late-stage best-of-K refinement further improves sample quality by branching trajectories only near the end of denoising, avoiding the $K$-fold cost over the full trajectory. Empirically, across regulatory DNA design and protein inverse folding benchmarks, D-DOIT outperforms training-free guidance baselines. It improves enhancer activity and cell-type specificity while preserving sequence naturalness, and achieves the highest success rate in protein inverse folding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: D-DOIT 把离散扩散的奖励适配写成从奖励倾斜分布采样，用离散版 Doob's h-transform 直接重加权反向转移概率，只用奖励值不用梯度。每步采样候选下一状态、用模型预测头补全为干净序列、按奖励重采样，避免昂贵的未来 rollout；在调控 DNA 设计与蛋白质逆折叠基准上胜过 training-free guidance 基线。
Motivation: 离散扩散用类别 token-reveal 转移而非连续状态更新，连续扩散的漂移修正式引导无法直接套用；现有 training-free 引导又依赖奖励梯度或昂贵 rollout。
Method: 推导离散 Doob's h-transform，对反向核的转移概率按奖励重加权而非加漂移项；每步采样候选下一状态，用模型预测头补全成完整序列，交奖励 oracle 打分后按奖励比例重采样；可选的 late-stage best-of-K refinement 只在去噪末端分支轨迹。
Result: 在调控 DNA 设计与蛋白质逆折叠基准上优于 training-free guidance 基线：提升 enhancer 活性与细胞类型特异性，同时保持序列自然度 (sequence naturalness)，并在蛋白质逆折叠上取得最高成功率。
Conclusion: 只用奖励值、不需梯度与全程 rollout 的 Doob's h-transform 重加权，足以让离散扩散按通用奖励做推理时适配。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Entropy: Self-Diagnostic Multi-Role Token Optimization for Video Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has substantially advanced multimodal reasoning, yet it remains fundamentally limited by ambiguous token-level credit assignment. While high-entropy token heuristics encourage possibility exploration, naively extending them to video reasoning tends to induce lengthy reasoning, as the model becomes overly reliant on high-entropy visual activations. Alternative approaches that rely on counterfactual-based visual token localization for credit assignment also tend to over-prioritize visual exploration at the expense of decisive reasoning cues for answer derivation, thereby exacerbating the interference from spurious visual nuances. Moreover, these methods employ static counterfactual strategies that fail to co-evolve with the policy during training. In this paper, we introduce DyCPO, a co-evolutionary framework that jointly optimizes reliable token selection and adaptive counterfactual intervention. It constructs a multi-role dependence metric to balance visual exploration and answer-relevance mining in token-wise contrastive learning, while suppressing exploration-only filler tokens and spurious visual noise. Rather than relying on static counterfactual priors, DyCPO dynamically derives counterfactual signals from the model's own successful and failed rollouts, enabling self-diagnostic analysis and co-evolution of the optimization objective with the policy. Extensive experiments on complex video reasoning and general video understanding benchmarks demonstrate consistent performance improvements, establishing DyCPO as a robust token-level credit assignment paradigm for multimodal reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DyCPO 把视频推理 RL 中的 token 级信用分配改写为协同演化框架：用多角色依赖度量在 token 对比学习里平衡视觉探索与答案相关性挖掘，同时抑制纯填充 token 与伪视觉噪声，并从模型自身成功/失败 rollout 动态导出反事实信号，使优化目标与策略共同演化。在复杂视频推理与通用视频理解基准上给出一致的性能提升。
Motivation: RLVR 中 token 级信用分配含糊：高熵 token 启发式会诱导冗长推理，反事实视觉定位又过度偏向视觉探索、放大伪视觉细节干扰，且静态反事实先验无法随策略演化。
Method: 提出 DyCPO 协同演化框架：构造多角色依赖度量 (multi-role dependence metric) 在 token-wise 对比学习中权衡视觉探索与答案相关性，抑制探索型 filler token 与伪视觉噪声；反事实信号不再用静态先验，而是从模型自身成功与失败 rollout 中动态提取，实现自诊断并让目标与策略共同演化。
Result: 在复杂视频推理与通用视频理解基准上取得一致的性能提升（摘要未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: token 级信用分配应把可靠 token 选择与自适应反事实干预一起协同演化，而非依赖高熵启发式或静态反事实先验。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: KV$^2$: A Self-Refining KV Cache
papers.abstract_en: The memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache constrains the practical use of long-context models, and it dominates cost when one prefilled context must later serve many different queries. In this reusable setting, query-agnostic compression trades cost against quality: lightweight estimators are cheap but less accurate, whereas full-context reconstruction scoring is more accurate yet reprocesses the entire prompt. We introduce KV$^2$, a query-agnostic KV-cache compression method based on selective reconstruction. KV$^2$ first uses a lightweight proxy scorer to identify informative in-context tokens, then reprocesses only this subset to compute final eviction scores. On RULER, Needle-in-a-Haystack, and LongBench, KV$^2$'s margin over baselines widens as the budget tightens: on RULER 16K at a 2% KV-cache budget it improves the average score over the next-best baseline by more than 40 percentage points, and on LongBench it attains the highest average across 2%-10% budgets at lower compression-stage runtime and peak memory than full-context reconstruction. Reusable KV-cache compression thus does not require reprocessing the full context. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/KVsquared-0B97.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KV² 是一种 query-agnostic 的 KV cache 压缩方法：先用轻量 proxy scorer 筛出有信息量的 in-context token，只对这个子集重算得到最终 eviction score，从而避免全上下文重建。在 RULER 16K、2% KV 预算下，平均分比次优基线高出 40 个百分点以上；在 LongBench 上 2%–10% 预算区间取得最高平均分，且压缩阶段运行时与峰值内存低于全上下文重建。
Motivation: KV cache 显存占用限制长上下文模型的实用部署，尤其当一份预填充上下文要服务多个不同 query 时成本占主导。现有 query-agnostic 压缩在成本与质量间取舍：轻量估计器便宜但不准，全上下文重建打分准但要重处理整个 prompt。
Method: 两阶段选择性重建：轻量 proxy scorer 先定位有信息量的 in-context token，再仅对这一子集重处理计算最终 eviction score，保持 query-agnostic。在 RULER、Needle-in-a-Haystack、LongBench 上评测，并对比压缩阶段运行时与峰值内存。
Result: RULER 16K、2% KV 预算下，平均分较次优基线提升超过 40 个百分点；预算越紧优势越大。LongBench 上在 2%–10% 预算区间取得最高平均分，同时压缩阶段运行时与峰值内存低于全上下文重建。
Conclusion: 可复用场景下的 KV cache 压缩不必重处理完整上下文：只对 proxy scorer 选出的子集做选择性重建，即可在极低预算下大幅超过基线并降低压缩开销。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ULTRADISCOVERY: Abductive Exploration in an Interconnected, Epistemically Open Universe
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery often begins when scattered clues call for a new way of describing the world. Such abductive exploration can require constructing the representation in which an explanation is stated, when the world is epistemically open, and composing evidence scattered across contexts, when it is structurally interconnected. Existing benchmarks rarely separate these two demands or control them independently. We introduce ULTRADISCOVERY, an interactive world of five domains in which an agent revises an initially successful theory and predicts the outcome of an unseen cross-domain intervention. A $2 \times 2$ design leaves the representation open or discloses it, and leaves the evidence distributed or aligns it, with the latent dynamics fixed. With the representation open, agents across eleven models often retract the axiom they were taught, and none introduces the unobserved entity or rewrites the variables that a replacement requires. Disclosure triples intervention requests and adds about one of the eighteen findings the world affords, and alignment adds less. Two vendor-harness systems carry discovery into more domains, and one of them rewrites the variables in Open episodes. No system makes the exact prediction within 200 paid actions. At larger budgets one exact prediction appears with both aids, while every Open episode remains inexact. The results locate the difficulty in the step from accumulating evidence to composing it into a representation that transfers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ULTRADISCOVERY 是一个交互式科学发现基准：五个领域的世界中，智能体需修正一个原本成功的理论并预测未见过的跨领域干预结果，用 2×2 设计独立控制「表征是否开放」与「证据是否对齐」。11 个模型在表征开放时常常撤回被教的公理，却无一引入替换所需的未观测实体或重写变量；披露表征使干预请求增至三倍并多带来约 1 项发现（共 18 项），对齐证据的增益更小；即使在更大预算下，所有 Open 局面的预测仍不精确。
Motivation: 现有科学发现基准无法把「构造解释所在的表征」与「跨情境组合分散证据」这两种需求分开，也无法独立控制它们，因而难以定位智能体在哪一步失败。
Method: 构建交互式世界 ULTRADISCOVERY，覆盖五个领域：智能体修正一个初始成功的理论，并预测一次未见的跨领域干预结果；采用 2×2 实验设计，分别开放或披露表征、分散或对齐证据，同时固定潜在动力学；在 11 个模型以及两套厂商 harness 系统上运行，按付费动作预算（200 步及更大）统计发现数与预测精度。
Result: 表征开放时，11 个模型常常撤回被教授的公理，但没有任何模型引入替换所需的未观测实体或重写变量；披露表征使干预请求数增至三倍，并带来约 1 项发现（该世界共提供 18 项发现），而证据对齐带来的增益更小。两套厂商 harness 系统把发现扩展到更多领域，其中一套在 Open 局面中会重写变量。没有任何系统在 200 次付费动作内做出精确预测；在更大预算下，借助两项辅助也只出现一次精确预测，且所有 Open 局面的预测仍不精确。
Conclusion: 科学发现的瓶颈在于把积累的证据组合成可迁移表征这一步，而不在于证据收集本身；披露表征比对齐证据更能推动发现，但即便如此 Open 局面的精确预测依然失败。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: TRAC: Trajectory-aware Reuse and Adaptive Correction for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) video generation enables scalable long-video synthesis by sequentially generating fixed-length chunks, but incurs substantial computational cost from repeated denoising and attention over growing historical contexts. Recent cache reuse methods exploit temporal redundancy to reduce this cost, yet are mainly designed for single-trajectory generation, making them less suitable for sequentially coupled AR trajectories where approximation errors can accumulate and propagate across chunks. To address this challenge, we propose TRAC, a Trajectory-aware Reuse and Adaptive Correction framework for efficient and robust AR video generation. TRAC integrates three complementary components: (1) Robust Cumulative Scheduling (RCS), which selects cache reuse schedules by accounting for cumulative rollout errors and their variation across chunks and prompts; (2) Autoregressive Trajectory-aware Guidance Scheduling (ATGS), which coordinates classifier-free guidance refreshes along the global AR trajectory; and (3) Spectral Structure Correction (SSC), which adaptively restores low-frequency structural information to mitigate long-term error accumulation. By combining these innovations, TRAC substantially improves the efficiency-quality trade-off of AR video generation. For example, on VBench with SkyReels-V2, it achieves a 6.03x speedup over the vanilla model with only ~0.6% VBench score degradation, while consistently outperforming existing AR acceleration methods in both latency and generation quality. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/yolosjxhhhhhh/trac.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRAC 针对自回归 (AR) 视频生成中缓存复用在多轨迹耦合下误差累积的问题，提出轨迹感知复用与自适应校正框架：RCS 按跨 chunk 与 prompt 的累积 rollout 误差选复用调度，ATGS 沿全局 AR 轨迹协调 CFG 刷新，SSC 自适应恢复低频结构。在 VBench 上用 SkyReels-V2 实现 6.03 倍加速、VBench 分数仅下降约 0.6%，延迟与生成质量均优于现有 AR 加速方法。
Motivation: 现有缓存复用方法面向单轨迹生成，而 AR 视频是顺序耦合的多轨迹，近似误差会跨 chunk 累积传播，导致复用带来的效率收益伴随质量退化。
Method: TRAC 含三个组件：Robust Cumulative Scheduling (RCS) 依据累积 rollout 误差及其跨 chunk、跨 prompt 的变化选择缓存复用调度；Autoregressive Trajectory-aware Guidance Scheduling (ATGS) 沿全局 AR 轨迹协调 classifier-free guidance 刷新；Spectral Structure Correction (SSC) 自适应恢复低频结构信息以抑制长期误差累积。
Result: 在 VBench 上以 SkyReels-V2 实现 6.03 倍加速，VBench 分数仅下降约 0.6%，并在延迟与生成质量两方面持续优于已有 AR 加速方法。
Conclusion: 把缓存复用调度、CFG 刷新与频谱结构校正按 AR 轨迹的累积误差统一设计，可以同时改善自回归视频生成的效率-质量权衡。

papers.title: Global Coherence: When Every Agent Is Right and the Team Is Still Wrong - A Local-to-Global Semantic Foundation for Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: AI agents can each make locally valid decisions yet jointly produce an invalid result. We call this the global coherence problem: a failure of shared state, not merely of intelligence. Our Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem gives the exact boundary. A policy can guarantee a valid action exactly when all worlds producing the same observation share an admissible action. If k indistinguishable worlds require pairwise-disjoint actions, the best randomized worst-case success is 1/k; more reasoning, roles, messages, or samples cannot recover the missing distinction. A stronger model can reason better within its context, but it cannot see beyond it. The smallest sufficient context is NP-hard to find, yet counterexample-guided refinement finds a sufficient one and recertifies it as rules change. We give local-to-global runtime semantics X = (H, C, G, F; D): topology H records overlapping scopes; category C governs state-changing actions; groupoid G keeps reversible translations; sheaf F tests whether local views glue into one world; and history D keeps only what alters legal futures. Each preserves the needed information as state is split, translated, or changed. Models propose; the harness owns shared state and governs commit. Ten studies test the boundary. On a revision benchmark, a frontier model scores 40/40 when the deciding event is visible; hidden, every arm is consistent with chance (1/3); one restored fact returns 40/40. On TeamBench, ordinary teams exceed a shared budget in 5/5 runs, a visible live count leaves 4/5, and commit enforcement leaves 0/5. In tau2-bench Telecom, current-state checks score 0.07 after silent reverts; the harness scores 1.00. Refinement keeps a sufficient context through rule changes at 28% of the all-field cost. Solvers that already own the state tie it, as predicted. Local intelligence cannot substitute for missing global state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把多智能体各自局部正确却联合出错定义为全局一致性问题，并用 Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem 给出精确边界：只有当产生同一观测的所有世界共享一个可行动作时策略才能保证有效，若 k 个不可区分世界要求两两不相交的动作，最好随机化最坏情形成功率仅 1/k，更多推理、角色、消息或采样都无法补回缺失区分。配套提出局部到全局运行时语义 X=(H,C,G,F;D) 与由 harness 持有共享状态、管辖 commit 的架构。
Motivation: 多智能体系统里每个 agent 的决策在各自上下文内都成立，合起来却产生无效结果；作者主张这是共享状态的失效而非智能不足，需要一个可判定的边界与运行时治理机制。
Method: 先证 Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem 刻划可保证有效动作的充要条件，并指出最小充分上下文是 NP-hard、但可用反例引导精化 (counterexample-guided refinement) 找到并随规则变化重新认证；再给出局部到全局语义 X=(H,C,G,F;D)：拓扑 H 记录重叠作用域、范畴 C 管辖改状态动作、群胚 G 保持可逆翻译、层 F 检验局部视图能否粘合成一个世界、历史 D 只保留会改变合法未来的部分；模型提议、harness 持有共享状态并管辖 commit。
Result: 十项研究检验该边界。修订基准上，决定性事件可见时前沿模型得 40/40，隐藏时各臂都与随机水平 (1/3) 一致，恢复一个事实后回到 40/40。TeamBench 上普通团队 5/5 次超出共享预算，可见的实时计数降到 4/5，commit 强制后为 0/5。tau2-bench Telecom 中静默回滚后当前状态检查只得 0.07，harness 得 1.00。精化在规则变化下以全字段成本 28% 保持充分上下文；本就拥有状态的求解器与之打平，与定理预测一致。
Conclusion: 局部智能无法替代缺失的全局状态：区分度一旦被观测混叠抹掉，加算力也无解，可行路径是让 harness 持有共享状态并强制 commit，而非继续加角色或消息。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MorphoBranch: A Fine-Structure-Preserving Workbench for Morphometric Analysis of Branched Cellular Structures
papers.abstract_en: Background and Objectives: Fluorescence-labeled cellular arbors provide readouts of neuronal and microglial morphology, but fine and weakly labeled processes are prone to fragmentation and false connections that bias skeleton-based measurements. We present MorphoBranch, a fine-structure-preserving, human-reviewable workbench for morphometry of branched cellular structures. Methods: MorphoBranch combines a deterministic Morphometry Engine with an LLM-assisted Refinement Engine. The Mor- phometry Engine implements an image-to-graph workflow integrating multiscale structural evidence extraction, hysteresis segmen- tation, evidence-constrained skeleton refinement, and graph-based morphometry. The Refinement Engine maps natural-language requests to registered actions for parameter adjustment, preview execution, metric reporting, and unsupported-request handling, while image processing and quantitative computation remain deterministic and reviewable. Results: MorphoBranch was evaluated on two public neuronal axon datasets, AxonMIP and AxonStack, and the in-house Cell- Morph dataset of microglial fluorescence images. It achieved the highest Skeleton F1 and clDice and the lowest length-estimation error among the evaluated methods on all three datasets, while also achieving the highest Dice and IoU on AxonMIP and Axon- Stack. Across 150 natural-language tasks, the Refinement Engine achieved a 94.0% end-to-end success rate. Conclusions: These results demonstrate that MorphoBranch provides a reproducible, human-reviewable workflow for mor- phometric analysis of branched cellular structures. It supports fine-structure-preserving quantification across neuronal axon and microglial fluorescence images while maintaining inspectable and reproducible analysis workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MorphoBranch 把确定性的 Morphometry Engine（多尺度结构证据提取、滞回分割、证据约束骨架细化、图形态测量）与 LLM 辅助的 Refinement Engine 组合成可人工复核的分支细胞结构形态测量工作台。在 AxonMIP、AxonStack 与自建 CellMorph 三个数据集上取得最高 Skeleton F1 与 clDice、最低长度估计误差，150 条自然语言任务端到端成功率 94.0%。
Motivation: 荧光标记的神经元轴突与小胶质细胞分支中，细弱过程易断裂并产生错误连接，使基于骨架的形态测量结果产生偏差，且现有流程难以人工复核。
Method: Morphometry Engine 走 image-to-graph 流程：多尺度结构证据提取、滞回分割 (hysteresis segmentation)、证据约束的骨架细化与基于图的形态测量；Refinement Engine 把自然语言请求映射为注册动作，负责参数调整、预览执行、指标报告与不支持请求处理，图像处理与定量计算保持确定性。
Result: 在公开轴突数据集 AxonMIP、AxonStack 与自建小胶质细胞荧光数据集 CellMorph 上，Skeleton F1 与 clDice 为所评方法中最高、长度估计误差最低，并在 AxonMIP 与 AxonStack 上取得最高 Dice 与 IoU；150 条自然语言任务的 Refinement Engine 端到端成功率 94.0%。
Conclusion: 确定性图像处理加 LLM 只做动作映射的分工，能在保留细结构的同时给出可复现、可人工审查的分支细胞形态测量流程。

papers.title: StabilityArc: Decoding Protein Sequence Embeddings into Generalizable Stability Landscapes
papers.abstract_en: Every protein has a unique stability landscape, but the physical consequences of mutation are governed by recurring biochemical constraints. We test whether a shared decoder, trained on measurements from diverse proteins, can interpret these constraints in an unseen target, enabling cross-protein transfer for initial experimental round prescreening. We present StabilityArc , which maps frozen ESMC-600M residue representations through a shared RoPE transformer to an Lx20 matrix of substitution effects; a symmetric, contact-aware residual aids in predicting epistasis in simultaneous substitutions. In 66 strict leave-one-protein-out evaluations covering 134,794 ProteinGym variants, StabilityArc achieves 0.7134 Spearman correlation, exceeding the strongest zero-shot baseline, ProSST-2048 (0.6526), by 0.0608. We further explore the utility of this method by providing the score as a prior for Kermut, achieving Spearman correlation of 0.8280 across three supervised split schemes, improving on Kermut's reported 0.8167.
papers.comment: Accepted to Representations for the Physical Sciences Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026; 9 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StabilityArc 用共享 RoPE transformer 把冻结的 ESMC-600M 残基表征解码为 L×20 突变效应矩阵，再加对称、接触感知的残差项预测多位点上位性，实现跨蛋白零样本稳定性景观迁移。在 66 次严格 leave-one-protein-out 评估、覆盖 ProteinGym 134,794 个变体上，Spearman 达 0.7134，比最强零样本基线 ProSST-2048 的 0.6526 高 0.0608；作为先验接入 Kermut 后 Spearman 0.8280，超过其自报的 0.8167。
Motivation: 每个蛋白的稳定性景观都不同，但突变的物理后果受重复出现的生化约束支配；实验轮次前的初筛需要在未见过的靶标蛋白上直接给出突变效应排序，而现有零样本方法在跨蛋白泛化上精度不足。
Method: 冻结 ESMC-600M 的残基表征，经共享 RoPE transformer 解码为 L×20 的替换效应矩阵；另设对称且接触感知 (contact-aware) 的残差模块，用于预测同时多位点替换的上位性。评测采用严格 leave-one-protein-out 协议，并把打分作为先验提供给 Kermut。
Result: 66 次严格 leave-one-protein-out 评估、覆盖 ProteinGym 134,794 个变体，Spearman 相关 0.7134，超过最强零样本基线 ProSST-2048 的 0.6526，高出 0.0608。将该分数作为 Kermut 的先验后，在三种监督划分方案上 Spearman 0.8280，优于 Kermut 自报的 0.8167。
Conclusion: 跨蛋白共享的解码器能从冻结蛋白语言模型表征中读出通用生化约束，在未见靶标上给出可用于实验初筛的稳定性排序，并且作为先验还能进一步抬高监督模型 Kermut 的表现。

papers.title: CompMat-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Computational Materials Science
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating AI agents on scientific research tasks is constrained by the time and resources required for the underlying experiments or calculations. In computational materials research, repeating the same expensive simulations across agents and trials can make evaluation impractical. We introduce CompMat-Bench, a benchmark of 94 tasks derived from recently published computational materials studies, each asking agents to complete a step toward achieving the study's scientific goal. We reproduce the research steps in advance and assess agents on preparing inputs and analyzing outputs for expensive simulations, so expensive simulations can be avoided during evaluation. The reproduced inputs and results serve as ground truth for grading agents with fixed rules, without an LLM judge. The benchmark supports four evaluation conditions: single tasks and workflows composed of related tasks, each with full or reduced methodological guidance. With full guidance on single tasks, agents based on three LLMs demonstrate the ability to complete individual materials research steps, with pass rates of 66.0-90.4% across 94 tasks. Both longer workflows and reduced guidance can limit agent performance, but in different ways for different agents: they lower the pass rates of the weaker agents, whereas the strongest agent falls only when a long workflow is combined with reduced guidance. Failure analysis attributes most failures to scientific errors rather than to errors in software usage. CompMat-Bench provides a basis for comparing agents on the steps of real materials research and for analyzing agent failure modes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CompMat-Bench 是一个计算材料科学研究步骤的 AI agent 基准：94 个任务取自近期已发表的计算材料研究，昂贵模拟预先复现，用固定规则而非 LLM judge 评分。在单任务加完整方法指导条件下，基于三个 LLM 的 agent 通过率 66.0–90.4%；更长工作流或削减指导会拉低表现，但只在最强 agent 上需要两者叠加才明显下降，且多数失败源于科学错误而非软件操作错误。
Motivation: 在计算材料研究上评测 AI agent 需要重复昂贵的模拟，跨 agent、跨 trial 重复计算使评测本身不可行。
Method: 从近期发表的计算材料研究中提炼 94 个任务，每个任务要求 agent 完成通向原研究科学目标的一步；预先复现这些研究步骤，让 agent 只做模拟输入准备与输出分析，评测阶段避开昂贵模拟。复现的输入与结果作为 ground truth，用固定规则打分，不用 LLM judge。评测支持四种条件：单任务与相关任务组成的工作流，各自再分完整方法指导与削减指导。
Result: 在完整指导的单任务条件下，基于三个 LLM 的 agent 通过率为 66.0–90.4%（94 个任务）。更长工作流与削减指导都会压低通过率，但方式因 agent 而异：弱 agent 在任一条件下都下降，最强 agent 只在长工作流叠加削减指导时才下降。失败分析显示多数失败归因于科学错误，而非软件使用错误。
Conclusion: 预先复现昂贵模拟并用固定规则评分，可以让真实材料研究步骤上的 agent 评测变得可行；agent 的瓶颈主要在科学推理而非工具操作，且长工作流与指导削减对不同强度 agent 的影响不同。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: KV-streams for Efficient Compaction in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Scaling the horizon of agentic LLMs is bottlenecked by the need to fit ever longer context traces in GPU memory. Context compaction has been the most popular mechanism to alleviate this issue, keeping GPU memory constant for a given trace. Unfortunately, most compaction strategies rely on prefilling the LLM context many times over, hindering training throughput. To alleviate this bottleneck and enable efficient trainable compaction, we propose KV-streams, a plug-and-play strategy compatible with any compaction strategy that substantially increases throughput while showing no evidence of hindering performance. KV-streams enable scalable compaction by streaming the KV cache forward rather than flushing it after each compaction. We show that KV-streams enable three different compaction strategies, achieving a 2.6 to 5x wall-clock speedup in training. Beyond efficiency, we find that the streamed KV cache can act as a recurrent state, carrying forward information that has long since disappeared from the context. Specifically, in a controlled setting we show that, contrary to prior work, RL alone is all that is needed for this behavior to emerge. Overall, we show KV-streams to be an efficient and lightweight plug-and-play addition to any post-training pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 KV-streams：compaction 后不丢弃 KV cache，而是把它流式前传，作为可复用状态接进任意上下文压缩策略。训练吞吐提升 2.6–5 倍且无性能受损证据；流式 KV 还充当循环状态，携带早已滑出上下文的信息，且该行为仅靠 RL 即可涌现。
Motivation: agentic LLM 的长轨迹把上下文塞满 GPU 显存，而主流 compaction 策略反复 prefill 同一上下文，严重拖慢训练吞吐。
Method: KV-streams 是与具体 compaction 策略解耦的即插即用策略：compaction 后把 KV cache 流式前传而非清空，从而避免重复 prefill；在三种不同 compaction 策略上验证兼容性，并在受控设定下检验流式 KV 作为循环状态的行为来源。
Result: 在三种 compaction 策略上训练 wall-clock 加速 2.6–5 倍，且没有性能受损的证据；受控实验显示流式 KV cache 能携带已从上下文中消失的长期信息，与先前工作相反，仅靠 RL 就足以让这一行为涌现。
Conclusion: KV-streams 是可加进任意 post-training 流水线的轻量组件：既把 compaction 训练变快，又让 KV cache 充当跨上下文的循环记忆，而无需额外机制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Migration to Calibration: Aligning Agents with Deployment Requirements
papers.abstract_en: Deploying, migrating, or scaling an agent changes its model, support system, application, and users. Calibration should align the agent with destination requirements without requiring source imitation or universal superiority. We propose three standard families: basic capability and operational reachability; technical and professional precision, including terminology, units, reporting periods, program fidelity, and report dependencies; and user context covering roles, use cases, authorized values, permissions, and budgets. A versioned mapping distinguishes requirements to preserve, transform, add, or retire. Four instruments---benchmarks, positive/negative examples, skills, and role-conditioned cost/utility---supply tunable reward channels within a fixed acceptance contract. Consultants annotate methods, branches, bounded loops, checkpoints, relative comparisons, and report refinement; a registry records applicable evidence. Adaptation revises configurations or trains a separate controller or skill while freezing the foundation executor. Independent hard gates govern qualification; RL and preference methods optimize candidates without supplying factual truth. Qualification and held-out improvement over the unchanged target are separate outcomes. Supplied intent labels permit a limited paired recount: small prompt/retry gains coexist with regressions and failed gates. FinQA supplements match prior summaries and retain provenance conflicts. These observations motivate destination-specific evaluation but do not establish calibration efficacy. We specify matched-budget tests, clean reload, complete-denominator reporting, and dependency revalidation. This is a methodological proposal with partially reconciled pilot evidence; confirmatory validation and the greater-than-80% zero-shot task-context acceptance target remain outstanding.
papers.comment: 64 pages, 10 figures, 11 tables. Revised destination-oriented calibration framework and a partially reconciled pilot evidence audit. Methodological proposal; no confirmatory calibration or RL efficacy results. Matched-budget validation and the automatic calibration tool remain future work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向部署的 agent 校准 (destination-oriented calibration) 框架：把迁移后的模型、支撑系统与用户变化视为需要按目标场景需求重新对齐的问题，用三类标准需求族、版本化映射与四类奖励通道替代源端模仿。作者明确这是方法学提案，配对重计只显示 prompt/retry 有小幅增益同时伴随回退与门禁失败，>80% 零样本任务上下文验收目标仍待验证。
Motivation: 部署、迁移或扩展 agent 会同时改变模型、支撑系统、应用与用户，现有对齐思路依赖源端模仿或追求普适最优，无法回答目标场景自身的验收要求。
Method: 定义三类标准需求族（基础能力与运行可达性；术语、单位、报告期、程序保真与报告依赖等技术与专业精度；角色、用例、授权取值、权限与预算等用户上下文），用版本化映射区分需保留、转换、新增或退役的需求；由 benchmark、正负样例、skills、role-conditioned cost/utility 四类工具在固定验收契约下提供可调奖励通道，顾问标注方法、分支、有界循环、检查点、相对比较与报告精修并登记适用证据；适配阶段改配置或训练独立 controller/skill 而冻结 foundation executor，独立硬门禁负责资格判定，RL 与偏好方法只优化候选。
Result: 在 supplied intent labels 上的有限配对重计显示 prompt/retry 带来小幅增益，同时存在回退与未通过门禁的案例；FinQA 补充项与既有摘要一致但保留 provenance 冲突；资格判定与相对未改动目标的 held-out 提升被列为两个独立结果，>80% 零样本任务上下文验收目标尚未达成。
Conclusion: 校准应按目标场景需求而非源端模仿来评估，且资格与提升必须分开报告；作者要求 matched-budget 测试、clean reload、完整分母报告与依赖重验证，确认性校准与 RL 效果仍属未来工作。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 定义三类标准需求族（基础能力与运行可达性；术语、单位、报告期、程序保真与报告依赖等技术与专业精度；角色、用例、授权取值、权限与预算等用户上下文），用版本化映射区分需保留、转换、新增或退役的需求；由 benchmark、正负样例、skills、role-conditioned cost/utility 四类工具在固定验收契约下提供可调奖励通道，顾问标注方法、分支、有界循环、检查点、相对比较与报告精修并登记适用证据；适配阶段改配置或训练独立 controller/skill 而冻结 foundation executor，独立硬门禁负责资格判定，RL 与偏好方法只优化候选。
summary_sections.result: 在 supplied intent labels 上的有限配对重计显示 prompt/retry 带来小幅增益，同时存在回退与未通过门禁的案例；FinQA 补充项与既有摘要一致但保留 provenance 冲突；资格判定与相对未改动目标的 held-out 提升被列为两个独立结果，>80% 零样本任务上下文验收目标尚未达成。
summary_sections.conclusion: 校准应按目标场景需求而非源端模仿来评估，且资格与提升必须分开报告；作者要求 matched-budget 测试、clean reload、完整分母报告与依赖重验证，确认性校准与 RL 效果仍属未来工作。

papers.title: THEIA: A Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Vision-Language Analysis of Layout
papers.abstract_en: The integration of artificial intelligence into computer-aided design frameworks has sparked a shift in the design of analog integrated circuits (ICs), transitioning the field from using manual and algorithmic-based solutions to adopting automated and intelligent paradigms. In this scenario, the GDSII file represents the industry-standard database containing the ultimate and most accurate source of information of the analog circuit, encapsulating the complex physical geometries and parasitic realities that define tape out performance. This paper proposes THEIA, a novel dataset containing thousands of layout images paired with question-answer conversations, along with a benchmark that employs a fine-tuned vision-language model (VLM) to analyze GDSII files of analog circuits, enabling designers to interact with and query physical layouts as intuitive, meaningful entities. Experimental results using thousands of analog designs across five realistic tasks demonstrate that the proposed fine-tuned VLM outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose VLMs by a significant margin (up to 73%), highlighting a fundamental gap between general-purpose multimodal reasoning and domain-specific layout understanding.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 10 figures, 14 tables, to be published in NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: THEIA 提出面向模拟集成电路版图的多模态数据集与基准：数千张 GDSII 版图图像配对问答对话，用微调后的视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 让设计者直接查询物理版图。在数千个模拟设计的五项真实任务上，微调 VLM 比通用 VLM 最高高出 73%，显示通用多模态推理与领域版图理解之间存在根本差距。
Motivation: 模拟 IC 设计正从人工与算法方案转向自动化智能化，但 GDSII 中的几何与寄生信息难以用自然语言查询，通用 VLM 缺乏版图领域理解。
Method: 构建 THEIA 数据集：数千张版图图像与问答对话配对；基准对一个通用 VLM 做微调，并在五项真实任务上与最先进通用 VLM 对比。
Result: 在数千个模拟设计、五项真实任务上，微调 VLM 相比 SOTA 通用 VLM 最高提升 73%。

papers.title: LVMT: Video Mask Transformer for Long-term Video Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Existing online video segmentation methods struggle to track objects in long, complex videos with long-term occlusions. We hypothesize that this limitation is caused by (i) the inability of their temporal propagation mechanism to adaptively select the object information that is propagated across time, and (ii) their inability to be trained on long videos due to memory requirements and vanishing gradients. To address the first limitation, we propose to use a lightweight GRU-based temporal propagation module that can learn to select which information it keeps in memory and propagates across time. Second, to allow training on long videos, we introduce Truncated Query Propagation (TQP), a training strategy in which the model processes a video in chunks of frames, where information about tracked objects is propagated between chunks but backpropagation is only conducted in individual chunks, enabling longer temporal supervision without out-of-memory issues, inference overhead, or vanishing gradients. The resulting model is called the Long-term Video Mask Transformer (LVMT). Extensive experiments on six benchmarks show that LVMT sets a new state of the art across a range of video segmentation tasks, while retaining the speed of the highly efficient model it is based on, making it 10X faster than the prior state of the art. Code: https://github.com/tue-mps/lvmt
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LVMT 用轻量 GRU 时序传播模块让模型自行选择跨帧保留与传播的目标信息，并提出 Truncated Query Propagation (TQP) 训练策略：视频按帧块分段处理，目标信息在块间传播而反向传播只在单块内进行，从而在不爆显存、不增推理开销、不出现梯度消失的前提下用长视频监督训练。在六个视频分割基准上达到新 SOTA，同时比先前 SOTA 快 10 倍。
Motivation: 在线视频分割在长视频、长时遮挡场景下跟踪失败：现有方法的时序传播无法自适应筛选要跨时间传递的目标信息，且受显存与梯度消失限制无法直接在长视频上训练。
Method: 两部分：GRU-based 时序传播模块，学习在记忆中选择保留哪些目标信息并跨时间传播；Truncated Query Propagation (TQP) 训练策略，把视频切成帧块，块间传播目标信息但只在块内反向传播，实现更长时序监督。组合后的模型即 Long-term Video Mask Transformer (LVMT)，基于一个高效率的骨干模型。
Result: 在六个基准 (benchmarks) 上的一系列视频分割任务中取得新的 state of the art，同时保持所基于模型的高效率，比先前 SOTA 快 10X。
Conclusion: 自适应选择传播内容加上分块截断的时序训练，可以在长视频上同时拿到更强的分割精度、更长的时序监督和 10 倍推理速度优势。

papers.title: MiCo: Mutual Information Coverage Optimization through Semantic Erasure Modeling for Efficient MLLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in multimodal understanding, but processing large numbers of visual tokens results in high computational costs. While many methods have been proposed to reduce the number of visual tokens, most of them rely on heuristics and are prone to discarding substantial visual information during pruning, leading to degradation in model performance. In this work, by using a semantic erasure model, we derive a general mutual information coverage objective from task log-loss and propose MiCo, a training-free two-stage pruning method. MiCo first uses visual signals to select a representative candidate pool before visual tokens enter the language model, then performs task-aware subset selection within it. At each stage, suitable observable proxies instantiate the derived objective as a monotone submodular coverage function, which MiCo greedily optimizes under the token budget. MiCo is evaluated on diverse MLLMs ranging from 7B to 13B parameters across a broad range of image and video benchmarks spanning general visual reasoning, fine-grained OCR and grounding, hallucination detection, and long-video understanding. MiCo consistently achieves the best performance across nearly all evaluated models under all pruning ratios. On LLaVA-NEXT-13B, MiCo uses only 5.6% visual tokens, retains 97.5% of baseline performance, and achieves a 3.8-fold inference speedup. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MiCo and our mutual information coverage objective for visual token pruning. Our code is available at https://github.com/MAX-7237/MiCo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MiCo 是免训练的两阶段视觉 token 剪枝方法：从任务 log-loss 经语义擦除模型 (semantic erasure model) 推出互信息覆盖目标，用单调次模覆盖函数在 token 预算下贪心优化。在 LLaVA-NEXT-13B 上只保留 5.6% 视觉 token 即保住基线 97.5% 的性能，推理加速 3.8 倍。
Motivation: MLLM 处理大量视觉 token 计算开销高，现有剪枝方法多依赖启发式，容易丢弃大量视觉信息并导致性能下降。
Method: 两阶段免训练剪枝：先用视觉信号在 token 进入语言模型前选出代表性候选池，再做任务感知子集选择；两阶段各用合适的可观测代理把推导出的互信息覆盖目标实例化为单调次模覆盖函数，并在 token 预算下贪心优化。
Result: 在 7B–13B 参数的多种 MLLM 上、覆盖通用视觉推理、细粒度 OCR 与 grounding、幻觉检测、长视频理解等图像与视频基准，MiCo 在几乎所有模型与所有剪枝比例下取得最佳性能；LLaVA-NEXT-13B 上仅用 5.6% 视觉 token，保留基线 97.5% 性能，推理加速 3.8 倍。
Conclusion: 把视觉 token 剪枝写成互信息覆盖目标并用次模贪心求解，可以在极低 token 预算下基本不损失 MLLM 性能，且无需训练。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Predict Before You Modify: Learning Improvement Dynamics for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents improve through repeated cycles of modification and evaluation. However, existing methods receive feedback on modifications only after costly evaluations, and aggregate scores may obscure distinctions between failures that require different repairs. We introduce predictive self-evolution through an editable Improvement Dynamics Model (IDM). Before evaluation, the IDM predicts task-level outcomes of a proposed modification and guides an optional revision. After evaluation, past modifications and their observed outcomes are used to improve the IDM, allowing predictive knowledge to accumulate across generations. The system can thus improve how it solves tasks, proposes modifications, and predicts their effects. Building on HyperAgents, we evaluate this approach across multilingual coding, paper review, robotics reward design, and Olympiad-level mathematical grading. Our approach outperforms HyperAgents across all four domains, with up to 46% higher average performance over generations. Gains also persist under matched token budgets that include both agent evolution and task evaluation, and extend to held-out tasks. Forecast accuracy improves as the IDM evolves, and the learned predictive knowledge transfers to improve evolution in a new domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可编辑的 Improvement Dynamics Model (IDM)，让自进化智能体在昂贵评估之前先预测某次修改的任务级结果并据此修订，评估之后再用观测结果更新 IDM，使预测知识跨代累积。基于 HyperAgents 在多语言代码、论文评审、机器人奖励设计与 Olympiad 数学评分四个领域上，平均性能逐代最高比 HyperAgents 高 46%，且在匹配 token 预算与 held-out 任务上增益仍在。
Motivation: 自进化智能体只能在昂贵评估之后才拿到修改反馈，而聚合分数会掩盖需要不同修复的失败类型，导致修改试错成本高、跨代知识不积累。
Method: 构建可编辑的 Improvement Dynamics Model (IDM)：评估前预测所提修改的任务级结果并引导可选修订，评估后用历史修改与观测结果更新 IDM；系统建立在 HyperAgents 之上，覆盖多语言代码、论文评审、机器人奖励设计与 Olympiad 级数学评分四个领域。
Result: 在四个领域上全部优于 HyperAgents，逐代平均性能最高提升 46%；在同时计入智能体进化与任务评估的匹配 token 预算下增益仍保持，并可迁移到 held-out 任务；IDM 的预测精度随进化提升，学到的预测知识可迁移到新领域改进进化。
Conclusion: 把预测改进动力学放进自进化回路，可以在同等 token 预算下跨代、跨任务、跨领域提升智能体性能，且预测知识本身可积累和迁移。

papers.title: FlatClip: Reusing Image Foundation Models for fMRI Representation Learning via Cortical Flatmaps
papers.abstract_en: Can the spatial organization of cortical activity help transfer frozen image representations to fMRI prediction? We introduce FlatClip, which renders cortical activity as anatomy-linked flatmaps and extracts features with a frozen SigLIP2 encoder. Only a lightweight downstream probe is trained, without fMRI-specific encoder pretraining or fine-tuning. Across four resting-state benchmarks, FlatClip outperforms the evaluated ROI-level baselines on HCP and ADNI, but is weaker on PPMI and below the strongest voxel-level models overall. On NSD visual-fMRI decoding, restricting inputs to visual or NSD-provided task-active cortex improves recognition over whole-cortex inputs. Spatial perturbations reduce performance with both retrained and fixed readouts, and anatomy-linked arrangements outperform cortical-pixel permutations across three colormaps. Together, these results demonstrate a practical route for reusing image-pretrained features in fMRI and highlight cortical arrangement and input-region selection as important design choices. Code is available at https://github.com/OneMore1/FlatClip.

papers.title: Witness Overlap: Directional Provenance Inside Open-Weight Model Families
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight models are often released, fine-tuned, aligned, merged, and re-released, making provenance audits ask not only whether checkpoints are related, but also which checkpoint came first. Many existing model-provenance methods are designed for a base-known audit setting: given a victim or source model, they test whether a suspect model is related to it. Although these audits are framed as source-to-suspect tests, their underlying evidence is often symmetric, relying on representation similarity, weight similarity, behavioral fingerprints, or correlation statistics. Symmetric pairwise comparisons can detect relatedness, but they cannot by themselves orient relationship between checkpoints A and B. We therefore introduce a local geometric comparison: instead of comparing two checkpoints directly, we add a third same-family checkpoint as a witness and compare the geometry around each candidate endpoint. Direction is inferred by asking which candidate behaves more like a branching parent. Motivated by this idea, and by the empirically observed asymmetry between parent-anchored and child-anchored witness-overlap distributions, we propose Witness Overlap, a prompt-free, training-free white-box test for directional provenance. On 176 LLM checkpoints from 16 families, our one-witness test orients 95.3\% of parent-child decisions using Frobenius cosine. We further evaluate root identification, sibling discrimination, generalizations to VLM and diffusion families, and chain-structured ordering. The signal is robust to weight noise and sparse pruning, with a proposed SVD weight reduction variant showing greater robustness than Frobenius cosine.

papers.title: Strip Convolution and Direction-Aware Exclusion Loss for Oriented Ship Detection
papers.abstract_en: Oriented ship detection in very high resolution (VHR) remote sensing imagery remains challenging due to elongated hull geometry and dense target distributions in complex port scenes. Existing methods typically address geometric representation and duplicate suppression separately. To jointly tackle these issues, we propose an oriented ship detector with two complementary components. The C3k2_Strip module employs orthogonal strip convolutions to better capture elongated hull structures, while the Class-Aware Direction-Aware Exclusion Loss (CA-DAEL) suppresses redundant predictions using class, direction, and confidence cues. Experiments on HRSC2016 and DIOR-R achieve 78.45% and 53.71% mAP50:95, respectively, with only 2.91M parameters. On HRSC2016, the proposed method improves mAP50:95 by 6.32 percentage points over the YOLOv11-OBB baseline, demonstrating its effectiveness for accurate oriented ship detection.

papers.title: LiFR v2: Completion-Augmented Event Propagation for High-Rate Dense Prediction
papers.abstract_en: High-rate dense perception in dynamic environments is limited by the low update rate of RGB cameras, as rapid scene changes can occur between frames. Event cameras offer temporally dense but spatially sparse measurements, complementary to spatially dense RGB observations. Direct fusion cannot fully exploit this complementarity, while event-guided propagation fails on newly appearing or disoccluded regions without valid RGB support. We present LiFR v2, a unified propagation-completion-memory framework for causal anytime and streaming dense prediction from an RGB keyframe and events. LiFR v2 introduces an Event-Guided Completion Module (EGCM) to recover task-relevant representations where propagation is unsupported, and a History Retrieval Module (HRM) to reuse completed representations across successive queries. The framework supports semantic segmentation, monocular depth estimation, and multi-task dense prediction, and we further introduce SHF-Emerge to evaluate rapid object emergence and disocclusion. LiFR v2 achieves 74.37% mIoU on DSEC and 56.13% on SHF-Emerge, improving LiFR-Seg by 1.85 percentage points on the latter, while reducing SHF-Emerge depth RMSE from 1.564 m to 1.118 m over the propagation baseline. It also exceeds 100 FPS for both segmentation and depth, demonstrating accurate and efficient high-rate perception beyond RGB frame rates.

papers.title: Jev for Scientific Decisions: Evaluating Semantic Choices and Their Consequences
papers.abstract_en: Scientific workflows often require choosing among known relations before a deterministic calculation can proceed. Whether observations share a culture, treatment or reference standard can change the scientific meaning of the resulting count or comparison. We evaluate Jev as a semantic decision component using a harness that follows its documented guidance and assigns arithmetic to code. The study compares twelve model configurations on twenty source-grounded Choices across ten scientific cases, each repeated five times. We measure semantic selections, downstream outputs and final claim labels separately. Jev matched five other configurations at complete semantic correctness and achieved the lowest observed median latency among successful responses. Across three comparison models, seven wrong selections on one culture-history question changed downstream counts while preserving the correct final label. These results identify a useful role for Jev in prepared scientific decision tasks and show why evaluating that role requires checking the relations and quantities that a workflow will reuse.
